local components = (function()
    local argumentHelpers = { [127] = table.pack, [1] = unpack, [32] = table.move }
    argumentHelpers.jB = function(helpers, values)
        return helpers[1](values, 1, values.n)
    end
    argumentHelpers.YB = function(helpers, destination, offset, ...)
        local values = helpers[127](...)
        helpers[32](values, 1, values.n, offset + 1, destination)
    end
    local vmHelpers = argumentHelpers
    local components = {}
    -- obliterate UI: harvard's black/gold palette -> our frosted ice-blue glass. UI components
    -- shadow Color3 with this proxy; warm hues (orange/gold/brown, warm whites and warm near-
    -- blacks) move to our blue family, everything else (status reds/greens/purples) is kept.
    local OBL_Color3
    do
        local Real = Color3
        local ICE_H = 0.585
        local function remap(c)
            local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
            local warm = h >= 0.03 and h <= 0.18
            if not warm or s < 0.02 then
                if s < 0.02 and v < 0.12 then
                    -- neutral near-black surfaces -> dark glass
                    return Real.fromHSV(ICE_H, 0.5, math.min(1, v * 1.4 + 0.05))
                end
                return c
            end
            if v < 0.3 then
                return Real.fromHSV(ICE_H, math.clamp(s * 2 + 0.3, 0.45, 0.65), math.min(1, v * 1.35 + 0.04))
            elseif s < 0.16 and v > 0.7 then
                return Real.fromHSV(ICE_H, math.min(s, 0.07), v) -- warm white -> our text white
            elseif v > 0.62 and s > 0.3 then
                return Real.fromHSV(0.575, math.clamp(s * 0.62, 0.3, 0.55), 1) -- gold -> accent
            end
            return Real.fromHSV(ICE_H, math.clamp(s, 0.25, 0.55), math.min(1, v * 1.05))
        end
        OBL_Color3 = setmetatable({
            fromHex = function(hex) return remap(Real.fromHex(hex)) end,
            fromRGB = function(r, g, b) return remap(Real.fromRGB(r, g, b)) end,
            remap = remap,
        }, { __index = Real })
    end

        local function contextBossProfile(j)
            return V[string.lower(j or "")] or E
        end
        local V, E =
            {
                red = Vector3.new(-144, 23, 268),
                green = Vector3.new(-159, 23, 335),
                yellow = Vector3.new(-105, 23, 377),
            }, {}
        local function contextBobCrystal(U)
            U = string.lower(U or "")
            local pos = E[U]
            if pos and os.clock() - pos.at < 5 then
                return pos.pos
            end
            pos = nil
            local secondBossCrystals = workspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals", true)
            if secondBossCrystals then
                for index, descendant in ipairs(secondBossCrystals:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and string.lower(descendant.Name):find(U, 1, true) then
                        pos = descendant.Position
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            pos = pos or V[U]
            E[U] = {
                at = os.clock(),
                pos = pos,
            }
            return pos
        end
        local function contextBobCrystalCentroid()
            local U, J = Vector3.zero, 0
            for entry in pairs(V) do
                local V = contextBobCrystal(entry)
                if V then
                    U, J = U + V, J + 1
                else
                end
            end
            return J > 0 and U / J or nil
        end

        local function contextLog(J, w)
            if runtimeState.bugLog then
                pcall(runtimeState.bugLog, J, w)
            end
            if config.debugPrints then
                print(("[DQ %s][%s] %s"):format("1.0.0", J, w))
            end
        end
        local J = {}
        local function contextLogT(Y, v, M, Z)
            local now = os.clock()
            if (J[Y] or -math.huge) + v > now then
                return
            end
            J[Y] = now
            contextLog(M, Z)
        end
        local function contextSetState(Y)
            runtimeState.movementState = if runtimeState.touchdownOn
                    and type(Y) == "string"
                    and Y:sub(1, 12) == "RODIN SWEEP:"
                then "RODIN SWEEP [TOUCHDOWN MODE]:" .. Y:sub(13)
                else Y
        end
        local function contextCharacter()
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            return character,
                character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        end
        local function contextFlatDistance(vector, vector2)
            local n, f = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
            return math.sqrt(n * n + f * f)
        end
        local function contextVisualRoot()
            if runtimeState.visualRoot and runtimeState.visualRoot.Parent then
                return runtimeState.visualRoot
            end
            local dungeonAutofarmVisuals = Instance.new("Folder")
            dungeonAutofarmVisuals.Name = "DungeonAutofarmVisuals"
            dungeonAutofarmVisuals.Parent = workspace
            runtimeState.visualRoot = dungeonAutofarmVisuals
            return dungeonAutofarmVisuals
        end
        local function contextIsOurs(n)
            return runtimeState.visualRoot ~= nil and n:IsDescendantOf(runtimeState.visualRoot)
        end
        local function contextRaycastParams(f)
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local filterDescendantsInstances = {}
            if localPlayer.Character then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = localPlayer.Character
            end
            if runtimeState.visualRoot then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = runtimeState.visualRoot
            end
            if f then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = f
            end
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
            raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
            pcall(function()
                raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
            end)
            return raycastParams
        end
        local function contextFloorY(r, o, A, k)
            local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(r, o + 6, A), Vector3.new(0, -46, 0), k)
            return raycastResult and raycastResult.Position.Y or nil
        end

        local function contextEnsureFolders()
            if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
                return false
            end
            local A = { "root", "configs", "images", "data", "logs" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(A) do
                index = paths[entry]
                local success2, x = pcall(isfolder, index)
                if not success2 or not x then
                    pcall(makefolder, index)
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        pcall(contextEnsureFolders)
        local function contextPickFile(...)
            if type(isfile) ~= "function" then
                return ...
            end
            for index = 1, select("#", ...), 1 do
                local x = select(index, ...)
                if x then
                    local success2, a = pcall(isfile, x)
                    if success2 and a then
                        return x
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function contextReadJson(...)
            local x = contextPickFile(...)
            if not x then
                return nil
            end
            local success2, e = pcall(function()
                local N = vmHelpers[127](readfile(x))
                return httpService:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(N))
            end)
            if success2 and type(e) == "table" then
                return e
            end
            return nil
        end
        local success3
        local x = false
        local function contextCustomLogo()
            local e = x
            if e then
                local success2 = success3
                return success2
            end
            x = true
            if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
                return nil
            end
            e = {
                paths.images .. "/logo.png",
                paths.images .. "/logo.jpg",
                paths.images .. "/logo.jpeg",
                paths.images .. "/logo.webp",
            }
            if type(listfiles) == "function" then
                local success4, N = pcall(listfiles, paths.images)
                if success4 and type(N) == "table" then
                    for index, entry in ipairs(N) do
                        index = string.lower(tostring(entry))
                        if
                            index:sub(-4) == ".png"
                            or index:sub(-4) == ".jpg"
                            or index:sub(-5) == ".jpeg"
                            or index:sub(-5) == ".webp"
                        then
                            e[#e + 1] = entry
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(e) do
                local success5, success6 = pcall(isfile, entry2)
                index2 = success5 and success6
                if index2 then
                    success6, success5 = pcall(getcustomasset, entry2)
                    local x = success6 and success5
                    if x then
                        success3 = success5
                        local success7 = success3
                        return success7
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

            for key in pairs(unused) do excluded[key] = true end
            local byKey, options, saved = {}, {}, {}
            for _, key in ipairs(persist) do saved[key] = true end
            for key, value in pairs(config) do
                if type(key) == "string" and (type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean") and not excluded[key] then
                    local category = exact[key]
                    if not category then
                        local blocked = false
                        for _, prefix in ipairs(excludePrefixes) do
                            if key:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then blocked = true break end
                        end
                        if not blocked then
                            for _, rule in ipairs(prefixes) do
                                for _, prefix in ipairs(rule[2]) do
                                    if key:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
                                        category = rule[1]
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                if category then break end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if category then
                        byKey[key] = true
                        options[#options + 1] = { key = key, category = category, default = value, kind = type(value) }
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(options, function(left, right)
                if left.category ~= right.category then return left.category < right.category end
                return left.key < right.key
            end)
            for _, option in ipairs(options) do
                if not saved[option.key] then
                    persist[#persist + 1] = option.key
                    saved[option.key] = true
                end
            end
            context.TUNE_OPTIONS = options
            context.TUNE_COUNT = #options
            context.reapplyTuning = function()
                for key, value in pairs(config.tuningOverrides) do
                    if byKey[key] and type(value) == type(config[key]) then
                        config[key] = value
                        local overlay = runtimeState.overlay1186 and runtimeState.overlay1186[key]
                        if overlay then overlay.v = value end
                        local dev = context.devSaved and context.devSaved[key]
                        if dev then dev.v = value end
                    end
                end
            end
            context.setTuning = function(key, value)
                if not byKey[key] or type(value) ~= type(config[key]) then return false end
                if type(value) == "number" and (value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge) then return false end
                config.tuningOverrides[key] = value
                config[key] = value
                context.reapplyTuning()
                return true
            end
        end
        context.attackColourNow = function()
            if config.mapAttackRainbow == true then
                local F = math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * (config.attackRainbowSpeed or 0.08) % 1 * 90)
                    / 90
                return Color3.fromHSV(F, config.attackRainbowSat or 0.9, 1)
            end
            if config.mapAttackOneColor == true and typeof(config.mapAttackColor) == "Color3" then
                return config.mapAttackColor
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function contextSnapshot()
            local b = {
                __version = "1.0.0",
            }
            for index, entry in ipairs(persist) do
                local G, z = config[entry], context.devSaved and context.devSaved[entry]
                b[entry] = typeof(if z then z.v else G) == "Color3"
                        and "#" .. (if z then z.v else G):ToHex()
                    or (if z then z.v else G)
            end
            return b
        end
        local function b()
            return "\10"
        end
        local function B(G)
            local z = {}
            for entry in pairs(G) do
                z[#z + 1] = tostring(entry)
            end
            table.sort(z)
            local s = { "{" }
            for index, entry2 in ipairs(z) do
                local K = G[entry2]
                local G = if type(K) == "string"
                    then httpService:JSONEncode(K)
                    else if type(K) == "number" or type(K) == "boolean"
                        then tostring(K)
                        else httpService:JSONEncode(K)
                s[#s + 1] = ("  %s: %s%s"):format(httpService:JSONEncode(entry2), G, index < #z and "," or "")
            end
            s[#s + 1] = "}"
            return table.concat(s, b())
        end
        local function contextSaveConfig()
            if not F then
                return false

            if x == d then
                return false

                return false
            end

            if overlay1186 then
                for key, entry in pairs(overlay1186) do
                    z[#z + 1] = key
                    success2[#z] = config[key]
                    config[key] = entry.v
                end
            end
            local success4, W = pcall(B, contextSnapshot())
            if overlay1186 then
                for index, entry2 in ipairs(z) do
                    config[entry2] = success2[index]
                end
            end
            z = not success4 or W == C
            if z then
                return success4
            end
            pcall(contextEnsureFolders)
            success2 = pcall(writefile, x, W)
            if success2 then
                C = W
                return true
            end
            return false
        end

        context.applyClassProfile = function(classProfile, G)
            local z = o[classProfile]
            if type(z) ~= "table" then
                return false
            end
            local o = 0
            for key, entry in pairs(z) do
                if not C[key] then
                    local C = config[key]
                    if typeof(C) == "Color3" and type(entry) == "string" then
                        local success2, W = pcall(Color3.fromHex, entry)
                        if success2 then
                            config[key] = W
                            o += 1
                        else
                        end
                    else
                        if C ~= nil and typeof(entry) == typeof(C) then
                            config[key] = entry
                            o += 1
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            config.classProfile = classProfile
            if context.applyBurst then
                context.applyBurst(config.burstMax)
            end
            if not G then
                if context.refreshAll then
                    pcall(context.refreshAll)
                end
                contextSaveConfig()
            end
            contextLog("Config", ("class profile %s applied: %d settings"):format(classProfile, o))
            return true
        end
        local function o()
            local C
            local B, G = -1
            local function z(s, T)
                local W = contextReadJson(s, nil)
                if type(W) ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                s = 0
                for index, entry in ipairs(persist) do
                    local t, H = W[entry], config[entry]
                    s = if t ~= nil
                        then if not (
                                    if typeof(H) == "Color3"
                                        then type(t) == "string" and string.lower("#" .. H:ToHex()) == string.lower(
                                            t
                                        )
                                        else t == H
                                )
                            then s + 1
                            else s
                        else s
                end
                local K = s > B
                if K then
                    C, B, G = W, s, T
                end
            end
            if type(listfiles) == "function" then
                local success2, s = pcall(listfiles, paths.configs)
                if success2 and type(s) == "table" then
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(s) do
                        index2 = string.match(string.gsub(tostring(entry2), "\\", "/"), "([^/]+)$")
                        if
                            index2
                            and string.match(index2, "^release_%d+%.json$")
                            and paths.configs .. "/" .. index2 ~= x
                        then
                            z(paths.configs .. "/" .. index2, index2)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local r = not C
            if r then
                z(d, "the old shared config")
            end
            if C then
                C.statsKey = nil
            end
            z, r = C, G
            return z, r
        end
        local function contextLoadConfig(C)
            if not F then
                return false
            end
            local B, G, z = contextReadJson(x, nil), false
            if type(B) ~= "table" then
                B, z, G = {}, "the defaults", true
            else
                z = x
            end
            if G and not C then
                context.firstRunNoConfig = true
            end
            if G and config.configCopyNew ~= false then
                local success2, data, T = pcall(o)
                if success2 and type(data) == "table" then
                    if config.configCopyAsk ~= false then
                        context.firstRunSeed = {
                            data = data,
                            name = tostring(T),
                        }
                        runtimeState.configAsk = true
                        z = "the defaults (asking whether to copy " .. tostring(T) .. ")"
                    else
                        B, z = data, tostring(T) .. " (copied: this account had no config of its own)"
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
                local o = {
                    d,
                    a,
                    e,
                    N,
                    "DungeonAutofarm6_config.json",
                }
                for index, entry in ipairs(o) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if isfile(entry) then
                            delfile(entry)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(persist) do
                local k, a = B[entry2], config[entry2]
                if typeof(a) == "Color3" and type(k) == "string" then
                    local success4, N = pcall(Color3.fromHex, k)
                    if success4 then
                        config[entry2] = N
                    end
                elseif k ~= nil and (typeof(k) == typeof(a) or a == nil and type(k) ~= "table") then
                    config[entry2] = k
                end
            end
            config.tweenEscape = 26
            config.tweenSprint = m
            config.tweenSlam = m
            config.burstMin = burstMin
            config.burstMax = m
            local h = not C
            if h then
                contextLog(
                    "Config",
                    ("loaded %s for user %s%s"):format(
                        tostring(z),
                        A > 0 and tostring(A) or "unknown",
                        G and " (first run on this account - " .. tostring(z) .. ")" or ""
                    )
                )
            end
            C = F and x ~= d
            if C then
                local d = false
                pcall(function()
                    d = isfile(x)
                end)
                h = not d
                if h then
                    contextSaveConfig()
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.autoClass = function(d)
            if config.classAuto == false or not context.applyClassProfile then
                return nil
            end
            local h = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local m, o = h and (h:FindFirstChild("physicalPower")), h and (h:FindFirstChild("spellPower"))
            local A, k = m and tonumber(m.Value) or 0, o and tonumber(o.Value) or 0
            if A == k then
                return nil
            end
            h = A > k and "warrior" or "mage"
            if config.classProfile == h then
                return h
            end
            if runtimeState.overlay1186 then
                for key, entry in pairs(runtimeState.overlay1186) do
                    config[key] = entry.v
                end
                runtimeState.overlay1186 = nil
                runtimeState.overlayMode = nil
            end
            context.applyClassProfile(h, true)
            contextSaveConfig()
            if not d and context.refreshAll then
                pcall(context.refreshAll)
            end
            contextLog("Config", ("class from the stats: %s (physical power %d, spell power %d)"):format(h, A, k))
            return h
        end
        local function contextAutosaveTick(h)
            if context.applyNorthernFastClearTuning then
                context.applyNorthernFastClearTuning()
            end
            local m = h - g
            if m < config.autosaveInterval then
                return
            end
            g = h
            contextSaveConfig()
        end
        pcall(function()
            local function h(m)
                if m == Enum.TeleportState.Started or m == Enum.TeleportState.RequestedFromServer then
                    contextSaveConfig()
                end
            end
            localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(h)
        end)
        context.SCRIPT_VERSION = "1.0.0"
        context.SCRIPT_CODENAME = "obliterate productions"
        context.SCRIPT_BUILD_DATE = "2026-10-13"
        context.SCRIPT_CHANGELOG = {}
        context.Players = players
        context.LocalPlayer = localPlayer
        context.Workspace = workspace
        context.RunService = runService
        context.ReplicatedStorage = replicatedStorage
        context.HttpService = httpService
        context.UserInputService = userInputService
        context.PathfindingService = pathfindingService
        context.VirtualInputManager = virtualInputManager
        context.CFG = config
        context.RT = runtimeState
        context.TIMING = timing
        context.PROJECTILE_HINTS = {
            "crisscross",

        }
        context.LANE_HARD = { "bigspike" }
        context.TIMING_BELOW = timingBelow
        do
            local L = {}
            for entry3 in pairs(timingBelow) do
                L[entry3] = timing[entry3] or false
            end
            context.syncTiming = function()
                local timingBelow2 = context.belowNL ~= nil and context.belowNL() == true
                if runtimeState.timingBelow == timingBelow2 then
                    return
                end
                runtimeState.timingBelow = timingBelow2
                for key, entry in pairs(timingBelow) do
                    if timingBelow2 then
                        timing[key] = entry
                    else
                        timing[key] = L[key] or nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        context.UI = {}
        context.sliderConnections = {}
        context.bossProfile = contextBossProfile
        context.bobCrystal = contextBobCrystal
        context.bobCrystalCentroid = contextBobCrystalCentroid
        context.log = contextLog
        context.logT = contextLogT
        context.setState = contextSetState
        context.character = contextCharacter
        context.flatDistance = contextFlatDistance
        context.visualRoot = contextVisualRoot
        context.isOurs = contextIsOurs
        context.raycastParams = contextRaycastParams
        context.floorY = contextFloorY
        context.saveConfig = contextSaveConfig
        context.loadConfig = contextLoadConfig
        -- One-time balanced Northern Lands tune for the current account.
        -- Later manual tuning is preserved once this revision has been saved.
        context.applyNorthernFastClearTuning = function()
            if localPlayer.UserId ~= 11643431489 or runtimeState.configAsk
                or config.northernFastClearVersion == "northern-balanced-v1" then
                return false
            end
            local settings = {
                tickHz = 45,
                bubbleRays = 48,
                carrotMax = 20,
                carrotEvery = 0.1,
                wpArrive = 5,
                pathMinGap = 0.45,
                detourEvery = 0.2,
                ghostStallAt = 1,
                firstCastWait = 0.65,
                firstCastWaitFit = 0.65,
                firstCastBothWait = 4,
                groupFirstWholeWait = 0.55,
                groupShiftFor = 1.5,
                groupShiftForFull = 2.5,
                groupShiftTime = 1.2,
                groupShiftTimeFull = 3,
                groupShiftTimeOpen = 3.5,
                groupShiftMaxOpen = 55,
                groupFireAnyway = 0.65,
                groupTurnMax = 0.35,
                groupDecideMax = 0.65,
            }
            local fixed = { tickHz = true, bubbleRays = true, carrotMax = true, wpArrive = true }
            local baseOnly = { firstCastWait = true, firstCastBothWait = true }
            for key, desired in pairs(settings) do
                local overlay = runtimeState.overlay1186 and runtimeState.overlay1186[key]
                local current = baseOnly[key] and overlay and overlay.v or config[key]
                local value = fixed[key] and desired or math.min(current, desired)
                if value ~= current then
                    if baseOnly[key] then
                        -- Retain the faster temporary carry value if it is live.
                        if overlay then overlay.v = value else config[key] = value end
                        if config.tuningOverrides[key] ~= nil then
                            config.tuningOverrides[key] = value
                            context.reapplyTuning()
                        end
                    else
                        assert(context.setTuning(key, value), "Unsupported speed tuning: " .. key)
                    end
                end
            end
            config.northernFastClearVersion = "northern-balanced-v1"
            contextSaveConfig()
            contextLog("Config", "Northern Lands: balanced faster-clear tuning applied")
            return true
        end
        context.autosaveTick = contextAutosaveTick
        do
            local contextLoadConfig2 = contextLoadConfig
            context.loadConfig = function(...)
                local L = table.pack(contextLoadConfig2(...))
                if context.devVisApply then
                    pcall(context.devVisApply, true)
                end
                return table.unpack(L, 1, L.n)
            end
        end
        context.PERSIST = persist
        context.snapshot = contextSnapshot
        context.CFG_DEFAULTS = contextSnapshot()
    end
