        local function normalizeItemName(itemName)
            return (
                string
                    .lower(tostring(itemName or ""))
                    :gsub("\226\128\153", "'")
                    :gsub("\226\128\152", "'")
                    :gsub("\226\128\147", "-")
                    :gsub("\226\128\148", "-")
                    :gsub("%s+", " ")
                    :gsub("^%s+", "")
                    :gsub("%s+$", "")
            )
        end
        local armorAliases, armorLookupCache = {}, {}
        do
            local _ = {}
            local function addArmorAlias(aliasName, profileName)
                aliasName = normalizeItemName(aliasName)
                local entry = profilesByName[profileName]
                if aliasName == "" or _[aliasName] or not entry or not entry.a then
                    return
                end
                _[aliasName] = true
                armorAliases[#armorAliases + 1] = {
                    alias = aliasName,
                    entry = entry,
                }
            end
            for key, entry2 in pairs(profilesByName) do
                if entry2.a then
                    addArmorAlias(key, key)
                end
            end
            for index, entry3 in ipairs(profileAliases) do
                addArmorAlias(entry3[1], entry3[2])
            end
            addArmorAlias("crystalline guardian", "crystalline guadian")
            addArmorAlias("rogue guardian", "rouge guardian")
            addArmorAlias("rogue", "rouge")
            table.sort(armorAliases, function(O, _)
                if #O.alias ~= #_.alias then
                    return #O.alias > #_.alias
                end
                return O.alias < _.alias
            end)
        end
        local function findGearProfile(itemName, itemType)
            if itemType == "ability" then
                return nil
            end
            local c = normalizeItemName(itemName)
            if c == "" then
                return nil
            end
            if profilesByName[c] then
                return profilesByName[c]
            end
            if itemType ~= "chest" and itemType ~= "helmet" then
                return nil
            end
            if armorLookupCache[c] ~= nil then
                return armorLookupCache[c] or nil
            end
            for index2, entry in ipairs(armorAliases) do
                if c:find(entry.alias, 1, true) then
                    armorLookupCache[c] = entry.entry
                    return entry.entry
                end
            end
            armorLookupCache[c] = false
            return nil
        end
        gearProfiles.entryFor = findGearProfile
        local rarityRanks = {
            common = 1,
            uncommon = 2,
            rare = 3,
            epic = 4,
        }
        gearProfiles.maxPotential = function(S, D)
            local P, _ = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(D) or 0)), (math.floor(S + 0.5))
            while P > 0 and _ < 200 do
                _ += math.clamp(math.floor(_ / 20), 1, 10)
                P = P - 1
            end
            return if P > 0 then _ + P * 10 else _
        end
        local function validatedMaxPotential(statValue, remainingUpgrades)
            statValue = tonumber(statValue)
            if not statValue or statValue ~= statValue or math.abs(statValue) == math.huge then
                return nil
            end
            return gearProfiles.maxPotential(statValue, remainingUpgrades)
        end
        local function selectStatRange(P, _, l, c)
            local u = P.t
            if not u or #u == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            P = rarityRanks[string.lower(tostring(_ or ""))]
            if P and u[P] then
                return u[P]
            end
            P, _ = nil
            for index2, entry in ipairs(u) do
                index2 = if c > 0 and entry[2] > 0
                    then if c >= entry[1] and c <= entry[2]
                        then -1000000000
                        else 0 + math.min(math.abs(c - entry[1]), math.abs(c - entry[2]))
                    else 0
                index2 = if l > 0
                    then if l >= entry[5] and l <= entry[6]
                        then index2 - 1000000000
                        else if l < entry[5] then index2 + entry[5] - l else index2 + l - entry[6]
                    else index2
                if not P or index2 < P then
                    P, _ = index2, entry
                else
                end
            end
            return _
        end
        gearProfiles.primaryKey = function(L, P)
            local _, l, c, u =
                tonumber(L.physicalDamage or L.physicalPower),
                tonumber(L.spellPower),
                tonumber(L.health),
                findGearProfile(L.name, P)
            L = string.lower(u and u.c or "")
            if L:find("guardian") and c then
                return "health"
            end
            if L:find("mage") and l then
                return "spellPower"
            end
            if P == "weapon" and L:find("war") and _ then
                return "physicalDamage"
            end
            if P == "weapon" and _ and l then
                return _ >= l and "physicalDamage" or "spellPower"
            end
            if _ and l and math.max(_, l) >= 200 and math.max(_, l) > math.min(_, l) * 5 then
                return _ > l and "physicalDamage" or "spellPower"
            end
            return c and "health" or _ and "physicalDamage" or l and "spellPower" or nil
        end
        local function getPrimaryStat(P, _)
            local l = gearProfiles.primaryKey(P, _)
            if l == "health" then
                return tonumber(P.health)
            end
            if l == "spellPower" then
                return tonumber(P.spellPower)
            end
            if l then
                return tonumber(P.physicalDamage or P.physicalPower)
            end
            return nil
        end
        gearProfiles.compute = function(P, _)
            if type(P) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            local l = findGearProfile(P.name, _)
            if not l then
                return nil
            end
            local O = getPrimaryStat(P, _)
            if not O then
                return nil
            end
            local L, c = tonumber(P.currentUpgrade) or 0, tonumber(P.maxUpgrades) or 0
            _ = validatedMaxPotential(O, math.max(0, c - L))
            if not _ then
                return nil
            end
            L = selectStatRange(l, P.rarity, _, c)
            if not L then
                return nil
            end
            c, l = tonumber(L[5]), tonumber(L[6])
            if not c or not l then
                return nil
            end
            L = l > c and (_ - c) / (l - c) * 100 or (_ >= l and 100 or 0)
            return math.floor(math.clamp(L, 0, 100) * 10 + 0.5) / 10
        end
        local inventoryTables = {}
        local lastInventoryScan = -1000000000
        local function scanInventoryTables(D)
            local P = type(getgc) ~= "function"
                or os.clock() - lastInventoryScan < (tonumber(context.CFG.godpotRescan) or 8)
            if P then
                return
            end
            lastInventoryScan = os.clock()
            table.clear(inventoryTables)
            local d, O = {
                D,
            }, game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            P = O and (O:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
            D = P and (P:FindFirstChild("inventory"))
            O = D and (D:FindFirstChild("mainBackground"))
            D = O and (O:FindFirstChild("innerBackground"))
            P, O = D and (D:FindFirstChild("rightSideFrame")), {}
            if P and (P:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")) then
                O[#O + 1] = P.ScrollingFrame
            end
            if D and (D:FindFirstChild("leftSideFrame")) then
                O[#O + 1] = D.leftSideFrame
            end
            P = {}
            for index2, entry in ipairs(O) do
                for index3, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                    D, index3 = child:FindFirstChild("itemType"), child:FindFirstChild("uniqueItemNum", true)
                    child = D and tostring(D.Value)
                    if
                        index3
                        and child
                        and not P[child]
                        and (child == "weapon" or child == "chest" or child == "helmet" or child == "ability")
                    then
                        P[child] = true
                        d[#d + 1] = child .. "_" .. tostring(index3.Value)
                    end
                end
            end
            for index4, entry4 in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
                if type(entry4) == "table" then
                    for index5, entry5 in ipairs(d) do
                        D = rawget(entry4, entry5)
                        if type(D) == "table" and rawget(D, "UniqueItemID") then
                            inventoryTables[#inventoryTables + 1] = entry4
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        gearProfiles.gearFor = function(d, O, D, P)
            if type(getgc) ~= "function" or not d or d == "none" then
                return nil
            end
            local _ = d .. "_" .. tostring(O)
            for index2 = 1, 2, 1 do
                for index3, entry in ipairs(inventoryTables) do
                    index3 = rawget(entry, _)
                    if type(index3) == "table" and (not D or D == "" or tostring(index3.imageId) == D) then
                        return index3
                    end
                    if P and D then
                        for key2, entry4 in pairs(entry) do
                            if
                                type(key2) == "string"
                                and key2:sub(1, #d + 1) == d .. "_"
                                and type(entry4) == "table"
                                and entry4.equipped == true
                                and tostring(entry4.imageId) == D
                            then
                                return entry4
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if index2 == 1 then
                    scanInventoryTables(_)
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        gearProfiles.forItem = function(d, L, O, S)
            local D = gearProfiles.gearFor(d, L, O, S)
            return D and gearProfiles.compute(D, d) or nil
        end
        gearProfiles.color = function(d)
            if d >= 99 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(155, 255, 220)
            end
            if d >= 90 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(105, 235, 135)
            end
            if d >= 75 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(190, 230, 105)
            end
            if d >= 50 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 105)
            end
            if d >= 25 then
                return Color3.fromRGB(255, 166, 90)
            end
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 120)
        end
    end

    components.movementBoost = function(context)
        local config, runtimeState = context.CFG, context.RT
        local localPlayer, speedSettings =
            context.LocalPlayer, {
                TargetSpeed = 24,
                MinSpeed = 18,
                MaxSpeed = 26,
                FallbackSpeed = 16,
            }
        local character = localPlayer.Character
        local humanoid, boostEnabled, originalWalkSpeed, moverHeading =
            character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), false
        local function ensureCharacter()
            local u = character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Parent
            if u then
                return true
            end
            character = localPlayer.Character
            humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            u = humanoid
            return u ~= nil
        end
        local function setMoverHeading(moverHeading2)
            moverHeading = moverHeading2
            runtimeState.moverHeading = moverHeading2
        end
        local targetSpeed = speedSettings.TargetSpeed
        local function enableSpeedBoost(R)
            local y = not ensureCharacter()
            if y then
                local q = targetSpeed
                return q
            end
            local q, locomotionSpeed =
                math.clamp(
                    tonumber(R) or speedSettings.TargetSpeed,
                    speedSettings.MinSpeed,
                    speedSettings.MaxSpeed
                ),
                boostEnabled
            if locomotionSpeed then
                R = math.abs(q - targetSpeed) >= 2
                if R then
                    targetSpeed = q
                end
                y = humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= targetSpeed
                if y then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
                end
                runtimeState.locomotionSpeed = targetSpeed
                local y = targetSpeed
                return y
            end
            boostEnabled, targetSpeed = true, q
            originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed > 0 and humanoid.WalkSpeed or nil
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
            locomotionSpeed = nil
            locomotionSpeed, runtimeState.locomotion = targetSpeed, true
            runtimeState.locomotionSpeed = locomotionSpeed
            R = targetSpeed
            return R
        end
        local function disableSpeedBoost()
            moverHeading = nil
            runtimeState.moverHeading = nil
            local y = boostEnabled
            if not y then
                return
            end
            boostEnabled = false
            runtimeState.locomotion = false
            runtimeState.locomotionSpeed = nil
            y = ensureCharacter()
            if y then
                local humanoid2 = humanoid
                humanoid2.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or speedSettings.FallbackSpeed
            end
            originalWalkSpeed = nil
        end
        local characterAddedConnection = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
            character = newCharacter
            humanoid, boostEnabled, originalWalkSpeed, moverHeading =
                newCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), false, nil, nil
            runtimeState.moverHeading = nil
            runtimeState.locomotion = false
            runtimeState.locomotionSpeed = nil
        end)
        local function stopSpeedBoost()
            disableSpeedBoost()
            local connection = characterAddedConnection
            if connection then
                characterAddedConnection:Disconnect()
                characterAddedConnection = nil
            end
        end
        context.LC = {
            on = enableSpeedBoost,
            off = disableSpeedBoost,
            steer = setMoverHeading,
            stop = stopSpeedBoost,
            CONFIG = speedSettings,
            active = function()
                return false
            end,
            boosted = function()
                local d = boostEnabled
                return d
            end,
            speed = function()
                local d = boostEnabled and targetSpeed or nil
                return d
            end,
        }
    end

    components.hazardReader = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local timing = context.TIMING
        local projectileHints = context.PROJECTILE_HINTS
        local attackCatalog = context.ATTACKS
        local ourAttacks = context.OURS
        local workspace = context.Workspace
        local replicatedStorage = context.ReplicatedStorage
        local players = context.Players
        local localPlayer = context.LocalPlayer
        local contextLog = context.log
        local contextLogT = context.logT
        local contextIsOurs = context.isOurs
        local contextCharacter = context.character
        local contextFlatDistance = context.flatDistance
        local lowercase = string.lower
        local min = math.huge
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local abs = math.abs
        local max = math.max
        local min2, hazardReader, v, M =
            math.min, {
                models = {},
                parts = {},
                zones = {},
                enemies = {},
                walls = {},
                beams = {},
                connections = {},
                spawns = {},
                spawnSet = {},
                watch = {},
                twinSeen = {},
            }, setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",
            }
        hazardReader.spent = v({}, M)
        M, v = setmetatable, {
            __mode = "k",
        }
        hazardReader.hitSize = M({}, v)
        M, v = setmetatable, {
            __mode = "k",
        }
        hazardReader.seen = M({}, v)
        M, v = setmetatable, {
            __mode = "k",
        }
        hazardReader.shown = M({}, v)
        hazardReader.safeSpots = {}
        hazardReader.safeField = nil
        hazardReader.fanUntil = -min
        hazardReader.lastSweep = -min
        hazardReader.lastEnemyScan = -min
        hazardReader.lastShow = -min
        hazardReader.count = 0
        local v = {
            Map = true,
            dungeon = true,
            enemies = true,
            Terrain = true,
            Lobby = true,
            Camera = true,
        }
        local function contextGameClock()
            if config.clockServerTime ~= false then
                return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            end
            local timeSync = hazardReader.timeSync
            if timeSync then
                local success, f = pcall(timeSync.GetTime, timeSync)
                if success and type(f) == "number" then
                    return f
                end
            end
            return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end
        local function serverTimestampToLocalClock(serverTimestamp)
            return os.clock() + (serverTimestamp - contextGameClock())
        end
        local function getLagAdjustedServerTime()
            local timeSync = hazardReader.timeSync
            if timeSync then
                local success, o = pcall(timeSync.GetTime, timeSync)
                if success and type(o) == "number" then
                    return o
                end
            end
            return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (config.syncLag or 0.93)
        end
        local function adjustedTimestampToLocalClock(serverTimestamp)
            return os.clock() + (serverTimestamp - getLagAdjustedServerTime())
        end
        local function contextFootprint(zone, cframe, size, round, cyl)
            local position = cframe.Position
            zone.cx, zone.cz, zone.cy = position.X, position.Z, position.Y
            if cyl then
                zone.r, zone.hy = size.Y * 0.5, size.X * 0.5
            elseif round then
                zone.r, zone.hy = size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5
            else
                zone.r = nil
                local rightVector, N, lookVector = cframe.RightVector, cframe.UpVector, cframe.LookVector
                local F, C, g = abs(rightVector.Y), abs(N.Y), abs(lookVector.Y)
                local i, b
                if C >= F and C >= g then
                    zone.ha, zone.hb, zone.hy = size.X * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5
                    i, b = rightVector, lookVector
                else
                    if F >= g then
                        zone.ha, zone.hb, zone.hy = size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5, size.X * 0.5
                        i, b = N, lookVector
                    else
                        zone.ha, zone.hb, zone.hy = size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                        i, b = rightVector, N
                    end
                end
                F, N = max(sqrt(i.X * i.X + i.Z * i.Z), 0.001), max(sqrt(b.X * b.X + b.Z * b.Z), 0.001)
                zone.ax, zone.az, zone.bx, zone.bz = i.X / F, i.Z / F, b.X / N, b.Z / N
            end
            zone.cframe = cframe
            zone.size = size
            zone.round = round
            zone.cyl = cyl
            zone.moving = false
            return zone
        end
        local function detectRoundDimensions(A, vector)
            local rightVector, a, e = A.RightVector, A.UpVector, A.LookVector
            local N, I, F = abs(rightVector.Y), abs(a.Y), abs(e.Y)
            A, a, e = nil
            if I >= N and I >= F then
                A, a, e = vector.Y, vector.X, vector.Z
            else
                if N >= F then
                    A, a, e = vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z
                else
                    A, a, e = vector.Z, vector.X, vector.Y
                end
            end
            if a > 2 and e > 2 and abs(a - e) <= max(a, e) * (config.roundMeshTol or 0.1) then
                return max(a, e), A
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function detectRoundPart(k)
            local x = k:IsA("Part")
            if x and k.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
                local size = k.Size
                return true, max(size.X, size.Z), size.Y
            end
            if
                x and k:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil
                or not x and (k:IsA("MeshPart") or k:IsA("UnionOperation"))
            then
                local x, a = detectRoundDimensions(k.CFrame, k.Size)
                if x then
                    return true, x, a
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function contextAddZone(x)
            if not x.bubbleKeep then
                return
            end
            if not x.moving then
                contextFootprint(x, x.cframe, x.size, x.round, x.cyl)
            end
            hazardReader.zones[#hazardReader.zones + 1] = x
            hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
            if #hazardReader.zones > 240 then
                table.remove(hazardReader.zones, 1)
            end
        end
        local function contextDropZones(a, e)
            for index = #hazardReader.zones, 1, -1 do
                local I = hazardReader.zones[index]
                if I.madeAt and I.madeAt < e and I.name:sub(1, #a) == a then
                    table.remove(hazardReader.zones, index)
                end
            end
        end
        local function normalizeHalfTurnAngle(angleDegrees)
            angleDegrees %= 180
            return if angleDegrees > 90 then angleDegrees - 180 else angleDegrees
        end
        local function recordBeamSample(N, I)
            local F, beams = N.CFrame.LookVector, hazardReader.beams
            beams[#beams + 1] = {
                t = I,
                yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(F.X, F.Z)) % 180,
                hub = N.Position,
                size = N.Size,
            }
            hazardReader.hub = N.Position
            hazardReader.hubAt = I
            if #beams > 24 then
                table.remove(beams, 1)
            end
            F = 0
            for index = #beams, 1, -1 do
                if I - beams[index].t <= 0.5 then
                    F += 1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            if F >= 4 then
                if I > (hazardReader.fanUntil or -min) then
                    contextDropZones("slam incoming", I + 1)
                    hazardReader.fanStarts = hazardReader.fanStarts or {}
                    hazardReader.fanStarts[#hazardReader.fanStarts + 1] = I
                    while #hazardReader.fanStarts > 6 do
                        table.remove(hazardReader.fanStarts, 1)
                    end
                    local g = {}
                    for index2 = 2, #hazardReader.fanStarts, 1 do
                        local b = hazardReader.fanStarts[index2] - hazardReader.fanStarts[index2 - 1]
                        if b >= 5 and b <= 60 then
                            g[#g + 1] = b
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(g)
                    hazardReader.fanPeriod = #g > 0 and g[math.ceil(#g / 2)] or nil
                    hazardReader.lastFanStart = I
                end
                hazardReader.fanUntil = I + 4
                hazardReader.fanBeamAt = I
                local g, g, g = contextCharacter()
                if
                    config.fanDance == false
                    and (g and contextFlatDistance(g.Position, N.Position) or 0)
                        < config.fanRadius - 4
                then
                    runtimeState.reflex = {
                        name = "fan",
                        from = N.Position,
                        radius = config.fanRadius,
                        untilAt = I + 3.5,
                    }
                end
            end
            contextDropZones("beam next", I - 0.5)
            if F >= 4 then
                return
            end
            N, F = beams[#beams], 0
            for index3 = #beams - 1, 1, -1 do
                local i = beams[index3]
                local C, b = N.t - i.t, normalizeHalfTurnAngle(N.yaw - i.yaw)
                if C > 0.8 then
                    break
                end
                if C >= 0.08 and abs(b) >= 15 and abs(b) <= 25 then
                    hazardReader.fanSweep = b > 0 and 1 or -1
                    hazardReader.fanSweepAt = I
                    hazardReader.beamYaw, hazardReader.beamYawAt, hazardReader.beamRate = N.yaw, I, abs(b) / C
                    F += 1
                    for index4 = 1, 2, 1 do
                        i, index3 = math.rad(N.yaw + b * index4), I + C * index4
                        contextAddZone({
                            name = "beam next",
                            kind = "zone",
                            castRed = true,
                            bubbleKeep = true,
                            hardPending = true,
                            slim = 3,
                            cframe = CFrame.lookAt(N.hub, N.hub + Vector3.new(math.sin(i), 0, math.cos(i))),
                            size = N.size,
                            from = I,
                            untilAt = index3 + 1.16 + (config.beamHitTail or 0.2),
                            exact = true,
                            madeAt = I,
                        })
                    end
                    if F >= 2 then
                        break
                    end
                else
                end
            end
        end
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local function N(I, F, instance)
            local vector = F - I
            if vector.Magnitude < 1 then
                return false
            end
            local filterDescendantsInstances = {
                table.unpack(instance),
            }
            for index = 1, 6, 1 do
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
                index = workspace:Raycast(I, vector, raycastParams)
                if not index then
                    return false
                end
                instance = index.Instance
                local a = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                local I = a ~= nil and a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
                if
                    instance.CanCollide
                    and instance.Transparency < 0.95
                    and not I
                    and not hazardReader.parts[instance]
                    and hazardReader.models[a] == nil
                    and (index.Position - F).Magnitude > (config.orbShieldNear or 2)
                then
                    return true
                end
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = I and a or instance
            end
            return false
        end
        context.crystalShield = function(a, I, F, C, g, i)
            if config.crystalShield == false or not a or not I or not context.bobCrystal then
                return false
            end
            local b = context.bobCrystal(a)
            if not b then
                return false
            end
            local B, G = C - I, g - F
            g = B * B + G * G
            if g < 1 then
                return false
            end
            C = ((b.X - I) * B + (b.Z - F) * G) / g
            if C <= 0 or C >= 1 then
                return false
            end
            local z, s, T = I + B * C - b.X, F + G * C - b.Z, config.crystalShieldR or 6.5
            if z * z + s * s > T * T then
                return false
            end
            b = math.sqrt(g)
            if b * (1 - C) < (config.crystalShieldPast or 3) then
                return false
            end
            a = i and hazardReader.parts[i]
            if
                a
                and a.spawn
                and (config.orbFuse or 20) - (os.clock() - a.spawn)
                    < b * C / (config.orbSpeed or 17) + (config.crystalShieldFuse or 0.5)
            then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        context.orbColour = function(a)
            return a and a.Name and string.lower(tostring(a.Name)):match("secondboss(%a+)orb") or nil
        end
        context.bobOrbsOnMe = function()
            local a, bobOrbsMe = os.clock(), hazardReader.bobOrbsMe
            if bobOrbsMe and a >= bobOrbsMe.at and a - bobOrbsMe.at < (config.bobOrbsMeTTL or 0.004) then
                return bobOrbsMe
            end
            bobOrbsMe = {
                at = a,
            }
            a = not (context.otherRoots and #context.otherRoots() > 0)
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.parts or {}) do
                if key.Parent then
                    local colour = string.lower(key.Name):match("secondboss(%a+)orb")
                    if
                        colour
                        and (
                            entry.lineOwn == "me"
                            or entry.lineOwn == nil
                                and (entry.stick == "me" or a and entry.stick ~= "other")
                        )
                    then
                        local position = key.Position
                        bobOrbsMe[#bobOrbsMe + 1] = {
                            x = position.X,
                            z = position.Z,
                            colour = colour,
                            part = key,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            hazardReader.bobOrbsMe = bobOrbsMe
            return bobOrbsMe
        end
        context.wrongPillarOn = function(a, I, F, C, g)
            if not context.bobCrystal then
                return nil
            end
            local i, b = C - a, g - I
            local B, G, z, s = i * i + b * b, config.wrongPillarR or 13, math.huge, context.bobCrystal(F)
            if s and B > 1 then
                C = ((s.X - a) * i + (s.Z - I) * b) / B
                g = math.clamp(C, 0, 1)
                local T, W, K = a + i * g - s.X, I + b * g - s.Z, config.crystalShieldR or 6.5
                z = if C > 0 and T * T + W * W <= K * K then g else z
            else
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(config.bobColours or { "red", "green", "yellow" }) do
                if entry ~= F then
                    C = context.bobCrystal(entry)
                    if C then
                        g = B > 1 and math.clamp(((C.X - a) * i + (C.Z - I) * b) / B, 0, 1) or 1
                        s, index = a + i * g - C.X, I + b * g - C.Z
                        if s * s + index * index < G * G and g < z then
                            return entry
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.wrongPillarAt = function(a, vector)
            if config.wrongPillarGuard == false then
                return nil
            end
            local F = context.bobOrbsOnMe()
            if #F == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local C, g = (a.X + vector.X) * 0.5, (a.Z + vector.Z) * 0.5
            for index = 1, #F, 1 do
                a = F[index]
                index = context.wrongPillarOn(a.x, a.z, a.colour, vector.X, vector.Z)
                    or context.wrongPillarOn(a.x, a.z, a.colour, C, g)
                if index then
                    return index, a.colour
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.wrongPillarStep = function(a, I)
            local F, C = context.wrongPillarAt(a, I)
            if not F then
                return nil
            end
            if context.wrongPillarAt(a, a) then
                return nil
            end
            return F, C
        end
        context.orbNearShielded = function(a, I)
            local orbNear = hazardReader.orbNear
            return orbNear ~= nil
                and orbNear.x ~= nil
                and context.crystalShield(
                    orbNear.colour or context.orbColour(orbNear.part),
                    orbNear.x,
                    orbNear.z,
                    a,
                    I,
                    orbNear.part
                )
        end
        context.orbShielded = function(a, shielded)
            if config.orbPillarShield == false or not (a and a.Parent and shielded and shielded.Parent) then
                return false
            end
            local F, shieldAt = hazardReader.parts[a], os.clock()
            if F and F.shieldAt and shieldAt - F.shieldAt < (config.orbShieldEvery or 0.1) then
                return F.shielded == true
            end
            local position, position2, b, B =
                a.Position, shielded.Position, {
                    shielded.Parent,
                    a,
                }, context.orbColour(a)
            shielded = B ~= nil
                    and context.crystalShield(B, position.X, position.Z, position2.X, position2.Z, a)
                or N(position, Vector3.new(position2.X, position.Y, position2.Z), b)
                    and N(position, position2, b)
            if F then
                F.shieldAt = shieldAt
                F.shielded = shielded
            end
            return shielded
        end
        local function a(N, madeAt)
            local F, transform, size = N.Position, N.CFrame, N.Size
            N = size.X >= size.Z and transform.RightVector or transform.LookVector
            local i, b = N.X, N.Z
            N = math.sqrt(i * i + b * b)
            if N < 0.01 then
                return
            end
            i /= N
            b /= N
            N = math.deg(math.atan2(b, i))
            local from = math.floor((if N < 0 then N + 180 else N) / 6 + 0.5) % 30
            hazardReader.volleyRows = hazardReader.volleyRows or {}
            N = hazardReader.volleyRows[from]
            local vector = N and Vector3.new(F.X - N.pos.X, 0, F.Z - N.pos.Z) or nil
            local span = vector and vector.Magnitude or 0
            local s = N ~= nil
                and madeAt - N.t <= 0.4
                and span >= 6
                and span <= 40
                and math.abs(vector.X * i + vector.Z * b) / span <= 0.5
            local T = s and (N.n or 1) + 1 or 1
            hazardReader.volleyRows[from] = {
                t = madeAt,
                pos = F,
                n = T,
            }
            local W, K, rowDx, rowDz, X = not s
            if s then
                K, rowDx, rowDz = math.max(madeAt - N.t, 0.08), vector.X / span, vector.Z / span
                hazardReader.rowLearn = {
                    dt = K,
                    span = span,
                }
                X = span
            else
                local N = hazardReader.rowLearn
                X, K, rowDz = N and N.span or config.mageRowStep or 17, N and N.dt or config.mageRowDt or 0.15, -i
                local i, G = config.mageCasterNear or 6
                for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                    if entry.isMage and entry.root and entry.root.Parent then
                        N = math.sqrt((entry.x - F.X) ^ 2 + (entry.z - F.Z) ^ 2)
                        if N < i then
                            i, G = N, entry
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if G and G.root and G.root.Parent then
                    N = G.root.CFrame.LookVector
                    local i = math.sqrt(N.X * N.X + N.Z * N.Z)
                    if i > 0.01 then
                        rowDx, rowDz = N.X / i, N.Z / i
                    else
                        rowDx = b
                    end
                else
                    rowDx = b
                end
            end
            if not (rowDx and rowDz) then
                return
            end
            span = Vector3.new(rowDx * X, 0, rowDz * X)
            hazardReader.lastRowDir = {
                dx = rowDx,
                dz = rowDz,
                t = madeAt,
            }
            hazardReader.mageShotSeen = {
                t = madeAt,
                x = F.X,
                z = F.Z,
            }
            F = "volley next " .. tostring(from)
            contextDropZones(F, madeAt - 0.05)
            for index2 = 1, W and (config.mageRowAheadGuess or 2) or (config.mageRowAhead or 4), 1 do
                if T + index2 > (config.mageRowSlabs or 7) then
                    break
                end
                from = madeAt + K * index2
                contextAddZone({
                    name = F,
                    kind = "zone",
                    bubbleKeep = true,
                    hardPending = true,
                    exact = true,
                    weight = 1,
                    madeAt = madeAt,
                    slim = config.mageMargin,
                    noLead = W or nil,
                    cframe = transform + span * index2,
                    size = Vector3.new(size.X, max(size.Y, 12), size.Z),
                    from = from,
                    untilAt = from + (config.mageRowLive or 1.05) + (config.mageTail or 0.3),
                    telegraphed = true,
                    rowDx = rowDx,
                    rowDz = rowDz,
                })
            end
        end
        local function N(I, F)
            local pos = I.Position
            local size = max(I.Size.Y, I.Size.Z)
            I = hazardReader.lastCircle
            hazardReader.lastCircle = {
                t = F,
                pos = pos,
                size = size,
                chainAt = I and I.chainAt and F - I.t <= (config.bobChainGap or 2) and I.chainAt or F,
            }
            local i, magnitude, B, G
            local idx = I and I.chainAt and F - I.t <= (config.bobChainGap or 2) and (I.idx or 1) + 1 or 1
            hazardReader.lastCircle.idx = idx
            local s = context.PB ~= nil
                and context.PB.boss ~= nil
                and string.lower(tostring(context.PB.boss)):find("bob", 1, true) ~= nil
            if I and F - I.t < 0.6 then
                local vector, W = Vector3.new(pos.X - I.pos.X, 0, pos.Z - I.pos.Z), size - I.size
                if vector.Magnitude >= 8 and vector.Magnitude <= 45 and abs(W) <= 12 then
                    i, magnitude, B, G = vector.Unit, vector.Magnitude, W, max(F - I.t, 0.15)
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not i then
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if enemy.isBoss then
                        index = Vector3.new(pos.X - enemy.x, 0, pos.Z - enemy.z)
                        if index.Magnitude >= 5 then
                            i = index.Unit
                        else
                            if s and config.bobChainAim ~= false then
                                I = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
                                local T = I and (I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                                if T then
                                    local vector2 = Vector3.new(T.Position.X - pos.X, 0, T.Position.Z - pos.Z)
                                    i = if vector2.Magnitude >= 5 then vector2.Unit else i
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not i then
                return
            end
            if s then
                local circleChain, chainAt = hazardReader.circleChain, hazardReader.lastCircle.chainAt
                if idx == 1 or not (circleChain and circleChain.chainAt == chainAt) then
                    I = magnitude or (config.bobChainStep or 22)
                    hazardReader.circleChain = {
                        chainAt = chainAt,
                        ox = pos.X - i.X * I * (idx - 1),
                        oz = pos.Z - i.Z * I * (idx - 1),
                        dx = i.X,
                        dz = i.Z,
                        sp = I,
                        gr = B or (config.bobChainGrow or 6),
                        size0 = size - (B or (config.bobChainGrow or 6)) * (idx - 1),
                        dt = G or (config.bobChainDt or 0.26),
                        idx = idx,
                        lastAt = F,
                    }
                else
                    circleChain.idx = idx
                    circleChain.lastAt = F
                    if magnitude then
                        circleChain.dx, circleChain.dz = i.X, i.Z
                        circleChain.sp = magnitude
                        circleChain.gr = B
                        circleChain.dt = G
                    end
                end
            end
            contextDropZones("circle ", F - 0.2)
            local I = config.circlePad or 0
            local T = size + I
            local function W(vector3, t, H, X)
                local dF = s and math.min(6, (config.bobChainN or 10) - idx) or 6
                if dF <= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local z = s and config.bobChainWide ~= false
                if z then
                    T = max(T, size + H * dF + I)
                end
                for index2 = 1, dF, 1 do
                    local vector4, OF, SF =
                        pos + vector3 * (t * index2),
                        min2(size + H * index2 + I, size + H * 6 + I),
                        F + X * index2 + 0.1
                    if OF < 16 then
                        break
                    end
                    contextAddZone({
                        name = "circle next",
                        kind = "zone",
                        castRed = true,
                        hardPending = true,
                        cframe = CFrame.new(vector4.X, pos.Y, vector4.Z),
                        size = Vector3.new(OF, 12, OF),
                        round = true,
                        from = F,
                        untilAt = SF + 1,
                        telegraphed = true,
                        madeAt = F,
                        bubbleKeep = true,
                    })
                end
                dF = max(size + H * 6 + I, 16)
                z = t * 6 + dF * 0.5
                H = pos + vector3 * (z * 0.5)
                contextAddZone({
                    name = "circle line",
                    kind = "zone",
                    castRed = true,
                    hardPending = true,
                    exact = true,
                    weight = 1,
                    cframe = CFrame.lookAt(
                        Vector3.new(H.X, pos.Y, H.Z),
                        Vector3.new(H.X + vector3.X, pos.Y, H.Z + vector3.Z)
                    ),
                    size = Vector3.new(T, 12, z),
                    from = F,
                    untilAt = F + X * 6 + 1.2,
                    telegraphed = true,
                    madeAt = F,
                    bubbleKeep = true,
                })
            end
            if magnitude then
                W(i, magnitude, B, G)
            elseif s then
                W(i, config.bobChainStep or 22, config.bobChainGrow or 6, config.bobChainDt or 0.26)
            else
                W(i, 26, -6, 0.27)
            end
        end
        local function I(F, C)
            for index, descendant in ipairs(F:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and lowercase(descendant.Name):find(C, 1, true) then
                    return descendant
                end
            end
        end
        local function F(C)
            local g, i = 0
            for index, descendant in ipairs(C:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Size.X * descendant.Size.Z > g then
                    g, i = descendant.Size.X * descendant.Size.Z, descendant
                else
                end
            end
            return i
        end
        local function C(parent)
            for index = 1, 4, 1 do
                parent = parent.Parent
                if not parent then
                    return false
                end
                if parent:IsA("Model") and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function contextOtherRoots()
            local othersAt = os.clock()
            if hazardReader.othersAt and othersAt - hazardReader.othersAt < 0.2 then
                return hazardReader.others
            end
            local others = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                if entry ~= localPlayer then
                    index = entry.Character
                    local G = index and (index:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    if G and G.Parent then
                        others[#others + 1] = G
                    end
                end
            end
            hazardReader.others = others
            hazardReader.othersAt = othersAt
            return others
        end
        local function contextAttackOwner(b, B, G, z, s)
            local T = contextOtherRoots()
            if #T == 0 then
                return "me", false
            end
            local W, W, W = contextCharacter()
            if not W then
                return nil, false
            end
            local function K(t, H)
                local X, dF = t - B, H - G
                t = math.sqrt(X * X + dF * dF)
                if b == "under" then
                    return -t
                end
                if not z then
                    return nil
                end
                if t < 0.5 then
                    return 1
                end
                return (X * z + dF * s) / t
            end
            local z = K(W.Position.X, W.Position.Z)
            if z == nil then
                return nil, false
            end
            local s = math.sqrt((W.Position.X - B) ^ 2 + (W.Position.Z - G) ^ 2)
            local t, H, X, dF =
                b ~= "under" and s < (config.ownerNear or 25) and z >= (config.ownerNearCos or 0.8), z, -2, "me"
            for index = 1, #T, 1 do
                z = T[index].Position
                W = K(z.X, z.Z)
                t = if t and (z.X - B) * (z.X - B) + (z.Z - G) * (z.Z - G) < s * s then false else t
                if W then
                    if W > H then
                        H, X, dF = W, H, "other"
                    else
                        X = if W > X then W else X
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if b == "under" and -H > (config.ownerUnderMax or 40) then
                return nil, t
            end
            if b ~= "under" and (H < (config.ownerCos or 0.6) or H - X < (config.ownerMargin or 0.15)) then
                return nil, t
            end
            return dF, t
        end

        end

            if not B then
                return
            end
            for index = 1, #B, 1 do
                g(B[index])
            end
        end

        context.bobFamily = function(z)
            local bobFamMemo, T
            if type(z) == "string" then
                bobFamMemo = hazardReader.bobFamMemo
                if not bobFamMemo then
                    bobFamMemo = {}
                    hazardReader.bobFamMemo = bobFamMemo
                    hazardReader.bobFamN = 0
                else
                end
                T = bobFamMemo[z]
                if T ~= nil then
                    return T
                end
            else
            end
            local bobFamN = string.lower(tostring(z or ""))
            T = if bobFamN:find("firstboss", 1, true) or bobFamN:find("thirdboss", 1, true)
                then false
                else if bobFamN:find("secondboss", 1, true)
                        or bobFamN:find("icespikes", 1, true)
                        or bobFamN:find("movingbeam", 1, true)
                    then true
                    else if bobFamN == "wall"
                            or bobFamN == "spike field"
                            or bobFamN == "ground spikes"
                            or bobFamN == "spikes grow"
                        then true
                        else false
            if bobFamMemo then
                bobFamN = (hazardReader.bobFamN or 0) + 1
                if bobFamN > 512 then
                    bobFamMemo = {}
                    hazardReader.bobFamMemo = bobFamMemo
                    bobFamN = 1
                else
                end
                bobFamMemo[z] = T
                hazardReader.bobFamN = bobFamN
            end
            return T
        end

                    hazardReader.parts[part] = nil

            hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
            contextLogT(

                "Reader",

            )
        end

        local function z(model)
            if
                hazardReader.models[model]
                or contextIsOurs(model)
                or C(model)
                or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            then
                return
            end
            local name = lowercase(model.Name)
            local W = os.clock()
            if ourAttacks[name] then
                return
            end
            if name == "bonusbosstallswirly" then
                return
            end
            if
                context.PK
                and context.PK.hooked
                and context.PK.MODELS[name]
                and context.isEvent
                and context.isEvent()
            then
                return
            end
            if
                context.fixesOn
                and context.fixesOn()
                and config.carryEntryTrigger ~= false
                and name:match("^initial%a*bossentry$")
            then
                return
            end
            if
                context.fixesOn
                and context.fixesOn()
                and config.lkCurseIgnore ~= false
                and name == "thirdbosscursering"
            then
                return
            end
            if config.rodinSweepPattern ~= false then
                local parent = model.Parent
                local model2 = name == "bonusbosssweepingflames" and model
                    or parent ~= nil and parent ~= workspace and lowercase(parent.Name) == "bonusbosssweepingflames" and parent
                    or nil
                if model2 then
                    if
                        config.rodinSweep ~= false
                        and not (hazardReader.rodinSweep and hazardReader.rodinSweep.model == model2)
                        and not (hazardReader.rodinSweepDone and hazardReader.rodinSweepDone[model2])
                    then
                        hazardReader.rodinSweep = {
                            model = model2,
                            at = W,
                            segs = {},
                        }
                        contextLogT("rodin", 2, "Reader", "sweep: read as one pattern")
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
            if
                hazardReader.bossDownUntil
                and W < hazardReader.bossDownUntil
                and (
                    name:find("firstboss", 1, true)
                    or name:find("secondboss", 1, true)
                    or name:find("thirdboss", 1, true)
                )
            then
                return
            end
            if name:find("firstboss", 1, true) and context.firstBossDead() then
                return
            end
            if context.bobDown() and context.bobFamily(name) then
                return
            end
            local hbs, pcs = {}, {}
            for index, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    index = lowercase(descendant.Name)
                    if index:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                        hbs[#hbs + 1] = descendant
                    end
                    if index:find("precast", 1, true) then
                        pcs[#pcs + 1] = descendant
                    end
                end
            end
            local H = hbs[1]
            local X = pcs[1]
            if name == "bonusbosssweepingflames" and config.rodinSweep ~= false then
                hazardReader.rodinSweep = {
                    model = model,
                    at = W,
                    segs = {},
                }
                contextLogT("rodin", 2, "Reader", "sweep: tracking the wave across nine segments")
            end
            if
                name == "bonusbossmemorymodel"
                and config.rodinSplit ~= false
                and not (hazardReader.rodinSplit and hazardReader.rodinSplit.model == model)

                    model = model,
                    at = W,
                    flashes = {},
                    conns = {},
                    parts = {},
                }
                hazardReader.rodinSplit = rodinSplit
                rodinSplit.note = function(QF, lit)
                    local OF = rodinSplit.parts[QF]
                    if not OF then
                        return
                    end
                    if lit and not OF.lit then
                        rodinSplit.flashes[#rodinSplit.flashes + 1] = {
                            t = os.clock() - rodinSplit.at,
                            side = OF.side,
                            good = OF.good,
                        }
                    end
                    OF.lit = lit
                end
                rodinSplit.hook = function(QF)
                    if rodinSplit.parts[QF] or not QF:IsA("BasePart") then
                        return
                    end
                    local LF = lowercase(QF.Name)
                    local side = LF:find("left", 1, true) and "left"
                        or LF:find("right", 1, true) and "right"
                        or nil
                    if not (side and (LF:find("precast", 1, true))) then
                        return
                    end
                    rodinSplit.parts[QF] = {
                        side = side,
                        good = LF:find("precastgood", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        lit = QF.Transparency < 0.9,
                    }
                    rodinSplit.conns[#rodinSplit.conns + 1] = QF:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency")
                        :Connect(function()
                            rodinSplit.note(QF, QF.Transparency < 0.9)
                        end)
                end
                for index2, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                    rodinSplit.hook(child)
                end
                rodinSplit.conns[#rodinSplit.conns + 1] = model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(QF)
                    rodinSplit.hook(QF)
                end)
                contextLogT("rodin", 2, "Reader", "arena split: reading the four green flashes")

            if name == "bonusbossmemorymodel" then
                return

            if
                name == "bonusbosslongline"
                and H
                and not hazardReader.seen[model]
                and config.rodinFan ~= false

                    local QF = dF.LookVector
                    local rodinFanYaw = math.atan2(QF.Z, QF.X)

                    for index3 = 1, config.rodinFanCount or 9, 1 do
                        dF = rodinFanYaw + OF * index3
                        QF = Vector3.new(math.cos(dF), 0, math.sin(dF))

                            name = "rodin line next",
                            kind = "zone",
                            bubbleKeep = true,
                            hardPending = true,
                            exact = true,
                            weight = 1,
                            madeAt = W,
                            cframe = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + QF),
                            size = Vector3.new(H.Size.X, math.max(H.Size.Y, 12), H.Size.Z),

                            untilAt = W + 0.105 * index3 + (config.rodinFanLast or 1.4),

                    end

                        "rodin",
                        2,
                        "Reader",
                        ("long-line fan: %d more lines placed at %d deg steps"):format(
                            config.rodinFanCount or 9,
                            config.rodinFanStep or -20
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            if name == "thirdbosslineshot" and not hazardReader.seen[model] then
                hazardReader.lastLineShotAt = W
            end
            if name == "thirdbossmultirings" then
                hazardReader.arcsUntil = W + (config.odinArcHold or 3)
                for index4, child2 in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                    if child2:IsA("BasePart") then
                        index4 = math.max(child2.Size.X, child2.Size.Z) * 0.5
                        if index4 > 20 and index4 < 32 then
                            local lookVector = child2.CFrame.LookVector
                            local OF = math.sqrt(lookVector.X * lookVector.X + lookVector.Z * lookVector.Z)
                            if OF > 0.01 then
                                hazardReader.arcAxis = {
                                    x = lookVector.X / OF,
                                    z = lookVector.Z / OF,
                                    cx = child2.Position.X - lookVector.X / OF * (index4 / 2),
                                    cz = child2.Position.Z - lookVector.Z / OF * (index4 / 2),
                                }
                            end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if
                (name == "secondbossspreadbeam" or name == "secondbosshorizontalbeam")
                and not hazardReader.seen[model]
            then
                hazardReader.lastBeamAt = W
            end
            if name == "secondbosshorizontalbeam" and H and not hazardReader.seen[model] then
                local position2, QF = H.Position, hazardReader.hbSet
                if QF and W - QF.t < 0.6 then
                    local LF, OF = position2.X - QF.x, position2.Z - QF.z
                    local SF = math.sqrt(LF * LF + OF * OF)
                    QF.n = QF.n + 1
                    if QF.n == 2 and SF > 8 and SF < 60 then
                        for index5 = 1, config.hbPredict or 14, 1 do
                            contextAddZone({
                                name = "beam next",
                                kind = "zone",
                                bubbleKeep = true,
                                hardPending = true,
                                exact = true,
                                weight = 1,
                                madeAt = W,
                                cframe = H.CFrame + Vector3.new(LF * index5, 0, OF * index5),
                                size = Vector3.new(H.Size.X + 2, 12, H.Size.Z),
                                from = W + 0.16 * index5 + 0.65,
                                untilAt = W + 0.16 * index5 + 1.5,
                            })
                        end
                        contextLogT(
                            "beams",
                            2,
                            "Reader",
                            ("horizontal set: step %.1f studs per 0.16 s, %d lanes predicted"):format(
                                SF,
                                config.hbPredict or 14
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    QF.t, QF.x, QF.z = W, position2.X, position2.Z
                else
                    hazardReader.hbSet = {
                        t = W,
                        x = position2.X,
                        z = position2.Z,
                        n = 1,
                    }
                end
            end
            local noTele = name:find("icespikes", 1, true) and X and not hazardReader.seen[model]
            if noTele then
                hazardReader.lastSpikesAt = W
                if name:find("large", 1, true) then
                    contextDropZones("spikes grow", W)
                end
                if name:find("small", 1, true) and config.spikeGrowOnSmall ~= false then
                    local QF = config.spikeGrowR or 46
                    contextAddZone({
                        name = "spikes grow",
                        kind = "zone",
                        bubbleKeep = true,
                        cframe = CFrame.new(X.Position.X, X.Position.Y, X.Position.Z),
                        size = Vector3.new(QF * 2, 12, QF * 2),
                        round = true,
                        from = W,
                        untilAt = W + (config.spikeGrowLive or 2),
                        telegraphed = true,
                        madeAt = W,
                        lead = math.max(config.dodgeLead, QF / 20 + 0.5),
                    })
                end
                local QF = math.max(X.Size.Y, X.Size.Z) * 0.5 + 2
                contextAddZone({
                    name = "spike field",
                    bubbleKeep = true,
                    kind = "zone",
                    cframe = CFrame.new(X.Position.X, X.Position.Y, X.Position.Z),
                    size = Vector3.new(QF * 2, 14, QF * 2),
                    round = true,
                    from = W,
                    untilAt = W + config.spikeHurtFor,
                    exact = true,
                    weight = 0.9,
                    madeAt = W,
                    model = model,
                })
                do
                    local QF, LF = false, {}
                    local function OF()
                        local SF = QF
                        if SF then
                            return
                        end
                        QF = true
                        local now, DF, PF = os.clock(), X.Position.X, X.Position.Z
                        for index6, zone in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                            if
                                zone.name == "ground spikes"
                                and zone.cx
                                and (zone.cx - DF) ^ 2 + (zone.cz - PF) ^ 2 < 400
                            then
                                zone.untilAt = math.min(zone.untilAt, now + 0.25)
                            end
                        end
                        SF = hazardReader.models[model]
                        if SF and not SF.long then
                            SF.untilAt = math.min(SF.untilAt, now + 0.25)
                        end
                        for index7, entry in ipairs(LF) do
                            pcall(function()
                                entry:Disconnect()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    LF[#LF + 1] = X:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
                        if X.Transparency >= 0.95 then
                            OF()
                        end
                    end)
                    LF[#LF + 1] = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(QF)
                        if QF:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local SF = lowercase(QF.Name)
                            if not SF:find("precast", 1, true) and not SF:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                                OF()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.delay(config.spikeGrowMax or 1.7, function()
                        if model.Parent then
                            OF()
                        end
                    end)
                    LF[#LF + 1] = X.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                        if not X.Parent then
                            OF()
                        end
                    end)
                    for index8, descendant2 in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant2:IsA("BasePart") and descendant2 ~= X then
                            index8 = lowercase(descendant2.Name)
                            if not index8:find("precast", 1, true) and not index8:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                                LF[#LF + 1] = descendant2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(OF)
                                LF[#LF + 1] = descendant2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(OF)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    LF[#LF + 1] = model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                        if not model.Parent then
                            for index6, entry in ipairs(LF) do
                                pcall(function()
                                    entry:Disconnect()
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            if
                name == "thirdbossmemorysafezone"
                or name == "thirdbosssafespot"
                or name == "thirdbosssafespots"
                or name == "thirdbossmasssafespotcircles"
                or name == "thirdbossmemorydamagezone"
            then
                local safeSpots, LF = {}
                for index9, descendant3 in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant3:IsA("BasePart") then
                        noTele, index9 =
                            lowercase(descendant3.Name),
                            max(descendant3.Size.X, max(descendant3.Size.Y, descendant3.Size.Z))
                        if noTele:find("damage", 1, true) or name == "thirdbossmemorydamagezone" then
                            LF = if index9 > 60 then descendant3 else LF
                        else
                            if noTele:find("precast", 1, true) and index9 <= 120 then
                                local OF, DF =
                                    #safeSpots + 1, {
                                        x = descendant3.Position.X,
                                        y = descendant3.Position.Y,
                                        z = descendant3.Position.Z,
                                    }
                                DF.r, DF.part, safeSpots[OF] =
                                    max(descendant3.Size.Y, descendant3.Size.Z) * 0.5, descendant3, DF
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if #safeSpots > 0 then
                    hazardReader.safeSpots = safeSpots
                    hazardReader.safeSpotsAt = W
                end
                if
                    not LF
                    and #safeSpots > 0
                    and name == "thirdbosssafespot"
                    and context.fixesOn
                    and context.fixesOn()
                    and config.lkSafeSpot ~= false
                then
                    local lead = config.lkCurseAt or 6
                    hazardReader.safeField = {
                        from = W + lead,
                        untilAt = W + lead + 0.3,
                        lead = lead,
                        curse = true,
                        model = model,
                        name = name,
                    }
                    contextLogT(
                        "safe",
                        2,
                        "Boss",
                        ("%s: curse goes off in %.1fs, safe circle %.0f studs wide"):format(
                            name,
                            lead,
                            safeSpots[1].r * 2
                        )
                    )

                end
                if LF then
                    safeSpots = timing[name] or {}
                    hazardReader.safeField = {
                        from = W + (safeSpots.first or config.defaultFire),
                        untilAt = W + (safeSpots.last or config.defaultFire + 0.9),
                        model = model,
                        name = name,
                    }
                    contextLogT(
                        "safe",
                        2,
                        "Odin",
                        ("%s: the arena goes lethal in %.2fs, %d refuges known"):format(
                            name,
                            hazardReader.safeField.from - W,
                            #hazardReader.safeSpots
                        )
                    )
                end
                hazardReader.models[model] = {
                    model = model,
                    name = name,
                    spawn = W,
                    from = W,
                    untilAt = W + 12,
                    long = false,
                    noTele = false,
                    pad = 0,
                    minT = 1,
                    safeFamily = true,
                }
                hazardReader.count = hazardReader.count + 1
                return
            end
            if name == "thirdbossmultirings" then
                if context.OD and context.OD.noteRingSet then
                    context.OD.noteRingSet(model, W)
                end
                return
            end
            local slamRadius, LF = hazardReader.seen[model], X ~= nil and X.Parent ~= nil and X.Transparency < 0.9
            if slamRadius then
                if config.slamOnce ~= false and name == "firstbossjumpslam" then
                    return
                end
                noTele = timing[name]
                local OF, SF =
                    H ~= nil
                        and LF
                        and (H.Position - slamRadius.pos).Magnitude >= 5
                        and not (noTele and noTele.sweeps),
                    LF and slamRadius.pcT >= 0.9
                if not OF and not SF then
                    return
                end
            end
            noTele = false
            if not H and not X then
                if not attackCatalog[name] or model.Parent ~= workspace then
                    return
                end
                H, noTele = F(model), true
                if not H and name == "firstbossjumpslam" then
                    LF = model:GetPivot().Position
                    if W - (hazardReader.lastSlamAt or -min) > 3 then
                        hazardReader.lastSlamAt = W
                        hazardReader.slamCentre = LF
                        slamRadius = hazardReader.leash
                        if
                            slamRadius
                            and slamRadius.enemy
                            and slamRadius.enemy.root
                            and slamRadius.enemy.root.Parent
                        then
                            hazardReader.slamJumpDist = (slamRadius.enemy.root.Position - LF).Magnitude
                        end
                    end
                    local OF = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if
                        OF
                        and (LF - OF.Position).Magnitude < 300
                        and not (runtimeState.reflex and runtimeState.reflex.name == "slam")
                    then
                        runtimeState.reflex = {
                            name = "slam",
                            from = LF,
                            radius = 56,
                            untilAt = W + 2.6,
                            startedAt = W,
                            early = true,
                        }
                    end
                end
                if not H then
                    return
                end
            else
            end
            for entry2 in pairs(G) do
                if #name > #entry2 and string.sub(name, 1, #entry2) == entry2 then
                    hazardReader.twinSeen[entry2] = W
                    for part in pairs(hazardReader.parts) do
                        if lowercase(part.Name) == entry2 then
                            hazardReader.parts[part] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            LF = timing[name] or {}
            local OF, long, startedAt =
                LF.first or (X and not noTele and config.defaultFire or 0),
                LF.long == true or noTele and not LF.last,
                hazardReader.hitDelay and hazardReader.hitDelay[name]
            if startedAt and startedAt.n >= 3 and startedAt.med then
                slamRadius = OF
                OF = math.max(startedAt.med - config.hitLead - (context.DG and context.DG.lag or 0) / 22, 0)
                OF, long = if LF.hardFirst then math.min(OF, slamRadius) else OF, false
            else
            end
            slamRadius = false
            if context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() and config.carryHoldZones ~= false and not LF.last then
                long, slamRadius = true, true
            else
            end
            local oneShot = type(config.earlyHits) == "table" and config.earlyHits[name]
            OF = if type(oneShot) == "number" and oneShot > 0 then math.max(OF - oneShot, 0) else OF
            local _F, slim = type(config.missHits) == "table" and config.missHits[name], LF.slim
            slim = if name == "northernmageshot" then config.mageMargin else slim
            slim = if not slim and H then if min2(H.Size.X, H.Size.Z) <= 10 then 3 else slim else slim
            slim = if context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() and config.carrySlim ~= true then nil else slim
            oneShot = context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() and (config.carryPad or 6) or 0
            local cF = {
                model = model,
                hb = H,
                pc = X,
                name = name,
                spawn = W,
                from = W + OF,
                untilAt = long and min or W + (LF.last or OF + config.defaultLive),
                long = long,
                noTele = noTele,
                holdFull = LF.holdFull == true,
                hardFirst = LF.hardFirst == true,
                precastBox = LF.precastBox == true,
                hbs = hbs,
                pcs = pcs,
                boxes = {},
                anchorBuf = {},
                pad = LF.padExact and LF.pad or math.max(LF.pad or 0, type(_F) == "number" and _F or 0, oneShot),
                slim = slim,
                minT = X and X.Transparency or 1,
            }
            oneShot = LF.exact == true and LF.hardFirst ~= true
            cF.oneShot = oneShot

                config.expireOnCasterDeath ~= false
                and not string.find(name, "boss", 1, true)
                and hazardReader.enemies
            then
