                if pcs then
                    local position3, casters = pcs.Position, {}
                    for index10, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                        if
                            not enemy.isBoss
                            and enemy.humanoid
                            and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                            and enemy.root
                            and enemy.root.Parent
                        then
                            _F = enemy.root.Position
                            if
                                math.sqrt((_F.X - position3.X) ^ 2 + (_F.Z - position3.Z) ^ 2)
                                <= (config.casterRadius or 90)
                            then
                                casters[#casters + 1] = enemy.humanoid
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #casters > 0 then
                        cF.casters = casters
                    end
                end
            end
            cF.holdLive = slamRadius or nil
            if startedAt and startedAt.n >= 3 and startedAt.med then
                cF.untilAt = W + startedAt.med + config.hitTail + (context.DG and context.DG.lag or 0) / 22
                cF.holdFull = true
                cF.exact = true
            end
            if name == "northernmageshot" then
                cF.untilAt = cF.untilAt + (config.mageTail or 0.3)
            end
            if oneShot then
                if LF.last then
                    cF.untilAt = min2(cF.untilAt, W + LF.last + 0.15)
                end
                if LF.first then
                    cF.from = min2(cF.from, W + LF.first)
                end
                cF.from = min2(cF.from, cF.untilAt - 0.05)
            end
            cF.exact = cF.exact or LF.exact == true
            hazardReader.models[model] = cF
            context.famSeen(name)
            if
                context.AC
                and context.AC.paintNow
                and not cF.safeFamily
                and not tostring(cF.name or ""):find("safe", 1, true)
            then
                pcall(context.AC.paintNow, model)
            end
            hazardReader.count = hazardReader.count + 1
            hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
            slamRadius = name:find("icespikes", 1, true)
            if slamRadius then
                local OF, SF =
                    H or X or model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true), false
                local function lF()
                    local uF = SF
                    if uF then
                        return
                    end
                    SF = true
                    local now, hF = os.clock(), hazardReader.models[model]
                    if hF and not hF.long then
                        hF.untilAt = math.min(hF.untilAt, now + 0.25)
                    end
                    uF, hF = OF and OF.Position.X or 0, OF and OF.Position.Z or 0
                    for index6, zone in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                        if
                            (zone.name == "ground spikes" or zone.name == "spike field")
                            and zone.cx
                            and (zone.cx - uF) ^ 2 + (zone.cz - hF) ^ 2 < 3600
                        then
                            zone.untilAt = math.min(zone.untilAt, now + 0.25)
                        end
                    end
                end
                cF.growConn = model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(OF)
                    if OF:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local SF = lowercase(OF.Name)
                        if not SF:find("precast", 1, true) and not SF:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                            lF()
                        end
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(config.spikeGrowMax or 1.7, lF)
            end
            if H then
                cF.touchConn = H.ChildAdded:Connect(function(OF)
                    if not OF:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                        return
                    end
                    OF = os.clock()
                    local SF = OF - cF.spawn
                    cF.touches = (cF.touches or 0) + 1
                    cF.hitAt = cF.hitAt or SF
                    cF.fired = true
                    local lF = hazardReader.multiTouch and hazardReader.multiTouch[name]
                    if cF.touches >= 2 and not cF.hardFirst and not lF and not cF.oneShot then
                        hazardReader.multiTouch = hazardReader.multiTouch or {}
                        hazardReader.multiTouch[name] = true
                        contextLogT(
                            "touch",
                            2,
                            "Reader",
                            ("%s touched twice in one instance: treated as continuous from now on"):format(name)
                        )
                        lF = true
                    else
                    end
                    if name == "bonusbosslongline" and config.rodinLineGone ~= false then
                        cF.detonatedAt = cF.detonatedAt or OF
                        cF.long = false
                        local untilAt = OF + (config.rodinLineTail or 0)
                        cF.untilAt = math.min(cF.untilAt, untilAt)
                        for index6, zone in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                            if zone.model == model then
                                zone.untilAt = math.min(zone.untilAt, untilAt)
                            end
                        end
                        local lookVector2, position4 = H.CFrame.LookVector, H.Position
                        local RF = math.sqrt(lookVector2.X * lookVector2.X + lookVector2.Z * lookVector2.Z)
                        if RF > 0.01 then
                            local yF = math.cos(math.rad(config.rodinLineSameDeg or 5))
                            for index7, zone2 in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                                if
                                    zone2.name == "rodin line next"
                                    and zone2.cframe
                                    and zone2.untilAt > untilAt
                                then
                                    index7 = zone2.cframe.LookVector
                                    local EF = math.sqrt(index7.X * index7.X + index7.Z * index7.Z)
                                    if
                                        EF > 0.01
                                        and math.abs(
                                            (index7.X * lookVector2.X + index7.Z * lookVector2.Z) / (EF * RF)
                                        ) >= yF
                                        and (zone2.cframe.Position - position4).Magnitude
                                            <= (config.rodinLineSameNear or 20)
                                    then
                                        zone2.untilAt = untilAt
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
                        b(hbs)
                    elseif (cF.long or cF.hardFirst or lF) and not cF.oneShot then
                        local max2, untilAt2, hF, mF =
                            math.max,
                            cF.untilAt,
                            OF + config.hitTail,
                            name == "northernmageshot" and (config.mageTail or 0.3)
                        cF.untilAt = max2(untilAt2, hF + (mF or 0))
                    else
                        cF.detonatedAt = cF.detonatedAt or OF
                        local lF = OF
                            + (
                                ({
                                        firstbosspassivebeam = true,
                                        thirdbosslineshot = true,
                                        thirdbossbeampart = true,
                                        thirdbossbeamshot = true,
                                        thirdbossoneshotbeam = true,
                                        thirdbossspreadline = true,
                                        thirdbossrandomline = true,
                                    })[name]
                                    and (config.beamHitTail or 0.2)
                                or 0
                            )
                        cF.untilAt = math.min(cF.untilAt, lF)
                        for index11, zone3 in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                            if zone3.model == model then
                                zone3.untilAt = math.min(zone3.untilAt, lF)
                            end
                        end
                        b(hbs)
                    end
                    if SF < 0.3 then
                        return
                    end
                    hazardReader.hitDelay = hazardReader.hitDelay or {}
                    OF = hazardReader.hitDelay[name]
                        or {
                            n = 0,
                            min = min,
                            max = 0,
                            sum = 0,
                            list = {},
                        }
                    OF.n, OF.sum = OF.n + 1, OF.sum + SF
                    OF.list[#OF.list + 1] = SF
                    if #OF.list > 40 then
                        table.remove(OF.list, 1)
                    end
                    SF = table.clone(OF.list)
                    table.sort(SF)
                    OF.min, OF.max =
                        SF[math.max(1, math.floor(#SF * 0.1 + 0.5))], SF[math.min(#SF, math.ceil(#SF * 0.9))]
                    OF.med = SF[math.ceil(#SF / 2)]
                    hazardReader.hitDelay[name] = OF
                end)
            end
            if #hbs > 1 then
                cF.touchConns = {}
                for index12 = 2, #hbs, 1 do
                    pcs = hbs[index12]
                    cF.touchConns[#cF.touchConns + 1] = pcs.ChildAdded:Connect(function(OF)
                        if OF:IsA("TouchTransmitter") and cF.touchConn then
                            local now = os.clock()
                            cF.touches = (cF.touches or 0) + 1
                            cF.fired = true
                            if
                                not (
                                    cF.long
                                    or cF.hardFirst
                                    or hazardReader.multiTouch and hazardReader.multiTouch[name]
                                )
                            then
                                cF.detonatedAt = cF.detonatedAt or now
                                cF.untilAt = math.min(cF.untilAt, now)
                                b(hbs)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            if H and (name:find("passivebeam", 1, true)) then
                recordBeamSample(H, W)
            end
            _F = name == "firstbossjumpslam" and (H or X) or nil
            if _F then
                oneShot = runtimeState.reflex
                if W - (hazardReader.lastSlamAt or -min) > 3 then
                    hazardReader.lastSlamAt = W
                    hazardReader.slamCentre = _F.Position
                end
                startedAt = oneShot
                        and oneShot.name == "slam"
                        and oneShot.startedAt
                        and W - oneShot.startedAt < 0.5
                        and oneShot.startedAt
                    or W
                runtimeState.reflex = {
                    name = "slam",
                    from = _F.Position,
                    radius = 56,
                    untilAt = startedAt + 2.6,
                    startedAt = startedAt,
                    hopped = oneShot and oneShot.hopped or nil,
                    dir = oneShot and oneShot.name == "slam" and oneShot.dir or nil,
                }
                slamRadius = max(_F.Size.X, _F.Size.Z) * 0.5 + (LF.pad or 0)
                hazardReader.slamRadius = slamRadius
                contextAddZone({
                    name = "slam soon",
                    bubbleKeep = true,
                    kind = "zone",
                    cframe = CFrame.new(_F.Position.X, _F.Position.Y, _F.Position.Z),
                    size = Vector3.new(slamRadius * 2, 20, slamRadius * 2),
                    round = true,
                    from = W,
                    untilAt = W + 2,
                    exact = true,
                    weight = 0.7,
                    madeAt = W,
                })
            end
            if H and (name:find("mageshot", 1, true)) then
                a(H, W)
            end
            if H and (name == "secondbossspreadbeam" or name == "secondbossspinninglaser") then
                _F, LF, pcs = contextCharacter()
                if pcs then
                    startedAt, oneShot = H.Size, H.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pcs.Position)
                    local a, e = startedAt.Z * 0.5, startedAt.X * 0.5
                    if startedAt.X > startedAt.Z then
                        a, e = startedAt.X * 0.5, startedAt.Z * 0.5
                    else
                    end
                    slamRadius = math.clamp(startedAt.X > startedAt.Z and oneShot.X or oneShot.Z, -a, a)
                    local vector = H.CFrame
                        * (
                            startedAt.X > startedAt.Z and Vector3.new(slamRadius, 0, 0)
                            or Vector3.new(0, 0, slamRadius)
                        )
                    if
                        math.sqrt((pcs.Position.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (pcs.Position.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                            < e + 14
                        and not (runtimeState.reflex and runtimeState.reflex.name == "slam")
                    then
                        local vector2 = startedAt.X > startedAt.Z and H.CFrame.RightVector or H.CFrame.LookVector
                        local perp = Vector3.new(-vector2.Z, 0, vector2.X)
                        perp = if perp.Magnitude > 0.01 then perp.Unit else Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                        runtimeState.reflex = {
                            name = "spread",
                            from = Vector3.new(vector.X, pcs.Position.Y, vector.Z),
                            radius = e + 14,
                            untilAt = W + 1.3,
                            startedAt = W,
                            perp = perp,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if X and (name:find("cricle", 1, true) or name:find("circlestrike", 1, true)) then
                N(X, W)
            end
            if B and (H or X) and not noTele then
                B(model, H, X)
            end
        end
        local function a(e)
            if config.slamOnce ~= false and lowercase(e.Name) == "firstbossjumpslam" then
                return
            end
            local N = hazardReader.models[e]
            if N then
                if os.clock() - N.spawn < (config.retrackMinAge or 1.2) then
                    return
                end
                if N.touchConn then
                    N.touchConn:Disconnect()
                end
                if N.touchConns then
                    for index, touchConn in ipairs(N.touchConns) do
                        pcall(function()
                            touchConn:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    N.touchConns = nil
                end
                hazardReader.models[e] = nil
            end
            hazardReader.seen[e] = nil
            if e.Parent then
                z(e)
            end
        end
        B = function(e, N, B)
            if hazardReader.watch[e] then
                return
            end
            local s = {
                conns = {},
            }
            hazardReader.watch[e] = s
            if B then
                local transparency = B.Transparency
                s.conns[#s.conns + 1] = B:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
                    local transparency2, K = B.Transparency, transparency - 0.25
                    if transparency2 < K then
                        a(e)
                    end
                    transparency = transparency2
                end)
            end
            if N then
                local T = N.CFrame
                s.conns[#s.conns + 1] = N:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
                    local W, K = os.clock(), config.retrackEvery or 0.05
                    if s.cfAt and W - s.cfAt < K then
                        return
                    end
                    s.cfAt = W
                    W = N.CFrame
                    local N, K, t =
                        W.LookVector:Dot(T.LookVector) < config.retrackTurn,
                        not config.retrackNeedsTelegraph or B == nil or B.Transparency < 0.9,
                        (W.Position - T.Position).Magnitude > 1
                    if N and K or t and not hazardReader.models[e] and K then
                        a(e)
                    end
                    T = W
                end)
            end
            s.conns[#s.conns + 1] = e.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                if e.Parent then
                    return
                end
                for index, conn in ipairs(s.conns) do
                    pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                end
                hazardReader.watch[e] = nil
                hazardReader.seen[e] = nil
            end)
        end
        local a = {
            groundaura = true,
            ["enhanced aura ring"] = true,
            mesh1 = true,
            mesh2 = true,
        }
        local function e(part)
            if hazardReader.parts[part] or contextIsOurs(part) or C(part) then
                return
            end
            local B = hazardReader.spent[part]
            if B then
                local position = part.Position
                if (position.X - B.x) ^ 2 + (position.Z - B.z) ^ 2 < 25 then
                    return
                end
                hazardReader.spent[part] = nil
            end
            B = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local s = B ~= nil and lowercase(B.Name) == "bonusbosssweepingflames" and part:IsA("BasePart")
            if B ~= nil and lowercase(B.Name) == "bonusbosstallswirly" then
                return
            end
            if
                config.rodinSweepPattern ~= false
                and B ~= nil
                and (s or B.Parent ~= nil and lowercase(B.Parent.Name) == "bonusbosssweepingflames")
            then
                return
            end
            if B and hazardReader.models[B] and not s then
                return
            end
            local T = lowercase(part.Name)
            if ourAttacks[T] then
                return
            end
            if a[T] then
                return
            end
            if
                (T:find("firstboss", 1, true) or B ~= nil and lowercase(B.Name):find("firstboss", 1, true))
                and context.firstBossDead()
            then
                return
            end
            if
                context.fixesOn
                and context.fixesOn()
                and config.lkCurseIgnore ~= false
                and (T == "thirdbosscursering" or B ~= nil and lowercase(B.Name) == "thirdbosscursering")
            then
                return
            end
            if T == "bonusbossbouncingorbgood" or T == "bonusbossbouncingorbbad" then
                hazardReader.rodinOrbSeenAt = os.clock()
            end
            if T == "bonusbossbouncingorbgood" then
                hazardReader.rodinGoodOrb = {
                    part = part,
                    at = os.clock(),
                }
                hazardReader.rodinGoodOrbs = hazardReader.rodinGoodOrbs or {}
                if not hazardReader.rodinGoodOrbs[part] then
                    local lastAt, greenWave = os.clock(), hazardReader.greenWave
                    if
                        not greenWave
                        or lastAt - (greenWave.lastAt or -min) > (config.rodinGreenWaveGap or 15)
                    then
                        greenWave = {
                            n = 0,
                            at = lastAt,
                        }
                        hazardReader.greenWave = greenWave
                    else
                    end
                    greenWave.n = greenWave.n + 1
                    greenWave.lastAt = lastAt
                end
                local rodinGoodBorn, rodinGoodBorn2 = hazardReader.rodinGoodBorn
                if rodinGoodBorn then
                    rodinGoodBorn2 = rodinGoodBorn
                else
                    local setMetatable, weakKeys =
                        setmetatable, {
                            __mode = "k",
                        }
                    rodinGoodBorn2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
                end
                hazardReader.rodinGoodBorn = rodinGoodBorn2
                if not hazardReader.rodinGoodBorn[part] then
                    hazardReader.rodinGoodBorn[part] = os.clock()
                end
                hazardReader.rodinGoodOrbs[part] = os.clock()
                return
            end
            if T == "bonusbossflameprecast" then
                if config.rodinFlameMine ~= false then
                    hazardReader.rodinFlameRings = hazardReader.rodinFlameRings or {}
                    hazardReader.rodinFlameRings[part] = os.clock()
                else
                    hazardReader.rodinFlameFollow = {
                        part = part,
                        at = os.clock(),
                    }
                end
                return
            end
            if B and attackCatalog[lowercase(B.Name)] and not s then
                return
            end
            if G[T] and os.clock() - (hazardReader.twinSeen[T] or -min) < 6 then
                return
            end
            B = attackCatalog[T] == true or s == true
            if not B then
                s = false
                for index, projectileHint in ipairs(projectileHints) do
                    if T:find(projectileHint, 1, true) then
                        s = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not s then
                    return
                end
            end
            s = part.Position
            hazardReader.parts[part] = {
                part = part,
                x = s.X,
                z = s.Z,
                vx = 0,
                vz = 0,
                at = os.clock(),
                spawn = os.clock(),
                reg = B,
            }
            context.famSeen(T)
            if context.AC and context.AC.paintNow and not string.lower(part.Name):find("good", 1, true) then
                pcall(context.AC.paintNow, part)
            end
            if T:find("secondboss", 1, true) and T:find("orb", 1, true) then
                hazardReader.parts[part].ownKind = "homing"
            end
            if T == "thirdbossbouncingorb" then
                hazardReader.parts[part].odinOrb = true
            end
            if config.champV2 == false and string.lower(part.Name):find("seeking", 1, true) then
                contextDropZones("seeking spike", os.clock())
            end
            hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
            if T:find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) then
                hazardReader.lastMissileAt = os.clock()
                if
                    config.missileArray ~= false
                    and part:IsA("BasePart")
                    and hazardReader.arenaCentre
                    and not (context.rodinMissiles() and config.rodinMissileGrid ~= true)
                then
                    local D, a = os.clock(), part.CFrame.LookVector
                    local G, W = a.X, a.Z
                    a = math.sqrt(G * G + W * W)
                    if a > 0.01 then
                        G /= a
                        W /= a
                        B = math.atan2(G, W)
                        if
                            not (
                                hazardReader.missileArrayAt
                                and D - hazardReader.missileArrayAt < 6
                                and hazardReader.missileArrayYaw
                                and math.abs(
                                        (B - hazardReader.missileArrayYaw + 3.141592653589793)
                                                % 6.283185307179586
                                            - 3.141592653589793
                                    )
                                    < 0.10471975511965978
                            )
                        then
                            hazardReader.missileArrayAt = D
                            hazardReader.missileArrayYaw = B
                            local arenaCentre, K, t, H, X, dF, QF, LF =
                                hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                                -W,
                                config.missileLanePitch or 15,
                                config.missileLaneWidth or 10,
                                config.missileLaneFrom or 1,
                                config.missileLaneLive or 5,
                                config.missileLaneStep or 0.6,
                                {}
                            for index2 = -6, 6, 1 do
                                local SF, DF =
                                    #LF + 1, {
                                        off = index2 * t,
                                    }
                                DF.at, LF[SF] = D + QF * math.abs(index2), DF
                            end
                            t = { -120, -105, 105, 120 }
                            for index3, entry in ipairs(t) do
                                local SF, DF =
                                    #LF + 1, {
                                        off = entry,
                                    }
                                DF.at, LF[SF] =
                                    D + (config.missileFlankAt or 4) + (math.abs(entry) > 110 and QF or 0), DF
                            end
                            for index4, entry2 in ipairs(LF) do
                                index4, t = arenaCentre.X + K * entry2.off, arenaCentre.Z + G * entry2.off
                                QF = Vector3.new(index4, arenaCentre.Y, t)
                                contextAddZone({
                                    name = "missile lane",
                                    kind = "zone",
                                    castRed = false,
                                    bubbleKeep = true,
                                    hardPending = false,
                                    weight = config.missileLaneWeight or 0.5,
                                    slim = config.missileLaneSlim or 0.5,
                                    tight = true,
                                    cframe = CFrame.lookAt(QF, QF + Vector3.new(G, 0, W)),
                                    size = Vector3.new(H, 12, 360),
                                    from = entry2.at + X,
                                    untilAt = entry2.at + X + dF,
                                    telegraphed = true,
                                    madeAt = D,
                                    bubbleKeep = true,
                                })
                            end
                            contextLogT(
                                "odin",
                                1,
                                "Reader",
                                ("missile array laid: %d lanes at yaw %.0f"):format(#LF, math.deg(B))
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            B = part.Parent and lowercase(part.Parent.Name) or ""
            if T:find("bouncingorbbeam", 1, true) or B:find("bouncingorbbeam", 1, true) then
                part = os.clock()
                if
                    not hazardReader.orbBlastAt
                    or part > hazardReader.orbBlastAt + 1
                    or hazardReader.orbBlastAt - part > (config.orbBlastDelay or 14.1) + 1
                then
                    hazardReader.orbBlastAt = part + (config.orbBlastDelay or 14.1)
                    contextLogT(
                        "orbs",
                        2,
                        "Odin",
                        ("bouncing orb wave (beam part): detonation in %.1f s"):format(
                            config.orbBlastDelay or 14.1
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            if T:find("crisscross", 1, true) then
                hazardReader.crissAt = os.clock()
                local D, D, D = contextCharacter()
                if D then
                    local a, G, T = os.clock(), s.X - D.Position.X, s.Z - D.Position.Z
                    part, B =
                        context.PB == nil or context.PB.expectSlam == nil or context.PB.expectSlam(a),
                        hazardReader.charAt ~= nil and a - hazardReader.charAt < 6
                    if G * G + T * T < 144 and a - (hazardReader.slamTellAt or -min) > 3 and part and not B then
                        hazardReader.slamTellAt = a
                        contextAddZone({
                            name = "slam incoming",
                            kind = "zone",
                            bubbleKeep = true,
                            cframe = CFrame.new(D.Position.X, D.Position.Y, D.Position.Z),
                            size = Vector3.new(config.slamTellD or 67, 20, config.slamTellD or 67),
                            round = true,
                            from = a + 0.3,
                            untilAt = a + 4.5,
                            exact = true,
                            weight = 1,
                            madeAt = a,
                        })
                        contextLogT(
                            "slamtell",
                            1,
                            "Reader",
                            "criss cross spawned on the character: the slam is coming, running now"
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        context.castHold = function(D)
            if config.castStagger == false then
                return false
            end
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots or {}) do
                if entry.hitMax then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return D - (runtimeState.lastAnyCast or -math.huge) < (config.castJudgeAt or 1.1) + 0.15
        end
        context.noteCastRange = function(slot, lastAnyCast, N, hum, G)
            if not (slot and hum and G and N) then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.lastAnyCast = lastAnyCast
            runtimeState.rangePend = runtimeState.rangePend or {}
            local s, T = G.X - N.X, G.Z - N.Z
            N, G =
                {
                    slot = slot,
                    at = lastAnyCast,
                    hum = hum,
                    hp0 = hum.Health,
                    d = math.sqrt(s * s + T * T),
                }, config.castJudgeAt or 1.1
            for index = 1, #runtimeState.rangePend, 1 do
                T = runtimeState.rangePend[index]
                if T.hum == hum and math.abs(T.at - lastAnyCast) < G then
                    T.dirty = true
                    N.dirty = true
                end
            end
            runtimeState.rangePend[#runtimeState.rangePend + 1] = N
            while #runtimeState.rangePend > 16 do
                table.remove(runtimeState.rangePend, 1)
            end
        end
        local function D(a)
            task.defer(function()
                local N = runtimeState.castQueue
                if not N or #N == 0 then
                    return
                end
                local aoe = table.remove(N, 1)
                if os.clock() - aoe.at <= 0.8 then
                    runtimeState.castSeen = runtimeState.castSeen or {}
                    runtimeState.castSeen[aoe.slot] = aoe.at
                end
                N = a.PrimaryPart or a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if os.clock() - aoe.at > 0.8 or not N then
                    return
                end
                local G = N.Position
                local lastPlaceD, T, W =
                    contextFlatDistance(G, aoe.pos),
                    contextFlatDistance(G, aoe.targetPos),
                    contextFlatDistance(aoe.targetPos, aoe.pos)
                hazardReader.abilitySlots = hazardReader.abilitySlots or {}
                N = hazardReader.abilitySlots[aoe.slot]
                    or {
                        reach = (config.abilityRangeKnown or 0) > 0 and config.abilityRangeKnown or nil,
                    }
                hazardReader.abilitySlots[aoe.slot] = N
                if not N.fromTool then
                    N.name = a.Name
                end
                G = not N.measured and (I(a, "hitbox") or F(a)) or nil
                if G then
                    local a, I =
                        G.Size,
                        G:IsA("Part") and (G.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder or G.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball)
                    N.aoeX, N.aoeZ = I and max(a.Y, a.Z) or a.X, I and max(a.Y, a.Z) or a.Z
                    a = config.aoeMax or 24
                    if N.aoeX > a then
                        N.aoeX = a
                    end
                    if N.aoeZ > a then
                        N.aoeZ = a
                    end
                    N.aoeRound = I or abs(N.aoeX - N.aoeZ) < 1
                end
                if context.seedAoe then
                    pcall(context.seedAoe, N)
                end
                N.lastPlaceD = lastPlaceD
                N.lastToTarget = T
                T = N.placeHist or {}
                T[#T + 1] = {
                    d = lastPlaceD,
                    t = W,
                }
                while true do
                    W, G = #T, config.aoeHist
                    if not (W > (G or 7)) then
                        break
                    end
                    table.remove(T, 1)
                end
                N.placeHist = T
                W, lastPlaceD = {}, {}
                for index = 1, #T, 1 do
                    W[index] = T[index].d
                    lastPlaceD[index] = abs(T[index].d - T[index].t)
                end
                table.sort(W)
                table.sort(lastPlaceD)
                N.placeMed = W[math.ceil(#W / 2)]
                if #T >= 3 then
                    G = lastPlaceD[math.ceil(#lastPlaceD / 2)] < (config.aoeOnTargetTol or 4)
                    if N.onTarget ~= G then
                        N.onTarget = G
                        contextLogT(
                            "aoe",
                            1,
                            "Reader",
                            ("%s lands %s (median placement %.0f, %d casts)"):format(
                                tostring(N.name or aoe.slot),
                                G and "ON THE TARGET" or "a fixed distance ahead",
                                N.placeMed or 0,
                                #T
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    runtimeState.aoeMode = G and "target" or "fixed"
                end
                if context.saveAoe then
                    pcall(context.saveAoe, os.clock())
                end
                if N.cap and N.reach and N.reach > N.cap + 2 then
                    N.cap = nil
                end
                G, aoe, T = nil
                for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                    N = abilitySlot.cap or abilitySlot.reach
                    G = if N and (not G or N < G) then N else G
                    key = abilitySlot.aoeX
                            and (abilitySlot.measured and abilitySlot.aoeRound == false and min2(
                                abilitySlot.aoeX,
                                abilitySlot.aoeZ
                            ) * 0.5 or max(abilitySlot.aoeX, abilitySlot.aoeZ) * 0.5)
                        or nil
                    if key and (not aoe or key < aoe) then
                        aoe, T = key, abilitySlot
                    else
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.abilityRange = G
                hazardReader.abilityReach = G
                hazardReader.aoe = aoe
                hazardReader.aoeShape = T
                G = nil
                for key2, abilitySlot2 in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                    G = if abilitySlot2.hitMax
                            and (abilitySlot2.hits or 0) >= (config.castCleanFor or 4)
                            and (not G or abilitySlot2.hitMax < G)
                        then abilitySlot2.hitMax
                        else G
                end
                if config.aoeMeasured ~= true and G and G > (config.abilityRangeKnown or 0) then
                    config.abilityRangeKnown = math.floor(G)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function N(inst)
            if
                contextIsOurs(inst)
                or C(inst)
                or ourAttacks[lowercase(inst.Name)]
                or inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            then
                return
            end
            local _ = lowercase(inst.Name)
            for index, entry in ipairs(a) do
                if _:find(entry, 1, true) then
                    return
                end
            end
            _ = inst
            while _.Parent and _.Parent ~= workspace do
                _ = _.Parent
                if hazardReader.spawnSet[_] or hazardReader.models[_] then
                    return
                end
            end
            if v[_.Name] then
                return
            end
            hazardReader.spawnSet[inst] = true
            local spawns, spawns2 = hazardReader.spawns, hazardReader.spawns
            local v, a = #spawns2 + 1, {
                inst = inst,
            }
            a.at, spawns[v] = os.clock(), a
            if #hazardReader.spawns > 80 then
                hazardReader.spawnSet[table.remove(hazardReader.spawns, 1).inst] = nil
            end
        end
        context.wallVel = function(_)
            if not (_ and _.vx) then
                return nil
            end
            if config.wallSide ~= false and _.side and _.ax then
                local y, v = -_.az * _.side, _.ax * _.side
                local a = math.max(_.vx * y + _.vz * v, _.vn or 0)
                if a <= 2 then
                    return nil
                end
                return y, v, a
            end
            local y = math.sqrt(_.vx * _.vx + _.vz * _.vz)
            if y <= 2 then
                return nil
            end
            return _.vx / y, _.vz / y, y
        end

        local function v(model, I)
            local F = false
            if model:IsA("Model") then
                if
                    runtimeState.castQueue
                    and #runtimeState.castQueue > 0
                    and (hazardReader.ourAbilityNames or {})[model.Name]
                then
                    return D(model)
                end
                if lowercase(model.Name):find("movingbeam", 1, true) then
                    if context.bobDown() then
                        return
                    end
                    hazardReader.walls[model] = hazardReader.walls[model]
                        or {
                            model = model,
                            at = os.clock(),
                            born = os.clock(),
                            vx = 0,
                            vz = 0,
                        }
                    hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
                    return
                end
                z(model)
                F = hazardReader.models[model] ~= nil
            else
                if model:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if model.Parent == workspace then
                        e(model)
                        F = hazardReader.parts[model] ~= nil
                    else
                        local D = lowercase(model.Name)
                        local C = (D:find("hitbox", 1, true) or D:find("precast", 1, true))
                            and model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if C then
                            z(C)
                            F = hazardReader.models[C] ~= nil
                        else
                            if attackCatalog[D] and not _[D] then
                                e(model)
                                F = hazardReader.parts[model] ~= nil
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
            end
            local D = lowercase(model.Name)
            if D:sub(1, 9) == "bonusboss" and not (context.BONUS_BOSS_LC or {})[D] then
                hazardReader.bonusBossUnknown = hazardReader.bonusBossUnknown or {}
                hazardReader.bonusBossUnknown[D] = hazardReader.bonusBossUnknown[D] or os.clock()
            end
            if I and not F then
                N(model)
            end
        end

        local function D(name, transform, a, e, N, I, halfW, halfL, B, G, soft, s)
            local T = transform.LookVector
            local W = Vector3.new(T.X, 0, T.Z)
            W = W.Magnitude < 0.01 and Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) or W.Unit
            hazardReader.pathCount = (hazardReader.pathCount or 0) + 1
            T = name == "sideways missile"
                    and config.missileSyncClock ~= false
                    and adjustedTimestampToLocalClock
                or serverTimestampToLocalClock
            contextAddZone({
                name = name,
                moving = true,
                ground = true,
                kind = "path",
                bubbleKeep = true,
                warn = not s,
                castRed = s or nil,
                laneHard = config.champV2 ~= false and (name == "seeking spike" or name == "big spike") or nil,
                ox = transform.Position.X,
                oy = transform.Position.Y,
                oz = transform.Position.Z,
                dx = W.X,
                dz = W.Z,
                speed = a / max(e, 0.01),
                offset = G or 0,
                halfW = halfW,
                halfL = halfL,
                halfH = max(B, 6),
                r = config.spikeRound ~= false
                        and (name == "big spike" and (config.bigSpikeR or halfW) or name == "seeking spike" and halfW)
                    or nil,
                from = s and os.clock()
                    or math.max(T(N), name == "sideways missile" and T(I) - (config.missileLead or 1.4) or T(N)),
                untilAt = T(I),
                pathStart = T(N),
                soft = soft,
            })
            contextLogT(
                "path",
                2,
                "Reader",
                ("%s announced: %.0f studs at %.0f/s, starts in %.2fs"):format(
                    name,
                    a,
                    a / max(e, 0.01),
                    T(N) - os.clock()
                )
            )
        end
        context.crissPathFor = function(part, x, a, e)
            local cpath = x.cpath
            if not cpath then
                local I, cpath2 = config.crissMatchLat or 4
                for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.crissPaths or {}) do
                    if not entry.part then
                        local B, G = a.X - entry.ox, a.Z - entry.oz
                        local z, s, T =
                            B * entry.dx + G * entry.dz,
                            math.abs(-B * entry.dz + G * entry.dx),
                            entry.v * (e - entry.t0)
                        if
                            s < I
                            and z > -6
                            and z < entry.len + 6
                            and math.abs(z - T) < (config.crissMatchAlong or 35)
                        then
                            I, cpath2 = s, entry
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not cpath2 then
                    return nil
                end
                cpath2.part = part
                x.cpath = cpath2
                cpath = cpath2
            else
            end
            x, part = a.X - cpath.ox, a.Z - cpath.oz
            a = x * cpath.dx + part * cpath.dz
            if a > 0.5 and a < cpath.len - 0.5 then
                part = e - a / cpath.v
                if not cpath.t0v or part < cpath.t0v then
                    cpath.t0v = part
                end
            end
            return cpath
        end
        local function _(name, a, e, N, I, F)
            local from = serverTimestampToLocalClock(N)
            contextAddZone({
                name = name,
                kind = "zone",

                round = true,
                from = from,

                telegraphed = true,
                weight = F and 1 or nil,
                lead = math.max(config.dodgeLead, e / 20 + 0.5),
            })
        end

        context.orbBounce = function(a, e, N, I)
            if config.orbBounce == false then
                return nil
            end
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                return nil
            end
            local C, B, G, z = config.odinOrbWallR or 100, a - arenaCentre.X, e - arenaCentre.Z, N * N + I * I
            if z < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local s, T, W = 2 * (B * N + G * I), B * B + G * G - C * C
            if T >= 0 and s > 0 then
                W = 0
            else
                e = s * s - 4 * z * T
                if e < 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                W = (-s + math.sqrt(e)) / (2 * z)
                W = if W < 0 then 0 else W
            end
            C, z = B + N * W, G + I * W
            B = math.sqrt(C * C + z * z)
            if B < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            e, T = C / B, z / B
            a = N * e + I * T
            return W, arenaCentre.X + C, arenaCentre.Z + z, N - 2 * a * e, I - 2 * a * T
        end
        context.orbLineOwner = function(a, e, N)
            if config.orbOwnerLine == false then
                return nil
            end
            if e.lineAt and N - e.lineAt < 0.2 then
                return e.lineOwn
            end
            e.lineAt = N
            N = e.lineBeam
            if not (N and N.Parent == a) then
                N = nil
                for index, child in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Beam") then
                        index = child.Attachment1
                        if index and not index:IsDescendantOf(a) then
                            N = child
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                e.lineBeam = N
            else
            end
            a = N and N.Attachment1
            N = a and a.Parent
            a = N and N.Parent
            if not (a and a.Parent) then
                return e.lineOwn
            end
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            local lineOwn = character ~= nil and a == character and "me"
                or players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(a) and "other"
                or nil
            if lineOwn then
                e.lineOwn, e.lineRoot, e.lineName = lineOwn, N, a.Name
            end
            return e.lineOwn
        end

        local function D(name, F, halfW)
            if not (type(F) == "table" and #F >= 5 and typeof(F[5]) == "CFrame" and type(F[1]) == "number") then
                return
            end
            local B = F[5].LookVector
            local G = math.sqrt(B.X * B.X + B.Z * B.Z)
            if G <= 0.01 then
                return
            end
            local z, s, position, len = B.X / G, B.Z / G, F[5].Position, F[1]
            G, B = Vector3.new(position.X + z * len * 0.5, position.Y, position.Z + s * len * 0.5), os.clock()
            contextAddZone({
                name = name,
                kind = "zone",
                bubbleKeep = true,
                castRed = true,
                warn = false,
                weight = 1,
                cframe = CFrame.lookAt(G, Vector3.new(G.X + z, G.Y, G.Z + s)),
                size = Vector3.new(halfW * 2, 12, len),
                from = B,
                untilAt = serverTimestampToLocalClock(F[4]) + (config.spikeLineLinger or 0.2),
                madeAt = B,
                line = {
                    ox = position.X,
                    oy = position.Y,
                    oz = position.Z,
                    ux = z,
                    uz = s,
                    len = len,
                    halfW = halfW,
                    launch = serverTimestampToLocalClock(F[3]),
                    speed = len / math.max(type(F[2]) == "number" and F[2] or 3, 0.01),
                },
            })
        end
        local function I(kind, C)
            if
                not (
                    type(C) == "table"
                    and #C >= 5
                    and typeof(C[5]) == "CFrame"
                    and type(C[1]) == "number"
                    and type(C[2]) == "number"
                )
            then
                return
            end
            local lookVector = C[5].LookVector
            local G = math.sqrt(lookVector.X * lookVector.X + lookVector.Z * lookVector.Z)
            if G <= 0.01 then
                return
            end
            local spikePaths = hazardReader.spikePaths or {}
            hazardReader.spikePaths = spikePaths
            local now = os.clock()
            for index = #spikePaths, 1, -1 do
                if spikePaths[index].t1 < now then
                    table.remove(spikePaths, index)
                end
            end
            spikePaths[#spikePaths + 1] = {
                kind = kind,
                ox = C[5].Position.X,
                oz = C[5].Position.Z,
                dx = lookVector.X / G,
                dz = lookVector.Z / G,
                len = C[1],
                speed = C[1] / math.max(C[2], 0.01),
                t0 = serverTimestampToLocalClock(C[3]),
                t1 = serverTimestampToLocalClock(C[4]) + 0.3,
            }
            while #spikePaths > 24 do
                table.remove(spikePaths, 1)
            end
        end

        local function D(rodinRig)
            local rodinRigCache = hazardReader.rodinRigCache
            if not rodinRigCache then
                local setMetatable, weakKeys = setmetatable, {
                    __mode = "k",
                }
                rodinRigCache = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
                hazardReader.rodinRigCache = rodinRigCache
            else
            end
            local n = rodinRigCache[rodinRig]
            local f = n ~= nil
            if f then
                return n
            end
            n = false
            f = lowercase(rodinRig.Name):find("reincarnation", 1, true)
            if f then
                n = true
            else
            end
            f = not n
            if f then
                local function x()
                    local iterateArray, e = ipairs, vmHelpers[127](rodinRig:GetDescendants())
                    for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(e)) do
                        key = entry:IsA("MeshPart") and entry.Name:find("odinfinalpieces", 1, true)
                        if key then
                            n = true
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(x)
            end
            rodinRigCache[rodinRig] = n
            f = n and hazardReader.rodinRig ~= rodinRig
            if f then
                hazardReader.rodinRig = rodinRig
                contextLogT(
                    "rodin",
                    3,
                    "Scan",
                    ("bonus boss rig found: %s under %s"):format(
                        rodinRig.Name,
                        rodinRig.Parent and rodinRig.Parent.Name or "?"
                    )
                )
            end
            return n
        end
        local function _()
            if hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent then
                return true
            end
            local Z = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (Z ~= nil and tostring(Z.Value) == "Northern Lands") then
                return false
            end
            Z = workspace:FindFirstChild("bonusBossStatus")
            if Z ~= nil and tostring(Z.Value or "") ~= "" then
                return true
            end
            Z = workspace:FindFirstChild("bonusBossVotingActive")
            return Z ~= nil and Z.Value == true
        end
        context.rodinAlive = function()
            local rodinRig = hazardReader.rodinRig
            if rodinRig and rodinRig.Parent then
                local humanoid = rodinRig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    return true
                end
            end
            rodinRig = workspace:FindFirstChild("Odin Reincarnation")
            if rodinRig ~= nil and rodinRig:IsA("Model") then
                local humanoid2 = rodinRig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health > 0 then
                    hazardReader.rodinRig = rodinRig
                    return true
                end
            end
            local Z, rodinCands = os.clock(), hazardReader.rodinCands
            if rodinCands == nil or Z - (hazardReader.rodinCandsAt or -min) >= 1 then
                rodinCands = {}
                for index, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Model") and lowercase(child.Name):find("reincarnation", 1, true) then
                        rodinCands[#rodinCands + 1] = child
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.rodinCands = rodinCands
                hazardReader.rodinCandsAt = Z
            else
            end
            for index2 = 1, #rodinCands, 1 do
                Z = rodinCands[index2]
                if Z.Parent == workspace then
                    index2 = Z:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if index2 and index2.Health > 0 then
                        hazardReader.rodinRig = Z
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local d
        local function contextReaderTick(_)
            local sweepSkip = hazardReader.considerQueue
            if sweepSkip and #sweepSkip > 0 then
                local f = math.min(#sweepSkip, config.considerBudget or 120)
                for index = 1, f, 1 do
                    local a = sweepSkip[index]
                    if a and a.Parent then
                        pcall(v, a, true)
                    end
                end
                local x = #sweepSkip
                if f >= x then
                    table.clear(sweepSkip)
                else
                    local a = math.floor(f)
                    if a > 0 then
                        table.move(sweepSkip, a + 1, x, 1)
                        for index2 = x - a + 1, x, 1 do
                            sweepSkip[index2] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if _ - (hazardReader.abilityNamesAt or -min) > 5 then
                hazardReader.abilityNamesAt = _
                sweepSkip = workspace:FindFirstChild("thirdBossMiddlePart")
                hazardReader.arenaCentre = sweepSkip and sweepSkip.Position or nil
                hazardReader.ringBand = false
                hazardReader.bobHome = nil
                hazardReader.dodgeCentre = nil
                for index3, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                    if entry.isBoss and entry.humanoid and entry.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        index3 = context.bossProfile(entry.model and entry.model.Name)
                        if index3 and index3.ringBand then
                            hazardReader.ringBand = true
                            hazardReader.dodgeCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
                            break
                        end
                        if index3 and index3.orbs then
                            hazardReader.bobHome = context.bobCrystalCentroid() or Vector3.new(-136, 23, 327)
                            hazardReader.dodgeCentre = hazardReader.bobHome
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.hitDelay = hazardReader.hitDelay or {}
                if not hazardReader.learnedSeeded then
                    hazardReader.learnedSeeded = true
                    for key, entry2 in pairs(type(config.learnedHits) == "table" and config.learnedHits or {}) do
                        if
                            type(entry2) == "table"
                            and type(entry2.min) == "number"
                            and type(entry2.max) == "number"
                            and (entry2.n or 0) >= 3
                            and not hazardReader.hitDelay[key]
                        then
                            local med = type(entry2.med) == "number" and entry2.med
                                or (entry2.min + entry2.max) * 0.5
                            local hitDelay, metrics =
                                hazardReader.hitDelay, {
                                    n = entry2.n,
                                    min = entry2.min,
                                    max = entry2.max,
                                    med = med,
                                    sum = 0,
                                }
                            metrics.list, hitDelay[key] =
                                {
                                    entry2.min,
                                    med,
                                    entry2.max,
                                }, metrics
                        end
                    end
                end
                if type(config.learnedHits) ~= "table" then
                    config.learnedHits = {}
                end
                for key2, entry3 in pairs(hazardReader.hitDelay) do
                    if entry3.n >= 3 then
                        config.learnedHits[key2] = {
                            n = entry3.n,
                            min = entry3.min,
                            max = entry3.max,
                            med = entry3.med,
                        }
                    end
                end
                local f, x, aoe =
                    {}, ipairs, {
                        localPlayer.Backpack,
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
