        local n = {}
        local function contextOrbLegs(x)
            local a = n[x]
            if a ~= nil then
                return a or nil
            end
            local e, N, arenaCentre =
                context.ORB_PATHS and context.ORB_PATHS[x],
                context.ORB_SLOTS and context.ORB_SLOTS[x],
                hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not (e and #e >= 4 and N and arenaCentre) then
                return nil
            end
            a = {}
            local C = #e / 2
            for index = 1, C, 1 do
                local i, b, len, G, z = e[2 * index - 1], e[2 * index]
                if index < C then
                    local C, s = e[2 * index + 1] - i, e[2 * index + 2] - b
                    len = sqrt(C * C + s * s)
                    G, z = C / len, s / len
                else
                    local e = math.rad(N[index] or N[#N])
                    G, z = math.cos(e), math.sin(e)
                    local N, C, s = i - arenaCentre.X, b - arenaCentre.Z, config.orbWallR or 99
                    e = N * G + C * z
                    local I = e * e - (N * N + C * C - s * s)
                    len = I > 0 and max(-e + sqrt(I), 0) or 0
                    len = if len < 1 then config.orbLastLegLen or 200 else len
                end
                a[index] = {
                    x = i,
                    z = b,
                    ux = G,
                    uz = z,
                    len = len,
                }
            end
            n[x] = a
            return a
        end
        context.orbLegs = contextOrbLegs
        local function n(x, vector, orbAlongAt)
            local N, I = hazardReader.arenaCentre, sqrt((x.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (x.vz or 0) ^ 2)
            if x.orbSlot == nil and not x.orbSlotNo then
                local C = sqrt((vector.X - N.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - N.Z) ^ 2)
                if C >= (config.orbSlotMinR or 3) and C < (config.orbSlotFrom or 80) then
                    local g, i, orbSlot =
                        math.deg(math.atan2(vector.Z - N.Z, vector.X - N.X)), config.orbSlotTol or 4
                    for index = 0, 14, 1 do
                        local G = abs((g - (context.ORB_FIRST - context.ORB_STEP * index) + 180) % 360 - 180)
                        if G < i then
                            i, orbSlot = G, index
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    orbSlot = if orbSlot and I > 2
                        then if abs((math.deg(math.atan2(x.vz, x.vx)) - g + 180) % 360 - 180)
                                > (config.orbSlotDirTol or 25)
                            then nil
                            else orbSlot
                        else orbSlot
                    if orbSlot and (contextOrbLegs(orbSlot)) then
                        x.orbSlot = orbSlot
                        x.orbLegN = 1
                        g = runtimeState.perf and runtimeState.perf.cur
                        if g then
                            g.orbSlotted = (g.orbSlotted or 0) + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                if x.orbSlot == nil and C >= (config.orbSlotMinR or 3) and I > 2 then
                    local C, g, i, b, orbSlot2, orbLegN =
                        x.vx / I, x.vz / I, math.cos(math.rad(config.orbSlotDirTol or 25)), config.orbLegLat or 3
                    for index2 = 0, 14, 1 do
                        local s = contextOrbLegs(index2)
                        if s then
                            for index3 = 1, #s, 1 do
                                local W = s[index3]
                                if W.ux * C + W.uz * g >= i then
                                    local C, g = vector.X - W.x, vector.Z - W.z
                                    local s = C * W.ux + g * W.uz
                                    if s >= -2 and s <= W.len + 2 then
                                        local s = abs(C * W.uz - g * W.ux)
                                        if s < b then
                                            b, orbSlot2, orbLegN = s, index2, index3
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if orbSlot2 then
                        x.orbSlot = orbSlot2
                        x.orbLegN = orbLegN
                        i = runtimeState.perf and runtimeState.perf.cur
                        if i then
                            i.orbSlotted, i.orbSlotLate = (i.orbSlotted or 0) + 1, (i.orbSlotLate or 0) + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            I = x.orbSlot and contextOrbLegs(x.orbSlot)
            if not I then
                return
            end
            N = x.orbLegN or 1
            while N < #I do
                local f, C = I[N], I[N + 1]
                local g, i = vector.X - f.x, vector.Z - f.z
                if g * f.ux + i * f.uz >= f.len - (config.orbLegTurnAt or 1.5) then
                    N += 1
                else
                    local b, B, G = abs(g * f.uz - i * f.ux), vector.X - C.x, vector.Z - C.z
                    local f = abs(B * C.uz - G * C.ux)
                    if b > 2 and f < 1 and B * C.ux + G * C.uz >= 0 then
                        N += 1
                    else
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            x.orbLegN = N
            local f = I[N]
            x.orbAlong = max(min2((vector.X - f.x) * f.ux + (vector.Z - f.z) * f.uz, f.len), 0)
            if x.orbAlongAt and x.orbAlongLeg == N and orbAlongAt - x.orbAlongAt > 0.05 then
                I = (x.orbAlong - (x.orbAlongPrev or x.orbAlong)) / (orbAlongAt - x.orbAlongAt)
                if I > 5 and I < 80 and x.orbAlong < f.len - 3 then
                    x.orbPathSpd = (x.orbPathSpd or I) * 0.8 + I * 0.2
                end
            end
            x.orbAlongPrev = x.orbAlong
            x.orbAlongAt = orbAlongAt
            x.orbAlongLeg = N
        end
        local function f(vector, a, e, N, I, C)
            local dist = Z ~= C
            if dist then
                Z = C
                local filterDescendantsInstances = {}
                for index, entry in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if entry.Character then
                        filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = entry.Character
                    end
                end
                if runtimeState.visualRoot then
                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = runtimeState.visualRoot
                end
                if hazardReader.rodinRig then
                    filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = hazardReader.rodinRig
                end
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                    if entry2.isBoss and entry2.model and entry2.model ~= hazardReader.rodinRig then
                        filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = entry2.model
                    end
                end
                raycastParams2.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
            end
            dist = N * (config.orbLaneTime or config.bubbleTrajLead or 2.4) + I + 2
            local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(vector, Vector3.new(a, 0, e) * dist, raycastParams2)
            if not raycastResult then
                return nil
            end
            local _, Z = raycastResult.Normal.X, raycastResult.Normal.Z
            local i, b = sqrt(_ * _ + Z * Z), hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if i < 0.3 and b then
                _, Z = b.X - raycastResult.Position.X, b.Z - raycastResult.Position.Z
                i = sqrt(_ * _ + Z * Z)
            else
            end
            if i < 0.01 then
                return nil
            end
            _ /= i
            Z /= i
            b = a * _ + e * Z
            if b > -0.05 then
                return nil
            end
            dist = max(raycastResult.Distance - I / max(-b, 0.2), 0)
            return {
                x = vector.X + a * dist,
                z = vector.Z + e * dist,
                dx = a - 2 * b * _,
                dz = e - 2 * b * Z,
                dist = dist,
                t = C + dist / N,
            }
        end
        local function contextHazards(u, Z)
            Z = Z or {}
            if hazardReader.bossDownUntil and u < hazardReader.bossDownUntil then
                for index = #Z, 1, -1 do
                    Z[index] = nil
                end
                return Z
            end
            local x = hazardReader.charAt ~= nil
                and u - hazardReader.charAt < (config.invulnAfterRespawn or 4)
                and context.PB ~= nil
                and context.PB.boss ~= nil
            if x and config.invulnKeepReading == false then
                for index2 = #Z, 1, -1 do
                    Z[index2] = nil
                end
                return Z
            end
            local a = 0
            local e, speed, I = hazardReader.spikeField, pairs, hazardReader.models
            for key, entry in speed(I) do
                key = entry.name
                local i = key == "smallicespikes" or key == "mediumicespikes" or key == "largeicespikes"
                if e and (e.untilAt or 0) > u - 2 and i then
                    e.untilAt = math.max(e.untilAt or 0, u + (config.spikeFieldRefresh or 0.6))
                    hazardReader.spikeFieldUntil = math.max(hazardReader.spikeFieldUntil or 0, e.untilAt)
                end
                if
                    context.fixesOn
                    and context.fixesOn()
                    and entry.model
                    and entry.model.Parent
                    and (not entry.hbs or #entry.hbs == 0)
                    and u - (entry.rescanAt or 0) > 0.1
                then
                    entry.rescanAt = u
                    local hbs, pcs = {}, {}
                    for index3, descendant in ipairs(entry.model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                            index3 = string.lower(descendant.Name)
                            if index3:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                                hbs[#hbs + 1] = descendant
                            end
                            if index3:find("precast", 1, true) then
                                pcs[#pcs + 1] = descendant
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #hbs > 0 then
                        entry.hbs, entry.hb = hbs, hbs[1]
                        entry.noTele = false
                        entry.boxes = {}
                    end
                    if #pcs > 0 and (not entry.pcs or #entry.pcs == 0) then
                        entry.pcs, entry.pc = pcs, pcs[1]
                    end
                end
                local i = entry.precastBox and entry.pcs and #entry.pcs > 0
                local b, anchorBuf =
                    i and entry.pcs or (entry.hbs and #entry.hbs > 0 and entry.hbs or entry.pcs), entry.anchorBuf
                if not anchorBuf then
                    anchorBuf = {}
                    entry.anchorBuf = anchorBuf
                else
                end
                if not entry.boxes then
                    entry.boxes = {}
                end
                local G = 0
                if b then
                    for index4 = 1, #b, 1 do
                        local s = b[index4]
                        if s.Parent then
                            G += 1
                            anchorBuf[G] = s
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                if G == 0 then
                    b = entry.precastBox and entry.pc and entry.pc.Parent and entry.pc
                        or (
                            entry.hb and entry.hb.Parent and entry.hb
                            or (entry.pc and entry.pc.Parent and entry.pc or nil)
                        )
                    if b then
                        anchorBuf[1] = b
                        G = 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                b = anchorBuf[1]
                if b and not hazardReader.shown[b] then
                    if b.Transparency < 0.9 then
                        entry.everSeen = true
                    elseif
                        entry.everSeen
                        and u > entry.from
                        and not (
                            entry.holdLive
                            or timing[entry.name]
                                and (timing[entry.name].holdLive or timing[entry.name].linger and entry.hbs and #entry.hbs > 0 and entry.hbs[1].Parent)
                        )
                    then
                        entry.untilAt = min2(entry.untilAt, u + 0.05)
                    end
                end
                if entry.casters and not entry.casterDead then
                    b = false
                    for index5, caster in ipairs(entry.casters) do
                        if caster.Parent and caster.Health > 0 then
                            b = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not b then
                        entry.casterDead = true
                        entry.long = false
                        entry.holdLive = nil
                        entry.untilAt = math.min(entry.untilAt, u)
                    end
                end
                b = entry.detonatedAt and not entry.long and 0 or 0.05
                local z, s =
                    (G > 0 or u <= entry.untilAt) and (entry.long or u <= entry.untilAt + b),
                    G > 0 and G or #entry.boxes
                for index6 = 1, s, 1 do
                    local src, T = anchorBuf[index6], entry.boxes[index6]
                    if src then
                        if index6 > 1 and not hazardReader.shown[src] then
                            if src.Transparency < 0.9 then
                                entry.everSeen = true
                            elseif
                                entry.everSeen
                                and u > entry.from
                                and not (
                                    entry.holdLive
                                    or timing[entry.name]
                                        and (timing[entry.name].holdLive or timing[entry.name].linger and entry.hbs and #entry.hbs > 0 and entry.hbs[1].Parent)
                                )
                            then
                                entry.untilAt = min2(entry.untilAt, u + 0.05)
                            end
                        end
                        local B, W = src.Size, src:IsA("Part")
                        b = W and src.Shape
                        local K = W and b == Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                        B = if i
                                and (not entry.hbs or #entry.hbs == 0)
                                and not K
                            then Vector3.new(B.X, max(B.Y, 10), B.Z)
                            else B
                        B = if entry.precastBox and i and K then Vector3.new(max(B.X, 20), B.Y, B.Z) else B
                        B = if entry.pad > 0
                            then K and Vector3.new(B.X, B.Y + entry.pad * 2, B.Z + entry.pad * 2) or Vector3.new(
                                B.X + entry.pad * 2,
                                B.Y,
                                B.Z + entry.pad * 2
                            )
                            else B
                        if not T then
                            T = {
                                name = entry.name,
                                kind = "model",
                                attack = true,
                                slim = entry.slim,
                                weight = entry.name == "thirdbossmultirings" and 0.35 or nil,
                                castRed = entry.name == "firstbossjumpslam" or nil,
                            }
                            entry.boxes[index6] = T
                        else
                        end
                        T.bornAt, T.fired = entry.spawn, entry.fired
                        T.noFlee = context.OD ~= nil
                                and context.OD.danceIgnore ~= nil
                                and entry.model ~= nil
                                and context.OD.danceIgnore[entry.model] == true
                            or nil
                        local i = W and b == Enum.PartType.Ball or entry.name == "firstbossjumpslam"
                        if
                            not i
                            and not K
                            and config.spikeRound ~= false
                            and tostring(entry.name or ""):find("spike", 1, true)
                            and max(B.X, B.Z)
                                <= (config.spikeRoundAspect or 2) * max(min2(B.X, B.Z), 0.1)
                        then
                            W = max(B.X, B.Z)
                            B, i = (Vector3.new(W, B.Y, W)), true
                        else
                        end
                        W = src.CFrame
                        if
                            not i
                            and not K
                            and config.roundAll ~= false
                            and (
                                src:IsA("MeshPart")
                                or src:IsA("UnionOperation")
                                or src:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil
                            )
                        then
                            local b, t = detectRoundDimensions(W, B)
                            if b then
                                B, i = (Vector3.new(b, t, b)), true
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        contextFootprint(T, W, B, i, K)
                        T.src = src
                        W = timing[entry.name]
                        if W and W.sweeps then
                            local position, vector, speed2 = src.Position, T.swPos, T.swT
                            if vector and u - speed2 > 0.03 then
                                local W, K =
                                    (position.X - vector.X) / (u - speed2), (position.Z - vector.Z) / (u - speed2)
                                T.swVx, T.swVz = (T.swVx or W) * 0.6 + W * 0.4, (T.swVz or K) * 0.6 + K * 0.4
                                T.swPos = position
                                T.swT = u
                            elseif not vector then
                                T.swPos = position
                                T.swT = u
                            end
                            speed2 = sqrt((T.swVx or 0) ^ 2 + (T.swVz or 0) ^ 2)
                            if speed2 > 2 and speed2 < 80 then
                                T.moving, T.ox, T.oy, T.oz, T.dx, T.dz =
                                    true, position.X, position.Y, position.Z, T.swVx / speed2, T.swVz / speed2
                                T.speed = speed2
                                T.offset = 0
                                T.pathStart = u
                                T.halfW, T.halfL, T.halfH =
                                    max(B.X, B.Z) * 0.5, min2(B.X, B.Z) * 0.5, max(B.Y * 0.5, 6)
                            else
                                T.moving = nil
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    z = T and z
                    if z then
                        T.from, T.untilAt, T.exact =
                            entry.from, src and entry.long and min or entry.untilAt, entry.exact
                        T.noGrace = entry.name == "firstbosspassivebeam" and config.beamNoGrace ~= false or nil
                        T.warn = not entry.fired
                            and u < entry.from
                            and entry.pc ~= nil
                            and entry.pc.Parent ~= nil
                            and entry.pc.Transparency < 1
                        local o, i =
                            false,
                            config.rodinFlameStackOne ~= false
                                and entry.name == "bonusbossgroundflame"
                                and T.cx
                                and not T.moving
                        if i then
                            index6 = config.rodinFlameStack or 6
                            for index7 = 1, a, 1 do
                                local zone = Z[index7]
                                if zone.name == "bonusbossgroundflame" and zone.cx and not zone.moving then
                                    index7 = sqrt((zone.cx - T.cx) ^ 2 + (zone.cz - T.cz) ^ 2)
                                    if index7 <= index6 then
                                        local G = T.r or max(T.halfW or 0, T.halfL or 0)
                                        local z = max(zone.r or max(zone.halfW or 0, zone.halfL or 0), index7 + G)
                                        if zone.r then
                                            zone.r = z
                                        end
                                        zone.halfW, zone.halfL = max(zone.halfW or 0, z), max(zone.halfL or 0, z)
                                        zone.untilAt = max(zone.untilAt or 0, T.untilAt or 0)
                                        o = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        i = not o
                            and not (
                                key == "thirdbosslineshot"
                                and context.odinIgnoreLine ~= nil
                                and context.odinIgnoreLine(entry.model)
                            )
                        if i then
                            a += 1
                            Z[a] = T
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                entry.box = entry.boxes[1]
            end
            I = nil
            if
                hazardReader.orbBlastAt
                and u > hazardReader.orbBlastAt - (config.orbBlastLead or 2)
                and u < hazardReader.orbBlastAt + 0.7
            then
                local o, o, o = contextCharacter()
                if o then
                    local C, g, i = o.Position.X, o.Position.Z, min
                    for part in pairs(hazardReader.parts) do
                        if part.Parent and lowercase(part.Name):find("bouncingorb", 1, true) then
                            e = part.Position
                            speed = (e.X - C) * (e.X - C) + (e.Z - g) * (e.Z - g)
                            if speed < i then
                                i, I = speed, part
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            e, speed = pairs, hazardReader.parts
            for key2, entry2 in e(speed) do
                local speed3 = sqrt(entry2.vx * entry2.vx + entry2.vz * entry2.vz)
                local size, position2 = key2.Size, key2.Position
                local B, hzNameF = key2.Name, entry2.hzNameF
                if not hzNameF or entry2.hzNameK ~= B then
                    local z, proj = lowercase(B), false
                    for index8, entry3 in ipairs(y) do
                        if z:find(entry3, 1, true) then
                            proj = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    hzNameF = {
                        pn = z,
                        proj = proj,
                        bigspike = z:find("bigspike", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        seeking = z:find("seeking", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        crisscross = z:find("crisscross", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        bouncingorb = z:find("bouncingorb", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        orb = z:find("orb", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        missile = z:find("missile", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        thirdboss = z:find("thirdboss", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        thirdbossmissile = z:find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        bbBouncingOrb = z:find("bonusbossbouncingorb", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        bonusboss = z:find("bonusboss", 1, true) ~= nil,
                        secondboss = z:find("secondboss", 1, true) ~= nil,
                    }
                    entry2.hzNameF = hzNameF
                    entry2.hzNameK = B
                else
                end
                local y, z = hzNameF.pn, max(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5
                z = if hzNameF.bigspike
                    then z + (config.bigSpikePad or 0)
                    else if hzNameF.seeking
                        then z + (config.seekingPad or 0)
                        else if hzNameF.crisscross
                            then z + (config.crissTruePad or 0)
                            else if hzNameF.bouncingorb then z + (config.orbBodyPad2 or 0) else z
                local s, T
                if hzNameF.crisscross and config.crissExact ~= false and context.crissPathFor then
                    s = context.crissPathFor(key2, entry2, position2, u)
                    if s then
                        B = config.crissLead
                            or math.clamp(runtimeState.dataPingS or runtimeState.pingS or 0.06, 0, 0.3)
                        T = math.clamp(s.v * (u - (s.t0v or s.t0) + B), 0, s.len)
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                local box = entry2.box
                if not box then
                    B = false
                    for index9 = 1, #(context.LANE_HARD or {}), 1 do
                        local t = context.LANE_HARD[index9]
                        if y:find(t, 1, true) then
                            B = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    local K = y:find("crisscross", 1, true)
                        or y:find("spike", 1, true)
                        or y:find("orb", 1, true)
                        or y:find("shot", 1, true)
                        or y:find("strike", 1, true)
                        or y:find("missile", 1, true)
                    box = {
                        name = key2.Name,
                        kind = "part",
                        attack = true,
                        ground = K ~= nil,
                        warn = false,
                        laneHard = B or nil,
                        src = key2,
                    }
                    entry2.box = box
                else
                end
                if hzNameF.thirdbossmissile then
                    B = context.rodinMissiles() and config.rodinMissileDanger ~= true
                    box.weight = B and 0 or nil
                    box.noDraw = B and config.rodinMissileDraw ~= true or nil
                end
                B = (hzNameF.thirdboss or hzNameF.bbBouncingOrb)
                    and hzNameF.orb
                    and speed3 > 6
                    and not (hzNameF.bouncingorb and config.bounceLeadZone ~= true)
                if B then
                    local K = config.orbLeadTime or 0.4
                    local t, H, X = position2.X + entry2.vx * K, position2.Z + entry2.vz * K, hzNameF.bouncingorb
                    if X then
                        K = config.bounceLeadTime or 0.8
                        t = position2.X + entry2.vx * K
                        H = position2.Z + entry2.vz * K
                    else
                    end
                    local lead = entry2.lead
                    if not lead then
                        lead = {
                            name = key2.Name .. " lead",
                            kind = "part",
                            ground = true,
                            warn = false,
                            weight = 1,
                            castRed = true,
                        }
                        entry2.lead = lead
                    else
                    end
                    lead.weight = X and (config.bounceLaneWeight or 0.6) or 1
                    lead.castRed = not X or nil
                    local QF, LF = max(size.X, size.Z), X and (config.bouncePad2 or 0)
                    X = QF + (LF or (config.orbLeadPad or 4)) * 2
                    contextFootprint(
                        lead,
                        CFrame.new(t, position2.Y, H),
                        Vector3.new(X, max(size.Y, 10), X),
                        true,
                        false
                    )
                    lead.from, lead.untilAt = u, u + K + 0.3
                    a += 1
                    Z[a] = lead
                else
                end
                B = hzNameF.bouncingorb
                if B then
                    box.weight = config.bounceWeight
                    box.bounces = true
                    local K = hazardReader.orbBlastAt and key2 == I
                    if K then
                        local blast = entry2.blast
                        if not blast then
                            blast = {
                                name = "orb blast",
                                kind = "part",
                                ground = true,
                                warn = false,
                                weight = 1,
                            }
                            entry2.blast = blast
                        else
                        end
                        local t = config.orbBlastRadius or 26
                        contextFootprint(blast, CFrame.new(position2), Vector3.new(t * 2, 14, t * 2), true, false)
                        blast.from, blast.untilAt = u, u + 0.5
                        a += 1
                        Z[a] = blast
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                B = false
                if
                    hzNameF.secondboss
                    and hzNameF.orb
                    and config.orbPillarShield ~= false
                    and context.orbShielded
                then
                    local K = contextCharacter()
                    local t = K and (K:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    B = if t then context.orbShielded(key2, t) else B
                else
                end
                if hzNameF.secondboss and hzNameF.orb then
                    box.weight = B and 0 or nil
                    box.laneFree = B or nil
                end
                local K = hzNameF.secondboss and hzNameF.orb and not B
                if K then
                    box.noFlee = true
                    B = entry2.bubble
                    if not B then
                        B = {
                            name = key2.Name .. " bubble",
                            kind = "part",
                            ground = false,
                            warn = false,
                            weight = 0.75,
                            noFlee = true,
                        }
                        entry2.bubble = B
                    else
                    end
                    local t = sqrt(entry2.vx * entry2.vx + entry2.vz * entry2.vz)
                    local H, X =
                        min2(t * (config.orbAheadTime or 0.6), config.orbAheadMax or 24), contextCharacter()
                    local dF = X and (X:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    if dF then
                        X = contextFlatDistance(position2, dF.Position)
                            - (config.orbBubble or 34)
                            - (config.orbAheadKeep or 10)
                        H = if X < H then (max(X, 0)) else H
                    else
                    end
                    local V, X, dF =
                        t > 0.5 and entry2.vx / t or 0,
                        t > 0.5 and entry2.vz / t or 0,
                        (config.orbBubble + H * 0.5) * 2
                    contextFootprint(
                        B,
                        CFrame.new(position2.X + V * H * 0.5, position2.Y, position2.Z + X * H * 0.5),
                        Vector3.new(dF, 12, dF),
                        true,
                        false
                    )
                    B.from, B.untilAt = u, u + 0.5
                    a += 1
                    Z[a] = B
                else
                end

        d = function(character)
            local u, u, y = contextCharacter()
            if not u or not y then
                hazardReader.lastHp = nil
                return
            end
            local lastHp = u.Health
            if hazardReader.lastHp and lastHp < hazardReader.lastHp - 0.5 then
                u = context.depthOf
                if u then
                    hazardReader.earlyScratch = hazardReader.earlyScratch or {}
                    local V, E, j, U = contextHazards(character, hazardReader.earlyScratch), y.Position, min
                    local y, w, Z, n = 0, false, min
                    for index = 1, #V, 1 do
                        local f = V[index]
                        if not f.weight and attackCatalog[f.name or ""] then
                            local r, o = (f.from or 0) - character, u(f, E.X, E.Y, E.Z, 0)
                            if -o < j then
                                j, U, y = -o, f, r
                            else
                            end
                            if r > 0.05 and o >= 0 then
                                if type(config.earlyHits) ~= "table" then
                                    config.earlyHits = {}
                                end
                                index = config.earlyHits[f.name] or 0
                                if r + 0.05 > index then
                                    config.earlyHits[f.name] = r + 0.05
                                    contextLogT(
                                        "early",
                                        3,
                                        "Reader",
                                        ("%s hit %.1f s before its window opened: pulled forward"):format(
                                            f.name,
                                            r
                                        )
                                    )
                                end
                            end
                            if character >= (f.from or 0) and character <= (f.untilAt or 0) then
                                if o >= 0 then
                                    w = true
                                else
                                    if -o < Z then
                                        Z, n = -o, f
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if not w and U and j <= config.missHitMax then
                        if y <= 0.05 then
                            if type(config.missHits) ~= "table" then
                                config.missHits = {}
                            end
                            V = config.missHits[U.name] or 0
                            if j + 0.5 > V then
                                config.missHits[U.name] = math.min(j + 0.5, config.missHitMax)
                                contextLogT(
                                    "miss",
                                    3,
                                    "Reader",
                                    ("%s reached %.1f studs past its box: padded"):format(U.name, j)
                                )
                            end
                        elseif y > 0 and y < 2 then
                            if type(config.earlyHits) ~= "table" then
                                config.earlyHits = {}
                            end
                            E = config.earlyHits[U.name] or 0
                            if y + 0.05 > E then
                                config.earlyHits[U.name] = y + 0.05
                                contextLogT(
                                    "early",
                                    3,
                                    "Reader",
                                    ("%s fired %.1f s before its window while we stood beside it: pulled forward"):format(
                                        U.name,
                                        y
                                    )
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if lastHp <= 0 and (hazardReader.lastHp or 0) > 0 then
                character = localPlayer.Character
                u = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                if u then
                    hazardReader.lastDeathPos = u.Position
                end
            end
            hazardReader.lastHp = lastHp
        end
        local function contextReaderStart()
            pcall(function()
                hazardReader.timeSync = require(replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("timeSync"))
            end)
            local u = {
                "shot",
                "strike",
                "spike",
                "beam",
                "orb",
                "missile",
                "ring",
                "wall",
                "slam",
                "cross",
                "boss",
                "spear",
                "ball",
                "bomb",
                "rock",
                "shuriken",
                "laser",
                "explosion",
            }
            hazardReader.considerQueue = hazardReader.considerQueue or {}
            hazardReader.connections[#hazardReader.connections + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(
                function(y)
                    local q = os.clock()
                    if not hazardReader.streamWinAt or q - hazardReader.streamWinAt > 0.1 then
                        hazardReader.streamWinAt = q
                        hazardReader.streamWinN = 0
                    end
                    hazardReader.streamWinN = (hazardReader.streamWinN or 0) + 1
                    if hazardReader.streamWinN >= (config.streamBurstN or 300) then
                        if
                            not hazardReader.streamBurstAt
                            or q - hazardReader.streamBurstAt > (config.streamBurstGap or 1)
                        then
                            hazardReader.streamBurstSince = q
                        end
                        hazardReader.streamBurstAt = q
                    end
                    q = string.lower(y.Name)
                    local V = y.Parent == workspace or attackCatalog[y.Name] ~= nil or timing[q] ~= nil
                    if not V then
                        for index, entry in ipairs(u) do
                            if q:find(entry, 1, true) then
                                V = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if not (attackCatalog[y.Name] ~= nil or timing[q] ~= nil) then
                        local urgWinAt = os.clock()
                        if
                            hazardReader.streamBurstAt
                            and urgWinAt - hazardReader.streamBurstAt < (config.streamBurstFor or 0.6)
                            and (
                                hazardReader.streamBurstSince == nil
                                or urgWinAt - hazardReader.streamBurstSince
                                    < (config.streamBurstMax or 2.5)
                            )
                        then
                            V = false
                        else
                            if V then
                                if not hazardReader.urgWinAt or urgWinAt - hazardReader.urgWinAt > 0.05 then
                                    hazardReader.urgWinAt = urgWinAt
                                    hazardReader.urgWinN = 0
                                end
                                hazardReader.urgWinN = (hazardReader.urgWinN or 0) + 1
                                V = if hazardReader.urgWinN > (config.streamUrgentMax or 40) then false else V
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if V then
                        task.defer(function()
                            if y.Parent then
                                pcall(v, y, true)
                            end
                        end)
                    else
                        hazardReader.considerQueue[#hazardReader.considerQueue + 1] = y
                    end
                end
            )
            hazardReader.connections[#hazardReader.connections + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(
                function()
                    hazardReader.charAt = os.clock()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local character = localPlayer.Character
                        local humanoid = character and (character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8))
                        if not humanoid then
                            return
                        end
                        local now = os.clock()
                        local u, connection = humanoid.Health
                        connection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(P)
                            local q = u - 0.5
                            if P < q then
                                local runtimeState2 = context.RT
                                if runtimeState2 then
                                    runtimeState2.hurtAges = runtimeState2.hurtAges or {}
                                    runtimeState2.hurtAges[#runtimeState2.hurtAges + 1] = os.clock() - now
                                    if #runtimeState2.hurtAges > 30 then
                                        table.remove(runtimeState2.hurtAges, 1)
                                    end
                                end
                                if connection then
                                    connection:Disconnect()
                                end
                            end
                            u = P
                        end)
                    end)
                    if
                        hazardReader.firstWpKey ~= nil
                        and config.waypointFirstOnly ~= false
                        and not hazardReader.wpFlowDone
                    then
                        hazardReader.wpFlowDone = true
                        contextLogT(
                            "waypoint",
                            1,
                            "Reader",
                            "died after the first set: the waypoint flow is off for the rest of the run"
                        )
                    end
                    local bigRoom, lastDeathPos = hazardReader.bigRoom, hazardReader.lastDeathPos
                    if bigRoom and lastDeathPos then
                        local u, y = lastDeathPos.X - bigRoom.x, lastDeathPos.Z - bigRoom.z
                        if
                            u * u + y * y
                                <= ((bigRoom.r or 120) + (config.resetRoomLeave or 150)) ^ 2
                            and not bigRoom.resetWasUs
                        then
                            bigRoom.left = nil
                            bigRoom.resetDone = false
                            bigRoom.clearSince = nil
                            hazardReader.resetUsed = nil
                            hazardReader.catchUpUsed = nil
                            contextLogT(
                                "reset",
                                1,
                                "Reader",
                                "died inside the big room: its reset is armed again"
                            )
                            local diedInAt = hazardReader.charAt
                            bigRoom.diedInAt = diedInAt
                            hazardReader.spawnCp = nil
                            task.spawn(function()
                                local u, order = math.huge
                                for index = 1, 10, 1 do
                                    task.wait(0.3)
                                    if hazardReader.charAt ~= diedInAt then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    index = localPlayer.Character
                                    local h, dungeon =
                                        index and (index:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
                                        workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
                                    if h and dungeon then
                                        for index2, child in ipairs(dungeon:GetChildren()) do
                                            index, index2 =
                                                child:FindFirstChild("checkPoint"), child:FindFirstChild("order")
                                            child = index2 and tonumber(index2.Value)
                                            if index and index:IsA("BasePart") and child then
                                                index2 = (index.Position - h.Position).Magnitude
                                                if index2 < u then
                                                    u, order = index2, child
                                                else
                                                end
                                            else
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                                if
                                    hazardReader.charAt == diedInAt
                                    and order
                                    and u < (config.resetCatchUpSpawnR or 30)
                                then
                                    hazardReader.spawnCp = {
                                        at = diedInAt,
                                        order = order,
                                    }
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if bigRoom then
                        bigRoom.resetWasUs = false
                    end
                end
            )
            local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(remotes and remotes:GetChildren() or {}) do
                if entry2:IsA("RemoteEvent") and entry2.Name:find("BossSpecficEvents", 1, true) then
                    hazardReader.connections[#hazardReader.connections + 1] = entry2.OnClientEvent:Connect(
                        function(S, P)
                            if type(S) == "string" and S:find("^First Boss") and context.firstBossDead() then
                                return
                            end
                            context.famSeen(S)
                            local u = F[S]
                            if u then
                                local success, y = pcall(u, P)
                                if not success then
                                    contextLogT("evt", 2, "Reader", tostring(S) .. ": " .. tostring(y))
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    )
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                local S = require(replicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Utility", 5):WaitForChild("BridgeNet2", 5))
                local P = S.ReferenceIdentifier("action")
                hazardReader.connections[#hazardReader.connections + 1] = S.ReferenceBridge("precastHitbox")
                    :Connect(function(S)
                        if type(S) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end
                        local from = os.clock()
                            + (S.delayUntilAttack or 0)
                            - (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - (S.startTime or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
                        if S[P] == "Circle" and S.position then
                            contextAddZone({
                                name = "circle",
                                kind = "zone",
                                bubbleKeep = true,
                                cframe = CFrame.new(S.position),
                                size = Vector3.new((S.radius or 5) * 2, 12, (S.radius or 5) * 2),
                                round = true,
                                from = from,
                                untilAt = from + 0.45,
                                telegraphed = true,
                            })
                        elseif S.cframe and S.size then
                            contextAddZone({
                                name = "cube",
                                kind = "zone",
                                bubbleKeep = true,
                                cframe = S.cframe,
                                size = Vector3.new(S.size.X, max(S.size.Y, 12), S.size.Z),
                                from = from,
                                untilAt = from + 0.45,
                                telegraphed = true,
                            })
                        end
                    end)
            end)
            contextLog("Reader", "listening")
        end
        local function contextReaderStop()
            for index, connection in ipairs(hazardReader.connections) do
                pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
            end
            hazardReader.connections = {}
        end
        local function contextNearlyDead(l)
            if not l or not l.humanoid or l.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            local c = hazardReader.hitSize[l.model]
            if not c or #c < 2 then
                return false
            end
            local u = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(c) do
                u = if entry > u then entry else u
            end
            return u > 0 and l.humanoid.Health <= u * 2.2
        end
        context.clearThreats = function(l)
            hazardReader.bossDownUntil = os.clock() + config.bossDownQuiet
            for key, model in pairs(hazardReader.models) do
                if model.touchConn then
                    pcall(function()
                        model.touchConn:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
                if model.touchConns then
                    for index, touchConn in ipairs(model.touchConns) do
                        pcall(function()
                            touchConn:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            table.clear(hazardReader.models)
            table.clear(hazardReader.parts)
            for index2 = #hazardReader.zones, 1, -1 do
                hazardReader.zones[index2] = nil
            end
            table.clear(hazardReader.walls)
            hazardReader.count = 0
            hazardReader.orbLead = nil
            hazardReader.orbNear = nil
            hazardReader.orbRayU = nil
            runtimeState.reflex = nil
            contextLogT("clear", 2, "Reader", "threats cleared: " .. tostring(l))
        end
        context.RD = hazardReader
        context.hazards = contextHazards
        context.readerTick = contextReaderTick
        context.readerStart = contextReaderStart
        context.readerStop = contextReaderStop
        context.gameClock = contextGameClock
        context.nearlyDead = contextNearlyDead
    end

    components.dangerGeometry = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local contextHazards = context.hazards
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local abs = math.abs
        local max = math.max
        local min = math.min
        local infinity = math.huge
        local dangerGeometry = {
            target = nil,
            reason = "",
            dangerHere = 0,
            here0 = 0,
            now = 0,
            offsets = {},
            outer = {},
            cands = {},
            boxes = {},
            reach = 2,
            halfHeight = 5,
            feet = 3,
            approach = nil,
            heading = nil,
            headingAt = -infinity,
            evalStats = {},
        }
        local function contextDepthOf(zone, y, q, V, E)
            local p = q - zone.cy
            if abs(p) > zone.hy + E then
                if
                    not (
                        p > 0
                        and p <= zone.hy + E + (config.sinkSlack or 4)
                        and zone.hy <= 1.5
                        and (zone.r or max(zone.ha or 0, zone.hb or 0)) >= 3
                        and context.belowNL
                        and context.belowNL()
                    )
                then
                    return -infinity
                end
            end
            p, E = y - zone.cx, V - zone.cz
            if zone.r then
                V = sqrt(p * p + E * E)
                q = zone.r - V
                if zone.ring then
                    if p * zone.sx + E * zone.sz < 0 then
                        return -infinity
                    end
                    q = min(q, V - zone.ring)
                else
                end
                return q
            end
            V, y = abs(p * zone.ax + E * zone.az) - zone.ha, abs(p * zone.bx + E * zone.bz) - zone.hb
            if V <= 0 and y <= 0 then
                return -max(V, y)
            end
            return -sqrt(max(V, 0) ^ 2 + max(y, 0) ^ 2)
        end
        local function depthWeight(R, y, q)
            local V = R + y
            if V >= 0 then
                return 1
            end
            if -V < q then
                return 1 + V / q
            end
            return 0
        end
        local function contextDangerAt(y, q, V, E, p, j, U)
            local J, w, Y, v, M =
                p or dangerGeometry.reach,
                dangerGeometry.halfHeight,
                j or config.dodgeShoulder,
                dangerGeometry.now,
                dangerGeometry.boxes
            j, p = v + E, 0
            for index = 1, #M, 1 do
                local n = M[index]
                if not n.far and not (U and U(n)) then
                    index = nil
                    if n.moving then
                        if j <= n.untilAt and (n.ground or abs(q - n.oy) <= n.halfH + w) then
                            local U, f = n.offset + n.speed * max(j - n.pathStart, 0), n.endAlong
                            U = if f and U > f then f else U
                            local r, o = n.dx, n.dz
                            local A, k = y - (n.ox + r * U), V - (n.oz + o * U)
                            local U, x, a = A * r + k * o, n.r
                            if x then
                                f = -A * o + k * r
                                index, a = x - sqrt(U * U + f * f), abs(f) - x
                            else
                                local f = abs(U) - n.halfL
                                a = abs(-A * o + k * r) - n.halfW
                                index = if f <= 0 and a <= 0
                                    then -max(f, a)
                                    else -sqrt(max(f, 0) ^ 2 + max(a, 0) ^ 2)
                            end
                            p = if index + J < 0
                                    and not n.noLane
                                    and not n.laneFree
                                    and U > n.halfL
                                    and a <= J
                                    and U - n.halfL <= n.speed * min(
                                        max(n.untilAt - j, 0),
                                        n.horizon or config.laneHorizon
                                    )
                                    and p < config.pathLaneDanger
                                then config.pathLaneDanger
                                else p
                        else
                        end
                    else
                        local from, U = n.from, not n.exact and (n.telegraphed or n.from > v)
                        local f = U and max(n.lead or config.dodgeLead, dangerGeometry.leadFloor or 0)
                            or (dangerGeometry.leadFloor or 0)
                        index = if j >= from - f and j <= n.untilAt then contextDepthOf(n, y, q, V, w) else index
                    end
                    if index then
                        local _, U
                        if n.fullKeep and not dangerGeometry.redRelax then
                            _, U = dangerGeometry.reach or J, config.redOrbShoulder or 0.75
                        else
                            _, U = J, Y
                        end
                        if n.slim then
                            _, U =
                                (min(_, n.slim + (dangerGeometry.lag or 0) * config.slimLagShare)),
                                min(U, config.slimShoulder)
                        else
                        end
                        local f = index + _
                        f = if n.soft and E > config.softAfter
                            then (if n.weight
                                then (if f >= 0 then 1 else if -f < U then 1 + f / U else 0) * n.weight
                                else if f >= 0 then 1 else if -f < U then 1 + f / U else 0) * config.softFactor
                            else if n.weight
                                then (if f >= 0 then 1 else if -f < U then 1 + f / U else 0) * n.weight
                                else if f >= 0 then 1 else if -f < U then 1 + f / U else 0
                        if f > p then
                            if f >= 1 then
                                return 1
                            end
                            p = f
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            j = hazardReader.leash
            if j then
                q = j.enemy.root
                if q.Parent then
                    M = q.Position
                    if sqrt((y - M.X) ^ 2 + (V - M.Z) ^ 2) - j.radius > -4 then
                        return 1
                    end
                end
            end
            q = hazardReader.enemies
            for index2 = 1, #q, 1 do
                v = q[index2]
                if v.melee and not v.isBoss then
                    index2 = min(E, 0.6)
                    w, M =
                        sqrt((y - v.x - v.vx * index2) ^ 2 + (V - v.z - v.vz * index2) ^ 2),
                        v.extent + v.meleeDistance + 2
                    j = w <= M + J and 1
                        or depthWeight(-(w - M - config.meleeBuffer), J, Y * 2)
                            * config.meleeBandWeight
                    if j > p then
                        if j >= 1 then
                            return 1
                        end
                        p = j
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return p
        end
        context.redOrbNear = function(O, P, _)
            local u, y, q, V, E, p, j, U =
                dangerGeometry.boxes or {},
                dangerGeometry.now or os.clock(),
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                (config.redOrbStand or 0.5) + (_ or 0),
                config.redOrbStandStep or 0.2,
                O.X,
                O.Z,
                (P or 0) + 1.0E-6
            P = type(E) == "number" and E > 0
            for index = 1, #u, 1 do
                _ = u[index]
                if _.fullKeep and _.moving then
                    O = (_.r or _.halfW or 12) + q + V
                    local u, q, V, w, Y, endAlong, M, Z, n, f, r =
                        O * O,
                        (_.untilAt or 0) + 0.2,
                        _.offset or 0,
                        _.speed or 0,
                        _.pathStart or y,
                        _.endAlong,
                        _.ox,
                        _.oz,
                        _.dx,
                        _.dz,
                        0
                    while r <= U do
                        index = y + r
                        if index <= q then
                            local O = V + w * max(index - Y, 0)
                            O = if endAlong and O > endAlong then endAlong else O
                            local _, y = p - (M + n * O), j - (Z + f * O)
                            if _ * _ + y * y < u then
                                return true
                            end
                        elseif P then
                            break
                        end
                        r += E
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function contextWalkable(P, _, u, y, q)
            local V = config.maxStepHeight + 1.5
            local E = Vector3.new(P.X, P.Y - dangerGeometry.feet + V, P.Z)
            P = workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(E), Vector3.new(2.5, 3, 2.5), Vector3.new(_, u + V, y) - E, q)
            return P == nil, P
        end
        local function contextDecide(P, _)
            local now = os.clock()
            dangerGeometry.lag =
                min((runtimeState.pingS or 0) * max(runtimeState.speedNow or 16, 16), config.pingMarginMax)
            dangerGeometry.now, dangerGeometry.reach, dangerGeometry.halfHeight, dangerGeometry.feet =
                now,
                P.Size.X * 0.5 + config.dodgeMargin + dangerGeometry.lag,
                (_.HipHeight + P.Size.Y) * 0.5 + 2.5,
                _.HipHeight + P.Size.Y * 0.5
            dangerGeometry.halfWidth = P.Size.X * 0.5
            if context.carryIgnoresHits and context.carryIgnoresHits() then
                for index = #dangerGeometry.boxes, 1, -1 do
                    dangerGeometry.boxes[index] = nil
                end
            else
                contextHazards(now, dangerGeometry.boxes)
            end
            dangerGeometry.here0, dangerGeometry.dangerHere, dangerGeometry.target, dangerGeometry.reason, dangerGeometry.origin =
                0, 0, nil, "bubble", P.Position
            for index2 = #dangerGeometry.cands, 1, -1 do
                dangerGeometry.cands[index2] = nil
            end
            runtimeState.moveBoost = false
        end
        context.DG = dangerGeometry
        context.dangerAt = contextDangerAt
        context.decide = contextDecide
        context.walkable = contextWalkable
        context.depthOf = contextDepthOf
        context.RING_GAPS = { 31.25, 43.75, 56.25, 68.75, 81.25 }
        context.odinRankOff = function(L)
            local O, S, D, P =
                config.odinRankIn or 56.25,
                config.odinRankOut or 81.25,
                config.odinRank3In or 43.75,
                config.odinRank3Weight or 0.35
            if L >= O and L <= S then
                return 0
            end
            if L > S then
                return L - S
            end
            if L >= D then
                return (O - L) * P
            end
            return (O - D) * P + (D - L)
        end
        context.odinBandOff = function(d)
            local L, O = config.odinBandIn or 43.75, config.odinRankOut or 81.25
            if d < L then
                return L - d
            end
            if d > O then
                return d - O
            end
            return 0
        end
    end

    components.odinMechanics = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local floor = math.floor
        local abs = math.abs
        local infinity = math.huge
        local max = math.max
        local min, odinMechanics, setMetatable, weakKeys =
            math.min, {}, setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",
            }
        odinMechanics.sets = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
        odinMechanics.setList = {}
        odinMechanics.orbs = {}
        odinMechanics.orbList = {}
        odinMechanics.missiles = {}
        odinMechanics.missileList = {}
        odinMechanics.arrays = {}
        odinMechanics.lines = {}
        odinMechanics.lineList = {}
        odinMechanics.lastTick = 0
        context.OD = odinMechanics
        local function m(part)
            local y = max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) * 0.5
            if y < 10 then
                return nil
            end
            local q = part.CFrame.LookVector
            local V, E = q.X, q.Z
            q = sqrt(V * V + E * E)
            if q < 0.01 then
                return nil
            end
            V /= q
            E /= q
            q = part.Position
            return q.X - V * (y / 2),
                q.Z - E * (y / 2),
                y,
                y - (y >= 100 and (config.ringThicknessOuter or 17.5) or (config.ringThickness or 12.5)),
                V,
                E,
                q.Y
        end
        odinMechanics.noteRingSet = function(model, spawn)
            local q = odinMechanics.sets[model]
            if q then
                return q
            end
            q = {
                model = model,
                spawn = spawn,
                boxed = {},
                parts = {},
                bands = {},
                n = 0,
                centre = nil,
            }
            odinMechanics.sets[model] = q
            odinMechanics.setList[#odinMechanics.setList + 1] = q
            if context.logT then
                context.logT("rings", 2, "Odin", "ring set seen")
            end
            return q
        end
        local function R(y, madeAt)
            local V = config.ringLive or 1.3
            if not y.centreX then
                local E = y.model:FindFirstChild("center") or y.model:FindFirstChild("Center")
                if E and (E:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    y.centreX, y.centreZ = E.Position.X, E.Position.Z
                end
            end
            for index, child in ipairs(y.model:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("BasePart") and not y.boxed[child] then
                    index = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if index == "ring" then
                        local j, centreZ, J, inner, Y, v, M = m(child)
                        if j and y.centreX then
                            local Z, n = child.Position.X - y.centreX, child.Position.Z - y.centreZ
                            local f = sqrt(Z * Z + n * n)
                            if f > 1 then
                                Y, v = Z / f, n / f
                            else
                            end
                            j, centreZ = y.centreX, y.centreZ
                        else
                            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
                            j = if j
                                    and arenaCentre
                                    and abs(
                                            sqrt(
                                                (child.Position.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2
                                                    + (child.Position.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2
                                            ) - J / 2
                                        )
                                        > (config.ringPosTol or 4)
                                then nil
                                else j
                        end
                        if j then
                            y.boxed[child] = true
                            y.parts[#y.parts + 1] = child
                            y.bands[#y.bands + 1] = {
                                cx = j,
                                cz = centreZ,
                                R = J,
                                inner = inner,
                                sx = Y,
                                sz = v,
                            }
                            y.n = y.n + 1
                            if context.addZone then
                                context.addZone({
                                    name = "ring arc",
                                    kind = "zone",
                                    bubbleKeep = true,
                                    slim = config.ringSlim,
                                    tight = true,
                                    cframe = CFrame.new(j, M, centreZ),
                                    size = Vector3.new(
                                        (J + (config.ringPad or 0)) * 2,
                                        12,
                                        (J + (config.ringPad or 0)) * 2
                                    ),
                                    round = true,
                                    ring = inner - (config.ringPad or 0),
                                    sx = Y,
                                    sz = v,
                                    from = y.spawn,
                                    untilAt = y.spawn + V,
                                    exact = true,
                                    madeAt = madeAt,
                                    model = y.model,
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    elseif index == "center" then
                        y.boxed[child] = true
                        y.centre = child
                        local position, j = child.Position, max(child.Size.X, child.Size.Y, child.Size.Z)
                        y.centreR, y.centreX, y.centreZ = j * 0.5, position.X, position.Z
                        if context.addZone then
                            context.addZone({
                                name = "ring centre",
                                kind = "zone",
                                bubbleKeep = true,
                                cframe = CFrame.new(position.X, position.Y, position.Z),
                                size = Vector3.new(j, 12, j),
                                round = true,
                                from = y.spawn,
                                untilAt = y.spawn + V,
                                exact = true,
                                madeAt = madeAt,
                                model = y.model,
                            })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function y(q)
            if config.ringInvulnFree == false or hazardReader.charAt == nil then
                return false
            end
            return q.spawn + (config.ringLive or 1.3)
                <= hazardReader.charAt
                    + (config.invulnAfterRespawn or 4)
                    - (config.ringInvulnMargin or 0.2)
        end
        local function q(V, E, p, j)
            if y(V) then
                return false
            end
            j = (j or 0) + (config.ringPad or 0)
            local bands = V.bands
            for index = 1, #bands, 1 do
                local zone = bands[index]
                local U, Y = E - zone.cx, p - zone.cz
                if U * zone.sx + Y * zone.sz >= -j then
                    index = sqrt(U * U + Y * Y)
                    if index >= zone.inner - j and index <= zone.R + j then
                        return true, zone.R
                    end
                end
            end
            if V.centreR then
                local U, J = E - V.centreX, p - V.centreZ
                if sqrt(U * U + J * J) <= V.centreR + j then
                    return true, 0
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.ringClear = function(V, E, p)
            local j, U = config.ringLive or 1.3
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local w = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                index = p - w.spawn
                if index >= -0.05 and index <= j and w.model.Parent and not y(w) then
                    local bands = w.bands
                    for index2 = 1, #bands, 1 do
                        local zone = bands[index2]
                        local p, w = V - zone.cx, E - zone.cz
                        if p * zone.sx + w * zone.sz >= 0 then
                            index2 = sqrt(p * p + w * w)
                            U = if U == nil
                                    or (
                                            if index2 < zone.inner
                                                then zone.inner - index2
                                                else if index2 > zone.R then index2 - zone.R else 0
                                        )
                                        < U
                                then if index2 < zone.inner
                                    then zone.inner - index2
                                    else if index2 > zone.R then index2 - zone.R else 0
                                else U
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return U
        end
        odinMechanics.inRingBand = function(V, E, p, j)
            j = j or 0
            local U = config.ringLive or 1.3
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local w = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                index = p - w.spawn
                if index >= -0.05 and index <= U and w.model.Parent then
                    local p, U = q(w, V, E, j)
                    if p then
                        return true, w, U
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.ignoreSets = {}
        odinMechanics.ignoreLines = {}
        local function V(E, p, j, U)
            local J, w = config.ringLive or 1.3, config.ringFlashFrom or 0.9
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local v = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                index = j - v.spawn
                if index >= w and index <= J and v.model.Parent and q(v, E, p, U) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.pathCrossesRing = function(E, p, j, U, J, w)
            if #odinMechanics.setList == 0 then
                return false
            end
            local Y, v = j - E, U - p
            U = sqrt(Y * Y + v * v)
            if U < 1 then
                return false
            end
            local M, Z = config.ringSlim or 2.5, max(2, math.ceil(U / 2))
            w = w or J
            for index = 1, Z, 1 do
                j = index / Z
                index, U = E + Y * j, p + v * j
                if odinMechanics.inRingBand(index, U, J + (w - J) * j, M) then
                    return true
                end
                if odinMechanics.inRingBand(index, U, J, M) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function E(p, j, part, spawn)
            local w, position = j[part], part.Position
            local v = w
            if not w then
                w = {
                    part = part,
                    x = position.X,
                    z = position.Z,
                    vx = 0,
                    vz = 0,
                    t = spawn,
                    spawn = spawn,
                    hasV = false,
                }
                j[part] = w
                p[#p + 1] = w
                return w
            end
            p = spawn - v.t
            if p > 0.02 then
