                j, w, part = (position.X - v.x) / p, (position.Z - v.z) / p, false
                if v.hasV and config.orbBounce ~= false then
                    local p = v.vx * j + v.vz * w
                    part = p < 0 or p * p < 0.5 * (v.vx * v.vx + v.vz * v.vz) * (j * j + w * w)
                else
                end
                if v.hasV and not part then
                    v.vx, v.vz = v.vx * 0.5 + j * 0.5, v.vz * 0.5 + w * 0.5
                else
                    v.vx = j
                    v.vz = w
                    v.hasV = true
                end
                v.x, v.z = position.X, position.Z
                v.t = spawn
            end
            return v
        end
        local function p(j, U, J, w)
            for index = #j, 1, -1 do
                local v = j[index]
                if
                    not v.part.Parent
                    or J - v.spawn > w
                    or v.part:IsA("BasePart") and v.part.Transparency >= 1
                then
                    U[v.part] = nil
                    table.remove(j, index)
                end
            end
        end
        local function j()
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                odinMechanics.arrays = {}
                return
            end
            local arrays = {}
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.missileList, 1 do
                local Y = odinMechanics.missileList[index]
                local v, M = Y.vx, Y.vz
                index = sqrt(v * v + M * M)
                if index < 20 then
                    local lookVector = Y.part.CFrame.LookVector
                    v, M = lookVector.X, lookVector.Z
                    index = sqrt(v * v + M * M)
                    if index > 0.01 and (arenaCentre.X - Y.x) * v + (arenaCentre.Z - Y.z) * M < 0 then
                        v, M = -v, -M
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if index > 0.01 then
                    v /= index
                    M /= index
                    local w = math.atan2(v, M)
                    local Z
                    for index2, array in ipairs(arrays) do
                        if
                            abs((w - array.yaw + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793)
                            < 0.13962634015954636
                        then
                            Z = array
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not Z then
                        Z = {
                            yaw = w,
                            lx = v,
                            lz = M,
                            nx = -M,
                            nz = v,
                            at = Y.spawn,
                            n = 0,
                            maxAlong = -infinity,
                            pending = 0,
                            lastSpawn = Y.spawn,
                        }
                        arrays[#arrays + 1] = Z
                    else
                    end
                    Z.n = Z.n + 1
                    if Y.spawn < Z.at then
                        Z.at = Y.spawn
                    end
                    if Y.spawn > Z.lastSpawn then
                        Z.lastSpawn = Y.spawn
                    end
                    w = (Y.x - arenaCentre.X) * Z.lx + (Y.z - arenaCentre.Z) * Z.lz
                    if w > Z.maxAlong then
                        Z.maxAlong = w
                    end
                    if w < 30 then
                        Z.pending = Z.pending + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            odinMechanics.arrays = arrays
        end
        odinMechanics.lineSeenAt = odinMechanics.lineSeenAt or {}
        if not odinMechanics.lineSeenConn then
            odinMechanics.lineSeenConn = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(U)
                if U.Name == "thirdBossLineShot" and U:IsA("Model") then
                    odinMechanics.lineSeenAt[U] = os.clock()
                end
            end)
        end
        odinMechanics.tick = function(U)
            odinMechanics.lastTick = U
            local J = U - (odinMechanics.prevTick or U)
            odinMechanics.prevTick = U
            local ringLive = config.ringLive
            for index, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                index = child.Name
                if index == "thirdBossMultiRings" then
                    local Y = odinMechanics.noteRingSet(child, U)
                    if Y.n < 7 and U - Y.spawn < 2 then
                        R(Y, U)
                    end
                    if U - Y.spawn < (config.ringSettle or 2) then
                        for index2 = 1, #Y.parts, 1 do
                            local v = Y.parts[index2]
                            if v.Parent then
                                local M, Z, n, inner, r, o = m(v)
                                local zone = Y.bands[index2]
                                if M and zone then
                                    zone.cx = M
                                    zone.cz = Z
                                    zone.R = n
                                    zone.inner = inner
                                    zone.sx = r
                                    zone.sz = o
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                elseif index == "thirdBossBouncingOrb" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    E(odinMechanics.orbList, odinMechanics.orbs, child, U)
                elseif index == "thirdBossMissile" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if child.Transparency < 1 then
                        E(odinMechanics.missileList, odinMechanics.missiles, child, U)
                    end
                elseif index == "thirdBossLineShot" and child:IsA("Model") then
                    if not odinMechanics.lines[child] then
                        local part = child:FindFirstChild("hitBox")
                            or child:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
                            or child:FindFirstChild("precast")
                        if part and (part:IsA("BasePart")) then
                            local R = {
                                model = child,
                                part = part,
                                spawn = odinMechanics.lineSeenAt and odinMechanics.lineSeenAt[child] or U,
                            }
                            if odinMechanics.lineSeenAt then
                                odinMechanics.lineSeenAt[child] = nil
                            end
                            odinMechanics.lines[child] = R
                            odinMechanics.lineList[#odinMechanics.lineList + 1] = R
                            if config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false then
                                local ignoredModels, ignoredModels2 = odinMechanics.ignoredModels
                                if ignoredModels then
                                    ignoredModels2 = ignoredModels
                                else
                                    local setMetatable2, weakKeys2 =
                                        setmetatable, {
                                            __mode = "k",
                                        }
                                    ignoredModels2 = setMetatable2({}, weakKeys2)
                                end
                                odinMechanics.ignoredModels = ignoredModels2
                                if
                                    R.spawn - (odinMechanics.lastLineAt or -infinity)
                                    > (config.odinFanQuiet or 2)
                                then
                                    odinMechanics.fan = {
                                        first = R,
                                        startAt = R.spawn,
                                    }
                                    odinMechanics.central = R
                                    odinMechanics.fanGreen = nil
                                    context.logT("odin", 1, "Odin", "fan: first beam - red")
                                else
                                    R.ignored = true
                                    odinMechanics.ignoredModels[child] = true
                                end
                                odinMechanics.lastLineAt =
                                    math.max(odinMechanics.lastLineAt or -infinity, R.spawn)
                            elseif odinMechanics.central == nil then
                                odinMechanics.central = R
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for index3 = #odinMechanics.setList, 1, -1 do
                local R = odinMechanics.setList[index3]
                if not R.model.Parent or U - R.spawn > 25 then
                    odinMechanics.sets[R.model] = nil
                    table.remove(odinMechanics.setList, index3)
                end
            end
            p(odinMechanics.orbList, odinMechanics.orbs, U, 40)
            p(odinMechanics.missileList, odinMechanics.missiles, U, 12)
            for index4 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                local R = odinMechanics.lineList[index4]
                if not R.firedAt and R.model and R.model.Parent then
                    index4 = R.model:FindFirstChild("precast")
                    local sig = index4 and floor(index4.Transparency * 100 + 0.5) or -1
                    if R.sig == nil then
                        R.sig = sig
                    elseif sig ~= R.sig then
                        local m = U - R.spawn
                        if m >= (config.lineFiredMin or 0.3) then
                            R.firedAt = U
                            if R == odinMechanics.central and odinMechanics.noteGreen then
                                pcall(odinMechanics.noteGreen, R, U)
                            end
                            odinMechanics.firedAges = odinMechanics.firedAges or {}
                            odinMechanics.firedAges[#odinMechanics.firedAges + 1] = m
                            if #odinMechanics.firedAges > 40 then
                                table.remove(odinMechanics.firedAges, 1)
                            end
                            if config.lineFiredLog ~= false then
                                context.logT(
                                    "odin",
                                    1,
                                    "Odin",
                                    ("line shot fired at age %.2f (precast %d -> %d)"):format(m, R.sig, sig)
                                )
                            end
                        end
                        R.sig = sig
                    end
                end
            end
            for index5 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                local R = odinMechanics.lineList[index5]
                if not R.firedAt and not R.ignored then
                    index5 = hazardReader.models and hazardReader.models[R.model]
                    if
                        index5
                        and (index5.detonatedAt or index5.fired)
                        and U - R.spawn >= (config.lineFiredMin or 0.3)
                    then
                        R.firedAt = U
                        if R == odinMechanics.central and odinMechanics.noteGreen then
                            pcall(odinMechanics.noteGreen, R, U)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for index6 = #odinMechanics.lineList, 1, -1 do
                local R = odinMechanics.lineList[index6]
                if not R.model.Parent and not R.goneAt then
                    R.goneAt = U
                end
                if R.goneAt and U > R.goneAt + (config.beamHitTail or 0.2) or U - R.spawn > 6 then
                    odinMechanics.lines[R.model] = nil
                    if odinMechanics.danceSide then
                        odinMechanics.danceSide[R.model] = nil
                    end
                    if odinMechanics.central == R then
                        odinMechanics.central = nil
                    end
                    table.remove(odinMechanics.lineList, index6)
                end
            end
            j()
        end
        local function m(R, E, p, j, U)
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                return false
            end
            local w, Y = config.missileLanePitch or 15, (config.missileLaneWidth or 10) * 0.5
            for index = 1, U and 0 or #odinMechanics.missileList, 1 do
                local M = odinMechanics.missileList[index]
                index = sqrt(M.vx * M.vx + M.vz * M.vz)
                if index > 20 then
                    local Z, n, f, r = M.vx / index, M.vz / index, R - M.x, E - M.z
                    local o = f * Z + r * n
                    if o > -(config.missileBodyKeep or 20) then
                        if abs(-n * f + Z * r) <= Y + j and o / index <= p - M.t + 2.5 then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for index2, array in ipairs(odinMechanics.arrays) do
                index2, U =
                    p - array.at,
                    config.arrayLanePending == true and array.pending > 0
                        or p - array.lastSpawn < (config.arrayGrace or 1.2)
                            and p >= array.lastSpawn - 0.1
                if index2 <= (config.volleyLive or 7) and U then
                    local p = (R - arenaCentre.X) * array.nx + (E - arenaCentre.Z) * array.nz
                    if abs(p) <= 120 + Y + j then
                        if abs(p - floor(p / w + 0.5) * w) <= Y + j then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function R(E, p, j, U, J, w)
            local Y = config.fieldLineLive or 1.2
            J = J or -0.05
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                local M = odinMechanics.lineList[index]
                local Z, n, f =
                    j - M.spawn,
                    (
                        config.odinAllLanes == false
                            and (not (config.odinCentralBeam ~= false and odinMechanics.central ~= nil) or M == odinMechanics.central)
                        or config.odinAllLanes ~= false
                    ) and not (M.ignored and config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false),
                    M.part.Parent ~= nil or M.goneAt ~= nil and j <= M.goneAt + (config.beamHitTail or 0.2)
                if
                    n
                    and Z >= J
                    and Z <= Y + (M.goneAt and (config.beamHitTail or 0.2) or 0)
                    and f
                    and not (w and odinMechanics.ignoreLines[M])
                then
                    local j, J = M.part.CFrame, M.part.Size
                    local position, Y, rightVector = j.Position, j.LookVector, j.RightVector
                    local Z, n, f, r, o, A, k, x =
                        E - position.X, p - position.Z, max(J.Z, J.X) * 0.5, min(J.Z, J.X) * 0.5
                    if J.Z >= J.X then
                        o, A, k, x = Y.X, Y.Z, rightVector.X, rightVector.Z
                    else
                        o, A, k, x = rightVector.X, rightVector.Z, Y.X, Y.Z
                    end
                    J, j = sqrt(o * o + A * A), sqrt(k * k + x * x)
                    if J > 0.01 and j > 0.01 then
                        index, Y = (Z * o + n * A) / J, (Z * k + n * x) / j
                        if abs(index) <= f + U and abs(Y) <= r + U then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function E(p)
            if p.bT ~= p.t then
                p.bT = p.t
                p.bH, p.bX, p.bZ, p.bVX, p.bVZ = context.orbBounce(p.x, p.z, p.vx, p.vz)
                p.bS = p.bH and sqrt(p.bVX * p.bVX + p.bVZ * p.bVZ) or 0
            end
            return p.bH
        end
        local function odinLanes(laneAt)
            if
                config.odinOrbLanes == false
                or not (context.rodinOrbs and context.rodinOrbs())
                or not (context.BB and context.BB.blueBeams)
            then
                return nil
            end
            if odinMechanics.laneAt == laneAt then
                return odinMechanics.laneMap
            end
            local laneMap = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs((context.BB.blueBeamsFull or context.BB.blueBeams)()) do
                if entry.orb and not entry.cone and (entry.osp or 0) > 1 then
                    index = laneMap[entry.orb]
                    if not index then
                        index = {}
                        laneMap[entry.orb] = index
                    else
                    end
                    index[#index + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            odinMechanics.laneAt = laneAt
            odinMechanics.laneMap = laneMap
            return laneMap
        end
        odinMechanics.odinLanes = odinLanes
        local function lanePos(U, J)
            for index = 1, #U, 1 do
                local Y = U[index]
                index = (J - (Y.t0 or 0)) * Y.osp
                if index >= 0 and index <= (Y.dL or Y.L) then
                    return Y.ox + Y.ux * index, Y.oz + Y.uz * index
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        odinMechanics.lanePos = lanePos
        local function U(J, w, Y, v, M, Z)
            local n, f, r = (config.fieldOrbKeep or 10) + M, odinLanes(v), hazardReader.orbBlastAt
            local p = if Z
                then r ~= nil and abs(Y - r) < 0.5
                else r ~= nil and r - Y < (config.orbBlastLead or 2) + 0.3 and Y < r + 0.8
            p = if config.orbBlastOnContact ~= false then false else p
            r = (config.orbBlastRadius or 26) + M + 2
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.orbList, 1 do
                Z = odinMechanics.orbList[index]
                index = max(Y - Z.t, 0)
                local A, k, x, a, e, N = Z.x + Z.vx * index, Z.z + Z.vz * index, 0, f and f[Z.part]
                local f = k
                if a then
                    e, k = lanePos(a, Y - v)
                else
                    k = N
                end
                if e then
                    A = e
                else
                    N = E(Z)
                    if N and index > N then
                        a = index - N
                        A, k, x =
                            Z.bX + Z.bVX * a,
                            Z.bZ + Z.bVZ * a,
                            math.min(a * Z.bS * (config.orbScatter or 0.27), config.orbScatterMax or 10)
                    else
                        k = f
                    end
                end
                f, N = J - A, w - k
                a = sqrt(f * f + N * N)
                if a <= n + x then
                    return true
                end
                if p and a <= r then
                    return true
                end
            end
            n = hazardReader.zones
            for index2 = 1, #n, 1 do
                r = n[index2]
                if
                    r.name == "orb explosion"
                    and r.r
                    and (r.from or 0) <= Y + 0.3
                    and (r.untilAt or infinity) >= Y
                then
                    v, index2 = J - r.cx, w - r.cz
                    if sqrt(v * v + index2 * index2) <= r.r + M then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function orbLaneCost(j, J)
            if #odinMechanics.orbList == 0 then
                return 0
            end
            local w, Y, v, M = config.orbLaneLook or 1.8, config.orbLaneWidth or 18, config.orbLaneCost or 45, 0
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.orbList, 1 do
                local n = odinMechanics.orbList[index]
                index = sqrt((n.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (n.vz or 0) ^ 2)
                if index > 6 then
                    local f, r, o, A = n.vx / index, n.vz / index, j - n.x, J - n.z
                    local k = o * f + A * r
                    if k > -8 and k <= index * w then
                        local Z = abs(-r * o + f * A)
                        M = if Z <= Y then M + v * (1 - Z / Y) else M
                    else
                    end
                    k = E(n)
                    if k and k < w and n.bS > 6 then
                        A, f, o, r = n.bVX / n.bS, n.bVZ / n.bS, j - n.bX, J - n.bZ
                        local E = o * A + r * f
                        if E > -8 and E <= n.bS * (w - k) then
                            local E = abs(-f * o + A * r)
                            M = if E <= Y then M + v * (1 - E / Y) else M
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return M
        end
        odinMechanics.orbLaneCost = orbLaneCost
        local function E(j, J, w)
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                return false
            end
            local v, M = j - arenaCentre.X, J - arenaCentre.Z
            j = sqrt(v * v + M * M)
            if j <= (config.fieldArenaR or 105) then
                return false
            end
            return w == nil or j > w - 1
        end
        local function j(J, w, Y, v)
            if context.rodinMissiles and context.rodinMissiles() then
                local M, Z = (config.missileLaneHalf or 5) + v, 16 + v
                for index = 1, #odinMechanics.missileList, 1 do
                    local f = odinMechanics.missileList[index]
                    index = sqrt(f.vx * f.vx + f.vz * f.vz)
                    if index > 1 then
                        local r = max(Y - f.t, 0)
                        local o, A, k, x = f.x + f.vx * r, f.z + f.vz * r, f.vx / index, f.vz / index
                        local n, f = J - o, w - A
                        if abs(n * k + f * x) <= Z and abs(-x * n + k * f) <= M then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local M = (config.missileBodyKeep or 20) + v
            for index2 = 1, #odinMechanics.missileList, 1 do
                v = odinMechanics.missileList[index2]
                index2 = max(Y - v.t, 0)
                local Y, n = v.x + v.vx * index2, v.z + v.vz * index2
                local v, Z = J - Y, w - n
                if v * v + Z * Z <= M * M then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function ringLethalAt(w, Y, v, M)
            local Z, n = config.ringLive or 1.3, config.ringHazardFrom or 0.7
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local r = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                index = v - r.spawn
                if index >= n and index <= Z and r.model.Parent and q(r, w, Y, M) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.ringLethalAt = ringLethalAt
        local function hazardAt(Y, v, M, Z, n)
            if config.ringCellFlashOnly ~= false then
                if ringLethalAt(Y, v, M, n) then
                    return "ring"
                end
            elseif odinMechanics.inRingBand(Y, v, M, n) then
                return "ring"
            end
            if config.missileCellBodyOnly ~= false then
                if
                    j(Y, v, M, n + (config.missileCellMargin or 4))
                    or config.missileCellLanes == true and m(Y, v, M, n, true)
                then
                    return "missile"
                end
            elseif m(Y, v, M, n) then
                return "missile"
            end
            if R(Y, v, M, n + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3), (config.lineHitFrom or 0.65) - 0.2) then
                return "line"
            end
            if U(Y, v, M, Z, n) then
                return "orb"
            end
            return nil
        end
        odinMechanics.hazardAt = hazardAt
        local function pathHazardAt(v, M, Z, n, f)
            if V(v, M, Z, f) then
                return "ring"
            end
            if j(v, M, Z, f) then
                return "missile"
            end
            if R(v, M, Z, f + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3.5), config.lineHitFrom or 0.65, true) then
                return "line"
            end
            if U(v, M, Z, n, f, true) then
                return "orb"
            end
            return nil
        end
        odinMechanics.pathHazardAt = pathHazardAt
        odinMechanics.ringsActive = function(V)
            local v = config.ringLive or 1.3
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local Z = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                if
                    V - Z.spawn <= v + (config.blueRailHold or 0.3)
                    and Z.model.Parent
                    and #Z.bands > 0
                    and not y(Z)
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.blueArcs = function(V)
            local v, M, Z =
                config.ringLive or 1.3, {}, (config.fieldArenaR or 105) - (config.blueRailWallGap or 4)
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                local set = odinMechanics.setList[index]
                index = V - set.spawn
                if
                    index >= -0.05
                    and index <= v + (config.blueRailHold or 0.3)
                    and set.model.Parent
                    and #set.bands > 0
                    and not y(set)
                then
                    local y = {}
                    for index2, band in ipairs(set.bands) do
                        index2 = nil
                        for index3, entry in ipairs(y) do
                            if entry.sx * band.sx + entry.sz * band.sz > 0.9 then
                                index2 = entry
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if not index2 then
                            index2 = {
                                sx = band.sx,
                                sz = band.sz,
                                cx = band.cx,
                                cz = band.cz,
                                list = {},
                            }
                            y[#y + 1] = index2
                        else
                        end
                        index2.list[#index2.list + 1] = band
                    end
                    for index4, entry2 in ipairs(y) do
                        table.sort(entry2.list, function(y, n)
                            return y.R < n.R
                        end)
                        index4 = set.centreR or 0
                        for index5, entry3 in ipairs(entry2.list) do
                            if entry3.inner - index4 >= (config.blueRailMinGap or 6) then
                                M[#M + 1] = {
                                    cx = entry2.cx,
                                    cz = entry2.cz,
                                    r = (index4 + entry3.inner) * 0.5,
                                    sx = entry2.sx,
                                    sz = entry2.sz,
                                    set = set,
                                }
                            end
                            index4 = max(index4, entry3.R)
                        end
                        if Z - index4 >= (config.blueRailMinGap or 6) then
                            M[#M + 1] = {
                                cx = entry2.cx,
                                cz = entry2.cz,
                                r = (index4 + Z) * 0.5,
                                sx = entry2.sx,
                                sz = entry2.sz,
                                set = set,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return M
        end
        local function y(V, v, M, Z, n)
            local f = { 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(f) do
                index = M + entry
                if
                    ringLethalAt(V, v, index, n)
                    or R(V, v, index, n + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3), (config.lineHitFrom or 0.65) - 0.2)
                    or U(V, v, index, Z, n)
                    or j(V, v, index, n)
                then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function V(v, M, Z, n, f, r, o, A)
            local k, x = Z - v, n - M
            n = sqrt(k * k + x * x)
            Z = max(1, math.ceil(n / 2))
            for index = 1, Z, 1 do
                local e = index / Z
                local Z, a, N = v + k * e, M + x * e, f + n * e / r
                if
                    ringLethalAt(Z, a, N, o)
                    or j(Z, a, N, 1)
                    or not A and U(Z, a, N, f, o, true)
                    or R(Z, a, N, o + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3), (config.lineHitFrom or 0.65) - 0.2)
                then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        odinMechanics.railHalfW = function()
            return (config.blueRailWidth or 0.4) * 0.5 + (config.blueRailWiden or 1)
        end
        odinMechanics.bluePlan = function(v, vector)
            local Z = odinMechanics.blueArcs(v)
            if #Z == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local speed, f, r, o, A, k =
                config.burstMax or 28, config.odinCrossM or 2, odinMechanics.railHalfW(), vector.X, vector.Z
            if
                config.odinRailYellow ~= false
                and context.BB
                and context.BB.blueBeams
                and context.BB.onBlueBeam
                and context.rodinOrbs
                and context.rodinOrbs()
            then
                local success, a = pcall(context.BB.blueBeams)
                if success and type(a) == "table" and #a > 0 then
                    k = a
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local x = config.odinRailYellowPad or 0.5
            local function a(e, N)
                return k ~= nil and context.BB.onBlueBeam(e, N, x, k) ~= nil
            end
            local x, e = a(o, A), {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(Z) do
                local lim, off = o - entry.cx, A - entry.cz
                index = sqrt(lim * lim + off * off)
                local g, mid =
                    index > 0.01 and math.atan2(off, lim) or math.atan2(entry.sz, entry.sx),
                    math.atan2(entry.sz, entry.sx)
                off, lim =
                    (g - mid + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793,
                    1.5707963267948966 - (config.blueRailHalfIn or 2) / entry.r
                off = math.clamp(off, -lim, lim)
                g = abs(index - entry.r) <= r and index or entry.r
                local N, b = entry.cx + math.cos(mid + off) * g, entry.cz + math.sin(mid + off) * g
                local B, G =
                    #e + 1, {
                        a = entry,
                        mid = mid,
                        off = off,
                        lim = lim,
                        rr = g,
                        x = N,
                        z = b,
                    }
                G.d, e[B] = sqrt((N - o) ^ 2 + (b - A) ^ 2), G
            end
            Z = config.odinRanks ~= false and context.odinRankOff ~= nil and (config.odinRankRailWeight or 3) or 0
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(e) do
                entry2.rank = entry2.d + (Z > 0 and context.odinRankOff(entry2.a.r) * Z or 0)
            end
            table.sort(e, function(N, I)
                return N.rank < I.rank
            end)
            Z = {}
            for index3 = 1, k and 2 or 1, 1 do
                local I = k ~= nil and index3 == 1
                for index4, entry3 in ipairs(e) do
                    local zone, C, g, i =
                        entry3.a, entry3.d <= (config.odinCrossHold or 1.5), {
                            entry3.rr,
                        }, ipairs
                    index3 = {
                        zone.r,
                        zone.r - r,
                        zone.r + r,
                    }
                    for key, entry4 in i(index3) do
                        key = false
                        for index5, entry5 in ipairs(g) do
                            if abs(entry5 - entry4) < 0.05 then
                                key = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if not key then
                            g[#g + 1] = entry4
                        end
                    end
                    local r, N = (config.blueSlideStep or 3) / zone.r, (config.blueSlideFar or 60) / zone.r
                    for index6 = 0, math.floor(N / r), 1 do
                        for index7, entry6 in ipairs(index6 == 0 and { 1 } or { 1, -1 }) do
                            index7 = entry3.off + entry6 * index6 * r
                            if index7 >= -entry3.lim and index7 <= entry3.lim then
                                for index8, entry7 in ipairs(g) do
                                    local g, s, T =
                                        zone.cx + math.cos(entry3.mid + index7) * entry7,
                                        zone.cz + math.sin(entry3.mid + index7) * entry7,
                                        entry3.d + index6 * r * zone.r + abs(entry7 - entry3.rr)
                                    if not (I and (a(g, s))) then
                                        i = ((index4 * 1000 + index6) * 2 + (entry6 > 0 and 0 or 1)) * 8 + index8
                                        local k = Z[i]
                                        if k == nil then
                                            k = y(g, s, v + T / speed, v, f)
                                            Z[i] = k
                                        else
                                        end
                                        if k then
                                            if index6 == 0 and index8 == 1 and C then
                                                odinMechanics.cross = {
                                                    x = g,
                                                    z = s,
                                                    at = v,
                                                }
                                                return {
                                                    move = false,
                                                    label = x
                                                            and not I
                                                            and ("ODIN RINGS: on the blue rail (r%.0f) in a blue orb's yellow - nowhere on the rails off it, holding on the rail"):format(
                                                                zone.r
                                                            )
                                                        or ("ODIN RINGS: on the blue rail (r%.0f), holding"):format(
                                                            zone.r
                                                        ),
                                                }
                                            end
                                            local y, Z, k
                                            if C and index6 > 0 then
                                                local a = entry3.off
                                                    + entry6
                                                        * math.min(
                                                            index6 * r,
                                                            (config.blueSlideLead or 4) / zone.r
                                                        )
                                                y, Z =
                                                    zone.cx + math.cos(entry3.mid + a) * entry7,
                                                    zone.cz + math.sin(entry3.mid + a) * entry7
                                                local N, i, G = o, A, v
                                                k = true
                                                for index9 = 1, index6, 1 do
                                                    a = entry3.off + entry6 * index9 * r
                                                    local B, K, t =
                                                        zone.cx + math.cos(entry3.mid + a) * entry7,
                                                        zone.cz + math.sin(entry3.mid + a) * entry7,
                                                        v + index9 * r * zone.r / speed
                                                    if not V(N, i, B, K, G, speed, f, not I) then
                                                        k = false
                                                        break
                                                    end
                                                    N, i, G = B, K, t
                                                end
                                            else
                                                y, Z, k = g, s, (V(o, A, g, s, v, speed, f))
                                            end
                                            if k then
                                                odinMechanics.cross = {
                                                    x = g,
                                                    z = s,
                                                    at = v,
                                                }
                                                local label = if x and I
                                                    then ("ODIN RINGS: off the blue orb's yellow, along the blue rail (r%.0f), %.0f studs"):format(
                                                        zone.r,
                                                        T
                                                    )
                                                    else if C
                                                        then ("ODIN RINGS: sliding along the blue rail (r%.0f) to a clear spot, %.0f studs"):format(
                                                            zone.r,
                                                            index6 * r * zone.r
                                                        )
                                                        else ("ODIN RINGS: onto the blue rail (r%.0f), %.0f studs"):format(
                                                            zone.r,
                                                            entry3.d
                                                        )
                                                return {
                                                    move = true,
                                                    point = Vector3.new(y, vector.Y, Z),
                                                    speed = speed,
                                                    label = label,
                                                }
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        odinMechanics.crossPlan = function(y, vector, v)
            if not (v and v.lines and #v.lines > 0) then
                return nil
            end
            local M = odinMechanics.blueArcs(y)
            if #M == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local speed, n, f, r, o =
                config.burstMax or 28, config.odinCrossM or 2, config.blueRailHalfIn or 2, infinity
            for index, line in ipairs(v.lines) do
                local x, a = v.bx + v.nx * line, v.bz + v.nz * line
                for index2, entry in ipairs(M) do
                    index2, index = x - entry.cx, a - entry.cz
                    local M = index2 * v.ax + index * v.az
                    local I = M * M - (index2 * index2 + index * index - entry.r * entry.r)
                    if I >= 0 then
                        local A, iterateArray = sqrt(I), ipairs
                        index2 = {
                            -M - A,
                            -M + A,
                        }
                        for key, entry2 in iterateArray(index2) do
                            key, A = x + v.ax * entry2, a + v.az * entry2
                            if (key - entry.cx) * entry.sx + (A - entry.cz) * entry.sz >= f then
                                local f, x = key - vector.X, A - vector.Z
                                entry2 = sqrt(f * f + x * x)
                                local a = entry2
                                    + (
                                        v.pick ~= nil and abs(line - v.pick) < 0.01 and 0
                                        or (config.odinCrossOtherLine or 6)
                                    )
                                a = if config.odinRanks ~= false and context.odinRankOff
                                    then a + context.odinRankOff(entry.r) * (config.odinRankRailWeight or 3)
                                    else a
                                if a < r then
                                    local v, e, F = y + entry2 / speed, { 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5 }, true
                                    for index3, entry3 in ipairs(e) do
                                        index3 = v + entry3
                                        if
                                            ringLethalAt(key, A, index3, n)
                                            or R(
                                                key,
                                                A,
                                                index3,
                                                n + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3),
                                                (config.lineHitFrom or 0.65) - 0.2
                                            )
                                            or U(key, A, index3, y, n)
                                        then
                                            F = false
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if F then
                                        e = max(1, math.ceil(entry2 / 2))
                                        for index4 = 1, e, 1 do
                                            v = index4 / e
                                            local e, C, g =
                                                vector.X + f * v, vector.Z + x * v, y + entry2 * v / speed
                                            if
                                                ringLethalAt(e, C, g, n)
                                                or j(e, C, g, 1)
                                                or U(e, C, g, y, n, true)
                                            then
                                                F = false
                                                break
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                    if F then
                                        r, o =
                                            a, {
                                                x = key,
                                                z = A,
                                                d = entry2,
                                                r = entry.r,
                                                line = line,
                                            }
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            if not o then
                return nil
            end
            odinMechanics.cross = {
                x = o.x,
                z = o.z,
                at = y,
            }
            if o.d <= (config.odinCrossHold or 1.5) then
                return {
                    move = false,
                    label = ("ODIN RINGS + MISSILES: holding where the green rail crosses the blue rail (r%.0f)"):format(
                        o.r
                    ),
                }
            end
            return {
                move = true,
                point = Vector3.new(o.x, vector.Y, o.z),
                speed = speed,
                label = ("ODIN RINGS + MISSILES: to where the green rail crosses the blue rail (r%.0f, %.0f studs)"):format(
                    o.r,
                    o.d
                ),
            }
        end
        local function y(V)
            local v = config.ringLive or 1.3
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                if V - odinMechanics.setList[index].spawn <= v + 0.2 then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for index2, array in ipairs(odinMechanics.arrays) do
                if
                    V - array.at <= (config.volleyLive or 7)
                    and (array.pending > 0 or V - array.lastSpawn < (config.arrayGrace or 1.2))
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for index3 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                if
                    V - odinMechanics.lineList[index3].spawn <= (config.fieldLineLive or 1.2) + 0.1
                    and not odinMechanics.lineList[index3].ignored
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            if #odinMechanics.orbList > 0 then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        local function V(goneAt, vector, Z, n)
            local central = odinMechanics.central
            if
                not (central and central.model and central.model.Parent and central.part and central.part.Parent)
            then
                return nil
            end
            local r, o = goneAt - (central.spawn or goneAt), central.model:FindFirstChild("precast")
            local A = not (o and o:IsA("BasePart")) or o.Transparency >= 0.99
            if
                r > (config.fieldLineLive or 1.2) + (config.centralBeamGrace or 0.2)
                or A and r >= (config.lineFiredMin or 0.3)
            then
                if not central.goneAt then
                    central.goneAt = goneAt
                    if config.lineFiredLog ~= false then
                        context.logT(
                            "odin",
                            1,
                            "Odin",
                            ("central beam gone at age %.2f (%s) - task over"):format(
                                r,
                                A and "telegraph off screen" or "live time over"
                            )
                        )
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local k = vector.X
            local x = vector.Z
            r, o = central.part.CFrame, central.part.Size
            local position = r.Position
            local e, N, I, F, C, g, i, b = r.LookVector, r.RightVector, max(o.Z, o.X) * 0.5, min(o.Z, o.X) * 0.5
            if o.Z >= o.X then
                C = e.X
                g = e.Z
                i = N.X
                b = N.Z
            else
                C = N.X
                g = N.Z
                i = e.X
                b = e.Z
            end
            r, N = sqrt(C * C + g * g), sqrt(i * i + b * b)
            if r < 0.01 or N < 0.01 then
                return nil
            end
            C /= r
            g /= r
            i /= N
            b /= N
            o, e = k - position.X, x - position.Z
            A, N = o * C + e * g, o * i + e * b
            local B = max(-I + 4, min(I - 4, A))
            local function G(z)
                return position.X + C * B + i * z, position.Z + g * B + b * z
            end
            local function a(C, g, i)
                for index = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                    local B = odinMechanics.lineList[index]
                    if
                        B ~= central
                        and not B.ignored
                        and B.part
                        and B.part.Parent
                        and i - B.spawn >= -0.05
                        and i - B.spawn <= (config.fieldLineLive or 1.2)
                    then
                        local i, size = B.part.CFrame, B.part.Size
                        local position2, s, T, W, K, t, H, X, dF =
                            i.Position,
                            i.LookVector,
                            i.RightVector,
                            max(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5,
                            min(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5
                        if size.Z >= size.X then
                            t, H, X, dF = s.X, s.Z, T.X, T.Z
                        else
                            t, H, X, dF = T.X, T.Z, s.X, s.Z
                        end
                        T, index = sqrt(t * t + H * H), sqrt(X * X + dF * dF)
                        if T > 0.01 and index > 0.01 then
                            s, i = C - position2.X, g - position2.Z
                            if
                                abs((s * t + i * H) / T) <= W + Z
                                and abs((s * X + i * dF) / index)
                                    <= K + Z + (config.centralOtherLaneM or 3)
                            then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function C(g, i)
                local b = { 0, 0.3, 0.6 }
                for index, entry in ipairs(b) do
                    index = goneAt + entry
                    if
                        odinMechanics.inRingBand(g, i, index, Z)
                        or U(g, i, index, goneAt, Z)
                        or m(g, i, index, Z)
                        or E(g, i, n)
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                    if config.odinAllLanes ~= false and a(g, i, index) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            if central.firedAt ~= nil then
                e, r = G(0)
                if abs(N) <= (config.centralBeamOn or 2.5) and not (config.odinAllLanes ~= false and C(k, x)) then
                    odinMechanics.last = {
                        hold = true,
                    }
                    return {
                        move = false,
                        label = "CENTRAL BEAM: on the spent footprint, holding",
                    }
                end
                if C(e, r) then
                    return nil
                end
                odinMechanics.last = {
                    x = e,
                    z = r,
                    at = goneAt,
                }
                return {
                    move = true,
                    urgent = true,
                    point = Vector3.new(e, vector.Y, r),
                    speed = config.burstMax or 28,
                    label = ("CENTRAL BEAM: back onto the footprint (lat %.1f)"):format(N),
                }
            end
            A = F
                + (
                    config.centralBeamPark
                    or (context.DG and context.DG.reach or 1.8) + (config.centralBeamParkM or 1)
                )
            local function n(f, a)
                if config.centralBeamWay == false then
                    return false
                end
                local g, i, b = config.burstMax or 28, f - k, a - x
                f = sqrt(i * i + b * b)
                a = max(1, math.ceil(f / 2))
                for index = 1, a, 1 do
                    local z = index / a
                    local a, B, s = k + i * z, x + b * z, goneAt + f * z / g
                    if ringLethalAt(a, B, s, Z) or j(a, B, s, 1) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            F = N >= 0 and 1 or -1
            e, r = G(F * A)
            if C(e, r) or n(e, r) then
                I, o = G(-F * A)
                if C(I, o) or n(I, o) then
                    return nil
                end
                F, e, r = -F, I, o
            else
            end
            o = config.centralBeamNear == false or abs(N) <= A + (config.centralBeamParkBand or 2)
            if
                abs(N) >= A - (config.centralBeamHoldIn or 0.5)
                and o
                and N >= 0 == (F >= 0)
                and not (config.odinAllLanes ~= false and C(k, x))
            then
                odinMechanics.last = {
                    hold = true,
                }
                return {
                    move = false,
                    label = ("CENTRAL BEAM: parked beside the beam (lat %.1f), holding"):format(N),
                }
            end
            odinMechanics.last = {
                x = e,
                z = r,
                at = goneAt,
            }
            return {
                move = true,
                urgent = true,
                point = Vector3.new(e, vector.Y, r),
                speed = config.burstMax or 28,
                label = ("CENTRAL BEAM: park beside the beam (lat %.1f -> %.0f)"):format(N, F * A),
            }
        end
        odinMechanics.runeR = function()
            if config.odinRuneR then
                return config.odinRuneR
            end
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                return nil
            end
            if odinMechanics.runeAt and os.clock() - odinMechanics.runeAt < 30 and odinMechanics.runeV then
                return odinMechanics.runeV
            end
            odinMechanics.runeAt = os.clock()
            local J, v = 0, 0
            local function runeV()
                local Z = workspace:FindFirstChild("bossRoomRunes")
                if not Z then
                    return
                end
                local iterateArray, n = ipairs, vmHelpers[127](Z:GetDescendants())
                for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(n)) do
                    Z = entry:IsA("BasePart")
                            and sqrt(
                                (entry.Position.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (entry.Position.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2
                            )
                        or 0
                    key = entry:IsA("BasePart") and Z > 20
                    if key then
                        local d
                        if config.odinRuneAt == "outer" then
                            local S = { -1, 1 }
                            d = 0
                            for index, entry2 in ipairs(S) do
                                index = { -1, 1 }
                                for index2, entry3 in ipairs(index) do
                                    index2 = { -1, 1 }
                                    for index3, entry4 in ipairs(index2) do
                                        index3 = entry.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
                                            Vector3.new(
                                                entry2 * entry.Size.X * 0.5,
                                                entry3 * entry.Size.Y * 0.5,
                                                entry4 * entry.Size.Z * 0.5
                                            )
                                        )
                                        entry4 =
                                            sqrt((index3.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (index3.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2)
                                        d = if entry4 > d then entry4 else d
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            d = Z
                        end
                        local S, j = J + d, v + 1
                        J, v = S, j
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(runeV)
            runeV = v > 0 and J / v or (config.odinRuneFallback or (config.odinRuneAt == "outer" and 62 or 56))
            odinMechanics.runeV = runeV
            return odinMechanics.runeV
        end
        local function lineGeom(position)
            if not (position and position.Parent) then
                return nil
            end
            local transform, size = position.CFrame, position.Size
            local v, M, Z, n, f, r = transform.LookVector, transform.RightVector
            if size.Z >= size.X then
                Z, n, f, r = v.X, v.Z, M.X, M.Z
            else
                Z, n, f, r = M.X, M.Z, v.X, v.Z
            end
            v, M = sqrt(Z * Z + n * n), sqrt(f * f + r * r)
            if v < 0.01 or M < 0.01 then
                return nil
            end
            position = transform.Position
            return {
                x = position.X,
                y = position.Y,
                z = position.Z,
                ax = Z / v,
                az = n / v,
                sx = f / M,
                sz = r / M,
                halfL = max(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5,
                halfW = min(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5,
            }
        end
        odinMechanics.lineGeom = lineGeom
        odinMechanics.noteGreen = function(S, firedAt)
            local fanGreen = lineGeom(S.part)
            if not fanGreen then
                return
            end
            fanGreen.model, fanGreen.spawn = S.model, S.spawn
            fanGreen.firedAt = firedAt
            odinMechanics.fanGreen = fanGreen
            fanGreen = hazardReader.models and hazardReader.models[S.model]
            if fanGreen then
                fanGreen.long, fanGreen.detonatedAt = false, fanGreen.detonatedAt or firedAt
                fanGreen.untilAt = math.min(fanGreen.untilAt or firedAt, firedAt)
                for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.zones or {}) do
                    if entry.model == S.model then
                        entry.untilAt = math.min(entry.untilAt, firedAt)
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.boxGen = (hazardReader.boxGen or 0) + 1
            end
            context.logT("odin", 1, "Odin", "fan: first beam detonated - green")
        end
        context.odinIgnoreLine = function(S)
            if config.odinFirstBeamOnly == false or not S then
                return false
            end
            if odinMechanics.ignoredModels and odinMechanics.ignoredModels[S] then
                return true
            end
            local j = odinMechanics.lines[S]
            if j then
                return j.ignored == true
            end
            return odinMechanics.lastLineAt ~= nil
                and os.clock() - odinMechanics.lastLineAt <= (config.odinFanQuiet or 2)
        end
        local function fanDissolve(j, J)
            j.done, j.doneAt = true, os.clock()
            if j.first then
                j.first.ignored = true
            end
            odinMechanics.fanGreen = nil
            odinMechanics.central = nil
            odinMechanics.fanActiveAt = nil
            context.logT("odin", 1, "Odin", "fan: " .. J .. " - back to normal")
        end
        odinMechanics.fanDissolve = fanDissolve
        local function j(J, v)
            local M = config.fieldLineLive or 1.2
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                local n = odinMechanics.lineList[index]
                if
                    n.model ~= J.model
                    and n.spawn >= J.spawn - 0.05
                    and v - n.spawn <= M + (config.odinFanTail or 0.3)
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        odinMechanics.fanGreenNow = function(J)
            local fanGreen = odinMechanics.fanGreen
            if not fanGreen then
                return nil
            end
            if config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false then
                local fan = odinMechanics.fan
                if not fan or fan.done or not fan.first or fan.first.model ~= fanGreen.model then
                    odinMechanics.fanGreen = nil
                    return nil
                end
                return fanGreen
            end
            if J - fanGreen.firedAt > (config.odinFanGreenMax or 6) then
                odinMechanics.fanGreen = nil
                return nil
            end
            if J - fanGreen.firedAt > (config.odinFanGreenMin or 0.8) and not j(fanGreen, J) then
                odinMechanics.fanGreen = nil
                return nil
            end
            return fanGreen
        end
        odinMechanics.fanRedNow = function(j)
            local central = odinMechanics.central
            if
                not (central and central.part and central.model and central.model.Parent)
                or central.firedAt
                or central.goneAt
            then
                return nil
            end
            if
                config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false
                and (not odinMechanics.fan or odinMechanics.fan.done or odinMechanics.fan.first ~= central)
            then
                return nil
            end
            if j - (central.spawn or j) > (config.fieldLineLive or 1.2) + (config.centralBeamGrace or 0.2) then
                return nil
            end
            return lineGeom(central.part)
        end
        local function j(J, v, M, Z, n, f)
            local r, o = config.fieldLineLive or 1.2, { 0, 0.3, 0.6 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(o) do
                index = M + entry
                if
                    odinMechanics.inRingBand(J, v, index, Z)
                    or U(J, v, index, M, Z)
                    or m(J, v, index, Z)
                    or E(J, v, n)
                then
                    return true
                end
                for index2 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                    entry = odinMechanics.lineList[index2]
                    if
                        entry.model ~= f
                        and not entry.ignored
                        and index - entry.spawn >= -0.05
                        and index - entry.spawn <= r
                    then
                        index2 = lineGeom(entry.part)
                        if index2 then
                            local d, n = J - index2.x, v - index2.z
                            if
                                abs(d * index2.ax + n * index2.az) <= index2.halfL + Z
                                and abs(d * index2.sx + n * index2.sz)
                                    <= index2.halfW + Z + (config.centralOtherLaneM or 3)
                            then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function d(J, vector, M, Z)
            local n = odinMechanics.fanGreenNow(J)
            if not n then
                return nil
            end
            local f, r = vector.X, vector.Z
            local o, A = f - n.x, r - n.z
            local k, x = o * n.ax + A * n.az, o * n.sx + A * n.sz
            A = max(-n.halfL + 4, min(n.halfL - 4, k))
            local o, a = n.x + n.ax * A, n.z + n.az * A
            if j(o, a, J, M, Z, n.model) then
                return nil
            end
            if abs(x) <= (config.centralBeamOn or 2.5) and abs(k - A) <= 2 then
                odinMechanics.last = {
                    hold = true,
                }
                return {
                    move = false,
                    label = ("ODIN FAN: in the green (the spent first beam), holding until the fan is over (%.1fs)"):format(
                        J - n.firedAt
                    ),
                }
            end
            odinMechanics.last = {
                x = o,
                z = a,
                at = J,
            }
            return {
                move = true,
                urgent = true,
                point = Vector3.new(o, vector.Y, a),
                speed = config.burstMax or 28,
                label = ("ODIN FAN: into the green (the spent first beam), %.0f studs"):format(
                    sqrt((o - f) ^ 2 + (a - r) ^ 2)
                ),
            }
        end
        odinMechanics.fanPlan = function(fanActiveAt, vector)
            if fanActiveAt - odinMechanics.lastTick > 1 or config.odinCentralBeam == false then
                return nil
            end
            local v, fan = config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false, odinMechanics.fan
            if v then
                if not fan or fan.done or not fan.first then
                    return nil
                end
                if fan.first.firedAt and fanActiveAt - fan.first.firedAt > (config.odinFanMax or 4) then
                    fanDissolve(fan, "the green not reached in time")
                    return nil
                end
                if
                    not fan.first.firedAt
                    and (fan.first.goneAt or fanActiveAt - fan.first.spawn > (config.fieldLineLive or 1.2) + 1)
                then
                    fanDissolve(fan, "the first beam went without detonating")
                    return nil
                end
            end
            local Z, n = config.fieldLaneMargin or 1, hazardReader.arenaCentre
            local f = n and sqrt((vector.X - n.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - n.Z) ^ 2) or nil
            n = V(fanActiveAt, vector, Z, f)
            if n then
                local central = odinMechanics.central
                n.label = n.label:gsub(
                    "^CENTRAL BEAM",
                    central and central.firedAt and "ODIN FAN [GREEN]" or "ODIN FAN [RED]"
                )
            else
                n = (d(fanActiveAt, vector, Z, f))
            end
            Z = odinMechanics.fanGreen
            if v and n and Z then
                if
                    abs((vector.X - Z.x) * Z.sx + (vector.Z - Z.z) * Z.sz)
                    <= (config.centralBeamOn or 2.5) + 0.5
                then
                    fan.inGreenAt = fan.inGreenAt or fanActiveAt
                end
                if fan.inGreenAt then
                    f = (config.odinGreenHold or 1) - (fanActiveAt - fan.inGreenAt)
                    if f <= 0 then
                        fanDissolve(fan, ("%.1fs in the green"):format(config.odinGreenHold or 1))
                        return nil
                    end
                    n.label = n.label .. (" - back to normal in %.1fs"):format(f)
                end
            end
            if n then
                odinMechanics.fanActiveAt = fanActiveAt
            end
            return n
        end
        context.odinFanPinned = function(d)
            return odinMechanics.fanActiveAt ~= nil and d - odinMechanics.fanActiveAt < 0.3
        end
        odinMechanics.plan = function(firedAt, vector)
            if firedAt - odinMechanics.lastTick > 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local j = vector.X
            local J = vector.Z
            if not y(firedAt) then
                local arenaCentre, v, M =
                    hazardReader.arenaCentre, context.readyDamageCasts and context.readyDamageCasts() or 0, 0
                if context.attackReady then
                    local Z, n = context.attackReady()
                    M = if not Z then n or 0 else M
                else
                end
                local Z, n, f =
                    v >= 1 or M <= (config.closeLead or 1.2),
                    arenaCentre and sqrt((j - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (J - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2) or nil,
                    config.odinRuneStand ~= false and arenaCentre ~= nil and odinMechanics.runeR() or nil
                local v, M =
                    f ~= nil and n ~= nil and abs(n - f) > (config.odinRuneBand or 4) + 2,
                    config.odinRanks ~= false and context.odinRankOff ~= nil and arenaCentre ~= nil
                if M then
                    v = n ~= nil and context.odinRankOff(n) > (config.odinRankSlack or 1)
                    f = nil
                else
                end
                if
                    not (
                        arenaCentre
                        and n
                        and (not Z and n < (config.odinIdleR or 88) - 6 and f == nil and not M or v)
                    )
                then
                    odinMechanics.last = nil
                    return nil
                end
            end
            local speed = config.fieldSpeed or 24
            local v = config.fieldHold or 0.8
            local M = config.fieldLaneMargin or 1
            local arenaCentre2 = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            local n = arenaCentre2 and sqrt((j - arenaCentre2.X) ^ 2 + (J - arenaCentre2.Z) ^ 2) or nil
            local ignoreLines, r, o, A, k, x, a =
                (config.missileLaneWidth or 10) * 0.5, config.missilePassT or 0.9, config.missilePassClear or 1.5
            for index = 1, #odinMechanics.missileList, 1 do
                local N = odinMechanics.missileList[index]
                index = sqrt(N.vx * N.vx + N.vz * N.vz)
                if index > 20 then
                    local I, F, C, g = N.vx / index, N.vz / index, j - N.x, J - N.z
                    local i = C * I + g * F
                    local b = i / index - max(firedAt - N.t, 0)
                    if i > -15 and b <= r then
                        local e = -F * C + I * g
                        if abs(e) < ignoreLines + o then
                            if not A or abs(e) < abs(k) then
                                A, k, x =
                                    N, e, {
                                        I,
                                        F,
                                    }
                            else
                            end
                        else
                            a = N
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            r = false
            if A or a then
                local e = { 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9 }
                for index2, entry in ipairs(e) do
                    index2 = firedAt + entry
                    if
                        odinMechanics.inRingBand(j, J, index2, M)
                        or R(j, J, index2, M + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3.5))
                        or U(j, J, index2, firedAt, M)
                    then
                        r = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if r then
                    local e, N
                    a, A = N, e
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if A then
                local A, e = k >= 0 and 1 or -1, ignoreLines + o + 1 - abs(k)
                local N, I = j + -x[2] * A * e, J + x[1] * A * e
                if
                    odinMechanics.inRingBand(N, I, firedAt, M)
                    or odinMechanics.inRingBand(N, I, firedAt + 0.6, M)
                then
                    r = ignoreLines + o + 1 + abs(k)
                    local F, C = j + -x[2] * -A * r, J + x[1] * -A * r
                    if
                        not (
                            odinMechanics.inRingBand(F, C, firedAt, M)
                            or odinMechanics.inRingBand(F, C, firedAt + 0.6, M)
                        )
                    then
                        A, e = -A, r
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                N, I = -x[2] * A, x[1] * A
                odinMechanics.last = {
                    x = j + N * e,
                    z = J + I * e,
                    at = firedAt,
                }
                return {
                    move = true,
                    point = Vector3.new(j + N * e, vector.Y, J + I * e),
                    speed = speed,
                    label = ("MISSILE PATH: %.1f off its line, stepping %.0f out"):format(k, e),
                }
            elseif a then
                odinMechanics.last = {
                    hold = true,
                }
                return {
                    move = false,
                    label = "MISSILE PASSING: beside its line, feet locked",
                }
            end
            odinMechanics.ignoreSets = {}
            odinMechanics.ignoreLines = {}
            for index3 = 1, #odinMechanics.setList, 1 do
                o = odinMechanics.setList[index3]
                if o.model.Parent and q(o, j, J, M) then
                    odinMechanics.ignoreSets[o] = true
                end
            end
            r, ignoreLines = M + (config.fieldLineMargin or 3.5), {}
            for index4 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                o = odinMechanics.lineList[index4]
                local transform, size = o.part.CFrame, o.part.Size
                if o.part.Parent then
                    local position, x, a = transform.Position, transform.LookVector, transform.RightVector
                    local q, e, N, I, F, C, g, i =
                        j - position.X, J - position.Z, max(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5, min(size.Z, size.X) * 0.5
                    if size.Z >= size.X then
                        F, C, g, i = x.X, x.Z, a.X, a.Z
                    else
                        F, C, g, i = a.X, a.Z, x.X, x.Z
                    end
                    a, x = sqrt(F * F + C * C), sqrt(g * g + i * i)
                    if
                        a > 0.01
                        and x > 0.01
                        and abs((q * F + e * C) / a) <= N + r
                        and abs((q * g + e * i) / x) <= I + r
                    then
                        ignoreLines[o] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            odinMechanics.ignoreLines = ignoreLines
            odinMechanics.danceIgnore = nil
            if config.odinCentralBeam ~= false then
                r = V(firedAt, vector, M, n)
                if r then
                    return r
                end
            end
            if config.beamDance ~= false and config.odinCentralBeam == false and #odinMechanics.lineList > 0 then
                local q, V = config.beamDanceRange or 30, config.beamDanceLm or config.fieldLineMargin or 3.5
                ignoreLines = config.lineFiredAt or 0.65
                local function danceIgnore(k)
                    if not k.part.Parent then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local x, a = k.part.CFrame, k.part.Size
                    local position2, lookVector, I, halfL, halfW, g, i, b, B =
                        x.Position, x.LookVector, x.RightVector, max(a.Z, a.X) * 0.5, min(a.Z, a.X) * 0.5
                    if a.Z >= a.X then
                        g, i, b, B = lookVector.X, lookVector.Z, I.X, I.Z
                    else
                        g, i, b, B = I.X, I.Z, lookVector.X, lookVector.Z
                    end
                    x, a = sqrt(g * g + i * i), sqrt(b * b + B * B)
                    if x <= 0.01 or a <= 0.01 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    g /= x
                    i /= x
                    b /= a
                    B /= a
                    k, I = j - position2.X, J - position2.Z
                    return {
                        p = position2,
                        ax = g,
                        az = i,
                        sx = b,
                        sz = B,
