                        halfL = halfL,
                        halfW = halfW,
                        along = k * g + I * i,
                        lat = k * b + I * B,
                    }
                end
                local k, x
                r = odinMechanics.dance
                    and odinMechanics.dance.model
                    and odinMechanics.lines[odinMechanics.dance.model]
                if r and firedAt - r.spawn <= (config.beamDanceFor or 3.2) then
                    o = danceIgnore(r)
                    if o and abs(o.along) <= o.halfL - 4 and abs(o.lat) <= q + 8 then
                        k, x = r, o
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if not k then
                    local a = #odinMechanics.lineList
                    for index5 = 1, a, 1 do
                        local a = odinMechanics.lineList[index5]
                        index5 = firedAt - a.spawn
                        if index5 <= (config.beamDanceFor or 3.2) and index5 < ignoreLines + 0.3 then
                            local e = danceIgnore(a)
                            if
                                e
                                and abs(e.along) <= e.halfL - 4
                                and abs(e.lat) <= q
                                and (not k or a.spawn < k.spawn)
                            then
                                k, x = a, e
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                if k then
                    odinMechanics.laneMem = odinMechanics.laneMem or {}
                    q = odinMechanics.laneMem
                    if q.model ~= k.model then
                        q.firedAt = nil
                    end
                    q.model = k.model
                    q.at = firedAt
                    q.ox, q.oz = x.p.X, x.p.Z
                    q.ax, q.az, q.sx, q.sz = x.ax, x.az, x.sx, x.sz
                    q.halfL, q.halfW = x.halfL, x.halfW
                    danceIgnore = {}
                    for index6 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                        local a = odinMechanics.lineList[index6]
                        if a ~= k and a.spawn >= k.spawn - 0.05 and a.model then
                            danceIgnore[a.model] = true
                        end
                    end
                    odinMechanics.danceIgnore = danceIgnore
                    local q, A = firedAt - k.spawn, x.halfW + V + (config.beamDancePark or 1.5)
                    local function urgent(e)
                        return x.p.X + x.ax * x.along + x.sx * e, x.p.Z + x.az * x.along + x.sz * e
                    end
                    local e = abs(x.lat) < x.halfW + 1
                    local function N(I, F, C, g)
                        if odinMechanics.inRingBand(I, F, C, M) then
                            return "ring"
                        end
                        if e and not g then
                            return nil
                        end
                        if m(I, F, C, M) then
                            return "missile"
                        end
                        if U(I, F, C, firedAt, M) then
                            return "orb"
                        end
                        local ignoreLines2, ignoreLines3 = odinMechanics.ignoreLines, {}
                        for index7 = 1, #odinMechanics.lineList, 1 do
                            local G = odinMechanics.lineList[index7]
                            if G == k then
                                if g then
                                    ignoreLines3[G] = true
                                end
                            elseif G.spawn >= k.spawn - 0.05 then
                                ignoreLines3[G] = true
                            end
                        end
                        odinMechanics.ignoreLines = ignoreLines3
                        g = R(I, F, C, M + V, (config.lineHitFrom or 0.65) - 0.2, true)
                        odinMechanics.ignoreLines = ignoreLines2
                        if g then
                            return "line"
                        end
                        return nil
                    end
                    local R = hazardReader.models[k.model]
                    local I = k.firedAt ~= nil or R ~= nil and (R.detonatedAt ~= nil or R.fired == true)
                    if
                        I
                        and odinMechanics.laneMem
                        and odinMechanics.laneMem.model == k.model
                        and not odinMechanics.laneMem.firedAt
                    then
                        odinMechanics.laneMem.firedAt = firedAt
                    end
                    local F, phase, g
                    if q < ignoreLines and not I then
                        odinMechanics.danceSide = odinMechanics.danceSide or {}
                        R = odinMechanics.danceSide[k.model]
                        if not R then
                            local side = x.lat >= 0 and 1 or -1
                            side = if odinMechanics.dance
                                    and odinMechanics.dance.model == k.model
                                    and odinMechanics.dance.side
                                then odinMechanics.dance.side
                                else side
                            local b, B = urgent(side * A)
                            if N(b, B, firedAt + 0.3, false) or E(b, B, n) then
                                local b, B = urgent(-side * A)
                                side = if not (N(b, B, firedAt + 0.3, false) or E(b, B, n)) then -side else side
                            else
                            end
                            R = {
                                side = side,
                            }
                            odinMechanics.danceSide[k.model] = R
                        else
                        end
                        F, phase, g = R.side * A, "beside", false
                    else
                        F, phase, g = 0, "in the lane of", true
                    end
                    I, R = urgent(F)
                    A = sqrt((I - j) ^ 2 + (R - J) ^ 2)
                    local i, b = firedAt + A / speed, true
                    if A > 2 then
                        b = if odinMechanics.pathCrossesRing
                                and odinMechanics.pathCrossesRing(j, J, I, R, firedAt, i)
                            then false
                            else b
                        if b then
                            local B = max(2, math.ceil(A / 4))
                            for index8 = 1, B, 1 do
                                local z = index8 / B
                                if N(j + (I - j) * z, J + (R - J) * z, firedAt + (i - firedAt) * z, g) then
                                    b = false
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local B = b and not N(I, R, i, g) and not N(I, R, i + 0.5, g) and not E(I, R, n)
                    if not B and config.beamGapWalk ~= false then
                        local b, G, z, s = config.beamGapStep or 6, config.beamGapMax or 90
                        for index9 = 1, math.ceil(G / b), 1 do
                            i = { 1, -1 }
                            for index10, entry2 in ipairs(i) do
                                index10 = x.lat + entry2 * index9 * b
                                local i, b = urgent(index10)
                                if
                                    (config.beamGapMustClear == false or abs(index10) >= x.halfW + V)
                                    and not E(i, b, n)
                                then
                                    entry2 = sqrt((i - j) ^ 2 + (b - J) ^ 2)
                                    local V = firedAt + entry2 / speed
                                    if not N(i, b, V, g) and not N(i, b, V + 0.5, g) then
                                        local T = true
                                        if
                                            not (
                                                odinMechanics.pathCrossesRing
                                                and odinMechanics.pathCrossesRing(j, J, i, b, firedAt, V)
                                            )
                                        then
                                            local K = max(2, math.ceil(entry2 / 4))
                                            for index11 = 1, K, 1 do
                                                local H = index11 / K
                                                if
                                                    N(
                                                        j + (i - j) * H,
                                                        J + (b - J) * H,

                                                    x = q,
                                                    z = index16,
                                                    d = index7,
                                                    when = when2,
                                                }, E
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                return _, c
                            end
                            r, I, speed2 = O(true), false
                            if not r then
                                speed2, I = O(false), true
                            else
                                speed2 = r
                            end
                            a, e = config.fieldMoveGain or 0.25, I and (config.fieldUncheckedGain or 0.5)
                            O, V =
                                a + (e or 0),
                                config.fieldMoveWhenHit ~= false and m <= (config.fieldHitNow or 0.05)
                            if speed2 and (speed2.when >= m + O or V and speed2.when > m) then
                                label = ("ODIN FIELD: %s here in %.1fs -> every path cut, cell %.0f studs clear for %.1fs"):format(
                                    o,
                                    m,
                                    speed2.d,
                                    speed2.when == infinity and 9.9 or speed2.when
                                )
                            else
                                if speed2 and config.fieldNoWayOutStand ~= true then
                                    label = ("ODIN FIELD: %s here in %.1fs -> nothing better, taking the best going: cell %.0f studs, clear for %.1fs"):format(
                                        o,
                                        m,
                                        speed2.d,
                                        speed2.when == infinity and 9.9 or speed2.when
                                    )
                                else
                                    odinMechanics.last = {
                                        none = true,
                                    }
                                    return {
                                        move = false,
                                        label = ("ODIN FIELD: %s here in %.1fs and nowhere at all to go - standing"):format(
                                            o,
                                            m
                                        ),
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                            N = speed2
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            odinMechanics.last = {
                x = N.x,
                z = N.z,
                at = firedAt,
            }
            k, r = N.x - j, N.z - J
            I = sqrt(k * k + r * r)
            if I > 1 then
                odinMechanics.commit = {
                    ux = k / I,
                    uz = r / I,
                    at = firedAt,
                }
            end
            g = m <= 0.5
            speed2 = (o == "ring" or g) and (config.burstMax or 28)
                or (context.walkSpeedNow and context.walkSpeedNow() or speed)
            return {
                move = true,
                urgent = g or o == "ring",
                point = Vector3.new(N.x, vector.Y, N.z),
                speed = speed2,
                label = label,
            }
        end
        odinMechanics.state = function()
            local d, Q, O, S =
                #odinMechanics.setList, #odinMechanics.arrays, #odinMechanics.lineList, #odinMechanics.orbList
            return ("sets %d arrays %d lines %d orbs %d"):format(d, Q, O, S)
        end
        odinMechanics.clearFor = function(vector, Q, O)
            if Q - odinMechanics.lastTick > 1 then
                return false
            end
            local S, D, P, iterateArray, l =
                vector.X, vector.Z, (config.fieldLaneMargin or 1) + 0.5, ipairs, {
                    0,
                    O * 0.5,
                    O,
                    O + 0.3,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(l) do
                if hazardAt(S, D, Q + entry, Q, P) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
    end

    components.bossPhases = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState, hazardReader = context.RT, context.RD
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local max = math.max
        local min = math.min
        local infinity = math.huge
        local abs = math.abs
        local bossPhases = {
            boss = nil,
            phase = "idle",
            phaseAt = -infinity,
            fansSinceSlam = 0,
            lastFanAt = -infinity,
            lastSlamAt = -infinity,
            lastJumpAt = -infinity,
            lastChainAt = -infinity,
            lastSpikesAt = -infinity,
            lastFloorAt = -infinity,
            respawnAt = -infinity,
            lastLineAt = -infinity,
            lastMissileAt = -infinity,
            fanSeen = 0,
            slamSeen = 0,
            note = "",
        }
        context.PB = bossPhases
        local function c(u, h, m, R)
            local y, q = u - m, h - R
            return sqrt(y * y + q * q)
        end
        local function u(h)
            if not (h and h.isBoss and h.model) then
                return nil
            end
            return context.bossProfile(h.model.Name)
        end
        local function h(phase, phaseAt)
            if bossPhases.phase ~= phase then
                bossPhases.phase = phase
                bossPhases.phaseAt = phaseAt
            end
        end
        local function m(R, champEntry, q)
            if not hazardReader.champEntry and q and q.root and q.root.Parent then
                local position = q.root.Position
                if c(champEntry.X, champEntry.Z, position.X, position.Z) <= 140 then
                    hazardReader.champEntry = champEntry
                end
            end
            local fanStarts = hazardReader.fanStarts
            local lastFanAt = fanStarts and fanStarts[#fanStarts] or nil
            if lastFanAt and lastFanAt ~= bossPhases.lastFanAt then
                bossPhases.lastFanAt = lastFanAt
                bossPhases.fanSeen = bossPhases.fanSeen + 1
                bossPhases.fansSinceSlam = bossPhases.fansSinceSlam + 1
            end
            if hazardReader.lastSlamAt and hazardReader.lastSlamAt ~= bossPhases.lastSlamAt then
                bossPhases.lastSlamAt = hazardReader.lastSlamAt
                bossPhases.slamSeen = bossPhases.slamSeen + 1
                bossPhases.fansSinceSlam = 0
            end
            if hazardReader.jumpUpAt and hazardReader.jumpUpAt ~= bossPhases.lastJumpAt then
                bossPhases.lastJumpAt = hazardReader.jumpUpAt
            end
            local V, E, p =
                hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and R < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1,
                R - bossPhases.lastFanAt,
                R - bossPhases.lastSlamAt
            if V then
                h(bossPhases.fansSinceSlam == 1 and bossPhases.slamSeen > 0 and "bigfan" or "fan", R)
            elseif p < 3 then
                h("slam", R)
            elseif bossPhases.fansSinceSlam >= 1 and E > 6 then
                h("vortex", R)
            elseif bossPhases.lastFanAt > -infinity and E > 4 then
                h("between", R)
            else
                h("open", R)
            end
            pcall(bossPhases.champHop, R, champEntry, q)
        end
        local function R()
            if hazardReader.hopDelays then
                return hazardReader.hopDelays
            end
            local hopDelays = {}
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile("HarvardLabs/data/champ_hop.json") then
                    local q = game:GetService("HttpService")
                        :JSONDecode(readfile("HarvardLabs/data/champ_hop.json"))
                    if type(q) == "table" then
                        for index, entry in ipairs(q) do
                            if type(entry) == "number" then
                                hopDelays[#hopDelays + 1] = entry
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            hazardReader.hopDelays = hopDelays
            return hopDelays
        end
        local function hopDelay()
            local q = R()
            if #q == 0 then
                return config.champHopDelay
            end
            local V = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(q) do
                V[index] = entry
            end
            table.sort(V)
            return V[math.ceil(#V / 2)]
        end
        bossPhases.hopDelay = hopDelay
        bossPhases.champHop = function(q, champMid, E)
            if config.champHopKeep == false or not (E and E.root and E.root.Parent) then
                return
            end
            champMid = E.root.Position
            if not hazardReader.champMid and bossPhases.slamSeen == 0 then
                hazardReader.champMid = champMid
            end
            E = hazardReader.hub or hazardReader.champMid
            if not E then
                return
            end
            local p, champHop = c(champMid.X, champMid.Z, E.X, E.Z), hazardReader.champHop
            if
                bossPhases.slamSeen > 0
                and bossPhases.lastSlamAt > -infinity
                and (not champHop or champHop.slamAt ~= bossPhases.lastSlamAt)
            then
                champHop = {
                    slamAt = bossPhases.lastSlamAt,
                    away = false,
                }
                hazardReader.champHop = champHop
            else
            end
            if not champHop then
                return
            end
            if p > (config.champHopAwayR or 20) then
                champHop.away = true
            end
            if champHop.away and not champHop.backAt and p < (config.champHopHomeR or 10) then
                champHop.backAt = q
                local U = q - champHop.slamAt
                if U > 0.3 and U < 30 then
                    local J = R()
                    J[#J + 1] = U
                    while true do
                        local R, champHopKeepN = #J, config.champHopKeepN
                        if not (R > (champHopKeepN or 12)) then
                            break
                        end
                        table.remove(J, 1)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        writefile("HarvardLabs/data/champ_hop.json", game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(J))
                    end)
                end
                if context.logT then
                    context.logT(
                        "champhop",
                        0,
                        "Boss",
                        ("Midgardian hopped back to the middle %.1fs after the slam (learned %.1fs)"):format(
                            U,
                            hopDelay() or U
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            p = hopDelay()
            local R, untilAt =
                p and champHop.slamAt + p - (config.champHopLead or 1.5)
                    or champHop.slamAt + (config.champHopFirst or 1),
                champHop.backAt and champHop.backAt + (config.champHopFanHold or 4)
                    or champHop.slamAt + (config.champHopMax or 15)
            untilAt = if p
                    and not champHop.backAt
                    and q > champHop.slamAt + p + (config.champHopLate or 3)
                then math.min(untilAt, q + 1)
                else untilAt
            hazardReader.champHopDue = not champHop.backAt and p and champHop.slamAt + p or nil
            if q >= R and q < untilAt and context.addZone then
                local R = config.champHopKeepR or 60
                if not champHop.zone then
                    local zone = {
                        name = "hop back",
                        kind = "zone",
                        bubbleKeep = true,
                        round = true,
                        exact = true,
                        weight = 1,
                        madeAt = q,
                        cframe = CFrame.new(E.X, champMid.Y, E.Z),
                        size = Vector3.new(R * 2, 20, R * 2),
                        from = q,
                        untilAt = untilAt,
                    }
                    context.addZone(zone)
                    champHop.zone = zone
                    if context.logT then
                        context.logT(
                            "champhop",
                            1,
                            "Boss",
                            ("hop back %s - out of the middle (%.0f round it)"):format(
                                p and ("due in %.1fs"):format(champHop.slamAt + p - q) or "not timed yet",
                                R
                            )
                        )
                    end
                end
                champHop.zone.untilAt = untilAt
            elseif champHop.zone and q >= untilAt then
                champHop.zone.untilAt = math.min(champHop.zone.untilAt or q, q)
            end
        end
        local function R(y)
            local lastCircle = hazardReader.lastCircle
            if lastCircle and lastCircle.t ~= bossPhases.lastChainAt then
                bossPhases.lastChainAt = lastCircle.t
            end
            if hazardReader.lastSpikesAt and hazardReader.lastSpikesAt ~= bossPhases.lastSpikesAt then
                bossPhases.lastSpikesAt = hazardReader.lastSpikesAt
            end
            if hazardReader.lastFloorAt and hazardReader.lastFloorAt ~= bossPhases.lastFloorAt then
                bossPhases.lastFloorAt = hazardReader.lastFloorAt
            end
            local q, V, E = y - bossPhases.lastChainAt, y - bossPhases.lastSpikesAt, y - bossPhases.lastFloorAt
            if q < 1.2 then
                h("circles", y)
            elseif q < 4 and V > q then
                h("spikes-due", y)
            elseif V < 2.5 then
                h("spikes", y)
            elseif E < 3 then
                h("floor", y)
            else
                h("between", y)
            end
        end
        local function y(q, vector, orbBlastAt)
            if not hazardReader.odinEntry and orbBlastAt and orbBlastAt.root and orbBlastAt.root.Parent then
                local odinMiddle = context.Workspace
                local j = odinMiddle and (odinMiddle:FindFirstChild("thirdBossMiddlePart", true))
                if j then
                    odinMiddle = j.Position
                    local j = c(vector.X, vector.Z, odinMiddle.X, odinMiddle.Z)
                    if j > 1 and j < 140 then
                        local U, J = (vector.X - odinMiddle.X) / j, (vector.Z - odinMiddle.Z) / j
                        if config.odinFarSide ~= false then
                            U, J = -U, -J
                        else
                        end
                        local position, w, Y, v =
                            orbBlastAt.root.Position,
                            (context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or 81) - (config.odinRingIn or 4),
                            { 81.25, 68.75, 56.25, 43.75, 31.25 }
                        for index, entry in ipairs(Y) do
                            local Y, Z = odinMiddle.X + U * entry, odinMiddle.Z + J * entry
                            if c(Y, Z, position.X, position.Z) <= w then
                                v = Vector3.new(Y, vector.Y, Z)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        hazardReader.odinEntry = v
                            or Vector3.new(odinMiddle.X + U * 43.75, vector.Y, odinMiddle.Z + J * 43.75)
                        hazardReader.odinMiddle = odinMiddle
                    end
                end
            end
            if hazardReader.lastLineShotAt and hazardReader.lastLineShotAt ~= bossPhases.lastLineAt then
                bossPhases.lastLineAt = hazardReader.lastLineShotAt
            end
            if hazardReader.lastMissileAt and hazardReader.lastMissileAt ~= bossPhases.lastMissileAt then
                bossPhases.lastMissileAt = hazardReader.lastMissileAt
            end
            orbBlastAt = hazardReader.orbBlastAt
            if hazardReader.charAt and q - hazardReader.charAt < (config.invulnAfterRespawn or 4) then
                h("invuln", q)
            elseif q - bossPhases.lastLineAt < 2 then
                h("lines", q)
            elseif orbBlastAt and q > orbBlastAt - 3 and q < orbBlastAt + 1 then
                h("orbs", q)
            elseif q - bossPhases.lastMissileAt < 3 then
                h("missiles", q)
            else
                h("odin", q)
            end
        end
        bossPhases.tick = function(phaseAt, q, V)
            local E = u(V)
            local boss = E and V.model.Name or nil
            if boss ~= bossPhases.boss then
                bossPhases.boss = boss
                bossPhases.phase = "idle"
                bossPhases.phaseAt = phaseAt
                bossPhases.fansSinceSlam = 0
                bossPhases.fanSeen = 0
                bossPhases.slamSeen = 0
                bossPhases.lastFanAt, bossPhases.lastSlamAt, bossPhases.lastJumpAt, bossPhases.lastChainAt, bossPhases.lastSpikesAt, bossPhases.lastFloorAt =
                    -infinity, -infinity, -infinity, -infinity, -infinity, -infinity
            end
            if not E then
                bossPhases.phase = "idle"
                return
            end
            if E.fan then
                m(phaseAt, q, V)
            elseif E.home then
                R(phaseAt)
            else
                y(phaseAt, q, V)
            end
        end
        bossPhases.expectSlam = function(h)
            if bossPhases.boss == nil then
                return false
            end
            if not context.bossProfile(bossPhases.boss).fan then
                return false
            end
            if hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and h < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1 then
                return false
            end
            if h - bossPhases.lastSlamAt < 10 then
                return false
            end
            if bossPhases.lastFanAt == -infinity then
                return true
            end
            if h - bossPhases.lastFanAt < 6 then
                return false
            end
            return bossPhases.fansSinceSlam >= 1
        end
        bossPhases.fanHold = function(P)
            if bossPhases.boss == nil or not context.bossProfile(bossPhases.boss).fan then
                return nil
            end
            local h, m, R =
                hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and P < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1,
                hazardReader.fanPeriod
                    and hazardReader.lastFanStart
                    and P - hazardReader.lastFanStart
                        >= hazardReader.fanPeriod - (config.fanEarly or 2),
                P - bossPhases.lastSlamAt
            P = bossPhases.slamSeen > 0
                and bossPhases.fansSinceSlam == 0
                and R >= (config.slamHoldFrom or 10)
                and R < 25
            if not (h or m or P) then
                return nil
            end
            return config.fanRadius or 90
        end
        bossPhases.anchorPoint = function(vector, h)
            local m = u(h)
            if not m then
                return nil
            end
            if m.fan then
                local R = context.champWaypointsNow and context.champWaypointsNow() or config.champWaypoints
                if not R or #R == 0 then
                    return hazardReader.flankTarget
                end
                if context.champTourTarget then
                    local flankTarget =
                        context.champTourTarget(vector, h and h.root and h.root.Parent and h.root.Position or nil)
                    if flankTarget then
                        hazardReader.flankTarget = flankTarget
                        return flankTarget
                    end
                end
                local h = hazardReader.flankTarget
                if h and c(vector.X, vector.Z, h.X, h.Z) < 40 then
                    return h
                end
                local y, flankTarget2
                for index = 1, #R, 1 do
                    h = R[index]
                    index = c(vector.X, vector.Z, h[1], h[3])
                    if not y or index < y then
                        y, flankTarget2 = index, Vector3.new(h[1], vector.Y, h[3])
                    else
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.flankTarget = flankTarget2
                return flankTarget2
            end
            if not m.home then
                return hazardReader.odinEntry
            end
            return nil
        end
        bossPhases.hold = function(P, h)
            local m = u(h)
            if not m then
                return nil, nil
            end
            if m.fan then
                if config.champWaypoints and #config.champWaypoints > 0 then
                    return nil, nil
                end
                return bossPhases.fanHold(P), hazardReader.hub
            end
            if
                not m.home
                and bossPhases.phase == "lines"
                and h.root
                and h.root.Parent
                and not (m.ringBand and config.odinFirstBeamOnly ~= false)
            then
                return config.odinLineHold or 85, h.root.Position
            end
            return nil, nil
        end
        bossPhases.anchor = function(P, position, m, R)
            P = u(m)
            if not P or not m.root or not m.root.Parent then
                return nil
            end
            position = m.root.Position
            if P.home then
                m = hazardReader.bobHome or context.bobCrystalCentroid()
                if not m then
                    return nil
                end
                local u, y = m.X - position.X, m.Z - position.Z
                local q = sqrt(u * u + y * y)
                if q < 1 then
                    return nil
                end
                return Vector3.new(position.X + u / q * R, position.Y, position.Z + y / q * R)
            end
            if P.fan and hazardReader.hub then
                local P, u = position.X - hazardReader.hub.X, position.Z - hazardReader.hub.Z
                m = sqrt(P * P + u * u)
                if m < 6 then
                    return nil
                end
                return Vector3.new(position.X + P / m * R, position.Y, position.Z + u / m * R)
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.bobLine = function()
            if config.bobSpikeLine == false then
                return nil
            end
            local P = context.BR and context.BR.target
            if
                not (
                    P
                    and P.isBoss
                    and P.root
                    and P.root.Parent
                    and P.model
                    and context.bossProfile(P.model.Name).home
                )
            then
                return nil
            end
            local vector = context.bobCrystal and context.bobCrystal("green")
            if not vector then
                return nil
            end
            local position = P.root.Position
            local m, R = vector.X - position.X, vector.Z - position.Z
            local y = sqrt(m * m + R * R)
            if y < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local q = context.standoffFor and context.standoffFor(P) or 57
            local P, V, E = min(config.bobLineKeep or q * (config.bobSpikeBackShare or 0.75), y), m / y, R / y
            return {
                ax = vector.X,
                az = vector.Z,
                bx = position.X + V * P,
                bz = position.Z + E * P,
                ux = V,
                uz = E,
                len = y - P,
            }
        end
        context.bobLinePoint = function(D, P, u)
            u = u or context.bobLine()
            if not u then
                return nil
            end
            local h = (D - u.bx) * u.ux + (P - u.bz) * u.uz
            h = if h < 0 then 0 else if h > u.len then u.len else h
            local m, R = u.bx + u.ux * h, u.bz + u.uz * h
            return m, R, sqrt((D - m) ^ 2 + (P - R) ^ 2), h
        end
        bossPhases.lean = function(D, vector, u)
            local h, m, R, y = vector.X, vector.Z
            local q, V =
                bossPhases.boss and context.bossProfile(bossPhases.boss) or nil,
                context.BR and context.BR.target or nil
            local E = V and V.isBoss and V.root and V.root.Parent and V.root.Position or nil
            if q and q.home and E and hazardReader.bobHome then
                local p, j = hazardReader.bobHome.X - E.X, hazardReader.bobHome.Z - E.Z
                local U, J = sqrt(p * p + j * j), context.standoffFor and context.standoffFor(V) or 57
                if U > 1 then
                    R, y = Vector3.new(E.X + p / U * J, E.Y, E.Z + j / U * J), config.bobCentreBias or 30
                else
                end
                local w = c(h, m, E.X, E.Z)
                local Y = w <= (context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or 77) - 6
                if
                    (bossPhases.phase == "circles" or bossPhases.phase == "spikes-due")
                    and w < (config.bobCircleLeanRange or 110)
                    and not Y
                then
                    y = config.bobCircleLean or 40
                    R = E
                else
                end
                local v = u and u.box and u.box.name or nil
                local M, Z, n, f = v ~= nil
                    and (v == "spikes grow" or v == "ground spikes" or v == "spike field" or v:find(
                        "icespikes",
                        1,
                        true
                    ) ~= nil)
                    and w < 130
                if M and config.bobSpikeLine ~= false and context.bobLinePoint then
                    Z, n, f = context.bobLinePoint(h, m)
                else
                end
                if Z then
                    if f > (config.bobLineNear or 4) then
                        R, y = Vector3.new(Z, vector.Y, n), config.bobSpikeLineLean or 55
                    else
                        if not Y then
                            v = context.bobLine()
                            R, y = Vector3.new(v.bx, vector.Y, v.bz), config.bobSpikeLean or 50
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if M then
                        local v, M, Z = 0, 0, 0
                        if U > 1 then
                            v, M = -j / U, p / U
                            Z = (h - E.X) * v + (m - E.Z) * M
                        else
                        end
                        local p = config.bobSpikeBackAt or J * (config.bobSpikeBackShare or 0.75)
                        if U > 1 and abs(Z) > (config.bobSpikeSideAt or 34) then
                            R, y = Vector3.new(h - v * Z, vector.Y, m - M * Z), config.bobSpikeMidLean or 55
                        else
                            if w < p then
                                local p, j = h - E.X, m - E.Z
                                local U = sqrt(p * p + j * j)
                                if U > 1 then
                                    local backOut = config.bobSpikeBackOut or 18
                                    if config.bossReachFirst ~= false and context.fireReach then
                                        backOut = min(
                                            max(
                                                context.fireReach() - (config.bossReachPullSlack or 3) - w,
                                                config.bobSpikeBackMin or 6
                                            ),
                                            backOut
                                        )
                                    end
                                    R, y =
                                        Vector3.new(
                                            h + p / U * backOut,
                                            vector.Y,
                                            m + j / U * backOut
                                        ),
                                        config.bobSpikeBackLean or 55
                                else
                                end
                            else
                                if not Y then
                                    y = config.bobSpikeLean or 50
                                    R = E
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if
                q
                and not q.fan
                and not q.home
                and E
                and hazardReader.odinEntry
                and bossPhases.phase ~= "lines"
            then
                R, y = hazardReader.odinEntry, config.odinEntryLean or 30
            else
            end
            V = hazardReader.missileAxis
            if q and not q.fan and not q.home and V and D - V.t < 3 and bossPhases.phase ~= "lines" then
                local p, j = -V.dz, V.dx
                local U = (h - V.ox) * p + (m - V.oz) * j
                if abs(U) > 4 then
                    R, y = Vector3.new(h - p * U, vector.Y, m - j * U), config.odinAxisLean or 40
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if q and not q.fan and not q.home and E and bossPhases.phase == "lines" then
                local _, p = h - E.X, m - E.Z
                V = sqrt(_ * _ + p * p)
                if V < (config.odinLineHold or 85) + 10 then
                    if V < 1 then
                        _, p, V = 1, 0, 1
                    else
                    end
                    R, y = Vector3.new(h + _ / V * 60, vector.Y, m + p / V * 60), config.odinLineLean or 40
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if q and q.fan and hazardReader.hub then
                if hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and D < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1 then
                    E, V = h - hazardReader.hub.X, m - hazardReader.hub.Z
                    local _ = sqrt(E * E + V * V)
                    if _ < 1 then
                        E, V, _ = 1, 0, 1
                    else
                    end
                    local p, j, U = E / _, V / _, hazardReader.fanSweep or 0
                    if U ~= 0 then
                        local _ = U * math.rad(config.fanBehindDeg or 30)
                        local U, J = math.cos(_), math.sin(_)
                        p, j = p * U - j * J, p * J + j * U
                    else
                    end
                    R, y = Vector3.new(h + p * 60, vector.Y, m + j * 60), config.fanLean or 40
                else
                end
                if R == nil and context.quietDir then
                    local _, p = context.quietDir(D, h, m)
                    if _ then
                        local j, U = h - hazardReader.hub.X, m - hazardReader.hub.Z
                        local J = math.clamp(
                            sqrt(j * j + U * U),
                            (config.hubKeepOut or 60) + 5,
                            (config.fanRadius or 108) - 10
                        )
                        if context.champMid then
                            j, U = context.champMid()
                            J = if j then max(J, U + (config.champMidRing or 2)) else J
                        else
                        end
                        R, y =
                            Vector3.new(hazardReader.hub.X + _ * J, vector.Y, hazardReader.hub.Z + p * J),
                            config.quietLean or 30
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if
                q
                and q.fan
                and R == nil
                and config.champWaypoints
                and hazardReader.flankTarget
                and c(h, m, hazardReader.flankTarget.X, hazardReader.flankTarget.Z)
                    > (config.waypointHold or 14)
            then
                R, y = hazardReader.flankTarget, config.waypointLean or 25
            else
                if
                    q
                    and q.fan
                    and R == nil
                    and config.champEntryBox
                    and context.inEntryBox
                    and context.inEntryBox(h, m, 15)
                    and hazardReader.flankTarget
                then
                    R, y = hazardReader.flankTarget, config.entranceLean or 20
                else
                    if q and q.fan and hazardReader.champEntry and R == nil and not config.champEntryBox then
                        D, V = h - hazardReader.champEntry.X, m - hazardReader.champEntry.Z
                        E = sqrt(D * D + V * V)
                        if E < (config.entranceKeepOut or 45) + 25 then
                            if E < 1 then
                                D, V, E = 1, 0, 1
                            else
                            end
                            R, y =
                                Vector3.new(h + D / E * 60, vector.Y, m + V / E * 60), config.entranceLean or 20
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            if q and q.fan and hazardReader.hub and u and u.box and u.box.name == "firstbossjumpslam" then
                V, E = h - hazardReader.hub.X, m - hazardReader.hub.Z
                D = sqrt(V * V + E * E)
                if D < 1 then
                    V, E, D = 1, 0, 1
                else
                end
                R, y = Vector3.new(h + V / D * 60, vector.Y, m + E / D * 60), config.slamAwayLean or 35
            else
            end
            E = context.BB and context.BB.pend or nil
            if E then
                for index = 1, #E, 1 do
                    D = E[index]
                    if D and (D.name == "slam incoming" or D.name == "slam soon") and D.ox and D.r then
                        V, index = h - D.ox, m - D.oz
                        local p = sqrt(V * V + index * index)
                        if p < D.r + 8 then
                            if hazardReader.hub then
                                V, index = h - hazardReader.hub.X, m - hazardReader.hub.Z
                                p = sqrt(V * V + index * index)
                            else
                            end
                            if p < 1 then
                                V, index, p = 1, 0, 1
                            else
                            end
                            R, y =
                                Vector3.new(h + V / p * 60, vector.Y, m + index / p * 60), config.slamLean or 30
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if q and q.fan and R == nil and context.champMid then
                D, V = context.champMid()
                if D then
                    local _, p = h - D.X, m - D.Z
                    E = sqrt(_ * _ + p * p)
                    if E < V then
                        if E < 1 then
                            _, p, E = 1, 0, 1
                        else
                        end
                        local O = V + (config.champMidRing or 2)
                        R, y = Vector3.new(D.X + _ / E * O, vector.Y, D.Z + p / E * O), config.champMidLean or 40
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            V = hazardReader.leash
            if q and q.fan and V and V.enemy and V.enemy.root and V.enemy.root.Parent then
                E = context.arenaCentre and context.arenaCentre() or V.enemy.root.Position
                local L, O, _, q, p =
                    c(h, m, E.X, E.Z),
                    (V.radius or config.leashRadius or 122) - (config.arenaEdge or 32),
                    u
                        and u.box
                        and (
                            u.box.name == "firstbossjumpslam"
                            or u.box.name == "slam incoming"
                            or u.box.name == "slam soon"
                        )
                if context.champMid then
                    q, p = context.champMid()
                else
                end
                D = O - 12
                if L > (if q then max(D, p + (config.champMidBand or 10)) else D) and not _ then
                    O = Vector3.new(E.X, vector.Y, E.Z)
                    if q and L > 1 then
                        local d = p + (config.champMidRing or 2)
                        R = Vector3.new(E.X + (h - E.X) / L * d, vector.Y, E.Z + (m - E.Z) / L * d)
                    else
                        R = O
                    end
                    y = max(y or 0, config.rimLean or 12)
                else
                end
            else
            end
            return R, y
        end
        bossPhases.state = function()
            return bossPhases.boss
                    and ("%s:%s f%d s%d"):format(
                        bossPhases.boss,
                        bossPhases.phase,
                        bossPhases.fansSinceSlam,
                        bossPhases.slamSeen
                    )
                or "-"
        end
    end

    components.bubbleBoss = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local dangerGeometry = context.DG
        local contextDepthOf = context.depthOf
        local parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local abs = math.abs
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local max = math.max
        local min = math.min
        local infinity = math.huge
        local cos = math.cos
        local sin = math.sin
        local toRadians = math.rad
        local toDegrees = math.deg
        local atan2 = math.atan2
        local bubbleBoss = {
            active = false,
            lethal = false,
            threats = {},
            rel = {},
            soft = {},
            pend = {},
            mov = {},
            primary = nil,
            lastBreach = -infinity,
            dir = nil,
            dirAt = -infinity,
            count = 0,
            warmCount = 0,
            warnCount = 0,
            escapes = 0,
            folder = nil,
            pickedSafe = false,
            pickedDist = 0,
        }
        context.BB = bubbleBoss
        local function j(U, J, w, Y)
            local v = U.offset + U.speed * max(Y - U.pathStart, 0)
            v = if U.bounces and U.freeAhead
                then min(if U.endAlong and v > U.endAlong then U.endAlong else v, U.freeAhead)
                else if U.endAlong and v > U.endAlong then U.endAlong else v
            local M, Z = J - (U.ox + U.dx * v), w - (U.oz + U.dz * v)
            if U.r and (U.bbRound or config.roundMoving ~= false) then
                return U.r - sqrt(M * M + Z * Z)
            end
            Y, J = abs(M * U.dx + Z * U.dz) - U.halfL, abs(-M * U.dz + Z * U.dx) - U.halfW
            if Y <= 0 and J <= 0 then
                return -max(Y, J)
            end
            return -sqrt(max(Y, 0) ^ 2 + max(J, 0) ^ 2)
        end
        local U = 0
        local function J(w, Y, v)
            local M = Y > U + 0.05 and not w.noGrace and (config.expiryGrace or 0.6)
            local Z = M or 0
            return (w.from or 0) <= Y + ((if w.noLead then 0 else v) or 0) and (w.untilAt or infinity) + Z >= Y
        end
        local setMetatable, weakKeys = setmetatable, {
            __mode = "k",
        }
        local v = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
        local function velocityOf(Y, M)
            if Y.moving then
                return Y.dx * Y.speed, Y.dz * Y.speed
            end
            local Z, n = Y.cx, Y.cz
            if not (Z and n) then
                return 0, 0
            end
            local f = v[Y]
            if not f then
                v[Y] = {
                    x = Z,
                    z = n,
                    t = M,
                    vx = 0,
                    vz = 0,
                }
                return 0, 0
            end
            Y = M - f.t
            if Y > 0.011111111111111112 then
                local v, r = (Z - f.x) / Y, (n - f.z) / Y
                if v * v + r * r > 160000 then
                    v, r = 0, 0
                else
                end
                f.vx, f.vz = f.vx * 0.5 + v * 0.5, f.vz * 0.5 + r * 0.5
                f.x = Z
                f.z = n
                f.t = M
            end
            return f.vx, f.vz
        end
        bubbleBoss.velocityOf = velocityOf
        local function Y(v, M, Z, n, f, r, o)
            if not J(v, f, o) then
                return nil
            end
            if v.moving then
                if not (v.ground or abs(Z - v.oy) <= (v.halfH or 6) + r) then
                    return nil
                end
                return j(v, M, n, f)
            end
            o = f - U
            f = o > 0.001
            if f then
                local j, f = velocityOf(v, U)
                if j * j + f * f > 4 then
                    M, n = M - j * o, n - f * o
                else
                end
            else
            end
            o = contextDepthOf(v, M, Z, n, r)
            if o == -infinity then
                return nil
            end
            return o
        end
        local function j(v)
            if v.moving then
                if v.r and (v.bbRound or config.roundMoving ~= false) then
                    return v.r
                end
                if v.halfL and v.halfW then
                    return sqrt(v.halfL * v.halfL + v.halfW * v.halfW)
                end
                return nil
            end
            if v.r then
                return v.r
            end
            if v.ha and v.hb then
                return sqrt(v.ha * v.ha + v.hb * v.hb)
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function v(M, Z)
            local n = M.offset + M.speed * max(Z - M.pathStart, 0)
            n = if M.endAlong and n > M.endAlong then M.endAlong else n
            return if M.bounces and M.freeAhead then min(n, M.freeAhead) else n
        end
        local function depthBound(Z, n, f, r, o)
            if not J(Z, r, o) then
                return infinity
            end
            o = j(Z)
            if not o then
                return nil
            end
            local J, A, k = Z.moving
            if J then
                if not (Z.offset and Z.speed and Z.pathStart and Z.ox and Z.dx) then
                    return nil
                end
                local x = v(Z, r)
                A, k = Z.ox + Z.dx * x, Z.oz + Z.dz * x
            else
                A, k = Z.cx, Z.cz
                if not (A and k) then
                    return nil
                end
                local x = r - U
                local a = x > 0.001
                if a then
                    local a, e = velocityOf(Z, U)
                    if a * a + e * e > 4 then
                        n, f = n - a * x, f - e * x
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            Z, J = n - A, f - k
            r = sqrt(Z * Z + J * J) - o
            if r > 0 then
                return r
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function laneBound(Z, n, f, r, o)
            if not Z.moving then
                return -infinity
            end
            local A = j(Z)
            if not A or not (Z.offset and Z.speed and Z.pathStart and Z.ox and Z.dx) then
                return -infinity
            end
            local j, k = v(Z, r), v(Z, o)
            local v, r, x, a = Z.ox + Z.dx * j, Z.oz + Z.dz * j, Z.dx * (k - j), Z.dz * (k - j)
            o = x * x + a * a
            Z = if o > 1.0E-9 then min(max(((n - v) * x + (f - r) * a) / o, 0), 1) else 0
            o, k = n - (v + x * Z), f - (r + a * Z)
            r = sqrt(o * o + k * k) - A
            if r > 0 then
                return r
            end
            return -infinity
        end
        bubbleBoss.depthBound = depthBound
        bubbleBoss.laneBound = laneBound
        local function shadowMiss(v, Z, n, f, r, o)
            bubbleBoss.shadowBad = (bubbleBoss.shadowBad or 0) + 1
            bubbleBoss.shadowList = bubbleBoss.shadowList or {}
            local A = #bubbleBoss.shadowList < 40
            if A then
                bubbleBoss.shadowList[#bubbleBoss.shadowList + 1] = ("%s at (%.1f, %.1f) +%.2fs full=%s fast=%s primary=%s"):format(
                    v,
                    Z,
                    n,
                    f - U,
                    r,
                    o,
                    tostring(bubbleBoss.primary and bubbleBoss.primary.box and bubbleBoss.primary.box.name or "-")
                )
            end
        end
        bubbleBoss.shadowMiss = shadowMiss
        local function v(Z, n, f, r, o, A)
            local k = Z.from or 0
            if not Z.moving then
                return Y(Z, n, f, r, k, o, 0)
            end
            local x = min(Z.untilAt or k + 2, k + A)
            A = nil
            for index = 0, 6, 1 do
                local e = Y(Z, n, f, r, k + (x - k) * index / 6, o, 0)
                A = if e and (not A or e > A) then e else A
            end
            return A
        end
        local function contextArenaCentre()
            local n = hazardReader.leash
            if not n or not n.enemy then
                return nil
            end
            local root = n.enemy.root
            if not root or not root.Parent then
                return nil
            end
            if context.champMid then
                n = context.champMid()
                if n then
                    return n
                end
            end
            if hazardReader.hub and os.clock() - (hazardReader.hubAt or 0) < 20 then
                return hazardReader.hub
            end
            return root.Position
        end
        local function n(f, r, o, A)
            local k, x, a, e = r - f[1], o - f[2], f[3], f[4]
            r, o = k * a + x * e, -k * e + x * a
            return abs(r) <= f[5] + A and abs(o) <= f[6] + A
        end
        context.entryBoxDepth = function(f, r)
            if not hazardReader.leash then
                return nil
            end
            local o = config.champEntryBoxes
                or config.champEntryBox and {
                    config.champEntryBox,
                }
                or nil
            if not o then
                return nil
            end
            local A
            for index = 1, #o, 1 do
                local x = o[index]
                local o, a = f - x[1], r - x[2]
                local f, r = o * x[3] + a * x[4], -o * x[4] + a * x[3]
                index, o = x[5] - abs(f), x[6] - abs(r)
                if index > 0 and o > 0 then
                    a = min(index, o)
                    A = if not A or a > A then a else A
                else
                end
            end
            return A
        end
        context.inEntryBox = function(f, r, o)
            if not hazardReader.leash then
                return false
            end
            o = o or 0
            local A = config.champEntryBoxes
            if A then
                for index = 1, #A, 1 do
                    if n(A[index], f, r, o) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            A = config.champEntryBox
            return A ~= nil and n(A, f, r, o)
        end
        local n, f, r = false
        local o, A = false
        local k, x, a, fanSweep, N, I, F = false
        local function contextArenaOf(g, i)
            local b, B = hazardReader.leash, contextArenaCentre()
            if not B then
                return false, nil, nil, nil
            end
            local G = (b.radius or 122) - (config.arenaEdge or 32)
            if G <= 0 then
                return false, nil, nil, nil
            end
            local z = min(config.hubKeepOut or 45, G - 20)
            z = if r and r > z then min(r, G - 4) else z
            local s, T = g - B.X, i - B.Z
            B = sqrt(s * s + T * T)
            if b.enemy and b.enemy.root and b.enemy.root.Parent then
                s = b.enemy.root.Position
                local W, K = g - s.X, i - s.Z
                if sqrt(W * W + K * K) > (b.radius or 122) - (config.leashMargin or 8) then
                    return true, B, z, G
                end
            end
            if B > G then
                return true, B, z, G
            end
            if z > 0 and B < z then
                return true, B, z, G
            end
            T = config.champEntryBox
            if T then
                s = n and context.inEntryBox(g, i, 3)
                if s then
                    return true, B, z, G
                end
                b = f
                if b then
                    local b = context.entryBoxDepth(g, i)
                    local s = b and b > f - 2
                    if s then
                        return true, B, z, G
                    end
                end
            else
                local b = o and hazardReader.champEntry
                if b then
                    local b, s = g - hazardReader.champEntry.X, i - hazardReader.champEntry.Z
                    if sqrt(b * b + s * s) < (config.entranceKeepOut or 45) then
                        return true, B, z, G
                    end
                end
            end
            return false, B, z, G
        end
        context.outsideArena = function(g, i)
            return (contextArenaOf(g, i))
        end
        context.arenaOf = contextArenaOf
        context.arenaCentre = contextArenaCentre
        context.champFanDue = function(fanDueT)
            fanDueT = fanDueT or os.clock()
            if hazardReader.fanDueT and fanDueT - hazardReader.fanDueT < 0.05 then
                return hazardReader.fanDueV
            end
            local fanDueV = false
            if hazardReader.fanBeamAt and fanDueT - hazardReader.fanBeamAt < (config.champFanTail or 1) then
                fanDueV = true
            else
                if hazardReader.hopUpAt and fanDueT - hazardReader.hopUpAt < (config.champFanAfterHop or 1.5) then
                    fanDueV = true
                else
                    local b = config.champFanFromSlam == true and hazardReader.lastSlamAt or nil
                    if b and not (hazardReader.hopUpAt and hazardReader.hopUpAt > b) then
                        local B = b
                            + (
                                context.PB and context.PB.hopDelay and context.PB.hopDelay()
                                or config.champHopDelay
                                or 16
                            )
                        fanDueV = fanDueT >= B - (config.champFanLead or 2.5)
                            and fanDueT <= B + (config.champFanLate or 4)
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            hazardReader.fanDueT = fanDueT
            hazardReader.fanDueV = fanDueV
            return fanDueV
        end
        context.champMid = function()
            if config.champMidKeep == false then
                return nil
            end
            if config.champMidTimed ~= false and not context.champFanDue(os.clock()) then
                return nil
            end
            local champMidPart = hazardReader.leash
            if
                not (
                    champMidPart
                    and champMidPart.enemy
                    and champMidPart.enemy.root
                    and champMidPart.enemy.root.Parent
                )
            then
                return nil
            end
            champMidPart = hazardReader.champMidPart
            if not (champMidPart and champMidPart.Parent) then
                local champMidLook = os.clock()
                if champMidLook - (hazardReader.champMidLook or -infinity) > 5 then
                    hazardReader.champMidLook = champMidLook
                    champMidPart = parent:FindFirstChild("firstBossMiddlePart")
                    hazardReader.champMidPart = champMidPart
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local champMidLast = champMidPart and champMidPart.Parent and champMidPart.Position
                or hazardReader.hub
                or hazardReader.champMidLast
            if not champMidLast then
                return nil
            end
            hazardReader.champMidLast = champMidLast
            return champMidLast, (context.fanFloorRaw and context.fanFloorRaw() or 78) + (config.champMidPad or 6)
        end
        context.champInside = function(g, i)
            local vector, B = context.champMid()
            if not vector then
                return false
            end
            local G, z = g - vector.X, i - vector.Z
            return G * G + z * z < B * B
        end
        context.champRingPoint = function(vector, i)
            local vector2, B = context.champMid()
            if not (vector2 and vector) then
                return vector, false
            end
            local G, z = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
            local s = sqrt(G * G + z * z)
            if s >= B then
                return vector, false
            end
            if s < 2 and i then
                G, z = i.X - vector2.X, i.Z - vector2.Z
                s = sqrt(G * G + z * z)
            else
            end
            if s < 0.5 then
                G, z, s = 1, 0, 1
            else
            end
            i = B + (config.champMidRing or 2)
            return Vector3.new(vector2.X + G / s * i, vector.Y, vector2.Z + z / s * i), true
        end
        context.champRingStep = function(g, vector)
            local vector2, B = context.champMid()
            if not (vector2 and g and vector) then
                return nil
            end
            local G, z = vector.X - g.X, vector.Z - g.Z
            local s = G * G + z * z
            local T = if s > 0.01
                then math.clamp(((vector2.X - g.X) * G + (vector2.Z - g.Z) * z) / s, 0, 1)
                else 0
            local W, K = g.X + G * T - vector2.X, g.Z + z * T - vector2.Z
            if W * W + K * K >= B * B then
                return nil
            end
            W, G, K, z =
                atan2(g.Z - vector2.Z, g.X - vector2.X),
                vector.X - vector2.X,
                vector.Z - vector2.Z,
                config.champMidAimR or 20
            s, g =
                ((G * G + K * K >= z * z and atan2(K, G) or W) - W + 3.141592653589793)
                        % 6.283185307179586
                    - 3.141592653589793,
                toRadians(config.champMidStepDeg or 20)
            s = if s > g then g else if s < -g then -g else s
            K = B + (config.champMidRing or 2)
            return Vector3.new(vector2.X + cos(W + s) * K, vector.Y, vector2.Z + sin(W + s) * K)
        end
        local function g(i, b, B)
            return i.slim and min(b, i.slim + (B or 0)) or b
        end
        local function i(b, B, G)
            local z = g(b, B, G)
            if b.tight then
                return z
            end
            return max(z, config.bubbleBreachFloor or 3.5)
        end
        local function b(zone, G, z)
            if zone.moving then
                local s, T = G - zone.ox, z - zone.oz
                local W = -s * zone.dz + T * zone.dx >= 0 and 1 or -1
                return -zone.dz * W, zone.dx * W
            end
            local s, T = G - zone.cx, z - zone.cz
            if zone.r then
                z = sqrt(s * s + T * T)
                if z < 0.5 then
                    return 1, 0
                end
                local W, K = s / z, T / z
                if zone.ring and zone.r - z > z - zone.ring then
                    return -W, -K
                end
                return W, K
            end
            local W, K = s * zone.ax + T * zone.az, s * zone.bx + T * zone.bz
            if zone.ha - abs(W) <= zone.hb - abs(K) then
                z = W >= 0 and 1 or -1
                return zone.ax * z, zone.az * z
            end
            G = K >= 0 and 1 or -1
            return zone.bx * G, zone.bz * G
        end
        bubbleBoss.spikeTimeAt = function(B, G, z)
            local line = B.line
            if not (line and line.launch and line.speed and line.speed > 0 and line.ox and line.ux) then
                return nil
            end
            local T, W = G - line.ox, z - line.oz
            G, z, B =
                T * line.ux + W * line.uz,
                abs(-T * line.uz + W * line.ux),
                (line.halfW or 10) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.oldLineMargin or 1.5)
            if z > B or G < -B or G > (line.len or 0) + B then
                return nil
            end
            return line.launch + max(min(G, line.len or G), 0) / line.speed
        end
        bubbleBoss.oldLineAt = function(B, G, z, s, T, W)
            if config.oldLineFirst == false then
                return nil
            end
            local lineBoxes = bubbleBoss.lineBoxes
            if not lineBoxes or #lineBoxes == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local t = (runtimeState.dataPingS or 0.06) + (config.oldLineSlack or 0.15)
            for index = 1, #lineBoxes, 1 do
                local X = lineBoxes[index]
                if (X.untilAt or infinity) > z and not (T and bubbleBoss.spikeTimeAt(X, T, W)) then
                    index = bubbleBoss.spikeTimeAt(X, B, G)
                    if index then
                        local B = ((X.line.halfW or 10) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)) / X.line.speed + t
                        if index + B >= z and index - B <= z + (s or 0) then
                            return X, index
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.oldLineCut = function(B, G, z, s, T, W, K)
            if config.oldLineFirst == false or not (bubbleBoss.lineBoxes and #bubbleBoss.lineBoxes > 0) then
                return T, false
            end
            local t, H, X = max(W or 16, 4), config.oldLineHold or 0.6, 2
            while X <= T do
                if bubbleBoss.oldLineAt(B + z * X, G + s * X, K + X / t, X + 2 > T and H or 0, B, G) then
                    W = X - 2
                    if W >= 3 and not bubbleBoss.oldLineAt(B + z * W, G + s * W, K + W / t, H, B, G) then
                        return W, false
                    end
                    return T, true
                end
                X += 2
            end
            return T, false
        end
        local function B(G)
            if not G.kind and not G.bubbleKeep then
                return 0
            end
            return G.weight or 1
        end
        local function G(z)
            return z.bubbleKeep == true and z.kind == nil
        end
        local z = false
        local function s(T, W, K)
            if not (hazardReader.noGoArmed and hazardReader.noGoZones and contextDepthOf) then
                return false
            end
            for index = 1, #hazardReader.noGoZones, 1 do
                local H = hazardReader.noGoZones[index]
                if H.cx then
                    index = contextDepthOf(H, T, W, K, 2)
                    if index and index >= 0 then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function T(W)
            local K = B(W)
            if K < (config.bubbleMinWeight or 0.25) then
                return 0, K
            end
            local t = W.noGo and z
            if t then
                return 2, math.min(K, config.noGoFleeWeight or 0.35)
            end
            if G(W) then
                return 1, K
            end
            if K >= (config.bubbleHardAt or 1) then
                return 3, K
            end
            return 2, K
        end
        local G, W = {}, 0
        local function K(t)
            t = math.clamp(math.floor(t or 24), 8, 48)
            local H = W
            if t == H then
                return
            end
            W = t
            for index = #G, 1, -1 do
                G[index] = nil
            end
            for index2 = 0, t - 1, 1 do
                G[index2 + 1] = index2 * (360 / t)
            end
        end
        K(24)
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
        bubbleBoss.slamBlend = function(t, vector, X)
            if config.slamBlend == false then
                return nil
            end
            local dF = runtimeState.reflex
            if not (dF and dF.name == "slam" and dF.from and dF.radius) or t > (dF.untilAt or 0) then
                return nil
            end
            local QF, LF = vector.X, vector.Z
            if X and X.point and not X.soft then
                local OF, SF = X.point.X - dF.from.X, X.point.Z - dF.from.Z
                if OF * OF + SF * SF >= dF.radius * dF.radius then
                    return nil
                end
            end
            local OF, SF = QF - dF.from.X, LF - dF.from.Z
            local DF, PF = sqrt(OF * OF + SF * SF), dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8
            local _F, lF = dF.radius - DF, dangerGeometry.boxes or {}
            for index = 1, #lF, 1 do
                X = lF[index]
                if X.name == "firstbossjumpslam" and X.r and X.cx and not X.moving then
                    local cF, uF = QF - X.cx, LF - X.cz
                    _F = X.r + PF + (config.slamBlendSpare or 2) - sqrt(cF * cF + uF * uF)
                    break
                end
            end
            if _F <= 0 then
                return nil
            end
            lF, X = nil
            if dF.dir and (dF.dir.X ~= 0 or dF.dir.Z ~= 0) then
                lF, X = dF.dir.X, dF.dir.Z
            else
                if DF > 0.5 then
                    lF, X = OF / DF, SF / DF
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end
            local cF, uF, hF, mF, RF = bubbleBoss.threats or {}, 0, 0, 0
            for index2 = 1, #cF, 1 do
                DF = cF[index2]
                index2 = DF.box
                if
                    index2
                    and (DF.hard or DF.rank == 1)
                    and not string.lower(tostring(index2.name or "")):find("slam", 1, true)
                then
                    SF, OF = b(index2, QF, LF)
                    local qF = (DF.hard and 1 or (config.slamBlendWarm or 0.5)) * (max(DF.depth or 0, 0) + PF + 1)
                    uF += SF * qF
                    hF += OF * qF
                    mF += 1
                    RF = RF or tostring(index2.name or "?")
                else
                end
            end
            if mF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            DF, OF = lF * _F + uF, X * _F + hF
            if sqrt(DF * DF + OF * OF) < (config.slamBlendMin or 0.35) * max(_F, sqrt(uF * uF + hF * hF)) then
                return nil
            end
            local uF, hF, yF, qF =
                atan2(OF, DF),
                atan2(X, lF),
                config.slamBurstMax or config.burstMax or 28,
                dF.startedAt and not dF.pre and (config.slamLandAt or 1.98) - (t - dF.startedAt) or infinity
            for index3 = 0, 12, 1 do
                SF, cF, DF =
                    cos(uF), sin(uF), abs((uF - hF + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793)
                if index3 > 0 and DF < toRadians(1) then
                    return nil
                end
                PF = SF * lF + cF * X
                if PF > 0.05 and (qF == infinity or _F / PF / yF <= qF - (runtimeState.dataPingS or 0.06)) then
                    OF = parent:Raycast(vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(SF, 0, cF) * 40, raycastParams)
                    t = OF and OF.Distance or 40
                    if t >= 8 then
                        dF = min(config.slamBlendStep or 14, t - 3)
                        local t = Vector3.new(QF + SF * dF, vector.Y, LF + cF * dF)
                        if not (bubbleBoss.pathBlocked and bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, t, yF)) then
                            local H, X = mF + 1, math.floor(toDegrees(DF) + 0.5)
                            return t,
                                ("SLAM + %s: both at once - %d ways out added up, %d deg off the slam's%s, %.0f to go"):format(
                                    RF,
                                    H,
                                    X,
                                    index3 > 0 and (" (turned %d deg toward it)"):format(index3 * 15) or "",
                                    _F
                                )
                        end
                    end
                end
                index3 = (hF - uF + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793
                if abs(index3) < 0.001 then
                    return nil
                end
                uF += if index3 > toRadians(15)
                    then toRadians(15)
                    else if index3 < -toRadians(15) then -toRadians(15) else index3
            end
            return nil
        end
        local t, H, X
        local dF = {}
        local function QF()
            if not bubbleBoss.folder or not bubbleBoss.folder.Parent then
                local dqBubble = Instance.new("Folder")
                dqBubble.Name = "DQBubble"
                dqBubble.Parent = parent
                bubbleBoss.folder = dqBubble
            end
            return bubbleBoss.folder
        end
        local function LF(OF)
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Anchored = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.CanQuery = false
            part.CanTouch = false
            part.CastShadow = false
            part.Material, part.Shape = Enum.Material.Neon, OF or Enum.PartType.Block
            part.Parent = QF()
            return part
        end
        local function QF(OF)
            for index = OF, #dF, 1 do
                local OF = dF[index]
                if OF and OF.Parent then
                    OF.Transparency = 1
                end
            end
        end
        local function OF()
            local SF = t
            if SF then
                t:Destroy()
                t = nil
            end
            SF = H
            if SF then
                H:Destroy()
                H = nil
            end
            SF = X
            if SF then
                X:Destroy()
                X = nil
            end
            QF(1)
        end
        local function SF(vector, PF, _F)
            if context.NOVIS or not config.drawBubble or config.visuals == false then
                OF()
