                return
            end
            local lF = not t or not t.Parent
            if lF then
                t = LF(Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            end
            lF = not H or not H.Parent
            if lF then
                H = LF(Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            end
            local color, transparency =
                bubbleBoss.active and (bubbleBoss.lethal and Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(
                    255,
                    190,
                    60
                )) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 230, 130),
                t
            transparency.Size = Vector3.new(0.25, PF * 2, PF * 2)
            lF = t
            lF.CFrame = CFrame.new(vector.X, vector.Y - _F + 0.2, vector.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, toRadians(90))
            local hF, mF, transparency2 = t, t, bubbleBoss.active and 0.35 or 0.6
            hF.Color = color
            mF.Transparency = transparency2
            mF = H
            mF.Size = Vector3.new(5, PF * 2, PF * 2)
            hF = H
            hF.CFrame = CFrame.new(vector.X, vector.Y - _F + 2.5, vector.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, toRadians(90))
            hF, transparency2, transparency = H, H, bubbleBoss.active and 0.82 or 0.9
            hF.Color = color
            transparency2.Transparency = transparency
            color = bubbleBoss.primary
            hF = color and color.box
            if hF then
                PF = not X or not X.Parent
                if PF then
                    X = LF()
                end
                transparency = color.box
                transparency2, mF =
                    transparency.moving and transparency.ox or transparency.cx,
                    transparency.moving and transparency.oz or transparency.cz
                local t, H = transparency2 - vector.X, mF - vector.Z
                local PF, cF = max(sqrt(t * t + H * H), 0.5), X
                cF.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, PF)
                cF = X
                cF.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                    Vector3.new(vector.X + t * 0.5, vector.Y - _F + 1.2, vector.Z + H * 0.5),
                    Vector3.new(transparency2, vector.Y - _F + 1.2, mF)
                )
                cF, lF = X, X
                cF.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40)
                lF.Transparency = 0.25
            else
                local t = X
                if t then
                    X:Destroy()
                    X = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function t(H, X, DF)
            if
                context.NOVIS
                or not config.drawBubble
                or config.visuals == false
                or (config.bubbleTrajLead or 0) <= 0
            then
                QF(1)
                return
            end
            local PF, _F = min(X, 24), 0
            for index = 1, PF, 1 do
                X = H[index]
                local cF, uF, hF, mF = X.cx, X.cz, false, X.moving
                if mF then
                    hF = (X.from or 0) > U
                    local RF, speed, qF = X.offset or 0, X.speed, U
                    index = RF + speed * max(qF - (X.pathStart or U), 0)
                    cF, uF = X.ox + X.dx * index, X.oz + X.dz * index
                else
                end
                if cF then
                    local lF, RF = velocityOf(X, U)
                    mF = sqrt(lF * lF + RF * RF)
                    if mF > 2 and not X.noLane then
                        local yF = mF * config.bubbleTrajLead
                        _F += 1
                        local qF = dF[_F]
                        if not qF or not qF.Parent then
                            qF = LF()
                            dF[_F] = qF
                        else
                        end
                        local VF = X.halfW and (X.halfW - (X.pad or 0)) * 2
                            or (X.slim and max(X.slim * 2, 4) or 6)
                        qF.Size = Vector3.new(min(max(VF, 2), 40), 0.3, yF)
                        VF = Vector3.new(cF + lF / mF * yF * 0.5, DF, uF + RF / mF * yF * 0.5)
                        qF.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(VF, VF + Vector3.new(lF / mF, 0, RF / mF))
                        qF.Color = hF and Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40)
                        qF.Transparency = hF and 0.8 or 0.72
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if config.drawBlueBeams ~= false and bubbleBoss.blueBeams then
                H = bubbleBoss.blueBeams()
                for index2 = 1, #H, 1 do
                    if _F >= 80 then
                        break
                    end
                    PF = H[index2]
                    index2 = max(PF.dL or PF.L, 0.5)
                    if PF.cone then
                        local H, lF = math.atan(PF.cone), config.orbConeStrips or 7
                        for index3 = 0, lF - 1, 1 do
                            if _F >= 80 then
                                break
                            end
                            local uF = -H + 2 * H * index3 / max(lF - 1, 1)
                            local H, lF = math.cos(uF), math.sin(uF)
                            uF, index3 = PF.ux * H - PF.uz * lF, PF.ux * lF + PF.uz * H
                            _F += 1
                            lF = dF[_F]
                            if not lF or not lF.Parent then
                                lF = LF()
                                dF[_F] = lF
                            else
                            end
                            lF.Size = Vector3.new(max(PF.vw * 2, 2), 0.3, index2)
                            H = Vector3.new(PF.ox + uF * index2 * 0.5, DF, PF.oz + index3 * index2 * 0.5)
                            lF.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(H, H + Vector3.new(uF, 0, index3))
                            lF.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90)
                            lF.Transparency = 0.82
                        end
                    else
                        _F += 1
                        local H = dF[_F]
                        if not H or not H.Parent then
                            H = LF()
                            dF[_F] = H
                        else
                        end
                        H.Size = Vector3.new(max(PF.vw * 2, 2), 0.3, index2)
                        local LF = Vector3.new(PF.ox + PF.ux * index2 * 0.5, DF, PF.oz + PF.uz * index2 * 0.5)
                        H.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(LF, LF + Vector3.new(PF.ux, 0, PF.uz))
                        H.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90)
                        H.Transparency = 0.7
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            QF(_F + 1)
        end
        bubbleBoss.tick = function(H, point, QF, oscW)
            local prefMidAt = os.clock()
            bubbleBoss.scanNodes = bubbleBoss.scanNodes or {}
            bubbleBoss.softAt = nil
            U = H
            oscW = bubbleBoss.oscW
            if not oscW then
                oscW = {
                    pts = {},
                    at = -infinity,
                }
                bubbleBoss.oscW = oscW
            else
            end
            if H - oscW.at >= 0.15 then
                oscW.at = H
                local pts = oscW.pts
                pts[#pts + 1] = {
                    x = point.X,
                    z = point.Z,
                    t = H,
                }
                while #pts > 0 and H - pts[1].t > (config.oscWindow or 3) do
                    table.remove(pts, 1)
                end
                if config.oscBreak ~= false and #pts >= 10 and not bubbleBoss.osc then
                    local _F, lF, cF = 0
                    local uF, hF, mF = 0, 0, 0
                    for index = 3, #pts, 2 do
                        local yF, qF = pts[index].x - pts[index - 2].x, pts[index].z - pts[index - 2].z
                        index = sqrt(yF * yF + qF * qF)
                        _F += index
                        if index > 1.5 then
                            yF /= index
                            qF /= index
                            uF = if lF and yF * lF + qF * cF < -0.5 then uF + 1 else uF
                            local VF, EF = yF, qF
                            if hF * yF + mF * qF < 0 then
                                yF, qF = -VF, -EF
                            else
                                yF, qF = VF, EF
                            end
                            lF, cF, hF, mF = yF, qF, hF + yF * index, mF + qF * index
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    local lF, cF =
                        sqrt((pts[#pts].x - pts[1].x) ^ 2 + (pts[#pts].z - pts[1].z) ^ 2), sqrt(hF * hF + mF * mF)
                    if
                        uF >= (config.oscFlips or 2)
                        and _F > (config.oscPath or 20)
                        and lF < (config.oscNet or 8)
                        and cF > 1
                    then
                        bubbleBoss.osc = {
                            ax = hF / cF,
                            az = mF / cF,
                            untilAt = H + (config.oscFor or 2.5),
                            at = H,
                        }
                        bubbleBoss.oscCount = (bubbleBoss.oscCount or 0) + 1
                        bubbleBoss.dGoal = nil
                        bubbleBoss.flipDetour = true
                        if context.logT then
                            pcall(
                                context.logT,
                                "bubble",
                                2,
                                "Bubble",
                                ("oscillating: %d flips over %.0f studs for %.0f gained - going another way"):format(
                                    uF,
                                    _F,
                                    lF
                                )
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if bubbleBoss.osc and H >= bubbleBoss.osc.untilAt then
                bubbleBoss.osc = nil
                oscW.pts = {}
            end
            local bubbleRadius = config.bubbleRadius
            local bubbleLookahead = config.bubbleLookahead
            local lF = dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4
            local cF = point.X
            local uF = point.Y
            local hF = point.Z
            local mF, RF, yF = dangerGeometry.boxes or {}, bubbleBoss.lineBoxes or {}, 0
            for index2 = 1, #mF, 1 do
                oscW = mF[index2]
                if oscW.line and oscW.line.launch and oscW.line.speed then
                    yF += 1
                    RF[yF] = oscW
                else
                end
            end
            for index3 = yF + 1, #RF, 1 do
                RF[index3] = nil
            end
            bubbleBoss.lineBoxes = RF
            oscW = bubbleBoss.threats
            for index4 = #oscW, 1, -1 do
                oscW[index4] = nil
            end
            local qF = dangerGeometry.lag or 0
            local rel, EF = bubbleBoss.rel, 0
            local soft, jF = bubbleBoss.soft, 0
            local pend, JF = bubbleBoss.pend, 0
            local mov, YF = bubbleBoss.mov, 0
            local vF = config.bubbleWarnLead or 1.5
            local MF, ZF =
                config.rodinSpiralOneObject ~= false
                    and config.rodinSpiralDodgerOff ~= false
                    and hazardReader.rodinRig ~= nil
                    and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent ~= nil
                    and not (context.colourAttackLive and context.colourAttackLive(H)),
                #mF
            local warnCount, warmCount = 0, 0
            for index5 = 1, ZF, 1 do
                RF = mF[index5]
                local oF, AF = T(RF)
                oF = if MF and oF > 0 and context.isSpiralBox and context.isSpiralBox(RF) then 0 else oF
                if oF > 0 then
                    local kF, xF = RF.moving and RF.ox or RF.cx, RF.moving and RF.oz or RF.cz
                    local depth, eF, NF = kF ~= nil and (kF - cF) ^ 2 + (xF - hF) ^ 2 < 40000, velocityOf(RF, H)
                    if RF.bounces and RF.moving and H - (RF.freeAt or 0) > 0.2 then
                        RF.freeAt = H
                        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                            players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                            bubbleBoss.folder,
                        }
                        xF = parent:Raycast(
                            Vector3.new(RF.ox, RF.oy, RF.oz),
                            Vector3.new(RF.dx, 0, RF.dz) * 260,
                            raycastParams
                        )
                        RF.freeAhead = xF and max(xF.Distance - (RF.halfL or 6), 0) or nil
                    end
                    kF, index5 = i(RF, bubbleRadius, qF), (RF.from or 0) - H
                    xF = RF.warn == true and oF >= 2 and index5 > (config.bubbleLead or 0) and index5 <= vF
                    if depth then
                        if oF == 3 and not xF then
                            EF += 1
                            rel[EF] = RF
                        else
                            if xF then
                                JF += 1
                                pend[JF] = RF
                            else
                                jF += 1
                                soft[jF] = RF
                            end
                        end
                        if (oF == 3 or xF) and not RF.noFlee and (RF.moving or eF * eF + NF * NF > 9) then
                            YF += 1
                            mov[YF] = RF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if xF then
                        depth = v(RF, cF, uF, hF, lF, vF + bubbleLookahead)
                        if depth and depth >= -kF then
                            warnCount += 1
                            local w, i =
                                #oscW + 1, {
                                    box = RF,
                                    w = AF,
                                    hard = false,
                                    rank = 2,
                                    tti = index5,
                                    depth = depth,
                                }
                            i.score, oscW[w] = AF * (1 / (index5 + 0.15)) * (1 + max(depth, 0) / kF), i
                        else
                        end
                    else
                        if oF >= 2 and not RF.noFlee then
                            local hard = RF.moving or eF * eF + NF * NF > 4
                            local i = hard and max(bubbleLookahead, config.bubbleTrajLead or 0) or 0
                            i = if RF.kind == "wall" and i > (config.wallLead or 1.2)
                                then config.wallLead or 1.2
                                else i
                            local rF, tti, depth2 = hard and math.clamp(math.ceil(i / 0.15), 4, 12) or 0
                            for index6 = 0, rF, 1 do
                                hard = rF > 0 and i * index6 / rF or 0
                                index6 = Y(RF, cF, uF, hF, H + hard, lF, config.bubbleLead)
                                if index6 and index6 >= -kF then
                                    tti, depth2 = hard, index6
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if tti then
                                hard = oF == 3
                                warmCount = if not hard then warmCount + 1 else warmCount
                                rF = nil
                                if RF.line and config.oldLineFirst ~= false then
                                    local i = bubbleBoss.spikeTimeAt(RF, cF, hF)
                                    if i then
                                        local oF = ((RF.line.halfW or 10) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8))
                                                / max(RF.line.speed or 80, 1)
                                            + (runtimeState.dataPingS or 0.06)
                                        rF = i + oF >= H and max(i - oF - H, 0) or (config.oldLinePassedTti or 9)
                                    else
                                        rF = tti
                                    end
                                else
                                    rF = tti
                                end
                                local i, oF =
                                    #oscW + 1, {
                                        box = RF,
                                        w = AF,
                                        hard = hard,
                                        rank = hard and 0 or 1,
                                        tti = tti,
                                        depth = depth2,
                                    }
                                oF.score, oscW[i] = AF * (1 / (rF + 0.15)) * (1 + max(depth2, 0) / kF), oF
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            for index7 = EF + 1, #rel, 1 do
                rel[index7] = nil
            end
            for index8 = jF + 1, #soft, 1 do
                soft[index8] = nil
            end
            for index9 = JF + 1, #pend, 1 do
                pend[index9] = nil
            end
            for index10 = YF + 1, #mov, 1 do
                mov[index10] = nil
            end
            local function w(i)
                return i and (i.r or max(i.halfW or 0, i.halfL or 0)) or 0
            end
            local i = config.bubbleOnNow or 0.05
            table.sort(oscW, function(rF, oF)
                if rF.rank ~= oF.rank then
                    return rF.rank < oF.rank
                end
                local AF, kF = (rF.tti or 1) <= i, (oF.tti or 1) <= i
                if AF ~= kF then
                    return AF
                end
                if AF and kF and not (config.oldLineFirst ~= false and rF.box.line and oF.box.line) then
                    local i, AF = w(rF.box), w(oF.box)
                    if abs(i - AF) > (config.bubbleSizeTie or 2) then
                        return i > AF
                    end
                end
                return rF.score > oF.score
            end)
            bubbleBoss.count = #oscW
            bubbleBoss.warmCount = warmCount
            bubbleBoss.warnCount = warnCount
            z = false
            mF = #oscW > 0
            if mF then
                bubbleBoss.lastBreach = H
                if not bubbleBoss.active then
                    ZF = bubbleBoss.dir ~= nil and H - (bubbleBoss.dirAt or 0) < (config.bubbleDirMemory or 5)
                    bubbleBoss.active, bubbleBoss.escapes = true, bubbleBoss.escapes + 1
                    if ZF then
                        bubbleBoss.dirAt = H
                    else
                        bubbleBoss.dir = nil
                        bubbleBoss.anchor = nil
                    end
                end
                bubbleBoss.primary = oscW[1]
                bubbleBoss.lethal = oscW[1].hard
                if bubbleBoss.lethal then
                    bubbleBoss.lethalAt = H
                end
                RF = config.noGoSlamFree ~= false
                    and (
                        runtimeState.reflex ~= nil and runtimeState.reflex.name == "slam"
                        or runtimeState.tellRun ~= nil
                    )
                RF = bubbleBoss.lethal == true or RF
                z = RF and not (bubbleBoss.primary.box ~= nil and bubbleBoss.primary.box.noGo == true)
            elseif bubbleBoss.active then
                bubbleBoss.primary = nil
                bubbleBoss.lethal = false
                bubbleBoss.goal = nil
                if H - bubbleBoss.lastBreach > config.bubbleSettle then
                    bubbleBoss.active = false
                    bubbleBoss.dir = nil
                    bubbleBoss.anchor = nil
                end
            end
            SF(point, bubbleRadius, dangerGeometry.feet or 3)
            t(mov, YF, uF - (dangerGeometry.feet or 3) + 0.3)
            local w = false
            if config.bobOrbSolid ~= false and hazardReader.orbScan then
                ZF, MF, RF = bubbleBoss.bobOrbs or {}, {}, 0
                for index11, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.orbScan) do
                    mF = entry.part
                    if mF and mF.Parent and not MF[mF] then
                        MF[mF] = true
                        index11 = mF.Position
                        if (index11.X - cF) ^ 2 + (index11.Z - hF) ^ 2 < (config.bobOrbNear or 90) ^ 2 then
                            local t = hazardReader.parts[mF]
                            RF += 1
                            local SF = ZF[RF] or {}
                            ZF[RF] = SF
                            SF.x, SF.z = index11.X, index11.Z
                            SF.vx, SF.vz = t and t.vx or 0, t and t.vz or 0
                            SF.homing = t == nil or t.owner == nil or t.owner == "me" or entry.mine == true
                            SF.colour = string.lower(mF.Name):match("secondboss(%a+)orb")
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                for index12 = RF + 1, #ZF, 1 do
                    ZF[index12] = nil
                end
                w = RF > 0
                bubbleBoss.bobOrbs = ZF
            else
            end
            local i = config.bubbleLead or 0.35
            local function z(t, SF, rF, oF)
                local AF, kF = infinity
                for index13 = 1, EF + JF, 1 do
                    local aF = index13 <= EF and rel[index13] or pend[index13 - EF]
                    if not (oF and oF[aF]) then
                        index13 = Y(aF, t, uF, SF, rF, lF, i)
                        if index13 then
                            local t = -index13 - g(aF, bubbleRadius, qF)
                            if t < AF then
                                AF, kF = t, aF
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return AF, kF
            end
            local function t(SF, rF, oF, AF, kF)
                local xF = max(oF - H, 0)
                if z(SF, rF, oF, AF) <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                if kF then
                    return true
                end
                if z(SF, rF, H + xF * (config.stepInSlow or 1.1) + (config.stepInPad or 0.15) + qF, AF) <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                if xF > 0.1 and z(SF, rF, H + xF * (config.stepInFast or 0.9), AF) <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            local function SF(rF, oF, AF, kF, xF, aF, eF, NF)
                local IF, FF = AF - rF, kF - oF
                AF = sqrt(IF * IF + FF * FF)
                kF = max(1, math.ceil(AF / (config.stepInStep or 1.5)))
                for index13 = 1, kF, 1 do
                    local gF = index13 / kF
                    if not t(rF + IF * gF, oF + FF * gF, xF + AF * gF / aF, eF, NF) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local function rF(oF, AF, kF)
                local xF = config.arriveHold or 1
                return z(oF, AF, kF + xF * 0.5) > 0 and z(oF, AF, kF + xF) > 0
            end
            local function oF(AF, kF, xF, aF)
                local eF, NF, IF = config.stepInWays or 12, config.stepInExitMax or 26, config.stepInStep or 1.5
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                    players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                    bubbleBoss.folder,
                }
                local FF, CF, gF = Vector3.new(AF, uF + 2, kF), infinity
                for index13 = 0, eF - 1, 1 do
                    local bF = index13 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / eF
                    local eF, BF = cos(bF), sin(bF)
                    index13 = parent:Raycast(FF, Vector3.new(eF, 0, BF) * (NF + 2), raycastParams)
                    local FF, bF = min(NF, index13 and index13.Distance - (config.wallClear or 5) or NF), IF
                    while bF <= FF and bF < CF do
                        local NF, FF, iF = AF + eF * bF, kF + BF * bF, xF + bF / aF
                        if not t(NF, FF, iF) then
                            break
                        end
                        if rF(NF, FF, iF) then
                            if
                                config.ledgeGuard == false
                                or parent:Raycast(
                                    Vector3.new(NF, uF + 3, FF),
                                    Vector3.new(0, -(3 + (config.ledgeDrop or 7)), 0),
                                    raycastParams
                                )
                            then
                                gF, CF = Vector3.new(NF, uF, FF), bF
                            else
                            end
                            break
                        end
                        bF += IF
                    end
                end
                return gF, CF
            end
            local t = {}
            for index14 = 1, EF + JF, 1 do
                mF = index14 <= EF and rel[index14] or pend[index14 - EF]
                MF = Y(mF, cF, uF, hF, H, lF, i)
                if MF and MF >= -g(mF, bubbleRadius, qF) then
                    t[mF] = true
                end
            end
            local function point2(AF, kF, dist, aF)
                local eF, NF, IF = cF + AF * dist, hF + kF * dist, H + dist / aF
                if not SF(cF, hF, eF, NF, H, aF, t) then
                    return nil
                end
                local FF, CF, gF = IF
                while FF <= IF + (config.stepInLook or 3) do
                    local iF, bF = z(eF, NF, FF)
                    if iF <= 0 then
                        CF, gF = FF, bF
                        break
                    end
                    FF += 0.05
                end
                if not CF then
                    return nil
                end
                local exit, exitD = oF(eF, NF, IF, aF)
                if not exit then
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    dx = AF,
                    dz = kF,
                    dist = dist,
                    q = Vector3.new(eF, uF, NF),
                    exit = exit,
                    exitD = exitD,
                    tBad = CF,
                    onB = gF,
                    depth = max(-z(eF, NF, CF), 0),
                    slack = CF - (IF + exitD / aF),
                }
            end
            mF = bubbleBoss.stepIn

                        else
                        end

                                point = mF.exit,

                                burst = mF.speed,

                                    tostring(mF.name),

                                    max(mF.tBad - H, 0)

                    end
                end

                return nil

                if not AF or not vector then
                    return nil

                    return nil

            end
            local function xF(aF, eF)
                bubbleBoss.goal = nil

                    bubbleBoss.primary and bubbleBoss.primary.box and bubbleBoss.primary.box.name or "warning"

            bubbleBoss.cmH = nil
            bubbleBoss.cmF = nil
            if context.champMid then
                bubbleBoss.cmH, bubbleBoss.cmF = context.champMid()

            local aF, aF = contextArenaOf(cF, hF)
            r = nil
            RF = hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and H < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1 and aF and hazardReader.hub

                r = min(aF - (config.fanInSlack or 4), (config.fanRadius or 108) - 6)
            end
            o = false
            RF = hazardReader.champEntry
            if RF then

            end
            n = config.champEntryBox ~= nil and not context.inEntryBox(cF, hF, 0)

            a = nil

            MF, mF = (ZF and ZF.box and tostring(ZF.box.name or "") or ""):lower(), true
            if config.seekSideSolo ~= false then

                end
            else

            bubbleBoss.seekSolo = mF
            RF = mF and (MF:find("big spike", 1, true) or MF:find("bigspike", 1, true))
            if RF then

                            z = r / n,
                        }
                    end
                end
            else

                                x = f / n,
                                z = r / n,
                            }

                                else

            fanSweep = nil

                and mF.box

                        if
                            wall.cx
                            and sqrt((wall.cx - cF) ^ 2 + (wall.cz - hF) ^ 2)
                                < (config.wallNear or 30)
                        then
                            n = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                local f = RF and ZF > 0.5 and not n
                if f then
                    A, k =
                        {
                            x = (RF.cx - cF) / ZF,
                            z = (RF.cz - hF) / ZF,
                        }, true
                end
                f = RF and not n and config.spikeSafeSide ~= false and bubbleBoss.spikeSide
                if f then
                    local success2, f = pcall(bubbleBoss.spikeSide, H, point, RF, speed)
                    local r = success2 and f
                    if r then
                        A, k =
                            {
                                x = -f.ux,
                                z = -f.uz,
                            }, true
                    end
                end
            end
            ZF = not A and context.PB and (context.PB.phase == "spikes" or context.PB.phase == "spikes-due")
            MF = ZF
                and context.BR
                and context.BR.target
                and context.BR.target.isBoss
                and context.BR.target.root
                and context.BR.target.root.Parent
                and not (context.bobLine and context.bobLine())
                and not (config.spikeLeadFree ~= false and hazardReader.orbLead and hazardReader.orbLead.goal)
            if MF then
                mF = context.BR.target.root.Position
                ZF, RF = mF.X - cF, mF.Z - hF
                local n = sqrt(ZF * ZF + RF * RF)
                local f = n > 1
                if f then
                    A = {
                        x = ZF / n,
                        z = RF / n,
                    }
                end
                n = A and hazardReader.walls
                if n then
                    local iteratePairs, walls = pairs, hazardReader.walls
                    for key4, wall2 in iteratePairs(walls) do
                        key4 = wall2.cx
                            and sqrt((wall2.cx - cF) ^ 2 + (wall2.cz - hF) ^ 2)
                                < (config.wallNear or 30)
                        if key4 then
                            A = nil
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local n = {}
            local function f(primary)
                if not primary.stillSeek then
                    return false
                end
                primary = bubbleBoss.primary
                return primary ~= nil
                    and primary.box ~= nil
                    and string.lower(tostring(primary.box.name or "")):find("seeking", 1, true)
                        ~= nil
            end
            local r = bubbleBoss.primary ~= nil
                and bubbleBoss.primary.box ~= nil
                and tostring(bubbleBoss.primary.box.name or ""):lower():find("spike", 1, true)
                    ~= nil
            local function o(eF, NF, IF)
                local FF, CF, bubbleLead, iF, bF =
                    -infinity, -infinity, config.bubbleLead, bubbleBoss.beamWhite, infinity
                for index13 = 1, EF, 1 do
                    local GF = rel[index13]
                    index13 = not (GF.stillSeek and f(GF)) and Y(GF, eF, uF, NF, IF, lF, bubbleLead) or nil
                    if index13 then
                        local zF = -index13 - g(GF, bubbleRadius, qF)
                        bF, FF = if zF < bF then zF else bF, if index13 > FF then index13 else FF
                        zF = n[GF]
                        local sF = index13 > CF
                            and (
                                not zF
                                or config.bubbleDeeperCut ~= false
                                    and index13 > zF + (config.bubbleDeeperBy or 3)
                            )
                        CF = if sF and not (iF and iF[GF]) then index13 else CF
                    else
                    end
                end
                for index19 = 1, YF, 1 do
                    IF = mov[index19]
                    if IF.laneHard then
                        iF, index19 = g(IF, bubbleRadius, qF), config.bubbleTrajLead or 1.2
                        index19 = if r then max(index19, config.spikeWallLead or 3) else index19
                        local GF = config.laneStepT or 0.2
                        local zF = math.max(4, math.ceil(index19 / GF))
                        for index20 = 1, zF, 1 do
                            GF = index19 * index20 / zF
                            index20 = Y(IF, eF, uF, NF, H + GF, lF, (config.bubbleLead or 0) + GF)
                            if index20 and index20 >= -iF then
                                local BF = -index20 - iF
                                bF, FF = if BF < bF then BF else bF, if index20 > FF then index20 else FF
                                BF = index20 > CF
                                    and (
                                        not n[IF]
                                        or config.bubbleDeeperCut ~= false
                                            and index20 > n[IF] + (config.bubbleDeeperBy or 3)
                                    )
                                CF = if BF then index20 else CF
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                IF = bubbleBoss.liveNow
                for index21 = 1, bubbleBoss.liveNowN or 0, 1 do
                    iF = Y(IF[index21], eF, uF, NF, H, lF, bubbleLead)
                    CF = if iF and iF >= 0 and iF > CF then iF else CF
                end
                return bF, FF, CF
            end
            local function eF(NF, IF, FF)
                local CF, gF, bubbleLead, bF = -infinity, -infinity, config.bubbleLead, bubbleBoss.beamWhite
                local BF = infinity
                for index13 = 1, EF, 1 do
                    local zF = rel[index13]
                    if not (zF.stillSeek and f(zF)) then
                        index13 = depthBound(zF, NF, IF, FF, bubbleLead)
                        if
                            not (
                                index13
                                and -index13 <= CF
                                and -index13 <= gF
                                and index13 - g(zF, bubbleRadius, qF) >= BF
                            )
                        then
                            local f = Y(zF, NF, uF, IF, FF, lF, bubbleLead)
                            if f then
                                local GF = -f - g(zF, bubbleRadius, qF)
                                BF, CF = if GF < BF then GF else BF, if f > CF then f else CF
                                GF = n[zF]
                                local sF = f > gF
                                    and (
                                        not GF
                                        or config.bubbleDeeperCut ~= false
                                            and f > GF + (config.bubbleDeeperBy or 3)
                                    )
                                gF = if sF and not (bF and bF[zF]) then f else gF
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                for index19 = 1, YF, 1 do
                    bF = mov[index19]
                    if bF.laneHard then
                        FF, index19 = g(bF, bubbleRadius, qF), config.bubbleTrajLead or 1.2
                        index19 = if r then max(index19, config.spikeWallLead or 3) else index19
                        local GF = config.laneStepT or 0.2
                        local zF = math.max(4, math.ceil(index19 / GF))
                        if not (laneBound(bF, NF, IF, H + index19 / zF, H + index19) > FF) then
                            for index20 = 1, zF, 1 do
                                GF = index19 * index20 / zF
                                index20 = Y(bF, NF, uF, IF, H + GF, lF, (config.bubbleLead or 0) + GF)
                                if index20 and index20 >= -FF then
                                    local f = -index20 - FF
                                    BF, CF = if f < BF then f else BF, if index20 > CF then index20 else CF
                                    f = index20 > gF
                                        and (
                                            not n[bF]
                                            or config.bubbleDeeperCut ~= false
                                                and index20 > n[bF] + (config.bubbleDeeperBy or 3)
                                        )
                                    gF = if f then index20 else gF
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                bF = bubbleBoss.liveNow
                for index21 = 1, bubbleBoss.liveNowN or 0, 1 do
                    FF = bF[index21]
                    if not depthBound(FF, NF, IF, H, bubbleLead) then
                        index21 = Y(FF, NF, uF, IF, H, lF, bubbleLead)
                        gF = if index21 and index21 >= 0 and index21 > gF then index21 else gF
                    else
                    end
                end
                return BF, CF, gF
            end
            local function fitsAt(NF, IF, FF)
                local CF, gF, iF, bF = false
                if hazardReader.leash then
                    CF, gF, iF, bF = contextArenaOf(NF, IF)
                else
                end
                local BF = F
                if BF then
                    local missileAxis = hazardReader.missileAxis
                    local zF, sF =
                        abs((NF - missileAxis.ox) * -missileAxis.dz + (IF - missileAxis.oz) * missileAxis.dx), F
                    if zF > sF then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                BF = a
                if BF then
                    local F = abs((NF - cF) * a.x + (IF - hF) * a.z)
                    if F > (config.seekAlongMax or 8) then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                BF = fanSweep
                if BF then
                    local a, F = cF - N, hF - I
                    local N = sqrt(a * a + F * F)
                    local I, GF = N > 5
                    if I then
                        local fanSweep3 = fanSweep
                        GF = fanSweep3 * (F * (NF - cF) - a * (IF - hF)) / N > (config.sweepAheadSlack or 3)
                    else
                        GF = I
                    end
                    if GF then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                BF = x
                if BF then
                    local a, e = NF - x.x, IF - x.z
                    local N, I = sqrt(a * a + e * e), x.d - (config.spreadOutSlack or 3)
                    if N < I then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                BF = A
                if BF then
                    local x, a = NF - cF, IF - hF
                    local e = sqrt(x * x + a * a)
                    local N, I = e > 3
                    if N then
                        local F, GF = x * A.x, a * A.z
                        local x, a = (F + GF) / e, k and (config.spikeOnUsCos or 0.94)
                        I = x > -(a or (config.spikeAxisCos or 0.8))
                    else
                        I = N
                    end
                    if I then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                if CF and not (r and hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil and config.spikeLeadArenaFree ~= false) then
                    local x, a = config.arenaSlack or 8, r and (config.spikeArenaSlack or 14)
                    BF = x + (a or 0)
                    x = bF and bF + BF or nil
                    if x and gF ~= nil and gF > x and (aF == nil or aF <= x) then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                    if aF ~= nil and iF ~= nil and bF ~= nil then
                        x = aF > bF and aF - bF or aF < iF and iF - aF or 0
                        if (gF > bF and gF - bF or gF < iF and iF - gF or 0) > x + BF then
                            return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                        end
                    elseif aF == nil then
                        return -infinity, infinity, infinity
                    end
                end
                BF = config.bbFast
                BF = if BF == nil then true else BF
                if BF == true then
                    return eF(NF, IF, FF)
                end
                local x, a, e = o(NF, IF, FF)
                if BF == "shadow" then
                    local o, N, I = eF(NF, IF, FF)
                    bubbleBoss.shadowN = (bubbleBoss.shadowN or 0) + 1
                    if x ~= o or a ~= N or e ~= I then
                        shadowMiss(
                            "fitsAt",
                            NF,
                            IF,
                            FF,
                            ("%s/%s/%s"):format(x, a, e),
                            ("%s/%s/%s"):format(o, N, I)
                        )
                    end
                end
                return x, a, e
            end
            bubbleBoss.fitsAt = fitsAt
            local o = config.bubbleSoftCost or 6
            local function x(a, e, N)
                local I = 0
                for index13 = 1, jF, 1 do
                    local aF = soft[index13]
                    index13 = Y(aF, a, uF, e, N, lF, config.bubbleLead)
                    if index13 then
                        local eF = index13 + g(aF, bubbleRadius, qF)
                        I = if eF > 0 then I + eF * B(aF) * o else I
                    else
                    end
                end
                for index19 = 1, JF, 1 do
                    N = pend[index19]
                    index19 = v(N, a, uF, e, lF, vF + bubbleLookahead)
                    if index19 then
                        local a = index19 + g(N, bubbleRadius, qF)
                        if a > 0 then
                            local e = 1 - min(max(((N.from or 0) - H) / vF, 0), 1)
                            I += a * B(N) * o * (0.35 + 0.65 * e)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return I
            end
            local function a(e, N, I)
                local F = 0
                for index13 = 1, jF, 1 do
                    local jF = soft[index13]
                    local pF, eF = g(jF, bubbleRadius, qF), depthBound(jF, e, N, I, config.bubbleLead)
                    if not (eF and eF >= pF) then
                        index13 = Y(jF, e, uF, N, I, lF, config.bubbleLead)
                        if index13 then
                            local eF = index13 + pF
                            F = if eF > 0 then F + eF * B(jF) * o else F
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                for index19 = 1, JF, 1 do
                    I = pend[index19]
                    index19 = g(I, bubbleRadius, qF)
                    local jF
                    if I.moving then
                        local UF = I.from or 0
                        jF = laneBound(I, e, N, UF, (min(I.untilAt or UF + 2, UF + vF + bubbleLookahead)))
                            >= index19
                    else
                        local J = depthBound(I, e, N, I.from or 0, 0)
                        jF = J ~= nil and J >= index19
                    end
                    if not jF then
                        local J = v(I, e, uF, N, lF, vF + bubbleLookahead)
                        if J then
                            local v = J + index19
                            if v > 0 then
                                local J = 1 - min(max(((I.from or 0) - H) / vF, 0), 1)
                                F += v * B(I) * o * (0.35 + 0.65 * J)
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return F
            end
            local function softAt(v, M, e)
                local N = config.bbFast
                N = if N == nil then true else N
                if N == true then
                    return a(v, M, e)
                end
                local I = x(v, M, e)
                if N == "shadow" then
                    local x = a(v, M, e)
                    bubbleBoss.shadowN = (bubbleBoss.shadowN or 0) + 1
                    if I ~= x then
                        shadowMiss("softAt", v, M, e, tostring(I), tostring(x))
                    end
                end
                return I
            end
            bubbleBoss.softAt = softAt
            bubbleBoss.reachPull = config.bossReachFirst ~= false
                and (function()
                    local target = context.BR and context.BR.target
                    if
                        not (target and target.isBoss and target.root and target.root.Parent and target.model)
                        or context.PB and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
                        or hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent
                    then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local profile = context.bossProfile(target.model.Name)
                    if profile.fan and os.clock() < (hazardReader.fanUntil or -infinity) + 1 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if
                        profile.home
                        and (
                            config.bobReachFirst == false
                            or context.bobStandOut and context.bobStandOut(os.clock())
                        )
                    then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local reach = context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or nil
                    if not reach then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local approach = dangerGeometry.approach
                    local position = target.root.Position
                    return {
                        x = position.X,
                        z = position.Z,
                        limit = max(
                            reach - (config.bossReachPullSlack or 3),
                            approach and approach.standoff or 0
                        ),
                    }
                end)()
                or nil
            local function j(v, M)
                local x, prefMid = 0, hazardReader.hub
                if prefMid and context.fanFloor then
                    local e = context.fanFloor()
                    if e > 0 then
                        local N = sqrt((v - prefMid.X) ^ 2 + (M - prefMid.Z) ^ 2)
                        x = if N < e then x + min((config.fanInnerWeight or 0.6) * (e - N), 12) else x
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if bubbleBoss.cmH then
                    prefMid = sqrt((v - bubbleBoss.cmH.X) ^ 2 + (M - bubbleBoss.cmH.Z) ^ 2)
                    x = if prefMid < bubbleBoss.cmF
                        then x + min((config.champMidPref or 0.6) * (bubbleBoss.cmF - prefMid), 12)
                        else x
                else
                end
                prefMid = hazardReader.ringBand and hazardReader.arenaCentre or nil
                if prefMid then
                    local e, N, I =
                        sqrt((v - prefMid.X) ^ 2 + (M - prefMid.Z) ^ 2),
                        config.ringBandRadius or 81.25,
                        config.odinRanks ~= false and context.odinRankOff ~= nil
                    for index13 = 1, #context.RING_GAPS, 1 do
                        local B = context.RING_GAPS[index13]
                        N = if (not I or context.odinRankOff(B) == 0) and abs(e - B) < abs(e - N) then B else N
                    end
                    x += min((config.ringBandWeight or 0.3) * max(abs(e - N) - 1.5, 0), 12)
                    x = if I
                        then x + min(
                            (config.odinRankDodgeWeight or 0.6) * context.odinRankOff(e),
                            config.odinRankDodgeCap or 30
                        )
                        else x
                else
                end
                if hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent and config.rodinHome ~= false then
                    if bubbleBoss.prefMidAt ~= prefMidAt then
                        prefMid = parent:FindFirstChild("thirdBossMiddlePart")
                        bubbleBoss.prefMidAt = prefMidAt
                        bubbleBoss.prefMid = prefMid
                        if prefMid then
                            local position = prefMid.Position
                            bubbleBoss.prefMidX, bubbleBoss.prefMidZ = position.X, position.Z
                        end
                    end
                    if bubbleBoss.prefMid then
                        local e = sqrt((v - bubbleBoss.prefMidX) ^ 2 + (M - bubbleBoss.prefMidZ) ^ 2)
                        x += min(
                            (config.rodinHomePull or 1.2)
                                * max(abs(e - (config.rodinHomeRing or 56)) - (config.rodinHomeReach or 10), 0),
                            config.rodinHomeCap or 45
                        )
                        local N = e - (config.rodinLeash or 62)
                        x = if N > 0
                            then x + min((config.rodinLeashPull or 6) * N, config.rodinLeashCap or 600)
                            else x
                        e, N = hazardReader.rodinBands, hazardReader.rodinBandC
                        if e and N then
                            local I, F = sqrt((v - N.x) ^ 2 + (M - N.z) ^ 2), config.rodinBandPad or 3.5
                            for index19 = 1, #e, 1 do
                                local B = abs(I - e[index19])
                                x = if B < F then x + (config.rodinBandCost or 30) * (F - B) / F else x
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                prefMid = context.bobPullTo and context.bobPullTo(prefMidAt) or hazardReader.bobHome
                if prefMid and not hazardReader.orbLead then
                    local e = sqrt((v - prefMid.X) ^ 2 + (M - prefMid.Z) ^ 2)
                    x += min(
                        (config.bobHomePull or 0.35) * max(e - (config.bobHomeReach or 18), 0),
                        config.bobHomeCap or 12
                    )
                else
                end
                if config.dodgeMeleePref ~= false then
                    local e, N, I = config.dodgeMeleeKeep or 30, config.meleeDeadly or 18, 0
                    for index20 = 1, #(hazardReader.enemies or {}), 1 do
                        prefMid = hazardReader.enemies[index20]
                        if
                            prefMid.melee
                            and not prefMid.isBoss
                            and prefMid.root
                            and prefMid.root.Parent
                            and (prefMid.humanoid == nil or prefMid.humanoid.Health > 0)
                        then
                            index20 = sqrt((v - prefMid.x) ^ 2 + (M - prefMid.z) ^ 2)
                            I = if index20 < N
                                then I + (config.dodgeMeleeDeadly or 3)
                                else if index20 < e then I + (e - index20) / max(e - N, 1) else I
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    x = if I > 0
                        then x + min(I * (config.dodgeMeleeWeight or 10), config.dodgeMeleeCap or 60)
                        else x
                else
                end
                local vector, origin =
                    hazardReader.orbLead and hazardReader.orbLead.goal or nil, dangerGeometry.origin
                if vector and origin then
                    prefMid = sqrt((v - vector.X) ^ 2 + (M - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                        - sqrt((origin.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (origin.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                    x = if prefMid > 0
                        then x + min((config.orbGoalPull or 0.6) * prefMid, config.orbGoalCap or 20)
                        else x
                else
                end
                prefMid = bubbleBoss.reachPull
                if prefMid then
                    local e = sqrt((v - prefMid.x) ^ 2 + (M - prefMid.z) ^ 2) - prefMid.limit
                    x = if e > 0
                        then x + min((config.bossReachPull or 2) * e, config.bossReachPullCap or 50)
                        else x
                else
                end
                return x
            end
            local v = config.bubbleTrajLead or 1.2
            local M = config.bubbleTrajCost or 14
            local function x(a, e)
                if YF == 0 or v <= 0 then
                    return 0
                end
                local N = 0
                for index13 = 1, YF, 1 do
                    local F = mov[index13]
                    if not ((F.from or 0) > H) then
                        index13 = g(F, bubbleRadius, qF)
                        for index19 = 1, 5, 1 do
                            local _F = v * index19 / 5
                            index19 = Y(F, a, uF, e, H + _F, lF, (config.bubbleLead or 0) + _F)
                            if index19 and index19 >= -index13 then
                                N += M / (_F + 0.3)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return N
            end
            MF = bubbleBoss.beamWhite
            if not MF then
                ZF, RF = setmetatable, {
                    __mode = "k",
                }
                MF = ZF({}, RF)
                bubbleBoss.beamWhite = MF
            else
            end
            for index22 = 1, EF, 1 do
                mF = rel[index22]
                if mF.name == "firstbosspassivebeam" and mF.ax then
                    ZF, RF = (cF - mF.cx) * mF.bx + (hF - mF.cz) * mF.bz, MF[mF]
                    if RF then
                        if
                            mF.fired
                            or H - RF.at > (config.beamCrossHold or 0.9)
                            or ZF * RF.side < 0 and math.abs(ZF) > (mF.hb or 4)
                        then
                            MF[mF] = nil
                        end
                    elseif mF.bornAt and H - mF.bornAt < (config.beamCrossYoung or 0.5) and not mF.fired then
                        MF[mF] = {
                            at = H,
                            side = ZF >= 0 and 1 or -1,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            MF = bubbleBoss.liveNow
            if not MF then
                MF = {}
                bubbleBoss.liveNow = MF
            else
            end
            for entry3 in pairs(n) do
                n[entry3] = nil
            end
            for index23 = 1, EF, 1 do
                ZF = Y(rel[index23], cF, uF, hF, H, lF, config.bubbleLead)
                if ZF and ZF >= 0 then
                    n[rel[index23]] = ZF
                end
            end
            for index24 = 1, YF, 1 do
                mF = mov[index24]
                if mF.laneHard then
                    RF = Y(mF, cF, uF, hF, H, lF, config.bubbleLead)
                    if RF and RF >= 0 then
                        n[mF] = RF
                    end
                end
            end
            RF, mF = H + (config.bubbleProbe or 72) / max(speed, 1), 0
            for index25 = 1, EF, 1 do
                ZF = rel[index25]
                if
                    not n[ZF]
                    and (ZF.from or 0) <= H
                    and (ZF.untilAt or infinity) >= H
                    and (ZF.moving or (ZF.untilAt or infinity) < RF)
                then
                    mF += 1
                    MF[mF] = ZF
                else
                end
            end
            for index26 = 1, YF, 1 do
                ZF = mov[index26]
                if ZF.laneHard and not n[ZF] and (ZF.from or 0) <= H and (ZF.untilAt or infinity) >= H then
                    mF += 1
                    MF[mF] = ZF
                else
                end
            end
            bubbleBoss.liveNowN = mF
            local v, v = fitsAt(cF, hF, H)
            local function lineEnters(a, e, N)
                local I, F = a - cF, e - hF
                local B = sqrt(I * I + F * F)
                if B < 0.5 then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    config.ringPathCheck ~= false
                    and context.OD
                    and context.OD.pathCrossesRing
                    and context.OD.pathCrossesRing(cF, hF, a, e, H, N)
                then
                    return true
                end
                local a, _F, pF = I / B, F / B, config.bubbleStep or 2

                if V then
                    local M, Z = -mageArcList
                    if (zone.cx - J) * M + (zone.cz - w) * V < 0 then
                        M, Z = -M, -V
                    else
                        Z = V
                    end
                    return M, Z, nil, 0
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.mageFireLive = function(V, j)
            if config.mageCommit == false then
                return false
            end
            local mageShotSeen = hazardReader.mageShotSeen
            if not (mageShotSeen and j - mageShotSeen.t < (config.mageStrafeHold or 2)) then
                return false
            end
            if (mageShotSeen.x - V.X) ^ 2 + (mageShotSeen.z - V.Z) ^ 2 >= (config.mageStrafeNear or 120) ^ 2 then
                return false
            end
            V = context.BR and context.BR.target
            if V and V.isBoss or context.PB and context.PB.boss then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        bubbleBoss.mageCommitDir = function(vector, j)
            local mcCache = bubbleBoss.mcCache
            if mcCache and mcCache.at == j and mcCache.x0 == vector.X and mcCache.z0 == vector.Z then
                return mcCache.x, mcCache.z
            end
            local J, w
            if bubbleBoss.mageFireLive(vector, j) then
                local v, M, M, Z, n, n = bubbleBoss.mageStrafeDir(vector, j)
                if v and M and n then
                    J, w = -Z * n, M * n
                else
                end
            else
            end
            bubbleBoss.mcCache = {
                at = j,
                x0 = vector.X,
                z0 = vector.Z,
                x = J,
                z = w,
            }
            return J, w
        end
        bubbleBoss.mageStrafeDir = function(side, j, J)
            if context.orbitDir and runtimeState.orbitLive then
                local w, v, M, Z, n, f = context.orbitDir(side, j)
                if w then
                    if config.mageCommit ~= false and f then
                        local r, o = bubbleBoss.mageFace(side, J)
                        if r then
                            local side2, mageStrafe =
                                -Z * f * -o + M * f * r >= 0 and 1 or -1, bubbleBoss.mageStrafe
                            if not mageStrafe then
                                mageStrafe = {
                                    side = side2,
                                    flipAt = -infinity,
                                }
                                bubbleBoss.mageStrafe = mageStrafe
                            else
                            end
                            mageStrafe.side = side2
                            mageStrafe.at = j
                        end
                    end
                    return w, v, M, Z, n, f
                end
            end
            local w, v, M = bubbleBoss.mageFace(side, J)
            if not w then
                return nil
            end
            local Z, mageStrafe2 = side + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), bubbleBoss.mageStrafe
            if not mageStrafe2 or j - (mageStrafe2.at or -infinity) > (config.mageStrafeForget or 8) then
                local f, r, side3 = { 1, -1 }, -infinity, 1
                for index, entry in ipairs(f) do
                    J, index = -v * entry, w * entry
                    local raycastResult = parent:Raycast(Z, Vector3.new(J, 0, index) * 40, raycastParams)
                    local x, runOn = raycastResult and raycastResult.Distance or 40, runtimeState.runOn
                    x = if runOn
                            and runOn.d
                            and runOn.d > 1
                        then x + ((runOn.x - side.X) * J + (runOn.z - side.Z) * index) / runOn.d * 30
                        else x
                    if x > r then
                        r, side3 = x, entry
                    else
                    end
                end
                mageStrafe2 = {
                    side = side3,
                    flipAt = -infinity,
                }
                bubbleBoss.mageStrafe = mageStrafe2
            else
            end
            mageStrafe2.at = j
            side = mageStrafe2.side
            local f, r, o = -v * side, w * side, config.mageStrafeWallAt or 10
            if
                j - mageStrafe2.flipAt > (config.mageStrafeFlipGap or 3)
                and parent:Raycast(Z, Vector3.new(f, 0, r) * o, raycastParams)
                and not parent:Raycast(Z, Vector3.new(-f, 0, -r) * o, raycastParams)
            then
                side = -side
                mageStrafe2.side = side
                mageStrafe2.flipAt = j
                mageStrafe2.wallFlipAt = j
                f, r = -f, -r
            else
            end
            if M then
                o = M < (config.mageStrafeMin or 30) and -1 or M > (config.mageStrafeMax or 75) and 1 or 0
                if o ~= 0 then
                    Z = toRadians(config.mageStrafeTilt or 25)
                    J, j = cos(Z), sin(Z) * o
                    f, r = f * J + w * j, r * J + v * j
                else
                end
            else
            end
            return f, r, w, v, M, side
        end
        bubbleBoss.mageSideStep = function(V, vector, J, w, v, M)
            local Z, n, f, r, o, side = bubbleBoss.mageStrafeDir(vector, J, V)
            if not Z then
                return nil
            end
            local A = vector.X
            local k = vector.Z
            local x, a, e, N =
                vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
                config.mageStrafeStep or 14,
                { 0, 20, -20, 40, -40 },
                runtimeState.mageExit
            if config.mageExitLean ~= false and N and N.q and J - (N.at or -infinity) < 0.3 then
                local I, F, i = N.q.X - A, N.q.Z - k, {}
                for index, entry in ipairs(e) do
                    index = toRadians(entry)
                    local G, z = Z * cos(index) + f * sin(index), n * cos(index) + r * sin(index)
                    index = sqrt(G * G + z * z)
                    i[entry] = index > 0 and (G * I + z * F) / index or -infinity
                end
                table.sort(e, function(I, F)
                    return i[I] > i[F]
                end)
            elseif
                config.runOnDodge ~= false
                and runtimeState.runOn
                and runtimeState.runOn.d
                and runtimeState.runOn.d > 1
                and not (context.BR and context.BR.target and context.BR.target.isBoss)
            then
                local I, F, i = runtimeState.runOn.x - A, runtimeState.runOn.z - k, {}
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(e) do
                    V = toRadians(entry2)
                    local G, z = Z * cos(V) + f * sin(V), n * cos(V) + r * sin(V)
                    index2 = sqrt(G * G + z * z)
                    i[entry2] = index2 > 0 and (G * I + z * F) / index2 or -infinity
                end
                table.sort(e, function(I, F)
                    return i[I] > i[F]
                end)
            end
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(e) do
                N = toRadians(entry3)
                local i = Z * cos(N) + f * sin(N)
                local b = n * cos(N) + r * sin(N)
                V = sqrt(i * i + b * b)
                i /= V
                b /= V
                entry3 = parent:Raycast(x, Vector3.new(i, 0, b) * (a + 11), raycastParams)
                index3 = min(a + 8, (entry3 and entry3.Distance or infinity) - (config.wallClear or 3))
                local function B(G)
                    local z, s, K = A + i * G, k + b * G, J + G / max(w, 1)
                    local G, t, t = v(z, s, K)
                    if not (G > 0 and t < 0) then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local t, H, H = v(z, s, K + (config.mageStrafeHoldT or 0.5))
                    if not (t > 0 and H < 0) or M(z, s, J) then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if context.mageArcBad and context.mageArcBad(z, s, A, k) then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if context.coneBad and context.coneBad(z, s, A, k, nil, vector.Y) then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if
                        config.ledgeGuard ~= false
                        and not parent:Raycast(
                            Vector3.new(z, vector.Y + 3, s),
                            Vector3.new(0, -(3 + (config.ledgeDrop or 7)), 0),
                            raycastParams
                        )
                    then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return min(G, t)
                end
                local dist, margin
                if a <= index3 then
                    margin = B(a)
                    dist = if margin then a else dist
                else
                end
                if not dist then
                    entry3 = config.mageStrafeMinStep or 6
                    while entry3 <= index3 do
                        margin = B(entry3)
                        if margin then
                            dist = entry3
                            break
                        end
                        entry3 = entry3 + 2
                    end
                else
                end
                if dist then
                    return {
                        dx = i,
                        dz = b,
                        dist = dist,
                        free = index3,
                        margin = margin,
                        soft = 0,
                        clean = true,
                        roomy = margin >= (config.roomyMargin or 10),
                        side = side,
                        strafe = true,
                    }
                end
            end
            if config.mageCommit == false then
                return nil
            end
            local function M(I, F)
                return config.ledgeGuard == false
                    or parent:Raycast(
                            Vector3.new(I, vector.Y + 3, F),
                            Vector3.new(0, -(3 + (config.ledgeDrop or 7)), 0),
                            raycastParams
                        )
                        ~= nil
            end
            V, N = infinity
            for index4, entry4 in ipairs(e) do
                index4 = toRadians(entry4)
                local e, F = Z * cos(index4) + f * sin(index4), n * cos(index4) + r * sin(index4)
                index4 = sqrt(e * e + F * F)
                e /= index4
                F /= index4
                index4 = parent:Raycast(x, Vector3.new(e, 0, F) * (a + 11), raycastParams)
                entry4 = min(a + 8, (index4 and index4.Distance or infinity) - (config.wallClear or 3))
                index4 = (min(a, entry4))
                while index4 >= (config.mageStrafeMinStep or 6) do
                    local Z, n = A + e * index4, k + F * index4
                    if M(Z, n) then
                        local margin2, f, r = v(Z, n, J + index4 / max(w, 1))
                        if margin2 > 0 and r < 0 then
                            return {
                                dx = e,
                                dz = F,
                                dist = index4,
                                free = entry4,
                                margin = margin2,
                                soft = 0,
                                clean = false,
                                side = side,
                                strafe = true,
                                kept = 1,
                            }
                        end
                        margin2 = max(r or 0, f or 0)
                        if margin2 < V then
                            V, N =
                                margin2, {
                                    dx = e,
                                    dz = F,
                                    dist = index4,
                                    free = entry4,
                                    margin = 0,
                                    soft = 0,
                                    clean = false,
                                    side = side,
                                    strafe = true,
                                    kept = 2,
                                }
                        else
                        end
                        break
                    end
                    index4 -= 2
                end
            end
            return N
        end
        bubbleBoss.pathBlocked = function(vector, vector2, J)
            local w, bubbleRadius, M, Z, now =
                dangerGeometry.boxes or {},
                config.bubbleRadius,
                dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4,
                dangerGeometry.lag or 0,
                os.clock()
            U = now
            local f, r = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local o = sqrt(f * f + r * r)
            if o < 0.1 then
                return false
            end
            local A = max(J, 4)
            J = o / A
            local k, x, x = math.clamp(math.ceil(max(o / 6, J / 0.25)), 2, 24), contextArenaOf(vector.X, vector.Z)
            local a, e, N =
                hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil and config.leadArenaFree ~= false,
                hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil and config.leadOrbBoxFree ~= false
            if config.pathLeaveOk ~= false then
                for index = 1, #w, 1 do
                    local F = w[index]
                    if not F.moving and T(F) == 3 then
                        index = Y(F, vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z, max(now, F.from or now), M, config.bubbleLead)
                        if index and index >= -g(F, bubbleRadius, Z) then
                            local I = Y(
                                F,
                                vector2.X,
                                vector.Y,
                                vector2.Z,
                                max(now + J, F.from or now),
                                M,
                                config.bubbleLead
                            )
                            if not (I and I >= -g(F, bubbleRadius, Z)) then
                                N = N or {}
                                N[F] = true
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            for index2 = 1, k, 1 do
                local F = index2 / k
                local i, b, B, G, z, s, K = vector.X + f * F, vector.Z + r * F, now + o * F / A
                if not a then
                    G, z, s, K = contextArenaOf(i, b)
                else
                end
                F = K and K + (config.arenaSlack or 8) or nil
                if G and F and z ~= nil and z > F and (x == nil or x <= F) then
                    bubbleBoss.blockReason = "arena out " .. index2
                    return true
                end
                if G and x ~= nil and s ~= nil and K ~= nil then
                    F = x > K and x - K or x < s and s - x or 0
                    if (z > K and z - K or z < s and s - z or 0) > F + (config.arenaSlack or 8) then
                        bubbleBoss.blockReason = "arena band " .. index2
                        return true
                    end
                elseif G and x == nil then
                    bubbleBoss.blockReason = "arena nostart " .. index2
                    return true
                end
                if bubbleBoss.oldLineAt(i, b, B, 0, vector.X, vector.Z) then
                    bubbleBoss.blockReason = "old spike line " .. index2
                    return true
                end
                for index3 = 1, #w, 1 do
                    F = w[index3]
                    index3 = F.warn == true
                        and (F.from or 0) > now + (config.bubbleLead or 0)
                        and not F.hardPending
                    if e and F.bobOrb == nil then
                        local w = string.lower(tostring(F.name or ""))
                        F.bobOrb = w:find("secondboss", 1, true) ~= nil and w:find("orb", 1, true) ~= nil or false
                    end
                    if T(F) == 3 and not index3 and not (N and N[F]) and not (e and F.bobOrb == true) then
                        local w = Y(F, i, vector.Y, b, B, M, config.bubbleLead)
                        if w and w >= -g(F, bubbleRadius, Z) then
                            bubbleBoss.blockReason = tostring(F.name or F.kind or "?")
                                .. " "
                                .. index2
                                .. "/"
                                .. k
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if
                bubbleBoss.oldLineAt(vector2.X, vector2.Z, now + J, config.oldLineHold or 0.6, vector.X, vector.Z)
            then
                bubbleBoss.blockReason = "old spike line at the end"
                return true
            end
            bubbleBoss.blockReason = nil
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.pathTouchesRed = function(vector, j, J, w, v)
            local M, Z, n = dangerGeometry.boxes or {}, dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4, os.clock()
            U = n
            local f, r = j.X - vector.X, j.Z - vector.Z
            local o = sqrt(f * f + r * r)
            if o < 0.5 then
                return false
            end
            local A, k, x, a, e =
                max(J or 16, 4),
