                (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.redTouchMargin or 0.5),
                dangerGeometry.lag or 0,
                math.clamp(math.ceil(o / (config.redNodeStep or 2)), 1, 80),
                n + (v or 0)
            v, J = e + o / A
            for index = 1, #M, 1 do
                n = M[index]
                if
                    not n.moving
                    and not n.noDraw
                    and not (w and w(n))
                    and T(n) == 3
                    and (n.from or 0) <= e
                    and (n.untilAt or infinity) >= e
                then
                    local I, F = n.slim and min(k, n.slim + x) or k, Y(n, vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z, e, Z, 0)
                    if F and F >= -I then
                        index = Y(n, j.X, vector.Y, j.Z, v, Z, 0)
                        if not (index and index >= -I) then
                            J = J or {}
                            J[n] = true
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            for index2 = 1, a, 1 do
                j = index2 / a
                n, v, index2 = vector.X + f * j, vector.Z + r * j, e + o * j / A
                for index3 = 1, #M, 1 do
                    local f = M[index3]
                    if
                        T(f) == 3
                        and not f.noDraw
                        and not (w and w(f))
                        and not (J and J[f])
                        and (f.from or 0) <= index2
                        and (f.untilAt or infinity) >= index2
                    then
                        local j, J = f.slim and min(k, f.slim + x) or k, Y(f, n, vector.Y, v, index2, Z, 0)
                        if J and J >= -j then
                            return true, f
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.redAtSpot = function(V, j, J, w, v)
            local M, Z, n, f =
                dangerGeometry.boxes or {},
                dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4,
                (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.redTouchMargin or 0.5),
                dangerGeometry.lag or 0
            for index = 1, #M, 1 do
                local o = M[index]
                local M, A = o.from or 0, o.untilAt or infinity
                if T(o) == 3 and not o.noDraw and M <= v and A >= w then
                    local k, x =
                        o.slim and min(n, o.slim + f) or n, {
                            max(w, M),
                            (w + v) * 0.5,
                            v,
                            min(v, A),
                        }
                    for index2 = 1, 4, 1 do
                        index = x[index2]
                        if index >= M and index <= A and index >= w and index <= v then
                            index2 = Y(o, V, j, J, index, Z, 0)
                            if index2 and index2 >= -k then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.yellowThrough = function(vector, j, J)
            J = max(J or 16, 4)
            local w = config.yellowThroughHold or 1
            local v = config.yellowThroughSpare or 0.8
            local M = bubbleBoss.blueBeams and bubbleBoss.blueBeams() or {}
            local arenaCentre, n = hazardReader.arenaCentre, vector.Y
            local function f(vector2, o)
                local A = o / J
                if bubbleBoss.redAtSpot(vector2.X, n, vector2.Z, j + A, j + A + w) then
                    return nil
                end
                if #M > 0 and bubbleBoss.onBlueBeam(vector2.X, vector2.Z, 0, M) then
                    o = bubbleBoss.orbArrive(vector2.X, vector2.Z, M) - A
                    if o < v then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return o
                end
                return infinity
            end
            local function w(v)
                return not bubbleBoss.pathTouchesRed(vector, v, J) and bubbleBoss.orbPathSafe(vector, v, J)
            end
            local J = bubbleBoss.ytLast
            if J and j - J.at < (config.yellowThroughKeep or 0.4) then
                local v = sqrt((J.q.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (J.q.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                if v > 2 and f(J.q, v) and w(J.q) then
                    return J.q, v, J.note
                end
            end
            bubbleBoss.ytLast = nil
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                bubbleBoss.folder,
            }
            local v, M, r, o =
                config.yellowThroughWays or 32, config.yellowThroughFar or 60, vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), {}
            for index = 0, v - 1, 1 do
                J = index * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / v
                local v, k = cos(J), sin(J)
                index = parent:Raycast(r, Vector3.new(v, 0, k) * M, raycastParams)
                local J, r = index and index.Distance - (config.wallClear or 5) or M, config.yellowThroughMin or 4
                while r <= J do
                    index = Vector3.new(vector.X + v * r, n, vector.Z + k * r)
                    local spare = f(index, r)
                    if spare then
                        local J = r + (spare < infinity and (config.yellowThroughLaneCost or 20) or 0)
                        J = if arenaCentre and context.odinBandOff
                            then J + context.odinBandOff(
                                sqrt((index.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (index.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2)
                            ) * (config.yellowThroughRankW or 1)
                            else J
                        o[#o + 1] = {
                            q = index,
                            d = r,
                            c = J,
                            spare = spare,
                        }
                        break
                    end
                    r += 2
                end
            end
            table.sort(o, function(V, J)
                return V.c < J.c
            end)
            for index2 = 1, min(#o, config.yellowThroughTry or 12), 1 do
                M = o[index2]
                if
                    (
                        config.ledgeGuard == false
                        or parent:Raycast(
                                Vector3.new(M.q.X, n + 3, M.q.Z),
                                Vector3.new(0, -(3 + (config.ledgeDrop or 7)), 0),
                                raycastParams
                            )
                            ~= nil
                    ) and w(M.q)
                then
                    index2 = M.spare < infinity
                            and (", in a blue orb's lane %.1fs before it comes"):format(M.spare)
                        or ""
                    bubbleBoss.ytLast = {
                        q = M.q,
                        at = j,
                        note = index2,
                    }
                    return M.q, M.d, index2
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.wayClear = function(V, vector, J, w)
            w = w or os.clock()
            local v, bubbleRadius = dangerGeometry.boxes or {}, config.bubbleRadius
            local Z = dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4
            local n = dangerGeometry.lag or 0
            local f = config.bubbleLead or 0.35
            local r, o, A = V.Y, {}, {}
            for index = 1, #v, 1 do
                local x = v[index]
                if T(x) == 3 and not x.noDraw and not ((x.untilAt or infinity) < w) then
                    o[#o + 1] = x
                    index = Y(x, V.X, r, V.Z, w, Z, f)
                    if index and index >= -g(x, bubbleRadius, n) then
                        A[x] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            local function k(x, a, e, N)
                for index2 = 1, #o, 1 do
                    local F = o[index2]
                    if not (N and N[F]) then
                        index2 = Y(F, x, r, a, e, Z, f)
                        if index2 and index2 >= -g(F, bubbleRadius, n) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local M, Z, f = max(J or 16, 4), vector.X - V.X, vector.Z - V.Z
            v = sqrt(Z * Z + f * f)
            J = max(1, math.ceil(v / (config.stepInStep or 1.5)))
            for index3 = 1, J, 1 do
                local o = index3 / J
                local r, x, a = V.X + Z * o, V.Z + f * o, v * o / M
                if not k(r, x, w + a, A) then
                    return false
                end
                if not k(r, x, w + a * (config.stepInSlow or 1.1) + (config.stepInPad or 0.15) + n, A) then
                    return false
                end
                if a > 0.1 and not k(r, x, w + a * (config.stepInFast or 0.9), A) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            V, J = w + v / M, config.arriveHold or 1
            return k(vector.X, vector.Z, V + J * 0.5) and k(vector.X, vector.Z, V + J)
        end
        bubbleBoss.SPIKE_KIND = {
            ["seeking spike"] = "seek",
            ["seeking line"] = "seek",
            ["big spike"] = "big",
            ["big spike line"] = "big",
        }
        bubbleBoss.spikeSideAt = function(vector, vector2, J, w)
            if config.beamSpikeSide == false then
                return false
            end
            w = w or os.clock()
            if bubbleBoss.spkFor ~= dangerGeometry.now or not bubbleBoss.spkList then
                local v, spkList, Z = dangerGeometry.boxes or {}, bubbleBoss.spkList or {}, 0
                for index = 1, #v, 1 do
                    local f = v[index]
                    index = f.spikeKind
                    if index == nil then
                        local v = tostring(f.name or "")
                        local r = string.lower(v)
                        local o = bubbleBoss.SPIKE_KIND[v]
                            or r:find("bigspike", 1, true) and "big"
                            or r:find("seekingspike", 1, true) and "seek"
                        if o then
                            if o then
                                r = Z + 1
                                spkList[r] = f
                                Z = r
                            else
                            end
                            index = o
                        else
                            index = false
                        end
                        f.spikeKind = index
                    else
                        if index then
                            local v = Z + 1
                            spkList[v] = f
                            Z = v
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index2 = Z + 1, #spkList, 1 do
                    spkList[index2] = nil
                end
                bubbleBoss.spkList, bubbleBoss.spkFor = spkList, dangerGeometry.now
            end
            local spkList2 = bubbleBoss.spkList
            if #spkList2 == 0 then
                return false
            end
            local M = dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4
            local Z = config.bubbleLead or 0.35
            local n = vector.Y
            local f = config.spikeSideSeek or 10
            local r, o = config.spikeSideBig or 20, {}
            for index3 = 1, #spkList2, 1 do
                local k = spkList2[index3]
                index3 = Y(k, vector.X, n, vector.Z, w, M, Z)
                if index3 and index3 >= -(k.spikeKind == "big" and r or f) then
                    o[k] = true
                end
            end
            local function A(k, x, a, e)
                for index4 = 1, #spkList2, 1 do
                    local I = spkList2[index4]
                    if not (e and e[I]) and not ((I.untilAt or infinity) < w) then
                        index4 = Y(I, k, n, x, a, M, Z)
                        if index4 and index4 >= -(I.spikeKind == "big" and r or f) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local v, M = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local Z, n = sqrt(v * v + M * M), max(J or 16, 4)
            local J, f = w + Z / n, config.spikeSideHold or 1.5
            for index5 = 0, 3, 1 do
                if A(vector2.X, vector2.Z, J + f * index5 / 3) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            J = max(1, math.ceil(Z / 3))
            for index6 = 1, J - 1, 1 do
                if A(vector.X + v * index6 / J, vector.Z + M * index6 / J, w + Z * index6 / J / n, o) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.fanDance = function(V, point, burst)
            local w = hazardReader.hub
            if not w then
                return nil
            end
            local v = w.X
            local M = w.Z
            local Z = point.X
            local n = point.Y
            local f = point.Z
            local r = sqrt((Z - v) ^ 2 + (f - M) ^ 2)
            if r < (config.danceMinR or 20) then
                return nil
            end
            local o, A, k = atan2(f - M, Z - v), 3.141592653589793, 1.5707963267948966
            local x, bubbleRadius = dangerGeometry.boxes or {}, config.bubbleRadius
            local e = dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4
            local N = dangerGeometry.lag or 0
            w = hazardReader.hitDelay and hazardReader.hitDelay.firstbosspassivebeam
            local I, F, C, i =
                w and w.med or 0.916,
                math.clamp(runtimeState.dataPingS or runtimeState.pingS or 0, 0, 0.4),
                config.danceLook or 2,
                config.bubbleLead or 0.35
            local b, B, G, z = math.asin, {}, {}, {}
            for index = 1, #x, 1 do
                w = x[index]
                index = w.name
                if index == "firstbosspassivebeam" and w.cx and w.ha and w.hb and not w.moving then
                    local K, t, H
                    if w.hb >= w.ha then
                        K, t, H = w.bx, w.bz, w.ha
                    else
                        K, t, H = w.ax, w.az, w.hb
                    end
                    local born, QF = w.bornAt or V, abs((w.cx - v) * -t + (w.cz - M) * K)
                    B[#B + 1] = {
                        c = (atan2(t, K) - o + k) % A - k,
                        w0 = H + g(w, bubbleRadius, N) + QF,
                        t1 = born + I,
                        born = born,
                        fired = w.fired == true,
                    }
                elseif
                    index ~= "beam next"
                    and index ~= "firstbosspassivebeam"
                    and T(w) == 3
                    and not w.noDraw
                    and not ((w.untilAt or infinity) < V)
                then
                    G[#G + 1] = w
                    local E = Y(w, Z, n, f, V, e, i)
                    if E and E >= -g(w, bubbleRadius, N) then
                        z[w] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            if #B == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local E = config.danceDt or 0.05
            w = math.ceil(C / E)
            local s = w
            local K = min((config.danceSpan or 60) / r, 1.2)
            local t, H = max(burst or 16, 8) * (config.danceSpeedShare or 0.85) * E / r, {}
            local function X(QF)
                local LF = {}
                for index2 = 1, #H, 1 do
                    local DF = H[index2]
                    if DF.s0 <= QF and QF <= DF.s1 then
                        for index3 = -1, 1, 1 do
                            local PF, _F = DF.c + index3 * A - DF.a, DF.c + index3 * A + DF.a
                            if _F >= -K and PF <= K then
                                LF[#LF + 1] = {
                                    max(PF, -K),
                                    min(_F, K),
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(LF, function(A, SF)
                    return A[1] < SF[1]
                end)
                QF = {}
                for index4, entry in ipairs(LF) do
                    index4 = QF[#QF]
                    if index4 and entry[1] <= index4[2] then
                        if entry[2] > index4[2] then
                            index4[2] = entry[2]
                        end
                    else
                        QF[#QF + 1] = {
                            entry[1],
                            entry[2],
                        }
                    end
                end
                return QF
            end
            local function A(QF)
                local LF, SF = {}, -K
                for index2, entry in ipairs(QF) do
                    if entry[1] > SF then
                        LF[#LF + 1] = {
                            SF,
                            entry[1],
                        }
                    end
                    SF = if entry[2] > SF then entry[2] else SF
                end
                if SF < K then
                    LF[#LF + 1] = {
                        SF,
                        K,
                    }
                end
                return LF
            end
            local function QF(LF, SF)
                local DF = {}
                for index2, entry in ipairs(LF) do
                    local LF, _F, lF = max(entry[1] - SF, -K), min(entry[2] + SF, K), DF[#DF]
                    if lF and LF <= lF[2] then
                        if _F > lF[2] then
                            lF[2] = _F
                        end
                    else
                        DF[#DF + 1] = {
                            LF,
                            _F,
                        }
                    end
                end
                return DF
            end
            local function LF(SF, DF)
                local PF, _F, lF = {}, 1, 1
                while _F <= #SF and lF <= #DF do
                    local cF, uF = max(SF[_F][1], DF[lF][1]), min(SF[_F][2], DF[lF][2])
                    if cF < uF then
                        PF[#PF + 1] = {
                            cF,
                            uF,
                        }
                    end
                    if SF[_F][2] < DF[lF][2] then
                        _F = _F + 1
                    else
                        lF = lF + 1
                    end
                end
                return PF
            end
            local function SF(DF, PF)
                for index2, entry in ipairs(DF) do
                    if PF >= entry[1] and PF <= entry[2] then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local DF = math.ceil((config.danceHold or 0.3) / E)
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                bubbleBoss.folder,
            }
            local function PF(_F, lF, cF, uF)
                for index2 = 1, #G, 1 do
                    local mF = G[index2]
                    if not (uF and z[mF]) then
                        index2 = Y(mF, _F, n, lF, cF, e, i)
                        if index2 and index2 >= -g(mF, bubbleRadius, N) then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local function Y(a)
                return v + r * cos(o + a), M + r * sin(o + a)
            end
            local v = {}
            local function M(o)
                local a = abs(o)
                local e = a < 1.0E-9 and 0 or math.ceil(a / t)
                if e + 1 > s then
                    return false
                end
                local N = o >= 0 and 1 or -1
                for index2 = 1, e, 1 do
                    local i = N * min(index2 * t, a)
                    if not SF(v[index2], i) then
                        return false
                    end
                    local N, G = Y(i)
                    if not PF(N, G, V + index2 * E, true) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                for index3 = max(e, 1), min(e + DF, s), 1 do
                    if not SF(v[index3], o) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                local N, g = Y(o)
                if not PF(N, g, V + max(e, 1) * E, false) or not PF(N, g, V + (e + DF) * E, false) then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    a * r > 1
                    and parent:Raycast(Vector3.new(Z, n + 2, f), Vector3.new(N - Z, 0, g - f), raycastParams)
                then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            I, x =
                {
                    {
                        sh = 0,
                        pre = (config.dancePre or 0.1) + F * (config.dancePingK or 1.5),
                        post = config.dancePost or 0.08,
                        m = config.danceMargin or 0.75,
                    },
                    {
                        sh = F,
                        pre = 0.08 + F * 0.25,
                        post = 0.06 + F * 0.25,
                        m = 0.5,
                    },
                    {
                        sh = F,
                        pre = 0.06 + F * 0.2,
                        post = 0.05 + F * 0.2,
                        m = 0,
                    },
                    {
                        sh = F,
                        pre = 0.06 + F * 0.2,
                        post = 0.05 + F * 0.2,
                        m = 0.25,
                        first = true,
                    },
                }, infinity
            for index5, entry2 in ipairs(B) do
                x = if not entry2.fired
                        and entry2.t1 > V - 0.05
                        and abs(entry2.c) - b(min(1, entry2.w0 / r)) <= K
                        and entry2.t1 < x
                    then entry2.t1
                    else x
            end
            F = math.clamp(config.danceLevels or 4, 1, 4)
            local Z, f
            for index6 = 1, F, 1 do
                b = I[index6]
                s = w
                if b.first then
                    if x == infinity then
                        break
                    end
                    s = math.clamp(math.ceil((x - V + 0.3) / E), 2, w)
                else
                end
                H = {}
                for index7, entry3 in ipairs(B) do
                    if not b.first or entry3.t1 <= x + (config.danceFirstSpan or 0.12) then
                        local a, e = entry3.t1 - b.sh - b.pre, entry3.t1 - b.sh + b.post
                        e = if not entry3.fired and V > entry3.t1 + 0.05
                            then max(e, min(V + 0.1, entry3.born + (config.danceWaitMax or 1.4)))
                            else e
                        e = if entry3.fired then min(e, V) else e
                        if e > V and a < V + C then
                            local N, I, F =
                                entry3.w0 + b.m, #H + 1, {
                                    c = entry3.c,
                                }
                            F.a, F.s0, F.s1, H[I] = N >= r and k or math.asin(N / r), a, e, F
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #H == 0 then
                    if index6 == 1 then
                        return nil
                    end
                    break
                end
                v = {
                    [s] = A((X(V + s * E))),
                }
                for index8 = s - 1, 1, -1 do
                    v[index8] = LF(QF(v[index8 + 1], t), (A((X(V + index8 * E)))))
                end
                if M(0) then
                    Z = 0
                else
                    local E, w = (config.danceStep or 0.75) / r, bubbleBoss.danceSign or 1
                    for index9 = 1, math.floor(K / E), 1 do
                        if M(w * index9 * E) then
                            Z = w * index9 * E
                            break
                        end
                        if M(-w * index9 * E) then
                            Z = -w * index9 * E
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if Z then
                    f = index6
                    break
                end
            end
            if not Z then
                return nil
            end
            x = infinity
            for index10 = 1, #H, 1 do
                QF = H[index10]
                x = if abs(QF.c) <= QF.a and QF.s0 < x then QF.s0 else x
            end
            if Z == 0 then
                if
                    x - V > (config.danceIdle or 0.8)
                    and not (hazardReader.fanBeamAt and V - hazardReader.fanBeamAt < (config.danceFanHold or 0.6))
                then
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    point = point,
                    hold = true,
                    soft = true,
                    dance = true,
                    label = x < infinity
                            and ("FAN DANCE: holding between the lanes - the next beam over this spot in %.2fs, out by then"):format(
                                max(x - V, 0)
                            )
                        or "FAN DANCE: holding between the lanes",
                }
            end
            bubbleBoss.danceSign = Z > 0 and 1 or -1
            B, C = Y(Z)
            A, k, X =
                {
                    point = Vector3.new(B, n, C),
                    soft = false,
                    dance = true,
                    noCast = true,
                    burst = burst,
                }, x < infinity and ("FAN DANCE: %.0f studs round - the beam over this spot fires in %.2fs, parked by its edge"):format(abs(Z) * r, max(x - V, 0)) or ("FAN DANCE: %.0f studs round, to a spot it can keep dodging from"):format(abs(Z) * r), f and f > 1 and (f == 4 and " (the first beam only)" or (" (tight timing %d)"):format(f))
            A.label = k .. (X or "")
            return A
        end
        bubbleBoss.isRedOrb = function(V)
            local E = V and V.name
            return type(E) == "string" and string.lower(E):find("bouncingorbbad", 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        local function V(E)
            return not bubbleBoss.isRedOrb(E)
        end
        bubbleBoss.redInWay = function(E, j, J, w)
            return (bubbleBoss.pathTouchesRed(E, j, J, V, w))
        end
        local V = { 20, -20, 35, -35, 50, -50, 70, -70, 90, -90, 115, -115, 140, -140 }
        bubbleBoss.route = function(vector, vector2, J)
            if
                not (bubbleBoss.orbLaneHit and bubbleBoss.orbLaneHit(vector.X, vector.Z, vector2.X, vector2.Z))
                and not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, vector2, J)
            then
                return vector2
            end
            local w, Y = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local v = sqrt(w * w + Y * Y)
            if v < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local M, Z = w / v, Y / v
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                bubbleBoss.folder,
            }
            Y, w = infinity
            for index, entry in ipairs(config.routeLegs or { 8, 14, 22 }) do
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(V) do
                    repeat
                        if abs(entry2) > (config.routeMaxAngle or 70) then
                            break
                        end
                        index = toRadians(entry2)
                        local o, A = M * cos(index) - Z * sin(index), M * sin(index) + Z * cos(index)
                        index2 = Vector3.new(vector.X + o * entry, vector.Y, vector.Z + A * entry)
                        if
                            not parent:Raycast(
                                vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
                                Vector3.new(o, 0, A) * (entry + 2),
                                raycastParams
                            )
                            and not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, index2, J)
                            and not (
                                bubbleBoss.orbLaneHit
                                and bubbleBoss.orbLaneHit(vector.X, vector.Z, index2.X, index2.Z)
                            )
                        then
                            local E = sqrt((vector2.X - index2.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - index2.Z) ^ 2)
                            if E < v - (config.routeMinGain or 1) then
                                local v = not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(index2, vector2, J)
                                local j, J = entry + E, v and 0 or (config.routeNotThrough or 400)
                                v = j + J
                                if v < Y then
                                    Y, w = v, index2
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    until true
                end
            end
            return w
        end
        bubbleBoss.redRoute = function(vector, vector2, J)
            if not bubbleBoss.redInWay(vector, vector2, J) then
                return vector2
            end
            local w, Y = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local v = sqrt(w * w + Y * Y)
            if v < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local M, Z, n = w / v, Y / v, max(J or 16, 4)
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                bubbleBoss.folder,
            }
            w, Y = infinity
            for index, entry in ipairs(config.routeLegs or { 8, 14, 22 }) do
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(V) do
                    repeat
                        if abs(entry2) > (config.routeMaxAngle or 70) then
                            break
                        end
                        index2 = toRadians(entry2)
                        local V, A = M * cos(index2) - Z * sin(index2), M * sin(index2) + Z * cos(index2)
                        index = Vector3.new(vector.X + V * entry, vector.Y, vector.Z + A * entry)
                        if
                            not parent:Raycast(
                                vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
                                Vector3.new(V, 0, A) * (entry + 2),
                                raycastParams
                            ) and not bubbleBoss.redInWay(vector, index, J)
                        then
                            local V = sqrt((vector2.X - index.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - index.Z) ^ 2)
                            if V < v - (config.routeMinGain or 1) then
                                local E = not bubbleBoss.redInWay(index, vector2, J, entry / n)
                                local j, J = entry + V, E and 0 or (config.routeNotThrough or 400)
                                E = j + J
                                if E < w then
                                    w, Y = E, index
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    until true
                end
            end
            return Y
        end
        local V, E = { 25, -25, 45, -45, 70, -70, 95, -95, 125, -125 }, 1
        local j, J, w = -infinity
        local Y = {}
        local function v(M, Z)
            local n, iteratePairs = {}, pairs
            local r = hazardReader.parts or {}
            for key, entry in iteratePairs(r) do
                local parent2 = key.Parent
                if parent2 then
                    local f = string.lower(key.Name)
                    local r = f:find("bouncingorb", 1, true)
                        and not f:find("good", 1, true)
                        and not (f == "bonusbossbouncingorbbad" and config.redOrbNoPath ~= false)
                    if r then
                        local osp = sqrt((entry.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (entry.vz or 0) ^ 2)
                        local k = osp > 2
                        if k then
                            local k, osp2, a =
                                not M and not Z and context.isBlueOrb(f) and (config.blueLaneFrac or 0.75) or 1,
                                osp * (M or config.orbLaneTime or config.bubbleTrajLead or 2.4),
                                M and infinity or (config.orbLaneMax or 120)
                            local Z, e = min(osp2, a) * k, max(key.Size.X, key.Size.Z) * 0.5
                            local N = e
                                + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
                                + (config.orbLaneMargin or 2)
                                + (entry.box and entry.box.pad or 0)
                            local blue = context.isBlueOrb(f)
                            local orbX = key.Position.X
                            local orbZ = key.Position.Z
                            local function C(g, i, b, B, G, z)
                                local s = {
                                    ox = g,
                                    oz = i,
                                    ux = b,
                                    uz = B,
                                    L = G,
                                    w = N,
                                    vw = e,
                                    dL = z,
                                    blue = blue,
                                    orbX = orbX,
                                    orbZ = orbZ,
                                    osp = osp,
                                    t0 = 0,
                                    orb = key,
                                }
                                n[#n + 1] = s
                                return s
                            end
                            a = blue
                                    and config.orbPathFollow ~= false
                                    and entry.orbSlot ~= nil
                                    and context.orbLegs
                                    and context.orbLegs(entry.orbSlot)
                                or nil
                            if a then
                                osp2 = entry.orbPathSpd or max(osp, config.orbBlueSpeed or 25)
                                local o, e =
                                    osp2 * (M or config.orbLaneTime or config.bubbleTrajLead or 2.4),
                                    M and infinity or (config.orbLaneMax or 120)
                                local M, g = min(o, e) * k, entry.orbLegN or 1
                                local k, i, b, B = a[g], entry.orbAlong or 0
                                b, B = k.x + k.ux * i, k.z + k.uz * i
                                e = 0
                                while k and M > 0.5 do
                                    o = min(k.len - i, M)
                                    if o > 0.05 then
                                        local G = C(b, B, k.ux, k.uz, o, o)
                                        G.rec = true
                                        G.t0 = e
                                        G.osp = osp2
                                        e += o / osp2
                                        M = M - o
                                    else
                                    end
                                    g += 1
                                    k, i = a[g], 0
                                    if k then
                                        b, B = k.x, k.z
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                local M = entry.bounced
                                local o = M and M.rec
                                if o then
                                    local k = (U or os.clock()) - (M.at or 0)
                                    if k >= 0 and k <= (config.orbConeAfter or 0.2) then
                                        local x = C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, Z, Z)
                                        x.rec = true
                                        x.t0 = -k
                                    end
                                end
                                o = M
                                    and not M.rec
                                    and not (blue and config.orbBlueNoGuess ~= false)
                                    and config.orbBounceCone ~= false
                                if o then
                                    local k = (U or os.clock()) - (M.at or 0)
                                    if k >= 0 and k <= (config.orbConeAfter or 0.2) then
                                        local x = Z * (config.orbConeLenFrac or 0.6)
                                        local a = C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, x, x)
                                        a.cone = math.tan(math.rad((config.orbBounceConeDeg or 65) * 0.5))
                                        a.bounce = true
                                        a.t0 = -k
                                    end
                                end
                                M = entry.bounce
                                if M and (M.dist or infinity) < Z then
                                    C(orbX, orbZ, entry.vx / osp, entry.vz / osp, M.dist + N, M.dist)
                                    local k, bounce2 = Z - M.dist, entry.bounce2
                                    if M.rec then
                                        if M.dist > (config.orbConeGone or 1.5) then
                                            o = C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, k, k)
                                            o.rec = true
                                            o.t0 = M.dist / osp
                                        end
                                    elseif not (blue and config.orbBlueNoGuess ~= false) then
                                        if config.orbBounceMirror == true then
                                            if
                                                M.dist > (config.orbConeGone or 1.5)
                                                and M.dist <= (config.orbConeNear or 25)
                                            then
                                                local o = k
                                                    * (config.orbMirrorLenFrac or config.orbConeLenFrac or 0.6)
                                                local a = C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, o, o)
                                                a.bounce = true
                                                a.t0 = M.dist / osp + (config.orbBounceDelay or 0)
                                            end
                                        elseif config.orbBounceCone ~= false then
                                            if
                                                M.dist > (config.orbConeGone or 1.5)
                                                and M.dist <= (config.orbConeNear or 70)
                                            then
                                                local o = k * (config.orbConeLenFrac or 0.6)
                                                local a = C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, o, o)
                                                a.cone = math.tan(math.rad((config.orbBounceConeDeg or 65) * 0.5))
                                                a.bounce = true
                                                a.t0 = M.dist / osp
                                            end
                                        elseif bounce2 and (bounce2.dist or infinity) < k then
                                            C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, bounce2.dist + N, bounce2.dist)
                                            C(
                                                bounce2.x,
                                                bounce2.z,
                                                bounce2.dx,
                                                bounce2.dz,
                                                k - bounce2.dist,
                                                k - bounce2.dist
                                            )
                                        else
                                            C(M.x, M.z, M.dx, M.dz, k, k)
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                    C(orbX, orbZ, entry.vx / osp, entry.vz / osp, Z, Z)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return n
        end
        local function M(Z, n, f)
            for index = 1, #Z, 1 do
                local o = Z[index]
                local Z, A = n - o.ox, f - o.oz
                index = Z * o.ux + A * o.uz
                if
                    index > -o.w
                    and index < o.L
                    and abs(Z * o.uz - A * o.ux)
                        < o.w + (o.cone and max(index, 0) * o.cone or 0)
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.orbLaneAt = function(Z, n)
            return config.orbLaneAvoid ~= false and M(v(), Z, n)
        end
        bubbleBoss.blueBeamsLong = function(Z)
            local n = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(v(Z)) do
                if entry.blue then
                    n[#n + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return n
        end
        bubbleBoss.blueBeams = function()
            local Z = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(v()) do
                if entry.blue then
                    Z[#Z + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return Z
        end
        bubbleBoss.blueBeamsFull = function()
            local Z = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(v(nil, true)) do
                if entry.blue then
                    Z[#Z + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return Z
        end
        bubbleBoss.onBlueBeam = function(Z, n, f, r)
            r = r or bubbleBoss.blueBeams()
            local o, A = dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8, config.orbBeamMargin or 1
            for index = 1, #r, 1 do
                local x = r[index]
                local r, k = Z - x.ox, n - x.oz
                local Z, n = r * x.ux + k * x.uz, x.vw + o + A + (f or 0)
                if
                    Z > -n
                    and Z < (x.dL or x.L) + n
                    and abs(r * x.uz - k * x.ux) < n + (x.cone and max(Z, 0) * x.cone or 0)
                then
                    return x
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.wallBeams = function()
            local wallBeamsAt = os.clock()
            if
                bubbleBoss.wallBeamsList
                and wallBeamsAt - (bubbleBoss.wallBeamsAt or -infinity)
                    < (config.wallBeamsTTL or 0.004)
            then
                return bubbleBoss.wallBeamsList
            end
            local wallBeamsList = {}
            bubbleBoss.wallBeamsList = wallBeamsList
            bubbleBoss.wallBeamsAt = wallBeamsAt
            if not hazardReader.walls then
                return wallBeamsList
            end
            for key, wall in pairs(hazardReader.walls) do
                if wall.cx and wall.vx and wall.vz then
                    wallBeamsAt, key = nil
                    local o = 0
                    if context.wallVel then
                        wallBeamsAt, key, o = context.wallVel(wall)
                    else
                    end
                    o = o or 0
                    if o > 2 then
                        local A, zone =
                            #wallBeamsList + 1, {
                                cx = wall.cx,
                                cz = wall.cz,
                                ux = wallBeamsAt,
                                uz = key,
                                nx = -key,
                                nz = wallBeamsAt,
                                vl = o,
                                half = wall.halfLen or 30,
                            }
                        zone.thick, wallBeamsList[A] = (wall.halfThick or 6) + (config.wallLanePad or 2), zone
                    end
                end
            end
            return wallBeamsList
        end
        bubbleBoss.wallTimes = function(zone, n, f)
            local r, o, A, k = dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8, config.wallSafeGap or 2.5, n - zone.cx, f - zone.cz
            local n, f, x = A * zone.ux + k * zone.uz, A * zone.nx + k * zone.nz, zone.half + r + o
            if abs(f) >= x or n <= -(zone.thick + r + o) then
                return nil
            end
            return max(n - zone.thick - r - o, 0) / zone.vl,
                (x + (config.wallOffPad or 2.5) - abs(f)) / (config.burstMax or 28),
                n,
                f
        end
        bubbleBoss.onWallBeam = function(Z, n, f, r)
            r = r or bubbleBoss.wallBeams()
            local o = config.wallSpare or 0.8
            for index = 1, #r, 1 do
                local k, x, a, e = bubbleBoss.wallTimes(r[index], Z, n)
                if k and k - (f or 0) <= x + o then
                    return r[index], k - (f or 0), x, a, e
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.wallsComing = function(Z, n, f)
            if config.wallNoToward == false then
                return nil
            end
            f = f or bubbleBoss.wallBeams()
            local r
            for index = 1, #f, 1 do
                local A = bubbleBoss.wallTimes(f[index], Z, n)
                if A and A <= (config.wallTowardT or 3.5) then
                    r = r or {}
                    r[#r + 1] = f[index]
                else
                end
            end
            return r
        end
        bubbleBoss.towardWall = function(Z, n, f)
            if not f then
                return false
            end
            local r = sqrt(Z * Z + n * n)
            if r < 0.001 then
                return false
            end
            for index = 1, #f, 1 do
                if (Z * f[index].ux + n * f[index].uz) / r < -(config.wallTowardCos or 0.1) then
                    return f[index]
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.wallPathSafe = function(vector, n, f, r, o)
            o = o or bubbleBoss.wallBeams()
            if #o == 0 then
                return true
            end
            local A, k = n.X - vector.X, n.Z - vector.Z
            local x, a, e, N =
                sqrt(A * A + k * k), max(f or 16, 4), dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8, config.wallSafeGap or 2.5
            n = max(1, math.ceil(x / 2))
            for index = 0, n, 1 do
                f = index / n
                local n, F, C = vector.X + A * f, vector.Z + k * f, (r or 0) + x * f / a
                for index2 = 1, #o, 1 do
                    index = o[index2]
                    local Z, f = n - index.cx, F - index.cz
                    local n, r = Z * index.ux + f * index.uz - index.vl * C, Z * index.nx + f * index.nz
                    if abs(n) < index.thick + e + N and abs(r) < index.half + e + N then
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        bubbleBoss.yellowAt = function(Z, n, f, r)
            if config.rodinYellowAvoid == false or not context.rodinOrbs() then
                return false
            end
            local o, A, k, x, a =
                dangerGeometry.boxes or {},
                dangerGeometry.halfHeight or 4,
                dangerGeometry.origin and dangerGeometry.origin.Y or 0,
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                config.dodgeLead or 1.2
            for index = 1, #o, 1 do
                local N = o[index]
                if not N.moving and not N.noDraw and N.cx and T(N) >= 2 then
                    index = N.from or 0
                    if index > f and index - f <= a and (N.untilAt or infinity) >= index then
                        local f = contextDepthOf(N, Z, k, n, A)
                        if f and f ~= -infinity and f >= -x then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if
                not (
                    hazardReader.sweepOrbFree ~= nil
                    and os.clock() - hazardReader.sweepOrbFree < (config.sweepOrbFreeFor or 1)
                ) and bubbleBoss.onBlueBeam(Z, n, 0, r)
            then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.bobOrbPathSafe = function(vector, Z, n)
            local bobOrbs = bubbleBoss.bobOrbs
            if not bobOrbs or #bobOrbs == 0 then
                return true
            end
            local r, o = Z.X - vector.X, Z.Z - vector.Z
            local A, k = sqrt(r * r + o * o), max(n or 16, 4)
            local x, a, e, N =
                A / k + (config.bobOrbAfter or 0.6),
                config.bobOrbKeep or 12,
                config.orbSpeed or 17,
                config.bobOrbStep or 0.1
            for index = 1, #bobOrbs, 1 do
                n = bobOrbs[index]
                Z, index = n.x, n.z
                local f = sqrt((vector.X - Z) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - index) ^ 2)
                local F, vector2, g =
                    if f < a + 2 then f - 2 else a,
                    config.crystalShield ~= false
                            and n.homing
                            and n.colour
                            and context.bobCrystal
                            and context.bobCrystal(n.colour)
                        or nil,
                    (config.crystalShieldR or 6.5) ^ 2
                if F > 0 then
                    local a, i = F * F, N
                    while i <= x do
                        if vector2 and (Z - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (index - vector2.Z) ^ 2 < g then
                            break
                        end
                        if n.homing then
                            f = A > 0.01 and min((i - N) * k, A) / A or 0
                            local x, F = vector.X + r * f - Z, vector.Z + o * f - index
                            local f = sqrt(x * x + F * F)
                            if f > 0.01 then
                                Z, index = Z + x / f * e * N, index + F / f * e * N
                            else
                            end
                        else
                            Z, index = Z + n.vx * N, index + n.vz * N
                        end
                        local n = A > 0.01 and min(i * k, A) / A or 0
                        local f, A = vector.X + r * n, vector.Z + o * n
                        if (f - Z) * (f - Z) + (A - index) * (A - index) < a then
                            return false
                        end
                        i = i + N
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        bubbleBoss.spikeSide = function(D, vector, zone, f)
            if not (zone and zone.cx) then
                return nil
            end
            local dangerAt = context.dangerAt
            local logT = context.logT
            if not dangerAt then
                return nil
            end
            local A = zone.cx
            local k = zone.cz
            local x = config.spikeSameCast or 10
            local a = zone.r or zone.size and zone.size.X * 0.5 or 46
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.zones or {}) do
                if
                    string.lower(tostring(entry.name or "")):find("spike", 1, true)
                    and entry.cx
                    and (entry.untilAt or 0) > D
                    and (entry.cx - A) ^ 2 + (entry.cz - k) ^ 2 < x * x
                then
                    index = entry.r or entry.size and entry.size.X * 0.5 or 0
                    a = if index > a then index else a
                else
                end
            end
            local function e(zone2)
                if not zone2.cx or (zone2.cx - A) ^ 2 + (zone2.cz - k) ^ 2 >= x * x then
                    return false
                end
                return string.lower(tostring(zone2.name or "")):find("spike", 1, true) ~= nil
            end
            local x = vector.X
            local N = vector.Y
            local I = vector.Z
            local F, C = x - A, I - k
            local A, k, g = sqrt(F * F + C * C), 0, 0
            if A > 0.5 then
                k, g = F / A, C / A
            else
            end
            local i = a + (config.spikeSideOver or 6)
            local a, b, B, G, spikeSidePick =
                max(i - A, 0),
                max(f or 26, 8),
                dangerGeometry.now or D,
                max((zone.from or D) - D, 0),
                bubbleBoss.spikeSidePick
            if spikeSidePick and spikeSidePick.zone ~= zone then
                bubbleBoss.spikeSidePick = nil
                spikeSidePick = nil
            else
            end
            if
                spikeSidePick
                and (x - spikeSidePick.x0) ^ 2 + (I - spikeSidePick.z0) ^ 2 > (config.spikeSideCommit or 6) ^ 2
            then
                return spikeSidePick
            end
            if spikeSidePick and D - spikeSidePick.at < (config.spikeSideEvery or 0.15) then
                return spikeSidePick
            end
            local s = dangerGeometry.reach or 2
            local T = config.spikeSideRoomCap or 96
            local function K(t, H, X)
                if dangerAt(t, N, H, X, s + T, 0, e) <= 0 then
                    return T
                end
                local QF, LF = T, 0
                while QF - LF > 8 do
                    local SF = (LF + QF) * 0.5
                    if dangerAt(t, N, H, X, s + SF, 0, e) > 0 then
                        QF = SF
                    else
                        LF = SF
                    end
                end
                return LF
            end
            local s, t, costs, X, position, LF =
                config.spikeSideHeadings or 16,
                config.spikeSideStep or 6,
                {},
                context.bobLine and context.bobLine() or nil
            if
                config.spikeSideReach ~= false
                and context.bobPullTo
                and context.bobPullTo(D)
                and context.bobAggroR
            then
                f = context.BR and context.BR.target
                if f and f.isBoss and f.root and f.root.Parent then
                    position, LF = f.root.Position, context.bobAggroR(f)
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local SF, cost, spikeSidePick2 = infinity
            for index2 = 0, s - 1, 1 do
                f = index2 * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / s
                local lF, cF = math.cos(f), math.sin(f)
                local f = F * lF + C * cF
                local run = -f + sqrt(max(f * f - A * A + i * i, 0))
                if run <= a + (config.spikeSideExtra or 14) then
                    local cost2, C, i, uF = t, 0, 0, 0
                    while cost2 < run do
                        f = dangerAt(x + lF * cost2, N, I + cF * cost2, D + cost2 / b - B, nil, nil, e)
                        C = if f > C then f else C
                        i += f
                        uF += 1
                        cost2 = cost2 + t
                    end
                    local f = x + lF * run
                    local t = I + cF * run
                    cost2 = D + run / b - B
                    local B, hF, mF =
                        dangerAt(f, N, t, cost2, nil, nil, e)
                            + 0.8 * dangerAt(f, N, t, cost2 + 0.6, nil, nil, e)
                            + 0.6 * dangerAt(f, N, t, cost2 + 1.2, nil, nil, e)
                            + 0.4 * dangerAt(f, N, t, cost2 + 2, nil, nil, e),
                        run / b - G,
                        K(f, t, cost2 + 1)
                    cost2 = C * 3
                        + (uF > 0 and i / uF or 0)
                        + B
                        + (run - a) * (config.spikeSideLenCost or 0.01)
                        + (1 - mF / T) * (config.spikeSideRoomCost or 0.6)
                        + (hF > 0 and hF * (config.spikeSideLateCost or 1.5) or 0)
                        + (1 - (lF * k + cF * g)) * 0.05
                    if X then
                        mF, hF, B = context.bobLinePoint(f, t, X)
                        cost2 = if B
                            then cost2
                                + min(B / (config.spikeSideLineScale or 40), 1.5)
                                    * (config.spikeSideLineCost or 0.8)
                            else cost2
                    else
                    end
                    if position then
                        B = sqrt((f - position.X) ^ 2 + (t - position.Z) ^ 2) - LF
                        cost2 = if B > 0
                            then cost2
                                + min(B / (config.spikeSideReachScale or 20), 1.5)
                                    * (config.spikeSideReachCost or 0.6)
                            else cost2
                    else
                    end
                    if cost2 < SF or spikeSidePick and spikeSidePick.i == index2 then
                        local success, success2 = pcall(function()
                            local e, C = Vector3.new(f, N + 4, t), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
                            return parent:Raycast(e, C, raycastParams)
                        end)
                        cost2 = if not (success and success2) then cost2 + 5 else cost2
                        success2, success = pcall(function()
                            local e, C = Vector3.new(x, N, I), Vector3.new(f - x, 0, t - I)
                            return parent:Raycast(e, C, raycastParams)
                        end)
                        cost2 = if bubbleBoss.pathBlocked
                                and bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, Vector3.new(f, N, t), b)
                                and tostring(bubbleBoss.blockReason or ""):find("arena", 1, true)
                            then (if success2 and success then cost2 + 5 else cost2) + 4
                            else if success2 and success then cost2 + 5 else cost2
                    else
                    end
                    costs[index2 + 1] = cost2
                    cost = if spikeSidePick and spikeSidePick.i == index2 then cost2 else cost
                    if cost2 < SF then
                        spikeSidePick2 = {
                            zone = zone,
                            i = index2,
                            ux = lF,
                            uz = cF,
                            x0 = x,
                            z0 = I,
                            at = D,
                            cost = cost2,
                            run = run,
                        }
                        SF = cost2
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if
                spikeSidePick
                and cost
                and (not spikeSidePick2 or cost <= SF + (config.spikeSideSwitch or 0.3))
            then
                spikeSidePick.at = D
                spikeSidePick.cost = cost
                spikeSidePick.costs = costs
                return spikeSidePick
            end
            if not spikeSidePick2 then
                return nil
            end
            spikeSidePick2.costs = costs
            bubbleBoss.spikeSidePick = spikeSidePick2
            bubbleBoss.spikeSideWhy = ("side %d of %d: cost %.2f, run %.0f (straight %.0f)"):format(
                spikeSidePick2.i,
                s,
                spikeSidePick2.cost,
                spikeSidePick2.run,
                a
            )
            if logT then
                logT("spikes", 1, "Dodge", "spike cast on us - " .. bubbleBoss.spikeSideWhy)
            end
            return spikeSidePick2
        end
        bubbleBoss.spikeBackPoint = function(success, vector)
            local success2 = hazardReader.orbLead
            local f = success2 and success2.ray
            hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = nil
            if not (f and f.ux) then
                hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = "no ray"
                return nil
            end
            local r, o, A, k, x, a = f.ux, f.uz, config.burstMax or 28, config.spikeKeepPad or 6, false, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.zones or {}) do
                if
                    string.lower(tostring(entry.name or "")):find("spike", 1, true)
                    and entry.cframe
                    and entry.size
                    and success <= (entry.untilAt or success)
                then
                    x = true
                    index, success2 = entry.cframe.Position, entry.size.X * 0.5 + k
                    local I, F = vector.X - index.X, vector.Z - index.Z
                    local e, C = I * r + F * o, I * I + F * F - success2 * success2
                    F = if C < 0 then -e + sqrt(max(e * e - C, 0)) else 0
                    if F > A * max((entry.from or success) - success, 0) + 1 then
                        hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = ("late: exit %.0f in %.1fs"):format(
                            F,
                            (entry.from or success) - success
                        )
                        return nil
                    end
                    a = if F > a then F else a
                else
                end
            end
            if not x then
                hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = "no spikes"
                return nil
            end
            f = a + 4
            local x = vector.X + r * f
            local a = vector.Z + o * f
            success, r = pcall(function()
                local o, e = Vector3.new(x, vector.Y + 4, a), Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
                return parent:Raycast(o, e, raycastParams)
            end)
            if not (success and r) then
                hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = ("no floor at %.0f"):format(f)
                return nil
            end
            success2, k = pcall(function()
                local D, r = Vector3.new(vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z), Vector3.new(x - vector.X, 0, a - vector.Z)
                return parent:Raycast(D, r, raycastParams)
            end)
            if success2 and k then
                hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = ("wall %s at %.0f"):format(
                    tostring(k.Instance and k.Instance.Name),
                    f
                )
                return nil
            end
            if
                bubbleBoss.bobOrbs
                and #bubbleBoss.bobOrbs > 0
                and not bubbleBoss.bobOrbPathSafe(vector, Vector3.new(x, vector.Y, a), A)
            then
                hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = ("orb in the way at %.0f"):format(f)
                return nil
            end
            hazardReader.spikeBackWhy = ("back %.0f"):format(f)
            return Vector3.new(x, vector.Y, a), f
        end
        bubbleBoss.spikeOutrun = function(D, vector)
            local n = hazardReader.orbLead
            hazardReader.spikeOutrunWhy = nil
            if not (n and n.goal) then
                return false
            end
            local f = hazardReader.orbSteer
            local r = f and f.p and f.colour == n.colour and D - (f.at or 0) < 1.5 and f.p or n.goal
            f, n = r.X - vector.X, r.Z - vector.Z
            r = sqrt(f * f + n * n)
            if r < 8 then
                hazardReader.spikeOutrunWhy = "aim close"
                return false
            end
            local o, A, k, x, a = f / r, n / r, config.tweenEscape or 26, config.spikeKeepPad or 6, false
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.zones or {}) do
                n = string.lower(tostring(entry.name or ""))
                if n:find("spike", 1, true) and entry.cframe and entry.size and D <= (entry.untilAt or D) then
                    local position, I, F =
                        entry.cframe.Position,
                        entry.size.X * 0.5,
                        max((entry.from or D) - D, 0) + (config.spikeKeepLag or 0.35)
                    index = min(k * F, r)
                    local D, r = vector.X + o * index, vector.Z + A * index
                    if
                        (D - position.X) * (D - position.X)
                            + (r - position.Z) * (r - position.Z)
                        < (I + x) * (I + x)
                    then
                        hazardReader.spikeOutrunWhy = ("in %s r%.0f at +%.1fs (%.0f along)"):format(
                            n:sub(1, 12),
                            I,
                            F,
                            index
                        )
                        return false
                    end
                    a = true
                else
                end
            end
            hazardReader.spikeOutrunWhy = a and "clear" or "no spikes"
            return a
        end
        bubbleBoss.orbPathSafe = function(vector, vector2, n, f)
            local r, o = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local A = sqrt(r * r + o * o)
            if A < 0.5 then
                return true
            end
            local k, x, a, e, N, I, F, C, g, i, b, B =
                max(n or 16, 4),
                math.clamp(math.ceil(A / 2), 1, 80),
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                max(
                    config.orbSafeGap or 2.5,
                    config.orbGapHitbox ~= false and context.playerHitboxW and context.playerHitboxW() or 0
                ),
                config.orbBeamMargin or 1,
                v(),
                r / A,
                o / A,
                math.cos(math.rad(config.orbSameWayDeg or 66)),
                config.orbSameWayNear or 10,
                max(config.orbSafeGapSame or 0.5, config.orbSameWayKeep or 1.5),
                hazardReader.sweepOrbFree ~= nil
                    and (U or os.clock()) - hazardReader.sweepOrbFree
                        < (config.sweepOrbFreeFor or 1)
            for index = 1, #I, 1 do
                n = I[index]
                local I, G, z = n.osp or 0, n.vw + a + N, F * n.ux + C * n.uz >= g
                if z and i > 0 then
                    local N, F = n.orbX or n.ox, n.orbZ or n.oz
                    z = if sqrt((vector.X - N) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - F) ^ 2) < n.vw + a + i then false else z
                else
                end
                local N, F = n.vw + a, z and b or (n.cone and (config.orbSafeGapCone or 1) or e)
                index = N + F
                if B then
                    F = dangerGeometry.halfWidth or 1
                    local e, C =
                        n.vw + F, config.touchdownGap or context.playerHitboxW and context.playerHitboxW()
                    index = e + (C or 2 * F) + (dangerGeometry.lag or 0)
                else
                end
                F, N = vector.X - n.ox, vector.Z - n.oz
                local e, C = F * n.ux + N * n.uz, abs(F * n.uz - N * n.ux)
                F, N =
                    e > -G and e < (n.dL or n.L) + G and C < G + (n.cone and max(e, 0) * n.cone or 0),
                    min(index, n.vw + a + (config.orbLeaveGap or 1))
                e, C = not F and max(config.orbCrossSpare or 0.4, 0) or 0, false
                for index2 = 0, x, 1 do
                    local g = index2 / x
                    local x, i = vector.X + r * g, vector.Z + o * g
                    local D, r = x - n.ox, i - n.oz
                    i, x = D * n.ux + r * n.uz, abs(D * n.uz - r * n.ux)
                    if i > -G and i < (n.dL or n.L) + G and x < G + (n.cone and max(i, 0) * n.cone or 0) then
                        D = (f or 0) + A * g / k - (n.t0 or 0)
                        if D >= -0.2 - e then
                            local f, o, A = I * max(D - e, 0), I * max(D + e, 0)
                            if n.cone then
                                r = sqrt(i * i + x * x)
                                A = r < f and f - r or r > o and r - o or 0
                            else
                                index2 = i < f and f - i or i > o and i - o or 0
                                A = sqrt(index2 * index2 + x * x)
                            end
                            if A < index then
                                if not F or A < N then
                                    return false
                                end
                                C = true
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if C then
                    F, index = vector2.X - n.ox, vector2.Z - n.oz
                    e, I = F * n.ux + index * n.uz, abs(F * n.uz - index * n.ux)
                    if
                        not (e <= -G or e >= (n.dL or n.L) + G or I >= G + (n.cone and max(e, 0) * n.cone or 0))
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        bubbleBoss.orbArrive = function(D, U, Z)
            Z = Z or (v())
            local n, f, r =
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                max(
                    config.orbSafeGap or 2.5,
                    config.orbGapHitbox ~= false and context.playerHitboxW and context.playerHitboxW() or 0
                ),
                infinity
            for index = 1, #Z, 1 do
                local S = Z[index]
                local m, Z, o, A = max(S.osp or 0, 1), S.vw + n + f, D - S.ox, U - S.oz
                local D, U = o * S.ux + A * S.uz, abs(o * S.uz - A * S.ux)
                index = nil
                if S.cone then
                    index = if D > -Z
                            and D < (S.dL or S.L) + Z
                            and U < Z + max(D, 0) * S.cone
                        then (S.t0 or 0) + max(sqrt(D * D + U * U) - Z, 0) / m
                        else index
                else
                    if U < Z and D < (S.dL or S.L) + Z then
                        o = sqrt(Z * Z - U * U)
                        index = if D + o >= 0 then (S.t0 or 0) + max(D - o, 0) / m else index
                    else
                    end
                end
                r = if index and index < r then index else r
            end
            return r
        end
        bubbleBoss.orbCrossIn = function(d, S, D, l)
            if bubbleBoss.orbPathSafe(d, S, D, 0) then
                return 0
            end
            local m, U = config.orbCrossStep or 0.15, l or config.orbCrossLook or 2
            l = m
            while l <= U + 1.0E-6 do
                if bubbleBoss.orbPathSafe(d, S, D, l) then
                    return l
                end
                l += m
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.orbLaneHit = function(d, S, D, l)
            if config.orbLaneAvoid == false then
                return false
            end
            if
                hazardReader.sweepOrbFree ~= nil
                and os.clock() - hazardReader.sweepOrbFree < (config.sweepOrbFreeFor or 1)
            then
                return false
            end
            if
                runtimeState.escRedAt ~= nil
                and os.clock() - runtimeState.escRedAt < 0.25
                and config.rodinYellowFreeInRed ~= false
            then
                return not bubbleBoss.orbPathSafe(
                    Vector3.new(d, 0, S),
                    Vector3.new(D, 0, l),
                    config.burstMax or 28
                )
            end
            local L = v()
            if #L == 0 then
                return false
            end
            local O, m = D - d, l - S
            l = max(math.ceil(sqrt(O * O + m * m) / 4), 1)
            for index = 1, l, 1 do
                if M(L, d + O * index / l, S + m * index / l) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        bubbleBoss.detour = function(vector, vector2, O)
            local S = bubbleBoss.flipDetour
            if S then
                bubbleBoss.flipDetour = nil
                local D, l, u = -E, os
                u, E = l.clock(), D
                j = u
                bubbleBoss.dGoal = nil
            end
            S = not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, vector2, O)
            if S then
                bubbleBoss.dGoal = nil
                J, w = nil, nil
                return nil
            end
            S = bubbleBoss.dGoal
            if S and os.clock() - S.at < config.bubbleCommit then
                if
                    sqrt((S.p.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (S.p.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                        > config.bubbleArrive
                    and not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, S.p, O)
                then
                    return S.p, S.deg
                end
            end
            bubbleBoss.dGoal = nil
            local D, l = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            S = sqrt(D * D + l * l)
            local u = S < 2
            if u then
                J, w = nil, nil
                return nil
            end
            local m, U, v, M = D / S, l / S, os.clock(), not J or w and S < w - 6
            if M then
                J, w = v, S
            end
            u = w and S < w
            if u then
                w = S
            end
            l = v - J > (config.bubbleDetourStuck or 3)
            u, D, M = min(S, config.bubbleDetourLeg * (l and 2.5 or 1)), v - j < (config.bubbleDetourStick or 4)
            if D then
                for index = #Y, 1, -1 do
                    Y[index] = nil
                end
                for index2, entry in ipairs(V) do
                    index2 = entry * E
                    if index2 > 0 then
                        Y[#Y + 1] = entry
                    end
                end
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(V) do
                    index3 = entry2 * E
                    if index3 <= 0 then
                        Y[#Y + 1] = entry2
                    end
                end
                M = Y
            else
                M = V
            end
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                players.LocalPlayer.Character,
                bubbleBoss.folder,
            }
            for index4, entry3 in ipairs(M) do
                D = toRadians(entry3)
                index4, v = m * cos(D) - U * sin(D), m * sin(D) + U * cos(D)
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(vector.X + index4 * u, vector.Y, vector.Z + v * u)
                local h = not parent:Raycast(
                    vector + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
                    Vector3.new(index4, 0, v) * (u + 3),
                    raycastParams
                ) and not bubbleBoss.pathBlocked(vector, vector3, O)
                if h then
                    index4 = sqrt((vector2.X - vector3.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - vector3.Z) ^ 2)
                    local d = l and index4 < S - 2 or index4 <= S + u * 0.5
                    if d then
                        bubbleBoss.dGoal = {
                            p = vector3,
                            at = os.clock(),
                            deg = entry3,
                        }
                        local d, Q, L = entry3 >= 0 and 1 or -1, os
                        L, E = Q.clock(), d
                        j = L
                        return vector3, entry3
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.stop = function()
            OF()
            for index = #dF, 1, -1 do
                dF[index] = nil
            end
            if bubbleBoss.folder then
                pcall(function()
                    bubbleBoss.folder:Destroy()
                end)
                bubbleBoss.folder = nil
            end
