            bubbleBoss.active = false
            bubbleBoss.primary = nil
            bubbleBoss.dir = nil
            bubbleBoss.lethal = false
            bubbleBoss.goal = nil
            bubbleBoss.dGoal = nil
            bubbleBoss.anchor = nil
        end
        bubbleBoss.status = function()
            return {
                active = bubbleBoss.active,
                lethal = bubbleBoss.lethal,
                threats = bubbleBoss.count,
                warm = bubbleBoss.warmCount,
                warnings = bubbleBoss.warnCount,
                escapes = bubbleBoss.escapes,
                primary = bubbleBoss.primary and bubbleBoss.primary.box.name or nil,
                tti = bubbleBoss.primary and bubbleBoss.primary.tti or nil,
            }
        end
    end

    components.movementCombat = function(context)
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local dangerGeometry = context.DG
        local contextDecide = context.decide
        local contextDangerAt = context.dangerAt
        local contextWalkable = context.walkable
        local contextRaycastParams = context.raycastParams
        local contextFloorY = context.floorY
        local contextSetState = context.setState
        local contextLogT = context.logT
        local contextDepthOf = context.depthOf
        local movementBoost = context.LC
        local contextWorkspace = context.Workspace
        local localPlayer = context.LocalPlayer
        local pathfindingService = context.PathfindingService
        local virtualInputManager = context.VirtualInputManager
        local sqrt = math.sqrt
        local abs = math.abs
        local max = math.max
        local min = math.min
        local cos = math.cos
        local sin = math.sin
        local toRadians = math.rad
        local infinity = math.huge
        local lowercase, f, r =
            string.lower, {
                0,
                15,
                -15,
                30,
                -30,
                45,
                -45,
                60,
                -60,
                75,
                -75,
                90,
                -90,
                100,
                -100,
                115,
                -115,
                130,
                -130,
            }, {
                0,
                20,
                -20,
                40,
                -40,
                60,
                -60,
                80,
                -80,
                100,
                -100,
                120,
                -120,
                145,
                -145,
                165,
                -165,
                180,
            }
        local function o()
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            local k = character and (character:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
            return k ~= nil and k.Value == true
        end
        local function contextCastWinding(k)
            k = k or runtimeState.castFace
            if config.castHoldWindup == false or not (k and k.dx and k.pressedAt) then
                return false
            end
            local x = os.clock() - k.pressedAt
            if runtimeState.pkSugar and x < (config.pkSugarHold or 1.4) then
                return true
            end
            if x < (config.castWindupMin or 0.75) then
                return true
            end
            return x < (config.castWindupMax or 1.3) and o()
        end
        context.castWinding = contextCastWinding
        local function o()
            local castFace = runtimeState.castFace
            return castFace ~= nil
                and castFace.dx ~= nil
                and (
                    os.clock() - (castFace.at or 0) < (config.castFaceHold or 0.45)
                    or contextCastWinding(castFace)
                )
        end
        local movement = {
            driving = false,
            controlsOff = false,
            restUntil = 0,
            boostSince = nil,
            facedAt = -infinity,
            counts = {
                arrive = 0,
                walked = 0,
                boost = 0,
            },
        }
        local combatBrain = {
            target = nil,
            waypoints = nil,
            index = 1,
            pathAt = -infinity,
            strafeDir = 1,
            strafeFlipAt = -infinity,
        }
        local function a(vector, vector2)
            local I, F = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
            return sqrt(I * I + F * F)
        end
        local function e()
            return runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk
        end
        local function N(I)
            local controlsAt = os.clock()
            if
                movement.controlsOff == not I
                and controlsAt - (movement.controlsAt or 0) < (config.controlsRecheck or 1)
            then
                return
            end
            if
                pcall(function()
                    local C = require(localPlayer.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule):GetControls()
                    if I then
                        C:Enable()
                    else
                        C:Disable()
                    end
                end)
            then
                movement.controlsOff = not I
                movement.controlsAt = controlsAt
            end
        end
        local function buffSeen()
            movement.controlsOff = false
            movement.controlsAt = 0
            movement.stallLogged = false
        end
        local F = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(buffSeen)
        if hazardReader and hazardReader.connections then
            hazardReader.connections[#hazardReader.connections + 1] = F
        end
        context.unbuffedOk = function(C)
            if config.unbuffedBurstBelowNL == true then
                return true
            end
            return not (context.belowNL and context.belowNL())
        end
        local function C(humanoid, i, lastSpeed)
            local B = os.clock()
            if not context.buffHoldsSpeed(B) and not context.unbuffedOk(B) then
                if i and context.buffPress then
                    pcall(context.buffPress, B)
                end
                if movementBoost.active() then
                    movementBoost.off()
                end
                local G = runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk or 16
                if humanoid.WalkSpeed > G + 0.5 then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = G
                    end)
                end
                movement.ourWalkSpeed = G
                runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = nil
                movement.boostSince = nil
                return
            end
            if context.buffHoldsSpeed(B) then
                local G = runtimeState.buffPressedAt or hazardReader.buffHolderSeenAt or 0
                if runtimeState.buffSpeedStamp ~= G then
                    runtimeState.buffSpeedStamp = G
                    if movementBoost.active() then
                        movementBoost.off()
                    end
                    local z = config.buffSpeed or config.burstMax or 28
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = z
                    end)
                    movement.ourWalkSpeed = z
                    runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = nil
                    movement.boostSince = nil
                    return
                end
                if movementBoost.active() then
                    G = humanoid.WalkSpeed
                    movementBoost.off()
                    if G > 0 and humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= G then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = G
                    end
                    movement.ourWalkSpeed = nil
                    runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = nil
                    movement.boostSince = nil
                end
                return
            end
            local G = humanoid.WalkSpeed
            if
                movement.ourWalkSpeed
                and math.abs(G - movement.ourWalkSpeed) > 0.01
                and (not runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore or math.abs(G - runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore) > 0.01)
            then
                movement.foreignUntil = G
                            < (runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore or runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk) - 0.5
                        and B + 2
                    or 0
                movement.ourWalkSpeed = nil
                runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = nil
            end
            if
                context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal == true
                or hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil
                or runtimeState.bobAggroAt ~= nil and B - runtimeState.bobAggroAt < 0.3
                or config.meleeBurst ~= false and runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil and B - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.3
                or config.rodinSpiralFullSpeed ~= false
                    and runtimeState.spiralRunAt ~= nil
                    and B - runtimeState.spiralRunAt < 0.3
            then
                movement.threatUntil = B + config.boostRelease
            end
            i = if B >= (movement.threatUntil or 0) then false else i
            i = if runtimeState.speedOff then false else i
            i = if context.buffHoldsSpeed(B) then false else i
            G = runtimeState.reflex ~= nil and runtimeState.reflex.name == "slam"
            i = if (movement.foreignUntil or 0) > B
                    and not G
                    and not (hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil and context.unbuffedOk(B))
                then false
                else i
            if context.BB ~= nil then
                G = context.BB.lethal == true
            end
            local lastRest = math.clamp(B - (movement.debtAt or B), 0, 0.5)
            movement.debtAt = B
            local z = runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore or runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk
            if movementBoost.boosted() then
                movement.debt = (movement.debt or 0) + math.max((movementBoost.speed() or z) - z, 0) * lastRest
            else
                movement.debt = math.max((movement.debt or 0) - (config.boostDrain or 8) * lastRest, 0)
            end
            z = config.boostLethalFree ~= false
                and (
                    context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal == true
                    or hazardReader.orbNear ~= nil and (hazardReader.orbNear.d or 999) < (config.orbBurstAt or 25)
                    or runtimeState.finishRushAt ~= nil and B - runtimeState.finishRushAt < 0.3
                    or runtimeState.tellRunAt ~= nil and B - runtimeState.tellRunAt < 0.3
                    or runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil
                        and B - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.3
                        and (runtimeState.meleeNearD or 99) < (config.meleeBurstAt or 20)
                )
            z = if not z
                    and config.rodinSpiralFullSpeed ~= false
                    and runtimeState.spiralRunAt ~= nil
                    and B - runtimeState.spiralRunAt < 0.3
                then true
                else z
            z = if not z
                    and config.leadBurstFree ~= false
                    and hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil
                    and context.unbuffedOk(B)
                then true
                else z
            z = if not z
                    and config.bobAggroBurstFree ~= false
                    and runtimeState.bobAggroAt ~= nil
                    and B - runtimeState.bobAggroAt < 0.3 + (config.boostRelease or 0.45)
                    and context.unbuffedOk(B)
                then true
                else z
            if
                i
                and movement.boostSince
                and not z
                and (
                    B - movement.boostSince > config.boostMaxRun
                    or (movement.debt or 0) >= (config.boostDebtMax or 12)
                )
            then
                lastRest = math.max(
                    config.boostRestMin or 0.4,
                    ((movement.debt or 0) - (config.boostDebtStart or 3)) / (config.boostDrain or 8)
                )
                movement.restUntil = B + lastRest
                movement.lastRest = lastRest
                i = false
            else
            end
            i = if i
                    and not movement.boostSince
                    and not z
                    and (movement.debt or 0) > (config.boostDebtStart or 3)
                then false
                else i
            if if (movement.restUntil or 0) > B and not z then false else i then
                if not runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore then
                    runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = math.min(humanoid.WalkSpeed, config.tweenWalk or 16)
                    movement.boostSince = B
                    movement.counts.boost = movement.counts.boost + 1
                end
                if lastSpeed >= (movement.lastSpeed or 0) - 0.01 then
                    movement.lastRaiseAt = B
                end
                movement.lastSpeed = lastSpeed
                movement.ourWalkSpeed = movementBoost.on(lastSpeed) or movementBoost.CONFIG.TargetSpeed
                return
            end
            if
                movement.boostSince
                and movement.lastSpeed
                and B - (movement.lastRaiseAt or 0) < (config.wsDownHold or 0.6)
            then
                movement.ourWalkSpeed = movementBoost.on(movement.lastSpeed) or movementBoost.CONFIG.TargetSpeed
                return
            end
            movementBoost.off()
            if runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore and not context.buffHoldsSpeed(B) then
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore
                end)
                movement.ourWalkSpeed = runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore
                runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore = nil
            end
            movement.boostSince = nil
        end
        context.burstAvailable = function(g)
            if runtimeState.speedOff then
                return false
            end
            if not context.unbuffedOk(g) then
                return context.buffHoldsSpeed(g)
            end
            if (movement.foreignUntil or 0) > g then
                return false
            end
            if
                config.rodinSpiralFullSpeed ~= false
                and runtimeState.spiralRunAt ~= nil
                and os.clock() - runtimeState.spiralRunAt < 0.3
            then
                return true
            end
            if
                config.boostLethalFree ~= false
                and (
                    context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal == true
                    or hazardReader.orbNear ~= nil and (hazardReader.orbNear.d or 999) < (config.orbBurstAt or 25)
                    or runtimeState.finishRushAt ~= nil and g - runtimeState.finishRushAt < 0.3
                    or runtimeState.tellRunAt ~= nil and g - runtimeState.tellRunAt < 0.3
                    or runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil
                        and g - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.3
                        and (runtimeState.meleeNearD or 99) < (config.meleeBurstAt or 20)
                )
            then
                return true
            end
            if (movement.restUntil or 0) > g then
                return false
            end
            if movement.boostSince then
                if
                    g - movement.boostSince > config.boostMaxRun
                    or (movement.debt or 0) >= (config.boostDebtMax or 12)
                then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            return (movement.debt or 0) <= (config.boostDebtStart or 3)
        end
        context.planSpeed = function(g)
            local i = runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk
            if runtimeState.speedOff then
                return i
            end
            if not context.unbuffedOk(g) then
                return context.buffHoldsSpeed(g) and (config.buffSpeed or 28) or i
            end
            if (movement.foreignUntil or 0) > g + (config.planAtWalkOver or 0.5) then
                return i
            end
            if (movement.restUntil or 0) > g + (config.planAtWalkOver or 0.5) then
                return i
            end
            i = context.BB and context.BB.primary
            if i and i.box and i.box.name == "firstbossjumpslam" then
                return config.slamBurstMax or config.tweenEscape
            end
            if i and i.box and context.burstBox(i.box.name) then
                return config.mageBurstMax or config.tweenEscape
            end
            return config.tweenEscape
        end
        context.mageArcSteer = function(vector, i, b)
            if not context.mageArcBad or (config.mageArcHard or 200) <= 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local magnitude = i.Magnitude
            if magnitude < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            local G, z, s = min(magnitude, config.mageArcLook or 10), i.X / magnitude, i.Z / magnitude
            if not context.mageArcBad(vector.X + z * G, vector.Z + s * G, vector.X, vector.Z) then
                return nil
            end
            local T, W =
                vector + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), {
                    15,
                    -15,
                    30,
                    -30,
                    45,
                    -45,
                    60,
                    -60,
                    75,
                    -75,
                    90,
                    -90,
                    110,
                    -110,
                    135,
                    -135,
                    160,
                    -160,
                    180,
                }
            for index, entry in ipairs(W) do
                i = toRadians(entry)
                local W, H = cos(i), sin(i)
                local i, X = z * W - s * H, z * H + s * W
                index, W = vector.X + i * G, vector.Z + X * G
                if
                    not context.mageArcBad(index, W, vector.X, vector.Z)
                    and not contextWorkspace:Raycast(T, Vector3.new(i, 0, X) * (G + 2), contextRaycastParams())
                    and not (
                        context.BB
                        and context.BB.pathBlocked
                        and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Vector3.new(index, vector.Y, W), b or 16)
                    )
                then
                    runtimeState.mageSteer = {
                        at = os.clock(),
                        deg = entry,
                    }
                    return Vector3.new(i, 0, X) * magnitude
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function g(humanoid, b, B, G, progAt)
            if hazardReader.rodinRig ~= nil and context.rodinFrontGuard then
                local success, T =
                    pcall(context.rodinFrontGuard, b.Position, B, runtimeState.brainNow or os.clock())
                B = if success and T then T else B
            else
            end
            local s = b.Position
            b = Vector3.new(B.X - s.X, 0, B.Z - s.Z)
            movement.driving = true
            N(false)
            local B = runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore or math.min(humanoid.WalkSpeed, config.tweenWalk or 16)
            if not runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore then
                runtimeState.walkSpeed = B
            end
            G = if (movement.escSpUntil or 0) > os.clock()
                    and movement.escSp
                    and G < movement.escSp
                    and (context.BB and context.BB.lethal)
                then movement.escSp
                else G
            if
                G > B + 0.5
                and not (runtimeState.firstCastWaitAt ~= nil and os.clock() - runtimeState.firstCastWaitAt < 0.5 and not (context.BB and context.BB.lethal))
                and (context.BB and context.BB.lethal or hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil or runtimeState.preWalk ~= nil and runtimeState.preWalk.active == true or runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil and os.clock() - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.3)
                and context.speedSkillFirst
            then
                context.speedSkillFirst(os.clock())
            end
            C(humanoid, G > B + 0.5, G)
            if b.Magnitude <= (progAt or 1) then
                movement.counts.arrive = movement.counts.arrive + 1
                movement.cmdDir, movement.cmdAt = nil, runtimeState.brainNow
                movementBoost.steer(nil)
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                movement.stallSince = nil
                return true
            end
            if config.cornerWrap ~= false then
                B = os.clock()
                if movement.cornerUntil and B < movement.cornerUntil and movement.cornerDir then
                    b = movement.cornerDir * b.Magnitude
                else
                    if (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0) > (config.cornerAfter or 0.5) and b.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                        local direction, W, K =
                            b.Unit, s + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), { 45, -45, 90, -90, 135, -135 }
                        for index, entry in ipairs(K) do
                            progAt = math.rad(entry)
                            index, entry = math.cos(progAt), math.sin(progAt)
                            local cornerDir = Vector3.new(
                                direction.X * index - direction.Z * entry,
                                0,
                                direction.X * entry + direction.Z * index
                            )
                            if
                                not contextWorkspace:Raycast(
                                    W,
                                    cornerDir * (config.cornerProbe or 8),
                                    contextRaycastParams()
                                )
                            then
                                movement.cornerDir, movement.cornerUntil =
                                    cornerDir, B + (config.cornerCommit or 0.7)
                                b = cornerDir * b.Magnitude
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            b = if config.mageArc ~= false
                    and b.Magnitude > 0.5
                    and not (context.BB and (context.BB.lethal or context.BB.goal ~= nil))
                then context.mageArcSteer(s, b, G) or b
                else b
            movement.counts.walked = movement.counts.walked + 1
            progAt = os.clock() - movement.facedAt < 0.25 or o()
            if humanoid.AutoRotate == progAt then
                humanoid.AutoRotate = not progAt
            end
            movementBoost.steer(b.Unit)
            if movementBoost.active() then
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            else
                progAt = math.clamp(G / max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1), 0.15, 1)
                progAt = if progAt < 1
                        and context.buffHoldsSpeed
                        and context.buffHoldsSpeed(os.clock())
                    then 1
                    else progAt
                B = b.Unit
                if config.wallSlide ~= false then
                    local G = config.wallSlideProbe or 4.5
                    local raycastResult =
                        contextWorkspace:Raycast(s + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), B * G, contextRaycastParams())
                    if raycastResult and raycastResult.Instance and raycastResult.Instance.CanCollide then
                        G = Vector3.new(raycastResult.Normal.X, 0, raycastResult.Normal.Z)
                        if G.Magnitude > 0.3 then
                            G = G.Unit
                            local vector = B - G * B:Dot(G)
                            if vector.Magnitude > 0.15 then
                                B = vector.Unit
                                movement.wallSlideAt = os.clock()
                                runtimeState.wallSlide = true
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if runtimeState.wallSlide and os.clock() - (movement.wallSlideAt or 0) > 0.3 then
                    runtimeState.wallSlide = false
                end
                movement.cmdDir, movement.cmdAt = B, runtimeState.brainNow
                humanoid:Move(B * progAt, false)
            end
            progAt = os.clock()
            if not movement.progPos or not movement.progAt then
                movement.progPos = s
                movement.progAt = progAt
            end
            if progAt - movement.progAt >= 1 then
                local G, T = s.X - movement.progPos.X, s.Z - movement.progPos.Z
                if math.sqrt(G * G + T * T) < (config.stallProgress or 1) then
                    movement.stallSince = movement.stallSince or movement.progAt
                else
                    movement.stallSince = nil
                end
                movement.progPos = s
                movement.progAt = progAt
            end
            runtimeState.stalledFor = movement.stallSince and progAt - movement.stallSince or 0
            if
                (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0)
                    > (
                        config.unstickFreefallFast ~= false
                            and humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                            and humanoid.RootPart
                            and humanoid.RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y > -(config.unstickFreefallFallSpeed or 4)
                            and (config.unstickFreefallAfter or 0.5)
                        or (config.unstickAfter or 2)
                    )
                and os.clock() - (movement.unstickAt or 0) > (config.unstickEvery or 3)
            then
                movement.unstickAt = os.clock()
                movement.unstickN = (movement.unstickN or 0) + 1
                progAt, B =
                    movement.unstickN % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1, b.Magnitude > 0.1 and b.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
                local b = Vector3.new(-B.Z * progAt, 0, B.X * progAt)
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid.Jump = true
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    while true do
                        local G, unstickFor = os.clock() - now, config.unstickFor
                        if not (G < (unstickFor or 0.4)) then
                            break
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid:Move(b, false)
                        end)
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end)
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                if context.log then
                    pcall(
                        context.log,
                        "Move",
                        ("unstick #%d: not moving for %.1fs - jump + sideways shove"):format(
                            movement.unstickN,
                            runtimeState.stalledFor or 0
                        )
                    )
                end
                runtimeState.unstickLast = {
                    at = os.clock(),
                    n = movement.unstickN,
                    md = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude,
                }
            end
            if (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0) > (config.stallReportAt or 1.5) and not movement.stallLogged then
                movement.stallLogged = true
                runtimeState.lastError =
                    "driving but the character is not moving - controls re-asserted (mobile: joystick?)"
                runtimeState.lastErrorAt = os.clock()
                if context.log then
                    pcall(
                        context.log,
                        "Move",
                        ("driving but not moving for %.1fs - controls re-asserted"):format(
                            runtimeState.stalledFor or 0
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            movement.lastPos = s
            return false
        end
        local function i(vector, vector2)
            local castFace = runtimeState.castFace
            if
                castFace
                and castFace.dx
                and (os.clock() - castFace.at < (config.castFaceHold or 0.45) or contextCastWinding(castFace))
            then
                if vector2 then
                    local z, s = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
                    local T = sqrt(z * z + s * s)
                    T = if T < 1 then config.aoeDistance or 39.6 else T
                    return Vector3.new(vector2.X + castFace.dx * T, vector.Y, vector2.Z + castFace.dz * T)
                end
                return Vector3.new(castFace.x, vector.Y, castFace.z)
            end
            return vector
        end
        local function b(parent, G, z)
            z = i(z, parent.Position)
            local position = parent.Position
            local vector = Vector3.new(z.X - position.X, 0, z.Z - position.Z)
            if vector.Magnitude < 0.5 then
                return false
            end
            local dqFaceAtt = parent:FindFirstChild("dq_faceAtt")
            if not dqFaceAtt then
                dqFaceAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
                dqFaceAtt.Name = "dq_faceAtt"
                dqFaceAtt.Parent = parent
            else
            end
            local W = parent:FindFirstChild("dq_faceAO")
            if not W then
                W = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
                W.Name = "dq_faceAO"
                W.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
                W.Attachment0 = dqFaceAtt
                W.RigidityEnabled = true
                W.Parent = parent
            else
            end
            W.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + vector.Unit)
            if not W.Enabled then
                W.Enabled = true
            end
            movement.facedAt = os.clock()
            if G.AutoRotate then
                G.AutoRotate = false
            end
            return true
        end
        local function contextFaceRelease(G)
            local z = G and (G:FindFirstChild("dq_faceAO"))
            if z and z.Enabled then
                z.Enabled = false
            end
        end
        context.faceRelease = contextFaceRelease
        local function G(z, s, T)
            T = i(T, z.Position)
            local position = z.Position
            local vector = Vector3.new(T.X - position.X, 0, T.Z - position.Z)
            if vector.Magnitude < 0.5 then
                return
            end
            movement.facedAt = os.clock()
            if s.AutoRotate then
                s.AutoRotate = false
            end
            if not (movement.driving and config.facePhysics ~= false and config.faceSnapWhileWalking ~= true) then
                z.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + vector.Unit)
            end
            if config.facePhysics ~= false then
                b(z, s, T)
            end
        end
        local function contextLockOnPress(s, T)
            local pressedAt = os.clock()
            local K, t, H, X
            if T then
                local dF = s.Position
                local QF, LF = T.X - dF.X, T.Z - dF.Z
                dF = sqrt(QF * QF + LF * LF)
                if dF >= 0.5 then
                    K, t, H, X = QF / dF, LF / dF, T.X, T.Z
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not K then
                T = s.CFrame.LookVector
                local dF = sqrt(T.X * T.X + T.Z * T.Z)
                if dF < 0.01 then
                    return
                end
                K, t = T.X / dF, T.Z / dF
                dF = context.aoeLanding and select(1, context.aoeLanding()) or config.aoeDistance or 39.6
                H, X = s.Position.X + K * dF, s.Position.Z + t * dF
            else
            end
            T = runtimeState.castFace
            if T and T.root == s and T.dx and T.dx * K + T.dz * t >= cos(toRadians(config.castFaceTolDeg or 8)) then
                T.at = pressedAt
                T.pressedAt = pressedAt
                return
            end
            runtimeState.castFace = {
                root = s,
                dx = K,
                dz = t,
                x = H,
                z = X,
                at = pressedAt,
                pressedAt = pressedAt,
            }
        end
        context.lockOnPress = contextLockOnPress
        local function s(T, W, vector, t, allowSameWindup)
            if not (T and T.Parent and W and W.Health > 0 and vector) then
                return false
            end
            local position = T.Position
            local dx, dz = vector.X - position.X, vector.Z - position.Z
            local distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
            if distance < 0.5 then
                return false
            end
            dx, dz = dx / distance, dz / distance
            local tolerance = cos(toRadians(math.clamp(tonumber(config.castFaceTolDeg) or 8, 1, 15)))
            local castFace = runtimeState.castFace
            local sameDirection = castFace and castFace.root == T and castFace.dx
                and castFace.dx * dx + castFace.dz * dz >= tolerance
            local winding = castFace and castFace.root == T and contextCastWinding(castFace)
            if winding then
                -- Q/E may share one settled heading; do not redirect an ability
                -- already winding up to a different target or movement heading.
                if not allowSameWindup or not sameDirection then
                    return false
                end
            elseif not sameDirection then
                castFace = { root = T, dx = dx, dz = dz, x = vector.X, z = vector.Z, at = t }
                runtimeState.castFace = castFace
            else
                castFace.dx, castFace.dz, castFace.x, castFace.z = dx, dz, vector.X, vector.Z
            end
            G(T, W, vector)
            local look = T.CFrame.LookVector
            local length = sqrt(look.X * look.X + look.Z * look.Z)
            if length < 0.01 or (look.X * dx + look.Z * dz) / length < tolerance then
                castFace.alignedAt = nil
                return false
            end
            castFace.alignedAt = castFace.alignedAt or t
            return config.castFaceLock == false
                or t - castFace.alignedAt >= (config.castFaceLead or 0.08)
        end
        local function contextReleaseMover(T, W)
            movement.cmdDir, movement.cmdAt = nil, runtimeState.brainNow
            if movement.driving then
                movement.driving = false
                if T then
                    T:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                end
            end
            movementBoost.steer(nil)
            local K = o()
            if T then
                C(T, false)
                if not K and not T.AutoRotate then
                    T.AutoRotate = true
                end
            else
                movementBoost.off()
            end
            if config.facePhysics ~= false and W and not K then
                contextFaceRelease(W)
            end
            movement.stallSince = nil
            movement.lastPos = nil
            movement.progPos = nil
            if not (_G.DQWP and _G.DQWP.on) then
                N(true)
            end
        end
        context.measuredReach = function()
            if
                config.aoeMeasured ~= true
                or type(config.aoeKnown) ~= "table"
                or not hazardReader.abilitySlots
            then
                return nil
            end
            local o = false
            for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                if abilitySlot.name and config.aoeKnown[string.lower(tostring(abilitySlot.name))] then
                    o = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if not (o and context.aoeLanding) then
                return nil
            end
            local o, T = context.aoeLanding()
            if not (o and T) then
                return nil
            end
            local aoeShape = hazardReader.aoeShape
            if
                config.aoeTrueShape ~= false
                and aoeShape
                and aoeShape.measured
                and aoeShape.aoeRound == false
                and aoeShape.aoeZ
            then
                return o + aoeShape.aoeZ * 0.5 - (config.rectReachInset or 6), o
            end
            return o + T, o
        end
        local function o()
            return config.classProfile == "warrior"
                    and config.warriorReachTrim ~= false
                    and not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
                    and (config.warriorReachTrim or -3)
                or 0
        end
        local function T()
            return o() + (config.reachTrim ~= false and (config.reachTrim or 3) or 0)
        end
        context.abilityReach = function()
            if context.pulseCarry() then
                return config.pulseRadius or 20
            end
            local o = context.measuredReach and context.measuredReach() or nil
            if o then
                local target = combatBrain.target
                if target and target.isBoss and target.model then
                    local K = context.bossProfile(target.model.Name)
                    o = if K.bigBody then o + (K.bigReach or config.bigBossReach or 0) else o
                else
                end
                return o - T()
            end
            local W, target2 = 0, combatBrain.target
            if target2 and target2.isBoss and target2.model then
                o = context.bossProfile(target2.model.Name)
                W = if o.bigBody then o.bigReach or config.bigBossReach else W
            else
            end
            local t, H = config.reachBonus or 0, target2 and target2.isBoss and (config.reachBonusBoss or 0)
            local X, dF = t + (H or (config.reachBonusMob or 0)), hazardReader.abilityRange
            if target2 and target2.isBoss and hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                o = nil
                for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                    H = abilitySlot.cap or abilitySlot.reach
                    o = if H and (not o or H > o) then H else o
                end
                dF = o or dF
            else
            end
            if config.autoStandoff and dF then
                return max(max(config.abilityRadius, min(dF, config.autoStandoffMax) + 12 + W) + X, 12) - T()
            end
            return max(config.abilityRadius + W + X, 12) - T()
        end
        context.fireReach = function()
            if context.pulseCarry() then
                return config.pulseRadius or 20
            end
            local o = context.measuredReach and context.measuredReach() or nil
            if o then
                return o - T()
            end
            o = nil
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots or {}) do
                key = entry.hitMax or (config.castStartAt or 44)
                o = if not o or key > o then key else o
            end
            local W = (o or (config.castStartAt or 44)) + (config.castProbe or 8) - T()
            o = context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or W
            return math.min(o, W)
        end
        local function o()
            if not (config.autoStandoff and hazardReader.abilitySlots) then
                return nil
            end
            local T = combatBrain.target
            local W, K = T ~= nil and T.isBoss == true
            for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                T = abilitySlot.hitMax
                if T then
                    key = not W and context.aoeLanding and context.aoeLanding() or nil
                    local X = W and T - (config.bossReachIn or 4)
                        or (
                            key and math.min(key, T)
                            or T
                                - (abilitySlot.aoeX and abilitySlot.aoeZ and math.max(
                                    abilitySlot.aoeX,
                                    abilitySlot.aoeZ
                                ) * 0.5 or 0)
                        )
                    X = math.max(X, config.castMinStand or 14)
                    K = if not K or X < K then X else K
                else
                end
            end
            if K then
                return max(min(K, config.autoStandoffMax) - (runtimeState.rangeShrink or 0), 12)
            end
            for key2, abilitySlot2 in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                W = if abilitySlot2.cap
                    then abilitySlot2.cap - config.rangeMargin
                    else if abilitySlot2.reach
                        then math.min(abilitySlot2.reach, config.castStartAt or 44)
                        else nil
                K = if W and (not K or W < K) then W else K
            end
            if not K then
                return nil
            end
            return max(min(K, config.autoStandoffMax) - (runtimeState.rangeShrink or 0), 12)
        end
        local function contextFanFloorRaw()
            return (2 * min(config.bubbleRadius or 6, 3) + 8) / 0.17431148549531633 + (config.fanFloorPad or 3)
        end
        context.fanFloor = function()
            if hazardReader.fanUntil ~= nil and os.clock() < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1 then
                return contextFanFloorRaw()
            end
            if config.fanFloorSlowOff ~= false then
                return 0
            end
            if os.clock() - (hazardReader.hubAt or -infinity) > (config.fanQuiet or 3) then
                return 0
            end
            return contextFanFloorRaw()
        end
        context.fanFloorRaw = contextFanFloorRaw
        local function T(W)
            local K = o()
            if not W.isBoss then
                local o, t =
                    context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 0,
                    W.melee and (config.meleeStandShare or 0.62) or (config.rangedStandShare or 0.45)
                local H = max(W.extent + (W.melee and config.mobStandoff or config.rangedStandoff), K or 0, o * t)
                return if W.model
                        and string.lower(tostring(W.model.Name)):find("mage", 1, true)
                    then max(H, config.mageStandoff or 38)
                    else H
            end
            local o = context.bossProfile(W.model.Name)
            local t, H
            if context.measuredReach then
                t, H = context.measuredReach()
            else
            end
            if o.fan and config.champMidTimed ~= false and context.champFanDue then
                if context.champFanDue() then
                    return config.fanRadius
                end
            else
                if o.fan and os.clock() < hazardReader.fanUntil + 1 then
                    return config.fanRadius
                end
                if
                    o.fan
                    and hazardReader.fanPeriod
                    and hazardReader.lastFanStart
                    and os.clock() - hazardReader.lastFanStart
                        >= hazardReader.fanPeriod - (config.fanEarly or 2)
                then
                    return config.fanRadius
                end
            end
            if o.fan then
                local X = H or min(context.abilityReach() - (config.ringIn or 6), K or infinity)
                return math.clamp(X, min(config.hubKeepOut or 45, X), config.fanRadius or 90)
            end
            if o.home then
                local X, dF =
                    hazardReader.bobHome or context.bobCrystalCentroid(),
                    H or context.abilityReach() - (config.bobRingIn or 6)
                if X and W.root and W.root.Parent then
                    local H = a(W.root.Position, X)
                    dF = if H < dF then max(H, config.bobStandMin or 30) else dF
                else
                end
                return math.clamp(dF, config.bobStandMin or 30, 90)
            end
            if o.bigReach then
                return math.clamp((t or context.abilityReach()) - (config.odinRingIn or 4), 40, 100)
            end
            return max(config.bossStandoff, K or 0)
        end
        local function contextStandoffFor(W)
            local K = T(W)
            if not K then
                return K
            end
            W = context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or nil
            if W then
                local T = max(W - (config.standoffIn or 4), config.castMinStand or 14)
                K = if K > T then T else K
            else
            end
            return K
        end
        local T = {
            melee = function(W)
                return W.melee and 0 or 1
            end,
            ranged = function(W)
                return W.melee and 1 or 0
            end,
            nearest = function()
                return 0
            end,
            group = function(W)
                local aoe = hazardReader.aoe
                if not aoe then
                    return W.melee and 0 or 1
                end
                local t, H = config.tagFirst ~= false and runtimeState.sweeping == true, 0
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        not enemy.isBoss
                        and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                        and (not t or not context.tagTarget or context.tagTarget(enemy))
                    then
                        local t, dF = enemy.x - W.x, enemy.z - W.z
                        H = if t * t + dF * dF <= aoe * aoe then H + 1 else H
                    else
                    end
                end
                return -H
            end,
        }
        local function contextMobTagged(K)
            if K == nil or K.model == nil then
                return false
            end
            local t = hazardReader.firstCastMobs
            if t ~= nil and t[K.model] == true then
                return true
            end
            t = hazardReader.castPending
            local H = t ~= nil and t[K.model] or nil
            return H ~= nil and os.clock() - H < (config.tagPendFor or 2)
        end
        local function contextMobUntagged(t)
            return t ~= nil and t.model ~= nil and not contextMobTagged(t)
        end
        local function contextRoomR(vector)
            if vector and vector.Y < (config.dropArenaY or -40) then
                return config.pitRoomRadius or 300
            end
            return config.tagRoomRadius or 150
        end
        context.roomR = contextRoomR
        local function H(X)
            if X == nil or X.model == nil then
                return nil
            end
            return hazardReader.groupOf and hazardReader.groupOf[X.model] or X.model
        end
        local function contextMarkStruck(dF)
            if dF == nil then
                return
            end
            local groupStruck, groupStruck2 = hazardReader.groupStruck
            if groupStruck then
                groupStruck2 = groupStruck
            else
                local setMetatable, weakKeys = setmetatable, {
                    __mode = "k",
                }
                groupStruck2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
            end
            hazardReader.groupStruck = groupStruck2
            hazardReader.groupStruck[hazardReader.groupOf and hazardReader.groupOf[dF] or dF] = hazardReader.tagPass
                or 1
        end
        context.markStruck = contextMarkStruck
        local function dF(groupStruck)
            local LF = H(groupStruck)
            if LF == nil then
                return false
            end
            groupStruck = hazardReader.groupStruck
            return groupStruck ~= nil and groupStruck[LF] == (hazardReader.tagPass or 1)
        end
        local function contextTagTarget(LF)
            return contextMobUntagged(LF) and not dF(LF)
        end
        local function contextTagPending(OF)
            if runtimeState.tagStuck or runtimeState.tagCross then
                return 0, infinity
            end
            local SF, DF, PF, _F, lF = contextRoomR(OF), 0, infinity, 0, infinity
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and contextMobUntagged(entry)
                then
                    index = OF and a(OF, entry.root.Position) or 0
                    if index <= SF then
                        DF += 1
                        PF = if index < PF then index else PF
                        if not dF(entry) then
                            _F, lF = _F + 1, if index < lF then index else lF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if _F == 0 and DF > 0 then
                hazardReader.tagPass = (hazardReader.tagPass or 1) + 1
                return DF, PF
            end
            return _F, lF
        end
        context.mobTagged = contextMobTagged
        context.mobUntagged = contextMobUntagged
        context.tagPending = contextTagPending
        context.tagTarget = contextTagTarget
        local function contextCastGate(vector, SF, DF)
            if config.openerWhole == false and config.tagStrict == false then
                return true
            end
            if not (vector and SF and context.aoeLanding) then
                return true
            end
            local PF, _F = context.aoeLanding()
            if not (PF and _F) then
                return true
            end
            local lF, cF = SF.X - vector.X, SF.Z - vector.Z
            local uF, hF, mF = sqrt(lF * lF + cF * cF), vector.X, vector.Z
            if uF > 0.5 then
                hF, mF = vector.X + lF / uF * PF, vector.Z + cF / uF * PF
            else
            end
            local RF, yF = _F - (config.openerSlack or 1.5), contextRoomR(vector)
            local qF
            if config.gatePacks ~= false and context.liveClusters then
                local success, EF = pcall(context.liveClusters, vector)
                if success and type(EF) == "table" then
                    local mobSeq, mobSeq2 = hazardReader.mobSeq
                    if mobSeq then
                        mobSeq2 = mobSeq
                    else
                        local setMetatable, weakKeys =
                            setmetatable, {
                                __mode = "k",
                            }
                        mobSeq2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
                    end
                    hazardReader.mobSeq = mobSeq2
                    local VF = {}
                    for index, entry in ipairs(EF) do
                        index = nil
                        for index2, member in ipairs(entry.members) do
                            if contextMobUntagged(member) then
                                mobSeq2 = hazardReader.mobSeq[member.model]
                                if not mobSeq2 then
                                    hazardReader.mobSeqN = (hazardReader.mobSeqN or 0) + 1
                                    mobSeq2 = hazardReader.mobSeqN
                                    hazardReader.mobSeq[member.model] = mobSeq2
                                else
                                end
                                index = if not index or mobSeq2 < index then mobSeq2 else index
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        if index then
                            for index3, member2 in ipairs(entry.members) do
                                if contextMobUntagged(member2) then
                                    VF[member2.model] = index
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    qF = function(EF)
                        return EF.model and VF[EF.model] or H(EF)
                    end
                else
                    qF = H
                end
            else
                qF = H
            end
            SF = runtimeState.orbitLive
            local VF, EF, pF, jF, UF =
                config.gatePacks ~= false
                        and SF
                        and SF.mode == "tag"
                        and type(SF.mem) == "table"
                        and SF.mem
                    or nil,
                {},
                0,
                0,
                false
            for index4, entry2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry2.isBoss
                    and entry2.root
                    and entry2.root.Parent
                    and entry2.humanoid
                    and entry2.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    local YF, vF, MF = entry2.root.Position.X, entry2.root.Position.Z, contextMobUntagged(entry2)
                    pF = if MF and a(vector, entry2.root.Position) <= yF then pF + 1 else pF
                    local ZF, nF, fF = YF - hF, vF - mF, _F + (entry2.extent or 0)
                    if ZF * ZF + nF * nF <= fF * fF and MF then
                        jF += 1
                        index4 = qF(entry2)
                        if index4 ~= nil then
                            EF[index4] = true
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    UF = if entry2.melee
                        then if sqrt((YF - vector.X) ^ 2 + (vF - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                                <= (entry2.extent or 0)
                                    + (entry2.meleeDistance or 4)
                                    + (config.openerMeleeSlack or 3)
                            then true
                            else UF
                        else UF
                else
                end
            end
            if UF then
                runtimeState.gateMeleeSince = runtimeState.gateMeleeSince or DF
            else
                runtimeState.gateMeleeSince = nil
            end
            SF = runtimeState.gateMeleeSince ~= nil
                and DF - runtimeState.gateMeleeSince >= (config.openerMeleeFor or 3)
            local function UF(gateWhy)
                runtimeState.gateHoldSince = runtimeState.gateHoldSince or DF
                if DF - runtimeState.gateHoldSince >= (config.tagStrictMax or 60) then
                    return true, gateWhy .. " (held too long - firing)"
                end
                runtimeState.gateWhy = gateWhy
                runtimeState.gateWhyAt = DF
                return false, gateWhy
            end
            if
                config.tagStrict ~= false
                and pF > 0
                and jF == 0
                and not runtimeState.tagStuck
                and not runtimeState.tagCross
            then
                local jF, JF = UF(("%d untagged left - no cast on tagged mobs"):format(pF))
                return jF, JF
            end
            if config.openerWhole ~= false and not SF then
                local SF, openerSince = runtimeState.openerSince
                if SF then
                    openerSince = SF
                else
                    local setMetatable2, weakKeys2 =
                        setmetatable, {
                            __mode = "k",
                        }
                    openerSince = setMetatable2({}, weakKeys2)
                end
                runtimeState.openerSince = openerSince
                for entry3 in pairs(EF) do
                    local EF, JF, wF, YF, vF, inn = {}, VF == nil, 0, 0, 0, 0
                    for index5, entry4 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                        if
                            not entry4.isBoss
                            and entry4.root
                            and entry4.root.Parent
                            and entry4.humanoid
                            and entry4.humanoid.Health > 0
                            and qF(entry4) == entry3
                            and contextMobUntagged(entry4)
                        then
                            yF, SF = entry4.root.Position.X, entry4.root.Position.Z
                            JF = if VF and entry4.model and VF[entry4.model] then true else JF
                            wF += 1
                            YF += yF
                            vF += SF
                            EF[#EF + 1] = entry4
                            if config.coverFootprint ~= false and context.coversMob and context.aoeShapeNow then
                                local qF, qF, qF, VF = context.aoeShapeNow()
                                inn = if context.coversMob(
                                        vector.X,
                                        vector.Z,
                                        uF > 0.5 and lF / uF or 1,
                                        uF > 0.5 and cF / uF or 0,
                                        entry4,
                                        PF,
                                        _F,
                                        qF,
                                        VF
                                    )
                                    then inn + 1
                                    else inn
                            else
                                inn = if (yF - hF) ^ 2 + (SF - mF) ^ 2 <= RF * RF then inn + 1 else inn
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if JF and wF > 0 and inn < wF then
                        openerSince = true
                        if context.enclosingCircle then
                            local OF, OF, OF = context.enclosingCircle(EF)
                            openerSince = OF == nil
                                or OF
                                    <= (config.coverFootprint ~= false and _F - (config.coverMargin or 0.5) + 0.6 or RF)
                        else
                        end
                        if
                            inn
                            < (openerSince and wF or math.max(2, math.ceil(wF * (config.openerPartFrac or 0.75))))
                        then
                            local OF, openerMobT = runtimeState.openerMobT
                            if OF then
                                openerMobT = OF
                            else
                                local setMetatable3, weakKeys3 =
                                    setmetatable, {
                                        __mode = "k",
                                    }
                                openerMobT = setMetatable3({}, weakKeys3)
                            end
                            runtimeState.openerMobT = openerMobT
                            OF = math.min(DF - (runtimeState.openerTickAt or DF), 0.2)
                            runtimeState.openerTickAt = DF
                            openerMobT = 0
                            for index6, entry5 in ipairs(EF) do
                                index6 = runtimeState.openerMobT[entry5.model]
                                openerMobT = if index6 and index6 > openerMobT then index6 else openerMobT
                            end
                            openerMobT = if not (context.dangerUp and context.dangerUp())
                                then openerMobT + OF
                                else openerMobT
                            for index7, entry6 in ipairs(EF) do
                                if entry6.model then
                                    runtimeState.openerMobT[entry6.model] = openerMobT
                                end
                            end
                            if
                                openerMobT
                                < (
                                    openerSince and (config.openerFitMax or 4)
                                    or (config.openerMaxWait or config.lineUpMax or 1)
                                )
                            then
                                if openerSince and context.enclosingCircle then
                                    local OF, SF, PF = context.enclosingCircle(EF)
                                    if OF then
                                        runtimeState.openerNeed = {
                                            k = entry3,
                                            x = OF,
                                            z = SF,
                                            r = PF,
                                            n = wF,
                                            inn = inn,
                                            at = DF,
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                                local OF, SF = UF(
                                    ("opener: %d of the group's %d untagged in the disc%s"):format(
                                        inn,
                                        wF,
                                        openerSince and "" or " (spread)"
                                    )
                                )
                                return OF, SF
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            runtimeState.gateHoldSince = nil
            return true
        end
        context.castGate = contextCastGate
        local function OF()
            local now, mageArcList = os.clock(), hazardReader.mageArcList
            if mageArcList and now >= mageArcList.at and now - mageArcList.at < (config.mageListTTL or 0.004) then
                return mageArcList
            end
            mageArcList = {
                at = now,
            }
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    entry.isMage
                    and not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and (
                        config.mageArcAll == true
                        or entry.model
                            and lowercase(entry.model.Name):find("northern", 1, true)
                    )
                then
                    mageArcList[#mageArcList + 1] = entry.root.Position
                end
            end
            hazardReader.mageArcList = mageArcList
            return mageArcList
        end
        context.mageGap = function(SF, DF)
            if config.mageArc == false then
                return 360, nil, 0
            end
            local PF, _F, lF = OF(), config.mageArcRange or 140, {}
            for index = 1, #PF, 1 do
                local cF, uF = PF[index].X - SF, PF[index].Z - DF
                index = cF * cF + uF * uF
                if index > 1 and index <= _F * _F then
                    lF[#lF + 1] = math.atan2(uF, cF)
                end
            end
            PF = #lF
            if PF == 0 then
                return 360, nil, 0
            end
            if PF == 1 then
                return 360, lF[1] + 3.141592653589793, 1
            end
            table.sort(lF)
            SF, DF = 0
            for index2 = 1, PF, 1 do
                _F = lF[index2]
                local cF = (index2 < PF and lF[index2 + 1] or lF[1] + 6.283185307179586) - _F
                if cF > SF then
                    SF, DF = cF, _F + cF * 0.5
                else
                end
            end
            return math.deg(SF), DF, PF
        end
        context.nextUntagged = function(OF, SF, DF, PF, _F)
            local now, cF, uF = os.clock(), hazardReader.nextUntag, not DF
            if uF and cF and cF.at == now and cF.x0 == OF and cF.z0 == SF then
                return cF.v
            end
            local hF, mF =
                DF or contextRoomR({
                    X = OF,
                    Y = 0,
                    Z = SF,
                }), {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and contextTagTarget(entry)
                then
                    DF = entry.root.Position
                    if
                        (DF.X - OF) ^ 2 + (DF.Z - SF) ^ 2 <= hF * hF
                        and not (_F and PF and abs(DF.Y - PF) > _F)
                    then
                        index = H(entry) or entry
                        cF = mF[index]
                        if not cF then
                            cF = {
                                n = 0,
                                sx = 0,
                                sz = 0,
                            }
                            mF[index] = cF
                        else
                        end
                        cF.n, cF.sx, cF.sz = cF.n + 1, cF.sx + DF.X, cF.sz + DF.Z
                    end
                end
            end
            DF = nil
            for key, entry2 in pairs(mF) do
                key, cF = entry2.sx / entry2.n, entry2.sz / entry2.n
                hF = sqrt((key - OF) ^ 2 + (cF - SF) ^ 2)
                DF = if not DF or hF < DF.d
                    then {
                        x = key,
                        z = cF,
                        n = entry2.n,
                        d = hF,
                    }
                    else DF
            end
            if uF then
                hazardReader.nextUntag = {
                    at = now,
                    x0 = OF,
                    z0 = SF,
                    v = DF,
                }
            end
            return DF
        end
        context.tagCrossTick = function(vector)
            if config.tagCross == false or config.tagFirst == false or not (vector and context.liveClusters) then
                runtimeState.tagCross = nil
                return
            end
            local now, DF, PF, _F =
                os.clock(), config.tagCrossReach or 110, config.tagCrossDy or 20, runtimeState.tagCross
            if _F then
                local left = 0
                for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                    if
                        entry.model
                        and _F.mem[entry.model]
                        and entry.root
                        and entry.root.Parent
                        and entry.humanoid
                        and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    then
                        index = entry.root.Position
                        left = if (index.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (index.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2 <= (DF + 20) ^ 2
                            then left + 1
                            else left
                    else
                    end
                end
                if left > 0 and now - _F.at < (config.tagCrossMax or 25) then
                    _F.left = left
                    return
                end
                runtimeState.tagCross = nil
            end
            local lF, cF, uF = {}, pcall(context.liveClusters, vector)
            if not cF or type(uF) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(uF) do
                local mF, RF, yF, mem = 0, 0, 0
                for index3, member in ipairs(entry2.members) do
                    if
                        (member.isMage or member.isSpear)
                        and not member.isBoss
                        and not contextTagTarget(member)
                        and member.root
                        and member.root.Parent
                    then
                        _F = member.root.Position
                        if
                            (_F.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (_F.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2 <= DF * DF
                            and math.abs(_F.Y - vector.Y) <= PF
                        then
                            mF += 1
                            RF += _F.X
                            yF += _F.Z
                            if mem then
                            else
                                cF, index3 =
                                    setmetatable, {
                                        __mode = "k",
                                    }
                                mem = cF({}, index3)
                            end
                            mem[member.model] = true
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if mF > 0 then
                    lF[#lF + 1] = {
                        x = RF / mF,
                        z = yF / mF,
                        n = mF,
                        mem = mem,
                    }
                end
            end
            if #lF == 0 then
                return
            end
            uF = context.nextUntagged(
                vector.X,
                vector.Z,
                config.runOnFarR or 240,
                vector.Y,
                config.runOnFarDy or 20
            )
            if not uF or uF.d < (config.tagCrossNear or 40) then
                return
            end
            _F, PF, DF, cF =
                (uF.x - vector.X) / uF.d,
                (uF.z - vector.Z) / uF.d,
                config.tagCrossLo or 50,
                config.tagCrossHi or 130
            for index4, entry3 in ipairs(lF) do
                local lF, RF = entry3.x - vector.X, entry3.z - vector.Z
                index4 = math.sqrt(lF * lF + RF * RF)
                if index4 > 1 then
                    local ang = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp((lF * _F + RF * PF) / index4, -1, 1)))
                    if ang >= DF and ang <= cF then
                        runtimeState.tagCross = {
                            at = now,
                            mem = entry3.mem,
                            ang = ang,
                            n = entry3.n,
                            left = entry3.n,
                            gx = uF.x,
                            gz = uF.z,
                            gd = uF.d,
                        }
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        context.mageArcBad = function(now, SF, DF, PF)
            local _F = config.mageArcHard or 200
            if config.mageArc == false or _F <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            local lF, cF, mageHereGap = context.mageGap(now, SF)
            if mageHereGap < 2 or lF >= _F then
                return false
            end
            if DF then
                now, mageHereGap = os.clock(), hazardReader.mageHereGap
                if
                    not (mageHereGap and mageHereGap.at == now and mageHereGap.x == DF and mageHereGap.z == PF)
                then
                    local SF, uF, uF = context.mageGap(DF, PF)
                    mageHereGap = {
                        at = now,
                        x = DF,
                        z = PF,
                        g = uF >= 2 and SF or 360,
                    }
                    hazardReader.mageHereGap = mageHereGap
                else
                end
                if mageHereGap.g < _F and lF >= mageHereGap.g + (config.mageArcBetter or 5) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.mobConeList = function()
            local now, mobConeList = os.clock(), hazardReader.mobConeList
            if mobConeList and now >= mobConeList.at and now - mobConeList.at < (config.mageListTTL or 0.004) then
                return mobConeList
            end
            mobConeList = {
                at = now,
            }
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    mobConeList[#mobConeList + 1] = entry.root.Position
                end
            end
            hazardReader.mobConeList = mobConeList
            return mobConeList
        end
        context.mobCone = function(OF, SF, DF, PF, _F)
            DF = DF or config.coneRange or 50
            local lF = config.orbitGatherDy or 20
            _F = _F or context.mobConeList()
            local cF = {}
            for index = 1, #_F, 1 do
                local vector = _F[index]
                if not PF or abs(vector.Y - PF) <= lF then
                    local _F, mF = vector.X - OF, vector.Z - SF
                    index = _F * _F + mF * mF
                    if index > 1 and index <= DF * DF then
                        cF[#cF + 1] = math.atan2(mF, _F)
                    end
                end
            end
            SF = #cF
            if SF == 0 then
                return 0, nil, 0
            end
            if SF == 1 then
                return 0, cF[1] + 3.141592653589793, 1
            end
            table.sort(cF)
            OF, PF = cF[1] + 6.283185307179586 - cF[SF]
            PF = cF[SF] + OF * 0.5
            for index2 = 2, SF, 1 do
                lF = cF[index2] - cF[index2 - 1]
                if lF > OF then
                    OF, PF = lF, cF[index2 - 1] + lF * 0.5
                else
                end
            end
            return 360 - math.deg(OF), PF, SF
        end
        context.coneBad = function(OF, SF, DF, PF, _F, lF)
            if config.orbitConeGuard == false then
                return false
            end
            local cF = context.mobCone(OF, SF, nil, lF)
            if cF <= (_F or config.orbitConeHard or 150) then
                return false
            end
            if DF and cF <= context.mobCone(DF, PF, nil, lF) then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        context.orbitShotEdge = function()
            if context.aoeShapeNow then
                local OF, SF, DF, DF = context.aoeShapeNow()
                if OF and DF then
                    return OF + DF * 0.5
                end
                if OF and SF then
                    return OF + SF
                end
            end
            return context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 60
        end
        context.orbitChaser = function(OF, vector)
            if not (OF.melee or OF.isSpear) then
                return false
            end
            local position = OF.root.Position
            if (position.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (position.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2 <= (config.orbitConeWith or 12) ^ 2 then
                return true
            end
            if contextMobTagged(OF) then
                return true
            end
            return (OF.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (OF.vz or 0) ^ 2 > (config.orbitChaseSpeed or 4) ^ 2
        end
        context.liveClusters = function(OF)
            local SF, DF = os.clock(), hazardReader.liveClusters
            if DF and DF.at == SF then
                return DF
            end
            local PF, _F = contextRoomR(OF), {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and entry.model
                then
                    DF = entry.root.Position
                    if (DF.X - OF.X) ^ 2 + (DF.Z - OF.Z) ^ 2 <= PF * PF then
                        _F[#_F + 1] = {
                            e = entry,
                            x = DF.X,
                            z = DF.Z,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            local liveClusters, cF = config.orbitLink or 20, {}
            local function uF(hF)
                while cF[hF] and cF[hF] ~= hF do
                    hF = cF[hF]
                end
                return hF
            end
            for index2 = 1, #_F, 1 do
                cF[index2] = index2
            end
            for index3 = 1, #_F, 1 do
