                    from = from,
                    at = now,
                    wps = nil,
                    margin = margin,
                }
                return nil
            end
            qF, xF = {}, aF
            while xF do
                EF, rF = math.floor(xF / 65536), xF % 65536
                table.insert(qF, 1, EF == vF and rF == ZF and Vector3.new(from.X, UF, from.Z) or JF(EF, rF))
                xF = oF[xF]
            end
            qF[#qF + 1] = Vector3.new(vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z)
            wps, EF = {}, 1
            while EF < #qF do
                VF = #qF
                while
                    VF > EF + 1
                    and (
                        math.abs(qF[VF].Y - qF[EF].Y) > wF
                        or not DF(qF[EF], qF[VF].X, qF[VF].Y - dangerGeometry.feet, qF[VF].Z, RF)
                    )
                do
                    VF -= 1
                end
                wps[#wps + 1] = qF[VF]
                EF = VF
            end
            hazardReader.gridCaches[margin] = {
                to = vector,
                from = from,
                at = now,
                wps = wps,
                margin = margin,
            }
            return wps
        end
        context.gridPath = contextGridPath
        context.maxRise = function()
            local PF = localPlayer.Character
            local lF = PF and (PF:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not lF then
                return 6
            end
            if lF:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                return config.swimMaxRise or 3
            end
            PF = lF.UseJumpPower and lF.JumpPower * lF.JumpPower / (2 * contextWorkspace.Gravity) or lF.JumpHeight
            return math.max((PF or 7) + (config.meshRiseSlack or 1.5), config.meshJumpFloor or 5.5)
        end
        context.computeWithin = function(PF, lF, cF, uF)
            uF = uF or config.pathTimeout or 8
            runtimeState.pathFlight = runtimeState.pathFlight or {}
            local hF, mF = os.clock(), 0
            for key, entry in pairs(runtimeState.pathFlight) do
                if hF - entry > (config.pathInFlightMax or 20) then
                    runtimeState.pathFlight[key] = nil
                else
                    mF += 1
                end
            end
            if mF >= (config.pathMaxInFlight or 4) then
                runtimeState.pathSkipped = (runtimeState.pathSkipped or 0) + 1
                return false
            end
            local mF, RF, yF = false, false, {}
            runtimeState.pathFlight[yF] = hF
            task.spawn(function()
                RF, mF = pcall(PF.ComputeAsync, PF, lF, cF), true
                runtimeState.pathFlight[yF] = nil
            end)
            hF = os.clock()
            while true do
                local PF = not mF and os.clock() - hF < uF
                if not PF then
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end
            hF = not mF
            if hF then
                runtimeState.pathTimeouts = (runtimeState.pathTimeouts or 0) + 1
                return false
            end
            return RF
        end
        local function PF(lF, vector)
            local uF = os.clock()
            local hF, mF, RF =
                hazardReader.navHoldUntil ~= nil and uF < hazardReader.navHoldUntil,
                hazardReader.meshBanUntil ~= nil and uF < hazardReader.meshBanUntil,
                context.fixesOn and context.fixesOn()
            local yF = RF and {
                config.carryAgentRadius or 3.5,
                2.5,
            } or { 2.5 }
            local function qF()
                local VF, EF = {
                    vector,
                }, a(lF, vector)
                if EF > 8 then
                    VF[2] = lF:Lerp(vector, (EF - 6) / EF)
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(yF) do
                    index = pathfindingService:CreatePath({
                        AgentRadius = entry,
                        AgentHeight = 5,
                        AgentCanJump = true,
                        WaypointSpacing = 4,
                        Costs = {
                            GhostWall = math.huge,
                        },
                    })
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(VF) do
                        if
                            context.computeWithin(index, lF, entry2)
                            and index.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success
                        then
                            EF, entry = {}, {}
                            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(index:GetWaypoints()) do
                                EF[index3] = entry3.Position
                                if entry3.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                                    entry[index3] = true
                                end
                            end
                            local E, yF = context.maxRise and context.maxRise() or 6, true
                            for index4 = 2, #EF, 1 do
                                if entry[index4] and EF[index4].Y - EF[index4 - 1].Y > E then
                                    yF = false
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if yF and #EF >= 2 then
                                combatBrain.jumps = entry
                                combatBrain.pathKind = "mesh"
                                return EF
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if mF and config.gridPathing ~= false and not RF then
                local E = contextGridPath(lF, vector)
                if E and #E >= 1 then
                    combatBrain.jumps = nil
                    combatBrain.pathKind = "grid"
                    return E
                end
            end
            local key = ("%d,%d,%d"):format(
                math.floor(vector.X / 16),
                math.floor(vector.Y / 16),
                math.floor(vector.Z / 16)
            )
            local yF = hazardReader.meshFail ~= nil
                and hazardReader.meshFail.key == key
                and uF < hazardReader.meshFail.untilAt
            if not hF and not yF then
                uF = qF()
                if uF then
                    hazardReader.meshFail = nil
                    return uF
                end
                if a(lF, vector) > (config.meshFailFar or 120) then
                    hazardReader.meshFail = {
                        key = key,
                        untilAt = os.clock() + (config.meshFailHold or 3),
                    }
                end
            end
            combatBrain.jumps = nil
            if config.gridPathing ~= false and (not mF or RF) then
                key = contextGridPath(lF, vector)
                if key and #key >= 1 then
                    combatBrain.pathKind = "grid"
                    return key
                end
            end
            if config.probePath ~= false then
                combatBrain.pathKind = hF and "probe (navmesh rebuilding)" or "probe"
                return SF(lF, vector)
            end
            mF, yF = {}, max(1, min(24, math.floor(a(lF, vector) / 8)))
            for index5 = 1, yF, 1 do
                mF[index5] = lF:Lerp(vector, index5 / yF)
            end
            combatBrain.pathKind = "straight"
            return mF
        end
        local raycastParams2 = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams2.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        pcall(function()
            raycastParams2.RespectCanCollide = true
        end)
        local function contextFloorAlong(vector, uF)
            raycastParams2.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                localPlayer.Character,
                contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("DungeonAutofarmVisuals"),
            }
            local hF = a(vector, uF)
            local mF, RF =
                math.max(1, math.floor(hF / (config.floorProbeStep or 5))), vector.Y - dangerGeometry.feet
            for index = 1, mF, 1 do
                hF = vector:Lerp(uF, index / mF)
                index = contextWorkspace:Raycast(
                    Vector3.new(hF.X, RF + 6, hF.Z),
                    Vector3.new(0, -(config.floorProbeDepth or 14), 0),
                    raycastParams2
                )
                if not index or index.Material == Enum.Material.Water or not index.Instance.CanCollide then
                    return false
                end
                RF = index.Position.Y
            end
            return true
        end
        context.floorAlong = contextFloorAlong
        local function E(vector, vector2, hF)
            if context.ghostBlocked and context.ghostBlocked(vector, vector2) then
                return false
            end
            if
                not contextWalkable(
                    vector,
                    vector2.X,
                    vector.Y - dangerGeometry.feet,
                    vector2.Z,
                    contextRaycastParams(hF)
                )
            then
                return false
            end
            if config.floorCheck ~= false and not contextFloorAlong(vector, vector2) then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        local function contextInNoGoZone(cF, uF, hF)
            if
                not (
                    hazardReader.noGoArmed
                    and hazardReader.noGoHot
                    and hazardReader.noGoZones
                    and context.depthOf
                )
            then
                return false
            end
            for index, noGoZone in ipairs(hazardReader.noGoZones) do
                if noGoZone.cx then
                    index = context.depthOf(noGoZone, cF, uF, hF, 2)
                    if index and index >= 0 then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.inNoGoZone = contextInNoGoZone
        local function contextNoGoPush(vector, vector2)
            if not (hazardReader.noGoArmed and hazardReader.noGoHot) then
                return vector2
            end
            if not contextInNoGoZone(vector2.X, vector2.Y, vector2.Z) then
                return vector2
            end
            local mF, RF, yF = config.noGoPushStep or 8, infinity
            for index = mF, config.noGoPushMax or 48, mF do
                for index2 = 0, 11, 1 do
                    local VF = index2 * 3.141592653589793 / 6
                    local EF, pF = vector2.X + cos(VF) * index, vector2.Z + sin(VF) * index
                    if not contextInNoGoZone(EF, vector2.Y, pF) then
                        index2, VF =
                            (EF - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (pF - vector2.Z) ^ 2,
                            (EF - vector.X) ^ 2
                                + (pF - vector.Z) ^ 2
                                - ((vector2.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                        index2 = if VF > 0 then index2 + VF else index2
                        if index2 < RF then
                            RF, yF = index2, Vector3.new(EF, vector2.Y, pF)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if yF then
                    return yF
                end
            end
            return vector2
        end
        context.noGoPush = contextNoGoPush
        local function contextStrafeAnchor(vector)
            if not (hazardReader.leash ~= nil and hazardReader.leash.enemy ~= nil) then
                local hF = config.champWaypoints and config.champWaypoints[1]
                if hF then
                    local mF = Vector3.new(hF[1], hF[2], hF[3])
                    if a(vector, mF) < (config.strafeArenaFrom or 160) then
                        return mF, "arena"
                    end
                end
            end
            local hF, mF, RF = 0, 0, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and not entry.melee
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and (entry.humanoid == nil or entry.humanoid.Health > 0)
                    and a(vector, entry.root.Position) < (config.groupLocalRadius or 90)
                then
                    hF, mF, RF = hF + entry.x, mF + entry.z, RF + 1
                else
                end
            end
            if RF > 0 then
                return Vector3.new(hF / RF, vector.Y, mF / RF), "mobs"
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.strafeAnchor = contextStrafeAnchor
        local raycastParams3
        local function hF()
            local mF = not raycastParams3
            if mF then
                raycastParams3 = RaycastParams.new()
                local raycastParams = raycastParams3
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                raycastParams3.IgnoreWater = true
                pcall(function()
                    raycastParams3.RespectCanCollide = true
                end)
            end
            local filterDescendantsInstances, RF = {}, localPlayer.Character
            if RF then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = RF
            end
            RF = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dq_ghost_walls")
            if RF then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = RF
            end
            if context.WL then
                for index, entry in ipairs(context.WL.parts or {}) do
                    if entry and entry.Parent then
                        filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = entry
                    end
                end
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.WL.logoParts or {}) do
                    if entry2 and entry2.Parent then
                        filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = entry2
                    end
                end
            end
            raycastParams3.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
            RF = raycastParams3
            return RF
        end
        context.enemyPathClear = function(uF, mF, RF, yF, success)
            local VF = yF - uF
            local EF = success - RF
            if sqrt(VF * VF + EF * EF) < 2 then
                return true
            end
            success, yF = pcall(function()
                local pF, jF, UF = Vector3.new(uF, mF + 3, RF), Vector3.new(VF, 0, EF), vmHelpers[127](hF())
                return contextWorkspace:Raycast(pF, jF, vmHelpers:jB(UF))
            end)
            if not success then
                return true
            end
            return yF == nil
        end
        local function uF(vector, vector2, RF)
            local yF, qF = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local VF = sqrt(yF * yF + qF * qF)
            if VF < 0.1 then
                return true
            end
            if context.wallStepBad and context.wallStepBad(vector, vector2, RF) then
                return false
            end
            if context.wrongPillarStep and context.wrongPillarStep(vector, vector2) then
                return false
            end
            if
                context.BB
                and context.BB.softAt
                and context.BB.softAt(vector2.X, vector2.Z, os.clock() + VF / math.max(RF or 16, 1))
                    > (config.walkSoftMax or 3)
            then
                return false
            end
            return not (context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, vector2, RF))
        end
        context.mageExitOk = function(vector, vector2, RF)
            return uF(vector, vector2, RF)
                and E(vector, vector2)
                and not (
                    context.coneBad
                    and context.coneBad(vector2.X, vector2.Z, vector.X, vector.Z, nil, vector.Y)
                )
        end
        local function hF()
            local mF
            for index, entry in ipairs(dangerGeometry.cands or {}) do
                mF = if entry.valid and not entry.blocked and (not mF or entry.cost < mF.cost) then entry else mF
            end
            return mF and Vector3.new(mF.x, mF.y, mF.z) or nil
        end
        local function mF()
            return context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.active or hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil
        end
        local function RF(yF, qF, VF, EF)
            local pF = hazardReader.orbNear
            if
                config.orbKeepGap ~= false
                and pF ~= nil
                and pF.x ~= nil
                and (pF.d or 999) < (config.orbMinGap or 10)
                and not (context.orbNearShielded and context.orbNearShielded(qF.Position.X, qF.Position.Z))
            then
                local position = qF.Position
                local UF, JF = position.X - pF.x, position.Z - pF.z
                local wF = math.sqrt(UF * UF + JF * JF)
                if wF > 0.5 then
                    local YF = config.orbGapStep or 10
                    local vF = Vector3.new(position.X + UF / wF * YF, position.Y, position.Z + JF / wF * YF)
                    if
                        not (
                            context.BB
                            and context.BB.pathBlocked
                            and context.BB.pathBlocked(position, vF, config.tweenEscape)
                        )
                        and not (context.wrongPillarStep and context.wrongPillarStep(position, vF))
                    then
                        g(yF, qF, vF, config.tweenEscape, 1)
                        contextSetState(("%s - orb %.0f away, holding the gap"):format(EF or VF, pF.d or 0))
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            if not mF() then
                contextReleaseMover(yF, qF)
                contextSetState(VF)
                return
            end
            if not (context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal) then
                contextReleaseMover(yF, qF)
                contextSetState(VF)
                return
            end
            pF = dangerGeometry.target or hF()
            if not pF then
                local position2, jF, UF = qF.Position, infinity
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    index = a(position2, enemy.root.Position)
                    if index < jF then
                        jF, UF = index, enemy
                    else
                    end
                end
                local jF = UF and Vector3.new(position2.X - UF.x, 0, position2.Z - UF.z) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
                jF = jF.Magnitude > 0.1 and jF.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
                pF = position2
                    + (Vector3.new(-jF.Z, 0, jF.X) * (combatBrain.strafeDir or 1) * 0.85 + jF * 0.5).Unit
                        * 14
            else
            end
            local hF = context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.active and not context.BB.lethal
            g(
                yF,
                qF,
                pF,
                hF
                        and not (hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil or hazardReader.orbNear ~= nil and (hazardReader.orbNear.d or infinity) < (config.orbSprintAt or 45))
                        and e()
                    or config.tweenEscape,
                1
            )
            contextSetState((EF or VF) .. (hF and "; stepping off warm ground" or "; moving off hot ground"))
        end
        local function hF(yF, qF, VF, detourDest, pF)
            if dangerGeometry.target then
                g(yF, qF, dangerGeometry.target, config.tweenEscape, 1)
                contextSetState(VF .. " blocked; via spot")
                return false
            end
            if
                runtimeState.wallWaitAt
                and runtimeState.wallWaitB
                and os.clock() - runtimeState.wallWaitAt < 0.25
                and context.BB
                and context.BB.wallTimes
            then
                local wallWaitB, position = runtimeState.wallWaitB, qF.Position
                local JF, wF, wF, wF = context.BB.wallTimes(wallWaitB, position.X, position.Z)
                if JF then
                    local JF = wallWaitB.half
                        + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
                        + (config.wallSafeGap or 2.5)
                        + (config.wallOffPad or 2.5)
                    local YF = ((wF or 0) >= 0 and 1 or -1) * JF - (wF or 0)
                    g(
                        yF,
                        qF,
                        Vector3.new(position.X + wallWaitB.nx * YF, position.Y, position.Z + wallWaitB.nz * YF),
                        config.burstMax or 28,
                        1
                    )
                    contextSetState(VF .. " - a moving wall coming the same way: out of its path to let it pass")
                else
                    RF(yF, qF, VF .. " - waiting for the moving wall to pass, then behind it")
                end
                return false
            end
            if context.carryNav and context.carryNav() and config.carryWaitBlocked ~= false then
                local jF = os.clock()
                if not runtimeState.blockWaitAt or jF - (runtimeState.blockWaitLast or 0) > 0.5 then
                    runtimeState.blockWaitAt = jF
                end
                runtimeState.blockWaitLast = jF
                if jF - runtimeState.blockWaitAt < (config.carryWaitMax or 2) then
                    RF(yF, qF, VF .. " blocked; waiting for the lane to clear")
                    return false
                end
            end
            if detourDest and context.BB and context.BB.detour then
                local detourAt = os.clock()
                local detourVia, detourDeg
                if
                    combatBrain.detourAt
                    and detourAt - combatBrain.detourAt < (config.detourEvery or 0.3)
                    and combatBrain.detourDest
                    and (combatBrain.detourDest - detourDest).Magnitude < 2
                then
                    detourVia, detourDeg = combatBrain.detourVia, combatBrain.detourDeg
                else
                    detourVia, detourDeg = context.BB.detour(qF.Position, detourDest, pF or e())
                    combatBrain.detourAt, combatBrain.detourDest, combatBrain.detourVia, combatBrain.detourDeg =
                        detourAt, detourDest, detourVia, detourDeg
                end
                if detourVia then
                    g(yF, qF, detourVia, e(), 1.5)
                    contextSetState(("%s blocked; round %d deg"):format(VF, detourDeg))
                    return false
                end
            end
            RF(yF, qF, VF .. " blocked")
            return false
        end
        local function yF(raycastResult, vector, raycastResult2)
            local centreShift, jF = vector.X - raycastResult.X, vector.Z - raycastResult.Z
            local UF = sqrt(centreShift * centreShift + jF * jF)
            if UF < 4 then
                return vector
            end
            local JF, wF, YF, vF, MF =
                -jF / UF,
                centreShift / UF,
                contextRaycastParams(raycastResult2),
                raycastResult + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
                14
            raycastResult, raycastResult2 =
                contextWorkspace:Raycast(vF, Vector3.new(JF, 0, wF) * MF, YF),
                contextWorkspace:Raycast(vF, Vector3.new(-JF, 0, -wF) * MF, YF)
            vF, YF =
                raycastResult and raycastResult.Distance or MF, raycastResult2 and raycastResult2.Distance or MF
            MF, UF = abs(vF - YF) < 1.5 and 0 or max(min((vF - YF) * 0.5, 6), -6), combatBrain.centreShift or 0
            centreShift = UF + (MF - UF) * (config.centreEase or 0.15)
            combatBrain.centreShift = centreShift
            if abs(centreShift) < 0.2 then
                return vector
            end
            return vector + Vector3.new(JF, 0, wF) * centreShift
        end
        local function qF(VF, EF, pF, jF, UF, JF)
            local progressPos, YF = EF.Position, os.clock()
            pF = contextNoGoPush(progressPos, pF)
            combatBrain.goTo = pF
            combatBrain.goToAt = YF
            local pathTo = pF
            if config.useWaypoints == false then
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                pF = yF(progressPos, pathTo, JF)
                if not uF(progressPos, pF, jF) then
                    return hF(VF, EF, UF, pF, jF)
                end
                g(VF, EF, pF, jF, 1.5)
                contextSetState(UF .. " direct")
                return
            end
            if
                a(progressPos, pathTo) < 70
                and abs(pathTo.Y - progressPos.Y) < (config.straightDy or 8)
                and E(progressPos, pathTo, JF)
            then
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                pF = yF(progressPos, pathTo, JF)
                if not uF(progressPos, pF, jF) then
                    return hF(VF, EF, UF, pF, jF)
                end
                g(VF, EF, pF, jF, 1.5)
                contextSetState(UF .. " straight")
                if
                    (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0) > (config.ghostGiveUp or 8)
                    and hazardReader.ghostWalls
                    and #hazardReader.ghostWalls > 0
                then
                    for index, ghostWall in ipairs(hazardReader.ghostWalls) do
                        if ghostWall.part then
                            pcall(function()
                                ghostWall.part:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    hazardReader.ghostWalls = {}
                    combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                    runtimeState.stalledFor = 0
                    movement.stallSince = nil
                    if context.logT then
                        context.logT(
                            "ghost",
                            1,
                            "Brain",
                            "stuck routing round learned walls - forgetting them and re-pathing"
                        )
                    end
                end
                if
                    (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0) > (config.ghostStallAt or 1.2)
                    and context.noteGhostWall
                    and YF - max(runtimeState.lastQ or 0, runtimeState.lastE or 0) > 1
                then
                    if
                        context.noteGhostWall(
                            progressPos,
                            Vector3.new(pF.X - progressPos.X, 0, pF.Z - progressPos.Z)
                        )
                    then
                        movement.stallSince = nil
                        runtimeState.stalledFor = 0
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            local pF = progressPos.Y - dangerGeometry.feet
            if combatBrain.waypoints then
                local vF, MF = infinity
                for index2, waypoint in ipairs(combatBrain.waypoints) do
                    if abs(waypoint.Y - pF) < 6 then
                        local fF = a(progressPos, waypoint)
                        if fF < vF then
                            vF, MF = fF, index2
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                local ZF = not MF
                if ZF then
                    combatBrain.offLevelSince = combatBrain.offLevelSince or YF
                else
                    combatBrain.offLevelSince = nil
                end
                if ZF or vF > (config.pathOff or 15) then
                    combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                else
                    combatBrain.index =
                        min(max(combatBrain.index, MF + (vF < 3 and 1 or 0)), #combatBrain.waypoints)
                end
            end
            local vF = combatBrain.waypoints ~= nil
                and combatBrain.pathAt ~= nil
                and YF - combatBrain.pathAt < (config.pathMinGap or 0.6)
                and combatBrain.index <= #combatBrain.waypoints
            if
                hazardReader.streamBurstAt
                and YF - hazardReader.streamBurstAt < (config.streamPathHold or 0.6)
                and (
                    hazardReader.streamBurstSince == nil
                    or YF - hazardReader.streamBurstSince < (config.streamBurstMax or 2.5)
                )
            then
                if combatBrain.waypoints and combatBrain.index <= #combatBrain.waypoints then
                    vF = true
                else
                    combatBrain.waypoints = {
                        progressPos:Lerp(pathTo, 0.5),
                        pathTo,
                    }
                    combatBrain.pathAt = YF
                    combatBrain.pathTo = pathTo
                    combatBrain.index = 1
                    combatBrain.carrotIdx = nil
                    vF = true
                end
            else
            end
            if
                not vF
                and (
                    not combatBrain.waypoints
                    or a(combatBrain.pathTo, pathTo) > 20
                    or YF - combatBrain.pathAt > (config.pathAge or 1.5)
                    or combatBrain.index > #combatBrain.waypoints
                )
            then
                if combatBrain.planningAt and YF - combatBrain.planningAt < (config.pathPlanMax or 40) then
                    if not (combatBrain.waypoints and combatBrain.index <= #combatBrain.waypoints) then
                        if
                            YF - combatBrain.planningAt
                            < (
                                config.respawnQuickPath ~= false
                                    and hazardReader.charAt
                                    and os.clock() - hazardReader.charAt < (config.respawnQuickPathFor or 6)
                                    and (config.respawnPathHoldMax or 0.5)
                                or (config.pathHoldMax or 2)
                            )
                        then
                            g(VF, EF, progressPos, e(), 1.5)
                            contextSetState(UF .. " (planning the route)")
                            return
                        end
                        local vF = config.gridPathing ~= false and contextGridPath(progressPos, pathTo) or nil
                        combatBrain.waypoints = vF or SF(progressPos, pathTo)
                        combatBrain.pathAt = YF
                        combatBrain.pathTo = pathTo
                        combatBrain.index = 1
                        combatBrain.carrotIdx = nil
                        combatBrain.jumps, combatBrain.pathKind =
                            nil, vF and "grid (the navmesh is slow)" or "probe (the navmesh is slow)"
                    end
                else
                    local planning = {}
                    combatBrain.planning = planning
                    combatBrain.planningAt = YF
                    local success, waypoints = pcall(PF, progressPos, pathTo)
                    if combatBrain.planning ~= planning then
                        return
                    end
                    combatBrain.planning = nil
                    combatBrain.planningAt = nil
                    if not success then
                        error(waypoints, 0)
                    end
                    progressPos, YF = EF.Position, os.clock()
                    pF = progressPos.Y - dangerGeometry.feet
                    combatBrain.waypoints = waypoints
                    combatBrain.pathAt = YF
                    combatBrain.pathTo = pathTo
                    combatBrain.index = 1
                    combatBrain.carrotIdx = nil
                    for index3, waypoint2 in ipairs(combatBrain.waypoints) do
                        if abs(waypoint2.Y - pF) >= 6 then
                            break
                        end
                        if a(progressPos, waypoint2) > 2.5 then
                            combatBrain.index = index3
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            local progressPath = combatBrain.waypoints
            if not progressPath then
                return
            end
            local PF = progressPath[combatBrain.index]
            while PF and a(progressPos, PF) < 3 and abs(PF.Y - pF) < 4 and combatBrain.index < #progressPath do
                combatBrain.index = combatBrain.index + 1
                PF = progressPath[combatBrain.index]
            end
            if not PF then
                return
            end
            if
                config.pathSkillNodes
                and #progressPath - combatBrain.index > config.pathSkillNodes
                and context.buffPress
                and context.buffState
                and context.buffState(YF) == "ready"
                and not (context.BB and context.BB.lethal)
                and not (
                    context.bobBuffNow
                    and context.PB
                    and context.PB.boss
                    and string.lower(tostring(context.PB.boss)):find("bob", 1, true)
                    and not context.bobBuffNow(YF)
                )
            then
                if context.buffPress(YF) then
                    contextLogT(
                        "buff",
                        3,
                        "Brain",
                        ("speed skill for the walk: %d nodes left"):format(#progressPath - combatBrain.index)
                    )
                end
            end
            local progressBest = a(progressPos, PF)
            if
                not combatBrain.progressAt
                or combatBrain.progressIdx ~= combatBrain.index
                or combatBrain.progressPath ~= progressPath
                or abs(progressPos.Y - combatBrain.progressPos.Y) > 6
            then
                combatBrain.progressAt, combatBrain.progressPos, combatBrain.progressIdx =
                    YF, progressPos, combatBrain.index
                combatBrain.progressPath = progressPath
                combatBrain.progressBest = progressBest
            elseif progressBest < (combatBrain.progressBest or infinity) - (config.progressGain or 1.5) then
                combatBrain.progressAt = YF
                combatBrain.progressPos = progressPos
                combatBrain.progressBest = progressBest
                combatBrain.stalls = 0
            end
            if YF - combatBrain.progressAt > (config.stallReplanAt or 1) then
                combatBrain.progressAt = YF
                combatBrain.stalls = (combatBrain.stalls or 0) + 1
                if combatBrain.pathKind == "mesh" then
                    hazardReader.meshBanUntil = YF + (config.meshBanFor or 6)
                end
                hazardReader.gridCaches = nil
                if
                    context.noteGhostWall
                    and YF - max(runtimeState.lastQ or 0, runtimeState.lastE or 0) > 1
                    and (runtimeState.stalledFor or 0) > 0.5
                then
                    context.noteGhostWall(progressPos, Vector3.new(PF.X - progressPos.X, 0, PF.Z - progressPos.Z))
                end
                if combatBrain.stalls % 2 == 1 or combatBrain.index >= #progressPath then
                    combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                    contextLogT("stall", 2, "Brain", "no progress; a new path from here")
                else
                    combatBrain.index = combatBrain.index + 1
                    contextLogT("stall", 2, "Brain", "no progress twice; skipping a waypoint")
                end
                return
            end
            local index4, carrotIdx = combatBrain.index, combatBrain.carrotIdx
            if
                not carrotIdx
                or carrotIdx < combatBrain.index
                or carrotIdx > #progressPath
                or YF - (combatBrain.carrotAt or -infinity) > (config.carrotEvery or 0.15)
            then
                carrotIdx = combatBrain.index
                for index5 = combatBrain.index + 1, min(#progressPath, combatBrain.index + (config.carrotNodes or 6)), 1 do
                    progressBest = progressPath[index5]
                    if abs(progressBest.Y - pF) >= 4 then
                        break
                    end
                    if a(progressPos, progressBest) > (config.carrotMax or 18) then
                        break
                    end
                    if not E(progressPos, progressBest, JF) then
                        break
                    end
                    if
                        config.carrotWide ~= false
                        and not DF(progressPos, progressBest.X, pF, progressBest.Z, contextRaycastParams(JF))
                    then
                        break
                    end
                    carrotIdx = index5
                end
                combatBrain.carrotIdx = carrotIdx
                combatBrain.carrotAt = YF
            else
            end
            PF = if carrotIdx > combatBrain.index then progressPath[carrotIdx] else PF
            if config.pathLookahead ~= false and context.BB and context.BB.detour and progressPath then
                local DF, YF, MF = config.pathLookaheadStuds or 55, progressPos, false
                for index6 = combatBrain.index, min(#progressPath, combatBrain.index + (config.pathLookaheadNodes or 10)), 1 do
                    progressBest = progressPath[index6]
                    if abs(progressBest.Y - pF) >= 6 then
                        break
                    end
                    if a(progressPos, progressBest) > DF then
                        break
                    end
                    if not uF(YF, progressBest, jF) then
                        MF = true
                        break
                    end
                    YF = progressBest
                end
                if MF then
                    YF = context.BB.detour(progressPos, pathTo, jF or e())
                    if YF then
                        g(VF, EF, YF, jF, 1.5)
                        contextSetState(UF .. " round the danger ahead")
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            PF = yF(progressPos, PF, JF)
            JF = context.ghostBlocked and context.ghostBlocked(progressPos, PF)
            if JF then
                pathTo = context.ghostDetour and context.ghostDetour(progressPos, PF, JF)
                if pathTo then
                    g(VF, EF, pathTo, jF, 1.5)
                    contextSetState(UF .. " round a learned wall")
                    return
                end
            end
            if not uF(progressPos, PF, jF) then
                return hF(VF, EF, UF, PF, jF)
            end
            pathTo = progressPath[index4]
            if combatBrain.jumps and combatBrain.jumps[index4] and pathTo and a(progressPos, pathTo) < 5 then
                VF.Jump = true
            end
            g(VF, EF, PF, jF, 1.5)
            contextSetState(
                ("%s %.0f/%.0f%s"):format(
                    UF,
                    combatBrain.index,
                    #progressPath,
                    combatBrain.carrotIdx
                            and combatBrain.carrotIdx > combatBrain.index
                            and (" (aiming %d)"):format(combatBrain.carrotIdx)
                        or ""
                )
            )
        end
        local function SF(DF, ...)
            if pcall(DF, virtualInputManager, ...) then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.vimRetries = (runtimeState.vimRetries or 0) + 1
            local PF = table.pack(...)
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(DF, virtualInputManager, table.unpack(PF, 1, PF.n))
            end)
        end
        context.pkHealPace = function()
            return math.max(config.pkHealEvery or 3, (config.pkHealCycle or 6.5) / 2)
        end
        context.pkHealer = function()
            if config.pkHealPace == false then
                return false
            end
            local pkHealerAt = os.clock()
            if runtimeState.pkHealerAt and pkHealerAt - runtimeState.pkHealerAt < 1 then
                return runtimeState.pkHealerIs == true
            end
            local pkHealerIs = false
            if context.isEvent and context.isEvent() then
                local iterateArray, cF =
                    ipairs, {
                        localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
                for key, entry in iterateArray(cF) do
                    if entry then
                        for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Chain Heal" then
                                pkHealerIs = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if pkHealerIs then
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            runtimeState.pkHealerAt = pkHealerAt
            runtimeState.pkHealerIs = pkHealerIs
            return pkHealerIs
        end
        local function DF(PF)
            if runtimeState.bugKey then
                local protectedCall, bugKey, hF =
                    pcall,
                    runtimeState.bugKey,
                    runtimeState.swapHoldUntil ~= nil
                        and os.clock() < runtimeState.swapHoldUntil
                        and (PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q or PF == Enum.KeyCode.E)
                protectedCall(bugKey, PF, hF)
            end
            if
                runtimeState.swapHoldUntil
                and os.clock() < runtimeState.swapHoldUntil
                and (PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q or PF == Enum.KeyCode.E)
            then
                if config.castConfirm ~= false and context.castWatch then
                    context.castWatch(PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q and "q" or "e", os.clock(), true)
                end
                return false
            end
            if (PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q or PF == Enum.KeyCode.E) and context.pkHealer() then
                runtimeState.healPaceAt = os.clock()
            end
            SF(virtualInputManager.SendKeyEvent, true, PF, false, game)
            if context.ALLTIME then
                if PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onCast, "q")
                elseif PF == Enum.KeyCode.E then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onCast, "e") end
            end
            runtimeState.keyDown = runtimeState.keyDown or {}
            runtimeState.keyDown[PF] = true
            local function keyUp()
                if runtimeState.keyDown[PF] then
                    runtimeState.keyDown[PF] = nil
                    SF(virtualInputManager.SendKeyEvent, false, PF, false, game)
                end
            end
            runtimeState.keyUp = keyUp
            task.delay(0.05, keyUp)
            task.spawn(function()
                for index = 1, 5, 1 do
                    if not runtimeState.keyDown[PF] then
                        return
                    end
                    if context.BB and context.BB.lethal then
                        keyUp()
                        return
                    end
                    task.wait(0.01)
                end
            end)
            if
                config.castConfirm ~= false
                and context.castWatch
                and (PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q or PF == Enum.KeyCode.E)
            then
                context.castWatch(PF == Enum.KeyCode.Q and "q" or "e", os.clock())
            end
            return true
        end
        local function contextPressAimedAbility(keyCode, root, humanoid, aim, now)
            if not s(root, humanoid, aim, now, true) then
                runtimeState.skillGate = "facing"
                return false
            end
            local castFace = runtimeState.castFace
            local previousAt, previousPress = castFace.at, castFace.pressedAt
            contextLockOnPress(root, aim)
            if not DF(keyCode) then
                -- A held key must not start a phantom wind-up or consume a cast.
                castFace.at, castFace.pressedAt = previousAt, previousPress
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        local function PF()
            local iterateArray, cF =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(cF) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot") then
                            index = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                            if not index or index.Value <= 0.1 then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.slotCd = function(_F)
            local cF, iterateArray = localPlayer.Character, ipairs
            local yF = {
                localPlayer.Backpack,
                cF,
            }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(yF) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") then
                            cF = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                            if cF and tostring(cF.Value) == _F then
                                index = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                                return index and tonumber(index.Value) or nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.tagOnCast = function(models, cF)
            if config.castConfirm == false then
                local castApplyTags, yF = context.castApplyTags, {}
                vmHelpers:YB(yF, 0, {
                    models = models,
                })
                castApplyTags(yF, cF)
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.tagOnCast = runtimeState.tagOnCast or {}
            local tagOnCast = runtimeState.tagOnCast
            for index = #tagOnCast, 1, -1 do
                if cF - tagOnCast[index].at > (config.tagOnCastWait or 0.5) then
                    table.remove(tagOnCast, index)
                end
            end
            local yF = {
                models = models,
                at = cF,
            }
            tagOnCast[#tagOnCast + 1] = yF
            while #tagOnCast > 16 do
                table.remove(tagOnCast, 1)
            end
            return yF
        end
        context.tagOnCastDrop = function(_F)
            local tagOnCast = runtimeState.tagOnCast
            if not (tagOnCast and _F) then
                return
            end
            for index = #tagOnCast, 1, -1 do
                if tagOnCast[index] == _F then
                    table.remove(tagOnCast, index)
                end
            end
        end
        context.castApplyTags = function(_F, cF)
            local castPending, castPending2 = hazardReader.castPending
            if castPending then
                castPending2 = castPending
            else
                local setMetatable, weakKeys = setmetatable, {
                    __mode = "k",
                }
                castPending2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
            end
            hazardReader.castPending = castPending2
            for index, entry in ipairs(_F) do
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(entry.models or {}) do
                    hazardReader.castPending[entry2] = cF
                    contextMarkStruck(entry2)
                end
            end
        end
        context.castWatch = function(castMissSlot, castOkAt, hF)
            if context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(castMissSlot) then
                return
            end
            local yF, VF = castMissSlot == "q" and "lastQ" or "lastE", {}
            local EF = runtimeState.tagOnCast
            if EF then
                for index = #EF, 1, -1 do
                    if castOkAt - EF[index].at <= (config.tagOnCastWait or 0.5) then
                        VF[#VF + 1] = EF[index]
                    end
                    table.remove(EF, index)
                end
            end
            local function pF(jF)
                runtimeState.castMiss = (runtimeState.castMiss or 0) + 1
                if runtimeState[yF] ~= nil and math.abs(runtimeState[yF] - castOkAt) < 0.1 then
                    runtimeState[yF] = runtimeState.castOk and runtimeState.castOk[castMissSlot] or -math.huge
                end
                runtimeState.castMissAt = os.clock()
                runtimeState.castMissSlot = castMissSlot
                contextLogT(
                    "castmiss",
                    1,
                    "Fight",
                    ("pressed %s but the ability did not go off (%s, %d so far) - nothing tagged by it, it goes again"):format(
                        string.upper(castMissSlot),
                        jF,
                        runtimeState.castMiss
                    )
                )
            end
            if hF then
                pF("held for the kit swap")
                return
            end
            local yF = context.slotCd(castMissSlot)
            EF = localPlayer.Character
            hF = EF and (EF:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
            local EF = hF ~= nil and hF.Value == true
            task.spawn(function()
                local now, jF = os.clock(), false
                while true do
                    local UF, JF = os.clock() - now, config.castConfirmFor
                    if not (UF < (JF or 1.2)) then
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    if runtimeState.destroyed then
                        return
                    end
                    JF = context.slotCd(castMissSlot)
                    if JF and JF > (yF or 0) + 0.05 then
                        jF = true
                        break
                    end
                    UF = localPlayer.Character
                    JF = UF and (UF:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
                    if JF and JF.Value == true and not EF then
                        jF = true
                        break
                    end
                    if
                        runtimeState.castSeen
                        and runtimeState.castSeen[castMissSlot]
                        and runtimeState.castSeen[castMissSlot] >= castOkAt - 0.01
                    then
                        jF = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if if not jF and yF == nil and context.slotCd(castMissSlot) == nil then true else jF then
                    runtimeState.castOk = runtimeState.castOk or {}
                    runtimeState.castOk[castMissSlot] = castOkAt
                    if not runtimeState.castOkAt or castOkAt > runtimeState.castOkAt then
                        runtimeState.castOkAt = castOkAt
                    end
                    context.castApplyTags(VF, castOkAt)
                else
                    if runtimeState.castOkAt and math.abs(runtimeState.castOkAt - castOkAt) <= 0.2 then
                        context.castApplyTags(VF, runtimeState.castOkAt)
                    end
                    pF("no cooldown, no cast")
                end
            end)
        end
        context.lastCastOk = function()
            if config.castConfirm == false then
                return max(runtimeState.lastQ or -infinity, runtimeState.lastE or -infinity)
            end
            return runtimeState.castOkAt or -infinity
        end
        context.pkHealTick = function(_F)
            if not context.pkHealer() then
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.healPaceAt and _F - runtimeState.healPaceAt < context.pkHealPace() then
                return
            end
            if
                config.pkCastAlways == false
                and (
                    context.BB and context.BB.lethal
                    or runtimeState.reflex ~= nil
                    or (dangerGeometry.dangerHere or 0) >= config.dodgeMoveAt
                )
            then
                return
            end
            local iterateArray, hF =
                ipairs, {
                    {
                        Enum.KeyCode.Q,
                        "q",
                        "lastQ",
                    },
                    {
                        Enum.KeyCode.E,
                        "e",
                        "lastE",
                    },
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(hF) do
                if context.slotReady(entry[2]) then
                    runtimeState[entry[3]] = _F
                    DF(entry[1])
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        context.pkAnyHurt = function()
            local pkHurtAt = os.clock()
            if runtimeState.pkHurtAt and pkHurtAt - runtimeState.pkHurtAt < 0.1 then
                return runtimeState.pkHurtIs == true
            end
            local pkHurtIs = false
            for index, entry in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                index = entry.Character
                entry = index and (index:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                if
                    entry
                    and entry.Health > 0
                    and entry.MaxHealth - entry.Health >= (config.pkHealNeedHp or 1)
                then
                    pkHurtIs = true
                    break
                end
            end
            runtimeState.pkHurtAt = pkHurtAt
            runtimeState.pkHurtIs = pkHurtIs
            return pkHurtIs
        end
        context.pkSlotIsHeal = function(_F)
            local iterateArray, hF =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(hF) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Chain Heal" then
                            index = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                            if index and tostring(index.Value) == _F then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.slotReady = function(_F)
            if
                config.pkFanHoldCast == true
                and context.PK
                and context.PK.fanWindow
                and context.isEvent
                and context.isEvent()
                and context.PK.fanWindow()
            then
                return false
            end
            if
                runtimeState.healPaceAt
                and os.clock() - runtimeState.healPaceAt < context.pkHealPace()
                and context.pkHealer()
            then
                return false
            end
            if
                config.pkHealOnlyHurt ~= false
                and context.pkHealer()
                and context.pkSlotIsHeal(_F)
                and not context.pkAnyHurt()
            then
                return false
            end
            if config.pressOnCooldown == true then
                return true
            end
            local cF = localPlayer.Character
            local hF = cF and (cF:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
            if hF and hF.Value == true then
                return false
            end
            local iterateArray, VF = ipairs, {
                localPlayer.Backpack,
                cF,
            }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(VF) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") then
                            cF = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                            if cF and tostring(cF.Value) == _F then
                                key = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                                index = key and tonumber(key.Value)
                                if index == nil or index < (config.pressCdBelow or 0) then
                                    return true
                                end
                                runtimeState.slotCdAt = runtimeState.slotCdAt or {}
                                hF = os.clock()
                                if index > 0 then
                                    runtimeState.slotCdAt[_F] = hF
                                    return false
                                end
                                return hF - (runtimeState.slotCdAt[_F] or -math.huge)
                                    >= (config.pressCdSettle or 0.2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function _F(cF, hF)
            local yF, VF = hF.X - cF.x, hF.Z - cF.z
            hF = sqrt(yF * yF + VF * VF)
            if hF < 45 then
                return true
            end
            if hF < 90 and string.lower(cF.model.Name):find("mage", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
            return hF > 0.1 and (cF.vx * yF + cF.vz * VF) / hF > 3
        end
        local function contextAoeShapeNow()
            if not context.aoeLanding then
                return nil
            end
            local hF, yF = context.aoeLanding()
            if not (hF and yF) then
                return nil
            end
            local aoeShape = hazardReader.aoeShape
            if
                config.aoeTrueShape ~= false
                and aoeShape
                and aoeShape.measured
                and aoeShape.aoeRound == false
                and aoeShape.aoeX
                and aoeShape.aoeZ
            then
                return hF, yF, aoeShape.aoeX, aoeShape.aoeZ
            end
            return hF, yF
        end
        local function contextCoversPoint(yF, VF, EF, pF, jF, UF, JF, wF, YF, vF)
            local MF, ZF = yF + EF * JF, VF + pF * JF
            VF, yF = jF - MF, UF - ZF
            if not YF then
                return VF * VF + yF * yF <= wF * wF
            end
            MF, ZF = VF * EF + yF * pF, VF * -pF + yF * EF
            return abs(MF) <= vF * 0.5 and abs(ZF) <= YF * 0.5
        end
        context.aoeShapeNow = contextAoeShapeNow
        context.coversPoint = contextCoversPoint
        local function contextCoversMob(VF, EF, pF, jF, UF, JF, wF, YF, vF, MF, ZF)
            MF, ZF = MF or UF and UF.x, ZF or UF and UF.z
            local nF = UF and UF.root
            if config.coverFootprint == false or not (nF and nF.Parent and MF) then
                return contextCoversPoint(VF, EF, pF, jF, MF or 0, ZF or 0, JF, wF, YF, vF)
            end
            local fF, rF = nF.Size, nF.CFrame
            UF, nF = rF.RightVector, rF.LookVector
            local oF, AF = sqrt(UF.X * UF.X + UF.Z * UF.Z), sqrt(nF.X * nF.X + nF.Z * nF.Z)
            if oF < 0.01 or AF < 0.01 then
                return contextCoversPoint(VF, EF, pF, jF, MF, ZF, JF, wF, YF, vF)
            end
            local kF, xF, aF, eF, NF, IF, FF, CF, gF =
                UF.X / oF,
                UF.Z / oF,
                nF.X / AF,
                nF.Z / AF,
                fF.X * 0.5,
                fF.Z * 0.5,
                config.coverMargin or 0.5,
                VF + pF * JF - MF,
                EF + jF * JF - ZF
            if not YF then
                nF, rF = CF * kF + gF * xF, CF * aF + gF * eF
                oF, VF = nF > NF and NF or (nF < -NF and -NF or nF), rF > IF and IF or (rF < -IF and -IF or rF)
                fF, EF, AF = nF - oF, rF - VF, wF - FF
                return AF > 0 and fF * fF + EF * EF <= AF * AF
            end
            UF, rF = vF * 0.5 - FF, YF * 0.5 - FF
            if UF <= 0 or rF <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            YF = -jF
            AF = {
                pF,
                jF,
                YF,
                pF,
                kF,
                xF,
                aF,
                eF,
            }
            for index = 1, 7, 2 do
                oF, FF = AF[index], AF[index + 1]
                EF, fF =
                    abs(UF * (pF * oF + jF * FF)) + abs(rF * (YF * oF + pF * FF)),
                    abs(NF * (kF * oF + xF * FF)) + abs(IF * (aF * oF + eF * FF))
                if abs(CF * oF + gF * FF) > EF + fF then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.coversMob = contextCoversMob
        local function VF(vector, best, jF)
            local UF, JF, wF, YF = contextAoeShapeNow()
            if not (UF and JF) then
                return nil
            end
            local vF, MF, aoeScan, nF =
                max(config.aimStepDeg or 5, 1),
                not jF and config.tagFirst ~= false and contextTagPending(vector) > 0,
                best and {
                    ld = UF,
                    lr = JF,
                    y = vector.Y,
                    at = os.clock(),
                    list = {},
                    best = 0,
                    bestN = 0,
                } or nil,
                hazardReader.aimStick
            local fF, rF, oF =
                nF and os.clock() - (nF.at or 0) < (config.aimStickFor or 1.2) and nF or nil,
                {},
                UF + JF + (config.aimCoverPad or 40)
            oF *= oF
            jF, nF = 0, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and entry.humanoid
                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and (not MF or contextTagTarget(entry))
                then
                    jF += 1
                    index, best = entry.x - vector.X, entry.z - vector.Z
                    if index * index + best * best <= oF then
                        nF += 1
                        rF[nF] = entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            -- Predict short movements only; large extrapolations can miss abrupt turns.
            local fastClear = config.castingPriority == "Fast Clear"
            local predictFor = fastClear and math.min(
                (config.fastClearPredictionLead or 0.18) + math.min(runtimeState.pingS or 0, 0.12),
                config.fastClearPredictionCap or 0.38
            ) or 0
            local oF, best2, kF, xF = 0, 0, -2
            MF, best = 0
            local aF, eF, NF = 0, infinity
            local fineCandidates = {}
            local function evaluateAngle(angle, preview)
                local radians = toRadians(angle % 360)
                local dx, dz = cos(radians), sin(radians)
                local impactX, impactZ = vector.X + dx * UF, vector.Z + dz * UF
                local hits, closest = 0, infinity
                for idx = 1, nF do
                    local enemy = rF[idx]
                    local predictedX, predictedZ = enemy.x, enemy.z
                    if predictFor > 0 then
                        local mvx, mvz = enemy.vx or 0, enemy.vz or 0
                        local mag = sqrt(mvx * mvx + mvz * mvz)
                        local disp = min(mag * predictFor, config.groupDriftMax or 14)
                        if mag > 0.1 then
                            predictedX += mvx / mag * disp
                            predictedZ += mvz / mag * disp
                        end
                    end
                    if contextCoversMob(vector.X, vector.Z, dx, dz, enemy, UF, JF, wF, YF, predictedX, predictedZ) then
                        hits += 1
                        local ox, oz = predictedX - impactX, predictedZ - impactZ
                        closest = min(closest, ox * ox + oz * oz)
                    end
                end
                if preview and aoeScan then
                    best2 += 1
                    aoeScan.list[best2] = {
                        x = impactX, z = impactZ, n = hits, w = hits, fx = dx, fz = dz,
                    }
                end
                if fF then
                    local stick = dx * fF.fx + dz * fF.fz
                    if stick > kF then
                        kF, xF, MF, best = stick, Vector3.new(impactX, vector.Y, impactZ), hits, best2
                    end
                end
                if hits > aF or hits == aF and hits > 0 and closest < eF then
                    NF, aF, eF = Vector3.new(impactX, vector.Y, impactZ), hits, closest
                    if aoeScan and preview then
                        aoeScan.best, aoeScan.bestN = best2, hits
                    end
                end
                if preview and fastClear and hits > 0 then
                    fineCandidates[#fineCandidates + 1] = { angle = angle, hits = hits, closest = closest }
                end
            end
            while oF < 360 do
                evaluateAngle(oF, true)
                oF += vF
            end
            if fastClear and #fineCandidates > 0 then
                table.sort(fineCandidates, function(a, b)
                    return a.hits > b.hits or a.hits == b.hits and a.closest < b.closest
                end)
                local fineStep = max(config.fastClearAimFineStep or 1, 0.5)
                for j = 1, min(3, #fineCandidates) do
                    local baseAngle = fineCandidates[j].angle
                    for offset = -vF * 0.5, vF * 0.5, fineStep do
                        evaluateAngle(baseAngle + offset, false)
                    end
                end
            end
            -- Direction stickiness may only break ties, not sacrifice an enemy.
            if xF and MF > 0 and aF - MF < (fastClear and 0.35 or (config.aimStickMargin or 1.5)) then
                if aoeScan and best then
                    aoeScan.best = best
                    aoeScan.bestN = aoeScan.list[best] and aoeScan.list[best].n or aoeScan.bestN
                end
                NF, aF = xF, MF
            end
            if NF then
                fF, vF = NF.X - vector.X, NF.Z - vector.Z
                rF = sqrt(fF * fF + vF * vF)
                if rF > 0.01 then
                    hazardReader.aimStick = {
                        fx = fF / rF,
                        fz = vF / rF,
                        at = os.clock(),
                    }
                end
            end
            if aoeScan then
                aoeScan.rx = wF
                aoeScan.rz = YF
                hazardReader.aoeScan = aoeScan
            end
            return NF, aF, jF
        end
        local function contextShapeHits(pF, jF, UF)
            local JF, wF, YF, vF = contextAoeShapeNow()
            if not (JF and wF) or not (UF and UF.x) then
                return true
            end
            local MF, ZF = jF.X - pF.X, jF.Z - pF.Z
            jF = sqrt(MF * MF + ZF * ZF)
            if jF < 0.5 then
                return true
            end
            MF /= jF
            ZF /= jF
            local nF, fF, rF = UF.extent or 0, pF.X + MF * JF, pF.Z + ZF * JF
            jF, pF = UF.x - fF, UF.z - rF
            if not YF then
                UF = wF + nF
                return jF * jF + pF * pF <= UF * UF
            end
            UF, JF = jF * MF + pF * ZF, jF * -ZF + pF * MF
            return abs(UF) <= vF * 0.5 + nF and abs(JF) <= YF * 0.5 + nF
        end
        context.shapeHits = contextShapeHits
        context.rodinCastLands = function(pF, jF)
            if config.rodinCastLands == false or not (pF and jF and jF.isBoss and jF.root and jF.root.Parent) then
                return true
            end
            local UF = jF.model
            if
                not (
                    UF
                    and (
                        UF == hazardReader.rodinRig
                        or lowercase(tostring(UF.Name)):find("reincarnation", 1, true)
                    )
                )
            then
                return true
            end
            local JF, wF, YF, vF, MF, ZF = pF.Position, jF.root.Position, contextAoeShapeNow()
            if not (YF and vF) or config.rodinCastTrimmedReach == true then
                UF, jF = a(JF, wF), abs(wF.Y - JF.Y)
                UF = if jF > (config.heightSplit or 6) then sqrt(UF * UF + jF * jF) else UF
                local nF = context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or nil
                if nF and UF > nF then
                    return false, ("%.0f studs off, past the reach (%.0f)"):format(UF, nF)
                end
                if not (YF and vF) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            jF = pF.CFrame.LookVector
            UF = sqrt(jF.X * jF.X + jF.Z * jF.Z)
            if UF < 0.01 then
                return false, "no facing"
            end
            local nF, fF = jF.X / UF, jF.Z / UF
            UF, jF, pF = wF.X - (JF.X + nF * YF), wF.Z - (JF.Z + fF * YF), config.rodinCastLandIn or 2
            if not MF then
                local rF = max(vF - pF, 1)
                if UF * UF + jF * jF <= rF * rF then
                    return true
                end
                local oF = (wF.X - JF.X) * nF + (wF.Z - JF.Z) * fF
                if oF > YF + rF then
                    return false, ("%.0f studs off, past the reach (where it lands, %.0f)"):format(oF, YF + rF)
                end
                oF = sqrt(UF * UF + jF * jF)
                return false, ("facing off - he is %.0f from where it lands (radius %.0f)"):format(oF, rF)
            end
            wF, vF, JF = UF * nF + jF * fF, UF * -fF + jF * nF, max(MF * 0.5 - pF, 1)
            if abs(wF) <= ZF * 0.5 and abs(vF) <= JF then
                return true
            end
            if abs(vF) <= JF then
                return false,
                    ("%.0f studs off, past the reach (where it lands, %.0f)"):format(wF + YF, YF + ZF * 0.5)
            end
            pF = abs(vF)
            return false,
                ("facing off - he is %.0f to the side of it (half width %.0f), %.0f ahead"):format(
                    pF,
                    JF,
                    wF + YF
                )
        end
        context.rodinAttackReach = function()
            local pF, jF, UF, JF = contextAoeShapeNow()
            if pF and jF and config.rodinCastTrimmedReach ~= true and config.rodinCastLands ~= false then
                if UF then
                    return pF + JF * 0.5
                end
                return pF + max(jF - (config.rodinCastLandIn or 2), 1)
            end
            return context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or (config.castStartAt or 44)
        end
        context.rodinCastHeld = function(castLandWhy, jF)
            runtimeState.castLandHeld = (runtimeState.castLandHeld or 0) + 1
            runtimeState.castLandWhy = castLandWhy
            contextLogT(
                "castland",
                1,
                "Fight",
                ("cast at Rodin held (%s): %s"):format(tostring(jF), tostring(castLandWhy or "?"))
            )
        end
        local function contextCanHit(jF, UF)
            if not (UF and UF.root and UF.root.Parent) then
                return false
            end
            return contextShapeHits(jF, T(UF), UF)
        end
        local function contextEngageReady(UF, JF, wF)
            if not (JF and JF.root and JF.root.Parent) then
                return false
            end
            if
                (if wF == nil then a(UF, JF.root.Position) else wF)
                <= (context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 0)
            then
                return true
            end
            if JF.isBoss and config.bossReachByShape ~= false then
                return contextCanHit(UF, JF)
            end
            return false
        end
        context.canHit = contextCanHit
        context.engageReady = contextEngageReady
        local function UF(JF, wF, YF, vF, MF, skillGate)
            local castHumanoid = JF
            local pos, fF = wF.Position, MF
            local rF = MF ~= nil
            if
                not YF.isBoss
                and config.orbitAim ~= false
                and runtimeState.orbitLive
                and runtimeState.orbitLive.mode == "tag"
                and runtimeState.orbitLive.x
                and context.aoeLanding
            then
                MF = runtimeState.orbitLive
                local oF, AF = (MF.ax or MF.x) - pos.X, (MF.az or MF.z) - pos.Z
                local kF, xF = sqrt(oF * oF + AF * AF), select(1, context.aoeLanding())
                if kF > 1 and xF and kF + (MF.ar or MF.r or 0) <= context.orbitShotEdge() then
                    fF = Vector3.new(pos.X + oF / kF * xF, pos.Y, pos.Z + AF / kF * xF)
                    rF = true
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not fF and not YF.isBoss then
                local oF, AF = VF(pos, true, skillGate)
                if oF then
                    fF = oF
                    rF = (AF or 0) > 0
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not fF then
                fF = T(YF)
            else
            end
            if not YF.isBoss then
                MF, skillGate = contextCastGate(pos, fF, vF)
                if not MF then
                    runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate
                    return false
                end
            end
            if not (if not rF then contextShapeHits(pos, fF, YF) else rF) then
                runtimeState.coverHoldSince = runtimeState.coverHoldSince or vF
                if vF - runtimeState.coverHoldSince < (config.castCoverHold or config.lineUpMax or 1) then
                    runtimeState.skillGate = "no cover"
                    return false
                end
            else
                runtimeState.coverHoldSince = nil
            end
            combatBrain.aim = fF
            if not s(wF, JF, fF, vF) then
                return false
            end
            if
                config.attackNeedsBuff ~= false
                and context.attackAllowedBySkill
                and not (context.nearlyDead and context.nearlyDead(YF))
            then
                JF, skillGate = context.attackAllowedBySkill(vF)
                if not JF then
                    if
                        skillGate == "ready"
                        and context.buffPress
                        and context.buffAllowed
                        and context.buffAllowed(vF)
                    then
                        context.buffPress(vF)
                    end
                    runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate
                    return false
                end
            end
            runtimeState.castQueue = runtimeState.castQueue or {}
            local JF = false
            local function MF(ZF, slot, oF)
                if context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(slot) then
                    return
                end
                if vF - (runtimeState[oF] or -infinity) < (config.abilityInterval or 0.15) then
                    return
                end
                if not context.slotReady(slot) then
                    runtimeState.skillGate = "cooldown"
                    return
                end
                local AF = {}
                if context.aoeLanding then
                    local kF, kF = context.aoeLanding()
                    if kF then
                        local xF = (kF + 4) * (kF + 4)
                        for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                            if entry.model and not entry.isBoss then
                                local aF, eF = entry.x - fF.X, entry.z - fF.Z
                                if aF * aF + eF * eF <= xF then
                                    AF[#AF + 1] = entry.model
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
