                end
                local kF, xF = context.tagOnCast and context.tagOnCast(AF, vF) or nil, runtimeState[oF]
                runtimeState[oF] = vF
                if not contextPressAimedAbility(ZF, wF, castHumanoid, fF, vF) then
                    if runtimeState[oF] == vF then
                        runtimeState[oF] = xF
                    end
                    if context.tagOnCastDrop then
                        context.tagOnCastDrop(kF)
                    end
                    runtimeState.skillGate = "held"
                    return
                end
                JF = true
                runtimeState.castQueue[#runtimeState.castQueue + 1] = {
                    slot = slot,
                    at = vF,
                    pos = pos,
                    targetPos = fF,
                }
                while #runtimeState.castQueue > 4 do
                    table.remove(runtimeState.castQueue, 1)
                end
                if context.noteCastRange and YF.humanoid then
                    context.noteCastRange(slot, vF, pos, YF.humanoid, fF)
                end
            end
            if config.autoQ then
                MF(Enum.KeyCode.Q, "q", "lastQ")
            end
            if config.autoE then
                MF(Enum.KeyCode.E, "e", "lastE")
            end
            return JF
        end
        context.weaponClick = function()
            local success = localPlayer.Character
            local wF = success and (success:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
            if not wF or wF.Value == true then
                return false
            end
            success = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("peaceful")
            if success and success.Value == true then
                return false
            end
            success, wF = pcall(function()
                local guiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
                return (guiService:GetErrorMessage() or "") ~= "" or guiService.MenuIsOpen == true
            end)
            if success and wF then
                return false
            end
            success = contextWorkspace.CurrentCamera
            if not success then
                return false
            end
            wF = success.ViewportSize
            local YF = math.floor(wF.X * 0.5)
            local vF = math.floor(wF.Y * 0.55)
            success, wF = pcall(function()
                local playerGui, guiService, iterateArray =
                    localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), game:GetService("GuiService"), ipairs
                local fF = {
                    vF,
                    vF - guiService:GetGuiInset().Y,
                }
                for key, entry in iterateArray(fF) do
                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(YF, entry)) do
                        if
                            entry2.Visible
                            and (entry2.Active or entry2:IsA("GuiButton") or entry2:IsA("TextBox"))
                        then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end)
            if not (success and wF) then
                runtimeState.swingBlocked = (runtimeState.swingBlocked or 0) + 1
                return false
            end
            SF(virtualInputManager.SendMouseButtonEvent, YF, vF, 0, true, game, 0)
            task.delay(0.03, function()
                SF(virtualInputManager.SendMouseButtonEvent, YF, vF, 0, false, game, 0)
            end)
            runtimeState.swings = (runtimeState.swings or 0) + 1
            return true
        end
        local function p(SF, JF, hereCastAt, YF)
            if context.isAlt1186() then
                return
            end
            if
                config.rodinRedNoCast ~= false
                and context.redOrbNear
                and context.redOrbNear(
                    JF.Position,
                    (config.castRootTime or 0.7) + (config.redOrbCastMargin or 0.35)
                )
            then
                return
            end
            if
                context.BB
                and context.BB.lethal
                and not (
                    context.PB
                    and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
                    and context.OD
                    and context.OD.clearFor
                    and context.OD.clearFor(JF.Position, YF, config.castRootTime or 0.7)
                )
            then
                local primary = context.BB.primary
                local MF = primary and type(primary.tti) == "number" and primary.tti or 0
                if
                    config.castWhileDodging == false
                    or MF < (config.castRootTime or 0.7) + (config.castDodgeMargin or 0.35)
                then
                    return
                end
            end
            local vF = runtimeState.strikeReady ~= nil and YF - runtimeState.strikeReady < 0.3
            if config.coverageAim ~= false and not hereCastAt.isBoss and context.groupPlan and not vF then
                local groupPlan = runtimeState.groupPlan
                        and runtimeState.groupPlanAt
                        and YF - runtimeState.groupPlanAt < 0.25
                        and runtimeState.groupPlan
                    or context.groupPlan(JF.Position, YF)
                runtimeState.groupPlan = groupPlan
                runtimeState.groupPlanAt = YF
                if
                    groupPlan
                    and groupPlan.hfx
                    and (groupPlan.hereN or 0) >= 1
                    and groupPlan.hereCastAt
                    and groupPlan.hereCastAt.root
                    and groupPlan.hereCastAt.root.Parent
                    and not (not contextTagTarget(groupPlan.hereCastAt) and contextTagPending(JF.Position) > 0)
                then
                    hereCastAt = groupPlan.hereCastAt
                    runtimeState.coverageN = groupPlan.hereN
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local MF = T(hereCastAt)
            combatBrain.aim = MF
            local ZF = a(JF.Position, MF)
            if not vF then
                G(JF, SF, MF)
            end
            local nF, fF = context.abilityReach(), abs(hereCastAt.root.Position.Y - JF.Position.Y)
            ZF = if fF > config.heightSplit then sqrt(ZF * ZF + fF * fF) else ZF
            if ZF > nF + config.groupStepIn and a(JF.Position, hereCastAt.root.Position) <= nF then
                MF = hereCastAt.root.Position
                ZF = a(JF.Position, MF)
                combatBrain.aim = MF
            else
            end
            fF = false
            if context.aoeLanding then
                local rF, oF = context.aoeLanding()
                fF = if rF and oF then abs(ZF - rF) <= oF + (hereCastAt.extent or 0) else fF
            else
            end
            if not hereCastAt.isBoss and config.tagCastOnly ~= false then
                local rF = contextTagPending(JF.Position)
                if rF > 0 then
                    local oF = contextTagTarget(hereCastAt)
                    if not oF and context.aoeLanding then
                        local AF, AF = context.aoeLanding()
                        if AF then
                            local kF = (AF + 4) * (AF + 4)
                            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                                if
                                    not entry.isBoss
                                    and entry.humanoid
                                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                                    and contextTagTarget(entry)
                                then
                                    local xF, aF = entry.x - MF.X, entry.z - MF.Z
                                    if xF * xF + aF * aF <= kF then
                                        oF = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if oF then
                        runtimeState.tagHoldSince = nil
                    else
                        runtimeState.tagHoldSince = runtimeState.tagHoldSince or YF
                        if YF - runtimeState.tagHoldSince < (config.tagHoldMax or 60) then
                            contextSetState(("SWEEP: %d still to tag - no cast on one already hit"):format(rF))
                            return
                        end
                    end
                else
                    runtimeState.tagHoldSince = nil
                end
            end
            if
                not hereCastAt.isBoss
                and context.firstCastOwed
                and context.firstCastOwed(hereCastAt)
                and not (runtimeState.strikeReady ~= nil and YF - runtimeState.strikeReady < 0.3)
            then
                local rF = context.groupSetFor and context.groupSetFor(hereCastAt) or nil
                local oF, AF =
                    rF and (rF.home or rF.strike) and context.strikeKey and context.strikeKey(rF) or nil,
                    runtimeState.homeWalkYieldAt ~= nil
                        and YF - runtimeState.homeWalkYieldAt < (config.homeYieldCast or 1)
                AF = if AF and not (context.threatened and context.threatened(JF.Position, YF)) then false else AF
                if oF and not (hazardReader.strikeGaveUp and hazardReader.strikeGaveUp[oF]) and not AF then
                    contextSetState("holding fire: the first cast goes from the home base / strike point")
                    return
                end
            end
            local aim = config.firstCastAnyD == true or ZF <= nF + (config.firstCastNear or 8) or fF
            if not hereCastAt.isBoss and aim and context.firstCastOwed and context.firstCastOwed(hereCastAt) then
                local oF, AF, kF = context.firstCastReady(YF)
                if not oF and not (fF and config.firstCastInDisc == true) then
                    runtimeState.firstCastBothSince = runtimeState.firstCastBothSince or YF
                    if YF - runtimeState.firstCastBothSince < (config.firstCastBothWait or 8) then
                        runtimeState.firstCastWaitAt = YF
                        contextSetState(("first cast: waiting for %s %.1fs"):format(AF or "cooldown", kF or 0))
                        return
                    end
                else
                    runtimeState.firstCastBothSince = nil
                end
            else
                runtimeState.firstCastBothSince = nil
            end
            if
                not hereCastAt.isBoss
                and aim
                and context.aoeLanding
                and (not context.firstCastReady or context.firstCastReady(YF))
            then
                local oF, AF = context.aoeLanding()
                if oF and AF then
                    local position, xF, aF, eF, NF = JF.Position, context.groupMembers(hereCastAt)
                    if NF >= 2 then
                        local IF = hazardReader.groupOf and hazardReader.groupOf[hereCastAt.model] or nil
                        local FF = IF and IF.id and ("ring %d"):format(IF.id)
                            or ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(aF / 20, eF / 20)
                        if not context.groupFirstCastDone(xF) then
                            runtimeState.firstCastSince = runtimeState.firstCastSince or {}
                            IF = runtimeState.firstCastSince[FF]
                            if not IF then
                                IF = YF
                                runtimeState.firstCastSince[FF] = YF
                            else
                            end
                            local CF, gF =
                                context.BB and context.BB.active or context.dangerUp and context.dangerUp(),
                                JF.CFrame.LookVector
                            local iF = Vector3.new(gF.X, 0, gF.Z)
                            if iF.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                                iF = iF.Unit
                                local bF, BF, GF, zF, sF, TF =
                                    position.X + iF.X * oF, position.Z + iF.Z * oF, 0, context.enclosingCircle(xF)
                                local WF, KF
                                if zF then
                                    WF, KF, GF = zF, sF, TF
                                else
                                    WF, KF = aF, eF
                                end
                                gF, TF =
                                    sqrt((WF - bF) ^ 2 + (KF - BF) ^ 2) + GF
                                        <= AF - (config.firstCastSlack or 1.5),
                                    GF <= AF - (config.firstCastSlack or 1.5)
                                sF = config.firstCastWholeStrict ~= false and TF
                                gF = if vF and not sF then true else gF
                                local aF, eF = gF and NF or 0, not gF
                                if eF then
                                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(xF) do
                                        zF, index2 = entry2.root.Position.X - bF, entry2.root.Position.Z - BF
                                        aF = if zF * zF + index2 * index2
                                                <= (AF - (config.firstCastSlack or 1.5)) ^ 2
                                            then aF + 1
                                            else aF
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                zF = TF and (config.firstCastWaitFit or 8) or (config.firstCastWait or 3)
                                if eF and (sF or not fF) and YF - IF < zF then
                                    if CF then
                                        return
                                    end
                                    bF, BF = position.X - WF, position.Z - KF
                                    local eF = sqrt(bF * bF + BF * BF)
                                    if eF > 1 then
                                        local IF = context.firstCastStandD
                                                and context.firstCastStandD(oF, AF, GF)
                                            or oF
                                        local vector =
                                            Vector3.new(WF + bF / eF * IF, position.Y, KF + BF / eF * IF)
                                        if
                                            a(position, vector) > 2
                                            and runtimeState.orbitStepAt ~= YF
                                            and not (
                                                context.coneBad
                                                and context.coneBad(
                                                    vector.X,
                                                    vector.Z,
                                                    position.X,
                                                    position.Z,
                                                    nil,
                                                    position.Y
                                                )
                                            )
                                        then
                                            g(SF, JF, vector, e(), 1.5)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    G(
                                        JF,
                                        SF,
                                        context.bestCastFacing
                                                and context.bestCastFacing(position, hereCastAt)
                                            or nil
                                            or Vector3.new(WF, position.Y, KF)
                                    )
                                    contextSetState(
                                        ("first cast: %d/%d of %s, circle r%.0f vs aoe r%.0f%s"):format(
                                            aF,
                                            NF,
                                            FF,
                                            GF,
                                            AF,
                                            TF and "" or " (wider than the disc)"
                                        )
                                    )
                                    return
                                end
                                if context.ST and context.ST.noteFirstCast then
                                    context.ST.noteFirstCast(gF)
                                end
                            end
                            if ZF <= nF or fF then
                                runtimeState.firstCastSince[FF] = nil
                                iF = {}
                                for index3, entry3 in ipairs(xF) do
                                    if entry3.model then
                                        iF[#iF + 1] = entry3.model
                                    end
                                end
                                if context.tagOnCast then
                                    context.tagOnCast(iF, YF)
                                else
                                    local castPending, castPending2 = hazardReader.castPending
                                    if castPending then
                                        castPending2 = castPending
                                    else
                                        local setMetatable, weakKeys =
                                            setmetatable, {
                                                __mode = "k",
                                            }
                                        castPending2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
                                    end
                                    hazardReader.castPending = castPending2
                                    for index4, entry4 in ipairs(iF) do
                                        hazardReader.castPending[entry4] = YF
                                        contextMarkStruck(entry4)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not hereCastAt.isBoss and context.bestCastFacing and not vF then
                local aim2, AF, kF = context.bestCastFacing(JF.Position, hereCastAt)
                if aim2 then
                    G(JF, SF, aim2)
                    combatBrain.aim = aim2
                    runtimeState.castCoverage = ("%d/%d"):format(AF or 0, kF or 0)
                end
            end
            if
                not hereCastAt.isBoss
                and not vF
                and config.orbitAim ~= false
                and runtimeState.orbitLive
                and runtimeState.orbitLive.mode == "tag"
                and runtimeState.orbitLive.x
                and context.aoeLanding
            then
                local orbitLive, position2 = runtimeState.orbitLive, JF.Position
                local kF, xF =
                    (orbitLive.ax or orbitLive.x) - position2.X, (orbitLive.az or orbitLive.z) - position2.Z
                local aF, eF = sqrt(kF * kF + xF * xF), select(1, context.aoeLanding())
                if aF > 1 and eF and aF + (orbitLive.ar or orbitLive.r or 0) <= context.orbitShotEdge() then
                    aim = Vector3.new(position2.X + kF / aF * eF, position2.Y, position2.Z + xF / aF * eF)
                    G(JF, SF, aim)
                    combatBrain.aim = aim
                end
            end
            vF = context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal == true
            if
                vF
                and context.BB.primary
                and context.BB.primary.box
                and context.BB.primary.box.name == "melee keep-out"
            then
                aim = infinity
                for index5, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        enemy.melee
                        and not enemy.isBoss
                        and enemy.root
                        and enemy.root.Parent
                        and enemy.humanoid
                        and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                    then
                        index5 = a(JF.Position, enemy.root.Position)
                        aim = if index5 < aim then index5 else aim
                    else
                    end
                end
                vF = if aim >= (config.meleeCastAt or 22) then false else vF
            else
            end
            local oF, AF = infinity, false
            for index6, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    enemy2.melee
                    and not enemy2.isBoss
                    and enemy2.root
                    and enemy2.root.Parent
                    and enemy2.humanoid
                    and enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    index6 = enemy2.root.Position
                    aim = a(JF.Position, index6)
                    oF = if aim < oF then aim else oF
                    if aim < (config.meleeCastHold or 22) then
                        AF = true
                    else
                        if aim < (config.meleeCastClosing or 36) then
                            local aF, eF = JF.Position.X - index6.X, JF.Position.Z - index6.Z
                            AF = if ((enemy2.vx or 0) * aF + (enemy2.vz or 0) * eF) / max(aim, 1) > 8
                                then true
                                else AF
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if oF < (config.meleeCastClosing or 36) then
                runtimeState.meleeHoldSince = runtimeState.meleeHoldSince or YF
            else
                runtimeState.meleeHoldSince = nil
            end
            AF = if AF
                    and runtimeState.meleeHoldSince
                    and YF - runtimeState.meleeHoldSince >= (config.meleeHoldMax or 1.5)
                    and (oF >= (config.meleeStrikeAt or 18) or not (context.BB and context.BB.lethal))
                then false
                else AF
            if AF then
                runtimeState.meleeCastHoldAt = YF
            end
            aim = hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil
                and not (runtimeState.orbAttackAt ~= nil and YF - runtimeState.orbAttackAt < 0.2)
            aim = if aim
                    and hereCastAt.isBoss
                    and (hazardReader.orbLead.orbD or 0) >= (config.orbCastMin or 24)
                then if ZF
                        <= (context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or context.abilityReach())
                    then false
                    else aim
                else aim
            aim = if aim
                    and hazardReader.orbNear
                    and context.orbNearShielded
                    and context.orbNearShielded(JF.Position.X, JF.Position.Z)
                then false
                else aim
            local oF, kF =
                hazardReader.crissAt ~= nil
                    and YF - hazardReader.crissAt < (config.castHoldAfterCriss or 3)
                    and hereCastAt.isBoss,
                config.pkCastAlways ~= false and context.isEvent and context.isEvent()
            local xF = not kF
                and (
                    vF
                    or AF
                    or runtimeState.reflex ~= nil
                    or aim
                    or oF
                    or (dangerGeometry.dangerHere or 0) >= config.dodgeMoveAt
                )
            if
                (
                    ZF <= nF
                    or fF
                    or hereCastAt.isBoss
                        and config.bossReachByShape ~= false
                        and contextShapeHits(JF.Position, MF, hereCastAt)
                ) and not xF
            then
                if
                    kF
                    and context.PK
                    and context.PK.openingHold
                    and context.PK.openingHold()
                    and not (context.pkHealer and context.pkHealer())
                then
                    if not movement.driving then
                        contextSetState("cast: holding until the first fan (the boss cannot be hurt yet)")
                    end
                    return
                elseif kF and runtimeState.pkSugar then
                    if not s(JF, SF, MF, YF) then
                        if not movement.driving then
                            contextSetState("cast: turning to the boss for Sugarstorm")
                        end
                        return
                    end
                elseif kF then
                elseif context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.lethal == true then
                    vF = JF.CFrame.LookVector
                    oF = sqrt(vF.X * vF.X + vF.Z * vF.Z)
                    if oF < 0.01 or not context.shapeHits then
                        return
                    end
                    local nF, position3 =
                        context.aoeLanding and select(1, context.aoeLanding()) or (config.aoeDistance or 39.6),
                        JF.Position
                    if
                        not context.shapeHits(
                            position3,
                            Vector3.new(position3.X + vF.X / oF * nF, position3.Y, position3.Z + vF.Z / oF * nF),
                            hereCastAt
                        )
                    then
                        return
                    end
                elseif not s(JF, SF, combatBrain.aim or MF, YF) then
                    runtimeState.angleHoldSince = runtimeState.angleHoldSince or YF
                    if
                        not (
                            hazardReader.rodinRig ~= nil
                            and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent ~= nil
                            and YF - runtimeState.angleHoldSince > (config.rodinAngleHold or 0.4)
                        )
                    then
                        if not movement.driving then
                            contextSetState("cast: holding the angle")
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
                runtimeState.angleHoldSince = nil
                runtimeState.castQueue = runtimeState.castQueue or {}
                local function s(keyCode, slot, nF)
                    if YF - runtimeState[nF] < config.abilityInterval then
                        return
                    end
                    if context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(slot) then
                        return
                    end
                    local skillGate, skillGate2 = context.attackAllowedBySkill(YF)
                    if not skillGate then
                        if
                            skillGate2 == "ready"
                            and context.buffPress
                            and context.buffAllowed
                            and context.buffAllowed(YF)
                        then
                            context.buffPress(YF)
                        end
                        runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate2
                        return
                    end
                    if context.buffAllowed and context.buffAllowed(YF) and context.buffState then
                        local AF, xF, xF = context.buffState(YF)
                        if AF == "ready" then
                            if context.buffPress(YF) then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            skillGate2, skillGate = AF == "gap" and config.buffGapWait ~= false
                            if skillGate2 then
                                local AF = not hereCastAt.isBoss and config.attackOnlyWithSpeed ~= false
                                if AF then
                                    skillGate = AF
                                else
                                    local AF, aF = xF or 0, hereCastAt.isBoss and (config.bossBuffWait or 1)
                                    skillGate = AF <= (aF or (config.buffWaitMax or 1.3))
                                end
                            else
                                skillGate = skillGate2
                            end
                            if skillGate then
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if
                        config.castNeedsCover ~= false
                        and not kF
                        and not contextShapeHits(JF.Position, MF, hereCastAt)
                    then
                        runtimeState.coverGateSince = runtimeState.coverGateSince or YF
                        if YF - runtimeState.coverGateSince < (config.castCoverHold or config.lineUpMax or 1) then
                            runtimeState.skillGate = "no cover"
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        runtimeState.coverGateSince = nil
                    end
                    if hereCastAt.isBoss and context.rodinCastLands then
                        skillGate2, skillGate = context.rodinCastLands(JF, hereCastAt)
                        if not skillGate2 then
                            context.rodinCastHeld(skillGate, "brain")
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    if not hereCastAt.isBoss then
                        skillGate2, skillGate = contextCastGate(JF.Position, combatBrain.aim or MF, YF)
                        if not skillGate2 then
                            runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    if not context.slotReady(slot) then
                        runtimeState.skillGate = "cooldown"
                        return
                    end
                    local castAim = runtimeState.pkSugar and kF and MF or combatBrain.aim or MF
                    if not contextPressAimedAbility(keyCode, JF, SF, castAim, YF) then
                        return
                    end
                    runtimeState[nF] = YF
                    runtimeState.castQueue[#runtimeState.castQueue + 1] = {
                        slot = slot,
                        at = YF,
                        pos = JF.Position,
                        targetPos = MF,
                    }
                    while #runtimeState.castQueue > 4 do
                        table.remove(runtimeState.castQueue, 1)
                    end
                end
                if config.autoQ then
                    s(Enum.KeyCode.Q, "q", "lastQ")
                end
                if config.autoE then
                    s(Enum.KeyCode.E, "e", "lastE")
                end
            end
            if
                config.autoAttack
                and ZF <= config.attackRange + hereCastAt.extent
                and YF - runtimeState.lastClick >= config.clickInterval
            then
                runtimeState.lastClick = YF
                oF = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if oF then
                    pcall(oF.Activate, oF)
                elseif
                    config.classProfile == "warrior"
                    and config.weaponSwing ~= false
                    and context.weaponClick
                    and not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
                then
                    context.weaponClick()
                end
            end
        end
        context.fireLoop = function()
            if runtimeState.fireThread then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.fireThread = task.spawn(function()
                while not runtimeState.destroyed do
                    task.wait(config.bossFireEvery or 0.1)
                    local success, dF = pcall(function()
                        if runtimeState.farmEnabled and not runtimeState.modHalt and context.pkHealTick then
                            context.pkHealTick(os.clock())
                        end
                        if not (config.bossFire and runtimeState.farmEnabled) or runtimeState.modHalt then
                            return
                        end
                        local SF = localPlayer.Character
                        local humanoid, JF =
                            SF and (SF:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                            SF and (SF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        if not (humanoid and JF) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                            return
                        end
                        local wF
                        local YF, vF = ipairs, hazardReader.enemies
                        for key, entry in YF(vF) do
                            if
                                entry.isBoss
                                and entry.root
                                and entry.root.Parent
                                and entry.humanoid
                                and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                            then
                                wF = entry
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if not wF then
                            return
                        end
                        if
                            context.PK
                            and context.PK.openingHold
                            and context.PK.openingHold()
                            and not (context.pkHealer and context.pkHealer())
                        then
                            return
                        end
                        local now = os.clock()
                        local ZF = T(wF)
                        local pos = JF.Position
                        if config.bossFaceAlways then
                            combatBrain.aim = ZF
                            G(JF, humanoid, ZF)
                        end
                        SF, YF = a(pos, ZF), abs(wF.root.Position.Y - pos.Y)
                        if
                            (if YF > config.heightSplit then sqrt(SF * SF + YF * YF) else SF)
                            > context.fireReach()
                        then
                            return
                        end
                        vF = context.PB
                            and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
                            and context.OD
                            and context.OD.clearFor
                            and context.OD.clearFor(JF.Position, now, config.castRootTime or 0.7)
                        if
                            config.bossFireSafe
                            and not (config.pkCastAlways ~= false and context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
                            and (
                                context.BB and context.BB.lethal and not vF
                                or runtimeState.reflex ~= nil
                                or (dangerGeometry.dangerHere or 0) >= config.dodgeMoveAt
                            )
                        then
                            return
                        end
                        combatBrain.aim = ZF
                        G(JF, humanoid, ZF)
                        runtimeState.castQueue = runtimeState.castQueue or {}
                        local function SF(EF, slot, vF)
                            if now - runtimeState[vF] < config.abilityInterval then
                                return
                            end
                            if context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(slot) then
                                return
                            end
                            local fF, skillGate = context.attackAllowedBySkill(now)
                            if not fF then
                                if
                                    skillGate == "ready"
                                    and context.buffPress
                                    and context.buffAllowed
                                    and context.buffAllowed(now)
                                then
                                    context.buffPress(now)
                                end
                                runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate
                                return
                            end
                            if context.buffAllowed and context.buffAllowed(now) and context.buffState then
                                local oF, AF, AF = context.buffState(now)
                                if oF == "ready" then
                                    if context.buffPress(now) then
                                        return
                                    end
                                elseif
                                    oF == "gap"
                                    and config.buffGapWait ~= false
                                    and (AF or 0) <= (config.bossBuffWait or 1)
                                then
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                            if context.rodinCastLands then
                                skillGate, fF = context.rodinCastLands(JF, wF)
                                if not skillGate then
                                    if context.rodinCastHeld then
                                        context.rodinCastHeld(fF, "fire loop")
                                    end
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                            if not context.slotReady(slot) then
                                runtimeState.skillGate = "cooldown"
                                return
                            end
                            if not contextPressAimedAbility(EF, JF, humanoid, ZF, now) then
                                return
                            end
                            runtimeState[vF] = now
                            runtimeState.castQueue[#runtimeState.castQueue + 1] = {
                                slot = slot,
                                at = now,
                                pos = pos,
                                targetPos = ZF,
                            }
                            while #runtimeState.castQueue > 4 do
                                table.remove(runtimeState.castQueue, 1)
                            end
                            if context.noteCastRange and wF and wF.humanoid then
                                context.noteCastRange(slot, now, pos, wF.humanoid, ZF)
                            end
                        end
                        if config.autoQ then
                            SF(Enum.KeyCode.Q, "q", "lastQ")
                        end
                        if config.autoE then
                            SF(Enum.KeyCode.E, "e", "lastE")
                        end
                    end)
                    if not success then
                        runtimeState.lastError, runtimeState.lastErrorAt =
                            "fire loop: " .. tostring(dF), os.clock()
                    end
                end
                runtimeState.fireThread = nil
            end)
        end
        local function s(dF, SF, EF, strafeFlipAt)
            local position = dF.Position
            local function YF(vF)
                return not vF.isBoss
                    and vF.root
                    and vF.root.Parent
                    and (vF.humanoid == nil or vF.humanoid.Health > 0)
                    and (_F(vF, position) or a(position, vF.root.Position) < (config.orbitNear or 45))
            end
            local vF, MF, ZF, nF = {}, 0, 0, 0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if YF(enemy) then
                    MF += enemy.x
                    ZF += enemy.z
                    nF += 1
                    vF[nF] = enemy
                else
                end
            end
            local fF, rF, oF, AF, kF = SF.root.Position, false
            if nF > 1 and config.orbitPack ~= false then
                YF, dF = MF / nF, ZF / nF
                if config.orbitClusters ~= false and nF >= (config.orbitClusterMin or 4) then
                    local xF, aF, eF = config.orbitLink or 34, {}, {}
                    for index2 = 1, nF, 1 do
                        aF[index2] = 0
                    end
                    for index3 = 1, nF, 1 do
                        if aF[index3] == 0 then
                            local IF, FF =
                                {
                                    index3,
                                }, {
                                    index3,
                                }
                            aF[index3] = #eF + 1
                            local CF = 1
                            while CF <= #FF do
                                local gF = FF[CF]
                                CF += 1
                                for index4 = 1, nF, 1 do
                                    if aF[index4] == 0 then
                                        local iF, bF = vF[gF].x - vF[index4].x, vF[gF].z - vF[index4].z
                                        if iF * iF + bF * bF <= xF * xF then
                                            aF[index4] = aF[index3]
                                            IF[#IF + 1] = index4
                                            FF[#FF + 1] = index4
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            eF[#eF + 1] = IF
                        end
                    end
                    if #eF > 1 then
                        aF, xF = infinity, 1
                        for index5 = 1, #eF, 1 do
                            local IF, FF, CF = eF[index5], 0, 0
                            for index6 = 1, #IF, 1 do
                                local iF = vF[IF[index6]]
                                FF, CF = FF + iF.x, CF + iF.z
                            end
                            FF /= #IF
                            CF /= #IF
                            IF = (FF - position.X) ^ 2 + (CF - position.Z) ^ 2
                            if IF < aF then
                                aF, xF = IF, index5
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        local aF, NF, IF = 0, 0, 0
                        for index7 = 1, #eF, 1 do
                            if index7 ~= xF then
                                local xF = eF[index7]
                                for index8 = 1, #xF, 1 do
                                    local FF = vF[xF[index8]]
                                    aF, NF, IF = aF + FF.x, NF + FF.z, IF + 1
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        if IF > 0 then
                            oF, AF = aF / IF, NF / IF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                local xF = 0
                for index9 = 1, nF, 1 do
                    local eF = sqrt((vF[index9].x - YF) ^ 2 + (vF[index9].z - dF) ^ 2)
                    xF = if eF > xF then eF else xF
                end
                if xF + (config.orbitClear or 10) <= (config.orbitMax or 70) then
                    fF = Vector3.new(YF, fF.Y, dF)
                    kF = max(EF, xF + (config.orbitClear or 10))
                    rF = true
                else
                    kF = EF
                end
            else
                kF = EF
            end
            YF, dF = position.X - fF.X, position.Z - fF.Z
            local xF = sqrt(YF * YF + dF * dF)
            if xF < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            local aF = YF / xF
            local eF = dF / xF
            if config.oneSide ~= false and runtimeState.orbitSide then
                combatBrain.strafeDir = runtimeState.orbitSide
            end
            if nF > 1 and not rF and strafeFlipAt - combatBrain.strafeFlipAt > 1 then
                YF, EF = -eF, aF
                dF = (MF / nF - position.X) * YF + (ZF / nF - position.Z) * EF
                if dF > 2 then
                    combatBrain.strafeDir = 1
                elseif dF < -2 then
                    combatBrain.strafeDir = -1
                end
                runtimeState.orbitSide = combatBrain.strafeDir
            end
            if oF and config.orbitAwayFromFar ~= false and strafeFlipAt - combatBrain.strafeFlipAt > 1 then
                YF, dF = -eF, aF
                EF = (oF - position.X) * YF + (AF - position.Z) * dF
                if EF > 2 then
                    combatBrain.strafeDir = -1
                elseif EF < -2 then
                    combatBrain.strafeDir = 1
                end
                runtimeState.orbitSide = combatBrain.strafeDir
            end
            vF, EF = SF.melee and kF - xF > 2 and 2 or 6, SF.melee and 8 or 4
            local MF = max(min(kF - xF, EF), -EF)
            if SF.melee and MF > config.meleeBackOff then
                MF = config.meleeBackOff
            else
            end
            local ZF = contextRaycastParams(SF.model)
            local function nF(rF, oF)
                if config.strafeWalls == false then
                    return false
                end
                local AF, kF = position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(rF, position.Y + 2, oF)
                return contextWorkspace:Raycast(AF, kF - AF, ZF) ~= nil
            end
            local function rF(oF, AF)
                local kF = min(AF / max(xF, 10), config.strafeArcMaxRad or 0.6) * oF
                local oF, NF = cos(kF), sin(kF)
                local IF, FF, CF = aF * oF - eF * NF, aF * NF + eF * oF, xF + MF
                kF, NF = fF.X + IF * CF, fF.Z + FF * CF
                IF = contextFloorY(kF, position.Y, NF, ZF)
                if not IF or abs(IF - position.Y) > config.maxStepHeight + 3 then
                    return nil
                end
                if contextDangerAt(kF, position.Y, NF, AF / e()) >= config.dodgeMoveAt then
                    return nil
                end
                if nF(kF, NF) then
                    return nil
                end
                return Vector3.new(kF, IF, NF)
            end
            local function MF()
                if config.strafeBackOff == false then
                    return nil
                end
                local fF, oF =
                    position.X + aF * (config.strafeBackStep or 10),
                    position.Z + eF * (config.strafeBackStep or 10)
                local AF = contextFloorY(fF, position.Y, oF, ZF)
                if not AF or abs(AF - position.Y) > config.maxStepHeight + 3 then
                    return nil
                end
                if nF(fF, oF) then
                    return nil
                end
                return Vector3.new(fF, AF, oF)
            end
            EF, dF, SF = config.strafeArc or 30, config.strafeArcMid or 16, config.strafeArcMin or 8
            YF = rF(combatBrain.strafeDir, EF) or rF(combatBrain.strafeDir, dF) or rF(combatBrain.strafeDir, SF)
            if YF then
                return YF
            end
            YF = rF(-combatBrain.strafeDir, EF)
                or rF(-combatBrain.strafeDir, dF)
                or rF(-combatBrain.strafeDir, SF)
            if YF then
                combatBrain.strafeDir = -combatBrain.strafeDir
                combatBrain.strafeFlipAt = strafeFlipAt
                runtimeState.orbitSide = combatBrain.strafeDir
                return YF
            end
            YF = rF(combatBrain.strafeDir, vF * 0.5)
            if YF then
                return YF
            end
            YF = MF()
            if YF then
                return YF
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function dF(SF, vector, JF, wF)
            local YF = toRadians(JF)
            return SF
                + Vector3.new(
                        vector.X * cos(YF) - vector.Z * sin(YF),
                        0,
                        vector.X * sin(YF) + vector.Z * cos(YF)
                    )
                    * wF
        end
        context.casterTick = function(SF)
            if not runtimeState.farmEnabled or runtimeState.destroyed then
                return
            end
            local target = combatBrain.target
            if
                not (
                    target
                    and target.isBoss
                    and target.root
                    and target.root.Parent
                    and target.humanoid
                    and target.humanoid.Health > 0
                )
            then
                return
            end
            if
                context.PK
                and context.PK.openingHold
                and context.PK.openingHold()
                and not (context.pkHealer and context.pkHealer())
            then
                return
            end
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            local wF = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            local humanoid = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not (wF and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            if config.casterWhileDodging == false and context.BB and context.BB.lethal then
                return
            end
            local JF, vF = a(wF.Position, target.root.Position), false
            if context.aoeLanding then
                local MF, ZF = context.aoeLanding()
                vF = if MF and ZF then abs(JF - MF) <= ZF + (target.extent or 0) else vF
            else
            end
            if
                JF > context.fireReach()
                and not vF
                and not (
                    target.isBoss
                    and config.bossReachByShape ~= false
                    and context.canHit
                    and context.canHit(wF.Position, target)
                )
            then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.castQueue = runtimeState.castQueue or {}
            local function JF(castQueue, slot, castQueue2)
                if context.isBuffSlot(slot) then
                    return
                end
                local nF, skillGate = context.attackAllowedBySkill(SF)
                if not nF then
                    if
                        skillGate == "ready"
                        and context.buffPress
                        and context.buffAllowed
                        and context.buffAllowed(SF)
                    then
                        context.buffPress(SF)
                    end
                    runtimeState.skillGate = skillGate
                    return
                end
                if SF - runtimeState[castQueue2] < config.abilityInterval then
                    return
                end
                if context.castHold and context.castHold(SF) then
                    return
                end
                if context.buffAllowed and context.buffAllowed(SF) and context.buffState then
                    local rF, oF, oF = context.buffState(SF)
                    if rF == "ready" then
                        if context.buffPress(SF) then
                            return
                        end
                    elseif
                        rF == "gap"
                        and config.buffGapWait ~= false
                        and (oF or 0) <= (config.bossBuffWait or 1)
                    then
                        return
                    end
                end
                G(wF, humanoid, target.root.Position)
                if context.rodinCastLands then
                    nF, skillGate = context.rodinCastLands(wF, target)
                    if not nF then
                        if context.rodinCastHeld then
                            context.rodinCastHeld(skillGate, "caster")
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
                if not context.slotReady(slot) then
                    runtimeState.skillGate = "cooldown"
                    return
                end
                if not contextPressAimedAbility(castQueue, wF, humanoid, target.root.Position, SF) then
                    return
                end
                runtimeState[castQueue2] = SF
                castQueue, castQueue2 = runtimeState.castQueue, runtimeState.castQueue
                nF, skillGate =
                    #castQueue2 + 1, {
                        slot = slot,
                        at = SF,
                        pos = wF.Position,
                    }
                skillGate.targetPos, castQueue[nF] = target.root.Position, skillGate
                while #runtimeState.castQueue > 4 do
                    table.remove(runtimeState.castQueue, 1)
                end
                if context.noteCastRange and target.humanoid then
                    context.noteCastRange(slot, SF, wF.Position, target.humanoid, target.root.Position)
                end
            end
            if config.autoQ then
                JF(Enum.KeyCode.Q, "q", "lastQ")
            end
            if config.autoE then
                JF(Enum.KeyCode.E, "e", "lastE")
            end
        end
        local function z(SF, EF, JF)
            if SF.isBoss or config.faceCoverage == false then
                return T(SF)
            end
            local faceBest = runtimeState.faceBest
            if not faceBest or JF - faceBest.at >= (config.faceScanEvery or 0.2) then
                local YF, vF = VF(EF.Position, false, false)
                faceBest = {
                    at = JF,
                    point = YF ~= nil and (vF or 0) > 0 and YF or nil,
                }
                runtimeState.faceBest = faceBest
            else
            end
            return faceBest.point or T(SF)
        end
        context.faceTick = function(SF)
            local EF = localPlayer.Character
            local JF, humanoid, YF =
                EF and (EF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
                EF and (EF:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                combatBrain.target
            EF = YF and YF.root and YF.root.Parent and YF.humanoid and YF.humanoid.Health > 0
            if
                config.faceTarget == false
                or not runtimeState.farmEnabled
                or runtimeState.destroyed
                or not EF
                or not (JF and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0)
            then
                if config.facePhysics ~= false then
                    contextFaceRelease(JF)
                end
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.strikeReady ~= nil and SF - runtimeState.strikeReady < 0.3 then
                return
            end
            if a(JF.Position, YF.root.Position) > context.fireReach() + (config.faceWithin or 25) then
                if config.facePhysics ~= false then
                    contextFaceRelease(JF)
                end
                return
            end
            if config.facePhysics ~= false then
                EF = i(z(YF, JF, SF), JF.Position)
                b(JF, humanoid, EF)
                local lookVector, B, vF = JF.CFrame.LookVector, EF.X - JF.Position.X, EF.Z - JF.Position.Z
                local MF = math.sqrt(B * B + vF * vF)
                if
                    MF >= 1
                    and (lookVector.X * B + lookVector.Z * vF) / MF
                        < math.cos(math.rad(config.faceMinDeg or 12))
                then
                    local linearVelocity = JF.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local B = linearVelocity.X * linearVelocity.X + linearVelocity.Z * linearVelocity.Z > 4
                    if
                        not B
                        or SF - (runtimeState.faceTickAt or -1000000000)
                            >= (config.faceWriteEvery or 0.1)
                    then
                        runtimeState.faceTickAt = SF
                        local position = JF.Position
                        JF.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, Vector3.new(EF.X, position.Y, EF.Z))
                        if B then
                            JF.AssemblyLinearVelocity = linearVelocity
                        end
                        movement.facedAt = SF
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            if
                context.BB and context.BB.lethal
                or hazardReader.orbLead ~= nil
                or runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil and SF - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.3
            then
                return
            end
            local vector, lookVector2 = i(z(YF, JF, SF), JF.Position), JF.CFrame.LookVector
            YF, EF = vector.X - JF.Position.X, vector.Z - JF.Position.Z
            local i = math.sqrt(YF * YF + EF * EF)
            if i < 1 then
                return
            end
            if (lookVector2.X * YF + lookVector2.Z * EF) / i > math.cos(math.rad(config.faceMinDeg or 12)) then
                return
            end
            EF = JF.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if
                EF.X * EF.X + EF.Z * EF.Z > 4
                and SF - (runtimeState.faceTickAt or -1000000000) < (config.faceEvery or 0.25)
            then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.faceTickAt = SF
            G(JF, humanoid, vector)
        end
        context.buffTick = function(i)
            if not runtimeState.farmEnabled or runtimeState.destroyed then
                return
            end
            if not hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                return
            end
            if type(config.buffSpells) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not (humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            if context.arrowRainTick then
                pcall(context.arrowRainTick, i)
            end
            if context.pulseSpeedTick then
                pcall(context.pulseSpeedTick, i)
            end
            if context.buffUp then
                context.buffUp(i)
            end
            if not context.buffAllowed(i) then
                return
            end
            if i - (runtimeState.firstCastWaitAt or -math.huge) < 0.5 then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.lastBuff = runtimeState.lastBuff or {}
            context.buffPress(i)
        end
        context.isBuffSlot = function(i)
            local b = hazardReader.abilitySlots and hazardReader.abilitySlots[i]
            i = b and b.name and string.lower(tostring(b.name)) or nil
            if not i or type(config.buffSpells) ~= "table" then
                return false
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(context.buffNames()) do
                if i == string.lower(entry) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.groupWaypointFor = function(i, b)
            if config.groupWaypoints == false or config.waypointFlow == false then
                return nil
            end
            if hazardReader.wpFlowDone and config.waypointFirstOnly ~= false then
                return nil
            end
            if not hazardReader.groupWaypoints then
                hazardReader.groupWaypoints = {}
                pcall(function()
                    local groupWaypoints = isfile
                            and context.pickFile("HarvardLabs/data/waypoints.json", "dq_waypoints.json")
                        or nil
                    local z = groupWaypoints and readfile(groupWaypoints) or nil
                    groupWaypoints = z and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(z) or context.BAKED_WAYPOINTS
                    if type(groupWaypoints) == "table" then
                        hazardReader.groupWaypoints = groupWaypoints
                    end
                end)
            end
            b = hazardReader.groupWaypoints
            if #b == 0 or not (i and i.root and i.root.Parent) or i.isBoss then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z, SF, EF, JF = i.root.Position, ((config.groupLink or 34) * 1.5) ^ 2, 0, 0, 0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    index, i = enemy.root.Position.X - B.X, enemy.root.Position.Z - B.Z
                    if index * index + i * i <= z then
                        SF, EF, JF = SF + enemy.root.Position.X, EF + enemy.root.Position.Z, JF + 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if JF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            SF /= JF
            EF /= JF
            B, i = config.wpLinkRadius or 45
            for index2, entry in ipairs(b) do
                index2 = entry.group
                if type(index2) == "table" and type(entry.points) == "table" and #entry.points > 0 then
                    z = math.sqrt((index2[1] - SF) ^ 2 + (index2[3] - EF) ^ 2) - (entry.radius or 0)
                    if z < B then
                        B, i = z, entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not i then
                return nil
            end
            hazardReader.wpSetDone = hazardReader.wpSetDone or {}
            B = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(i.group[1], i.group[3])
            hazardReader.wpSetDone[B] = true
            b = 1
            if hazardReader.wpPreIdx and hazardReader.wpPreIdx[B] then
                if hazardReader.wpPreFinished and hazardReader.wpPreFinished[B] then
                    return nil
                end
                b = hazardReader.wpPreIdx[B]
            else
            end
            z = nil
            for index3 = b, #i.points, 1 do
                B = i.points[index3]
                index3 = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(B[1], B[3])
                if not (hazardReader.wpDropped and hazardReader.wpDropped[index3]) then
                    z = B
                    break
                end
            end
            return z and Vector3.new(z[1], z[2], z[3]) or nil
        end
        buffSeen, F = pcall(function()
            if
                isfile
                and context.pickFile("HarvardLabs/data/champ_waypoints.json", "dq_champ_waypoints.json")
            then
                local i = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(

                )

                        then
                            champWaypoints[#champWaypoints + 1] = {
                                tonumber(entry[1]),
