                            }
                        end
                    end
                    if #champWaypoints > 0 then
                        config.champWaypoints = champWaypoints
                        runtimeState.champWaypointsFrom = "dq_champ_waypoints.json"
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if not buffSeen then
            runtimeState.lastError, runtimeState.lastErrorAt = "champ waypoints: " .. tostring(F), os.clock()
        end
        context.quietDir = function(i, b, B)
            local hub = hazardReader.hub
            if
                not (
                    hub
                    and hazardReader.beamYaw
                    and hazardReader.beamYawAt
                    and i - hazardReader.beamYawAt <= (config.quietFresh or 6)
                )
            then
                return nil
            end
            local SF, EF = hazardReader.beamRate or 0, hazardReader.fanSweep or 0
            if SF < 1 or EF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            i = (hazardReader.beamYaw - EF * (config.quietBehindDeg or 80)) % 180
            local JF, wF, YF, vF = math.sin(math.rad(i)), math.cos(math.rad(i)), b - hub.X, B - hub.Z
            if YF * JF + vF * wF < 0 then
                JF, wF = -JF, -wF
            else
            end
            return JF, wF, (math.deg(math.atan2(YF, vF)) % 180 - hazardReader.beamYaw) * EF % 180 / SF
        end
        context.champWaypointsNow = function()
            local champWaypoints = config.champWaypoints
            if type(champWaypoints) ~= "table" or #champWaypoints <= 1 then
                return champWaypoints
            end
            local b, B =
                config.champWp2AfterSlam == false or (hazardReader.champSlams or 0) >= 1, {
                    champWaypoints[1],
                }
            for index = 2, #champWaypoints, 1 do
                if
                    b
                    and (
                        config.champWp2AfterReach == false
                        or hazardReader.champWpReached ~= nil
                            and hazardReader.champWpReached[index - 1] == true
                    )
                then
                    B[#B + 1] = champWaypoints[index]
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            return B
        end
        context.champTourTarget = function(vector, vector2)
            local B = context.champWaypointsNow and context.champWaypointsNow() or config.champWaypoints
            if type(B) ~= "table" or #B == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            if hazardReader.champTourBoss ~= hazardReader.leashBoss then
                hazardReader.champTour, hazardReader.champTourBoss = 1, hazardReader.leashBoss
            end
            local z, SF, champTour = #B, config.champTourReverse == true, hazardReader.champTour or 1
            champTour = if champTour > z then z else champTour
            local JF = B[champTour]
            local wF = Vector3.new(JF[1], vector.Y, JF[3])
            wF = if context.champRingPoint then context.champRingPoint(wF) else wF
            if (vector.X - wF.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - wF.Z) ^ 2 <= (config.champTourArrive or 8) ^ 2 then
                hazardReader.champTourArrivedAt = hazardReader.champTourArrivedAt or os.clock()
                if os.clock() - hazardReader.champTourArrivedAt >= (config.champTourDwell or 3) then
                    hazardReader.champTourArrivedAt = nil
                    champTour = SF and champTour - 1 or champTour + 1
                    champTour = if champTour > z then 1 else if champTour < 1 then z else champTour
                else
                end
            else
                hazardReader.champTourArrivedAt = nil
            end
            if vector2 then
                JF = (context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 84) + (config.champTourReachSlack or 10)
                for index = 1, z, 1 do
                    index = B[champTour]
                    if (index[1] - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (index[3] - vector2.Z) ^ 2 <= JF ^ 2 then
                        break
                    end
                    champTour = SF and champTour - 1 or champTour + 1
                    champTour = if champTour > z then 1 else if champTour < 1 then z else champTour
                end
            else
            end
            hazardReader.champTour = champTour
            SF = B[champTour]
            JF = Vector3.new(SF[1], vector.Y, SF[3])
            return if context.champRingPoint then context.champRingPoint(JF) else JF, champTour, z
        end
        context.waypointSets = function()
            local groupWaypointsFor = ""
            pcall(function()
                local dungeonName = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                if dungeonName then
                    groupWaypointsFor = tostring(dungeonName.Value or "")
                end
            end)
            local b = hazardReader.groupWaypoints and hazardReader.groupWaypointsFor == groupWaypointsFor
            if b then
                return hazardReader.groupWaypoints
            end
            hazardReader.groupWaypoints = {}
            hazardReader.groupWaypointsFor = groupWaypointsFor
            pcall(function()
                local groupWaypoints = isfile
                        and context.pickFile("HarvardLabs/data/waypoints.json", "dq_waypoints.json")
                    or nil
                local B = groupWaypoints and readfile(groupWaypoints) or nil
                groupWaypoints = B and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(B) or context.BAKED_WAYPOINTS
                B = type(groupWaypoints) == "table"
                if B then
                    local B = groupWaypoints[1] ~= nil
                    if B then
                        local B = groupWaypointsFor == "" or groupWaypointsFor == "Northern Lands"
                        if B then
                            hazardReader.groupWaypoints = groupWaypoints
                        end
                    else
                        local groupWaypoints2 = groupWaypoints[groupWaypointsFor]
                        if type(groupWaypoints2) == "table" then
                            hazardReader.groupWaypoints = groupWaypoints2
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return hazardReader.groupWaypoints
        end
        context.currentOrderSet = function(i)
            if config.strictGroupOrder == false or config.groupWaypoints == false then
                return nil
            end
            local b = context.waypointSets and context.waypointSets() or nil
            if not b or #b == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = {}, i and hazardReader.groupOf or nil
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    index = z and enemy.model and z[enemy.model] or nil
                    local z = if index ~= nil then i[index] else nil
                    if z == nil then
                        z = context.groupSetFor(enemy) or false
                        if index ~= nil then
                            i[index] = z
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if z then
                        B[z] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            for index2, entry in ipairs(b) do
                if B[entry] then
                    return entry, index2
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.groupSetFor = function(i)
            if config.groupWaypoints == false then
                return nil
            end
            if not (i and i.root and i.root.Parent) or i.isBoss then
                return nil
            end
            local firstWpKey = context.waypointSets()
            if #firstWpKey == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local B, B, z, SF = context.groupMembers(i)
            if SF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            i, SF = config.wpLinkRadius or 45
            for index, entry in ipairs(firstWpKey) do
                index = entry.group
                if type(index) == "table" then
                    local wF = math.sqrt((index[1] - B) ^ 2 + (index[3] - z) ^ 2) - (entry.radius or 0)
                    if wF < i then
                        i, SF = wF, entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if SF and config.waypointFirstOnly ~= false then
                firstWpKey = context.strikeKey and context.strikeKey(SF) or nil
                if hazardReader.firstWpKey == nil then
                    hazardReader.firstWpKey = firstWpKey
                elseif hazardReader.firstWpKey ~= firstWpKey then
                    return nil
                end
            end
            return SF
        end
        context.waypointSetsHas = function(i)
            for index, entry in ipairs(context.waypointSets()) do
                if entry == i then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.strikeKey = function(i)
            return i and i.group and ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(i.group[1], i.group[3]) or nil
        end
        context.firstCastPoint = function(i)
            if not i then
                return nil
            end
            local b = i.home or i.strike
            if not b then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = 0, 0
            if b[4] and b[5] and b[4] * b[4] + b[5] * b[5] > 0.01 then
                B, z = b[4], b[5]
            else
                if i.group then
                    B, z = i.group[1] - b[1], i.group[3] - b[3]
                    local SF = math.sqrt(B * B + z * z)
                    if SF > 0.01 then
                        B, z = B / SF, z / SF
                    else
                        B, z = 0, 0
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return b, B, z, b == i.home and "home base" or "strike point"
        end
        context.preWalkDone = function(i)
            local preWalk = runtimeState.preWalk
            if not preWalk then
                return true
            end
            if preWalk.done then
                return true
            end
            if i - (preWalk.at or 0) > 1.5 then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        context.groupSetAt = function(vector)
            local groupWaypoints = hazardReader.groupWaypoints
            if not groupWaypoints or not vector then
                return nil
            end
            for index, groupWaypoint in ipairs(groupWaypoints) do
                index = groupWaypoint.home
                if
                    type(index) == "table"
                    and index[1]
                    and index[3]
                    and (index[1] - vector.X) ^ 2 + (index[3] - vector.Z) ^ 2 < 1
                then
                    return groupWaypoint
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.preSpawnWaypoint = function(i)
            if config.groupWaypoints == false or config.waypointFlow == false or not i then
                return nil
            end
            if
                config.waypointFirstOnly ~= false
                and (hazardReader.firstWpKey ~= nil or hazardReader.wpFlowDone)
            then
                return nil
            end
            if not hazardReader.groupWaypoints then
                hazardReader.groupWaypoints = {}
                pcall(function()
                    local groupWaypoints = isfile
                            and context.pickFile("HarvardLabs/data/waypoints.json", "dq_waypoints.json")
                        or nil
                    local B = groupWaypoints and readfile(groupWaypoints) or nil
                    groupWaypoints = B and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(B) or context.BAKED_WAYPOINTS
                    if type(groupWaypoints) == "table" then
                        hazardReader.groupWaypoints = groupWaypoints
                    end
                end)
            end
            local b = hazardReader.groupWaypoints
            if #b == 0 then
                return nil, nil, nil, "no waypoint sets loaded (HarvardLabs/data/waypoints.json)"
            end
            hazardReader.wpSetDone = hazardReader.wpSetDone or {}
            local B, z, SF, EF, JF = (config.wpPreSpawned or 70) ^ 2, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(b) do
                local group = entry.group
                if type(group) == "table" and type(entry.points) == "table" and #entry.points > 0 then
                    local MF = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(group[1], group[3])
                    if not hazardReader.wpSetDone[MF] then
                        for index2, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                            if
                                not enemy.isBoss
                                and enemy.root
                                and enemy.root.Parent
                                and enemy.humanoid
                                and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                            then
                                local nF, fF = enemy.root.Position.X - group[1], enemy.root.Position.Z - group[3]
                                if nF * nF + fF * fF <= B then
                                    hazardReader.wpSetDone[MF] = true
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if hazardReader.wpSetDone[MF] then
                        z += 1
                    else
                        local ZF = math.sqrt((group[1] - i.X) ^ 2 + (group[3] - i.Z) ^ 2)
                        if (config.wpPreRange or 0) <= 0 or ZF <= config.wpPreRange then
                            SF, EF, JF = entry, index, MF
                            break
                        end
                        z += 1
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not SF then
                return nil, nil, nil, ("all %d waypoint set(s) spawned, engaged or out of range"):format(z)
            end
            hazardReader.wpPreIdx = hazardReader.wpPreIdx or {}
            local z, wF = hazardReader.wpPreIdx[JF] or 1, {}
            for index3, point in ipairs(SF.points) do
                wF[index3] = point
            end
            b = nil
            if type(SF.home) == "table" and SF.home[1] and SF.home[3] then
                wF[#wF + 1] = SF.home
                b = #wF
            else
            end
            local YF, vF = #wF, config.wpArrive or 4
            local function MF(ZF)
                local nF = wF[ZF]
                return nF ~= nil
                    and not (
                        hazardReader.wpDropped
                        and hazardReader.wpDropped[("%.0f,%.0f"):format(nF[1], nF[3])]
                    )
            end
            while z <= YF do
                if not MF(z) then
                    z += 1
                else
                    B = wF[z]
                    local ZF = math.sqrt((B[1] - i.X) ^ 2 + (B[3] - i.Z) ^ 2)
                    local nF
                    for index4 = z + 1, YF, 1 do
                        if MF(index4) then
                            nF = index4
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not (ZF <= vF and nF) then
                        break
                    end
                    z = nF
                end
            end
            if z > YF then
                for index5 = YF, 1, -1 do
                    if MF(index5) then
                        z = index5
                        break
                    end
                end
                if z > YF then
                    return nil, nil, nil, ("every point of set %d dropped for stalling"):format(EF)
                end
            else
            end
            hazardReader.wpPreIdx[JF] = z
            local ZF, nF = wF[z], true
            for index6 = z + 1, YF, 1 do
                if MF(index6) then
                    nF = false
                    break
                end
            end
            B = math.sqrt((ZF[1] - i.X) ^ 2 + (ZF[3] - i.Z) ^ 2)
            if nF and B <= vF then
                hazardReader.wpPreFinished = hazardReader.wpPreFinished or {}
                hazardReader.wpPreFinished[JF] = true
            end
            YF, i = b ~= nil and z == b and ("%d.home"):format(EF) or ("%d.%d"):format(EF, z)
            if b ~= nil and z == b then
                for index7 = z - 1, 1, -1 do
                    if MF(index7) then
                        i = Vector3.new(wF[index7][1], wF[index7][2], wF[index7][3])
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            return Vector3.new(ZF[1], ZF[2], ZF[3]), YF, B, nil, nF, #SF.points, i
        end
        context.dangerUp = function()
            local bubbleBoss = context.BB
            if bubbleBoss and (bubbleBoss.lethal or bubbleBoss.active or bubbleBoss.goal ~= nil) then
                return true
            end
            local b = bubbleBoss and bubbleBoss.primary
            if b and not (b.box and b.box.noFlee) then
                return true
            end
            if (dangerGeometry.dangerHere or 0) >= (config.dodgeMoveAt or 1) then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        context.groupFirstCastDone = function(i)
            if #i == 0 then
                return false
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(i) do
                if not contextMobTagged(entry) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.nextCastIn = function()
            if context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() then
                return 0
            end
            if not hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                return 0
            end
            local i = {}
            for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                if abilitySlot and abilitySlot.name and not (context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(key)) then
                    i[string.lower(tostring(abilitySlot.name))] = true
                end
            end
            local iterateArray, B, z =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }
            for key2, entry in iterateArray(B) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and i[string.lower(child.Name)] then
                            index = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                            key2 = index and tonumber(index.Value) or 0
                            z = if z == nil or (if key2 < 0 then 0 else key2) < z
                                then if key2 < 0 then 0 else key2
                                else z
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return z or 0
        end
        context.readyDamageCasts = function()
            if not hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                return 0, 0
            end
            local i = {}
            for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                if abilitySlot and abilitySlot.name and not (context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(key)) then
                    i[string.lower(tostring(abilitySlot.name))] = true
                end
            end
            local iterateArray, B, z, SF =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }, 0, 0
            for key2, entry in iterateArray(B) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and i[string.lower(child.Name)] then
                            z += 1
                            index = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                            key2 = index and tonumber(index.Value)
                            SF = if key2 == nil or key2 <= 0 then SF + 1 else SF
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return SF, z
        end
        context.noteBossDamage = function(i, b)
            if not (i and i.isBoss and i.humanoid) then
                hazardReader.bossHpLast = nil
                return
            end
            local bossHpLast, z = i.humanoid.Health, hazardReader.bossHpLast
            hazardReader.bossHpLast = bossHpLast
            if z == nil or bossHpLast >= z then
                return
            end
            local SF = z - bossHpLast
            if
                b - math.max(runtimeState.lastQ or 0, runtimeState.lastE or 0)
                    <= (config.castDmgWindow or 1.6)
                and SF > 0
            then
                z = i.root and i.root.Position
                if z then
                    for index, entry in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        if
                            entry ~= localPlayer
                            and entry.Character
                            and entry.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            and (entry.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - z).Magnitude
                                < (config.castDmgOthers or 150)
                        then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.castDmgList = hazardReader.castDmgList or {}
                table.insert(hazardReader.castDmgList, SF)
                while #hazardReader.castDmgList > 5 do
                    table.remove(hazardReader.castDmgList, 1)
                end
                bossHpLast = table.clone(hazardReader.castDmgList)
                table.sort(bossHpLast)
                hazardReader.castDmg = bossHpLast[math.ceil(#bossHpLast / 2)]
                hazardReader.castDmgAt = b
            elseif config.buffTickDmg ~= false and SF > 0 and context.buffUp and context.buffUp(b) then
                local tickDmg = i.root and i.root.Position
                if tickDmg then
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        if
                            entry2 ~= localPlayer
                            and entry2.Character
                            and entry2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            and (entry2.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - tickDmg).Magnitude
                                < (config.castDmgOthers or 150)
                        then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                hazardReader.tickDmgList = hazardReader.tickDmgList or {}
                table.insert(hazardReader.tickDmgList, SF)
                while #hazardReader.tickDmgList > 8 do
                    table.remove(hazardReader.tickDmgList, 1)
                end
                tickDmg = nil
                for index3, entry3 in ipairs(hazardReader.tickDmgList) do
                    tickDmg = if tickDmg == nil or entry3 < tickDmg then entry3 else tickDmg
                end
                hazardReader.tickDmg = tickDmg
                hazardReader.tickDmgAt = b
            end
        end
        context.isBob = function(i)
            local b = i and i.model
            i = b and string.lower(tostring(b.Name)) or ""
            return i:find("bob", 1, true) ~= nil or i:find("frost giant", 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        context.finishRushReady = function(i, b)
            if config.finishRush == false then
                return false
            end
            if not (i and i.isBoss and i.humanoid and i.humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return false
            end
            local B = config.finishAtOdin ~= false and context.PB ~= nil and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
            if config.finishBobOnly ~= false and not (context.isBob(i) or B) then
                return false
            end
            B = hazardReader.castDmg or 0
            if B <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            local z = context.readyDamageCasts()
            if z <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            if context.attackAllowedBySkill and not context.attackAllowedBySkill(b) then
                return false
            end
            local SF = B * z * (config.finishFactor or 1)
            SF = if config.finishCountTick ~= false
                    and context.buffUp
                    and context.buffUp(b)
                then SF + (hazardReader.tickDmg or 0)
                else SF
            b, B =
                i.humanoid.Health <= SF,
                localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if
                hazardReader.orbNear
                and (hazardReader.orbNear.d or 999) < (config.finishOrbHold or 34)
                and not (config.finishThroughOrb ~= false and b)
                and not (B and context.orbNearShielded and context.orbNearShielded(B.Position.X, B.Position.Z))
            then
                return false, SF, z
            end
            if i.humanoid.Health <= SF then
                return true, SF, z
            end
            return false, SF, z
        end
        context.groupPlan = function(i, b)
            if config.groupBrain == false or not context.aoeLanding then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = context.aoeLanding()
            if not (B and z) then
                return nil
            end
            local SF, SF, SF, EF = contextAoeShapeNow()
            if SF then
                SF -= 3
                EF -= 3
            else
            end
            local JF, wF, tReady = i.X, i.Z, 0
            if context.nextCastIn then
                tReady = context.nextCastIn()
            else
                if context.attackReady then
                    local vF, MF = context.attackReady()
                    tReady = if not vF then MF or 0 else tReady
                else
                end
            end
            if context.attackAllowedBySkill then
                if not context.attackAllowedBySkill(b) and context.buffState then
                    local vF, MF, MF = context.buffState(b)
                    tReady = if vF == "gap"
                        then math.max(tReady, MF or 0)
                        else if vF == "ready"
                            then math.max(tReady, 0.2)
                            else if vF == "up"
                                then math.max(
                                    tReady,
                                    (context.buffCooldownLeft and context.buffCooldownLeft(b) or 0) + 0.3
                                )
                                else tReady
                else
                end
            else
            end
            tReady = if tReady > 8 then 8 else tReady
            local castPredictionTime = tReady
            if config.castingPriority == "Fast Clear" then
                castPredictionTime += math.min(
                    (config.fastClearPredictionLead or 0.18) + math.min(runtimeState.pingS or 0, 0.12),
                    config.fastClearPredictionCap or 0.38
                )
            end
            local vF = {}
            local hereCastAt = config.tagFirst ~= false and contextTagPending(i) > 0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and not enemy.isBoss
                    and (enemy.humanoid == nil or enemy.humanoid.Health > 0)
                    and (not hereCastAt or contextTagTarget(enemy))
                then
                    local fF, rF = enemy.root.Position.X, enemy.root.Position.Z
                    local oF, AF = fF - JF, rF - wF
                    if oF * oF + AF * AF <= 28900 then
                        local oF, AF = enemy.vx or 0, enemy.vz or 0
                        local kF, chaser =
                            math.sqrt(oF * oF + AF * AF),
                            (enemy.melee or enemy.isSpear) and contextMobTagged(enemy) and true or false
                        chaser = if kF > 4 then chaser or (enemy.melee or enemy.isSpear) else chaser
                        index = contextMobUntagged(enemy)
                        local aF, eF =
                            #vF + 1, {
                                x = fF,
                                z = rF,
                                chaser = chaser,
                                sp = kF > 4 and kF or (config.groupChaserSpeed or 18),
                                melee = enemy.melee,
                                e = enemy,
                                fresh = index,
                                vx = oF,
                                vz = AF,
                            }
                        eF.grp, vF[aF] =
                            hazardReader.groupOf and enemy.model and hazardReader.groupOf[enemy.model] or nil, eF
                    end
                end
            end
            local ZF = {}
            hereCastAt = config.threatRange or 120
            for index2, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    enemy2.root
                    and enemy2.root.Parent
                    and not enemy2.isBoss
                    and (enemy2.humanoid == nil or enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0)
                then
                    local rF, oF = enemy2.root.Position.X, enemy2.root.Position.Z
                    local AF, kF = rF - JF, oF - wF
                    if AF * AF + kF * kF <= hereCastAt * hereCastAt then
                        local AF, kF = enemy2.vx or 0, enemy2.vz or 0
                        index2 = math.sqrt(AF * AF + kF * kF)
                        local xF, aF =
                            #ZF + 1, {
                                x = rF,
                                z = oF,
                                vx = AF,
                                vz = kF,
                                melee = enemy2.melee,
                                spear = enemy2.isSpear,
                                mage = enemy2.isMage,
                                sp = index2 > 4 and index2 or (config.groupChaserSpeed or 18),
                            }
                        aF.grp, ZF[xF] =
                            hazardReader.groupOf and enemy2.model and hazardReader.groupOf[enemy2.model] or nil,
                            aF
                    end
                end
            end
            if config.groupCommit == true and #vF > 0 then
                local commitGroup, fF = hazardReader.commitGroup, 0
                if commitGroup then
                    for index3 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                        fF = if vF[index3].grp == commitGroup then fF + 1 else fF
                    end
                else
                end
                if fF == 0 then
                    commitGroup = nil
                    local fF, rF = {}, {}
                    for index4 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                        hereCastAt = vF[index4].grp
                        if hereCastAt then
                            local AF = rF[hereCastAt]
                            if not AF then
                                AF = {
                                    g = hereCastAt,
                                    n = 0,
                                    sx = 0,
                                    sz = 0,
                                }
                                rF[hereCastAt] = AF
                                fF[#fF + 1] = AF
                            else
                            end
                            AF.n, AF.sx, AF.sz = AF.n + 1, AF.sx + vF[index4].x, AF.sz + vF[index4].z
                        end
                    end
                    rF = 0
                    for index5 = 1, #fF, 1 do
                        local zone = fF[index5]
                        if zone.n >= (config.commitMinGroup or 2) then
                            local kF, xF = zone.sx / zone.n - JF, zone.sz / zone.n - wF
                            index5 = math.sqrt(kF * kF + xF * xF)
                            if index5 > 1 and index5 <= (config.commitRange or 90) then
                                zone.ux, zone.uz = kF / index5, xF / index5
                                zone.d = index5
                                zone.cx, zone.cz = zone.sx / zone.n, zone.sz / zone.n
                                rF += 1
                                fF[rF] = zone
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    for index6 = #fF, rF + 1, -1 do
                        fF[index6] = nil
                    end
                    rF = false
                    for index7 = 1, #fF, 1 do
                        for index8 = index7 + 1, #fF, 1 do
                            local kF, xF = fF[index7].cx - fF[index8].cx, fF[index7].cz - fF[index8].cz
                            local aF, eF =
                                math.sqrt(kF * kF + xF * xF),
                                fF[index7].ux * fF[index8].ux + fF[index7].uz * fF[index8].uz
                                    <= (config.commitOpposedDot or -0.35)
                            if
                                aF >= (config.commitApart or 55)
                                or eF and aF >= (config.commitApartOpposed or 30)
                            then
                                rF = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if rF then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if rF then
                        local rF = -math.huge
                        for index9 = 1, #fF, 1 do
                            local AF = fF[index9].n * (config.commitSizeWeight or 10)
                                - fF[index9].d * (config.commitDistWeight or 0.35)
                            if AF > rF then
                                rF, commitGroup = AF, fF[index9].g
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    hazardReader.commitGroup = commitGroup
                else
                end
                if commitGroup then
                    local fF = {}
                    for index10 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                        if vF[index10].grp == commitGroup then
                            fF[#fF + 1] = vF[index10]
                        end
                    end
                    if #fF > 0 then
                        vF = fF
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if #vF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local nF, fF
            if context.strafeAnchor then
                nF, fF = context.strafeAnchor(i)
            else
            end
            nF = if fF ~= "arena" then nil else nF
            local fF, castAt, oF = i.Y < (config.dropArenaY or -40), {}, {}
            for index11 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                hereCastAt = vF[index11]
                if hereCastAt.grp then
                    local kF = castAt[hereCastAt.grp]
                    if not kF then
                        kF = {
                            n = 0,
                            sx = 0,
                            sz = 0,
                            idx = {},
                        }
                        castAt[hereCastAt.grp] = kF
                    else
                    end
                    kF.n = kF.n + 1
                    kF.sx, kF.sz = kF.sx + hereCastAt.x, kF.sz + hereCastAt.z
                    kF.idx[#kF.idx + 1] = index11
                end
            end
            for key, entry in pairs(castAt) do
                entry.x, entry.z = entry.sx / entry.n, entry.sz / entry.n
                hereCastAt = 0
                for index12, entry2 in ipairs(entry.idx) do
                    key = math.sqrt((vF[entry2].x - entry.x) ^ 2 + (vF[entry2].z - entry.z) ^ 2)
                    hereCastAt = if key > hereCastAt then key else hereCastAt
                end
                entry.r = hereCastAt
                key = z - (config.groupFitMargin or 2)
                if
                    (config.pitGroups ~= false or not fF)
                    and entry.n >= 2
                    and hereCastAt <= key * (config.groupFitStretch or 1.3)
                then
                    entry.fit = hereCastAt <= key
                    oF[#oF + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            local function castAt2(kF, xF, aF, eF, NF)
                local IF, FF, CF = kF + aF * B, xF + eF * B, 0
                for index13, entry3 in ipairs(oF) do
                    eF, xF, aF = 0, false, 0
                    for index14, entry4 in ipairs(entry3.idx) do
                        index14 = vF[entry4]
                        eF += 1
                        xF = if index14.fresh then true else xF
                        index13, kF = index14.x - IF, index14.z - FF
                        aF = if index13 * index13 + kF * kF <= (z - 1.5) ^ 2 then aF + 1 else aF
                    end
                    CF = if xF and aF > 0 and aF < eF and (entry3.fit or not NF) then CF + (eF - aF) else CF
                end
                return CF
            end
            hereCastAt = context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(b)
                or runtimeState.walkSpeed
                or config.groupWalk
                or 16
            local kF, xF =
                math.max(
                    math.min(config.groupReachMax or 70, hereCastAt * math.max(tReady, 0.3) + 4),
                    config.groupShiftMax or 36
                ),
                {
                    {
                        x = JF,
                        z = wF,
                        d = 0,
                    },
                }
            for index15, entry5 in ipairs(oF) do
                local NF, IF = JF - entry5.x, wF - entry5.z
                index15 = math.sqrt(NF * NF + IF * IF)
                if index15 > 0.5 then
                    local FF, CF = entry5.x + NF / index15 * B, entry5.z + IF / index15 * B
                    local aF = math.sqrt((FF - JF) ^ 2 + (CF - wF) ^ 2)
                    if aF <= (config.groupFullReach or 90) then
                        xF[#xF + 1] = {
                            x = FF,
                            z = CF,
                            d = aF,
                            fit = true,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if config.pitGroups ~= false or not fF then
                for key2, entry6 in pairs(castAt) do
                    local NF, IF, FF, CF, gF, iF = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
                    for index16, entry7 in ipairs(entry6.idx) do
                        key2 = vF[entry7]
                        if key2.e and key2.e.isMage then
                            NF, IF, FF = NF + key2.x, IF + key2.z, FF + 1
                        else
                            if key2.melee then
                                CF, gF, iF = CF + key2.x, gF + key2.z, iF + 1
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if FF >= 1 and iF >= 1 then
                        entry6, key2 = NF / FF, IF / FF
                        local NF, IF = entry6 - CF / iF, key2 - gF / iF
                        local FF = math.sqrt(NF * NF + IF * IF)
                        if FF > 1 then
                            NF /= FF
                            IF /= FF
                            for index17, entry8 in
                                ipairs(config.mageGuideArc ~= false and { 0, 40, -40, 75, -75 } or { 0 })
                            do
                                index17 = math.atan2(IF, NF) + math.rad(entry8)
                                local NF, IF, CF = math.cos(index17), math.sin(index17), { 0.9, 1, 1.1 }
                                for index18, entry9 in ipairs(CF) do
                                    index17, index18 = entry6 + NF * (B * entry9), key2 + IF * (B * entry9)
                                    entry9 = math.sqrt((index17 - JF) ^ 2 + (index18 - wF) ^ 2)
                                    if entry9 >= 3 and entry9 <= (config.groupFullReach or 90) then
                                        xF[#xF + 1] = {
                                            x = index17,
                                            z = index18,
                                            d = entry9,
                                            behind = true,
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for index19 = 0, 15, 1 do
                local eF = index19 * 0.39269908169872414
                for index20 = 1, 4, 1 do
                    index19 = kF * index20 / 4
                    if index19 >= 4 then
                        xF[#xF + 1] = {
                            x = JF + math.cos(eF) * index19,
                            z = wF + math.sin(eF) * index19,
                            d = index19,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if config.ringPull ~= false then
                local aF, eF, NF, IF, FF =
                    context.fireReach and context.fireReach()
                        or context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach()
                        or 60,
                    config.ringPullBand or 15,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0
                for index21, entry10 in ipairs(vF) do
                    local iF, bF = entry10.x - JF, entry10.z - wF
                    index21 = math.sqrt(iF * iF + bF * bF)
                    if index21 > aF and index21 <= aF + eF then
                        local BF = index21 - aF + 3
                        if BF >= 3 then
                            xF[#xF + 1] = {
                                x = JF + iF / index21 * BF,
                                z = wF + bF / index21 * BF,
                                d = BF,
                                pull = true,
                            }
                        end
                        NF, IF, FF = NF + entry10.x, IF + entry10.z, FF + 1
                    else
                    end
                end
                if FF >= 2 then
                    aF, eF = NF / FF, IF / FF
                    local NF, IF = aF - JF, eF - wF
                    local aF, eF = math.sqrt(NF * NF + IF * IF), { 0.35, 0.6 }
                    for index22, entry11 in ipairs(eF) do
                        index22 = aF * entry11
                        if index22 >= 3 and index22 <= 40 then
                            xF[#xF + 1] = {
                                x = JF + NF / aF * index22,
                                z = wF + IF / aF * index22,
                                d = index22,
                                pull = true,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if config.coverageGrid ~= false then
                local aF, eF, NF, IF =
                    (
                        context.fireReach and context.fireReach()
                        or context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach()
                        or 60
                    )
                        + (config.ringPullBand or 10)
                        + 20,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0
                for index23, entry12 in ipairs(vF) do
                    local CF, gF = entry12.x - JF, entry12.z - wF
                    if CF * CF + gF * gF <= aF * aF then
                        eF, NF, IF = eF + entry12.x, NF + entry12.z, IF + 1
                    else
                    end
                end
                if IF >= 2 then
                    local FF, CF = eF / IF, NF / IF
                    local eF, NF = FF - JF, CF - wF
                    FF = math.sqrt(eF * eF + NF * NF)
                    CF, aF = nil
                    if FF > 1 then
                        local IF = math.min(FF, kF * 0.6)
                        CF, aF = JF + eF / FF * IF, wF + NF / FF * IF
                    else
                        CF, aF = JF, wF
                    end
                    eF = config.coverageGridStep or 6
                    for index24 = -2, 2, 1 do
                        for index25 = -2, 2, 1 do
                            FF, NF = CF + index24 * eF, aF + index25 * eF
                            index25 = math.sqrt((FF - JF) ^ 2 + (NF - wF) ^ 2)
                            if index25 >= 3 and index25 <= kF then
                                xF[#xF + 1] = {
                                    x = FF,
                                    z = NF,
                                    d = index25,
                                    grid = true,
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local aF, eF, NF, IF, FF, CF = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
            for index26, entry13 in ipairs(vF) do
                if entry13.chaser or entry13.melee then
                    aF, eF, NF = aF + entry13.x, eF + entry13.z, NF + 1
                else
                    IF, FF, CF = IF + entry13.x, FF + entry13.z, CF + 1
                end
            end
            if CF >= 1 and NF >= 1 then
                local gF, iF = IF / CF, FF / CF
                local IF, FF = gF - aF / NF, iF - eF / NF
                kF = math.sqrt(IF * IF + FF * FF)
                if kF > 1 then
                    local aF = { 0.4, 0.8, 1.3 }
                    for index27, entry14 in ipairs(aF) do
                        local aF, CF = gF + IF / kF * (B * entry14), iF + FF / kF * (B * entry14)
                        index27 = math.sqrt((aF - JF) ^ 2 + (CF - wF) ^ 2)
                        if index27 >= 3 and index27 <= (config.groupFullReach or 90) then
                            xF[#xF + 1] = {
                                x = aF,
                                z = CF,
                                d = index27,
                                behind = true,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local aF, eF
            if config.groupPinch ~= false then
                local NF, IF = {}, {}
                for index28 = 1, #ZF, 1 do
                    kF = ZF[index28].grp
                    if kF then
                        local CF = NF[kF]
                        if not CF then
                            CF = {
                                n = 0,
                                sx = 0,
                                sz = 0,
                            }
                            NF[kF] = CF
                            IF[#IF + 1] = CF
                        else
                        end
                        CF.n, CF.sx, CF.sz = CF.n + 1, CF.sx + ZF[index28].x, CF.sz + ZF[index28].z
                    end
                end
                local FF, CF
                for index29 = 1, #IF, 1 do
                    NF = IF[index29]
