            IF = config.groupFullCover ~= false and config.groupExactCover ~= false and not SF and zF and #vF > 1
            if IF then
                BF = z - 1.5
                local SF, yF, EF = BF * BF
                local ZF, nF = -1, 0
                local function oF(aF, eF)
                    local BF, sF, TF = 0, 0, 0
                    for index13 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                        local KF, tF = vF[index13].x - aF, vF[index13].z - eF
                        if KF * KF + tF * tF <= SF then
                            BF += 1
                            sF, TF =
                                if vF[index13].fresh then sF + 1 else sF,
                                if not (vF[index13].chaser or vF[index13].melee) then TF + 1 else TF
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    local WF = BF + sF * (config.groupFreshWeight or 2) + TF * (config.groupRangedWeight or 3)
                    local sF = WF > ZF
                    if sF then
                        yF, EF, ZF, nF = aF, eF, WF, BF
                    end
                end
                for index47 = 1, #vF, 1 do
                    oF(vF[index47].x, vF[index47].z)
                end
                xF, fF = config.groupExactPairs or 400, 0
                for index48 = 1, #vF - 1, 1 do
                    for index49 = index48 + 1, #vF, 1 do
                        if fF >= xF then
                            break
                        end
                        FF, GF = vF[index49].x - vF[index48].x, vF[index49].z - vF[index48].z
                        kF = FF * FF + GF * GF
                        if kF > 0.01 and kF <= 4 * SF then
                            fF += 1
                            local eF, BF, sF, TF =
                                math.sqrt(kF),
                                (vF[index48].x + vF[index49].x) * 0.5,
                                (vF[index48].z + vF[index49].z) * 0.5,
                                math.sqrt(math.max(SF - kF * 0.25, 0))
                            local SF, ZF = -GF / eF * TF, FF / eF * TF
                            oF(BF + SF, sF + ZF)
                            oF(BF - SF, sF - ZF)
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if fF >= xF then
                        break
                    end
                end
                if yF then
                    castAt = nF > (zF.n or 0)
                    if castAt then
                        local SF, ZF = JF - yF, wF - EF
                        oF = math.sqrt(SF * SF + ZF * ZF)
                        local aF, eF, BF = oF < 0.5
                        if aF then
                            eF, BF = yF + B, EF
                        else
                            eF, BF = yF + SF / oF * B, EF + ZF / oF * B
                        end
                        SF = math.sqrt((eF - JF) ^ 2 + (BF - wF) ^ 2)
                        ZF = SF <= (config.groupFullReach or 90)
                        aF = ZF and NF
                        if aF then
                            local success3, aF = pcall(NF, i, Vector3.new(eF, i.Y, BF), hereCastAt)
                            local NF = success3 and aF
                            if NF then
                            else
                                if ZF then
                                    success3 = {
                                        x = eF,
                                        z = BF,
                                        d = SF,
                                        n = nF,
                                        a = math.atan2(EF - BF, yF - eF),
                                        meleeClose = 0,
                                        full = true,
                                    }
                                    zF = success3
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if ZF then
                                local ZF = {
                                    x = eF,
                                    z = BF,
                                    d = SF,
                                    n = nF,
                                    a = math.atan2(EF - BF, yF - eF),
                                    meleeClose = 0,
                                    full = true,
                                }
                                zF = ZF
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not zF then
                return nil
            end
            zF.first = (zF.n or 0) > 0 and (bestFirstFresh or 0) > 0
            if zF.first then
                runtimeState.firstSpot = {
                    x = zF.x,
                    z = zF.z,
                    at = b,
                }
            else
                runtimeState.firstSpot = nil
            end
            zF.tReady = tReady
            zF.fx, zF.fz = math.cos(zF.a), math.sin(zF.a)
            IF, i, fF, castAt = zF.x + zF.fx * B, zF.z + zF.fz * B
            for index50, entry22 in ipairs(vF) do
                kF, xF = CF[index50] - IF, gF[index50] - i
                GF = kF * kF + xF * xF
                if GF <= z * z and (not fF or GF < fF) then
                    fF, castAt = GF, entry22.e
                else
                end
            end
            zF.castAt = castAt
            if zF.a then
                zF.clips = castAt2(zF.x, zF.z, math.cos(zF.a), math.sin(zF.a), true)
            end
            if bF then
                zF.hereClips = castAt2(JF, wF, math.cos(bF), math.sin(bF), true)
            end
            zF.hereN = hereN
            if bF then
                zF.hfx, zF.hfz = math.cos(bF), math.sin(bF)
                FF, GF, castAt2, hereCastAt = JF + zF.hfx * B, wF + zF.hfz * B
                for index51, entry23 in ipairs(vF) do
                    b, i = entry23.x - FF, entry23.z - GF
                    castAt = b * b + i * i
                    if castAt <= z * z and (not castAt2 or castAt < castAt2) then
                        castAt2, hereCastAt = castAt, entry23.e
                    else
                    end
                end
                zF.hereCastAt = hereCastAt
            end
            return zF
        end
        context.applyBurst = function(i)
            i = tonumber(i) or config.burstMax or 28
            i = if i < 18 then 18 else i
            config.burstMax = i
            config.mageBurstMax = i
            config.slamBurstMax = i
            config.finishRushSpeed = i
            config.tweenEscape, config.homeBurst = math.max(i - 2, 16), math.max(i - 2, 16)
            if config.tweenSprint then
                config.tweenSprint = i
            end
            context.RT.lcCapSet = nil
            context.RT.burstApplied = i
        end
        context.buffHoldsSpeed = function(i)
            if config.buffFreezesWalkSpeed == false then
                return false
            end
            return context.buffUp ~= nil and context.buffUp(i) or false
        end
        context.burstBox = function(i)
            if i == nil then
                return false
            end
            local b = string.lower(tostring(i))
            if b == "northernmageshot" or b == "spearmanstrikehitbox" or b:sub(1, 11) == "volley next" then
                return true
            end
            if b == "wall" then
                return true
            end
            if b:find("warrior", 1, true) and b:find("strike", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        context.orbAttackWindow = function(vector, b, position)
            if config.orbAttack == false then
                return nil
            end
            local z = hazardReader.orbLead
            if not (z and b and b.isBoss and b.root and b.root.Parent) then
                return nil
            end
            local SF = z.orbD or 0
            if SF < (hazardReader.finishWindow and config.orbAttackGapFinish or config.orbAttackGap or 45) then
                return nil
            end
            if context.attackAllowedBySkill and not context.attackAllowedBySkill(position) then
                return nil
            end
            if (context.readyDamageCasts and context.readyDamageCasts() or 0) < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            position = b.root.Position
            z, b =
                math.sqrt((position.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (position.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2),
                context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or context.abilityReach()
            if z > b + (config.orbAttackDetour or 30) then
                return nil
            end
            local yF, EF = 0
            if z > b - 3 then
                local JF, wF = (position.X - vector.X) / z, (position.Z - vector.Z) / z
                yF = z - (b - 3)
                EF = Vector3.new(vector.X + JF * yF, vector.Y, vector.Z + wF * yF)
            else
                EF = vector
            end
            if
                SF
                    - (hazardReader.orbNear and hazardReader.orbNear.pace or config.orbPace or 30) * (yF / (config.tweenEscape or 26) + (config.castRootTime or 0.7))
                < (hazardReader.finishWindow and config.orbAttackKeepFinish or config.orbAttackKeep or 18)
            then
                return nil
            end
            if yF > 1 then
                if
                    context.BB
                    and context.BB.pathBlocked
                    and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, EF, config.tweenEscape or 26)
                then
                    return nil
                end
                if context.BB and context.BB.lethal then
                    return nil
                end
            end
            return EF, yF, SF
        end
        context.wallBeamStep = function(vector, b)
            if config.wallOrbStyle == false or not (context.BB and context.BB.wallBeams) then
                return nil
            end
            local B = context.BB.wallBeams()
            if #B == 0 then
                runtimeState.wallPick = nil
                runtimeState.wallHold = nil
                return nil
            end
            local z, info = config.burstMax or 28, runtimeState.wallHold
            if
                info
                and b < info.untilT
                and a(vector, info.p) > 2
                and not context.BB.onWallBeam(info.p.X, info.p.Z, a(vector, info.p) / z, B)
            then
                return info.p, info.info
            end
            runtimeState.wallHold = nil
            local yF, EF, JF = context.BB.onWallBeam(vector.X, vector.Z, 0, B)
            if not yF then
                runtimeState.wallPick = nil
                return nil
            end
            info, yF =
                combatBrain.goTo
                        and combatBrain.goToAt
                        and b - combatBrain.goToAt < 0.5
                        and combatBrain.goTo
                    or nil,
                combatBrain.target
            local wF, wallPick, vF =
                yF and yF.isBoss and yF.root and yF.root.Parent and yF.root.Position or nil,
                runtimeState.wallPick,
                config.wallWaitBehind ~= false and context.BB.wallTimes ~= nil
            local function MF(ZF, nF)
                for index = 1, #B, 1 do
                    if context.BB.wallTimes(B[index], ZF, nF) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local ZF, nF, fF, vector2, oF, wallPick2, vector3, xF, aF =
                context.BB.wallsComing and context.BB.wallsComing(vector.X, vector.Z, B) or nil,
                infinity,
                infinity
            for index2 = 0, 31, 1 do
                yF = index2 * 3.141592653589793 / 16
                local NF, IF = cos(yF), sin(yF)
                local yF, FF = if ZF and context.BB.towardWall(NF, IF, ZF) then infinity else 2, 0
                while yF <= (config.wallEscapeMax or 50) and FF < (config.wallEscapeTries or 4) do
                    local vector4, CF = Vector3.new(vector.X + NF * yF, vector.Y, vector.Z + IF * yF), yF / z
                    index2 =
                        not context.BB.onWallBeam(vector4.X, vector4.Z, CF + (config.wallStepMargin or 0.6), B)
                    FF = if index2 then FF + 1 else FF
                    if
                        index2
                        and contextDangerAt(vector4.X, vector.Y, vector4.Z, CF) < 0.5
                        and contextDangerAt(vector4.X, vector.Y, vector4.Z, CF + 0.6) < 0.5
                    then
                        local eF = if info
                            then yF + (config.wallEscapeGoalW or 0.3) * (a(vector4, info) - a(vector, info))
                            else yF
                        eF = if wF
                            then eF + (config.wallEscapeBossW or 0.4) * (a(vector4, wF) - a(vector, wF))
                            else eF
                        eF = if wallPick and NF * wallPick.ux + IF * wallPick.uz > 0.85
                            then eF - (config.wallEscapeKeep or 6)
                            else eF
                        local wF = vF and MF(vector4.X, vector4.Z)
                        if
                            eF < (wF and nF or fF)
                            and context.BB.wallPathSafe(vector, vector4, z, 0, B)
                            and not (context.BB.pathTouchesRed and context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, vector4, z))
                            and not (context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe and not context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe(
                                vector,
                                vector4,
                                z
                            ))
                            and E(vector, vector4)
                        then
                            if wF or not vF then
                                nF, vector2, oF, wallPick2 =
                                    eF, vector4, yF, {
                                        ux = NF,
                                        uz = IF,
                                    }
                            else
                                fF, vector3, xF, aF =
                                    eF, vector4, yF, {
                                        ux = NF,
                                        uz = IF,
                                    }
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        break
                    end
                    yF = yF + 2
                end
            end
            if vector3 then
                vector2, oF, wallPick2 = vector3, xF, aF
            else
            end
            if not vector2 then
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.wallPick = wallPick2
            info = {
                arrive = EF or 0,
                out = JF or 0,
                d = oF,
            }
            runtimeState.wallHold = {
                p = vector2,
                info = info,
                untilT = b + math.min(config.wallHoldMax or 1, oF / z + 0.3),
            }
            return vector2, info
        end
        context.wallStepBad = function(vector, vector2, wallWaitB)
            if config.wallOrbStyle == false or not (context.BB and context.BB.wallBeams) then
                return false
            end
            local z = context.BB.wallBeams()
            if #z == 0 then
                return false
            end
            local SF = math.max(wallWaitB or 16, 4)
            if config.wallWaitBehind ~= false and context.BB.wallTimes then
                local yF, EF = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
                wallWaitB = math.sqrt(yF * yF + EF * EF)
                if wallWaitB > 0.5 then
                    for index = 1, #z, 1 do
                        local wallWaitB2 = z[index]
                        if
                            (yF * wallWaitB2.ux + EF * wallWaitB2.uz) / wallWaitB
                            > (config.wallWithCos or 0.5)
                        then
                            local yF, EF, EF = context.BB.wallTimes(wallWaitB2, vector2.X, vector2.Z)
                            if yF and EF > 0 then
                                runtimeState.wallWaitAt = os.clock()
                                runtimeState.wallWaitB = wallWaitB2
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if context.BB.wallsComing then
                wallWaitB = context.BB.towardWall(
                    vector2.X - vector.X,
                    vector2.Z - vector.Z,
                    context.BB.wallsComing(vector.X, vector.Z, z)
                )
                if wallWaitB then
                    runtimeState.wallWaitAt = os.clock()
                    runtimeState.wallWaitB = wallWaitB
                    return true
                end
            end
            if
                context.BB.onWallBeam(
                    vector2.X,
                    vector2.Z,
                    a(vector, vector2) / SF + (config.wallStepMargin or 0.6),
                    z
                ) and not context.BB.onWallBeam(vector.X, vector.Z, 0, z)
            then
                return true
            end
            return not context.BB.wallPathSafe(vector, vector2, SF, 0, z)
        end
        context.wallOffYellow = function(vector, b)
            if config.wallOffYellow == false or not hazardReader.walls then
                return nil
            end
            local B = context.DG and context.DG.reach or 1.8
            local z, SF = config.burstMax or 28, config.wallLaneAhead or 3.5
            local function yF(EF)
                if not EF.cx then
                    return nil
                end
                local JF, wF, YF = context.wallVel(EF)
                if not JF or YF <= 2 then
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    w = EF,
                    vl = YF,
                    vx = JF,
                    vz = wF,
                    ux = -wF,
                    uz = JF,
                    halfLen = EF.halfLen or 30,
                    thick = (EF.halfThick or 6) + (config.wallLanePad or 2),
                }
            end
            local function EF(JF, wF, YF, vF)
                local MF, ZF = wF - JF.w.cx, YF - JF.w.cz
                YF, wF = MF * JF.vx + ZF * JF.vz, MF * JF.ux + ZF * JF.uz
                return YF > -JF.thick and YF < JF.vl * SF + JF.thick and math.abs(wF) < JF.halfLen + B + (vF or 0),
                    YF,
                    wF
            end
            b = {}
            for key, wall in pairs(hazardReader.walls) do
                key = yF(wall)
                if key then
                    b[#b + 1] = key
                end
            end
            local SF, ahead, lat
            for index, entry in ipairs(b) do
                local vF, MF, ZF = EF(entry, vector.X, vector.Z, 0)
                if vF and (not SF or MF < ahead) then
                    SF, ahead, lat = entry, MF, ZF
                else
                end
            end
            if not SF then
                return nil
            end
            local YF, vF, MF, iterateArray =
                SF.halfLen + B + (config.wallOffPad or 2.5),
                (ahead - SF.thick - B) / SF.vl,
                lat >= 0 and 1 or -1,
                ipairs
            yF = {
                MF,
                -MF,
            }
            for key2, entry2 in iterateArray(yF) do
                MF = entry2 * YF - lat
                local yF = vector.X + SF.ux * MF
                local YF = vector.Z + SF.uz * MF
                entry2 = math.abs(MF) / z
                local ZF = key2 == 1 or entry2 < vF
                if ZF then
                    for index2, entry3 in ipairs(b) do
                        if entry3 ~= SF and EF(entry3, yF, YF, 1) then
                            ZF = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                entry2 = Vector3.new(yF, vector.Y, YF)
                ZF = if ZF
                        and context.BB
                        and context.BB.pathBlocked
                        and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, entry2, z)
                    then false
                    else ZF
                if ZF then
                    local success, z = pcall(function()
                        local SF, EF, raycastParams =
                            Vector3.new(yF, vector.Y + 4, YF), Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), context.raycastParams
                        return contextWorkspace:Raycast(SF, EF, raycastParams)
                    end)
                    ZF = if success and not z then false else ZF
                else
                end
                if ZF then
                    return entry2,
                        {
                            near = key2 == 1,
                            ahead = ahead,
                            lat = lat,
                            need = math.abs(MF),
                            tHit = vF,
                        }
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.bobLanes = function(i, vector)
            local recs, z, SF = {}, -math.huge
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.models or {}) do
                if
                    (entry.name == "secondbosslines" or config.bobLineNames and config.bobLineNames[entry.name])
                    and entry.model
                    and entry.model.Parent
                    and entry.detonatedAt == nil
                    and i <= (entry.untilAt or 0) + (config.bobLineTail or 0.15)
                    and entry.hbs
                    and #entry.hbs >= 2
                then
                    recs[#recs + 1] = entry
                    if (entry.spawn or 0) > z then
                        z, SF = entry.spawn or 0, entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not SF then
                return nil
            end
            local z
            for index, hb in ipairs(SF.hbs) do
                if hb.Parent then
                    z = hb
                    break
                end
            end
            if not z then
                return nil
            end
            local function SF(yF)
                local EF, size = yF.CFrame, yF.Size
                yF = size.Z >= size.X and EF.LookVector or EF.RightVector
                EF = math.sqrt(yF.X * yF.X + yF.Z * yF.Z)
                if EF < 0.01 then
                    return nil
                end
                return yF.X / EF, yF.Z / EF, math.max(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5, math.min(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5
            end
            local yF, EF, halfL, wF = SF(z)
            if not yF then
                return nil
            end
            local z, lines, parts, MF, ZF, untilAt = -EF, {}, {}, 0, 0, 0
            for index2, rec in ipairs(recs) do
                for index3, hb2 in ipairs(rec.hbs) do
                    if hb2.Parent then
                        index2, index3 = SF(hb2)
                        if index2 and math.abs(index2 * yF + index3 * EF) > 0.996 then
                            parts[hb2] = true
                            local position = hb2.Position
                            lines[#lines + 1] = (position.X - vector.X) * z + (position.Z - vector.Z) * yF
                            MF, ZF = MF + (position.X - vector.X) * yF + (position.Z - vector.Z) * EF, ZF + 1
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                untilAt = if (rec.untilAt or 0) > untilAt then rec.untilAt else untilAt
            end
            if #lines < 2 then
                return nil
            end
            table.sort(lines)
            SF = {}
            for index4, line in ipairs(lines) do
                if #SF == 0 or line - SF[#SF] > 2 then
                    SF[#SF + 1] = line
                end
            end
            if #SF < 2 then
                return nil
            end
            local fF, rF, oF = context.DG and context.DG.reach or 1.8, 2 * wF + 2 * (config.bobLineBody or 1), {}
            for index5 = 1, #SF - 1, 1 do
                lines = SF[index5 + 1] - SF[index5]
                if lines >= rF then
                    oF[#oF + 1] = lines
                end
            end
            table.sort(oF)
            lines = #oF > 0 and oF[math.ceil(#oF / 2)] or 2 * wF + 10
            oF = math.max(wF + fF + 0.5, lines * 0.5)
            lines = {
                SF[1] - oF,
            }
            for index6 = 1, #SF - 1, 1 do
                if SF[index6 + 1] - SF[index6] >= rF then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = (SF[index6] + SF[index6 + 1]) * 0.5
                end
            end
            lines[#lines + 1] = SF[#SF] + oF
            return {
                ax = yF,
                az = EF,
                nx = z,
                nz = yF,
                L = SF,
                hw = wF,
                lines = lines,
                alongMid = MF / math.max(ZF, 1),
                halfL = halfL,
                untilAt = untilAt,
                recs = recs,
                parts = parts,
                bx = vector.X,
                bz = vector.Z,
                y = vector.Y,
                at = i,
            }
        end
        context.bobLinePlan = function(i, vector)
            if config.bobLineRails == false then
                hazardReader.bobLines = nil
                return nil
            end
            if context.belowNL and context.belowNL() then
                hazardReader.bobLines = nil
                runtimeState.bobRail = nil
                return nil
            end
            local bobLines = context.bobLanes(i, vector)
            if not bobLines then
                hazardReader.bobLines = nil
                runtimeState.bobRail = nil
                return nil
            end
            if math.abs(bobLines.alongMid) > bobLines.halfL - 2 then
                hazardReader.bobLines = bobLines
                return nil
            end
            local speed = config.burstMax or 28
            local function SF(yF)
                return yF.src ~= nil and bobLines.parts[yF.src] == true
            end
            local function yF(EF)
                local JF, wF, YF, vF =
                    vector.X + bobLines.nx * EF, vector.Z + bobLines.nz * EF, math.abs(EF) / speed, { 0, 0.5, 1 }
                for index, entry in ipairs(vF) do
                    if
                        contextDangerAt(JF, vector.Y, wF, YF + entry, nil, nil, SF)
                        >= (config.bobRailDanger or 0.5)
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                if context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and math.abs(EF) > 2 then
                    if
                        context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Vector3.new(JF, vector.Y, wF), speed)
                        and not tostring(context.BB.blockReason or ""):find("secondbosslines", 1, true)
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local SF = {}
            for index2, line in ipairs(bobLines.lines) do
                SF[#SF + 1] = line
            end
            local EF
            local pick = runtimeState.bobRail
            if pick and i - (pick.at or -math.huge) < (config.bobRailKeep or 2.5) then
                local wF = (pick.x - vector.X) * bobLines.nx + (pick.z - vector.Z) * bobLines.nz
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(SF) do
                    if math.abs(entry2 - wF) < 3 then
                        EF = entry2
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            table.sort(SF, function(wF, YF)
                return math.abs(wF) < math.abs(YF)
            end)
            pick = if EF
                    and math.abs(EF) <= math.abs(SF[1]) + (config.bobRailKeepSlack or 6)
                    and yF(EF)
                then EF
                else nil
            if not pick then
                for index4 = 1, math.min(#SF, 4), 1 do
                    if yF(SF[index4]) then
                        pick = SF[index4]
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            bobLines.pick = pick
            hazardReader.bobLines = bobLines
            if not pick then
                return nil
            end
            SF, yF = vector.X + bobLines.nx * pick, vector.Z + bobLines.nz * pick
            runtimeState.bobRail = {
                x = SF,
                z = yF,
                at = i,
            }
            local EF = math.max(bobLines.untilAt - i, 0)
            if math.abs(pick) <= (config.bobRailOn or 1) then
                return {
                    move = false,
                    label = ("BOB LINES: on the green rail between the lanes - holding (%d lanes, %.1fs)"):format(
                        #bobLines.L,
                        EF
                    ),
                }
            end
            return {
                move = true,
                point = Vector3.new(SF, vector.Y, yF),
                speed = speed,
                label = ("BOB LINES: onto the green rail between the lanes, %.0f studs (%d lanes, %.1fs)"):format(
                    math.abs(pick),
                    #bobLines.L,
                    EF
                ),
            }
        end
        context.wallStep = function(vector, b)
            if config.wallStep == false or not hazardReader.walls then
                return nil
            end
            local B, ahead
            for key, wall in pairs(hazardReader.walls) do
                b, key = nil
                local EF = 0
                if wall.cx and wall.vx then
                    b, key, EF = context.wallVel(wall)
                else
                end
                EF = EF or 0
                if wall.cx and b and EF > 5 then
                    local JF, wF, YF = -key, vector.X - wall.cx, vector.Z - wall.cz
                    local ahead2, lat, halfLen = wF * b + YF * key, wF * JF + YF * b, wall.halfLen or 30
                    if
                        ahead2 > -4
                        and ahead2 < (config.wallStepAhead or 45)
                        and math.abs(lat) < halfLen + 4
                        and (not B or ahead2 < ahead)
                    then
                        B, ahead =
                            {
                                w = wall,
                                vx = b,
                                vz = key,
                                ux = JF,
                                uz = b,
                                lat = lat,
                                ahead = ahead2,
                                halfLen = halfLen,
                                vl = EF,
                            }, ahead2
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not B then
                return nil
            end
            local z = (B.lat >= 0 and 1 or -1) * (B.halfLen + (config.wallStepPastEnd or 6))
            if config.wallNoToward ~= false then
                b = z - B.lat
                return Vector3.new(vector.X + B.ux * b, vector.Y, vector.Z + B.uz * b), B
            end
            b = -(config.wallStepBehind or 8)
            local SF, yF = B.w.cx + B.ux * z + B.vx * b, B.w.cz + B.uz * z + B.vz * b
            b = math.sqrt((SF - vector.X) ^ 2 + (yF - vector.Z) ^ 2) / (config.burstMax or 28)
            SF += B.vx * B.vl * b
            yF += B.vz * B.vl * b
            return Vector3.new(SF, vector.Y, yF), B
        end
        context.finishWindow = function(i, b)
            if config.finishRush == false then
                return false
            end
            if not (i and i.isBoss and i.humanoid and i.humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return false
            end
            if config.finishBobOnly ~= false and not context.isBob(i) then
                return false
            end
            b = if context.otherRoots then 1 + #context.otherRoots() else 1
            if i.humanoid.Health <= b * (config.finishPerPlayer or 1600000000000000) then
                return true
            end
            b = hazardReader.castDmg or 0
            if b <= 0 then
                return false
            end
            if
                i.humanoid.MaxHealth > 0
                and i.humanoid.Health / i.humanoid.MaxHealth * 100 > (config.finishMaxPct or 15)
            then
                return false
            end
            return i.humanoid.Health <= b * (config.finishCasts or 1)
        end
        context.attackReady = function()
            if not hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                return true
            end
            local i = {}
            for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                if abilitySlot and abilitySlot.name and not (context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot(key)) then
                    i[string.lower(tostring(abilitySlot.name))] = true
                end
            end
            if next(i) == nil then
                return true
            end
            local iterateArray, B, z =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }, 0
            for key2, entry in iterateArray(B) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and i[string.lower(child.Name)] then
                            key2 = child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                            index = key2 and tonumber(key2.Value)
                            z = if index ~= nil and index > z then index else z
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return z <= 0, z
        end
        context.crystalBetween = function(i, b)
            local orbLead, orbNear = hazardReader.orbLead, hazardReader.orbNear
            if not (orbLead and orbLead.goal and orbNear and i) then
                return false
            end
            if
                context.crystalShield
                and context.crystalShield(orbLead.colour, orbNear.x, orbNear.z, i.X, i.Z, orbNear.part)
            then
                return true
            end
            local SF, yF = i.X - orbNear.x, i.Z - orbNear.z
            i = SF * SF + yF * yF
            if i < 4 then
                return false
            end
            local EF = ((orbLead.goal.X - orbNear.x) * SF + (orbLead.goal.Z - orbNear.z) * yF) / i
            if EF <= 0.05 or EF >= 0.98 then
                return false
            end
            local i, JF = orbNear.x + SF * EF - orbLead.goal.X, orbNear.z + yF * EF - orbLead.goal.Z
            return i * i + JF * JF < (b or config.crystalLineClear or 10) ^ 2
        end
        context.orbBetween = function(vector, b)
            local B, orbNear = hazardReader.orbLead, hazardReader.orbNear
            if not (B and B.goal and orbNear and vector) then
                return false
            end
            local SF, yF = B.goal.X - vector.X, B.goal.Z - vector.Z
            B = SF * SF + yF * yF
            if B < 4 then
                return false
            end
            local EF = ((orbNear.x - vector.X) * SF + (orbNear.z - vector.Z) * yF) / B
            if EF <= 0.05 or EF >= 0.98 then
                return false
            end
            local B, JF = vector.X + SF * EF - orbNear.x, vector.Z + yF * EF - orbNear.z
            return B * B + JF * JF < (b or config.orbLineClear or 10) ^ 2
        end
        context.orbRoundPoint = function(vector, best, B, z, SF)
            if not (vector and best and B) then
                return nil
            end
            local yF, EF = B.x, B.z
            local JF, wF = vector.X - yF, vector.Z - EF
            local YF = math.sqrt(JF * JF + wF * wF)
            if YF < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            local phase, bestAt = best.X - yF, best.Z - EF
            yF = math.sqrt(phase * phase + bestAt * bestAt)
            if yF < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            EF = math.atan2(wF, JF)
            local ZF = math.atan2(bestAt, phase) - EF
            while ZF > 3.141592653589793 do
                ZF -= 6.283185307179586
            end
            while ZF <= -3.141592653589793 do
                ZF += 6.283185307179586
            end
            local nF, fF, side, oF =
                math.abs(ZF), config.orbRoundD or 26, config.orbRoundNeed or 34, hazardReader.orbRound
            oF = if oF and oF.part ~= B.part then nil else oF
            if nF < math.rad(config.orbRoundDone or 25) then
                hazardReader.orbRound = nil
                return best, nil
            end
            phase = oF and oF.phase
            phase = if (
                    if (if not phase then yF < side and "pull" or "round" else phase) == "round"
                            and yF < side - 6
                        then "pull"
                        else if not phase then yF < side and "pull" or "round" else phase
                )
                        == "pull"
                    and yF >= side + 4
                then "round"
                else if (if not phase then yF < side and "pull" or "round" else phase) == "round"
                        and yF < side - 6
                    then "pull"
                    else if not phase then yF < side and "pull" or "round" else phase
            best, bestAt = oF and oF.best, oF and oF.bestAt
            if phase == "round" then
                if not best or nF < best - 0.05235987755982989 then
                    best, bestAt = nF, z
                else
                    if z - (bestAt or z) > (config.orbRoundStall or 2.5) then
                        phase, best, bestAt = "pull", nil, nil
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
                best, bestAt = nil, nil
            end
            side = oF and oF.phase == phase and oF.side or nil
            if not side then
                if nF < 0.3490658503988659 or nF > 2.792526803190927 then
                    side = 1
                    EF = hazardReader.bobHome
                    if EF then
                        local AF, kF = -wF / YF, JF / YF
                        side = if AF * (EF.X - vector.X) + kF * (EF.Z - vector.Z) < 0 then -1 else side
                    else
                    end
                else
                    side = if config.orbLowestAngle ~= false
                        then ZF > 0 and 1 or -1
                        else if phase == "round" then ZF > 0 and 1 or -1 else ZF < 0 and 1 or -1
                end
            else
            end
            hazardReader.orbRound = {
                side = side,
                part = B.part,
                since = oF and oF.since or z,
                at = z,
                phase = phase,
                best = best,
                bestAt = bestAt,
            }
            best = B.pace or config.orbPace or 15
            SF = math.max(SF or config.tweenEscape or 24, 1)
            bestAt = math.clamp(best / SF + (config.orbRoundGain or 1) * (fF - YF) / fF, -0.5, 0.95)
            bestAt = if config.orbLowestAngle ~= false
                then if phase == "pull" then 0.95 else bestAt
                else if phase == "pull"
                        and math.abs(nF - 3.141592653589793) < 0.4363323129985824
                    then math.max(bestAt, math.min(best / SF + 0.15, 0.95))
                    else bestAt
            fF, z, B, best, EF =
                math.sqrt(math.max(1 - bestAt * bestAt, 0.05)), -wF / YF * side, JF / YF * side, JF / YF, wF / YF
            local SF, JF, wF, ZF = fF * z + bestAt * best, fF * B + bestAt * EF, config.orbRoundLead or 8
            if phase == "pull" then
                best, B =
                    config.orbLowestAngle ~= false
                            and "pull it straight back, %.0f deg, %.0f out, crystal %.0f from it"
                        or "pull it %s, %.0f deg, %.0f out, crystal %.0f from it",
                    config.orbLowestAngle ~= false and math.deg(nF) or (side > 0 and "left" or "right")
                ZF = best:format(
                    B,
                    config.orbLowestAngle ~= false and YF or math.deg(nF),
                    config.orbLowestAngle ~= false and yF or YF,
                    yF
                )
            else
                ZF = ("round it %s, %.0f deg to go, %.0f out"):format(
                    side > 0 and "left" or "right",
                    math.deg(nF),
                    YF
                )
            end
            return Vector3.new(vector.X + SF * wF, vector.Y, vector.Z + JF * wF), ZF
        end
        context.leadPlan = function(vector, b, B)
            local z = b and b.goal
            if not (vector and z) then
                return nil
            end
            local filterDescendantsInstances, leadPlanDeg = z.X - vector.X, z.Z - vector.Z
            local EF =
                math.sqrt(filterDescendantsInstances * filterDescendantsInstances + leadPlanDeg * leadPlanDeg)
            if EF < 3 then
                return nil
            end
            local JF, wF, YF, vF, MF, ZF, orbNear, fF, leadPlanDeg2 =
                filterDescendantsInstances / EF,
                leadPlanDeg / EF,
                math.min(EF, config.leadLeg or 20),
                config.burstMax or 28,
                config.leadCrystalClear or 16,
                b.colour and string.lower(tostring(b.colour)) or "",
                hazardReader.orbNear,
                {},
                { "red", "green", "yellow" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(leadPlanDeg2) do
                if entry ~= ZF then
                    EF = context.bobCrystal(entry)
                    if EF then
                        fF[#fF + 1] = {
                            col = entry,
                            x = EF.X,
                            z = EF.Z,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            local function oF(AF, kF, xF, aF, eF, NF)
                local IF, FF = xF - AF, aF - kF
                xF = IF * IF + FF * FF
                if xF < 1 then
                    return math.sqrt((eF - AF) ^ 2 + (NF - kF) ^ 2), 0
                end
                aF = math.clamp(((eF - AF) * IF + (NF - kF) * FF) / xF, 0, 1)
                return math.sqrt((AF + IF * aF - eF) ^ 2 + (kF + FF * aF - NF) ^ 2), aF
            end
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            filterDescendantsInstances = {}
            if localPlayer.Character then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = localPlayer.Character
            end
            if context.BB and context.BB.folder then
                filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = context.BB.folder
            end
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
            pcall(function()
                raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
            end)
            local kF, leadPlanDeg3, aF, eF, NF, IF, FF, CF =
                context.BB,
                hazardReader.leadPlanDeg,
                -math.huge,
                -math.huge,
                config.leadPlanDegs or { 0, 25, -25, 45, -45, 70, -70, 95, -95, 120, -120, 150, -150, 180 },
                -math.huge,
                {},
                {}
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(NF) do
                EF = math.rad(entry2)
                leadPlanDeg2, index2 = math.cos(EF), math.sin(EF)
                CF[#CF + 1] = {
                    d = entry2,
                    ax = JF * leadPlanDeg2 - wF * index2,
                    az = JF * index2 + wF * leadPlanDeg2,
                    L = entry2 == 0 and YF or math.min(YF, config.leadSideLeg or 16),
                    bonus = 0,
                    tag = tostring(entry2),
                }
            end
            if
                orbNear
                and orbNear.x
                and context.orbBetween
                and context.orbBetween(vector)
                and context.orbRoundPoint
            then
                NF = context.orbRoundPoint(vector, z, orbNear, B, vF)
                if NF then
                    EF, leadPlanDeg = NF.X - vector.X, NF.Z - vector.Z
                    leadPlanDeg2 = math.sqrt(EF * EF + leadPlanDeg * leadPlanDeg)
                    if leadPlanDeg2 > 0.5 then
                        filterDescendantsInstances, ZF = EF / leadPlanDeg2, leadPlanDeg / leadPlanDeg2
                        local gF = math.floor(
                            math.deg(
                                math.atan2(
                                    filterDescendantsInstances * wF - ZF * JF,
                                    filterDescendantsInstances * JF + ZF * wF
                                )
                            ) + 0.5
                        )
                        CF[#CF + 1] = {
                            d = gF,
                            ax = filterDescendantsInstances,
                            az = ZF,
                            L = math.min(YF, config.leadSideLeg or 16),
                            bonus = config.leadRoundBonus or 60,
                            tag = "R" .. gF,
                        }
                    end
                end
            else
                hazardReader.orbRound = nil
            end
            filterDescendantsInstances = orbNear ~= nil
                and orbNear.x ~= nil
                and (orbNear.d or 99) < (config.leadOrbCloseAt or 25)
            if not filterDescendantsInstances then
                ZF, YF =
                    #CF + 1, {
                        d = 0,
                        ax = 0,
                        az = 0,
                        L = 0,
                    }
                YF.bonus, YF.tag, YF.hold, CF[ZF] = -(config.leadHoldCost or 90), "H", true, YF
            end
            z, NF = nil
            JF, ZF, leadPlanDeg = -1
            YF, leadPlanDeg2, B = nil
            local gF, leadPlanDeg4, bF
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(CF) do
                local zF, sF, TF, WF = entry3.d, entry3.ax, entry3.az, entry3.L
                if
                    not filterDescendantsInstances
                    and not entry3.hold
                    and math.abs(zF) >= (config.leadBackDeg or 100)
                then
                    entry3.bonus = (entry3.bonus or 0) - (config.leadBackCost or 120)
                end
                EF, wF = vector.X + sF * WF, vector.Z + TF * WF
                local SF, KF =
                    Vector3.new(EF, vector.Y, wF),
                    not entry3.hold and workspace:Raycast(
                        Vector3.new(vector.X, vector.Y + 1.5, vector.Z),
                        Vector3.new(sF, 0, TF) * (WF + 3),
                        raycastParams
                    )
                index3 = if KF
                    then if KF
                        then "wall"
                        else if not entry3.hold
                                and not workspace:Raycast(
                                    Vector3.new(EF, vector.Y + 4, wF),
                                    Vector3.new(0, -16, 0),
                                    raycastParams
                                )
                            then "drop"
                            else if kF
                                    and kF.pathBlocked
                                    and kF.pathBlocked(vector, SF, vF)
                                then "box"
                                else if kF
                                        and kF.bobOrbPathSafe
                                        and not kF.bobOrbPathSafe(vector, SF, vF)
                                    then "orb"
                                    else nil
                    else if not entry3.hold
                            and not workspace:Raycast(
                                Vector3.new(EF, vector.Y + 4, wF),
                                Vector3.new(0, -16, 0),
                                raycastParams
                            )
                        then "drop"
                        else if kF
                                and kF.pathBlocked
                                and kF.pathBlocked(vector, SF, vF)
                            then "box"
                            else if kF
                                    and kF.bobOrbPathSafe
                                    and not kF.bobOrbPathSafe(vector, SF, vF)
                                then "orb"
                                else nil
                if index3 then
                    FF[#FF + 1] = entry3.tag
                        .. ":"
                        .. index3
                        .. (
                            index3 == "box"
                                and kF
                                and kF.blockReason
                                and "(" .. tostring(kF.blockReason):sub(1, 6) .. ")"
                            or ""
                        )
                    if index3 == "box" then
                        TF = -math.abs(zF) * (config.leadTurnCost or 1)
                        if TF > IF then
                            IF, z, NF = TF, SF, zF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if index3 == "box" and orbNear and orbNear.x then
                        WF = math.sqrt((EF - orbNear.x) ^ 2 + (wF - orbNear.z) ^ 2)
                        for index4, entry4 in ipairs(fF) do
                            KF = oF(vector.X, vector.Z, EF, wF, entry4.x, entry4.z)
                            WF = if KF < MF then WF - (MF - KF) else WF
                        end
                        if WF > JF then
                            JF, ZF, leadPlanDeg = WF, SF, zF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                    sF = -math.abs(zF) * (config.leadTurnCost or 1) + (entry3.bonus or 0)
                    sF = if leadPlanDeg3 ~= nil
                            and zF == leadPlanDeg3
                            and zF ~= 0
                        then sF + (config.leadStick or 12)
                        else sF
                    local JF
                    for index5, entry5 in ipairs(fF) do
                        index5 = oF(vector.X, vector.Z, EF, wF, entry5.x, entry5.z)
                        if index5 < MF then
                            sF, JF = sF - (MF - index5) * (config.leadCrystalCost or 25), JF or entry5.col
                        else
                        end
                        if orbNear and orbNear.x then
                            local vF, fF = oF(orbNear.x, orbNear.z, EF, wF, entry5.x, entry5.z)
                            if vF < MF and fF > 0.05 and fF < 0.98 then
                                sF, JF = sF - (MF - vF) * (config.leadOrbCrystalCost or 30), JF or entry5.col
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    local EF = config.wrongPillarGuard ~= false
                            and context.wrongPillarAt
                            and context.wrongPillarAt(vector, SF)
                        or nil
                    if EF then
                        if sF > eF then
                            eF, YF, leadPlanDeg2, B = sF, SF, zF, EF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                        if sF > aF then
                            aF, gF, leadPlanDeg4, bF = sF, SF, zF, JF
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            hazardReader.leadPlanDeg = leadPlanDeg4
            hazardReader.leadPlanWhy = (#FF > 0 and table.concat(FF, ",") or "")
                .. (leadPlanDeg4 and " ->" .. leadPlanDeg4 or " ->none")
                .. (bF and " cry:" .. bF or "")
            z = not gF
            if
                z
                and orbNear
                and orbNear.x
                and context.crystalShield
                and context.crystalShield(b.colour, orbNear.x, orbNear.z, vector.X, vector.Z, orbNear.part)
            then
                return Vector3.new(vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z), nil, " [behind the crystal - holding]"
            end
            if z and YF then
                hazardReader.leadPlanWhy = hazardReader.leadPlanWhy .. " wrongpillar " .. tostring(B)
                hazardReader.leadPlanDeg = leadPlanDeg2
                CF, kF = leadPlanDeg2 ~= 0 and leadPlanDeg2 or nil, vmHelpers[127](tostring(B))
                return YF,
                    CF,
                    (" [every way on takes an orb past the %s crystal - the least bad]"):format(vmHelpers:jB(kF))
            end
            if z and orbNear and orbNear.x and (orbNear.d or 99) < (config.leadOrbAwayAt or 40) and ZF then
                hazardReader.leadPlanWhy = hazardReader.leadPlanWhy .. " away " .. leadPlanDeg
                hazardReader.leadPlanDeg = leadPlanDeg
                return ZF, leadPlanDeg ~= 0 and leadPlanDeg or nil, " [away from the orb]"
            end
            if z then
                hazardReader.leadPlanWhy = hazardReader.leadPlanWhy .. " hold"
                hazardReader.leadPlanDeg = nil
                return Vector3.new(vector.X, vector.Y, vector.Z), nil, " [boxed in - holding]"
            end
            if leadPlanDeg4 == 0 and not bF and not (gF.X == vector.X and gF.Z == vector.Z) then
                return nil
            end
            if gF.X == vector.X and gF.Z == vector.Z then
                hazardReader.leadPlanWhy = hazardReader.leadPlanWhy .. " H"
                return gF, nil, " [beam ahead - waiting]"
            end
            return gF,
                leadPlanDeg4 ~= 0 and leadPlanDeg4 or nil,
                bF and " [clear of the " .. bF .. " crystal]" or nil
        end
        context.orbAroundPoint = function(vector, b, B)
            if not (vector and b and B) then
                return nil
            end
            local z, SF = b.X - vector.X, b.Z - vector.Z
            b = math.sqrt(z * z + SF * SF)
            if b < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            z /= b
            SF /= b
            b = -SF
            local yF, EF = (B.x - vector.X) * b + (B.z - vector.Z) * z
            if math.abs(yF) > 1.5 then
                EF = yF > 0 and -1 or 1
            else
                EF = 1
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if enemy.isBoss and enemy.root and enemy.root.Parent then
                        EF = (enemy.root.Position.X - vector.X) * b
                                        + (enemy.root.Position.Z - vector.Z) * z
                                    > 0
                                and -1
                            or 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            local yF, JF =
                math.min((config.orbBubble or 34) + (config.orbAroundPad or 6), config.orbAroundMax or 40),
                config.orbAroundAhead or 6
            return Vector3.new(B.x + z * JF + b * EF * yF, vector.Y, B.z + SF * JF + z * EF * yF)
        end
        context.groupMembers = function(i)
            local b = {}
            if not (i and i.root and i.root.Parent) then
                return b, 0, 0, 0
            end
            local B, position, SF, yF, EF, JF =
                hazardReader.groupOf and i.model and hazardReader.groupOf[i.model] or nil,
                i.root.Position,
                ((config.groupLink or 34) * 1.5) ^ 2,
                0,
                0,
                0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    i = nil
                    if B then
                        i = enemy.model ~= nil and hazardReader.groupOf[enemy.model] == B
                    else
                        local B, YF = enemy.root.Position.X - position.X, enemy.root.Position.Z - position.Z
                        i = B * B + YF * YF <= SF
                    end
                    if i then
                        b[#b + 1] = enemy
                        yF, EF, JF = yF + enemy.root.Position.X, EF + enemy.root.Position.Z, JF + 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if JF > 0 then
                yF, EF = yF / JF, EF / JF
            else
            end
            return b, yF, EF, JF
        end
        context.enclosingCircle = function(i)
            local b = #i
            if b == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = 0, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(i) do
                B, z = B + entry.root.Position.X, z + entry.root.Position.Z
            end
            B /= b
            z /= b
            for index2 = 1, 24, 1 do
                local yF, EF, JF = -1, B, z
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(i) do
                    index3 = (entry2.root.Position.X - B) ^ 2 + (entry2.root.Position.Z - z) ^ 2
                    if index3 > yF then
                        yF, EF, JF = index3, entry2.root.Position.X, entry2.root.Position.Z
                    else
                    end
                end
                B, z = B + (EF - B) / (index2 + 1), z + (JF - z) / (index2 + 1)
            end
            b = 0
            for index4, entry3 in ipairs(i) do
                index4 = math.sqrt((entry3.root.Position.X - B) ^ 2 + (entry3.root.Position.Z - z) ^ 2)
                b = if index4 > b then index4 else b
            end
            return B, z, b
        end
        context.bestCastFacing = function(vector, b)
            if not (b and b.root and b.root.Parent) or b.isBoss then
                return nil
            end
            if not context.aoeLanding then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = context.aoeLanding()
            if not B or not z then
                return nil
            end
            local SF, SF, SF, yF = contextAoeShapeNow()
            local cF = context.groupMembers(b)
            if #cF < 2 then
                return nil
            end
            local EF, JF = context.enclosingCircle(cF)
            local wF, YF = EF - vector.X, JF - vector.Z
            if math.sqrt(wF * wF + YF * YF) < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            local vF, MF, ZF, nF, fF, rF =
                math.atan2(YF, wF), config.castFanSpan or 50, math.max(config.castFanStep or 5, 1), -1, math.huge
            for index = -MF, MF, ZF do
                YF = vF + math.rad(index)
                b, index = math.cos(YF), math.sin(YF)
                local YF, vF, MF = vector.X + b * B, vector.Z + index * B, 0
                for index2, entry in ipairs(cF) do
                    wF, index2 = entry.root.Position.X - YF, entry.root.Position.Z - vF
                    MF = if if SF
                            then contextCoversPoint(
                                vector.X,
                                vector.Z,
                                b,
                                index,
                                entry.root.Position.X,
                                entry.root.Position.Z,
                                B,
                                z,
                                SF,
                                yF
                            )
                            else wF * wF + index2 * index2 <= z * z
                        then MF + 1
                        else MF
                end
                index = (YF - EF) ^ 2 + (vF - JF) ^ 2
                if MF > nF or MF == nF and index < fF then
                    nF, fF, rF = MF, index, Vector3.new(YF, vector.Y, vF)
                else
                end
            end
            return rF, nF, #cF
        end
        context.buffCooldownLeft = function(i)
            i = i or os.clock()
            local b = context.buffTool and context.buffTool()
            if not b then
                return 0
            end
            local B = b:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
            local z = B and tonumber(B.Value)
            if z ~= nil then
                return math.max(z, 0)
            end
            z, B = config.buffCooldown or 6, b:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
            z = if B and tonumber(B.Value) and tonumber(B.Value) > 0 then tonumber(B.Value) else z
            return math.max(z - (i - (runtimeState.buffPressedAt or -math.huge)), 0)
        end
        context.firstCastReady = function(i, b)
            i = i or os.clock()
            local B, z = context.attackReady()
            if not B then
                return false, "attack", z or 0
            end
            if context.buffState then
                local B, z, z = context.buffState(i)
                if B == "gap" then
                    return false, "skill", z or 0
                end
                if B == "up" and b then
                    z = context.buffCooldownLeft(i)
                    if z <= (config.firstCastBuffMinCd or 4) then
                        return false, "skill", z
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.threatened = function(vector, b)
            b = b or os.clock()
            if runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt ~= nil and b - runtimeState.meleeEscapeAt < 0.5 then
                return true
            end
            if not vector then
                return false
            end
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    local z, SF = vector.X - enemy.x, vector.Z - enemy.z
                    index = math.sqrt(z * z + SF * SF)
                    if index < (config.nearThreatRange or 30) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if enemy.melee and index < (config.meleeThreatRange or 45) then
                        if
                            (index > 0.1 and (enemy.vx * z + enemy.vz * SF) / index or 0) > 3
                            or index < (enemy.extent or 0) + (enemy.meleeDistance or 4) + 8
                        then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.firstCastOwed = function(i)
            if config.waypointFlow == false then
                return false
            end
            if hazardReader.wpFlowDone and config.waypointFirstOnly ~= false then
                return false
            end
            if not (i and i.root and i.root.Parent) or i.isBoss then

            end
            if not context.groupMembers then
                return false
            end
            if not (context.groupSetFor and context.groupSetFor(i)) then
                return false
            end

            if B < 2 then
                return false

            end
            return true
        end
        context.firstCastStandD = function(i, b, B)
            local z = (b or 0) - (B or 0) - (config.firstCastSlack or 1.5)
            b, B = i + math.max(z, 0), context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or i
            return if b > B - 2 then math.max(B - 2, i) else b
        end
        context.firstCastWalkIn = function(i, vector)
            if not (i and i.root and i.root.Parent) or i.isBoss then
                return nil
            end
            if not context.aoeLanding then
                return nil
            end
            if context.firstCastReady and not context.firstCastReady(os.clock()) then
                return nil
            end
            local B, z = context.aoeLanding()
            if not B then
                return nil
            end
            local SF = i.root.Position
            local cF, hF = SF.X - vector.X, SF.Z - vector.Z
            if
                math.sqrt(cF * cF + hF * hF)
                > (context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 52) + (config.walkInFrom or 35)
            then
                return nil
            end
            if math.abs(SF.Y - vector.Y) > (config.heightSplit or 6) then
                return nil
            end
            local yF, EF, JF, wF = context.groupMembers(i)
            if wF < 2 then
                return nil
            end
            wF = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(EF / 20, JF / 20)
            if context.groupFirstCastDone(yF) then
                return nil
            end
            SF, cF, hF, i = 0, context.enclosingCircle(yF)
            local yF, YF
            if cF then
                yF, YF, SF = cF, hF, i
            else
                yF, YF = EF, JF
            end
            EF, cF = vector.X - yF, vector.Z - YF
            i = math.sqrt(EF * EF + cF * cF)
            if i < 1 then
                return nil
            end
            JF = context.firstCastStandD(B, z, SF)
            if i <= JF + 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            return Vector3.new(yF + EF / i * JF, vector.Y, YF + cF / i * JF), wF
        end
        local i, b, B = context.PATH and context.PATH.data .. "/aoe.json" or "HarvardLabs/data/aoe.json", 0

                        }

                    hF = true
                else
                end
            end
            if not hF then
                return false
            end

                return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(cF)
            end)

        context.loadAoe = function()
            if config.aoeSave == false then

        end

                    key = math.max(abilitySlot.aoeX, abilitySlot.aoeZ) * 0.5
                    b = if not b or key < b then key else b

                if (config.aoeRadius or 0) > 0 then config.aoeRadius else b,

                            true,

                    end

            end

        end
