        local function B()
            local dungeonName = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            local SF = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or ""
            if SF == "" then
                return ""
            end
            return SF .. "|" .. localPlayer.Name
        end
        context.carryHitRuleHere = function()
            if (config.carryDodgeAt or 0.1) <= 0 or config.carryIgnoreHits == false then
                return false
            end
            if context.isAlt1186 and context.isAlt1186() then
                return false
            end
            local dungeonName = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            local SF = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or ""
            if SF == "" or not context.dungeonRank then
                return false
            end
            local z, cF =
                context.dungeonRank(SF), context.dungeonRank(config.carryIgnoreUpTo or "Volcanic Chambers")
            return z ~= nil and cF ~= nil and z <= cF
        end
        context.carryIgnoresHits = function()
            if not context.carryHitRuleHere() then
                return false
            end
            if config.carryDodgeAfterHit == false then
                return true
            end
            local z = B()
            if z == "" then
                return false
            end
            return b()[z] == nil
        end
        context.meleeCarry = function()
            if config.carryMelee == false or config.classProfile ~= "warrior" then
                return false
            end
            if context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() then
                return false
            end
            return context.carryIgnoresHits() == true
        end
        local function z()
            local character = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoid = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not humanoid then
                return
            end
            local hit8Hp, hit8Hp2 = humanoid.Health, runtimeState.hit8Hp
            runtimeState.hit8Hp = hit8Hp
            if not hit8Hp2 or hit8Hp >= hit8Hp2 or humanoid.MaxHealth <= 0 or hit8Hp <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local yF, EF = (hit8Hp2 - hit8Hp) / humanoid.MaxHealth, B()
            if EF ~= "" and yF >= (config.carryDodgeAt or 0.1) and b()[EF] == nil then
                runtimeState.hit8[EF] = math.floor(yF * 1000) / 10
                pcall(function()
                    local b = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("HarvardLabs/data/hit8.json"))
                    if type(b) == "table" then
                        for key, entry in pairs(b) do
                            if runtimeState.hit8[key] == nil then
                                runtimeState.hit8[key] = entry
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    writefile(
                        "HarvardLabs/data/hit8.json",
                        game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(runtimeState.hit8)
                    )
                end)
                contextLogT(
                    "hit8",
                    2,
                    "Fight",
                    ("%s: a hit took %.1f%% - dodging on for this dungeon"):format(EF, yF * 100)
                )
            end
        end
        context.apply1186 = function()
            if config.carryDodgeAfterHit ~= false and context.carryHitRuleHere and context.carryHitRuleHere() then
                pcall(z)
            end
            if context.DG then
                local dangerGeometry2, B =
                    context.DG, context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry() and (config.carryDodgeLead or 4)
                dangerGeometry2.leadFloor = B or nil
            end
            local overlayMode = context.pulseCarry() and "pulse"
                or context.meleeCarry and context.meleeCarry() and "melee"
                or context.carryIgnoresHits and context.carryIgnoresHits() and "ranged"
                or nil
            local B = overlayMode ~= nil
            if B and runtimeState.overlay1186 and runtimeState.overlayMode ~= overlayMode then
                for key, entry in pairs(runtimeState.overlay1186) do
                    config[key] = entry.v
                end
                runtimeState.overlay1186 = nil
            end
            if B == (runtimeState.overlay1186 ~= nil) then
                if B and overlayMode ~= "ranged" then
                    local z = if overlayMode == "melee"
                        then math.max((config.attackRange or 13) - (config.carryMeleeIn or 4), 4)
                        else math.max((config.pulseRadius or 20) - 6, 4)
                    config.mobStandoff = z
                    config.rangedStandoff = z
                    config.mageStandoff = z
                    config.bossStandoff = z
                end
                return
            end
            if B then
                local overlay1186 = {}
                for key2, entry2 in pairs(i) do
                    if not (overlayMode == "ranged" and key2 == "autoStandoff") then
                        overlay1186[key2] = {
                            v = config[key2],
                        }
                        config[key2] = entry2
                    end
                end
                local i = { "mobStandoff", "rangedStandoff", "mageStandoff", "bossStandoff" }
                for index, entry3 in ipairs(i) do
                    overlay1186[entry3] = {
                        v = config[entry3],
                    }
                end
                runtimeState.overlay1186 = overlay1186
                runtimeState.overlayMode = overlayMode
                contextLogT(
                    "1186",
                    3,
                    "Fight",
                    overlayMode == "melee"
                            and "1-186 warrior carry on: hits do not matter here - fighting in melee"
                        or overlayMode == "ranged" and "hits do not matter here: kiting off, fighting at the loadout's own range"
                        or "1-186 carry on: kiting off, fighting at pulse range"
                )
            else
                for key3, entry4 in pairs(runtimeState.overlay1186) do
                    config[key3] = entry4.v
                end
                runtimeState.overlay1186 = nil
                runtimeState.overlayMode = nil
                contextLogT("1186", 3, "Fight", "1-186 carry off: normal profile restored")
            end
        end
        context.buffTool = function()
            if type(config.buffSpells) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            local buffToolAt = os.clock()
            if runtimeState.buffToolAt and buffToolAt - runtimeState.buffToolAt < 0.1 then
                return runtimeState.buffToolCache, runtimeState.buffToolSlot
            end
            runtimeState.buffToolAt = buffToolAt
            runtimeState.buffToolCache = nil
            runtimeState.buffToolSlot = nil
            local b, B, z, buffToolN =
                {}, ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }, 0
            for key, entry in B(z) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") then
                            key = string.lower(child.Name)
                            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.buffNames()) do
                                if key == string.lower(entry2) then
                                    buffToolAt = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                                    buffToolN += 1
                                    b[buffToolN] = {
                                        tool = child,
                                        slot = buffToolAt and string.lower(tostring(buffToolAt.Value)) or nil,
                                    }
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            runtimeState.buffToolN = buffToolN
            if buffToolN == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            if buffToolN > 1 and config.buffAlternate ~= false then
                B, z = nil
                for index3 = 1, buffToolN, 1 do
                    buffToolAt = b[index3]
                    index3 = buffToolAt.tool:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                    if (index3 and tonumber(index3.Value) or 0) <= 0 and buffToolAt.slot then
                        local SF = runtimeState.lastBuff and runtimeState.lastBuff[buffToolAt.slot] or -math.huge
                        if B == nil or SF < z then
                            B, z = buffToolAt, SF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if B then
                    runtimeState.buffToolCache, runtimeState.buffToolSlot = B.tool, B.slot
                    return runtimeState.buffToolCache, runtimeState.buffToolSlot
                end
            end
            runtimeState.buffToolCache, runtimeState.buffToolSlot = b[1].tool, b[1].slot
            return runtimeState.buffToolCache, runtimeState.buffToolSlot
        end
        local function i(b)
            if b and string.lower(b.Name) == "pulse waves" then
                return config.pulseBuffDur or 2.5
            end
            if b and context.carrySkillDur(b.Name) then
                return context.carrySkillDur(b.Name)
            end
            return config.buffDuration or 5
        end
        F, buffSeen = runtimeState.buffSeen
        if F then
            buffSeen = F
        else
            local setMetatable4, weakKeys4 = setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",
            }
            buffSeen = setMetatable4({}, weakKeys4)
        end
        runtimeState.buffSeen = buffSeen
        local function contextBuffCastAge(now, b)
            local cooldown = now:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
            local left, SF = cooldown and tonumber(cooldown.Value) or 0, runtimeState.buffSeen[now]
            if not SF then
                SF = {}
                runtimeState.buffSeen[now] = SF
            else
            end
            now = os.clock()
            if left <= 0 then
                SF.at = nil
            elseif left > (SF.left or 0) + 0.3 and left >= b - 0.3 then
                SF.at = now
            end
            SF.left = left
            return SF.at and now - SF.at or nil
        end
        context.buffCastAge = contextBuffCastAge
        local function F()
            local iterateArray, B =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(B) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") then
                            index = string.lower(child.Name)
                            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.buffNames()) do
                                if index == string.lower(entry2) then
                                    local b, SF, cooldownLength =
                                        config.buffCooldown or 6, i(child), child:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
                                    key = contextBuffCastAge(
                                        child,
                                        if cooldownLength
                                                and tonumber(cooldownLength.Value)
                                                and tonumber(cooldownLength.Value) > 0
                                            then tonumber(cooldownLength.Value)
                                            else b
                                    )
                                    if key and key < SF then
                                        return true, SF - key
                                    end
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.buffState = function(b)
            local B, z = context.buffTool()
            if not B then
                return "none"
            end
            if (runtimeState.buffToolN or 0) > 1 and config.buffAnyCopy ~= false then
                local SF, cF = F()
                if SF then
                    return "up", z, cF
                end
            end
            local F, SF, cF = i(B), config.buffCooldown or 6, B:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
            SF = if cF and tonumber(cF.Value) and tonumber(cF.Value) > 0 then tonumber(cF.Value) else SF
            cF = config.buffFromTool ~= false and B:FindFirstChild("cooldown") or nil
            local i = cF and tonumber(cF.Value) or nil
            if i == nil then
                cF = b - (runtimeState.buffPressedAt or -math.huge)
                if cF < F then
                    return "up", z, F - cF
                end
                if cF < SF then
                    return "gap", z, SF - cF
                end
                return "ready", z, 0
            end
            if i <= 0 then
                return "ready", z, 0
            end
            if context.CARRY_SKILLS[string.lower(B.Name)] then
                cF = contextBuffCastAge(B, SF)
                if cF and cF < F then
                    return "up", z, F - cF
                end
                return "gap", z, i
            end
            if i > SF - F then
                return "up", z, i - (SF - F)
            end
            return "gap", z, i
        end
        context.arrowRainTool = function()
            local arrowToolAt = os.clock()
            if runtimeState.arrowToolAt and arrowToolAt - runtimeState.arrowToolAt < 0.25 then
                return runtimeState.arrowTool, runtimeState.arrowSlot
            end
            runtimeState.arrowToolAt = arrowToolAt
            runtimeState.arrowTool = nil
            runtimeState.arrowSlot = nil
            local iterateArray, F =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(F) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(child.Name) == "arrow rain" then
                            index = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                            runtimeState.arrowTool, runtimeState.arrowSlot =
                                child, index and string.lower(tostring(index.Value)) or nil
                            return runtimeState.arrowTool, runtimeState.arrowSlot
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.arrowRainUp = function(arrowAt)
            if config.arrowRainSpeed == false then
                return false
            end
            local arrowLeft = context.arrowRainTool()
            if not arrowLeft then
                runtimeState.arrowLeft = nil
                return false
            end
            local cooldown = arrowLeft:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
            arrowLeft = cooldown and tonumber(cooldown.Value) or 0
            if runtimeState.arrowLeft == nil then
                runtimeState.arrowLeft = arrowLeft
                return false
            end
            if arrowLeft > 0 and runtimeState.arrowLeft <= 0 then
                runtimeState.arrowAt = arrowAt
            end
            runtimeState.arrowLeft = arrowLeft
            return arrowLeft > 0
                and arrowAt - (runtimeState.arrowAt or -math.huge) < (config.arrowRainBuffDur or 2)
        end
        context.pulseUp = function(pulseToolsAt)
            if config.pulseSpeed == false then
                return false, 0
            end
            if not runtimeState.pulseToolsAt or pulseToolsAt - runtimeState.pulseToolsAt > 0.25 then
                runtimeState.pulseToolsAt = pulseToolsAt
                runtimeState.pulseToolList = {}
                local iterateArray, i =
                    ipairs, {
                        localPlayer.Backpack,
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
                for key, entry in iterateArray(i) do
                    if entry then
                        for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(child.Name) == "pulse waves" then
                                runtimeState.pulseToolList[#runtimeState.pulseToolList + 1] = child
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local F, i = 0, runtimeState.pulseCastSeen or 0
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(runtimeState.pulseToolList) do
                if entry2.Parent then
                    index2 = entry2:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
                    local z, SF = context.buffCastAge, index2 and tonumber(index2.Value) or (config.pulseCd or 4)
                    local b = z(entry2, SF)
                    z = b and (config.pulseBuffDur or 2.5) - b or 0
                    F, i =
                        if z > F then z else F, if b and pulseToolsAt - b > i + 0.05 then pulseToolsAt - b else i
                else
                end
            end
            if i > (runtimeState.pulseCastSeen or 0) then
                runtimeState.pulseCastSeen = i
                if not runtimeState.buffPressedAt or i > runtimeState.buffPressedAt then
                    runtimeState.buffPressedAt = i
                end
            end
            return F > 0, F
        end
        context.pulseSpeedTick = function(pulseSpeedPressAt)
            if
                config.pulseSpeed == false
                or not (context.isCarry1186 and context.isCarry1186())
                or context.pulseCarry and context.pulseCarry()
            then
                return
            end
            if context.buffTool and context.buffTool() then
                return
            end
            if
                pulseSpeedPressAt - (runtimeState.pulseSpeedPressAt or -math.huge)
                < (config.buffRetry or 0.45)
            then
                return
            end
            local F, F = context.pulseUp(pulseSpeedPressAt)
            if F > (config.pulseSpeedLead or 0.3) then
                return
            end
            F = nil
            for index, entry in ipairs(runtimeState.pulseToolList or {}) do
                local b, B =
                    entry.Parent and entry:FindFirstChild("cooldown"),
                    entry.Parent and entry:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                if b and (tonumber(b.Value) or 0) <= 0 and B then
                    F = string.lower(tostring(B.Value))
                    break
                end
            end
            if not F then
                return
            end
            local i = localPlayer.Character
            local b = i and (i:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if not b then
                return
            end
            i = b.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local B, z =
                i.X * i.X + i.Z * i.Z > 16 or runtimeState.preWalk ~= nil and runtimeState.preWalk.active == true,
                false
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    entry2.root
                    and entry2.root.Parent
                    and (entry2.humanoid == nil or entry2.humanoid.Health > 0)
                then
                    index2, i = entry2.root.Position.X - b.Position.X, entry2.root.Position.Z - b.Position.Z
                    if index2 * index2 + i * i < 3600 then
                        z = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not (B or z) then
                return
            end
            B = F == "q" and Enum.KeyCode.Q or (F == "e" and Enum.KeyCode.E or nil)
            if not B then
                return
            end
            runtimeState.pulseSpeedPressAt = pulseSpeedPressAt
            DF(B)
            contextLogT("buff", 4, "Fight", "pulse waves pressed for speed")
        end
        context.arrowRainTick = function(arrowPressAt)

        context.buffUp = function(buffHolderSeenAt)
            local F, i, i = context.buffState(buffHolderSeenAt)
            local b = F == "up"
            if not b and config.buffSpeedCheck ~= false then
                F = localPlayer.Character
                local humanoid = F and (F:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                if humanoid then
                    local buffSpeedSeen, SF, ourWalkSpeed =
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed,
                        runtimeState.walkSpeed or config.tweenWalk or 16,
                        movement.ourWalkSpeed
                    local B = ourWalkSpeed ~= nil and math.abs(buffSpeedSeen - ourWalkSpeed) < 0.01
                        or runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore ~= nil
                            and math.abs(buffSpeedSeen - runtimeState.walkSpeedBefore) < 0.01
                    if buffSpeedSeen > SF + (config.buffSpeedOver or 0.5) and not B then
                        runtimeState.buffSpeedSeen = buffSpeedSeen
                        b = true
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            b = if not b and context.arrowRainUp and context.arrowRainUp(buffHolderSeenAt) then true else b
            b = if context.pulseUp and context.pulseUp(buffHolderSeenAt) then true else b
            if config.buffHolderCheck ~= false then
                F = localPlayer.Character
                if F then
                    local spellBuff = F:FindFirstChild("spellBuff")
                    local holderPresent = spellBuff ~= nil and (tonumber(spellBuff.Value) or 0) > 0
                    runtimeState.holderWasPresent = runtimeState.holderPresent
                    runtimeState.holderPresent = holderPresent
                    if holderPresent then
                        if not runtimeState.holderWasPresent then
                            hazardReader.buffHolderSeenAt = buffHolderSeenAt
                        end
                        hazardReader.buffHolderSeen = true
                        b = true
                    else
                        b = if hazardReader.buffHolderSeen
                                and buffHolderSeenAt - (runtimeState.buffPressedAt or -math.huge)
                                    > (config.buffHolderGrace or 0.6)
                            then false
                            else b
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            runtimeState.buffUpUntil = b and buffHolderSeenAt + (i or 0) or 0
            return b
        end
        context.attackAllowedBySkill = function(I)
            if config.attackWaitsBuffLow ~= true and context.carryHitRuleHere and context.carryHitRuleHere() then
                return true, "lower dungeon"
            end
            local F = context.buffCooldownLeft and context.buffCooldownLeft(I) or 0
            if context.buffUp and context.buffUp(I) then
                if F < (config.attackSkillCdMin or 2) then
                    return false, ("up, cd %.1f"):format(F)
                end
                return true, "up"
            end
            if not context.buffState then
                return true, "no skill"
            end
            local i, b, b = context.buffState(I)
            if i == "up" then
                if F < (config.attackSkillCdMin or 2) then
                    return false, ("up, cd %.1f"):format(F)
                end
                return true, "up"
            end
            if i == "gap" then
                if config.attackNeedsBuffUp ~= false then
                    return false, ("gap %.1f"):format(b or 0)
                end
                return (b or 0) > (config.attackSkillMinCd or 1.4), ("gap %.1f"):format(b or 0)
            end
            if i == "ready" then
                return false, "ready"
            end
            return true, tostring(i)
        end

        context.emptySetTick = function(emptyCharAt)
            if config.emptySetSwap == false then
                return
            end
            local F = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (F and tostring(F.Value) ~= "") then
                return
            end
            local emptyChar = localPlayer.Character
            local emptySet = emptyChar and (emptyChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not (emptySet and emptySet.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            emptySet = runtimeState.emptySet
            if not emptySet or emptySet.job ~= game.JobId then
                emptySet = {
                    job = game.JobId,
                    n = 0,
                    at = -math.huge,
                }
                runtimeState.emptySet = emptySet
            else
            end
            if emptySet.done then
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.emptyChar ~= emptyChar then
                runtimeState.emptyChar = emptyChar
                runtimeState.emptyCharAt = emptyCharAt
                emptySet.emptySince = nil
            end
            local iterateArray, z =
                ipairs, {
                    emptyChar,
                    localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or emptyChar,
                }
            for key, entry in iterateArray(z) do
                for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Tool") then
                        emptySet.emptySince = nil
                        if emptySet.n > 0 then
                            emptySet.done = true
                            contextLogT(
                                "loadout",
                                5,
                                "Loadout",
                                "the other ability set has abilities - staying on it"
                            )
                        else
                            emptySet.done = true
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            emptySet.emptySince = emptySet.emptySince or emptyCharAt
            if
                emptyCharAt - emptySet.emptySince < (config.emptySetWait or 15)
                or emptyCharAt - emptySet.at < (config.emptySetRetry or 5)
            then
                return
            end
            if (runtimeState.loadoutFails or 0) > 0 and runtimeState.loadoutMap == tostring(F.Value) then
                return
            end
            if emptySet.n >= 2 then
                emptySet.done = true
                return
            end
            F = emptyChar:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
            if F and F.Value == true then
                return
            end
            emptySet.n = emptySet.n + 1
            emptySet.at = emptyCharAt
            runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
            DF(Enum.KeyCode.F)
            contextLogT(
                "loadout",
                5,
                "Loadout",
                emptySet.n == 1 and "no abilities on this set - swapping to the other set"
                    or "the other set is empty too - swapping back"
            )
        end
        context.otherSetHasSpeed = function()
            local speedSetCache = runtimeState.speedSetCache
            if speedSetCache and speedSetCache.job == game.JobId then
                return speedSetCache.v
            end
            if runtimeState.speedSetReading or os.clock() - (runtimeState.speedSetTriedAt or -math.huge) < 10 then
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.speedSetReading, runtimeState.speedSetTriedAt = true, os.clock()
            task.spawn(function()
                local I
                pcall(function()
                    I = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes").reloadInvy:InvokeServer()
                end)
                runtimeState.speedSetReading = false
                local F = type(I)
                if F ~= "table" then
                    return
                end
                local i, b, B = {}, pairs, I.abilities or {}
                for key, entry in b(B) do
                    if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.equipped) == "table" then
                        for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry.equipped) do
                            if entry2 == true then
                                i[key2] = string.lower(tostring(entry.name))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                b = {}
                for index, entry3 in ipairs(type(config.buffSpells) == "table" and config.buffSpells or {}) do
                    b[string.lower(tostring(entry3))] = true
                end
                local function I(z, SF)
                    return z ~= nil
                        and SF ~= nil
                        and context.CARRY_SKILLS[z] == true
                        and context.CARRY_SKILLS[SF] == true
                end
                B, F =
                    {
                        {
                            { "q", "e" },
                            { "q2", "e2" },
                        },
                        {
                            { "q2", "e2" },
                            { "q", "e" },
                        },
                    }, true
                for index2, entry4 in ipairs(B) do
                    local B, SF = entry4[1], entry4[2]
                    F = if I(i[B[1]], i[B[2]])
                        then (b[i[SF[1]] or ""] or b[i[SF[2]] or ""]) and true or false
                        else F
                end
                runtimeState.speedSetCache = {
                    job = game.JobId,
                    v = F,
                }
                if F == false then
                    contextLogT(
                        "loadout",
                        30,
                        "Loadout",
                        "the other set has no speed spell - the carry kit stays on past Orbital Outpost"
                    )
                end
            end)
            return nil
        end
        context.loadoutTick = function(I)
            if context.isEvent and context.isEvent() then
                return
            end
            if context.emptySetTick then
                context.emptySetTick(I)
            end
            if config.loadoutSwap == false or not (context.isCarry1186 and context.isCarry1186()) then
                return
            end
            if I - (runtimeState.loadoutAt or -math.huge) < (config.loadoutRetry or 2.5) then
                return
            end
            local dungeonName = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            local i = dungeonName and tostring(dungeonName.Value) or ""
            if i == "" then
                return
            end
            local b, B = context.dungeonRank(i), context.dungeonRank(config.loadoutPulseUpTo or "Orbital Outpost")
            if not b or not B then
                return
            end
            local wantPulse = b <= B
            if not wantPulse then
                b = context.otherSetHasSpeed()
                if b == false then
                    wantPulse = true
                else
                    if b == nil and context.carryKit() then
                        return
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            local hasPulse, loadoutChar = context.carryKit(), localPlayer.Character
            b = loadoutChar and (loadoutChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            if not (b and b.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.loadoutChar ~= loadoutChar then
                runtimeState.loadoutChar = loadoutChar
                runtimeState.loadoutCharAt = I
            end
            local iterateArray, yF, EF =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer.Backpack,
                    loadoutChar,
                }, false
            for key, entry in iterateArray(yF) do
                for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Tool") then
                        EF = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not EF then
                if
                    runtimeState.loadoutMap == i
                    and runtimeState.loadoutHome
                    and runtimeState.loadoutHome ~= ""
                    and (runtimeState.loadoutFails or 0) > 0
                    and (runtimeState.loadoutAt or -math.huge) >= (runtimeState.loadoutCharAt or math.huge)
                    and I - (runtimeState.loadoutCharAt or I) >= 5
                    and (runtimeState.loadoutBack or 0) < 3
                then
                    runtimeState.loadoutGaveUpFor = i
                    runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
                    runtimeState.loadoutAt, runtimeState.loadoutBack = I, (runtimeState.loadoutBack or 0) + 1
                    DF(Enum.KeyCode.F)
                    contextLogT("loadout", 30, "Loadout", "the other ability set is empty - swapping back")
                end
                return
            end
            if
                runtimeState.loadoutLoggedJob ~= game.JobId
                and context.queueLog
                and dungeonName
                and tostring(dungeonName.Value) ~= ""
            then
                runtimeState.loadoutLoggedJob = game.JobId
                B, iterateArray, b =
                    {}, ipairs, {
                        localPlayer.Backpack,
                        loadoutChar,
                    }
                for key2, entry2 in iterateArray(b) do
                    for index2, child2 in ipairs(entry2:GetChildren()) do
                        if child2:IsA("Tool") then
                            B[#B + 1] = child2.Name
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(B)
                local queueLog, hF = context.queueLog, {
                    map = i,
                }
                hF.tools, hF.wantPulse, hF.hasPulse = table.concat(B, ", "), wantPulse, hasPulse
                queueLog("loadout", hF)
            end
            if runtimeState.loadoutMap ~= i then
                runtimeState.loadoutMap = i
                runtimeState.loadoutFails = 0
                runtimeState.loadoutHome = nil
                runtimeState.loadoutBack = 0
            end
            local function F()
                local B, iterateArray2, EF =
                    {}, ipairs, {
                        localPlayer.Backpack,
                        loadoutChar,
                    }
                for key3, entry3 in iterateArray2(EF) do
                    for index3, child3 in ipairs(entry3:GetChildren()) do
                        if child3:IsA("Tool") then
                            B[#B + 1] = child3.Name
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(B)
                return table.concat(B, "|")
            end
            if wantPulse == hasPulse then
                runtimeState.loadoutFails = 0
                runtimeState.loadoutHome = nil
                runtimeState.loadoutBack = 0
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.loadoutGaveUpFor == i then
                if
                    runtimeState.loadoutHome
                    and F() ~= runtimeState.loadoutHome
                    and (runtimeState.loadoutBack or 0) < 3
                    and I - (runtimeState.loadoutAt or -math.huge) >= (config.loadoutRetry or 2.5)
                then
                    yF = loadoutChar:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
                    hasPulse = not (yF and yF.Value == true)
                    if not hasPulse then
                        runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
                    end
                    if hasPulse then
                        runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
                        runtimeState.loadoutAt, runtimeState.loadoutBack = I, (runtimeState.loadoutBack or 0) + 1
                        DF(Enum.KeyCode.F)
                        contextLogT(
                            "loadout",
                            2,
                            "Loadout",
                            "no Pulse Waves set - swapping back to the set it started on"
                        )
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            if (runtimeState.loadoutFails or 0) == 0 then
                runtimeState.loadoutHome = F()
            end
            b = loadoutChar:FindFirstChild("busyCasting")
            if b and b.Value == true then
                runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
                return
            end
            runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
            runtimeState.loadoutAt = I
            runtimeState.loadoutFails = (runtimeState.loadoutFails or 0) + 1
            if runtimeState.loadoutFails > (config.loadoutMaxTries or 1) then
                runtimeState.loadoutGaveUpFor = i
                contextLogT(
                    "loadout",
                    30,
                    "Loadout",
                    ("%s wants %s but swapping does not change the set - leaving it"):format(
                        i,
                        wantPulse and "Pulse Waves" or "the other set"
                    )
                )
                return
            end
            DF(Enum.KeyCode.F)
            contextLogT(
                "loadout",
                2,
                "Loadout",
                ("%s: swapping to %s"):format(i, wantPulse and "Pulse Waves" or "the speed + attack set")
            )
        end
        context.speedSkillFirst = function(I)
            if not (context.buffAllowed and context.buffAllowed(I)) then
                return false
            end
            if context.buffUp(I) then
                return true
            end
            return context.buffPress(I)
        end
        context.buffAllowed = function(I)
            if context.isAlt1186() then
                return false
            end
            if context.pulseCarry() then
                return true
            end
            local F = false
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if enemy.root and enemy.root.Parent and (enemy.humanoid == nil or enemy.humanoid.Health > 0) then
                    F = true
                    break
                end
            end
            local i = runtimeState.preWalk ~= nil
                and runtimeState.preWalk.active == true
                and I - (runtimeState.preWalk.at or 0) < 0.5
            if not F and not i then
                return false
            end
            local F, b, B =
                true,
                localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
                (context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or 60) + (config.buffFreeGap or 20)
            if b then
                for index2, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        enemy2.root
                        and enemy2.root.Parent
                        and (enemy2.humanoid == nil or enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0)
                    then
                        i, index2 = enemy2.root.Position.X - b.Position.X, enemy2.root.Position.Z - b.Position.Z
                        if i * i + index2 * index2 < B * B then
                            F = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                F = false
            end
            B = context.PB and context.PB.boss and string.lower(tostring(context.PB.boss)) or nil
            if B and (B:find("odin", 1, true)) then
                return true
            end
            if B and (B:find("champion", 1, true)) then
                return true
            end
            if B and (B:find("bob", 1, true)) then
                return context.bobBuffNow == nil or context.bobBuffNow(I)
            end
            if B and context.belowNL and context.belowNL() and config.buffBossBelowNL ~= false then
                return true
            end
            if B and not F then
                i = context.BB and context.BB.primary
                b = i and i.box and tostring(i.box.name or "") or ""
                local i, z = B:find("champion", 1, true) ~= nil and b == "firstbossjumpslam", hazardReader.orbLead
                local b = z ~= nil
                    and (
                        (z.orbD or 999) <= (config.buffOrbNear or 26)
                        or context.orbBetween
                            and context.orbBetween(
                                localPlayer.Character
                                    and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                    and localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                            )
                    )
                b = B:find("bob", 1, true) ~= nil and ((hazardReader.spikeFieldUntil or 0) > I or b)
                z = context.BB and context.BB.goal and context.BB.goal.bad == true
                if not (i or b or z) then
                    return false
                end
            elseif not F and context.BB and context.BB.lethal and config.buffOnMobEscape == false then
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        context.judgeCasts = function(I)
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if not enemy.isBoss and enemy.humanoid and enemy.model then
                    index = enemy.humanoid.Health
                    if enemy.lastSeenHP and index < enemy.lastSeenHP - 0.5 then
                        local firstCastMobs, firstCastMobs2 = hazardReader.firstCastMobs
                        if firstCastMobs then
                            firstCastMobs2 = firstCastMobs
                        else
                            local setMetatable, weakKeys =
                                setmetatable, {
                                    __mode = "k",
                                }
                            firstCastMobs2 = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
                        end
                        hazardReader.firstCastMobs = firstCastMobs2
                        hazardReader.firstCastMobs[enemy.model] = true
                        contextMarkStruck(enemy.model)
                    end
                    enemy.lastSeenHP = index
                end
            end
            local rangePend = runtimeState.rangePend
            if not rangePend or #rangePend == 0 then
                return
            end
            for index2 = #rangePend, 1, -1 do
                local b = rangePend[index2]
                if I - b.at >= (config.castJudgeAt or 1.1) then
                    table.remove(rangePend, index2)
                    local I, hum = hazardReader.abilitySlots and hazardReader.abilitySlots[b.slot], b.hum
                    if I and hum and hum.Parent and not b.dirty then
                        if hum.Health < b.hp0 - 0.5 then
                            I.hits = (I.hits or 0) + 1
                            if not I.hitMax or b.d > I.hitMax then
                                I.hitMax = b.d
                            end
                            I.missRun, I.reach = 0, math.floor((I.hitMax or b.d) + 0.5)
                            if I.cap and I.cap < I.reach then
                                I.cap = nil
                            end
                        elseif not I.hitMax or b.d > I.hitMax then
                            I.missRun = (I.missRun or 0) + 1
                            if (I.missRun or 0) >= (config.castMissRun or 3) then
                                local F = math.max(
                                    math.floor(b.d) - (config.castMissStep or 6),
                                    config.castMinStand or 14
                                )
                                I.cap = I.cap and math.min(I.cap, F) or F
                                I.reach = math.min(I.reach or F, F)
                                I.missRun = 0
                                contextLogT(
                                    "range",
                                    3,
                                    "Fight",
                                    ("%s: %d misses out at %.0f - range pulled to %d"):format(
                                        tostring(I.name),
                                        config.castMissRun or 3,
                                        b.d,
                                        F
                                    )
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        context.mageCentreFor = function(I, vector)
            if config.mageLead == false then
                return nil
            end
            if not (I and I.root and I.root.Parent) or I.isBoss then
                return nil
            end
            local position, b, B, z, SF, DF = I.root.Position, ((config.groupLink or 34) * 1.5) ^ 2, 0, 0, 0, 0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.model
                    and string.lower(enemy.model.Name):find("mage", 1, true)
                then
                    I, index = enemy.root.Position.X - position.X, enemy.root.Position.Z - position.Z
                    if I * I + index * index <= b then
                        B, z, SF, DF =
                            B + enemy.root.Position.X,
                            z + enemy.root.Position.Y,
                            SF + enemy.root.Position.Z,
                            DF + 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if DF == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            I = z / DF
            if math.abs(I - vector.Y) > (config.heightSplit or 6) then
                return nil
            end
            return Vector3.new(B / DF, I, SF / DF)
        end
        context.bigRoomNote = function(I, F)
            local bigRoom = hazardReader.mobGroups
            if not bigRoom then
                return
            end
            local b, B, z, SF, groups = config.resetRoomRadius or 170, {}, 0, 0, 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(bigRoom) do
                if (entry.n or 0) > 0 then
                    local hF, yF = entry.x - I.X, entry.z - I.Z
                    if hF * hF + yF * yF <= b * b then
                        B[#B + 1] = entry
                        z, SF, groups = z + entry.x, SF + entry.z, groups + 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if groups < (config.resetRoomGroups or 4) then
                return
            end
            z /= groups
            SF /= groups
            I = 0
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(B) do
                b = math.sqrt((entry2.x - z) ^ 2 + (entry2.z - SF) ^ 2) + (entry2.r or 0)
                I = if b > I then b else I
            end
            bigRoom = hazardReader.bigRoom or {}
            bigRoom.x, bigRoom.z, bigRoom.r = z, SF, math.max(I + 30, 60)
            bigRoom.at = F
            bigRoom.groups = groups
            bigRoom.clearSince = nil
            bigRoom.resetDone = false
            hazardReader.bigRoom = bigRoom
        end
        context.arenaClearReset = function(vector, selfResetAt, humanoid)
            if config.resetAfterArena == false then
                return false
            end
            context.bigRoomNote(vector, selfResetAt)
            local bigRoom = hazardReader.bigRoom
            if not bigRoom then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "no room"
                return false
            end
            if bigRoom.resetDone then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "done"
                return false
            end
            runtimeState.resetGate = "open"
            if selfResetAt - (bigRoom.at or 0) > 900 then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "room too old"
                return false
            end
            if context.runComplete and context.runComplete() then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "run complete"
                return false
            end
            if hazardReader.charAt and selfResetAt - hazardReader.charAt < (config.resetRespawnGap or 0) then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "just respawned"
                return false
            end
            local B = hazardReader.spawnCp
            if
                config.resetCatchUp ~= false
                and config.resetBelowY ~= false
                and vector.Y > (config.resetBelowY or -40)
                and B
                and hazardReader.charAt == B.at
                and bigRoom.diedInAt == B.at
                and not hazardReader.catchUpUsed
            then
                local z = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
                local position, DF
                for index, entry in ipairs(z and z:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    local checkPoint, order = entry:FindFirstChild("checkPoint"), entry:FindFirstChild("order")
                    if
                        checkPoint
                        and checkPoint:IsA("BasePart")
                        and order
                        and tonumber(order.Value) == B.order + 1
                    then
                        position, DF = checkPoint.Position, entry:FindFirstChild("barrier") == nil
                        break
                    end
                end
                if position then
                    local cF, hF =
                        math.sqrt((vector.X - position.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - position.Z) ^ 2),
                        math.sqrt((bigRoom.x - position.X) ^ 2 + (bigRoom.z - position.Z) ^ 2)
                    z = nil
                    for index2, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                        if
                            enemy.root
                            and enemy.root.Parent
                            and enemy.humanoid
                            and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                            and not enemy.isBoss
                        then
                            local yF, EF = enemy.root.Position.X - bigRoom.x, enemy.root.Position.Z - bigRoom.z
                            if yF * yF + EF * EF <= ((bigRoom.r or 120) + 60) ^ 2 then
                                z = enemy
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local SF = cF > (config.resetCatchUpFar or 150) and cF > hF
                    if DF and not z and SF then
                        bigRoom.resetDone = true
                        bigRoom.resetWasUs = true
                        runtimeState.selfResetAt = selfResetAt
                        hazardReader.catchUpUsed = true
                        contextLogT(
                            "reset",
                            1,
                            "Brain",
                            ("big room cleared while we were behind it (%.0f from the next checkpoint): resetting to come back there"):format(
                                cF
                            )
                        )
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid.Health = 0
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
                        end)
                        task.delay(1, function()
                            pcall(function()
                                local character = localPlayer.Character
                                local humanoid2 = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                                if humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health > 0 then
                                    character:BreakJoints()
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                        contextSetState("room cleared behind us: reset to the next checkpoint")
                        return true
                    end
                    hazardReader.belowSince = nil
                    runtimeState.resetGate = ("behind the room, %.0f from the next checkpoint (%s)"):format(
                        cF,
                        not SF and "close enough"
                            or not DF and "the next room is still barred"
                            or ("%s alive"):format(tostring(z.model and z.model.Name or "mob"))
                    )
                    return false
                end
            end
            if hazardReader.resetUsed then
                runtimeState.resetGate = "used"
                return false
            end
            if config.resetBelowY ~= false and vector.Y > (config.resetBelowY or -40) then
                hazardReader.belowSince = nil
                runtimeState.resetGate = ("above the drop (y %.0f)"):format(vector.Y)
                return false
            end
            if config.resetBelowY ~= false then
                hazardReader.belowSince = hazardReader.belowSince or selfResetAt
                B = config.resetBelowSettle or 3
                if selfResetAt - hazardReader.belowSince < B then
                    runtimeState.resetGate = ("just landed, reading the floor (%.1f/%.1fs)"):format(
                        selfResetAt - hazardReader.belowSince,
                        B
                    )
                    return false
                end
            end
            if config.resetAfterBob ~= false then
                B = false
                for entry2 in pairs(hazardReader.bossDown or {}) do
                    if entry2:find("bob", 1, true) then
                        B = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                local z = config.resetBelowY ~= false and vector.Y <= (config.resetBelowY or -40)
                if not B and not z then
                    runtimeState.resetGate = "Bob not down yet"
                    return false
                end
            end
            local z, SF, DF = bigRoom.r or 120, vector.X - bigRoom.x, vector.Z - bigRoom.z
            B = SF * SF + DF * DF
            if B <= z * z then
                bigRoom.entered = true
                bigRoom.left = nil
            end
            if bigRoom.entered and B > (z + (config.resetLeaveFar or 40)) ^ 2 then
                bigRoom.left = true
            end
            if bigRoom.left then
                bigRoom.clearSince = nil
                runtimeState.resetGate = ("left the room (%.0f from its centre, r %.0f)"):format(math.sqrt(B), z)
                return false
            end
            if B > (z + (config.resetRoomLeave or 150)) ^ 2 then
                bigRoom.clearSince = nil
                runtimeState.resetGate = ("not in the room (%.0f off)"):format(math.sqrt(B))
                return false
            end
            SF = (z + 60) ^ 2
            for index3, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                index3 = nil
                if enemy2.humanoid then
                    index3 = enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0
                    enemy2.noHumSince = nil
                else
                    enemy2.noHumSince = enemy2.noHumSince or selfResetAt
                    index3 = selfResetAt - enemy2.noHumSince < (config.resetGhostAfter or 20)
                end
                if
                    enemy2.root
                    and enemy2.root.Parent
                    and index3
                    and math.abs(enemy2.root.Position.Y - vector.Y)
                        <= (config.resetSameLevel or 25)
                then
                    local z, cF, hF, yF =
                        enemy2.root.Position.X - bigRoom.x,
                        enemy2.root.Position.Z - bigRoom.z,
                        enemy2.root.Position.X - vector.X,
                        enemy2.root.Position.Z - vector.Z
                    if
                        z * z + cF * cF <= SF
                        or not enemy2.isBoss and hF * hF + yF * yF <= (config.resetNearAny or 90) ^ 2
                    then
                        bigRoom.clearSince = nil
                        runtimeState.resetGate = ("%s alive at %.0f"):format(
                            tostring(enemy2.model and enemy2.model.Name or "mob"),
                            math.sqrt(
                                (enemy2.root.Position.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (enemy2.root.Position.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2
                            )
                        )
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            bigRoom.clearSince = bigRoom.clearSince or selfResetAt
            B = config.resetAfterClear or 0
            if selfResetAt - bigRoom.clearSince < B then
                contextSetState(
                    ("room cleared (%d groups): resetting in %.1fs to get back up"):format(
                        bigRoom.groups or 0,
                        B - (selfResetAt - bigRoom.clearSince)
                    )
                )
                return true
            end
            bigRoom.resetDone = true
            bigRoom.resetWasUs = true
            runtimeState.selfResetAt = selfResetAt
            hazardReader.resetUsed = true
            contextLogT(
                "reset",
                1,
                "Brain",
                ("big room cleared (%d groups): resetting the character to get back up"):format(
                    bigRoom.groups or 0
                )
            )
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.Health = 0
            end)
            pcall(function()
                humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
            end)
            task.delay(1, function()
                pcall(function()
                    local character = localPlayer.Character
                    local humanoid2 = character and (character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                    if humanoid2 and humanoid2.Health > 0 then
                        character:BreakJoints()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            contextSetState("room cleared: reset")
            return true
        end
        context.kitePlan = function(vector, F, i)
            if config.meleeKite == false or not (F and F.root and F.root.Parent) or not context.aoeLanding then
                runtimeState.kite = nil
                return nil
            end
            local b = context.aoeLanding()
            if not b then
                runtimeState.kite = nil
                return nil
            end
            local B, z, SF, DF, cF = config.kiteChaseR or 45, {}, 0, 0, 0
            for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    enemy.melee
                    and not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                    and a(vector, enemy.root.Position) <= B
                then
                    SF += enemy.root.Position.X
                    DF += enemy.root.Position.Z
                    cF += 1
                    index = H(enemy)
                    if index ~= nil then
                        z[index] = true
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if cF == 0 then
                runtimeState.kite = nil
                return nil
            end
            SF /= cF
            DF /= cF
            B = {}
            for index2, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                if
                    not enemy2.isBoss
                    and enemy2.root
                    and enemy2.root.Parent
                    and enemy2.humanoid
                    and enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    index2 = H(enemy2)
                    if index2 ~= nil and not z[index2] then
                        local H = B[index2]
                        if not H then
                            H = {
                                k = index2,
                                n = 0,
                                sx = 0,
                                sz = 0,
                                untag = 0,
                                list = {},
                            }
                            B[index2] = H
                        else
                        end
                        H.n, H.sx, H.sz = H.n + 1, H.sx + enemy2.root.Position.X, H.sz + enemy2.root.Position.Z
                        H.list[#H.list + 1] = enemy2
                        if contextTagTarget(enemy2) then
                            H.untag = H.untag + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local H, kite = runtimeState.sweeping == true, runtimeState.kite
            if kite and kite.doneAt then
                runtimeState.kiteDone = {
                    k = kite.k,
                    at = kite.doneAt,
                }
                runtimeState.kite = nil
                kite = nil
            else
            end
            z = runtimeState.kiteDone
            local hF = z and i - z.at < (config.kiteRest or 3) and z.k or nil
            kite = if kite
                    and (i - (kite.startAt or i) > (config.kiteCommit or 8) or i - (kite.at or i) > 1)
                then nil
                else kite
            z = kite and B[kite.k] or nil
            if z then
                z.x, z.z = z.sx / z.n, z.sz / z.n
                if sqrt((z.x - vector.X) ^ 2 + (z.z - vector.Z) ^ 2) > (config.kiteRange or 200) + 20 then
                    kite, z = nil, nil
                else
                end
            else
                kite = nil
            end
            if not z then
                local yF
                for key, entry in pairs(B) do
                    entry.x, entry.z = entry.sx / entry.n, entry.sz / entry.n
                    key = sqrt((entry.x - vector.X) ^ 2 + (entry.z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                    if key <= (config.kiteRange or 200) and key >= (config.kiteMinD or 12) and entry.k ~= hF then
                        local wF = key - (H and entry.untag > 0 and 1000 or 0)
                        if not z or wF < yF then
                            z, yF = entry, wF
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not z then
                runtimeState.kite = nil
                return nil
            end
            B = 0
            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(z.list) do
                index3 = sqrt((entry2.root.Position.X - z.x) ^ 2 + (entry2.root.Position.Z - z.z) ^ 2)
                B = if index3 > B then index3 else B
            end
            H = B + (config.kiteSide or 14)
            if not kite then
                B, hF = z.x - SF, z.z - DF
                local SF = sqrt(B * B + hF * hF)
                if SF < 1 then
                    B, hF = z.x - vector.X, z.z - vector.Z
                    SF = sqrt(B * B + hF * hF)
                else
                end
                if SF < 1 then
                    runtimeState.kite = nil
                    return nil
                end
                B /= SF
                hF /= SF
                local SF = -hF
                local side, yF, EF =
                    (vector.X - z.x) * SF + (vector.Z - z.z) * B >= 0 and 1 or -1, z.x + B * b, z.z + hF * b
                local JF, wF = yF - vector.X, EF - vector.Z
                EF, yF = JF * JF + wF * wF, false
                if EF > 1 then
                    local YF = math.clamp(((z.x - vector.X) * JF + (z.z - vector.Z) * wF) / EF, 0, 1)
                    yF = sqrt((vector.X + JF * YF - z.x) ^ 2 + (vector.Z + wF * YF - z.z) ^ 2) < H
                        and (vector.X - z.x) * B + (vector.Z - z.z) * hF < 0
                else
                end
                kite = {
                    k = z.k,
                    startAt = i,
                    ux = B,
                    uz = hF,
                    nx = SF,
                    nz = B,
                    side = side,
                    flankDone = not yF,
                }
            else
            end
            kite.at = i
            runtimeState.kite = kite
            local SF, DF, yF, EF, JF = z.x + kite.ux * b, z.z + kite.uz * b, "beyond"
            if not kite.flankDone then
                b, B, hF =
                    z.x + kite.nx * kite.side * H,
                    z.z + kite.nz * kite.side * H,
                    (vector.X - z.x) * kite.ux + (vector.Z - z.z) * kite.uz
                if sqrt((vector.X - b) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - B) ^ 2) <= 6 or hF >= 0 then
                    kite.flankDone = true
                    EF, JF = SF, DF
                else
                    EF, JF, yF = b, B, "flank"
                end
            else
                EF, JF = SF, DF
            end
            b, H = tostring(F.model and F.model.Name or "mob"), sqrt((SF - vector.X) ^ 2 + (DF - vector.Z) ^ 2)
            if H <= (config.kiteArrive or 4) then
                runtimeState.kiteArriveAt = runtimeState.kiteArriveAt or i
                if
                    (
                            context.lastCastOk and context.lastCastOk()
                            or math.max(runtimeState.lastQ or -math.huge, runtimeState.lastE or -math.huge)
                        )
                        >= runtimeState.kiteArriveAt
                    or i - runtimeState.kiteArriveAt > (config.kiteHoldMax or 2)
                then
                    kite.doneAt = i
                    runtimeState.kiteArriveAt = nil
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    hold = true,
                    face = Vector3.new(z.x, vector.Y, z.z),
                    label = ("KITE: beyond the next group with %s behind it - all %d in front, holding for the shot"):format(
                        b,
                        z.n + cF
                    ),
                }
            end
            runtimeState.kiteArriveAt = nil
            return {
                point = Vector3.new(EF, vector.Y, JF),
                label = ("KITE: leading %s%s to the next group (%d mobs) - %s, %.0f to the spot"):format(
                    b,
                    cF > 1 and " +" .. cF - 1 or "",
                    z.n,
                    yF == "flank" and "round its side" or "past it",
                    H
                ),
            }
        end
        context.meleeExtra = function(enemy)
            if config.meleeWide == false or not (enemy and enemy.model) then
                return 0
            end
            local name = string.lower(enemy.model.Name)
            for key, extra in pairs(type(config.meleeWideNames) == "table" and config.meleeWideNames or {}) do
                if name:find(string.lower(key), 1, true) then
                    return tonumber(extra) or 0
                end
            end
            return 0
        end
        context.meleeEscapeDue = function(position)
            for _, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    enemy.melee
                    and not enemy.isBoss
                    and enemy.root
                    and enemy.root.Parent
                    and enemy.humanoid
                    and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                then
                    local enemyPosition = enemy.root.Position
                    local distance = sqrt((enemyPosition.X - position.X) ^ 2 + (enemyPosition.Z - position.Z) ^ 2)
                    if distance < (config.meleeEscapeAt or 36) + context.meleeExtra(enemy) then
                        return enemy, distance
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.meleeSwing = function(vector, F, i, b, B)
            if config.meleeSwing == false or not (F and F.root and F.root.Parent) then
                return nil
            end
            local z, H, QF = F.root.Position
            local SF, DF =
                context.groupSetFor and context.groupSetFor(F) or nil, context.BR and context.BR.target or nil
            DF = if DF == F
                    or not (DF and DF.root and DF.root.Parent and (DF.humanoid == nil or DF.humanoid.Health > 0))
                then nil
                else DF
            local cF = false
            if DF and config.swingToTarget ~= false then
                H, QF, cF = DF.root.Position.X, DF.root.Position.Z, true
            else
            end
            if config.swingToUntagged ~= false and runtimeState.sweeping == true and context.tagTarget then
                local hF, yF, EF = math.huge
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        enemy ~= F
                        and not enemy.isBoss
                        and enemy.root
                        and enemy.root.Parent
                        and enemy.humanoid
                        and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                        and context.tagTarget(enemy)
                    then
                        index = enemy.root.Position
                        local wF = (index.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (index.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2
                        if wF < hF then
                            hF, yF, EF = wF, index.X, index.Z
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if yF then
                    H, QF, cF = yF, EF, true
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if config.swingToMages ~= false then
                local hF, yF, EF, JF = (config.swingMageFrom or 70) ^ 2, 0, 0, 0
                for index2, enemy2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        enemy2 ~= F
                        and not enemy2.isBoss
                        and enemy2.root
                        and enemy2.root.Parent
                        and enemy2.humanoid
                        and enemy2.humanoid.Health > 0
                    then
                        index2 = enemy2.root.Position
                        local vF, MF = index2.X - z.X, index2.Z - z.Z
                        if vF * vF + MF * MF <= hF then
                            local isMage = enemy2.isMage
                            if
                                if not isMage and config.swingToIdle ~= false
                                    then not _F(enemy2, vector)
                                    else isMage
                            then
                                yF, EF, JF = yF + index2.X, EF + index2.Z, JF + 1
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if JF > 0 and not cF then
                    H, QF = yF / JF, EF / JF
                else
                    if hazardReader.mageMid and not cF then
                        H, QF = hazardReader.mageMid.x, hazardReader.mageMid.z
                    else
                    end
                end
                if H and not cF and config.swingMageStop ~= false then
                    local cF, yF = H - vector.X, QF - vector.Z
                    if cF * cF + yF * yF < (config.swingMageStopAt or 30) ^ 2 then
                        local cF, yF = z.X - H, z.Z - QF
                        hF = math.sqrt(cF * cF + yF * yF)
                        if hF > 1 then
                            H, QF = z.X + cF / hF * 30, z.Z + yF / hF * 30
                        else
                            H = nil
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                if config.swingSpearStop ~= false then
                    local cF, yF, EF = (config.swingSpearStopAt or 24) ^ 2
                    for index3, enemy3 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                        if
                            enemy3 ~= F
                            and enemy3 ~= DF
                            and enemy3.isSpear
                            and not enemy3.isBoss
                            and enemy3.root
                            and enemy3.root.Parent
                            and enemy3.humanoid
                            and enemy3.humanoid.Health > 0
                        then
                            hF = enemy3.root.Position
                            local DF, wF = hF.X - vector.X, hF.Z - vector.Z
                            index3 = DF * DF + wF * wF
                            if index3 < cF then
                                cF, yF, EF = index3, hF.X, hF.Z
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if yF then
                        local DF, cF = z.X - yF, z.Z - EF
                        local hF = math.sqrt(DF * DF + cF * cF)
                        if hF > 1 then
                            H, QF = z.X + DF / hF * 30, z.Z + cF / hF * 30
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not H then
                if SF and SF.home then
                    H, QF = SF.home[1], SF.home[3]
                else
                    local DF, cF, hF = 0, 0, 0
                    for index4, enemy4 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                        if
                            enemy4 ~= F
                            and enemy4.melee
                            and not enemy4.isBoss
                            and enemy4.root
                            and enemy4.root.Parent
                            and enemy4.humanoid
                            and enemy4.humanoid.Health > 0
                        then
                            local EF, JF = enemy4.root.Position.X - z.X, enemy4.root.Position.Z - z.Z
                            if EF * EF + JF * JF <= 3600 then
                                DF, cF, hF = DF + enemy4.root.Position.X, cF + enemy4.root.Position.Z, hF + 1
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    if hF > 0 then
                        DF /= hF
                        cF /= hF
                        local hF, yF = z.X - DF, z.Z - cF
                        local DF = math.sqrt(hF * hF + yF * yF)
                        if DF > 1 then
                            H, QF = z.X + hF / DF * 30, z.Z + yF / DF * 30
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not H then
                return nil
            end
            local DF, cF = vector.X - z.X, vector.Z - z.Z
            SF = math.sqrt(DF * DF + cF * cF)
            if SF < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            local hF, yF = H - z.X, QF - z.Z
            if hF * hF + yF * yF < 4 then
                return nil
            end
            z = math.atan2(cF, DF)
            local H = math.atan2(yF, hF) - z
            while H > 3.141592653589793 do
                H -= 6.283185307179586
            end
            while H <= -3.141592653589793 do
                H += 6.283185307179586
            end
            hF = math.abs(H)
            if hF < math.rad(config.meleeSwingDone or 20) then
                runtimeState.meleeSwing = nil
                return nil
            end
            yF = runtimeState.meleeSwing
