                        index4.untilAt, index4.madeAt, index4.volley, index4.pathStart, index4.from =
                            zone3.untilAt, zone3.madeAt, zone3.volley, zone3.pathStart, zone3.from
                    end
                end
                for key, entry in pairs(sF) do
                    if
                        (entry.untilAt or 0) < eF - (config.rodinLineMemVolley or 15)
                        or hazardReader.mlDoneVolley ~= nil
                            and entry.volley ~= nil
                            and entry.volley <= hazardReader.mlDoneVolley
                    then
                        sF[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                local TF
                for key2, entry2 in pairs(sF) do
                    if
                        (
                            (entry2.untilAt or 0) > eF - GF
                            or config.rodinLinesKeepVolley ~= false
                                and entry2.volley ~= nil
                                and (entry2.untilAt or 0) > eF - (config.rodinLineMemVolley or 15)
                        )
                        and (entry2.madeAt or 0) > zF
                        and (
                            hazardReader.mlDoneVolley == nil
                            or (entry2.volley or math.huge) > hazardReader.mlDoneVolley
                        )
                    then
                        BF[#BF + 1] = entry2
                        key2 = entry2.madeAt or entry2.pathStart or entry2.from or 0
                        if key2 > bF then
                            bF, TF = key2, entry2
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not CF then
                    for index5, zone4 in ipairs(hazardReader.zones) do
                        if
                            zone4.ox
                            and zone4.dx
                            and (zone4.untilAt or 0) > eF
                            and zone4.name == "sideways missile"
                            and zone4.moving
                        then
                            BF[#BF + 1] = zone4
                            GF = zone4.madeAt or zone4.pathStart or zone4.from or 0
                            if GF > bF then
                                bF, TF = GF, zone4
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                for key3, entry3 in pairs(CF and {} or hazardReader.parts) do
                    if key3.Parent and lowercase(key3.Name):find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) then
                        zF = sqrt(entry3.vx * entry3.vx + entry3.vz * entry3.vz)
                        if zF > 2 then
                            local position, tF, HF = key3.Position, entry3.vx / zF, entry3.vz / zF
                            sF, GF =
                                (vector.X - position.X) * tF + (vector.Z - position.Z) * HF,
                                config.rodinPassedFrac or 0.5
                            local bF, WF =
                                (2 * GF - 1) * ((config.missileHalfLen or 16) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)),
                                GF >= 1 and (config.rodinMissilePassed or 3)
                            if sF > -(bF + (WF or 0)) then
                                local bF = {
                                    ox = position.X,
                                    oz = position.Z,
                                    dx = tF,
                                    dz = HF,
                                }
                                BF[#BF + 1] = bF
                                TF = TF or bF
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                GF, zF = false, hazardReader.rodinSplit
                if zF and zF.model and zF.model.Parent and not zF.over then
                    sF = eF - zF.at
                    for index6 = 1, #F, 1 do
                        CF = F[index6] + (zF.shift or 0) - sF
                        GF = if CF > -0.2 and CF < (config.rodinMissileSplitGap or 3) then true else GF
                        GF = if config.rodinSplitOwns ~= false then true else GF
                    end
                else
                end
                zF = hazardReader.rodinFanAt
                CF = config.rodinFanOut ~= false
                    and zF ~= nil
                    and hazardReader.rodinFanYaw ~= nil
                    and eF - zF < (config.rodinFanFor or 5.5)
                if #BF > 0 and TF then
                    local bF = TF.dx
                    local WF = TF.dz
                    local TF, KF, tF, spd, XF = -WF, bF, config.missileLaneHalf or 5, config.burstMax or 28, {}
                    for index7, entry4 in ipairs(BF) do
                        if abs(entry4.dx * bF + entry4.dz * WF) > 0.96 then
                            XF[#XF + 1] = {
                                l = (entry4.ox - vector.X) * TF + (entry4.oz - vector.Z) * KF,
                                passed = (entry4.untilAt or 0) + (config.rodinPassedGrace or 0.3) <= eF,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(XF, function(BF, di)
                        return BF.l < di.l
                    end)
                    sF, zF = {}, {}
                    for index8, entry5 in ipairs(XF) do
                        if #sF == 0 or entry5.l - sF[#sF] > 2 then
                            index8 = #sF + 1
                            sF[index8], zF[index8] = entry5.l, entry5.passed
                        else
                            zF[#sF] = zF[#sF] and entry5.passed
                        end
                    end
                    if #sF > 0 then
                        local control, di, Qi = config.rodinMissileLinesFor or 99, #sF, 1
                        while di - Qi + 1 > control do
                            if abs(sF[Qi]) > abs(sF[di]) then
                                Qi = Qi + 1
                            else
                                di = di - 1
                            end
                        end
                        local hub, rin =
                            hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                            (config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - (config.rodinMissileWallGap or 8)
                        local Si = hub and (hub.X - vector.X) * TF + (hub.Z - vector.Z) * KF or nil
                        XF = hub and (hub.X - vector.X) * bF + (hub.Z - vector.Z) * WF or nil
                        local function set(Pi)
                            return Si == nil or abs(Pi - Si) < rin - 4
                        end
                        local side, pick =
                            tF + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinMissileSideOff or 5),
                            2 * tF + 2 * (config.missileLineBody or 1)
                        if config.rodinEdgeAtHalfGap ~= false then
                            control = {}
                            for index9 = 1, #sF - 1, 1 do
                                local ci = sF[index9 + 1] - sF[index9]
                                if ci >= pick then
                                    control[#control + 1] = ci
                                end
                            end
                            table.sort(control)
                            local li = #control > 0 and control[math.ceil(#control / 2)]
                                or (config.rodinLaneGap or 15)
                            side = max(tF + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + 0.5, li * 0.5)
                        else
                        end
                        local lines, ci = {}, {}
                        local function ui(hi, mi)
                            local Ri = #lines + 1
                            lines[Ri], ci[Ri] = hi, mi == true
                        end
                        if Qi == 1 and set(sF[1] - side) then
                            ui(sF[1] - side, zF[1])
                        end
                        for index10 = max(Qi - 1, 1), min(di, #sF - 1), 1 do
                            control = (sF[index10] + sF[index10 + 1]) * 0.5
                            if sF[index10 + 1] - sF[index10] >= pick and set(control) then
                                ui(control, zF[index10] and zF[index10 + 1])
                            end
                        end
                        if di == #sF and set(sF[#sF] + side) then
                            ui(sF[#sF] + side, zF[#sF])
                        end
                        control = false
                        if #lines > 0 then
                            if config.rodinLinesMine ~= false then
                                pick, ui, set =
                                    if runtimeState.missileLinePt
                                            and eF - (runtimeState.missileLineAt or -infinity)
                                                < (config.rodinMissileKeep or 2.5)
                                        then (runtimeState.missileLinePt.X - vector.X) * TF
                                            + (runtimeState.missileLinePt.Z - vector.Z) * KF
                                        else 0,
                                    infinity
                                for index11 = 1, #lines, 1 do
                                    local Qi = abs(lines[index11] - pick)
                                    if Qi < ui then
                                        ui, set = Qi, index11
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                                control = set ~= nil and ci[set]
                            else
                                for index12 = 1, #lines, 1 do
                                    control = if ci[index12] then true else control
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        if config.rodinLinesAllAtOnce == false then
                            set = {}
                            for index13 = 1, #lines, 1 do
                                if not ci[index13] then
                                    set[#set + 1] = lines[index13]
                                end
                            end
                            control, lines = #set < #lines, set
                        else
                        end
                        set = {}
                        for index14 = 1, #lines, 1 do
                            set[#set + 1] = lines[index14] - (Si or 0)
                        end
                        pick = runtimeState.mlPrevSet
                        if
                            pick
                            and not control
                            and #set > 0
                            and pick.volley == hazardReader.mlVolley
                            and eF - pick.at < 0.5
                        then
                            ui = 0
                            for index15, entry6 in ipairs(pick.set) do
                                index15 = false
                                for index16, entry7 in ipairs(set) do
                                    if abs(entry7 - entry6) < 2.5 then
                                        index15 = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                ui = if not index15 then ui + 1 else ui
                            end
                            if ui > 0 and #set < #pick.set then
                                contextLogT(
                                    "rodinlines",
                                    1,
                                    "Brain",
                                    ("%d green line(s) went on their own, %d left (lanes %d, volley %s) - not the all-at-once rule"):format(
                                        ui,
                                        #set,
                                        #sF,
                                        tostring(hazardReader.mlVolley)
                                    )
                                )
                                local di = runtimeState.perf and runtimeState.perf.cur
                                if di then
                                    di.railSolo = (di.railSolo or 0) + ui
                                    di.railSoloLast = {
                                        lost = ui,
                                        left = #set,
                                        lanes = #sF,
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        runtimeState.mlPrevSet = {
                            set = set,
                            at = eF,
                            volley = hazardReader.mlVolley,
                        }
                        if control and config.rodinLinesAllAtOnce ~= false then
                            lines = {}
                            runtimeState.mlPrevSet = nil
                            hazardReader.mlDoneAt, hazardReader.mlDoneVolley = eF, hazardReader.mlVolley
                            pick = runtimeState.perf and runtimeState.perf.cur
                            if pick then
                                pick.railAll = (pick.railAll or 0) + 1
                            end
                            hazardReader.missileLines = nil
                            if context.drawMissileLines then
                                pcall(context.drawMissileLines)
                            end
                            contextLogT(
                                "rodin",
                                2,
                                "Brain",
                                ("missile volley %s: both missiles beside our line are past - all the lines gone"):format(
                                    tostring(hazardReader.mlVolley)
                                )
                            )
                        else
                            if control and #lines == 0 then
                                hazardReader.mlDoneAt, hazardReader.mlDoneVolley = eF, hazardReader.mlVolley
                            end
                        end
                        ui, control =
                            config.rodinRailAlways == false and (sF[1] - side >= 0 or sF[#sF] + side <= 0), false
                        for index17, entry8 in ipairs(sF) do
                            control = if abs(entry8) < tF + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) then true else control
                        end
                        if #lines > 0 then
                            control, pick = not odinRings
                                and not iF
                                and not (GF and config.rodinRailSplitYield == true)
                                and not (CF and config.rodinRailFanYield == true)
                            if ui then
                                pick = 0
                            else
                                set = infinity
                                for index18, line in ipairs(lines) do
                                    set = if abs(line) < set then abs(line) else set
                                end
                                if
                                    runtimeState.missileLinePt
                                    and eF - (runtimeState.missileLineAt or -infinity)
                                        < (config.rodinMissileKeep or 2.5)
                                then
                                    local CF = (runtimeState.missileLinePt.X - vector.X) * TF
                                        + (runtimeState.missileLinePt.Z - vector.Z) * KF
                                    for index19, line2 in ipairs(lines) do
                                        index19 = runtimeState.railHop ~= nil
                                                and eF < (runtimeState.railHop.untilAt or 0)
                                            or runtimeState.spiralHop ~= nil
                                                and eF < (runtimeState.spiralHop.untilAt or 0)
                                        if
                                            abs(line2 - CF) < 3
                                            and (
                                                index19
                                                or abs(line2)
                                                    <= set + (config.rodinMissileKeepSlack or 6)
                                            )
                                        then
                                            pick = line2
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                if not pick then
                                    local CF, iF =
                                        context.BB ~= nil and context.BB.osc ~= nil, config.rodinMissileTie or 4
                                    local function GF(di)
                                        return -WF * di < -0.5 or abs(WF * di) <= 0.5 and bF * di < 0
                                    end
                                    local function di(Qi, Di)
                                        local ci, hi = -WF * Qi, -WF * Di
                                        return ci < hi - 0.5 or abs(ci - hi) <= 0.5 and bF * Qi < bF * Di
                                    end
                                    for index20, line3 in ipairs(lines) do
                                        if not pick then
                                            pick = line3
                                        else
                                            if CF then
                                                local CF, Di = GF(line3), GF(pick)
                                                pick = if CF and not Di
                                                        or CF == Di and abs(line3) < abs(pick)
                                                    then line3
                                                    else pick
                                            else
                                                pick = if abs(line3) < abs(pick) - iF
                                                        or abs(abs(line3) - abs(pick)) <= iF
                                                            and di(line3, pick)
                                                    then line3
                                                    else pick
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                if control then
                                    runtimeState.missileLinePt =
                                        Vector3.new(vector.X + TF * pick, vector.Y, vector.Z + KF * pick)
                                    runtimeState.missileLineAt = eF
                                end
                            end
                            hazardReader.missileLines = {
                                ax = bF,
                                az = WF,
                                nx = TF,
                                nz = KF,
                                bx = vector.X,
                                bz = vector.Z,
                                y = vector.Y,
                                lines = lines,
                                pick = control and not ui and pick or nil,
                                L = sF,
                                P = zF,
                                hw = tF,
                                at = eF,
                            }
                            railCalc.ax = bF
                            railCalc.az = WF
                            railCalc.nx = TF
                            railCalc.nz = KF
                            railCalc.hw = tF
                            railCalc.spd = spd
                            railCalc.L = sF
                            railCalc.P = zF
                            railCalc.hub = hub
                            railCalc.Rin = rin
                            railCalc.hl0 = Si
                            railCalc.ht0 = XF
                            railCalc.side = side
                            railCalc.lines = lines
                            railCalc.outside = ui
                            railCalc.control = control
                            railCalc.pick = pick
                            drawn = true
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            railCalc.odinRings = odinRings
            railCalc.drawn = drawn
            if not drawn then
                hazardReader.missileLines = nil
            end
            runtimeState.railCalc = railCalc
            return railCalc
        end
        context.railSlideGoal = function(eF, NF, IF, FF, CF, gF, iF, bF)
            local BF = NF.X + CF * iF
            local GF = NF.Z + gF * iF
            local function zF(sF, TF)
                return (sF - BF) * IF + (TF - GF) * FF, (sF - BF) * CF + (TF - GF) * gF
            end
            iF, NF = config.rodinRailSlideOrbLat or 12, runtimeState.greenTap
            if NF and NF.at == eF and NF.to then
                local IF, FF = zF(NF.to.X, NF.to.Z)
                if abs(FF) <= iF then
                    return {
                        t = IF,
                        why = "toward the green orb",
                    }
                end
            end
            NF = hazardReader.rodinGoodOrb
            eF = NF and NF.part and NF.part.Parent and NF.part.Position or nil
            if eF then
                local IF, FF = zF(eF.X, eF.Z)
                if abs(FF) <= iF then
                    return {
                        t = IF,
                        why = "toward the green orb",
                    }
                end
            end
            iF = bF and bF.isBoss and bF.root and bF.root.Parent and bF.root.Position or nil
            if not iF then
                return nil
            end
            bF = (
                context.rodinAttackReach and context.rodinAttackReach()
                or context.fireReach and context.fireReach()
                or (config.castStartAt or 44)
            ) - (config.rodinAggroSpare or 3)
            if bF < 8 then
                return nil
            end
            eF, NF = zF(iF.X, iF.Z)
            if abs(NF) >= bF then
                if config.rodinRailSlideNear == false then
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    t = eF,
                    why = "toward the boss (this line never comes into his reach)",
                }
            end
            zF, iF = sqrt(bF * bF - NF * NF), config.rodinRailBossMin or 10
            local IF, FF, CF = abs(NF) < iF and sqrt(iF * iF - NF * NF) or 0, { -1, 1 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(FF) do
                NF, bF = eF + entry * IF, eF + entry * zF
                entry, index = min(NF, bF), max(NF, bF)
                iF = 0 < entry and entry or (0 > index and index or 0)
                CF = if CF == nil or abs(iF) < abs(CF) then iF else CF
            end
            if CF == nil or abs(CF) < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            return {
                t = CF,
                why = "into the boss's reach",
            }
        end
        local function eF(NF)
            local missileLines = hazardReader.missileLines
            if
                config.rodinLaneRule == false
                or missileLines == nil
                or missileLines.L == nil
                or missileLines.P == nil
                or NF - (missileLines.at or -infinity) >= 0.3
            then
                return nil
            end
            return missileLines
        end
        context.missileLaneAt = function(NF, IF, FF)
            local CF = eF(FF)
            if not CF then
                return false
            end
            local FF, gF =
                (NF - CF.bx) * CF.nx + (IF - CF.bz) * CF.nz, (CF.hw or 5) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
            for index = 1, #CF.L, 1 do
                if not CF.P[index] and abs(FF - CF.L[index]) < gF then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.missileLaneCross = function(NF, IF, FF)
            local CF = eF(FF)
            if not CF then
                return false
            end
            if
                runtimeState.escRedAt ~= nil
                and FF - runtimeState.escRedAt < 0.25
                and config.rodinYellowFreeInRed ~= false
                and context.missileBodyCatch
            then
                return context.missileBodyCatch(NF, IF, config.burstMax or 28)
            end
            local gF, iF =
                (NF.X - CF.bx) * CF.nx + (NF.Z - CF.bz) * CF.nz, (IF.X - CF.bx) * CF.nx + (IF.Z - CF.bz) * CF.nz
            IF, FF, NF = min(gF, iF), max(gF, iF), (CF.hw or 5) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
            for index = 1, #CF.L, 1 do
                iF = CF.L[index]
                if not CF.P[index] and iF + NF > IF and iF - NF < FF and abs(gF - iF) >= NF then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function NF(IF, vector)
            local missileLines = hazardReader.missileLines
            if
                config.rodinRailStay == false
                or missileLines == nil
                or missileLines.pick == nil
                or IF - (missileLines.at or -infinity) >= 0.3
            then
                return nil
            end
            if
                abs(
                    (vector.X - missileLines.bx - missileLines.nx * missileLines.pick)
                            * missileLines.nx
                        + (vector.Z - missileLines.bz - missileLines.nz * missileLines.pick)
                            * missileLines.nz
                ) > (config.rodinRailOnTol or 2)
            then
                return nil
            end
            return missileLines
        end
        local function IF(FF, CF, missileLines)
            if config.rodinRailStay == false then
                return false
            end
            local rodinSweep = hazardReader.rodinSweep
            if rodinSweep and rodinSweep.model and rodinSweep.model.Parent then
                return false
            end
            if missileLines then
                return NF(FF, CF) ~= nil
            end
            missileLines = hazardReader.missileLines
            return missileLines ~= nil and missileLines.pick ~= nil and FF - (missileLines.at or -infinity) < 0.3
        end
        local function FF(CF, gF)
            if config.rodinRailPassedSide == false then
                return nil
            end
            local missileLines = hazardReader.missileLines
            if
                missileLines == nil
                or missileLines.pick == nil
                or missileLines.L == nil
                or missileLines.P == nil
                or CF - (missileLines.at or -infinity) >= 0.3
            then
                return nil
            end
            local bF, BF =
                (gF.X - missileLines.bx) * missileLines.nx + (gF.Z - missileLines.bz) * missileLines.nz,
                (missileLines.hw or 5) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
            gF, CF = BF + 0.5
            for index = 1, #missileLines.L, 1 do
                if missileLines.L[index] - BF >= bF and not missileLines.P[index] then
                    CF = missileLines.L[index] - BF
                    break
                end
            end
            local GF
            for index2 = #missileLines.L, 1, -1 do
                if missileLines.L[index2] + BF <= bF and not missileLines.P[index2] then
                    GF = missileLines.L[index2] + BF
                    break
                end
            end
            local BF, zF = missileLines.L[#missileLines.L], missileLines.L[1]
            return {
                ml = missileLines,
                a0 = bF,
                lo = min(if GF == nil then zF ~= nil and zF < bF and zF - gF or bF else GF, bF),
                hi = max(if CF == nil then BF ~= nil and BF > bF and BF + gF or bF else CF, bF),
            }
        end
        local function CF(gF)
            return gF ~= nil and (gF.hi - gF.a0 > 1.5 or gF.a0 - gF.lo > 1.5)
        end
        local function gF(iF, bF, BF)
            local GF = (bF - iF.ml.bx) * iF.ml.nx + (BF - iF.ml.bz) * iF.ml.nz
            return GF >= iF.lo - 0.01 and GF <= iF.hi + 0.01
        end
        local function contextMissileBodyCatch(vector, BF, GF, zF)
            local sF, TF, WF, KF =
                (config.missileLaneHalf or 5) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinHopMissilePad or 1),
                (config.missileHalfLen or 16) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8),
                BF.X - vector.X,
                BF.Z - vector.Z
            BF = sqrt(WF * WF + KF * KF)
            local tF = math.clamp(math.ceil(BF / 3), 1, 40)
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.parts or {}) do
                if key.Parent and string.lower(key.Name):find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) then
                    local di = sqrt((entry.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (entry.vz or 0) ^ 2)
                    if di > 2 then
                        local Qi, Li, position = entry.vx / di, entry.vz / di, key.Position
                        for index = 0, tF, 1 do
                            local di = index / tF
                            index = (zF or 0) + BF * di / max(GF, 1)
                            local BF, GF =
                                vector.X + WF * di - (position.X + entry.vx * index),
                                vector.Z + KF * di - (position.Z + entry.vz * index)
                            if abs(BF * Qi + GF * Li) <= TF and abs(-BF * Li + GF * Qi) <= sF then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.missileBodyCatch = contextMissileBodyCatch
        context.hopMissiles = function(bF)
            local BF = hazardReader.hopMissileCache
            if BF and BF.at == bF then
                return BF.list
            end
            local list, zF = {}, dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.zones or {}) do
                if
                    (entry.name == "missile path" or entry.name == "sideways missile" and entry.moving)
                    and entry.ox
                    and entry.dx
                    and entry.pathStart
                    and (entry.speed or 0) > 2
                then
                    list[#list + 1] = {
                        ox = entry.ox,
                        oz = entry.oz,
                        dx = entry.dx,
                        dz = entry.dz,
                        s = entry.speed,
                        off = entry.offset or 0,
                        ps = entry.pathStart,
                        hl = (entry.halfL or config.missileHalfLen or 16) + zF,
                    }
                end
            end
            for key, entry2 in pairs(hazardReader.parts or {}) do
                if key.Parent and string.lower(key.Name):find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) then
                    BF = math.sqrt((entry2.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (entry2.vz or 0) ^ 2)
                    if BF > 2 then
                        local position = key.Position
                        local sF, KF =
                            #list + 1, {
                                ox = position.X,
                                oz = position.Z,
                                dx = entry2.vx / BF,
                                dz = entry2.vz / BF,
                                s = BF,
                                off = 0,
                                ps = bF,
                            }
                        KF.hl, list[sF] = (config.missileHalfLen or 16) + zF, KF
                    end
                end
            end
            hazardReader.hopMissileCache = {
                at = bF,
                list = list,
            }
            return list
        end
        context.hopMissileGap = function(vector, BF, GF, zF, sF, TF, WF)
            local KF = dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8
            local tF, HF, XF, di =
                (config.missileLaneHalf or 5) + KF + (config.rodinHopMissilePad or 1),
                (config.missileLaneHalf or 5) + KF,
                BF.X - vector.X,
                BF.Z - vector.Z
            BF = math.sqrt(XF * XF + di * di)
            local Qi, Li, Oi, Si, Di, Pi =
                math.clamp(math.ceil(BF / 1.5), 2, 60),
                math.max(GF, 1),
                XF * TF + di * WF,
                math.huge,
                math.huge,
                math.huge
            for index, entry in ipairs(context.hopMissiles(sF)) do
                index = nil
                if math.abs(entry.dx * WF - entry.dz * TF) > 0.96 then
                    KF, GF = (entry.ox - vector.X) * TF + (entry.oz - vector.Z) * WF, Oi >= 0 and 1 or -1
                    local TF, WF = KF * GF, Oi * GF
                    index = if TF > 0 and TF < WF
                        then tF
                        else if TF >= WF
                            then TF - WF > HF + 0.5 and -1 or HF
                            else math.abs(KF) > HF and -1 or HF
                else
                    index = tF
                end
                if index > 0 then
                    for index2 = 0, Qi, 1 do
                        local TF = index2 / Qi
                        local WF, KF, tF =
                            (zF or 0) + BF * TF / Li, vector.X + XF * TF - entry.ox, vector.Z + di * TF - entry.oz
                        if math.abs(-KF * entry.dz + tF * entry.dx) <= index then
                            index2 = KF * entry.dx
                                + tF * entry.dz
                                - (entry.off + entry.s * math.max(sF + WF - entry.ps, 0))
                            if index2 > entry.hl then
                                TF = (index2 - entry.hl) / entry.s
                                if TF < Si then
                                    Si, Di = TF, index2 - entry.hl
                                else
                                end
                            else
                                if index2 < -entry.hl then
                                    local bF = (-entry.hl - index2) / entry.s
                                    Pi = if bF < Pi then bF else Pi
                                else
                                    return 0, 0, 0
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return Si, Di, Pi
        end
        context.spiralMissileOK = function(vector, vector2, GF, zF)
            local sF = hazardReader.missileLines
            if not (sF and sF.nx) then
                return true
            end
            local TF, WF, KF, tF, HF =
                sF.nx,
                sF.nz,
                max(GF or 28, 4),
                config.rodinSpiralMissileSpare or 0.5,
                config.rodinSpiralMissilePassed or 0.15
            for index, entry in ipairs(config.rodinSpiralHopSpeeds or { 0.7, 1, 1.3 }) do
                GF, index, sF = context.hopMissileGap(vector, vector2, KF * entry, 0, zF, TF, WF)
                if GF < tF or sF < HF then
                    return false
                end
            end
            sF = sqrt((vector2.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2) / KF
            return context.hopMissileGap(vector2, vector2, KF, sF, zF, TF, WF)
                >= (config.rodinSpiralMissileStay or 1.5)
        end
        local function bF(BF)
            return (BF.r0 or BF.R) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralPad or 0.5)
        end
        local function BF(GF, zF, sF)
            local TF = GF.pred and (config.rodinSpiralUnc or 0.3) or 0
            return GF.left - TF <= sF and GF.left + (config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45) + TF >= zF
        end
        local function GF(zF, sF, TF, WF)
            local KF = config.rodinSpiralStay or 1
            for index, entry in ipairs(zF) do
                index = bF(entry)
                if (sF - entry.x) ^ 2 + (TF - entry.z) ^ 2 < index * index and BF(entry, WF, WF + KF) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.rodinFrontAt = function(zF)
            local rodinFront = runtimeState.rodinFront
            if rodinFront and rodinFront.at == zF then
                return rodinFront.ok and rodinFront or nil
            end
            local TF = hazardReader.rodinRig
            local WF = TF and TF.Parent and (TF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or TF.PrimaryPart) or nil
            TF = WF and WF.CFrame.LookVector or nil
            local KF = TF and sqrt(TF.X * TF.X + TF.Z * TF.Z) or 0
            if KF < 0.2 then
                runtimeState.rodinFront = {
                    at = zF,
                    ok = false,
                }
                return nil
            end
            local tF, HF = TF.X / KF, TF.Z / KF
            if rodinFront and rodinFront.ok and zF - rodinFront.at < 1 then
                KF = min((zF - rodinFront.at) / (config.rodinFrontEase or 0.3), 1)
                local XF, di =
                    rodinFront.fx + (tF - rodinFront.fx) * KF, rodinFront.fz + (HF - rodinFront.fz) * KF
                TF = sqrt(XF * XF + di * di)
                if TF > 0.2 then
                    tF, HF = XF / TF, di / TF
                else
                    tF, HF = rodinFront.fx, rodinFront.fz
                end
            else
            end
            KF = WF.Position
            rodinFront = {
                at = zF,
                ok = true,
                x = KF.X,
                z = KF.Z,
                fx = tF,
                fz = HF,
            }
            runtimeState.rodinFront = rodinFront
            return rodinFront
        end
        context.rodinFrontGuard = function(vector, vector2, TF)
            if config.rodinFrontOnly == false then
                return vector2
            end
            local WF = context.rodinFrontAt(TF)
            if not WF then
                return vector2
            end
            if
                contextColourPinned(TF)
                or hazardReader.rodinZone ~= nil and hazardReader.rodinZone.active
                or (contextFanPinned(TF))
            then
                return vector2
            end
            local KF, tF = hazardReader.rodinSplit, hazardReader.rodinSweep
            if KF and KF.model and KF.model.Parent and not KF.over or tF and tF.model and tF.model.Parent then
                return vector2
            end
            local HF, XF, di = config.rodinFrontMargin or 3, config.rodinFrontMinR or 8, WF.fx
            local Qi = WF.fz
            local Li, Oi = -Qi, di
            local function Si(Di, Pi)
                local _i, li = Di - WF.x, Pi - WF.z
                return _i * di + li * Qi, _i * Li + li * Oi
            end
            local function Di(Pi, _i, li)
                return Vector3.new(WF.x + di * Pi + Li * _i, li, WF.z + Qi * Pi + Oi * _i)
            end
            KF, tF = Si(vector2.X, vector2.Z)
            local WF, di = Si(vector.X, vector.Z)
            Si = max(KF, HF)
            local Qi
            if Si * Si + tF * tF < XF * XF then
                if abs(tF) < 0.5 then
                    Si, Qi = (max(Si, XF)), tF
                else
                    local Li = sqrt(max(XF * XF - Si * Si, 0))
                    Qi = tF >= 0 and max(tF, Li) or min(tF, -Li)
                end
            else
                Qi = tF
            end
            local Li, Oi = XF + (config.rodinFrontRound or 2), math.rad(config.rodinFrontStepDeg or 40)
            local Pi, _i = max(Li, sqrt(WF * WF + di * di)), math.atan2(di, WF)
            Li = nil
            if WF < HF then
                local li = abs(di) > 0.5 and (di >= 0 and 1 or -1) or (Qi >= 0 and 1 or -1)
                local ci = (abs(di) > 0.5 and _i or li * 3.141592653589793) - li * Oi
                Li = Di(Pi * cos(ci), Pi * sin(ci), vector2.Y)
            else
                local li, ci = Si - WF, Qi - di
                local ui = li * li + ci * ci
                if ui > 1 then
                    local hi = math.clamp(-(WF * li + di * ci) / ui, 0, 1)
                    local ui, mi = WF + li * hi, di + ci * hi
                    if hi > 0 and hi < 1 and ui * ui + mi * mi < XF * XF then
                        local di = _i + math.clamp(math.atan2(Qi, Si) - _i, -Oi, Oi)
                        Li = Di(Pi * cos(di), Pi * sin(di), vector2.Y)
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if Li == nil and abs(Si - KF) < 0.05 and abs(Qi - tF) < 0.05 then
                return vector2
            end
            tF, WF = Li or Di(Si, Qi, vector2.Y), config.burstMax or 28
            XF, _i, HF =
                sqrt((tF.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (tF.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2) / max(WF, 4),
                hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                context.spiralList and context.spiralList(
                    TF,
                    (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5)
                ) or {}
            if
                _i
                    and (tF.X - _i.X) ^ 2 + (tF.Z - _i.Z) ^ 2 >= ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2
                or contextDangerAt(tF.X, vector.Y, tF.Z, XF) >= 0.5
                or #HF > 0 and not GF(HF, tF.X, tF.Z, XF)
                or context.missileLaneAt and context.missileLaneAt(tF.X, tF.Z, TF)
                or context.BB and context.BB.yellowAt and context.BB.yellowAt(tF.X, tF.Z, TF + XF)
                or context.redOrbNear and context.redOrbNear(tF, XF + 0.5)
                or context.BB
                    and context.BB.wayClear
                    and not context.BB.wayClear(vector, tF, WF, TF)
            then
                runtimeState.frontGuardSkipAt = TF
                return vector2
            end
            runtimeState.frontGuardAt, runtimeState.frontGuardWay = TF, Li ~= nil
            return tF
        end
        local function zF(vector, TF, WF, KF, vector2, vector3, XF, di, Qi, Li, path, Si)
            local Di = config.rodinSpiralGrid or 3
            local Pi = math.floor((config.rodinSpiralPathR or 48) / Di)
            local _i, forced, ci, ui =
                2 * Pi + 1,
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                config.rodinSpiralTight or 0.5,
                config.rodinSpiralSlack or 0.8
            local hi = config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45
            local mi = config.rodinSpiralUnc or 0.3
            local Ri = config.rodinSpiralStay or 1
            local yi, isSpiralBox = max(KF, 4), context.isSpiralBox
            local Vi, Ei, pi = vector.X, vector.Z, {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(WF) do
                KF, index = sqrt((entry.x - Vi) ^ 2 + (entry.z - Ei) ^ 2), (entry.r0 or entry.R) + forced + ci
                local Ji = KF < index
                    and (index - KF) / yi
                        > (entry.pred and entry.left - mi or max(entry.left, 0) * ui)
                if entry.left >= -hi and not Ji then
                    local Ji, wi = bF(entry), (entry.r0 or entry.R) + forced + ci + Di * 0.5
                    index = max(Ji, wi)
                    local Yi, vi, Mi =
                        math.ceil(index / Di) + 1,
                        math.floor((entry.x - Vi) / Di + 0.5),
                        math.floor((entry.z - Ei) / Di + 0.5)
                    for index2 = max(Mi - Yi, -Pi), min(Mi + Yi, Pi), 1 do
                        for index3 = max(vi - Yi, -Pi), min(vi + Yi, Pi), 1 do
                            local Yi, vi = Vi + index3 * Di - entry.x, Ei + index2 * Di - entry.z
                            local ni = Yi * Yi + vi * vi
                            if ni < index * index then
                                vi = (index2 + Pi) * _i + (index3 + Pi) + 1
                                Yi = pi[vi]
                                if not Yi then
                                    Yi = {}
                                    pi[vi] = Yi
                                else
                                end
                                Yi[#Yi + 1] = entry
                                Yi[#Yi + 1] = ni < wi * wi
                                Yi[#Yi + 1] = ni < Ji * Ji
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function ji(Ui, Ji, wi)
                local Yi = pi[Ui]
                if not Yi then
                    return true
                end
                for index4 = 1, #Yi, 3 do
                    if Yi[index4 + 1] then
                        Ui = Yi[index4]
                        if
                            not (
                                if Ui.pred
                                    then wi <= Ui.left - mi or Ji >= Ui.left + hi + mi
                                    else wi <= max(Ui.left, 0) * ui or Ji >= Ui.left + hi
                            )
                        then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local function Ui(Ji, wi)
                local Yi = pi[Ji]
                if not Yi then
                    return true
                end
                for index4 = 1, #Yi, 3 do
                    if Yi[index4 + 2] and BF(Yi[index4], wi, wi + Ri) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            local function Ri(Ji, wi, Yi)
                local vi = pi[Ji]
                if not vi then
                    return infinity
                end
                Ji = infinity
                for index4 = 1, #vi, 3 do
                    if vi[index4 + 1] then
                        local Zi = vi[index4]
                        local vi = Zi.pred and Zi.left - mi or Zi.left
                        Ji = if wi < vi and vi - Yi < Ji then vi - Yi else Ji
                    else
                    end
                end
                return Ji
            end
            local Ji = eF(TF)
            local eF, wi = Ji and (Ji.hw or 5) + forced or 0, {}
            if Ji then
                forced = (Vi - Ji.bx) * Ji.nx + (Ei - Ji.bz) * Ji.nz
                for index5 = 1, #Ji.L, 1 do
                    if abs(forced - Ji.L[index5]) < eF then
                        wi[index5] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            local Yi = {}
            local function vi(Mi, Zi, ni, fi, ri)
                if vector3 and (Zi - vector3.X) ^ 2 + (ni - vector3.Z) ^ 2 >= XF then
                    return nil
                end
                if Si and not gF(Si, Zi, ni) then
                    return nil
                end
                local HF = Yi[Mi]
                if HF == nil then
                    HF = contextDangerAt(Zi, vector.Y, ni, fi, nil, nil, isSpiralBox)
                    HF = if contextSweepHotAt(Zi, ni, TF + fi + 0.3, TF) then max(HF, 1) else HF
                    if Ji then
                        local TF = (Zi - Ji.bx) * Ji.nx + (ni - Ji.bz) * Ji.nz
                        for index4 = 1, #Ji.L, 1 do
                            if not Ji.P[index4] and not wi[index4] and abs(TF - Ji.L[index4]) < eF then
                                HF = -1
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    Yi[Mi] = HF
                else
                end
                if HF < 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                if di and #di > 0 and context.BB.orbArrive then
                    Mi = context.BB.orbArrive(Zi, ni, di)
                    if Mi < infinity and Mi >= fi - (config.rodinSpiralOrbPass or 0.7) and Mi <= ri + 0.1 then
                        return nil
                    end
                end
                return HF
            end
            local eF = config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5
            forced, ci, KF = config.rodinSpiralHitCost or 40, config.rodinUnionDangerCost or 30, Pi * _i + Pi + 1
            local travel, HF, XF, di, Si, Ji, wi, Mi, Zi, ni =
                {
                    [KF] = 0,
                }, {
                    [KF] = 0,
                }, {
                    [KF] = 0,
                }, {}, {}, {
                    [KF] = infinity,
                }, config.rodinSpiralMarginWant or 0.5, config.rodinSpiralMarginCost or 60, {
                    KF,
                }, { 0 }
            local function fi(ri, oi)
                local Ai = #Zi + 1
                Zi[Ai] = ri
                ni[Ai] = oi
                while Ai > 1 do
                    oi = math.floor(Ai / 2)
                    if ni[oi] <= ni[Ai] then
                        break
                    end
                    Zi[oi], Zi[Ai], ni[oi], ni[Ai] = Zi[Ai], Zi[oi], ni[Ai], ni[oi]
                    Ai = oi
                end
            end
            local function ri()
                local oi = #Zi
                if oi == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                local Ai, ki = Zi[1], ni[1]
                Zi[1], ni[1] = Zi[oi], ni[oi]
                Zi[oi] = nil
                ni[oi] = nil
                oi -= 1
                local xi = 1
                while true do
                    local ai, ei = 2 * xi, 2 * xi + 1
                    local Ni = if ai <= oi and ni[ai] < ni[xi] then ai else xi
                    Ni = if ei <= oi and ni[ei] < ni[Ni] then ei else Ni
                    if Ni == xi then
                        break
                    end
                    Zi[Ni], Zi[xi], ni[Ni], ni[xi] = Zi[xi], Zi[Ni], ni[xi], ni[Ni]
                    xi = Ni
                end
                return Ai, ki
            end
            local Zi, ni, oi, Ai, ki, xi =
                Li or config.rodinSpiralTravelW or 1.5, Di * 1.41421356, Di / yi, 0, infinity
            while true do
                local ai, ei = ri()
                if not ai then
                    break
                end
                if not Si[ai] then
                    Si[ai] = true
                    Ai += 1
                    if ei * Zi >= ki or Ai > (config.rodinSpiralPathMax or 4000) then
                        break
                    end
                    local Ai, Ni = (ai - 1) % _i - Pi, math.floor((ai - 1) / _i) - Pi
                    local Ii, Fi, Ci, gi = Vi + Ai * Di, Ei + Ni * Di, HF[ai], di[ai]
                    if
                        ai ~= KF
                        and Ui(ai, Ci / yi)
                        and (Yi[ai] or 0) <= eF
                        and not (path and gi ~= nil and gi ~= KF and Ui(gi, HF[gi] / yi) and (Yi[gi] or 0) <= eF)
                    then
                        local Ui, Yi =
                            ei * Zi + (vector2 and sqrt((vector2.X - Ii) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - Fi) ^ 2) or 0),
                            Ji[ai] or infinity
                        Ui = if Yi < wi then Ui + Mi * (wi - max(Yi, -1)) else Ui
                        if Ui < ki then
                            ki, xi = Ui, ai
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    for index6 = -1, 1, 1 do
                        for index7 = -1, 1, 1 do
                            if index7 ~= 0 or index6 ~= 0 then
                                Ii, Li = Ai + index7, Ni + index6
                                if Ii >= -Pi and Ii <= Pi and Li >= -Pi and Li <= Pi then
                                    Fi = (Li + Pi) * _i + (Ii + Pi) + 1
                                    if not Si[Fi] then
                                        gi = index7 ~= 0 and index6 ~= 0 and ni or Di
                                        local tF = Ci + gi
                                        local Si = max(tF - Di * 0.5, 0) / yi
                                        local Ui = vi(Fi, Vi + Ii * Di, Ei + Li * Di, Si, Si + oi)
                                        if Ui ~= nil then
                                            local Yi, vi = not ji(Fi, Si, Si + oi), Ui > eF
                                            if Qi or not Yi and not vi then
                                                local Zi
                                                Zi, forced = ei + gi, Yi and forced
                                                local Ai = Zi + (forced or 0) + (vi and ci * min(Ui, 2) or 0)
                                                if Ai < (travel[Fi] or infinity) then
                                                    travel[Fi], HF[Fi], XF[Fi] = Ai, tF, XF[ai] + (Yi and 1 or 0)
                                                    di[Fi] = ai
                                                    Ji[Fi] = min(Ji[ai] or infinity, (Ri(Fi, Si, Si + oi)))
                                                    fi(Fi, Ai)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not xi then
                return nil
            end
            path, Mi, Ri = {}, {}, xi
            while Ri and Ri ~= KF do
                ci, fi = (Ri - 1) % _i - Pi, math.floor((Ri - 1) / _i) - Pi
                table.insert(path, 1, Vector3.new(Vi + ci * Di, vector.Y, Ei + fi * Di))
                table.insert(Mi, 1, Ri)
                Ri = di[Ri]
            end
            if #path == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            forced = 0
            if XF[xi] > 0 then
                di = {}
                for index8 = 1, #Mi, 1 do
                    Ji = Mi[index8]
                    Qi, ji = max(HF[Ji] - Di * 0.5, 0) / yi, pi[Ji]
                    if ji then
                        for index9 = 1, #ji, 3 do
                            Li = ji[index9]
                            if ji[index9 + 1] and not di[Li] then
                                if
                                    not (
                                        if Li.pred
                                            then Qi + oi <= Li.left - mi or Qi >= Li.left + hi + mi
                                            else Qi + oi <= max(Li.left, 0) * ui or Qi >= Li.left + hi
                                    )
                                then
                                    di[Li] = true
                                    forced += 1
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            travel, ni = HF[xi], #path
            Ei, Ri, wi = ni >= 2 and path[ni - 1] or vector, path[ni], ni >= 2 and Mi[ni - 1] or nil
            Qi = (wi and HF[wi] or 0) / yi
            local function KF(tF, XF, di)
                return GF(WF, tF, XF, di) and contextDangerAt(tF, vector.Y, XF, di, nil, nil, isSpiralBox) <= eF
            end
            if not KF(Ei.X, Ei.Z, Qi) then
                ji, ri = Ri.X - Ei.X, Ri.Z - Ei.Z
                wi, ci, oi = sqrt(ji * ji + ri * ri), 0, 1
                for index10 = 1, 7, 1 do
                    HF = (ci + oi) * 0.5
                    if KF(Ei.X + ji * HF, Ei.Z + ri * HF, Qi + wi * HF / yi) then
                        oi = HF
                    else
                        ci = HF
                    end
                end
                Vi = math.min(oi + (config.rodinSpiralEdgeGap or 0.3) / math.max(wi, 0.01), 1)
                path[ni] = Vector3.new(Ei.X + ji * Vi, vector.Y, Ei.Z + ri * Vi)
                travel -= wi * (1 - Vi)
            else
            end
            return {
                path = path,
                travel = travel,
                forced = forced,
            }
        end
        local function eF(sF, vector, WF, KF)
            local tF, HF, XF = max(KF, 4), WF.X - vector.X, WF.Z - vector.Z
            WF = sqrt(HF * HF + XF * XF)
            if WF < 0.01 then
                return true
            end
            local di, Qi, Li, Oi, Si, Di, Pi, _i =
                HF / WF,
                XF / WF,
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                config.rodinSpiralTight or 0.5,
                config.rodinSpiralSlack or 0.8,
                config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45,
                config.rodinSpiralUnc or 0.3,
                (config.rodinSpiralGrid or 3) / tF
            for index, entry in ipairs(sF) do
                if entry.left >= -Di then
                    HF, XF, KF = (entry.r0 or entry.R) + Li + Oi, vector.X - entry.x, vector.Z - entry.z
                    index = XF * XF + KF * KF - HF * HF
                    if index >= 0 then
                        local sF = XF * di + KF * Qi
                        local TF = sF * sF - index
                        if TF > 0 then
                            local KF = sqrt(TF)
                            local TF, HF = max(-sF - KF, 0), min(-sF + KF, WF)
                            if TF <= HF then
                                local sF, KF = TF / tF, HF / tF + (HF >= WF - 0.01 and _i or 0)
                                if
                                    not (
                                        if entry.pred
                                            then KF <= entry.left - Pi or sF >= entry.left + Di + Pi
                                            else KF <= max(entry.left, 0) * Si or sF >= entry.left + Di
                                    )
                                then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function sF(TF, WF, KF, tF, HF, XF, di, Qi, Li, Oi)
            local Si = runtimeState.spiralPath
            if Si and WF - Si.at < (config.rodinSpiralReplan or 0.2) then
                while true do
                    local idx, path = Si.idx, Si.path
                    if not (idx <= #path and a(TF, Si.path[Si.idx]) < 2) then
                        break
                    end
                    Si.idx = Si.idx + 1
                end
                if Si.idx <= #Si.path then
                    if (Si.forced or 0) > 0 then
                        return {
                            q = Si.path[min(Si.idx + 1, #Si.path)],
                            travel = Si.travel,
                            forced = Si.forced,
                        }
                    end
                    for index = min(Si.idx + 3, #Si.path), Si.idx, -1 do
                        if eF(KF, TF, Si.path[index], tF) then
                            return {
                                q = Si.path[index],
                                travel = Si.travel,
                                forced = 0,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Si = zF(TF, WF, KF, tF, HF, XF, di, Qi, false, Li, Oi)
            Si = if not Si and config.rodinSpiralSoft ~= false
                then zF(TF, WF, KF, tF, HF, XF, di, Qi, true, Li, Oi)
                else Si
            if not Si then
                runtimeState.spiralPath = nil
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.spiralPath = {
                at = WF,
                path = Si.path,
                idx = 1,
                travel = Si.travel,
                forced = Si.forced,
            }
            Qi = Si.path[min(2, #Si.path)]
            if (Si.forced or 0) == 0 then
                Qi = Si.path[1]
                for index2 = min(4, #Si.path), 1, -1 do
                    if eF(KF, TF, Si.path[index2], tF) then
                        Qi = Si.path[index2]
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            return {
                q = Qi,
                travel = Si.travel,
                forced = Si.forced,
            }
        end
        local function TF(vector, KF, tF, HF, vector2, di, Qi, Li)
            local Oi, Si, Di = max(HF, 4), config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45
            for index = 0, 47, 1 do
                local _i = index / 48 * 2 * 3.141592653589793
                local li, ci = math.cos(_i), math.sin(_i)
                for index2 = 2, 60, 1 do
                    index, _i = vector.X + li * index2, vector.Z + ci * index2
                    if vector2 and (index - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (_i - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= di then
                        break
                    end
                    local XF
                    if Li then
                        XF = true
                        for index3, entry in ipairs(tF) do
                            index3 = bF(entry)
                            if
                                not entry.pred
                                and entry.left >= -Si
                                and (index - entry.x) ^ 2 + (_i - entry.z) ^ 2 < index3 * index3
                            then
                                XF = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        XF = GF(tF, index, _i, index2 / Oi)
                    end
                    if
                        XF
                        and (
                            Qi
                            or contextDangerAt(
                                    index,
                                    vector.Y,
                                    _i,
                                    index2 / Oi,
                                    nil,
                                    nil,
                                    context.isSpiralBox
                                )
                                <= (config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5)
                        )
                    then
                        local XF = Vector3.new(index, vector.Y, _i)
                        local danger = config.rodinSpiralSafeSide ~= false
                                and context.spiralWayDanger
                                and context.spiralWayDanger(vector, XF, HF, KF, tF)
                            or 0
                        Di = if Di == nil
                                or danger < Di.danger
                                or danger == Di.danger and index2 < Di.travel
                            then {
                                q = XF,
                                travel = index2,
                                danger = danger,
                            }
                            else Di
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            return Di
        end
        local function WF(vector, tF, HF, XF, di, Qi, vector2, Oi, Si)
            local Di, Pi, _i = max(XF, 4), Qi.bx + Qi.nx * Qi.pick, Qi.bz + Qi.nz * Qi.pick
            local li, ci, ui, hi, mi =
                (vector.X - Pi) * Qi.ax + (vector.Z - _i) * Qi.az, context.isSpiralBox, { 1, -1 }, infinity
            local Ri, yi = infinity
            local qi, Vi = infinity
            for index, entry in ipairs(ui) do
                for index2 = 2, Si, 2 do
                    XF = li + entry * index2
                    local pi, Ui = Pi + Qi.ax * XF, _i + Qi.az * XF
                    if vector2 and (pi - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (Ui - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= Oi then
                        break
                    end
                    index = index2 / Di
                    if
                        contextDangerAt(pi, vector.Y, Ui, index, nil, nil, ci)
                            <= (config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5)
                        and not contextSweepHotAt(pi, Ui, tF + index + 1, tF)
                        and context.railSplitOK(vector, pi, Ui, tF)
                    then
                        local Ji = Vector3.new(pi, vector.Y, Ui)
                        local forced, Yi =
                            context.spiralWalkBad(HF, vector, Ji, Di, 0, true), GF(HF, pi, Ui, index)
                        if forced == 0 and Yi then
                            local Ei = index2 * (config.rodinSpiralTravelW or 1.5)
                                + (di and sqrt((di.X - pi) ^ 2 + (di.Z - Ui) ^ 2) or 0)
                            if Ei < hi then
                                hi, mi =
                                    Ei, {
                                        q = Ji,
                                        travel = index2,
                                    }
                            else
                            end
                            break
                        end
                        if Yi and forced < Ri then
                            Ri, yi =
                                forced, {
                                    q = Ji,
                                    travel = index2,
                                    forced = forced,
                                }
                        else
                        end
                        if forced < qi then
                            qi, Vi =
                                forced, {
                                    q = Ji,
                                    travel = index2,
                                    forced = forced,
                                }
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            if mi or yi or Vi then
                return mi or yi or Vi
            end
            di, ci = { 1, -1 }
            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(di) do
                for index4 = 2, Si, 2 do
                    XF = li + entry2 * index4
                    ui, index3 = Pi + Qi.ax * XF, _i + Qi.az * XF
                    if vector2 and (ui - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (index3 - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= Oi then
                        break
                    end
                    if GF(HF, ui, index3, index4 / Di) and context.railSplitOK(vector, ui, index3, tF) then
                        if ci == nil or index4 < ci.travel then
                            local tF = Vector3.new(ui, vector.Y, index3)
                            ci = {
                                q = tF,
                                travel = index4,
                                forced = context.spiralWalkBad(HF, vector, tF, Di, 0, true),
                            }
                        else
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            return ci
        end
        local function KF(vector, HF, XF, di, Qi, Li, vector2, Si, Di, Pi)
            local _i = max(di, 4)
            local function li(ci)
                return ci.forced
                        and ci.forced > 0
                        and (", along the green line - nowhere clean along it, the fewest circles going off (%d)"):format(
                            ci.forced
                        )
                    or ", along the green line (the rails' rules)"
            end
            local ci, ui = WF(vector, HF, XF, di, Qi, Li, vector2, Si, Di), config.rodinRailLineFar or 200
            if Pi and ui > Di and not (ci and GF(XF, ci.q.X, ci.q.Z, ci.travel / _i)) then
                local hi = WF(vector, HF, XF, di, Qi, Li, vector2, Si, ui)
                if hi and GF(XF, hi.q.X, hi.q.Z, hi.travel / _i) then
                    return hi, li(hi) .. ", the nearest way out of the spiral along it"
                end
            end
            if ci then
                return ci, (li(ci))
            end
            if not Pi then
                li = TF(vector, HF, XF, di, vector2, Si, true, true)
                if li then
                    return li, ", the shortest way off the red - nowhere along the green line gets out of it"
                end
                return nil
            end
            Pi, Qi, _i = config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45, Li.bx + Li.nx * Li.pick, Li.bz + Li.nz * Li.pick
            di, Di, li = (vector.X - Qi) * Li.ax + (vector.Z - _i) * Li.az, { 1, -1 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(Di) do
                for index2 = 2, ui, 2 do
                    index = di + entry * index2
                    local di, ui = Qi + Li.ax * index, _i + Li.az * index
                    if vector2 and (di - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (ui - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= Si then
                        break
                    end
                    ci = true
                    for index3, entry2 in ipairs(XF) do
                        index3 = bF(entry2)
                        if
                            not entry2.pred
                            and entry2.left >= -Pi
                            and (di - entry2.x) ^ 2 + (ui - entry2.z) ^ 2 < index3 * index3
                        then
                            ci = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if ci and context.railSplitOK(vector, di, ui, HF) then
                        li = if li == nil or index2 < li.travel
                            then {
                                q = Vector3.new(di, vector.Y, ui),
                                travel = index2,
                            }
                            else li
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if li then
                return li, ", along the green line - the nearest way off the red along it"
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function WF(vector, HF, XF, di, Qi)
            local Li, Oi, isSpiralBox, arenaCentre, Pi, _i, li =
                max(di, 4),
                config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5,
                context.isSpiralBox,
                hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - (config.rodinMissileWallGap or 8)) ^ 2,
                Qi.bx + Qi.nx * Qi.pick,
                Qi.bz + Qi.nz * Qi.pick
            local ci, ui, hi, mi = (vector.X - _i) * Qi.ax + (vector.Z - li) * Qi.az, { 1, -1 }, infinity
            local Ri, yi = infinity
            for index, entry in ipairs(ui) do
                for index2 = 2, config.rodinRailSlideFar or 90, 2 do
                    index = ci + entry * index2
                    local ci, Vi = _i + Qi.ax * index, li + Qi.az * index
                    if arenaCentre and (ci - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (Vi - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= Pi then
                        break
                    end
                    di = index2 / Li
                    local Qi = contextDangerAt(ci, vector.Y, Vi, di, nil, nil, isSpiralBox)
                    Qi = if contextSweepHotAt(ci, Vi, HF + di + 1, HF) then max(Qi, 1) else Qi
                    Qi = if not GF(XF, ci, Vi, di) then Qi + 1 else Qi
                    Qi = if not context.railSplitOK(vector, ci, Vi, HF) then infinity else Qi
                    local HF = Vector3.new(ci, vector.Y, Vi)
                    if Qi <= Oi then
                        ci = #XF > 0 and context.spiralWalkBad(XF, vector, HF, Li, 0, true) or 0
                        if ci < hi or ci == hi and index2 < mi.travel then
                            hi, mi =
                                ci, {
                                    q = HF,
                                    travel = index2,
                                    clear = true,
                                }
                        else
                        end
                        break
                    end
                    if Qi < Ri then
                        Ri, yi =
                            Qi, {
                                q = HF,
                                travel = index2,
                            }
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            return mi or yi
        end
        context.spiralAround = function(tF, HF, goal, di)
            if
                config.rodinSpiralAround == false
                or not goal
                or not (context.spiralList and hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
            then
                return nil
            end
            local Qi = context.spiralList(HF, (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5))
            if #Qi == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local Li = runtimeState.spiralAround
            if Li and HF - Li.at < (config.rodinSpiralReplan or 0.2) and a(Li.goal, goal) < 3 then
                while true do
                    local idx, path = Li.idx, Li.path
                    if not (idx <= #path and a(tF, Li.path[Li.idx]) < 2) then
                        break
                    end
                    Li.idx = Li.idx + 1
                end
                if Li.idx <= #Li.path then
                    for index = min(Li.idx + 3, #Li.path), Li.idx, -1 do
                        if eF(Qi, tF, Li.path[index], di) then
                            return Li.path[index]
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Li = zF(
                tF,
                HF,
                Qi,
                di,
                goal,
                hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2,
                context.BB and context.BB.blueBeams and context.BB.blueBeams() or nil,
                false,
                config.rodinSpiralAroundW or 0.3,
                nil,
                FF(HF, tF)
            )
            if not Li or #Li.path == 0 or a(Li.path[#Li.path], goal) >= a(tF, goal) - 1 then
                runtimeState.spiralAround = nil
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.spiralAround = {
                at = HF,
                path = Li.path,
                idx = 1,
                goal = goal,
            }
            goal = Li.path[1]
            for index2 = min(4, #Li.path), 1, -1 do
                if eF(Qi, tF, Li.path[index2], di) then
                    goal = Li.path[index2]
                    break
                end
            end
            return goal
        end
        local function eF(tF, HF, XF, di, Qi, Li, Oi, Si, Di)
            local Pi = runtimeState[tF]
            if Pi and XF - Pi.at < (config.rodinSpiralReplan or 0.2) then
                while true do
                    local idx, path = Pi.idx, Pi.path
                    if not (idx <= #path and a(HF, Pi.path[Pi.idx]) < 2) then
                        break
                    end
                    Pi.idx = Pi.idx + 1
                end
                if Pi.idx <= #Pi.path then
                    return Pi.path[min(Pi.idx + 1, #Pi.path)], Pi
                end
            end
            local _i = not Di and zF(HF, XF, di, Qi, nil, Li, Oi, nil, false, nil, nil, Si) or nil
            _i = if not _i then (zF(HF, XF, di, Qi, nil, Li, Oi, nil, true, nil, nil, Si)) else _i
            if not _i then
                runtimeState[tF] = nil
                return nil
            end
            Pi = {
                at = XF,
                path = _i.path,
                idx = 1,
                travel = _i.travel,
                forced = _i.forced,
            }
            runtimeState[tF] = Pi
            return _i.path[min(2, #_i.path)], Pi
        end
        local function tF(HF, vector)
            if
                config.rodinSpiralFirst == false
                or not (context.spiralList and hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
            then
                return false
            end
            if
                runtimeState.spiralOut
                and runtimeState.spiralOut.coveredAt
                and HF - runtimeState.spiralOut.coveredAt < 0.25
            then
                return true
            end
            local di, Qi =
