                context.spiralList(HF, (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5)),
                config.rodinSpiralEngage or 1
            for index, entry in ipairs(di) do
                if
                    (not entry.pred or entry.left <= Qi)
                    and (vector.X - entry.x) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - entry.z) ^ 2 < entry.R * entry.R
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function HF(XF)
            local di = XF and XF.name
            return not (di == "bonusbosslongline" or di == "rodin line next")
        end
        local function XF(di)
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not arenaCentre then
                return nil
            end
            if not hazardReader.rodinSpawnPt then
                local bonusBossPlayerSpawnPart = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("bonusBossPlayerSpawnPart")
                if bonusBossPlayerSpawnPart then
                    hazardReader.rodinSpawnPt = bonusBossPlayerSpawnPart.Position
                end
            end
            local Li = hazardReader.rodinSpawnPt
            local Oi, Si =
                (Li and math.atan2(Li.Z - arenaCentre.Z, Li.X - arenaCentre.X) or math.rad(
                    config.rodinEntranceDeg or 161
                )) + math.rad(config.rodinFlameStandDeg or -28.9),
                config.rodinFlameStandR or 86
            local Di, Pi, rodinFlamePlaced =
                arenaCentre.X + math.cos(Oi) * Si,
                arenaCentre.Z + math.sin(Oi) * Si,
                hazardReader.rodinFlamePlaced
            if rodinFlamePlaced and rodinFlamePlaced.x then
                Oi, Si, Li =
                    (config.rodinFlameDiaReal or 35) * 0.5
                        + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
                        + (config.rodinFlameLeaveGap or 4),
                    Di - rodinFlamePlaced.x,
                    Pi - rodinFlamePlaced.z
                local li = sqrt(Si * Si + Li * Li)
                if li < Oi + 1 then
                    if li < 0.5 then
                        Si, Li = arenaCentre.X - rodinFlamePlaced.x, arenaCentre.Z - rodinFlamePlaced.z
                        li = max(sqrt(Si * Si + Li * Li), 0.5)
                    else
                    end
                    Di, Pi = rodinFlamePlaced.x + Si / li * (Oi + 2), rodinFlamePlaced.z + Li / li * (Oi + 2)
                else
                end
            else
            end
            return Vector3.new(Di, di or 0, Pi)
        end
        local function di(vector, Li, Oi, Si, Di, vector2)
            local arenaCentre, li, ci =
                hazardReader.arenaCentre, ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2, hazardReader.rodinSweep
            local ui = config.touchLanesAsOne ~= false
                and ci ~= nil
                and ci.model ~= nil
                and ci.model.Parent ~= nil
                and not runtimeState.touchdownOn
            local hi, mi, Ri, yi, qi, Vi =
                ui and context.BB.blueBeamsLong and context.BB.blueBeamsLong(config.touchLaneHold or 4.4) or Oi,
                config.beamEscapeWays or 32,
                ui and (config.touchBeamFar or 60) or (config.beamEscapeFar or 40),
                {},
                {},
                context.BB.orbArrive and context.BB.orbArrive(vector.X, vector.Z, Oi) or 0
            local function spare(pi, ji, Ui)
                return contextDangerAt(pi, vector.Y, ji, Ui, 1, 0.5) < 0.5
                    and contextDangerAt(pi, vector.Y, ji, Ui + 0.6, 1, 0.5) < 0.5
                    and not contextSweepHotAt(pi, ji, Li + Ui + 0.5, Li)
            end
            for index = 0, mi - 1, 1 do
                ci = index * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / mi
                index, ui = math.cos(ci), math.sin(ci)
                local ji
                for index2 = 2, Ri, 2 do
                    local Ri, Ji = vector.X + index * index2, vector.Z + ui * index2
                    if arenaCentre and (Ri - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (Ji - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= li then
                        break
                    end
                    local _i = index2 / Si
                    if not context.BB.onBlueBeam(Ri, Ji, 0.5, hi) then
                        if spare(Ri, Ji, _i) then
                            local cost = index2
                                + (
                                    vector2
                                        and (sqrt((vector2.X - Ri) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - Ji) ^ 2) - a(
                                            vector,
                                            vector2
                                        )) * (config.blueBeamGoalW or 0.3)
                                    or 0
                                )
                            cost = if Di then cost + YF(Di, Ri, Ji) else cost
                            cost = if context.BB.yellowAt
                                    and context.BB.yellowAt(Ri, Ji, Li + _i, hi)
                                then cost + (config.rodinYellowCost or 1000)
                                else cost
                            local Li, Pi = #yi + 1, {}
                            Pi.q, Pi.d, Pi.cost, yi[Li] = Vector3.new(Ri, vector.Y, Ji), index2, cost, Pi
                            break
                        end
                    else
                        if context.BB.orbArrive then
                            local spare2 = context.BB.orbArrive(Ri, Ji, Oi) - _i
                            ji = if spare2 >= (config.beamThroughSpare or 0.8)
                                    and spare2 > Vi + 0.3
                                    and (not ji or spare2 > ji.spare)
                                    and spare(Ri, Ji, _i)
                                then {
                                    q = Vector3.new(Ri, vector.Y, Ji),
                                    d = index2,
                                    spare = spare2,
                                }
                                else ji
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ji then
                    qi[#qi + 1] = ji
                end
            end
            table.sort(yi, function(Li, Pi)
                return Li.cost < Pi.cost
            end)
            for index3 = 1, min(#yi, config.beamEscapeTry or 16), 1 do
                ci = yi[index3]
                if
                    not context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, ci.q, Si)
                    and context.BB.orbPathSafe(vector, ci.q, Si)
                then
                    return ci, "clear"
                end
            end
            table.sort(qi, function(Li, Pi)
                return Li.spare > Pi.spare
            end)
            for index4 = 1, min(#qi, config.beamThroughTry or 8), 1 do
                Di = qi[index4]
                if
                    not context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, Di.q, Si)
                    and context.BB.orbPathSafe(vector, Di.q, Si)
                then
                    return Di, "through"
                end
            end
            if config.beamEscapeForced ~= false then
                Di, mi = {
                    qi,
                    yi,
                }
                for index5, entry in ipairs(Di) do
                    for index6 = 1, #entry, 1 do
                        ui = entry[index6]
                        spare = ui.spare
                        spare = (
                            if not spare and context.BB.orbArrive
                                then context.BB.orbArrive(ui.q.X, ui.q.Z, Oi) - ui.d / Si
                                else spare
                        ) or 0
                        mi = if (not mi or spare > mi.spare)
                                and not context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, ui.q, Si)
                            then {
                                q = ui.q,
                                d = ui.d,
                                spare = spare,
                            }
                            else mi
                    end
                end
                if mi then
                    return mi, "forced"
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.isSpiralBox = function(Qi)
            return Qi ~= nil and Qi.name == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame"
        end
        context.spiralArms = function(Qi, vector)
            local spiralArms = hazardReader.spiralArms
            if not spiralArms or spiralArms.rig ~= hazardReader.rodinRig then
                spiralArms = {
                    list = {},
                    n = 0,
                    rig = hazardReader.rodinRig,
                }
                hazardReader.spiralArms = spiralArms
            else
            end
            if spiralArms.at == Qi then
                return spiralArms.list
            end
            spiralArms.at = Qi
            local Si = {}
            for key, model in pairs(hazardReader.models) do
                if model.name == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame" and not model.spArm and key.Parent then
                    local Di = model.pc or model.hb
                    if Di and Di.Parent then
                        local position = Di.Position
                        local li, ci = position.X - vector.X, position.Z - vector.Z
                        Si[#Si + 1] = {
                            rec = model,
                            x = position.X,
                            z = position.Z,
                            rad = math.sqrt(li * li + ci * ci),
                            ang = math.atan2(ci, li),
                            r0 = math.max(Di.Size.Y, Di.Size.Z) * 0.5,
                            spawn = model.spawn or Qi,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if #Si > 1 then
                table.sort(Si, function(Di, Pi)
                    if Di.spawn ~= Pi.spawn then
                        return Di.spawn < Pi.spawn
                    end
                    return Di.rad < Pi.rad
                end)
            end
            local Di, Pi = config.rodinArmLinkD or 24, config.rodinArmLinkT or 0.4
            for index, entry in ipairs(Si) do
                local Si, ci = Di
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(spiralArms.list) do
                    index = entry2.head
                    index2 = entry.spawn - index.spawn
                    if index2 >= -0.05 and index2 <= Pi then
                        local ui = math.sqrt((entry.x - index.x) ^ 2 + (entry.z - index.z) ^ 2)
                        if ui <= Si then
                            Si, ci = ui, entry2
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if ci then
                    Si = ci.head
                    local _i = entry.ang - Si.ang
                    entry.th = Si.th
                        + (
                            if _i > 3.141592653589793
                                then _i - 6.283185307179586
                                else if _i < -3.141592653589793 then _i + 6.283185307179586 else _i
                        )
                    if not ci.sign and math.abs(entry.th - ci.first.th) > 0.05 then
                        ci.sign = entry.th > ci.first.th and 1 or -1
                    end
                    if not ci.sign or (entry.th - Si.th) * ci.sign >= 0 then
                        ci.head = entry
                    end
                    ci.n = ci.n + 1
                else
                    entry.th = entry.ang
                    spiralArms.n = spiralArms.n + 1
                    ci = {
                        id = spiralArms.n,
                        first = entry,
                        head = entry,
                        n = 1,
                    }
                    spiralArms.list[#spiralArms.list + 1] = ci
                end
                entry.rec.spArm = ci.id
            end
            local Si, _i, li, ci, list =
                config.rodinSpiralLook or 2.5,
                config.rodinArmGrow or 3,
                config.rodinArmEndR or 108,
                config.rodinSpiralDet or 0.85,
                {}
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(spiralArms.list) do
                Pi, index3 = entry3.head, entry3.first
                entry3.live = entry3.sign ~= nil
                    and Qi - Pi.spawn <= (config.rodinArmIdle or 0.35)
                    and Pi.rad < li - 2
                if Qi - Pi.spawn <= ci + 1.5 then
                    list[#list + 1] = entry3
                end
                Di = (Pi.th - index3.th) * (entry3.sign or 1)
                _i = Di > 1.5 and math.clamp((Pi.rad - index3.rad) / Di, 2, 4.5) or _i
                local Ri, pred = Di * (Pi.rad + index3.rad) * 0.5, Pi.spawn - index3.spawn
                entry3.b = _i
                entry3.s = entry3.n >= 8 and Ri > 20 and math.clamp(Ri / (entry3.n - 1), 7, 15)
                    or (config.rodinArmStep or 10.9)
                entry3.vp = pred > 0.4 and Ri > 20 and math.clamp(Ri / pred, 90, 260)
                    or (config.rodinArmSpeed or 165)
                pred = {}
                if entry3.live then
                    local rad, hi, spawn, qi = Pi.rad, Pi.th, Pi.spawn, entry3.s / entry3.vp
                    for index4 = 1, 400, 1 do
                        index4 = entry3.s / math.sqrt(rad * rad + _i * _i)
                        hi += entry3.sign * index4
                        rad += _i * index4
                        spawn += qi
                        if rad > li or spawn > Qi + Si then
                            break
                        end
                        if spawn + ci >= Qi - 0.05 then
                            pred[#pred + 1] = {
                                x = vector.X + rad * math.cos(hi),
                                z = vector.Z + rad * math.sin(hi),
                                r0 = Pi.r0,
                                det = spawn + ci,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
                entry3.pred = pred
            end
            spiralArms.list = list
            return list
        end
        context.spiralFront = function(Qi, Li)
            if not Qi.live then
                return nil
            end
            local Oi = (Li - Qi.head.th) * Qi.sign % 6.283185307179586
            Li = Qi.head.rad + (Qi.b or 3) * Oi
            if Li > (config.rodinArmEndR or 108) + (Qi.head.r0 or 8.5) then
                return nil
            end
            return Li
        end
        context.spiralList = function(Qi, Li)
            local spiralListCache = hazardReader.spiralListCache
            if spiralListCache and spiralListCache.at == Qi then
                local Si = spiralListCache.byM[Li]
                if Si then
                    return Si
                end
            else
                spiralListCache = nil
            end
            local Si, Di, Pi = {}, config.rodinSpiralDet or 0.85, config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45
            for key, model in pairs(hazardReader.models) do
                if model.name == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame" then
                    local ci = model.pc or model.hb
                    if key.Parent and ci and ci.Parent and ci.Transparency < 0.9 then
                        local position, hi = ci.Position, math.max(ci.Size.Y, ci.Size.Z) * 0.5
                        model.spX, model.spZ = position.X, position.Z
                        model.spR0 = hi
                        local left = (model.spawn or Qi) + Di - Qi
                        if left >= -Pi or config.rodinSpiralKeepStale == true then
                            Si[#Si + 1] = {
                                x = position.X,
                                z = position.Z,
                                R = hi + Li,
                                r0 = hi,
                                left = left,
                                arm = model.spArm,
                            }
                        end
                    elseif model.spX and not key.Parent and config.rodinSpiralKeepGone ~= false then
                        local left2 = (model.spawn or Qi) + Di - Qi
                        if left2 >= -Pi then
                            Si[#Si + 1] = {
                                x = model.spX,
                                z = model.spZ,
                                R = model.spR0 + Li,
                                r0 = model.spR0,
                                left = left2,
                                arm = model.spArm,
                                ghost = true,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Di = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if
                config.rodinSpiralForecast == true
                and config.rodinSpiralArms ~= false
                and Di
                and hazardReader.rodinRig
                and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent
            then
                for index, entry in ipairs(context.spiralArms(Qi, Di)) do
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(entry.pred) do
                        Si[#Si + 1] = {
                            x = entry2.x,
                            z = entry2.z,
                            R = entry2.r0 + Li,
                            r0 = entry2.r0,
                            left = entry2.det - Qi,
                            pred = true,
                            arm = entry.id,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            if not spiralListCache then
                spiralListCache = {
                    at = Qi,
                    byM = {},
                }
                hazardReader.spiralListCache = spiralListCache
            else
            end
            spiralListCache.byM[Li] = Si
            return Si
        end
        context.spiralWalkBad = function(Qi, vector, Oi, Si, Di, Pi, _i)
            local li, ci, ui, hi = math.max(Si or 28, 4), Di or 0, Oi.X - vector.X, Oi.Z - vector.Z
            Oi, Si, Di = math.sqrt(ui * ui + hi * hi), 0, 0
            if Oi > 0.01 then
                Si, Di = ui / Oi, hi / Oi
            else
            end
            local mi, Ri, yi, qi, Vi =
                Pi and (config.rodinSpiralSlackTight or 0.95) or (config.rodinSpiralSlack or 0.8),
                config.rodinSpiralGone or 0.45,
                config.rodinSpiralUnc or 0.3,
                dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8,
                0
            for index, entry in ipairs(Qi) do
                index, hi, ui =
                    Pi and (entry.r0 or entry.R) + qi + (config.rodinSpiralTight or 0.5) or entry.R,
                    vector.X - entry.x,
                    vector.Z - entry.z
                local Qi, Li = hi * Si + ui * Di, hi * hi + ui * ui - index * index
                index = Qi * Qi - Li
                if index > 0 then
                    Li = math.sqrt(index)
                    local Si, Di = math.max(-Qi - Li, 0), math.min(-Qi + Li, Oi)
                    if Si <= Di then
                        local Qi, Li =
                            Si <= 0 and 0 or ci + Si / li, Di >= Oi - 0.01 and math.huge or ci + Di / li
                        if
                            not (
                                if entry.pred
                                    then Li <= entry.left - yi or Qi >= entry.left + Ri + yi
                                    else Li <= math.max(entry.left, 0) * mi or Qi >= entry.left + Ri
                            )
                        then
                            Vi += 1
                            if _i and Vi >= _i then
                                return Vi
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return Vi
        end
        context.missileHit = function(vector, vector2, Oi, Si)
            local Di, Pi, _i, li =
                (config.missileLaneHalf or 5) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinHopMissilePad or 1),
                (config.missileHalfLen or 16) + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8),
                vector2.X - vector.X,
                vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local ci = math.sqrt(_i * _i + li * li)
            local ui, hi, mi = math.clamp(math.ceil(ci / 3), 1, 40), math.max(Oi or 28, 1), Si or 0
            for key, part in pairs(hazardReader.parts) do
                if key.Parent and string.lower(key.Name):find("thirdbossmissile", 1, true) then
                    Oi, Si = part.vx or 0, part.vz or 0
                    local yi = math.sqrt(Oi * Oi + Si * Si)
                    if yi > 2 then
                        local qi, Vi, Ei = Oi / yi, Si / yi, key.Position
                        for index = 0, ui, 1 do
                            local yi = index / ui
                            index = mi + ci * yi / hi
                            local ui, pi =
                                vector.X + _i * yi - (Ei.X + Oi * index), vector.Z + li * yi - (Ei.Z + Si * index)
                            if math.abs(ui * qi + pi * Vi) <= Pi and math.abs(-ui * Vi + pi * qi) <= Di then
                                return index
                            end
                        end
                        local Qi, _i =
                            vector2.X - (Ei.X + Oi * (mi + ci / hi)), vector2.Z - (Ei.Z + Si * (mi + ci / hi))
                        Ei = Qi * qi + _i * Vi
                        if math.abs(-Qi * Vi + _i * qi) <= Di and Ei > -Pi then
                            return mi + ci / hi
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.missileClearIn = function(Qi, Li, Oi, Si)
            local Di, Pi = Si or 2, 0
            while Pi <= Di + 1.0E-6 do
                if not context.missileHit(Qi, Li, Oi, Pi) then
                    return Pi
                end
                Pi += 0.1
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.spiralRedOn = function(Qi, Li, Oi, Si)
            local Di = context.BB
            if not (Di and Di.pathTouchesRed) then
                return false
            end
            if
                not (hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
                or config.rodinSpiralTimedWalks == false
            then
                return Di.pathTouchesRed(Qi, Li, Oi)
            end
            if Di.pathTouchesRed(Qi, Li, Oi, context.isSpiralBox) then
                return true
            end
            Di = context.spiralList(
                Si or os.clock(),
                (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 2.5)
            )
            return context.spiralWalkBad(Di, Qi, Li, Oi, 0, false, 1) > 0
        end
        local function Qi(Li, Oi, Si, Di)
            local Pi, _i, li = dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8, config.orbBeamMargin or 1
            local ci = 0
            for index = 1, #Li, 1 do
                local hi = Li[index]
                if hi.orb == Oi then
                    local Li, Oi = Si - hi.ox, Di - hi.oz
                    local Si, Di = Li * hi.ux + Oi * hi.uz, hi.vw + Pi + _i
                    if Si > -Di and Si < (hi.dL or hi.L) + Di then
                        index = Li * hi.uz - Oi * hi.ux
                        local Li = abs(index) - (Di + (hi.cone and max(Si, 0) * hi.cone or 0))
                        if not li or Li < li then
                            li, ci = Li, index >= 0 and 1 or -1
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return li, ci
        end
        context.spiralGuardApply = function(Li)
            if
                config.rodinSpiralGuard == false
                or not (hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
                or not context.spiralList
            then
                return
            end
            if
                contextColourPinned(Li)
                or contextFanPinned(Li)
                or contextColourAttackLive(Li)
                or hazardReader.touchdown ~= nil
            then
                return
            end
            local Oi = hazardReader.rodinSplit
            if Oi and Oi.model and Oi.model.Parent and not Oi.over then
                return
            end
            if not (movement.cmdAt == Li and movement.cmdDir) then
                return
            end
            local Si, humanoid, Di = context.character()
            if not (humanoid and Di and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            local position, _i =
                Di.Position,
                context.spiralList(Li, (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5))
            if #_i == 0 then
                return
            end
            if not GF(_i, position.X, position.Z, 0) then
                return
            end
            Di = movement.cmdDir
            Oi = sqrt(Di.X * Di.X + Di.Z * Di.Z)
            if Oi < 0.01 then
                return
            end
            local li, ci = config.burstMax or 28, config.rodinSpiralGuardAhead or 3
            if GF(_i, position.X + Di.X / Oi * ci, position.Z + Di.Z / Oi * ci, ci / li) then
                return
            end
            _i = combatBrain.goTo and Li - (combatBrain.goToAt or -infinity) < 0.5 and combatBrain.goTo
                or Vector3.new(position.X + Di.X / Oi * 30, position.Y, position.Z + Di.Z / Oi * 30)
            Di = context.spiralAround and context.spiralAround(position, Li, _i, li)
            if Di then
                Oi, ci = Di.X - position.X, Di.Z - position.Z
                _i = sqrt(Oi * Oi + ci * ci)
                if _i > 0.3 then
                    runtimeState.spiralGuardAt = Li
                    movement.cmdDir = Vector3.new(Oi / _i, 0, ci / _i)
                    movement.cmdAt = Li
                    movement.driving = true
                    N(false)
                    C(humanoid, true, li)
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(Oi / _i, 0, ci / _i), false)
                    contextSetState(
                        "RODIN SPIRAL: the way on runs into the spiral - round it toward where it is going"
                    )
                    contextLogT(
                        "spiralguard",
                        1,
                        "Brain",
                        "the way on ran into the spiral - round it toward the goal"
                    )
                    return
                end
            end
            runtimeState.spiralGuardAt = Li
            movement.cmdDir = nil
            movement.cmdAt = Li
            movementBoost.steer(nil)
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            movement.stallSince = nil
            movement.lastPos = nil
            runtimeState.stalledFor = 0
            movement.cornerUntil = nil
            movement.cornerDir = nil
            contextSetState("RODIN SPIRAL: the way on runs into the spiral - waiting outside it")
            contextLogT("spiralguard", 1, "Brain", "the way on ran into the spiral - held outside it")
        end
        context.inTouchCorner = function(Li, Oi, Si)
            local touchCorners = hazardReader.touchCorners
            if
                config.rodinTouchCorners == false
                or not touchCorners
                or (Si or os.clock()) - touchCorners.at > 0.5
            then
                return false
            end
            Si = config.rodinTouchCornerR or 30
            for index, pt in ipairs(touchCorners.pts) do
                if (Li - pt.x) ^ 2 + (Oi - pt.z) ^ 2 < Si * Si then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.spiralWayDanger = function(vector, vector2, Si, Di, Pi, _i)
            local li, isSpiralBox, ui, hi =
                max(Si or 28, 4),
                context.isSpiralBox,
                config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5,
                sqrt((vector2.X - vector.X) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - vector.Z) ^ 2)
            local Si, mi =
                hi / li, if context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, vector2, li, isSpiralBox) then 1000 else 0
            mi = if context.BB.orbPathSafe and not context.BB.orbPathSafe(vector, vector2, li)
                then mi + 1000
                else mi
            mi = if Pi and context.spiralWalkBad
                then mi + 100 * context.spiralWalkBad(Pi, vector, vector2, li, 0, true)
                else mi
            mi = if contextDangerAt(vector2.X, vector.Y, vector2.Z, Si, nil, nil, isSpiralBox) > ui
                then mi + 50
                else mi
            mi = if contextSweepHotAt(vector2.X, vector2.Z, Di + Si + 1, Di) then mi + 50 else mi
            mi = if _i
                then if not context.spiralMissileOK(vector, vector2, li, Di) then mi + 50 else mi
                else if context.missileLaneAt(vector2.X, vector2.Z, Di) then mi + 50 else mi
            mi = if context.redOrbNear
                    and context.redOrbNear(vector2, Si + (config.rodinSpiralOrbStay or 1))
                then mi + 50
                else mi
            mi = if not _i and context.missileLaneCross(vector, vector2, Di) then mi + 20 else mi
            mi = if context.BB.yellowAt and context.BB.yellowAt(vector2.X, vector2.Z, Di + Si)
                then mi + 20
                else mi
            Di = math.clamp(math.ceil(hi / 3), 1, 20)
            for index = 1, Di - 1, 1 do
                _i = index / Di
                if
                    contextDangerAt(
                        vector.X + (vector2.X - vector.X) * _i,
                        vector.Y,
                        vector.Z + (vector2.Z - vector.Z) * _i,
                        Si * _i,
                        nil,
                        nil,
                        isSpiralBox
                    ) > ui
                then
                    mi += 20
                    break
                end
            end
            return mi
        end
        context.spiralRadialOut = function(vector, Oi, Si, Di, vector2, _i, li, ci, ui)
            local rodinRig = hazardReader.rodinRig
            if not (rodinRig and rodinRig.Parent) then
                return nil
            end
            local mi = hazardReader.arenaCentre or vector2
            if not mi then
                return nil
            end
            local Ri, yi = vector.X - mi.X, vector.Z - mi.Z
            mi = sqrt(Ri * Ri + yi * yi)
            if mi < 0.5 then
                return nil
            end
            Ri /= mi
            yi /= mi
            li = li or config.rodinSpiralFar or 60
            local qi, Vi, isSpiralBox, pi =
                max(Di, 4), config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5, context.isSpiralBox, hazardReader.rodinSweep
            local ji = config.rodinSweepSpiralOut ~= false
                and pi ~= nil
                and pi.model ~= nil
                and pi.model.Parent ~= nil
            local Ui, Ji = config.rodinSpiralOrbIn ~= false
                and not ji
                and hazardReader.rodinOrbSeenAt ~= nil
                and Oi - hazardReader.rodinOrbSeenAt < (config.rodinOrbPhaseFor or 7)
                and not contextColourAttackLive(Oi)
            if Ui then
                pcall(function()
                    local rootPart = rodinRig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    Ji = rootPart and rootPart.Position or rodinRig:GetPivot().Position
                end)
                Ui = if not Ji then false else Ui
            else
            end
            local hi, travel, Yi =
                config.rodinSpiralOrbStay or 1,
                {},
                config.rodinSpiralSafeSide ~= false and context.spiralWayDanger ~= nil
            for index = 1, 2, 1 do
                pi = { 1, -1 }
                for index2, entry in ipairs(pi) do
                    if not travel[entry] then
                        for index3 = 1, entry < 0 and min(li, mi) or li, 1 do
                            local li, fi = vector.X + Ri * entry * index3, vector.Z + yi * entry * index3
                            if vector2 and (li - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (fi - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= _i then
                                break
                            end
                            index2 = index3 / qi
                            if GF(Si, li, fi, index2) then
                                local ri = Vector3.new(li, vector.Y, fi)
                                local oi = Ui
                                    and context.redOrbNear ~= nil
                                    and context.redOrbNear(ri, index2 + hi)
                                if
                                    index == 2
                                    or contextDangerAt(li, vector.Y, fi, index2, nil, nil, isSpiralBox)
                                            <= Vi
                                        and not contextSweepHotAt(li, fi, Oi + index2 + 1, Oi)
                                        and (ui and context.spiralMissileOK(vector, ri, Di, Oi) or not ui and not context.missileLaneAt(
                                            li,
                                            fi,
                                            Oi
                                        ) and not context.missileLaneCross(
                                            vector,
                                            ri,
                                            Oi
                                        ))
                                        and not oi
                                then
                                    travel[entry] = {
                                        q = ri,
                                        travel = index3,
                                        sg = entry,
                                        sc = context.spiralWalkBad(ci or Si, vector, ri, Di, 0, true)
                                            + (context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, ri, Di, isSpiralBox) and 100 or 0)
                                            + (oi and 100 or 0),
                                        pass = index,
                                    }
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not Yi and (travel[1] or travel[-1]) then
                    break
                end
            end
            if Yi then
                pi = { 1, -1 }
                for index4, entry2 in ipairs(pi) do
                    index4 = travel[entry2]
                    if index4 then
                        index4.danger = context.spiralWayDanger(vector, index4.q, Di, Oi, ci or Si, ui)
                    end
                end
            end
            local li, vi = travel[1], travel[-1]
            local Mi, Zi = Yi and li and vi and li.danger ~= vi.danger
            if Mi then
                Zi = li.danger < vi.danger and li or vi
                Zi.safer = true
            else
                pi = config.rodinSpiralInward ~= false and not ji and vi and (not li or vi.sc <= li.sc)
                if pi then
                    vi.orbInward = true
                    Zi = vi
                else
                    Yi = Ui and config.rodinSpiralOrbInward ~= false and vi and vi.pass == 1 and vi.sc == 0
                    if Yi then
                        vi.orbInward = true
                        Zi = vi
                    else
                        local ni = li and vi
                        if ni then
                            local ni = li.sc ~= vi.sc
                            if ni then
                                Zi = li.sc < vi.sc and li or vi
                            else
                                if Ui then
                                    local ni = (li.q.X - Ji.X) ^ 2 + (li.q.Z - Ji.Z) ^ 2
                                    Zi = ni <= (vi.q.X - Ji.X) ^ 2 + (vi.q.Z - Ji.Z) ^ 2 and li or vi
                                    Zi.orbIn = true
                                else
                                    if ji then
                                        Zi = if context.inTouchCorner(li.q.X, li.q.Z, Oi)
                                                and not context.inTouchCorner(vi.q.X, vi.q.Z, Oi)
                                                and not contextSweepHotAt(
                                                    vi.q.X,
                                                    vi.q.Z,
                                                    Oi + vi.travel / qi + 1,
                                                    Oi
                                                )
                                            then vi
                                            else li
                                    else
                                        Zi = li.travel <= vi.travel and li or vi
                                        local spiralRadial = runtimeState.spiralRadial
                                        if
                                            spiralRadial
                                            and Oi - spiralRadial.at
                                                < (config.rodinSpiralRadialKeep or 0.6)
                                        then
                                            local ni = travel[spiralRadial.sg]
                                            Zi = if ni
                                                    and ni ~= Zi
                                                    and ni.sc == Zi.sc
                                                    and (ni.danger or 0) <= (Zi.danger or 0)
                                                    and ni.travel
                                                        <= Zi.travel + (config.rodinSpiralRadialSlack or 3)
                                                then ni
                                                else Zi
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            Zi = li or vi
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Yi = runtimeState.spiralRadial
            if
                Zi
                and config.rodinSpiralCommit ~= false
                and Yi
                and Oi - Yi.at < (config.rodinSpiralCommitGap or 0.5)
                and Yi.sg ~= Zi.sg
            then
                Mi = travel[Yi.sg]
                Zi = if Mi and Mi.sc <= Zi.sc and (Mi.danger or 0) <= (Zi.danger or 0) then Mi else Zi
            else
            end
            if not Zi then
                return nil
            end
            Mi = Ui and (config.rodinSpiralRunPastOrb or 0) or (config.rodinSpiralRunPast or 0)
            if Mi > 0 then
                ji, Yi = Zi.sg, Zi.travel
                li, vi, travel = ji < 0 and mi - 2 or math.huge
                for index5 = Yi + 1, Yi + Mi, 1 do
                    if index5 > li then
                        break
                    end
                    local li, Ji = vector.X + Ri * ji * index5, vector.Z + yi * ji * index5
                    if vector2 and (li - vector2.X) ^ 2 + (Ji - vector2.Z) ^ 2 >= _i then
                        break
                    end
                    pi = index5 / qi
                    if
                        not GF(Si, li, Ji, pi)
                        or contextDangerAt(li, vector.Y, Ji, pi, nil, nil, isSpiralBox) > Vi
                        or contextSweepHotAt(li, Ji, Oi + pi + 1, Oi)
                        or ui and not context.spiralMissileOK(vector, Vector3.new(li, vector.Y, Ji), Di, Oi)
                        or not ui and context.missileLaneAt(li, Ji, Oi)
                    then
                        break
                    end
                    vi, travel = Vector3.new(li, vector.Y, Ji), index5
                end
                Zi = if vi
                        and (ui or not context.missileLaneCross(vector, vi, Oi))
                        and not (Ui and context.redOrbNear ~= nil and context.redOrbNear(vi, travel / qi + hi))
                    then if context.spiralWalkBad(ci or Si, vector, vi, Di, 0, true)
                                + (context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, vi, Di, isSpiralBox) and 100 or 0)
                            <= Zi.sc
                        then {
                            q = vi,
                            travel = travel,
                            sg = ji,
                            sc = Zi.sc,
                            pass = Zi.pass,
                            orbIn = Zi.orbIn,
                            orbInward = Zi.orbInward,
                            runPast = travel - Yi,
                        }
                        else Zi
                    else Zi
            else
            end
            runtimeState.spiralRadial = {
                at = Oi,
                sg = Zi.sg,
            }
            Zi.note = Zi.sg > 0 and ", straight out from the middle of the arena"
                or ", straight in toward the middle of the arena"
            if Zi.orbIn then
                Zi.note = Zi.note .. " - the side nearer Rodin, for the green orbs"
            end
            if Zi.orbInward then
                Zi.note = Zi.note
                    .. " - inward, never apart from Rodin and the green orbs, parked on the first safe spot"
            end
            if Zi.safer then
                Zi.note = Zi.note .. " - the other side has danger on it"
            end
            return Zi
        end
        context.unionEscapeApply = function(cmdAt)
            if
                config.rodinUnionEscape == false
                or not (hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
            then
                return
            end
            if contextColourPinned(cmdAt) or contextFanPinned(cmdAt) then
                runtimeState.unionPath = nil
                return
            end
            if movement.cmdAt == cmdAt and movement.cmdDir then
                return
            end
            local Oi, humanoid, Si = context.character()
            if not (humanoid and Si and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                return
            end
            local position, Pi, _i =
                Si.Position,
                context.spiralList and context.spiralList(
                    cmdAt,
                    (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5)
                ) or {},
                config.rodinSpiralExitDanger or 0.5
            Si = contextDangerAt(position.X, position.Y, position.Z, 0)
            if Si <= _i and GF(Pi, position.X, position.Z, 0) then
                runtimeState.unionPath = nil
                return
            end
            local li, ci, ui = config.burstMax or 28, NF(cmdAt, position), FF(cmdAt, position)
            local hi, mi = not ci and not ui and runtimeState.unionPath or nil
            if ci or ui then
                runtimeState.unionPath = nil
                _i = WF(position, cmdAt, Pi, li, ci or ui.ml)
                _i = if _i
                        and not ci
                        and not (gF(ui, _i.q.X, _i.q.Z) and not contextMissileBodyCatch(position, _i.q, li))
                    then nil
                    else _i
                if CF(ui) then
                    local WF, Ri = eF(
                        "unionZonePath",
                        position,
                        cmdAt,
                        Pi,
                        li,
                        hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                        ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - (config.rodinMissileWallGap or 8)) ^ 2,
                        ui,
                        true
                    )
                    _i = if WF
                            and Ri
                            and (not (_i and _i.clear) or Ri.travel < _i.travel - 1)
                            and not contextMissileBodyCatch(position, WF, li)
                        then {
                            q = WF,
                            travel = Ri.travel,
                            clear = true,
                        }
                        else _i
                else
                end
                if not _i then
                    return
                end
                mi = _i.q
            else
            end
            if hi and cmdAt - hi.at < (config.rodinSpiralReplan or 0.2) then
                while true do
                    ui, _i = hi.idx, hi.path
                    if not (ui <= #_i and a(position, hi.path[hi.idx]) < 2) then
                        break
                    end
                    hi.idx = hi.idx + 1
                end
                mi = if hi.idx <= #hi.path then hi.path[min(hi.idx + 1, #hi.path)] else mi
            else
            end
            if not mi and config.rodinSpiralRadial ~= false and not GF(Pi, position.X, position.Z, 0) then
                _i = context.spiralRadialOut(
                    position,
                    cmdAt,
                    Pi,
                    li,
                    hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                    ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2,
                    nil,
                    Pi
                )
                if _i then
                    runtimeState.unionPath = nil
                    mi = _i.q
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not mi then
                hi, _i = hazardReader.arenaCentre, ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2
                ui = zF(
                    position,
                    cmdAt,
                    Pi,
                    li,
                    nil,
                    hi,
                    _i,
                    context.BB and context.BB.blueBeams and context.BB.blueBeams() or nil,
                    true
                )
                if ui then
                    runtimeState.unionPath = {
                        at = cmdAt,
                        path = ui.path,
                        idx = 1,
                    }
                    mi = ui.path[min(2, #ui.path)]
                else
                    runtimeState.unionPath = nil
                    local zF = TF(position, cmdAt, Pi, li, hi, _i, false, false)
                        or TF(position, cmdAt, Pi, li, hi, _i, true, false)
                    mi = zF and zF.q
                end
            else
            end
            if not mi then
                return
            end
            ui, _i = mi.X - position.X, mi.Z - position.Z
            hi = sqrt(ui * ui + _i * _i)
            if hi < 0.3 then
                return
            end
            movement.cmdDir = Vector3.new(ui / hi, 0, _i / hi)
            movement.cmdAt = cmdAt
            movement.driving = true
            N(false)
            if not GF(Pi, position.X, position.Z, 0) then
                runtimeState.spiralRunAt = os.clock()
            end
            C(humanoid, true, li)
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(ui / hi, 0, _i / hi), false)
            contextSetState(
                tostring(runtimeState.movementState or "")
                    .. (
                        ci
                            and " | + OUT OF THE DANGER IT STOOD IN - along the green line, every overlapping attack as one"
                        or " | + OUT OF THE DANGER IT STOOD IN - every overlapping attack as one"
                    )
            )
            contextLogT(
                "unionescape",
                1,
                "Brain",
                ("stood in danger (%.1f) - out of every overlapping attack there as one"):format(Si)
            )
        end
        context.orbBounceApply = function(zF)
            local orb = hazardReader.missileLines
            if
                config.orbBounceHold == false
                or not context.rodinOrbs()
                or contextColourPinned(zF)
                or contextFanPinned(zF)
                or context.odinFanPinned ~= nil and context.odinFanPinned(zF)
                or hazardReader.sweepOrbFree ~= nil and zF - hazardReader.sweepOrbFree < (config.sweepOrbFreeFor or 1)
                or orb ~= nil and orb.pick ~= nil and zF - (orb.at or -infinity) < 0.3
            then
                runtimeState.orbBounce = nil
                runtimeState.orbHold = nil
                return
            end
            local Li, humanoid, Oi = context.character()
            if not (humanoid and Oi and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                runtimeState.orbBounce = nil
                runtimeState.orbHold = nil
                return
            end
            local position, Di, Pi, _i, orbBounce =
                Oi.Position,
                context.BB and context.BB.blueBeams and context.BB.blueBeams() or {},
                config.orbBounceEdge or 1.5,
                config.orbBounceBack or 0.5,
                runtimeState.orbBounce or {}
            runtimeState.orbBounce = orbBounce
            Oi = {}
            for index = 1, #Di, 1 do
                orb = Di[index].orb
                if orb and not Oi[orb] then
                    Oi[orb] = true
                    local ext, side = Qi(Di, orb, position.X, position.Z)
                    index = orbBounce[orb]
                    if ext == nil then
                        orbBounce[orb] = nil
                    elseif not index then
                        orbBounce[orb] = {
                            n = 0,
                            lastAt = -infinity,
                            going = "out",
                            ext = ext,
                            side = side,
                        }
                    elseif index.going == "in" then
                        if ext < index.ext then
                            index.ext = ext
                        end
                        if ext >= index.ext + _i then
                            if side == index.side then
                                if zF - index.lastAt > (config.orbBounceWindow or 4) then
                                    index.n = 0
                                end
                                index.n = index.n + 1
                                index.lastAt = zF
                                if index.n > (config.orbBounceMax or 2) and not runtimeState.orbHold then
                                    runtimeState.orbHold = {
                                        orb = orb,
                                        at = zF,
                                    }
                                    index.n = 0
                                    contextLogT(
                                        "orbhold",
                                        0.5,
                                        "Brain",
                                        "bounced off a blue orb's yellow beam 3 times - standing still off it until it passes"
                                    )
                                end
                            end
                            index.going = "out"
                            index.ext = ext
                        end
                    else
                        if ext > index.ext then
                            index.ext = ext
                        end
                        if ext <= Pi and ext <= index.ext - _i then
                            index.going = "in"
                            index.ext = ext
                            index.side = side
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for entry in pairs(orbBounce) do
                if not Oi[entry] then
                    orbBounce[entry] = nil
                end
            end
            orbBounce = runtimeState.orbHold
            if not orbBounce then
                return
            end
            orb = orbBounce.orb
            local ci, ui, vector =
                if orb and orb.Parent then Qi(Di, orb, position.X, position.Z) else nil,
                false,
                combatBrain.goTo and zF - (combatBrain.goToAt or -infinity) < 0.5 and combatBrain.goTo or nil
            if vector and orb and orb.Parent and not (ci ~= nil and ci <= Pi) then
                _i, Oi = vector.X - position.X, vector.Z - position.Z
                local hi = math.min(math.ceil(sqrt(_i * _i + Oi * Oi)), 150)
                for index2 = 1, hi, 1 do
                    local Ri = Qi(Di, orb, position.X + _i * index2 / hi, position.Z + Oi * index2 / hi)
                    if Ri and Ri <= 0 then
                        ui = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not (ci ~= nil and ci <= Pi or ui) or zF - orbBounce.at > (config.orbBounceHoldMax or 8) then
                runtimeState.orbHold = nil
                contextLogT("orbhold", 0.5, "Brain", "the blue orb's yellow beam has passed - going on")
                return
            end
            if ci ~= nil and ci <= 0 then
                return
            end
            _i = movement.cmdAt == zF and movement.cmdDir or nil
            if not _i then
                return
            end
            Pi = Qi(Di, orb, position.X + _i.X * 1.5, position.Z + _i.Z * 1.5)
            if Pi ~= nil and Pi < (ci or infinity) - 0.05 and config.orbHoldSafeCheck ~= false then
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(config.orbHoldLook or { 0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.2 }) do
                    if contextDangerAt(position.X, position.Y, position.Z, entry2, 1, 0.5) >= 0.5 then
                        runtimeState.orbHold = nil
                        contextLogT(
                            "orbhold",
                            0.5,
                            "Brain",
                            "not holding off the blue orb's beam - this spot is about to be hit"
                        )
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            if Pi ~= nil and Pi < (ci or infinity) - 0.05 then
                movement.cmdDir = nil
                movement.cmdAt = zF
                movementBoost.steer(nil)
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                movement.stallSince = nil
                movement.lastPos = nil
                runtimeState.stalledFor = 0
                movement.cornerUntil = nil
                movement.cornerDir = nil
                contextSetState(
                    "RODIN BLUE ORB: bounced off its yellow beam 3 times - standing still off it until it passes"
                )
            end
        end
        local function zF(WF, Qi)
            local Li = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(WF) do
                if entry.orb == Qi and not entry.cone then
                    Li[#Li + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return Li
        end
        local function WF(Qi, Li)
            for index, seg in ipairs(Qi.segs) do
                local Di, Pi, _i = seg.t0 or 0, max(seg.osp or 0, 1), seg.dL or seg.L
                if Li >= Di and Li <= Di + _i / Pi then
                    index = (Li - Di) * Pi
                    return seg.ox + seg.ux * index, seg.oz + seg.uz * index
                end
            end
            return Qi.x + Qi.vx * Li, Qi.z + Qi.vz * Li
        end
        context.redPushApply = function(cmdAt)
            if
                config.redPush == false
                or not (hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent)
                or contextColourPinned(cmdAt)
                or contextFanPinned(cmdAt)
            then
                runtimeState.redPush = nil
                return
            end
            local Li, humanoid, Oi = context.character()
            if not (humanoid and Oi and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                runtimeState.redPush = nil
                return
            end
            local position = Oi.Position
            if NF(cmdAt, position) or IF(cmdAt, position, false) then
                runtimeState.redPush = nil
                return
            end
            local Di = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(dangerGeometry.boxes or {}) do
                if entry.fullKeep and entry.moving and (entry.untilAt or 0) >= cmdAt then
                    index, Oi = #Di + 1, {
                        b = entry,
                    }
                    Oi.need, Di[index] =
                        (entry.r or entry.halfW or 12)
                            + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
                            + (config.redOrbStand or 0.5),
                        Oi
                end
            end
            if #Di == 0 then
                runtimeState.redPush = nil
                return
            end
            local Pi = config.burstMax or 28
            local _i, li, ci, ui = config.redPushLook or 1, 0.05
            if movement.cmdAt == cmdAt and movement.cmdDir then
                Oi = sqrt(movement.cmdDir.X ^ 2 + movement.cmdDir.Z ^ 2)
                if Oi > 0.01 then
                    ci, ui = movement.cmdDir.X / Oi, movement.cmdDir.Z / Oi
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local function hi(mi, Ri, yi, qi, Vi)
                local Ei, pi, ji, Ui, Ji, wi, Yi = 0, infinity
                while Ei <= (Vi or _i) + 1.0E-6 do
                    local Vi, vi = position.X, position.Z
                    if mi then
                        local Mi = yi * Ei
                        Mi = if qi and Mi > qi then qi else Mi
                        Vi, vi = Vi + mi * Mi, vi + Ri * Mi
                    else
                    end
                    local mi = cmdAt + Ei
                    for index2 = 1, #Di, 1 do
                        local yi = Di[index2]
                        index2 = yi.b
                        if mi <= (index2.untilAt or 0) + 0.2 then
                            local Di = (index2.offset or 0)
                                + (index2.speed or 0) * max(mi - (index2.pathStart or cmdAt), 0)
                            Di = if index2.endAlong and Di > index2.endAlong then index2.endAlong else Di
                            local mi, qi = index2.ox + index2.dx * Di, index2.oz + index2.dz * Di
                            local Di = sqrt((Vi - mi) ^ 2 + (vi - qi) ^ 2) - yi.need
                            if Di < pi then
                                pi, ji, Ui, Ji, wi, Yi = Di, mi, qi, Vi, vi, index2
                            else
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    Ei = Ei + li
                end
                return pi, ji, Ui, Ji, wi, Yi
            end
            local Di, li
            Oi = runtimeState.greenTap
            if Oi and Oi.at == cmdAt and Oi.to and (Oi.phase == "in" or Oi.phase == "touch") then
                Di = sqrt((Oi.to.X - position.X) ^ 2 + (Oi.to.Z - position.Z) ^ 2)
                li = min(_i, Di / max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1) + (config.rodinTapHold or 0.35))
            else
            end
            local _i, mi, Ri, yi, qi, Vi = hi(ci, ui, max(humanoid.WalkSpeed, 1), Di, li)
            if _i >= 0 then
                runtimeState.redPush = nil
                return
            end
            local Di, li = yi - mi, qi - Ri
            qi = sqrt(Di * Di + li * li)
            if qi < 0.5 then
                Di, li = -(Vi.dz or 0), Vi.dx or 1
                if ci and Di * ci + li * ui < 0 then
                    Di, li = -Di, -li
                else
                end
                qi = max(sqrt(Di * Di + li * li), 0.001)
            else
            end
            Di /= qi
            li /= qi
            Ri = config.redPushW or 2
            mi, Oi = (ci or 0) + Di * Ri, (ui or 0) + li * Ri
            Vi = sqrt(mi * mi + Oi * Oi)
            if Vi < 0.001 then
                mi, Oi, Vi = Di, li, 1
            else
            end
            mi /= Vi
            Oi /= Vi
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            local li = (config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4
            local function Ei(pi, ji)
                local vector = Vector3.new(position.X + pi * Pi * 0.6, position.Y, position.Z + ji * Pi * 0.6)
                if arenaCentre and (vector.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= li * li then
                    return false
                end
                if context.spiralRedOn and context.spiralRedOn(position, vector, Pi, cmdAt) then
                    return false
                end
                if contextSweepHotAt(vector.X, vector.Z, cmdAt + 0.9, cmdAt) then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    context.BB
                    and context.BB.pathTouchesRed
                    and context.BB.pathTouchesRed(position, vector, Pi, context.BB.isRedOrb)
                then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            yi, qi, Ri = { 0, 30, 60, 90 }, -infinity
            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(yi) do
                Vi = entry2 == 0 and { 1 } or { 1, -1 }
                if entry2 > 0 and ci then
                    index3 = toRadians(entry2)
                    local li, yi = mi * cos(index3) - Oi * sin(index3), mi * sin(index3) + Oi * cos(index3)
                    Vi = if li * ci + yi * ui
                            < (mi * cos(-index3) - Oi * sin(-index3)) * ci
                                + (mi * sin(-index3) + Oi * cos(-index3)) * ui
                        then { -1, 1 }
                        else Vi
                else
                end
                for index4, entry3 in ipairs(Vi) do
                    index3 = toRadians(entry2 * entry3)
                    entry3, index4 = mi * cos(index3) - Oi * sin(index3), mi * sin(index3) + Oi * cos(index3)
                    local Oi = hi(entry3, index4, Pi)
                    if (Oi >= 0 or Oi > qi) and Ei(entry3, index4) then
                        local Si = Ri
                        if Oi >= 0 then
                            qi, Ri =
                                Oi, {
                                    entry3,
                                    index4,
                                }
                            break
                        end
                        if Oi > qi then
                            qi, Ri =
                                Oi, {
                                    entry3,
                                    index4,
                                }
                        else
                            Ri = Si
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if Ri and qi >= 0 then
                    break
                end
            end
            if not Ri or qi <= _i then
                return
            end
            hi, mi = Ri[1], Ri[2]
            runtimeState.redPush = {
                at = cmdAt,
            }
            movement.cmdDir = Vector3.new(hi, 0, mi)
            movement.cmdAt = cmdAt
            movement.driving = true
            N(false)
            C(humanoid, true, Pi)
            movementBoost.steer(Vector3.new(hi, 0, mi))
            if movementBoost.active() then
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            else
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(hi, 0, mi), false)
            end
            contextSetState(
                tostring(runtimeState.movementState or "") .. " | + OFF THE RED ORB'S WAY, FULL SPRINT"
            )
            contextLogT(
                "redpush",
                0.5,
                "Brain",
                ("a red orb would come %.1f studs inside its clearance - pushed off its way at full sprint"):format(
                    -_i
                )
            )
        end
        context.playerHitboxW = function()
            if config.playerHitboxW then
                return config.playerHitboxW
            end
            local character, hitboxW = localPlayer.Character, runtimeState.hitboxW
            if hitboxW and hitboxW.ch == character then
                return hitboxW.w
            end
            local Oi = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if not Oi then
                return hitboxW and hitboxW.w or 4
            end
            local Li, Si, Di, Pi, _i = infinity, -infinity, infinity, -infinity, 0
            for index, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local vector, ui, hi =
                        Oi.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(child.Position), child.Size.X * 0.5, child.Size.Z * 0.5
                    Li, Si, Di, Pi, _i =
                        if vector.X - ui < Li then vector.X - ui else Li,
                        if vector.X + ui > Si then vector.X + ui else Si,
                        if vector.Z - hi < Di then vector.Z - hi else Di,
                        if vector.Z + hi > Pi then vector.Z + hi else Pi,
                        _i + 1
                else
                end
            end
            Oi = _i > 0 and max(Si - Li, Pi - Di) or 0
            Oi = if not (Oi >= 2 and Oi <= 12) then 4 else Oi
            if _i >= 6 then
                runtimeState.hitboxW = {
                    ch = character,
                    w = Oi,
                }
            end
            return Oi
        end
        context.orbPushApply = function(cmdAt)
            if
                config.orbPush == false
                or not context.rodinOrbs()
                or contextColourPinned(cmdAt)
                or contextFanPinned(cmdAt)
                or context.odinFanPinned ~= nil and context.odinFanPinned(cmdAt)
            then
                runtimeState.orbPush = nil
                return
            end
            local Li, Li, Oi = context.character()
            if not (Li and Oi and Li.Health > 0) then
                runtimeState.orbPush = nil
                return
            end
            local position = Oi.Position
            local Di, Pi, _i =
                Oi.Size.X * 0.5,
                (config.orbClearHitbox or 1) * (context.playerHitboxW and context.playerHitboxW() or Oi.Size.X),
                config.orbSteerLook or 0.6
