            local hi, mi = context.BB and context.BB.blueBeams and context.BB.blueBeams() or {}, {}
            for key, entry in pairs(hazardReader.parts or {}) do
                if key.Parent and context.isBlueOrb(lowercase(key.Name)) then
                    local position2, rad, Ei =
                        key.Position,
                        max(key.Size.X, key.Size.Z) * 0.5,
                        sqrt((entry.vx or 0) ^ 2 + (entry.vz or 0) ^ 2)
                    if
                        sqrt((position2.X - position.X) ^ 2 + (position2.Z - position.Z) ^ 2)
                            - rad
                            - Di
                        < Pi + (ui + max(Ei, config.orbBlueSpeed or 25)) * _i
                    then
                        mi[#mi + 1] = {
                            x = position2.X,
                            z = position2.Z,
                            vx = entry.vx or 0,
                            vz = entry.vz or 0,
                            rad = rad,
                            segs = zF(hi, key),
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            local zF, Ri
            if movement.cmdAt == cmdAt and movement.cmdDir then
                Oi = sqrt(movement.cmdDir.X ^ 2 + movement.cmdDir.Z ^ 2)
                if Oi > 0.01 then
                    zF, Ri = movement.cmdDir.X / Oi, movement.cmdDir.Z / Oi
                else
                end
            else
            end
            local yi, qi = false
            local Vi, Ei, pi, ji = false, 0, 0, infinity
            for index = 1, #mi, 1 do
                local Ji, wi, Yi, vi, Mi = mi[index], li, infinity, position.X, position.Z
                local Zi, ni, fi = Ji.x, Ji.z, 0
                while wi <= _i + ci + 1.0E-6 do
                    index, Oi = position.X, position.Z
                    if zF then
                        local ri = min(wi, _i)
                        index, Oi = index + zF * ui * ri, Oi + Ri * ui * ri
                    else
                    end
                    local ri, oi = WF(Ji, wi)
                    local Ai = sqrt((index - ri) ^ 2 + (Oi - oi) ^ 2) - Ji.rad - Di
                    if Ai < Yi then
                        Yi, vi, Mi, Zi, ni, fi = Ai, index, Oi, ri, oi, wi
                    else
                    end
                    wi = wi + li
                end
                if Yi < Pi then
                    local Ui, ri
                    if config.orbGoBehind ~= false then
                        local oi, Ai = WF(Ji, fi)
                        local ki, xi = WF(Ji, fi + 0.1)
                        local WF, fi = ki - oi, xi - Ai
                        xi = sqrt(WF * WF + fi * fi)
                        if xi < 0.05 then
                            WF, fi = Ji.vx, Ji.vz
                            xi = sqrt(WF * WF + fi * fi) * 0.1
                        else
                        end
                        if xi >= 0.05 then
                            xi = sqrt(WF * WF + fi * fi)
                            WF /= xi
                            fi /= xi
                            ki, oi, Ai = -fi, position.X - Ji.x, position.Z - Ji.z
                            local xi, ai, ei = oi * WF + Ai * fi, oi * ki + Ai * WF, Ji.rad + Di + Pi
                            wi = ai >= 0 and 1 or -1
                            wi = if abs(ai) < 0.5 and zF then zF * ki + Ri * WF >= 0 and 1 or -1 else wi
                            if xi > -ei and abs(ai) < ei then
                                Ui, ri = ki * wi, WF * wi
                                local oi = sqrt(Ji.vx * Ji.vx + Ji.vz * Ji.vz)
                                local Ai = max(xi - Ji.rad - Di, 0) / max(oi, 1)
                                local xi = config.orbHeadOnStep ~= false
                                    and oi > 2
                                    and Ai <= (config.orbHeadOnT or 1.5)
                                    and (not qi or Ai < qi.t)
                                yi, qi =
                                    true, if xi
                                        then {
                                            t = Ai,
                                            ux = WF,
                                            uz = fi,
                                            nx = ki,
                                            nz = WF,
                                            sd = wi,
                                        }
                                        else qi
                            else
                                local oi = ei + (config.orbBehindExtra or 2)
                                Ui, ri =
                                    Ji.x - WF * oi + ki * wi * ei * 0.5 - position.X,
                                    Ji.z - fi * oi + WF * wi * ei * 0.5 - position.Z
                                Vi = true
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if not Ui then
                        Ui, ri = vi - Zi, Mi - ni
                    else
                    end
                    local WF = sqrt(Ui * Ui + ri * ri)
                    if WF < 0.1 then
                        Ui, ri = -Ji.vz, Ji.vx
                        if zF and Ui * zF + ri * Ri < 0 then
                            Ui, ri = -Ui, -ri
                        else
                        end
                        WF = sqrt(Ui * Ui + ri * ri)
                        if WF < 0.1 then
                            Ui, ri = position.X - Ji.x, position.Z - Ji.z
                            WF = max(sqrt(Ui * Ui + ri * ri), 0.1)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local Ji = (config.orbAwayW or 2) * min(max((Pi - Yi) / Pi, 0.25), 1)
                    Ei, pi, ji = Ei + Ui / WF * Ji, pi + ri / WF * Ji, if Yi < ji then Yi else ji
                else
                end
            end
            Di, mi = nil
            if
                config.orbOffBeam ~= false
                and not rF(cmdAt)
                and context.BB
                and context.BB.onBlueBeam
                and context.BB.orbArrive
            then
                Oi = context.BB.onBlueBeam(position.X, position.Z, 0, hi)
                if
                    Oi
                    and context.BB.orbArrive(position.X, position.Z, {
                            Oi,
                        })
                        <= (config.orbOffBeamWithin or 3)
                then
                    ci, li = Oi.uz, -Oi.ux
                    local WF = (position.X - Oi.ox) * ci + (position.Z - Oi.oz) * li >= 0 and 1 or -1
                    if zF then
                        local Ui = zF * ci + Ri * li
                        WF = if abs(Ui) > 0.2 then Ui > 0 and 1 or -1 else WF
                    else
                    end
                    Di, mi = ci * WF, li * WF
                else
                end
            else
            end
            Oi = ji < Pi
            if not Oi and not Di then
                runtimeState.orbPush = nil
                return
            end
            li = config.orbOffBeamW or 1
            Pi, ci = (zF or 0) + Ei + (Di and Di * li or 0), (Ri or 0) + pi + (mi and mi * li or 0)
            li = sqrt(Pi * Pi + ci * ci)
            if li < 0.05 then
                Pi, ci = Ei + (Di or 0), pi + (mi or 0)
                li = sqrt(Pi * Pi + ci * ci)
                if li < 0.05 then
                    runtimeState.orbPush = nil
                    return
                end
            else
            end
            Pi /= li
            ci /= li
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            local WF = (config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4
            local function Ri(Ei, pi)
                local vector = Vector3.new(position.X + Ei * ui * _i, position.Y, position.Z + pi * ui * _i)
                if arenaCentre and (vector.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= WF * WF then
                    return false
                end
                if context.spiralRedOn and context.spiralRedOn(position, vector, ui, cmdAt) then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    context.missileLaneAt
                    and (
                        context.missileLaneAt(vector.X, vector.Z, cmdAt)
                        or context.missileLaneCross(position, vector, cmdAt)
                    )
                then
                    return false
                end
                if contextSweepHotAt(vector.X, vector.Z, cmdAt + _i + 0.3, cmdAt) then
                    return false
                end
                return true
            end
            mi = FF(cmdAt, position)
            li, hi = mi and mi.ml or NF(cmdAt, position), CF(mi)
            local zF, WF
            local Ei = false
            if qi and not li then
                local iterateArray, Ui = ipairs, {
                    qi.sd,
                    -qi.sd,
                }
                for key2, entry2 in iterateArray(Ui) do
                    for index2, entry3 in ipairs(config.orbHeadOnTurns or { 0, 20, 45 }) do
                        key2 = toRadians(entry3)
                        entry3, index2 =
                            qi.nx * entry2 * cos(key2) + qi.ux * sin(key2),
                            qi.nz * entry2 * cos(key2) + qi.uz * sin(key2)
                        local qi =
                            Vector3.new(position.X + entry3 * ui * _i, position.Y, position.Z + index2 * ui * _i)
                        if
                            Ri(entry3, index2)
                            and not (context.BB and context.BB.pathTouchesRed and context.BB.pathTouchesRed(
                                position,
                                qi,
                                ui
                            ))
                            and not (
                                context.BB
                                and context.BB.orbPathSafe
                                and not context.BB.orbPathSafe(position, qi, ui)
                            )
                        then
                            zF, WF, Ei = entry3, index2, true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if zF then
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if Ei then
            else
                if li and not hi then
                    local qi = Pi * li.ax + ci * li.az
                    if abs(qi) >= 0.2 then
                        local pi = qi > 0 and 1 or -1
                        if Ri(li.ax * pi, li.az * pi) then
                            zF, WF = li.ax * pi, li.az * pi
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                    for index3, entry4 in ipairs(config.orbPushTurns or { 0, 20, -20, 45, -45, 70, -70 }) do
                        index3 = toRadians(entry4)
                        local Ui, Ji, wi =
                            Pi * cos(index3) - ci * sin(index3), Pi * sin(index3) + ci * cos(index3), true
                        if li then

                                or gF(mi, entry4.X, entry4.Z)
                                    and not contextMissileBodyCatch(position, entry4, ui)
                        else
                        end
                        if wi and (Ri(Ui, Ji)) then
                            zF, WF = Ui, Ji
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not zF then
                runtimeState.orbPush = nil
                return
            end
            runtimeState.orbPush = {
                at = cmdAt,
            }
            movement.cmdDir = Vector3.new(zF, 0, WF)
            movement.cmdAt = cmdAt
            movement.driving = true
            N(false)

            if movementBoost.active() then

            else
                Li:Move(Vector3.new(zF, 0, WF), false)

            hi, mi = tostring, runtimeState.movementState
            Li, Pi =

                    or Oi and Di and " | + OFF THE BLUE ORB AND OFF ITS YELLOW LANE"
            contextSetState(

                        or Oi and Vi and " | + ROUND BEHIND THE BLUE ORB"
                        or Oi and yi and " | + OUT OF THE BLUE ORB'S WAY, TO GO ROUND BEHIND IT"

                        or " | + OFF THE BLUE ORB'S YELLOW LANE, ITS ORB IS COMING"

            )
            if Oi then

                        max(ji, 0)
                    )
                )

                    "on a blue orb's yellow lane with its orb coming - the off-the-lane vector added"

        context.greenTapPlan = function(touchAt, vector, zF)
            local tapState = runtimeState.tapState
            local tapStats = runtimeState.tapStats
            if not tapStats then
                tapStats = {
                    taps = 0,
                    touched = 0,
                    early = 0,
                    dropped = 0,
                }
                runtimeState.tapStats = tapStats
            else
            end
            local function Li(Oi)
                if tapState and Oi then
                    tapStats.dropped = tapStats.dropped + 1
                    contextLogT("greentap", 0.5, "Brain", "green orb tap given up: " .. Oi)
                end
                runtimeState.tapState = nil
                hazardReader.rodinGoodPick = nil
                return nil
            end
            local Oi = hazardReader.rodinGoodOrbs
            if (Oi == nil or next(Oi) == nil) and not tapState then
                return nil
            end
            if
                config.rodinGoodOrb == false
                or contextColourPinned(touchAt)
                or contextFanPinned(touchAt)
                or tF(touchAt, vector)
            then
                return (Li("another attack comes first"))
            end
            local Si, rodinGoodVel = hazardReader.rodinSweep, hazardReader.rodinSplit
            if
                Si and Si.model and Si.model.Parent
                or rodinGoodVel
                    and rodinGoodVel.model
                    and rodinGoodVel.model.Parent
                    and not rodinGoodVel.over
            then
                return (Li("another attack comes first"))
            end
            if zF ~= nil and not zF.soft then
                for index, entry in ipairs(context.BB and context.BB.threats or {}) do
                    if entry.hard and not (entry.box and context.BB.isRedOrb(entry.box)) then
                        return (Li("the dodger is running from something else"))
                    end
                end
            end
            zF = hazardReader.rodinRig
            Si = zF and zF.Parent and (zF.PrimaryPart or zF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if not Si then
                return (Li())
            end
            local position = Si.Position
            local speed = config.burstMax or 28
            local li = config.rodinTapStep or 0.05
            local ci = config.rodinTapHold or 0.35
            local ui = config.redOrbStandLook or 1.6
            local hi = config.rodinTapSpare or 0.5
            local arenaCentre = hazardReader.arenaCentre
            local Ri = ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 4) ^ 2
            local yi, qi = context.BB.isRedOrb, {}
            Si, zF = dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8, config.redOrbStand or 0.5
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(dangerGeometry.boxes or {}) do
                if entry2.fullKeep and (entry2.untilAt or 0) >= touchAt and (entry2.moving or entry2.cx) then
                    rodinGoodVel, index2 = #qi + 1, {
                        b = entry2,
                    }
                    index2.need, qi[rodinGoodVel] = (entry2.r or entry2.halfW or 12) + Si + zF, index2
                end
            end
            local function Vi(zone, pi)
                if not zone.moving then
                    return zone.cx, zone.cz
                end
                local ji = (zone.offset or 0) + (zone.speed or 0) * max(pi - (zone.pathStart or touchAt), 0)
                ji = if zone.endAlong and ji > zone.endAlong then zone.endAlong else ji
                return zone.ox + zone.dx * ji, zone.oz + zone.dz * ji
            end
            local function Ei(pi, ji, Ui)
                local Ji, wi = touchAt + Ui, infinity
                for index3 = 1, #qi, 1 do
                    Ui = qi[index3]
                    if Ji <= (Ui.b.untilAt or 0) + 0.2 then
                        local vi, Mi = Vi(Ui.b, Ji)
                        index3 = sqrt((pi - vi) ^ 2 + (ji - Mi) ^ 2) - Ui.need
                        wi = if index3 < wi then index3 else wi
                    else
                    end
                end
                return wi
            end
            local function pi(ji, Ui)
                local Ji, wi, Yi = infinity
                for index3 = 1, #qi, 1 do
                    local Mi, Zi = Vi(qi[index3].b, touchAt)
                    index3 = (ji - Mi) ^ 2 + (Ui - Zi) ^ 2
                    if index3 < Ji then
                        Ji, wi, Yi = index3, ji - Mi, Ui - Zi
                    else
                    end
                end
                Ui = wi and sqrt(wi * wi + Yi * Yi) or 0
                if Ui < 0.001 then
                    return 1, 0
                end
                return wi / Ui, Yi / Ui
            end
            local ji = os.clock() + (config.rodinTapBudget or 0.004)
            local function Ui(Ji, wi, Yi, vi, Mi, Zi, ni)
                ni = ni or hi
                local fi = sqrt((Yi - Ji) ^ 2 + (vi - wi) ^ 2)
                local ri, oi, Ai = Mi + fi / speed, Mi, infinity
                while oi <= Zi + 1.0E-6 do
                    local Zi = fi > 0.001 and min((oi - Mi) * speed / fi, 1) or 1
                    local Mi = Ei(Ji + (Yi - Ji) * Zi, wi + (vi - wi) * Zi, oi)
                    if Mi < ni then
                        return nil
                    end
                    Ai = if Mi < Ai then Mi else Ai
                    oi = oi + (oi < ri and li or li * 2)
                end
                return Ai
            end
            local function Ji(wi, Yi, vi, Mi, Zi)
                if (vi - wi) ^ 2 + (Mi - Yi) ^ 2 < 0.25 then
                    return true
                end
                return not context.BB.pathTouchesRed(
                    Vector3.new(wi, vector.Y, Yi),
                    Vector3.new(vi, vector.Y, Mi),
                    speed,
                    yi,
                    Zi
                )
            end
            local function wi(Yi, vi, Mi, Zi, ni, fi)
                local function ri()
                    local oi = Ui(Yi, vi, Yi, vi, Mi, Mi + ui, fi)
                    if oi and contextDangerAt(Yi, vector.Y, vi, Mi, nil, nil, yi) < 0.5 then
                        return oi
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local oi, Ai =
                    {
                        {
                            x = Yi,
                            z = vi,
                            d = 0,
                        },
                    }, { 0, 45, -45, 90, -90, 135, -135, 180 }
                for index3, entry3 in ipairs(Ai) do
                    local ai, ei = cos(toRadians(entry3)), sin(toRadians(entry3))
                    local xi, Ni, Ii = Zi * ai - ni * ei, Zi * ei + ni * ai, { 10, 18, 26 }
                    for index4, entry4 in ipairs(Ii) do
                        ei, index3 = Yi + xi * entry4, vi + Ni * entry4
                        if
                            not (arenaCentre and (ei - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (index3 - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= Ri)
                        then
                            oi[#oi + 1] = {
                                x = ei,
                                z = index3,
                                d = entry4,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
                if config.rodinOrbStayNear ~= false then
                    for index5, entry5 in ipairs(oi) do
                        entry5.k = (entry5.x - position.X) ^ 2 + (entry5.z - position.Z) ^ 2
                    end
                    table.sort(oi, function(ki, xi)
                        if ki.k ~= xi.k then
                            return ki.k < xi.k
                        end
                        return ki.d < xi.d
                    end)
                end
                for index6, entry6 in ipairs(oi) do
                    if entry6.d == 0 then
                        index6 = ri()
                        if index6 then
                            return Yi, vi, index6, 0
                        end
                    else
                        if os.clock() > ji then
                            ni = ri()
                            if ni then
                                return Yi, vi, ni, 0
                            end
                            return nil
                        end
                        Ai = Mi + entry6.d / speed
                        Zi = Ui(Yi, vi, entry6.x, entry6.z, Mi, Ai + ui, fi)
                        if
                            Zi
                            and contextDangerAt(entry6.x, vector.Y, entry6.z, Ai, nil, nil, yi) < 0.5
                            and contextDangerAt(entry6.x, vector.Y, entry6.z, Ai + 0.5, nil, nil, yi) < 0.5
                            and Ji(Yi, vi, entry6.x, entry6.z, Mi)
                        then
                            return entry6.x, entry6.z, Zi, entry6.d
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            zF, rodinGoodVel = hazardReader.rodinGoodVel
            if zF then
                rodinGoodVel = zF
            else
                local setMetatable, weakKeys = setmetatable, {
                    __mode = "k",
                }
                rodinGoodVel = setMetatable({}, weakKeys)
            end
            hazardReader.rodinGoodVel = rodinGoodVel
            local yi, rodinGoodTouch, Yi = config.rodinGoodInset or 5, config.rodinGoodTouch, {}
            for entry7 in pairs(Oi or {}) do
                if entry7.Parent then
                    Si, rodinGoodVel = entry7.Position, hazardReader.rodinGoodVel[entry7]
                    if not rodinGoodVel then
                        rodinGoodVel = {
                            x = Si.X,
                            z = Si.Z,
                            t = touchAt,
                        }
                        hazardReader.rodinGoodVel[entry7] = rodinGoodVel
                    else
                        if touchAt - rodinGoodVel.t > 0.05 then
                            zF = touchAt - rodinGoodVel.t
                            local Mi, Zi = (Si.X - rodinGoodVel.x) / zF, (Si.Z - rodinGoodVel.z) / zF
                            rodinGoodVel.vx, rodinGoodVel.vz =
                                (rodinGoodVel.vx or Mi) * 0.5 + Mi * 0.5, (rodinGoodVel.vz or Zi) * 0.5 + Zi * 0.5
                            rodinGoodVel.x, rodinGoodVel.z = Si.X, Si.Z
                            rodinGoodVel.t = touchAt
                        end
                    end
                    local Mi = rodinGoodVel.vx
                            and sqrt(rodinGoodVel.vx * rodinGoodVel.vx + rodinGoodVel.vz * rodinGoodVel.vz)
                        or 0
                    Mi = if Mi < 4 then config.rodinOrbSpeed or 16 else Mi
                    local touch, ni = position.X - Si.X, position.Z - Si.Z
                    local fi, ri, oi = sqrt(touch * touch + ni * ni), 0, 0
                    if fi > 0.5 then
                        ri, oi = touch / fi * Mi, ni / fi * Mi
                    else
                    end
                    ni = max(entry7.Size.X, entry7.Size.Z) * 0.5
                    touch = max(ni - (config.rodinTapContact or 1.5), 1)
                    local Ai, ki =
                        #Yi + 1, {
                            p = entry7,
                            x = Si.X,
                            z = Si.Z,
                            vx = ri,
                            vz = oi,
                            gR = ni,
                            tr = max(ni - yi, 1),
                            tc = touch,
                            touch = touch,
                        }
                    ki.tH, ki.dB, Yi[Ai] = max(fi - (config.rodinOrbHealR or 2), 0) / Mi, fi, ki
                end
            end
            local function vi(Mi)
                for index3 = 1, #Yi, 1 do
                    if Yi[index3].p == Mi then
                        return Yi[index3]
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function Mi(Zi, ni, fi, ri, oi, Ai)
                local ki = min(ni, Zi.tH)
                local xi, ai, ei, Ni = Zi.x + Zi.vx * ki, Zi.z + Zi.vz * ki
                if oi then
                    local Ii, Fi = Vi(oi, touchAt + ni)
                    ei, Ni = xi - Ii, ai - Fi
                else
                    ei, Ni = vector.X - xi, vector.Z - ai
                end
                ni = sqrt(ei * ei + Ni * Ni)
                if ni < 0.001 then
                    ei, Ni = -Zi.vx, -Zi.vz
                    ni = max(sqrt(ei * ei + Ni * Ni), 0.001)
                else
                end
                ei /= ni
                Ni /= ni
                ki, ni, oi = ei * fi - Ni * ri, ei * ri + Ni * fi, Ai or Zi.tr
                return xi + ki * oi, ai + ni * oi, ki, ni
            end
            local function Zi(ni, fi, ri, oi)
                local Ai, ki, xi, ai = cos(fi), sin(fi), ni.tH + (config.rodinTapPast or 0.5), 0
                while ai <= xi + 1.0E-6 do
                    local fi, xi, ei, Ni = Mi(ni, ai, Ai, ki, ri, oi)
                    if sqrt((fi - vector.X) ^ 2 + (xi - vector.Z) ^ 2) <= speed * ai + 0.3 then
                        return ai, fi, xi, ei, Ni
                    end
                    ai += li
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function Mi(ni, fi, ri, oi, Ai, ki)
                local xi, ai, ei = ki or ni.tr, oi, infinity
                while ai <= Ai + 1.0E-6 do
                    ki = min(ai, ni.tH)
                    oi = Ei(ni.x + ni.vx * ki + fi * xi, ni.z + ni.vz * ki + ri * xi, ai)
                    if oi < hi then
                        return nil
                    end
                    ei = if oi < ei then oi else ei
                    ai = ai + li
                end
                return ei
            end
            local function ni(fi, ri, oi, Ai, ki, xi)
                local ai, ei = oi - fi, Ai - ri
                fi = sqrt(ai * ai + ei * ei)
                if fi < 2 then
                    ai, ei, fi = ki, xi, 1
                else
                end
                return ai / fi, ei / fi
            end
            local fi
            rodinGoodVel = hazardReader.rodinZone
            if
                rodinGoodVel
                and rodinGoodVel.active
                and touchAt - (rodinGoodVel.at or touchAt) < (config.rodinZoneStale or 30)
            then
                fi = rodinGoodVel.explodeAt and max(rodinGoodVel.explodeAt - touchAt, 0)
                    or max((config.rodinZoneFuse or 12.2) - (touchAt - (rodinGoodVel.at or touchAt)), 0)
            else
            end
            local ri = config.rodinTapLate or 0.1
            local function oi(Ai, ki, xi, ai)
                local ei, Ni = sqrt((ki - vector.X) ^ 2 + (xi - vector.Z) ^ 2), 0
                while Ni <= ai + 1.0E-6 do
                    local Ii, Fi = ei > 0.001 and min(Ni * speed / ei, 1) or 1, min(Ni, Ai.tH)
                    local ei, Ci =
                        vector.X + (ki - vector.X) * Ii - (Ai.x + Ai.vx * Fi),
                        vector.Z + (xi - vector.Z) * Ii - (Ai.z + Ai.vz * Fi)
                    if ei * ei + Ci * Ci <= Ai.tc * Ai.tc then
                        return Ni
                    end
                    Ni += 0.02
                end
                return ai
            end
            local Ai = sqrt((vector.X - position.X) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - position.Z) ^ 2)
            local function ki(xi, phi, ref, depth)
                local Ii, Fi, Ci, gi, ii = Zi(xi, toRadians(phi), ref, depth)
                if not Ii then
                    return nil
                end
                if config.rodinTapNearR ~= false then
                    local bi, Bi = max(config.rodinTapNearR or 28, Ai), min(Ii, xi.tH)
                    local Gi, zi = xi.x + xi.vx * Bi, xi.z + xi.vz * Bi
                    if (Gi - position.X) ^ 2 + (zi - position.Z) ^ 2 > bi * bi then
                        return nil
                    end
                end
                local bi = oi(xi, Fi, Ci, Ii)
                if bi > xi.tH - ri then
                    return nil
                end
                local oi = max(Ii, bi + ci)
                if fi and fi < oi * 2.5 + (config.rodinOrbZoneSpare or 3) then
                    return nil
                end
                local Bi = Ui(vector.X, vector.Z, Fi, Ci, 0, Ii)
                if not Bi then
                    return nil
                end
                local Gi = Mi(xi, gi, ii, Ii, oi, depth)
                if not Gi or not Ji(vector.X, vector.Z, Fi, Ci, 0) then
                    return nil
                end
                local zi, si = min(oi, xi.tH), depth or xi.tr
                local Ti, Wi = xi.x + xi.vx * zi + gi * si, xi.z + xi.vz * zi + ii * si
                si, Ii = ni(Ti, Wi, vector.X, vector.Z, gi, ii)
                local zi, Ki, ti, Hi = wi(Ti, Wi, oi, si, Ii)
                if not zi then
                    return nil
                end
                return {
                    g = xi,
                    phi = phi,
                    t = bi,
                    px = Fi,
                    pz = Ci,
                    ux = gi,
                    uz = ii,
                    ex = zi,
                    ez = Ki,
                    dE = Hi,
                    room = min(Bi, Gi, ti),
                    ref = ref,
                    depth = depth,
                }
            end
            local function oi(xi, ai, ei, Ni, Ii, Fi, Ci)
                local gi, ii = sqrt((Ii - ai) ^ 2 + (Fi - ei) ^ 2), Ni
                while ii <= Ci + 1.0E-6 do
                    local bi, Bi = gi > 0.001 and min((ii - Ni) * speed / gi, 1) or 1, min(ii, xi.tH)
                    local Ni, gi =
                        ai + (Ii - ai) * bi - (xi.x + xi.vx * Bi), ei + (Fi - ei) * bi - (xi.z + xi.vz * Bi)
                    if Ni * Ni + gi * gi <= xi.tc * xi.tc then
                        return ii
                    end
                    ii += 0.02
                end
                return Ci
            end
            local function xi(ai, phi, depth)
                local Ii, Fi, Ci =
                    math.atan2(vector.Z - position.Z, vector.X - position.X),
                    math.atan2(ai.z - position.Z, ai.x - position.X),
                    max(config.rodinTapViaR or 18, Ai)
                local gi, ii, bi, Bi, Gi =
                    (Fi - Ii) % 6.283185307179586,
                    cos(toRadians(phi)),
                    sin(toRadians(phi)),
                    depth or ai.tr,
                    config.rodinTapNearR ~= false and max(config.rodinTapNearR or 28, Ai) or nil
                for index3, entry3 in
                    ipairs(gi <= 3.141592653589793 and {
                        Ii + gi * 0.5,
                        Ii - (6.283185307179586 - gi) * 0.5,
                    } or {
                        Ii - (6.283185307179586 - gi) * 0.5,
                        Ii + gi * 0.5,
                    })
                do
                    if os.clock() > ji then
                        return nil
                    end
                    index3, Fi = position.X + cos(entry3) * Ci, position.Z + sin(entry3) * Ci
                    entry3 = sqrt((index3 - vector.X) ^ 2 + (Fi - vector.Z) ^ 2) / speed
                    if
                        not (arenaCentre and (index3 - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (Fi - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= Ri)
                        and entry3 < ai.tH - ri
                    then
                        local mi = Ui(vector.X, vector.Z, index3, Fi, 0, entry3)
                        if mi and Ji(vector.X, vector.Z, index3, Fi, 0) then
                            local Ri, Ii, Ci = ai.tH + (config.rodinTapPast or 0.5), entry3
                            while Ii <= Ri + 1.0E-6 do
                                local gi = min(Ii, ai.tH)
                                local si, Ti = ai.x + ai.vx * gi, ai.z + ai.vz * gi
                                local Wi, Ki = index3 - si, Fi - Ti
                                gi = sqrt(Wi * Wi + Ki * Ki)
                                if gi < 0.001 then
                                    Wi, Ki = -ai.vx, -ai.vz
                                    gi = max(sqrt(Wi * Wi + Ki * Ki), 0.001)
                                else
                                end
                                Wi /= gi
                                Ki /= gi
                                local gi, ti = Wi * ii - Ki * bi, Wi * bi + Ki * ii
                                local ii, bi = si + gi * Bi, Ti + ti * Bi
                                if sqrt((ii - index3) ^ 2 + (bi - Fi) ^ 2) <= speed * (Ii - entry3) + 0.3 then
                                    Ci = {
                                        t = Ii,
                                        px = ii,
                                        pz = bi,
                                        ux = gi,
                                        uz = ti,
                                        gx = si,
                                        gz = Ti,
                                    }
                                    break
                                end
                                Ii += li
                            end
                            if
                                Ci
                                and not (Gi and (Ci.gx - position.X) ^ 2 + (Ci.gz - position.Z) ^ 2 > Gi * Gi)
                            then
                                Ii = oi(ai, index3, Fi, entry3, Ci.px, Ci.pz, Ci.t)
                                Ri = max(Ci.t, Ii + ci)
                                if
                                    Ii <= ai.tH - ri
                                    and not (fi and fi < Ri * 2.5 + (config.rodinOrbZoneSpare or 3))
                                then
                                    local Pi = Ui(index3, Fi, Ci.px, Ci.pz, entry3, Ci.t)
                                    local li = Pi and Mi(ai, Ci.ux, Ci.uz, Ci.t, Ri, depth)
                                    if li and Ji(index3, Fi, Ci.px, Ci.pz, entry3) then
                                        local fi = min(Ri, ai.tH)
                                        local ri, oi =
                                            ai.x + ai.vx * fi + Ci.ux * Bi, ai.z + ai.vz * fi + Ci.uz * Bi
                                        local fi, gi = ni(ri, oi, index3, Fi, Ci.ux, Ci.uz)
                                        local ii, bi, Bi, Gi = wi(ri, oi, Ri, fi, gi)
                                        if ii then
                                            return {
                                                g = ai,
                                                phi = phi,
                                                t = Ii,
                                                px = Ci.px,
                                                pz = Ci.pz,
                                                ux = Ci.ux,
                                                uz = Ci.uz,
                                                ex = ii,
                                                ez = bi,
                                                dE = Gi,
                                                room = min(mi, Pi, li, Bi),
                                                depth = depth,
                                                via = {
                                                    x = index3,
                                                    z = Fi,
                                                },
                                            }
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function Pi(li)
                local mi, Ri = 0
                for index3 = 1, #qi, 1 do
                    local ri, oi = Vi(qi[index3].b, touchAt)
                    local Vi = sqrt((li.x - ri) ^ 2 + (li.z - oi) ^ 2) - li.gR - qi[index3].need
                    if Vi < mi then
                        mi, Ri = Vi, qi[index3].b
                    else
                    end
                end
                return Ri
            end
            local function li(mi)
                for index3 = 1, #qi, 1 do
                    if qi[index3].b == mi then
                        return mi
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function mi(Ri)
                return Ri > 99 and "no red orb near"
                    or ("red orbs %.1f studs past their clearance at the closest"):format(Ri)
            end
            yi = tapState and tapState.phase ~= "out" and vi(tapState.orb) or nil
            if tapState and tapState.phase ~= "out" and not yi then
                vi = touchAt < (tapState.healAt or infinity) - 0.05
                if vi then
                    tapStats.touched = tapStats.touched + 1
                end
                tapState.phase, tapState.why = "out", vi and "tapped it" or "it reached Rodin first"
                tapState.ex = nil
                contextLogT(
                    "greentap",
                    0.3,
                    "Brain",
                    vi and "green orb tapped - stepping back" or "green orb reached Rodin before the tap"
                )
            end
            if tapState and tapState.phase == "touch" and yi then
                if touchAt - tapState.touchAt >= ci then
                    tapState.phase = "out"
                    tapState.why = "on it for the touch"
                    tapState.ex = nil
                else
                    vi, rodinGoodVel = vector.X - yi.x, vector.Z - yi.z
                    Si = sqrt(vi * vi + rodinGoodVel * rodinGoodVel)
                    if Si < 0.5 then
                        vi, rodinGoodVel = -yi.vx, -yi.vz
                        Si = max(sqrt(vi * vi + rodinGoodVel * rodinGoodVel), 0.001)
                    else
                    end
                    vi /= Si
                    rodinGoodVel /= Si
                    local Ri, qi = tapState.touchAt + ci - touchAt, tapState.depth or yi.tr
                    local Vi, fi = Mi(yi, vi, rodinGoodVel, 0, Ri, tapState.depth), min(Ri, yi.tH)
                    local Mi, ri = yi.x + yi.vx * fi + vi * qi, yi.z + yi.vz * fi + rodinGoodVel * qi
                    zF, fi = ni(Mi, ri, tapState.fromX, tapState.fromZ, vi, rodinGoodVel)
                    if Vi and wi(Mi, ri, Ri, zF, fi) then
                        tapState.healAt = touchAt + yi.tH
                        hazardReader.rodinGoodPick = yi.p
                        return {
                            at = touchAt,
                            orb = yi.p,
                            phase = "touch",
                            speed = speed,
                            arrive = 0.3,
                            to = Vector3.new(
                                yi.x + yi.vx * 0.1 + vi * qi,
                                vector.Y,
                                yi.z + yi.vz * 0.1 + rodinGoodVel * qi
                            ),
                            label = ("RODIN GREEN TAP: on the green orb for the touch (%.2fs of %.2fs)"):format(
                                touchAt - tapState.touchAt,
                                ci
                            ),
                        }
                    end
                    tapStats.early = tapStats.early + 1
                    tapState.phase = "out"
                    tapState.why = "a red orb is coming - off it early"
                    tapState.ex = nil
                end
            end
            yi = nil
            if tapState and tapState.phase == "out" then
                vi = min(hi, max(Ei(vector.X, vector.Z, 0), 0))
                if tapState.ex and sqrt((tapState.ex - vector.X) ^ 2 + (tapState.ez - vector.Z) ^ 2) <= 1.5 then
                    Li()
                    tapState = nil
                else
                    zF = false
                    if tapState.ex then
                        Si = sqrt((tapState.ex - vector.X) ^ 2 + (tapState.ez - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                        zF = Ui(vector.X, vector.Z, tapState.ex, tapState.ez, 0, Si / speed + ui, vi)
                                ~= nil
                            and Ji(vector.X, vector.Z, tapState.ex, tapState.ez, 0)
                    else
                    end
                    if not zF then
