                            ni(vector.X, vector.Z, tapState.fromX or vector.X, tapState.fromZ or vector.Z, ui, hi)
                        hi, ui = wi(vector.X, vector.Z, 0, Ri, qi, vi)
                        if not hi then
                            Li("no clear way back out - the red orb standoff has it")
                            tapState = nil
                        else
                            tapState.ex = hi
                            tapState.ez = ui
                            if sqrt((hi - vector.X) ^ 2 + (ui - vector.Z) ^ 2) <= 1.5 then
                                Li()
                                tapState = nil
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if tapState then
                        hazardReader.rodinGoodPick = nil
                        yi = {
                            at = touchAt,
                            orb = tapState.orb,
                            phase = "out",
                            speed = speed,
                            arrive = 0.5,
                            to = Vector3.new(tapState.ex, vector.Y, tapState.ez),
                            label = ("RODIN GREEN TAP: %s - stepping back out of the red orbs' way, %.0f studs"):format(
                                tapState.why or "tapped it",
                                sqrt((tapState.ex - vector.X) ^ 2 + (tapState.ez - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                            ),
                        }
                        if config.rodinTapChain == false then
                            return yi
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            rodinGoodVel, vi = {}, hazardReader.rodinGoodBorn
            for index7 = 1, #Yi, 1 do
                Si = Yi[index7]
                if config.rodinTapBySpawn ~= false then
                    rodinGoodVel[#rodinGoodVel + 1] = {
                        g = Si,
                        sc = vi and vi[Si.p] or Oi and Oi[Si.p] or touchAt,
                        sc2 = Si.dB,
                    }
                elseif config.rodinTapNearFirst ~= false then
                    rodinGoodVel[#rodinGoodVel + 1] = {
                        g = Si,
                        sc = Si.dB,
                    }
                else
                    pi = Zi(Si, 0)
                    if pi then
                        zF = pi * (config.rodinOrbCatchW or 1) + min(Si.tH, 20) * (config.rodinOrbHealW or 0.5)
                        zF = if tapState and tapState.orb == Si.p then zF - (config.rodinOrbStickT or 0.4) else zF
                        rodinGoodVel[#rodinGoodVel + 1] = {
                            g = Si,
                            sc = zF,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(rodinGoodVel, function(ui, hi)
                if ui.sc ~= hi.sc then
                    return ui.sc < hi.sc
                end
                return (ui.sc2 or 0) < (hi.sc2 or 0)
            end)
            Oi = rodinGoodVel[1]
            if config.rodinTapOldestOnly ~= false and config.rodinTapBySpawn ~= false then
                for index8 = #rodinGoodVel, 2, -1 do
                    rodinGoodVel[index8] = nil
                end
            end
            pi, vi = nil
            for index9, entry8 in ipairs(rodinGoodVel) do
                if os.clock() > ji then
                    break
                end
                zF = {}
                if tapState and tapState.orb == entry8.g.p and tapState.phi then
                    zF[1] = {
                        tapState.phi,
                        tapState.ref and li(tapState.ref),
                        tapState.depth,
                    }
                end
                Si = { 0, 40, -40, 80, -80 }
                for index10, entry9 in ipairs(Si) do
                    zF[#zF + 1] = {
                        entry9,
                    }
                end
                local Ri = config.rodinTapInRed ~= false and Pi(entry8.g) or nil
                if Ri then
                    local qi = max(entry8.g.tc - (config.rodinTapInRedDepth or 1), 1)
                    for index11, entry10 in ipairs(config.rodinTapInRedAngles or { 0, 35, -35, 70, -70 }) do
                        zF[#zF + 1] = {
                            entry10,
                            Ri,
                            qi,
                        }
                    end
                    local Vi = { 0, 40, -40, 80, -80 }
                    for index12, entry11 in ipairs(Vi) do
                        zF[#zF + 1] = {
                            entry11,
                            nil,
                            qi,
                        }
                    end
                end
                for index13, entry12 in ipairs(zF) do
                    if index13 > 6 and os.clock() > ji then
                        break
                    end
                    pi = ki(entry8.g, entry12[1], entry12[2], entry12[3])
                    if pi then
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not pi and config.rodinTapRoundRodin ~= false then
                    Ri = { 0, 40, -40 }
                    for index14, entry13 in ipairs(Ri) do
                        if os.clock() > ji then
                            break
                        end
                        pi = xi(entry8.g, entry13, nil)
                        if pi then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                if pi then
                    vi = index9
                    break
                end
            end
            if not pi then
                if Oi and config.rodinTapOldestOnly ~= false then
                    contextLogT(
                        "greentapwait",
                        1,
                        "Brain",
                        ("green orb tap: waiting by Rodin for the one out longest (%.0f studs from him, %d newer out)"):format(
                            Oi.g.dB,
                            #Yi - 1
                        )
                    )
                end
                if yi then
                    return yi
                end
                return (Li(tapState and "no clear way in and back out any more" or nil))
            end
            ki = pi.g
            if not (tapState and tapState.orb == ki.p) then
                tapStats.taps = tapStats.taps + 1
                if vi and vi > 1 then
                    tapStats.passed = (tapStats.passed or 0) + 1
                    contextLogT(
                        "greentapskip",
                        0.5,
                        "Brain",
                        ("green orb tap: %d orb%s out longer had no clear tap in time - on to the next"):format(
                            vi - 1,
                            vi - 1 == 1 and "" or "s"
                        )
                    )
                end
                if yi then
                    tapStats.chained = (tapStats.chained or 0) + 1
                end
                Li, rodinGoodVel, zF =
                    (yi and "green orb tap, straight on from the last touch" or "green orb tap")
                        .. ": in %.0f studs (%s), touching in %.1fs, then %s - %s",
                    pi.px,
                    vector.X
                Oi, xi, li = (rodinGoodVel - zF) ^ 2, pi.pz, vector.Z
                Pi, Si =
                    sqrt(Oi + (xi - li) ^ 2),
                    pi.ref
                        and (
                            pi.phi == 0 and "its side away from the red orb it is in"
                            or ("%d deg round from its side away from the red orb it is in"):format(pi.phi)
                        )
                contextLogT(
                    "greentap",
                    0.3,
                    "Brain",
                    Li:format(
                        Pi,
                        Si
                            or (pi.phi == 0 and "its near side" or ("%d deg round it"):format(pi.phi))
                                .. (pi.depth and ", just inside its edge (it is in a red orb)" or ""),
                        pi.t,
                        pi.dE > 0.5 and ("a step back of %.0f studs"):format(pi.dE) or "standing there",
                        (mi(pi.room))
                    )
                )
                tapState = {
                    orb = ki.p,
                    fromX = vector.X,
                    fromZ = vector.Z,
                }
            else
            end
            tapState.phi, tapState.phase, tapState.healAt, tapState.ex, tapState.ez =
                pi.phi, "in", touchAt + ki.tH, pi.ex, pi.ez
            tapState.ref, tapState.depth = pi.ref, pi.depth
            runtimeState.tapState = tapState
            hazardReader.rodinGoodPick = ki.p
            if sqrt((vector.X - ki.x) ^ 2 + (vector.Z - ki.z) ^ 2) <= ki.touch then
                tapState.phase = "touch"
                tapState.touchAt = touchAt
                return {
                    at = touchAt,
                    orb = ki.p,
                    phase = "touch",
                    speed = speed,
                    arrive = 0.3,
                    to = Vector3.new(
                        ki.x + ki.vx * 0.1 + pi.ux * (pi.depth or ki.tr),
                        vector.Y,
                        ki.z + ki.vz * 0.1 + pi.uz * (pi.depth or ki.tr)
                    ),
                    label = ("RODIN GREEN TAP: on the green orb for the touch (0.00s of %.2fs)"):format(ci),
                }
            end
            return {
                at = touchAt,
                orb = ki.p,
                phase = "in",
                speed = speed,
                arrive = 0.3,
                to = pi.via and Vector3.new(pi.via.x, vector.Y, pi.via.z) or Vector3.new(pi.px, vector.Y, pi.pz),
                label = ("RODIN GREEN TAP: in to tap the green orb%s - %.0f studs, touching in %.1fs, then %s (%s)"):format(
                    pi.via and " - round Rodin, clear of the red orb"
                        or pi.ref and " on its side away from the red orb it is in"
                        or pi.depth and " just inside its edge (it is in a red orb)"
                        or "",
                    sqrt((pi.px - vector.X) ^ 2 + (pi.pz - vector.Z) ^ 2),
                    pi.t,
                    pi.dE > 0.5 and ("a step back of %.0f studs"):format(pi.dE) or "standing there",
                    (mi(pi.room))
                ),
            }
        end
        context.rodinAggroStep = function(y, N, vector, seenAt, Qi, Li)
            if config.rodinAggro == false then
                runtimeState.aggro = nil
                return false
            end
            local aggro = runtimeState.aggro
            if aggro and seenAt - (aggro.seenAt or aggro.at) > 0.3 then
                aggro = nil
                runtimeState.aggro = nil
            else
            end
            local function Si(Di)
                if aggro then
                    contextLogT("rodinaggro", 0, "Brain", "in for an attack: " .. Di)
                    runtimeState.aggroOffUntil = seenAt + (config.rodinAggroRest or 1)
                end
                runtimeState.aggro = nil
                return false
            end
            local vector2, arenaCentre =
                Qi and Qi.isBoss and Qi.root and Qi.root.Parent and Qi.root.Position or nil,
                hazardReader.arenaCentre
            if not (vector2 and arenaCentre and hazardReader.rodinRig and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent) then
                return (Si("called off - Rodin out of view"))
            end
            local _i, li, ci = hazardReader.rodinSweep, hazardReader.rodinSplit, hazardReader.missileLines
            local ui = if Li ~= nil and not Li.soft
                then "something to dodge"
                else if contextColourPinned(seenAt)
                        or hazardReader.rodinZone ~= nil and hazardReader.rodinZone.active
                    then "the colour attack"
                    else if _i
                            and _i.model
                            and _i.model.Parent
                        then "the sweep"
                        else if li
                                and li.model
                                and li.model.Parent
                                and not li.over
                            then "the split"
                            else if rF(seenAt)
                                then "the fan"
                                else if ci
                                        and ci.pick
                                        and seenAt - (ci.at or -infinity) < 0.3
                                    then "the missile lines"
                                    else if hazardReader.rodinFlameRings
                                            and next(hazardReader.rodinFlameRings) ~= nil
                                        then "a ground flame ring"
                                        else if hazardReader.rodinOrbSeenAt ~= nil
                                                and seenAt - hazardReader.rodinOrbSeenAt
                                                    < (config.rodinAggroOrbAfter or 1.5)
                                            then "the red and green orbs"
                                            else nil
            if ui then
                return (Si("called off - " .. ui))
            end
            _i = (
                context.rodinAttackReach and context.rodinAttackReach()
                or context.fireReach and context.fireReach()
                or (config.castStartAt or 44)
            ) - (config.rodinAggroSpare or 3)
            if _i < 8 then
                return (Si("called off - no reach worked out"))
            end
            local ui, hi = a(vector, vector2), config.burstMax or 28
            ci = config.castRootTime or 0.7
            local mi = ci + (config.rodinAggroStay or 0.8)
            local function Ri(yi)
                local qi = 0
                if context.attackReady then
                    local Vi, Ei = context.attackReady()
                    qi = if not Vi then Ei or 0 else qi
                else
                end
                local Vi = 0
                if context.buffState and config.attackNeedsBuffUp ~= false then
                    local Ei, pi, pi = context.buffState(seenAt)
                    if Ei == "gap" then
                        Vi = pi or 0
                    else
                        if Ei == "up" then
                            local Ei = context.buffCooldownLeft and context.buffCooldownLeft(seenAt) or 0
                            Vi = if Ei - yi < (config.attackSkillCdMin or 2) then Ei else Vi
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                return max(qi, Vi)
            end
            if aggro then
                aggro.seenAt = seenAt
                Li = context.lastCastOk and context.lastCastOk()
                    or max(runtimeState.lastQ or -infinity, runtimeState.lastE or -infinity)
                if Li > aggro.at then
                    aggro.castAt = aggro.castAt or Li
                    if seenAt - aggro.castAt >= ci then
                        return (Si(("done - the cast went %.0f studs from Rodin, back out"):format(ui)))
                    end
                end
                if seenAt - aggro.at > (config.rodinAggroMax or 5) then
                    return (Si("called off - it took too long"))
                end
            else
                if ui <= _i or seenAt < (runtimeState.aggroOffUntil or -infinity) then
                    return false
                end
                li = (ui - _i) / hi
                if ui - _i > (config.rodinAggroMaxIn or 45) then
                    return false
                end
                if Ri(li) > max(config.rodinAggroCdAt or 1, li) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            local yi = context.spiralList
                    and context.spiralList(
                        seenAt,
                        (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + (config.rodinSpiralMargin or 1.5)
                    )
                or {}
            local qi = ((config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) - 8) ^ 2
            local function Vi(vector3, pi)
                if (vector3.X - arenaCentre.X) ^ 2 + (vector3.Z - arenaCentre.Z) ^ 2 >= qi then
                    return false
                end
                if pi > 0 and context.BB.pathTouchesRed(vector, vector3, hi) then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    contextDangerAt(vector3.X, vector.Y, vector3.Z, pi) > 0.5
                    or contextDangerAt(vector3.X, vector.Y, vector3.Z, pi + mi * 0.5) > 0.5
                    or contextDangerAt(vector3.X, vector.Y, vector3.Z, pi + mi) > 0.5
                then
                    return false
                end
                if context.redOrbNear and context.redOrbNear(vector3, pi + mi) then
                    return false
                end
                if contextSweepHotAt(vector3.X, vector3.Z, seenAt + pi + mi, seenAt) then
                    return false
                end
                if
                    context.missileLaneAt(vector3.X, vector3.Z, seenAt)
                    or pi > 0 and context.missileLaneCross(vector, vector3, seenAt)
                then
                    return false
                end
                if pi > 0 and context.BB.orbPathSafe and not context.BB.orbPathSafe(vector, vector3, hi) then
                    return false
                end
                if context.BB.orbArrive and context.BB.orbArrive(vector3.X, vector3.Z) <= pi + mi then
                    return false
                end
                if #yi > 0 then
                    if pi > 0 and context.spiralWalkBad(yi, vector, vector3, hi, 0, true) > 0 then
                        return false
                    end
                    if
                        not GF(yi, vector3.X, vector3.Z, pi)
                        or not GF(yi, vector3.X, vector3.Z, pi + mi * 0.5)
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            ci, li = nil
            if aggro and ui <= _i + 0.5 then
                if Vi(vector, 0) then
                    ci, li = vector, 0
                else
                end
            else
                Li = math.atan2(vector.Z - vector2.Z, vector.X - vector2.X)
                for index, entry in ipairs(config.rodinAggroTurns or { 0, 15, -15, 30, -30, 45, -45 }) do
                    index = Li + toRadians(entry)
                    entry = Vector3.new(vector2.X + cos(index) * _i, vector.Y, vector2.Z + sin(index) * _i)
                    index = a(vector, entry)
                    if index <= (config.rodinAggroMaxIn or 45) and Vi(entry, index / hi) then
                        li = index / hi
                        ci = entry
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not ci then
                return (Si("called off - no safe way into his reach"))
            end
            Vi = Ri(li)
            if not aggro then
                aggro = {
                    at = seenAt,
                    seenAt = seenAt,
                }
                runtimeState.aggro = aggro
                contextLogT(
                    "rodinaggro",
                    0,
                    "Brain",
                    ("in for an attack: Rodin %.0f studs off (reach %.0f), the cast ready in %.1fs - in %.0f studs"):format(
                        ui,
                        _i,
                        Vi,
                        a(vector, ci)
                    )
                )
            else
            end
            if li <= 0 then
                aggro.inAt = aggro.inAt or seenAt
                if not aggro.castAt then
                    if Vi > (config.rodinAggroCdAt or 1) + 0.5 then
                        return (Si("called off - the cast is not about ready after all"))
                    end
                    if Vi <= 0 then
                        aggro.readyAt = aggro.readyAt or seenAt
                        if seenAt - aggro.readyAt > (config.rodinAggroHold or 1.5) then
                            return (Si("called off - in reach and ready, but no cast went"))
                        end
                    end
                end
                contextReleaseMover(y, N)
                contextSetState(
                    aggro.castAt
                            and ("RODIN AGGRO: in reach of Rodin (%.0f studs) - the cast is out, back out next"):format(
                                ui
                            )
                        or ("RODIN AGGRO: in reach of Rodin (%.0f studs) - attacking (ready in %.1fs)"):format(
                            ui,
                            Vi
                        )
                )
            else
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                combatBrain.goTo = ci
                combatBrain.goToAt = seenAt
                if not i(y, N, vector, ci, hi, "RODIN AGGRO") then
                    return (Si("called off - the way in is blocked"))
                end
                contextSetState(
                    ("RODIN AGGRO: in for an attack - %.0f studs to his reach (ready in %.1fs), then back out"):format(
                        a(vector, ci),
                        Vi
                    )
                )
            end
            if Qi then
                p(y, N, Qi, seenAt)
            end
            return true
        end
        context.castReadyIn = function(y, N)
            local zF = 0
            if context.attackReady then
                local WF, Qi = context.attackReady()
                zF = if not WF then Qi or 0 else zF
            else
            end
            local WF = 0
            if context.buffState and config.attackNeedsBuffUp ~= false then
                local Qi, Li, Li = context.buffState(y)
                if Qi == "gap" then
                    WF = Li or 0
                else
                    if Qi == "up" then
                        local Qi = context.buffCooldownLeft and context.buffCooldownLeft(y) or 0
                        WF = if Qi - (N or 0) < (config.attackSkillCdMin or 2) then Qi else WF
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            return max(zF, WF)
        end
        context.bobHitEdge = function(y)
            local N = y and y.extent or 0
            if context.aoeShapeNow then
                local y, zF, zF, zF = context.aoeShapeNow()
                if y and zF then
                    return y + zF * 0.5 + N
                end
            end
            return (context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 60) + N
        end
        context.bobStandOut = function(y)
            if config.bobClose == false or config.bobStandOutPhase == false then
                return false
            end
            local N = runtimeState.bobCyc
            if not (N and N.start) then
                return false
            end
            local zF = config.bobRound or 14.9
            if N.periods and #N.periods > 0 then
                local WF = {}
                for index = 1, #N.periods, 1 do
                    WF[index] = N.periods[index]
                end
                table.sort(WF)
                zF = WF[math.floor((#WF + 1) / 2)]
            else
            end
            local WF = (y or os.clock()) - N.start
            if WF < 0 or WF > zF * 3 then
                return false
            end
            N, y = WF % zF, config.bobSpreadAt or 8.5
            return N >= y - (config.bobOutBefore or 2.6) and N <= y + (config.bobOutAfter or 1.2)
        end
        context.bobAggroR = function(y)
            if config.bobClose ~= false and context.bobStandOut(os.clock()) then
                return max(context.bobHitEdge(y) - (config.bobAggroSpare or 5) - 5, config.bobStandOutR or 74)
            end
            if config.bobClose ~= false then
                return max(
                    min(context.bobHitEdge(y) - (config.bobAggroSpare or 5), config.bobStandD or 45),
                    (config.bobCloseKeepOut or 30) + (config.bobAggroKeepIn or 4)
                )
            end
            return max(
                context.bobHitEdge(y) - (config.bobAggroSpare or 5),
                (config.bobKeepOutRadius or 68) + (config.bobAggroKeepIn or 4)
            )
        end
        context.bobCycleTick = function(bobCyc)
            bobCyc = runtimeState.bobCyc
            if not bobCyc then
                bobCyc = {
                    periods = {},
                    spikes = {},
                }
                runtimeState.bobCyc = bobCyc
            else
            end
            local spikeT = hazardReader.lastCircle
            if spikeT and spikeT.t and spikeT.t ~= bobCyc.circleT then
                if not bobCyc.circleT or spikeT.t - bobCyc.circleT > (config.bobChainGap or 2) then
                    local start = spikeT.chainAt or spikeT.t
                    if bobCyc.start and start - bobCyc.start > 10 and start - bobCyc.start < 20 then
                        bobCyc.periods[#bobCyc.periods + 1] = start - bobCyc.start
                        if #bobCyc.periods > 8 then
                            table.remove(bobCyc.periods, 1)
                        end
                    end
                    bobCyc.start = start
                    bobCyc.spikeSeen = false
                end
                bobCyc.circleT = spikeT.t
            end
            spikeT = hazardReader.lastSpikesAt
            if spikeT and spikeT ~= bobCyc.spikeT then
                bobCyc.spikeT = spikeT
                if
                    bobCyc.start
                    and not bobCyc.spikeSeen
                    and spikeT - bobCyc.start > 2.5
                    and spikeT - bobCyc.start < 7
                then
                    bobCyc.spikes[#bobCyc.spikes + 1] = spikeT - bobCyc.start
                    if #bobCyc.spikes > 8 then
                        table.remove(bobCyc.spikes, 1)
                    end
                    bobCyc.spikeSeen = true
                end
            end
            return bobCyc
        end
        context.bobRootOK = function(y, N)
            if config.bobAggroRound == false then
                return true
            end
            local bobCyc = runtimeState.bobCyc
            if not (bobCyc and bobCyc.start) then
                return true
            end
            local function WF(Qi, Li)
                if not Qi or #Qi == 0 then
                    return Li
                end
                Li = {}
                for index = 1, #Qi, 1 do
                    Li[index] = Qi[index]
                end
                table.sort(Li)
                return Li[math.floor((#Li + 1) / 2)]
            end
            local Qi = WF(bobCyc.periods, config.bobRound or 14.9)
            if y - bobCyc.start > Qi * 3 then
                return true
            end
            local Li, Oi, Si =
                WF(bobCyc.spikes, config.bobSpikesAt or 4.3),
                config.bobSpreadAt or 8.5,
                config.bobSideBeamAt or 10.7
            WF = {
                {
                    "his spikes",
                    Li - 0.4,
                    Li + 0.5,
                    true,
                },
                {
                    "the spread beam",
                    Oi - 0.8,
                    Oi + 0.4,
                },
                {
                    "the sideways beam",
                    Si - 0.4,
                    Si + 0.7,
                },
                {
                    "the next circles",
                    Qi - 0.4,
                    Qi + 0.3,
                },
            }
            for index2 = 0, 3, 1 do
                Li = bobCyc.start + index2 * Qi
                for index3, entry in ipairs(WF) do
                    if
                        not (entry[4] and index2 == 0 and bobCyc.spikeSeen)
                        and y < Li + entry[3]
                        and N > Li + entry[2]
                    then
                        return false, entry[1]
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.bobStrafeAt = function(y, N, vector, WF, vector2, Li, Oi)
            if config.bobKeepMoving == false then
                return false
            end
            local Si, Di = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local Pi = sqrt(Si * Si + Di * Di)
            if Pi < 1 then
                return false
            end
            local _i, li, bobStrafe = -Di / Pi, Si / Pi, runtimeState.bobStrafe
            if not bobStrafe or WF - (bobStrafe.at or 0) > (config.bobStrafeFor or 1.4) then
                Pi = nil
                Pi, bobStrafe = bobStrafe, {}
                bobStrafe.side = Pi and -Pi.side or 1
                bobStrafe.at = WF
                runtimeState.bobStrafe = bobStrafe
            else
            end
            Si, Pi = config.burstMax or 28, config.bobStrafeStep or 14
            for index = 1, 2, 1 do
                Di, index =
                    vector.X + _i * bobStrafe.side * Pi - vector2.X,
                    vector.Z + li * bobStrafe.side * Pi - vector2.Z
                local Pi = sqrt(Di * Di + index * index)
                if Pi > 1 then
                    local _i = Vector3.new(vector2.X + Di / Pi * Li, vector.Y, vector2.Z + index / Pi * Li)
                    if Oi(_i, a(vector, _i) / Si) then
                        g(y, N, _i, Si, 1)
                        return true
                    end
                end
                bobStrafe.side = -bobStrafe.side
                bobStrafe.at = WF
            end
            return false
        end
        context.bobOrbWithin = function(vector, N, zF)
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.orbScan or {}) do
                index = entry.part
                if
                    index
                    and index ~= zF
                    and index.Parent
                    and a(vector, index.Position) < N
                    and not (
                        context.crystalShield
                        and context.crystalShield(
                            context.orbColour(index),
                            index.Position.X,
                            index.Position.Z,
                            vector.X,
                            vector.Z,
                            index
                        )
                    )
                then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.circleLaneExit = function(side, vector)
            local circleChain = hazardReader.circleChain
            if
                config.bobChainExit == false
                or not circleChain
                or side - (circleChain.lastAt or -infinity) > (config.bobChainLive or 1.6)
            then
                runtimeState.circleExit = nil
                return nil
            end
            local WF, Qi = circleChain.dx, circleChain.dz
            local Li, Oi, Si = -Qi, vector.X - circleChain.ox, vector.Z - circleChain.oz
            local Di, Pi, _i, li, ci =
                Oi * WF + Si * Qi, Oi * Li + Si * WF, (dangerGeometry.reach or 2.8) + (config.bobChainPad or 6), 0
            for index = 0, (config.bobChainN or 10) - 1, 1 do
                Si, Oi =
                    ((circleChain.size0 or 22) + (circleChain.gr or 6) * index) * 0.5 + _i,
                    Di - (circleChain.sp or 22) * index
                if abs(Oi) < Si then
                    local hi = sqrt(Si * Si - Oi * Oi)
                    if hi > li then
                        li, ci = hi, index
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if li <= 0 or abs(Pi) >= li then
                Si = runtimeState.circleExit
                if Si and Si.chainAt == circleChain.chainAt and config.bobChainReCheck ~= false then
                    Si.started = nil
                end
                return nil
            end
            local circleExit, ui =
                runtimeState.circleExit,
                (circleChain.chainAt or side)
                    + (circleChain.dt or 0.26) * (ci or 0)
                    + (config.bobChainLand or 0.1)
                    - side
            local function ci(hi)
                return hi > (config.bobChainExitMax or 40)
                    or hi > (config.bobChainExitShort or 10)
                        and hi / (config.burstMax or 28) > ui + (config.bobChainExitSlack or 0.3)
            end
            if not (circleExit and circleExit.chainAt == circleChain.chainAt and circleExit.started) then
                if ci(li + 1 - abs(Pi)) then
                    return nil
                end
            end
            circleExit = runtimeState.circleExit
            if not (circleExit and circleExit.chainAt == circleChain.chainAt) then
                circleExit = {
                    chainAt = circleChain.chainAt,
                    side = Pi >= 0 and 1 or -1,
                }
                runtimeState.circleExit = circleExit
            else
            end
            _i = config.burstMax or 28
            for index2 = 1, 2, 1 do
                side = index2 == 1 and circleExit.side or -circleExit.side
                index2, Si =
                    li + 1 - side * Pi,
                    Vector3.new(
                        circleChain.ox + WF * Di + Li * side * (li + 1),
                        vector.Y,
                        circleChain.oz + Qi * Di + WF * side * (li + 1)
                    )
                if
                    not (config.bobChainFarCheck ~= false and side * Pi < 0 and ci(index2))
                    and E(vector, Si)
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe and not context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe(
                        vector,
                        Si,
                        _i
                    ))
                    and not (
                        context.BB
                        and context.BB.wallPathSafe
                        and not context.BB.wallPathSafe(vector, Si, _i, 0)
                    )
                then
                    circleExit.side = side
                    circleExit.started = true
                    return Si, index2, side
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.lastDamagePress = function()
            local y = runtimeState.lastE or -infinity
            return if not (context.isBuffSlot and context.isBuffSlot("q"))
                then max(y, runtimeState.lastQ or -infinity)
                else y
        end
        context.bobSpotOK = function(vector, N, vector2, WF, Qi)
            local Li, Oi, Si =
                config.burstMax or 28,
                config.castRootTime or 0.7,
                Qi and WF or max(WF, context.castReadyIn(N, WF))
            local Di, bobRing = Si + Oi + (config.bobRootPad or 0.2), hazardReader.bobRing
            local function _i(li)
                return li == bobRing
            end
            Oi = config.bobAggroDanger or 0.5
            if
                contextDangerAt(vector2.X, vector.Y, vector2.Z, WF, nil, nil, _i) > Oi
                or contextDangerAt(vector2.X, vector.Y, vector2.Z, (WF + Di) * 0.5, nil, nil, _i) > Oi
                or contextDangerAt(vector2.X, vector.Y, vector2.Z, Di, nil, nil, _i) > Oi
            then
                return false, "an attack there"
            end
            if WF > 0 then
                if context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, vector2, Li) then
                    return false, "an attack in the way"
                end
                if
                    context.BB
                    and context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe
                    and not context.BB.bobOrbPathSafe(vector, vector2, Li)
                then
                    return false, "an orb in the way"
                end
                if not E(vector, vector2) then
                    return false, "a wall or no floor"
                end
            end
            if not Qi and context.bobRootOK then
                Oi, _i = context.bobRootOK(N + Si, N + Di)
                if not Oi then
                    return false, _i
                end
            end
            if config.wallOrbStyle ~= false and context.BB and context.BB.wallBeams then
                Qi = context.BB.wallBeams()
                if #Qi > 0 then
                    if context.BB.onWallBeam(vector2.X, vector2.Z, Di, Qi) then
                        return false, "a moving wall there"
                    end
                    if WF > 0 and not context.BB.wallPathSafe(vector, vector2, Li, 0, Qi) then
                        return false, "a moving wall in the way"
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        context.pkFanCentre = function(y)
            local vector = context.PK and context.PK.fanO
            local zF = y and y.root and y.root.Position.Y or vector and vector.Y or 0
            if vector then
                return Vector3.new(vector.X, zF, vector.Z)
            end
            return Vector3.new(config.pkFanX or 104, zF, config.pkFanZ or 1042)
        end
        context.pkNoHits = function()
            if config.pkSoloStrict == false or not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent()) then
                return false
            end
            local pkNoHitsAt = os.clock()
            if runtimeState.pkNoHitsAt and pkNoHitsAt - runtimeState.pkNoHitsAt < 1 then
                return runtimeState.pkNoHitsV == true
            end
            local N = false
            for index, entry in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                index = entry.Character
                entry = index and (index:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                if entry and entry.Health > 0 and entry.MaxHealth >= (tonumber(config.pkHealerHp) or 4000) then
                    N = true
                    break
                end
            end
            local pkNoHitsV = not N
            runtimeState.pkNoHitsAt = pkNoHitsAt
            runtimeState.pkNoHitsV = pkNoHitsV
            return pkNoHitsV
        end
        context.pkPushCost = function(vector, N, zF, WF, Qi, Li)
            local Oi = context.PK
            if not Oi then
                return nil
            end
            local now, Di, Pi = os.clock(), tonumber(Qi) or 0, 0
            if not WF and Oi.softUntil and now < Oi.softUntil then
                return nil
            end
            WF, Qi = N.X - vector.X, N.Z - vector.Z
            local _i, li, ci = sqrt(WF * WF + Qi * Qi), 0, 0
            if _i > 0.001 then
                li, ci = WF / _i, Qi / _i
            else
            end
            zF = math.max(zF or 16, 8)
            if _i >= 0.3 then
                if Oi.redTouch and Oi.redTouch(vector.X, vector.Z, N.X, N.Z) then
                    return nil
                end
                if Oi.inside and not Oi.inside(N, 0) then
                    if
                        not Li
                        or config.pkCandyThorns == false
                        or context.pkNoHits()
                        or Oi.inArena and not Oi.inArena(N, 0.5)
                    then
                        return nil
                    end
                    Pi = tonumber(config.pkThornCost) or 420
                else
                end
            else
            end
            N, WF = config.pkPad or 2.5, 0
            while true do
                Qi, Li = vector.X + li * WF, vector.Z + ci * WF
                if Oi.nearRoot and Oi.nearRoot(Qi, Li, 1) then
                    return nil
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(Oi.lethal or {}) do
                    if
                        now < entry.landAt + 0.1
                        and (Qi - entry.p.X) ^ 2 + (Li - entry.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry.r + N) ^ 2
                    then
                        return nil
                    end
                end
                if WF >= _i then
                    break
                end
                WF = math.min(WF + 1.5, _i)
            end
            Qi, Li = config.pkDashBody or 1.5, Pi
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(Oi.circles or {}) do
                if now + Di < entry2.hitAt + 0.05 then
                    N = math.min(math.max(entry2.hitAt - now - Di, 0) * zF, _i)
                    index2, WF = vector.X + li * N, vector.Z + ci * N
                    Li = if (index2 - entry2.p.X) ^ 2 + (WF - entry2.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry2.r + Qi) ^ 2
                        then Li + (config.pkCircleDmg or 350)
                        else Li
                else
                end
            end
            Qi = 0
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(Oi.lanes or {}) do
                if now + Di < entry3.untilAt then
                    N = math.min(math.max(entry3.hitAt - now - Di, 0) * zF, _i)
                    index3, WF = vector.X + li * N, vector.Z + ci * N
                    local y, N = index3 - entry3.o.X, WF - entry3.o.Z
                    local zF = y * entry3.ux + N * entry3.uz
                    if
                        zF >= -1
                        and zF <= entry3.len + 1
                        and math.abs(-y * entry3.uz + N * entry3.ux) < entry3.half + 1.5
                    then
                        Li, Qi = Li + (config.pkLineDmg or 840), Qi + 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return Li, Qi
        end
        context.pkPushOk = function(humanoid, N, zF)
            if config.pkPush == false or not N then
                return false
            end
            if (zF or 0) > 0 then
                return false
            end
            if N <= 0 then
                return true
            end
            if context.pkNoHits() then
                return false
            end
            return N <= (config.pkPushMax or 1400)
                and (humanoid and humanoid.Health or 0) - N >= (config.pkPushKeep or 150)
        end
        context.pkCandyFanOk = function(vector, vector2, vector3, WF, Qi)
            if config.pkCandyFanRule ~= true and not context.pkNoHits() then
                return true
            end
            local Li = context.PK
            if not (Li and Li.fanWindow and Li.fanWindow()) then
                return true
            end
            local Oi, Si = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local Di = Oi * Oi + Si * Si
            local Pi = Di > 1.0E-6
                    and math.clamp(((vector3.X - vector.X) * Oi + (vector3.Z - vector.Z) * Si) / Di, 0, 1)
                or 0
            local _i, li = vector.X + Oi * Pi - vector3.X, vector.Z + Si * Pi - vector3.Z
            if sqrt(_i * _i + li * li) >= (config.pkFanCandyFar or 30) then
                return true
            end
            if config.pkFanCandyEarly == false then
                return false
            end
            Pi = os.clock()
            if Li.fanAt and Pi - Li.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2) then
                return false
            end
            Si = Li.nextFan and Li.nextFan()
            if not Si then
                return false
            end
            WF = math.max(WF or 16, 8)
            _i, Oi =
                math.max(sqrt(Di) / WF, (Qi and Qi.landAt or Pi) - Pi) + (config.pkCandyPickT or 0.3),
                math.max(0, (config.pkFanSafeR or 40) - a(vector2, vector3))
            return Pi + _i + Oi / WF + (config.pkFanSpare or 0.6) <= Si + (config.pkFanHitAfter or 0.93)
        end
        context.pkFanSpot = function(vector, vector2)
            local zF = context.PK
            local WF = zF and zF.arena and zF.arena()
            if not WF then
                return nil
            end
            local Qi = (zF.borderDepth and zF.borderDepth() or 0) + (config.pkEdgeIn or 3)
            local Li, Oi, Si, Di = WF.x0 + Qi, WF.x1 - Qi, WF.z0 + Qi, WF.z1 - Qi
            if Oi <= Li or Di <= Si then
                return nil
            end
            local WF = Oi - Li >= Di - Si
            local Pi, _i, li, ci, ui, hi, mi, Ri =
                WF and vector2.X or vector2.Z,
                WF and vector2.Z or vector2.X,
                WF and vector.X or vector.Z,
                WF and vector.Z or vector.X,
                WF and Li or Si,
                WF and Oi or Di,
                WF and Si or Li,
                WF and Di or Oi
            local function yi(qi, Vi)
                if WF then
                    return Vector3.new(qi, vector.Y, Vi)
                end
                return Vector3.new(Vi, vector.Y, qi)
            end
            local WF = hi - Pi
            local qi = Pi - ui
            Qi, Si, Li =
                if math.abs(li - Pi) < (config.pkFanSideTie or 5)
                    then WF >= qi and 1 or -1
                    else li > Pi and 1 or -1,
                config.pkFanSafeR or 40,
                math.max(_i - mi, Ri - _i)
            local function Vi(Ei)
                return Ei > 0 and WF or qi
            end
            _i, Oi =
                (if sqrt(Vi(Qi) ^ 2 + Li ^ 2) < Si and Vi(-Qi) > Vi(Qi) then -Qi else Qi) > 0 and hi or ui,
                config.pkFanSpotIn or 4
            Qi = yi(_i, math.clamp(ci, mi + Oi, Ri - Oi))
            if a(Qi, vector2) < Si then
                zF, li, Di = math.huge, ipairs, {
                    mi + Oi,
                    Ri - Oi,
                }
                Vi = nil
                for key, entry in li(Di) do
                    ci = yi(_i, entry)
                    if a(ci, vector2) >= Si and a(ci, vector) < zF then
                        zF, Vi = a(ci, vector), ci
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not Vi then
                    hi, Pi = yi(_i, mi + Oi), yi(_i, Ri - Oi)
                    Qi = a(hi, vector2) >= a(Pi, vector2) and hi or Pi
                else
                    Qi = Vi
                end
            else
            end
            return Qi
        end
        context.pkFanOutStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi, Li)
            if
                config.pkFanOut == false
                or not (context.PK and context.PK.fanWindow and context.PK.fanWindow())
            then
                return false
            end
            if not (Qi and Qi.isBoss and Qi.root) then
                return false
            end
            local vector2 = context.pkFanCentre(Qi)
            local Si = a(vector, vector2)
            if Si >= (config.pkFanSafeR or 40) then
                return false
            end
            local Di, Pi, _i = context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16
            if Li then
                local li, ci = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
                local ui = sqrt(li * li + ci * ci)
                if ui > 1 then
                    local hi = Vector3.new(vector.X + li / ui * 10, vector.Y, vector.Z + ci / ui * 10)
                    if not context.PK.inside or context.PK.inside(hi, 0) then
                        Pi, _i = hi, "straight out from the boss"
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not Pi then
                Pi, _i = (context.pkFanSpot(vector, vector2)), "to its fan spot"
            else
            end
            if not Pi then
                return false
            end
            local li, ci = Pi.X - vector.X, Pi.Z - vector.Z
            Li = sqrt(li * li + ci * ci)
            if Li < 1 then
                return false
            end
            local Pi, ui, hi, mi =
                li / Li, ci / Li, math.min(Li, config.pkCandyStep or 14), { 0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(mi) do
                li = math.rad(entry)
                index, Li = math.cos(li), math.sin(li)
                local li, mi, yi =
                    Pi * index - ui * Li,
                    Pi * Li + ui * index,
                    entry == 0 and hi or math.min(hi, config.pkCandyDetour or 8)
                index = Vector3.new(vector.X + li * yi, vector.Y, vector.Z + mi * yi)
                if entry == 0 or a(index, vector2) > Si then
                    yi = context.pkPushCost(vector, index, Di, true)
                    if yi then
                        g(y, N, index, Di, 0.3)
                        contextSetState(
                            ("FAN OUT: %s, %.0f from the boss%s%s"):format(
                                _i,
                                Si,
                                entry ~= 0 and ", turned " .. entry .. " deg" or "",
                                yi > 0 and " - through " .. yi .. " HP of hits" or ""
                            )
                        )
                        combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                        p(y, N, Qi, WF)
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        context.pkPoisonOutStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi)
            if
                config.pkPoisonOut == false
                or not (context.PK and context.PK.inside and context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
            then
                return false
            end
            local Li, Oi, Si =
                context.PK, context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16, os.clock()
            for index, entry in ipairs(Li.roots or {}) do
                if Si < entry.untilAt then
                    local _i, li = vector.X - entry.p.X, vector.Z - entry.p.Z
                    index = sqrt(_i * _i + li * li)
                    if index < entry.r + (config.pkRootOutAt or 1.5) then
                        if index < 0.5 then
                            _i, li, index = 1, 0, 1
                        else
                        end
                        local ci = entry.r + (config.pkRootOutTo or 4)
                        local ui = Vector3.new(entry.p.X + _i / index * ci, vector.Y, entry.p.Z + li / index * ci)
                        if Li.redTouch and Li.redTouch(vector.X, vector.Z, ui.X, ui.Z) then
                            local Pi, hi, mi = _i / index, li / index, { 45, -45, 90, -90 }
                            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(mi) do
                                index2 = math.rad(entry2)
                                local mi, Ri =
                                    Pi * math.cos(index2) - hi * math.sin(index2),
                                    Pi * math.sin(index2) + hi * math.cos(index2)
                                entry2 = Vector3.new(
                                    vector.X + mi * (ci - index + 2),
                                    vector.Y,
                                    vector.Z + Ri * (ci - index + 2)
                                )
                                if not Li.redTouch(vector.X, vector.Z, entry2.X, entry2.Z) then
                                    ui = entry2
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        g(y, N, ui, Oi, 0.3)
                        contextSetState(("POISON OUT: away from a vine root, %.0f studs"):format(ci - index))
                        combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                        p(y, N, Qi, WF)
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            if not (Li.borderDepth and Li.borderDepth() > 0) or Li.inside(vector, 0) then
                return false
            end
            Si = Li.clamp(vector, config.pkThornOutIn or 3)
            local Di, Pi = Si.X - vector.X, Si.Z - vector.Z
            Li = sqrt(Di * Di + Pi * Pi)
            if Li < 0.5 then
                return false
            end
            local _i, li, ci, ui, hi = Di / Li, Pi / Li, { 0, 30, -30, 60, -60 }, math.huge
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(ci) do
                Di = math.rad(entry3)
                index3, Si = math.cos(Di), math.sin(Di)
                local Di, ci, Ri =
                    _i * index3 - li * Si, _i * Si + li * index3, math.min(Li / math.max(index3, 0.4), 12)
                index3 = Vector3.new(vector.X + Di * Ri, vector.Y, vector.Z + ci * Ri)
                Ri = context.pkPushCost(vector, index3, Oi, true, nil, true)
                if Ri then
                    Di = Ri + math.abs(entry3) * 3
                    if Di < ui then
                        ui, hi = Di, index3
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not hi then
                return false
            end
            g(y, N, hi, Oi, 0.3)
            contextSetState(("POISON OUT: straight out of the thorns, %.0f studs"):format(Li))
            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
            p(y, N, Qi, WF)
            return true
        end
        context.pkHitStreak = function(pkStreakN)
            local now, pkHpLast = os.clock(), pkStreakN and pkStreakN.Health or 0
            runtimeState.pkHits = runtimeState.pkHits or {}
            if
                runtimeState.pkHpLast
                and pkHpLast > 0
                and pkHpLast < runtimeState.pkHpLast - (config.pkHitMin or 300)
            then
                local WF, Qi = runtimeState.pkHpLast - pkHpLast, false
                for index, entry in ipairs(config.pkPoisonTicks or { 210, 510 }) do
                    Qi = if math.abs(WF - entry) < 3 then true else Qi
                end
                if not Qi then
                    runtimeState.pkHits[#runtimeState.pkHits + 1] = now
                end
            end
            runtimeState.pkHpLast = pkHpLast
            pkStreakN = 0
            for index2 = #runtimeState.pkHits, 1, -1 do
                if now - runtimeState.pkHits[index2] <= (config.pkStreakWin or 3) then
                    pkStreakN += 1
                else
                    table.remove(runtimeState.pkHits, index2)
                end
            end
            runtimeState.pkStreakN = pkStreakN
            return pkStreakN
        end
        context.pkPushStep = function(humanoid, N, vector, WF, Qi)
            if
                config.pkPush == false
                or not (context.PK and context.PK.goal)
                or not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
            then
                return false
            end
            if not (Qi and Qi.isBoss and Qi.root) then
                return false
            end
            if runtimeState.reflex then
                return false
            end
            local Li = context.PK.goal(vector)
            if not Li then
                return false
            end
            local Oi, Si, Di, Pi =
                context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16,
                context.PK.myCandy,
                Li.X - vector.X,
                Li.Z - vector.Z
            local _i = sqrt(Di * Di + Pi * Pi)
            if
                _i > (config.pkCandyFinish or 7)
                and not context.pkCandyFanOk(vector, Li, context.pkFanCentre(Qi), Oi, Si)
            then
                return false
            end
            if
                config.pkFanCoreWait == true
                and context.PK.fanAt
                and os.clock() - context.PK.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
                and a(Li, context.pkFanCentre(Qi)) < (config.pkFanCandyCore or 18)
            then
                return false
            end
            if _i <= (config.pkCandyOn or 1) then
                if Si then
                    Si.onSince = Si.onSince or WF
                    if
                        WF - Si.onSince > (config.pkCandyGiveUp or 2)
                        and WF > (Si.landAt or 0) + (config.pkCandyGiveUp or 2)
                    then
                        Si.skip = true
                        return false
                    end
                end
                local li, ci = context.pkPushCost(vector, vector, Oi)
                if
                    config.pkPush == false
                    or not li
                    or (humanoid and humanoid.Health or 0) - li <= (config.pkPushKeep or 150)
                then
                    return false
                end
                if li > 0 and context.pkNoHits() then
                    return false
                end
                if (ci or 0) > 0 and config.pkPushNoLines == true then
                    return false
                end
                if li > 0 and (runtimeState.pkStreakN or 0) >= (config.pkStreakMax or 2) then
                    return false
                end
                g(humanoid, N, Li, Oi, 0.3)
                contextSetState(
                    ("CANDY PUSH: on the green - waiting for the pickup%s"):format(
                        li > 0 and " (" .. li .. " HP of hits)" or ""
                    )
                )
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                p(humanoid, N, Qi, WF)
                return true
            end
            if Si and _i > 2 then
                Si.onSince = nil
            end
            local li, ci, ui, hi, mi, Ri, yi, qi =
                Di / _i,
                Pi / _i,
                math.min(_i, config.pkCandyDetour or 8),
                humanoid and humanoid.Health or 0,
                Vector3.new(Li.X, vector.Y, Li.Z),
                { 0, 20, -20, 40, -40, 60, -60, 80, -80 },
                math.huge
            Pi, Di = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(Ri) do
                index, Si = Di
                if entry == 0 then
                    local Ri, pi = context.pkPushCost(vector, mi, Oi, false, nil, true)
                    Si = Ri and ((pi or 0) == 0 or config.pkPushNoLines ~= true) and Ri or nil
                    pi = math.min(_i, config.pkCandyStep or 14)
                    Ri = Vector3.new(vector.X + li * pi, vector.Y, vector.Z + ci * pi)
                    Di = Ri
                else
                    Li = math.rad(entry)
                    local Ri, pi = math.cos(Li), math.sin(Li)
                    local Li, ji = li * Ri - ci * pi, li * pi + ci * Ri
                    Ri = Vector3.new(vector.X + Li * ui, vector.Y, vector.Z + ji * ui)
                    ji, Li = context.pkPushCost(vector, Ri, Oi, false, nil, true)
                    local zF, li
                    if ji then
                        zF, li = context.pkPushCost(Ri, mi, Oi, false, ui / math.max(Oi, 8), true)
                    else
                    end
                    pi = ji and zF and (config.pkPushNoLines ~= true or (Li or 0) == 0 and (li or 0) == 0)
                    Si, Di = pi and ji + zF or nil, Ri
                end
                local zF = Si and Si + (entry == 0 and 0 or (config.pkPushTurnCost or 60)) or nil
                if zF and zF < yi then
                    yi, qi, Pi = zF, Si, entry
                else
                    Di = index
                end
            end
            if
                qi
                and config.pkPush ~= false
                and hi - qi > (config.pkPushKeep or 150)
                and not (qi > 0 and (runtimeState.pkStreakN or 0) >= (config.pkStreakMax or 2))
                and not (qi > 0 and context.pkNoHits())
            then
                g(humanoid, N, Di, Oi, 0.3)
                contextSetState(
                    ("CANDY PUSH: green %.0f studs%s%s"):format(
                        _i,
                        Pi ~= 0 and ", turned " .. Pi .. " deg" or "",
                        qi > 0 and " - least damage way, " .. qi .. " HP" or ""
                    )
                )
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                p(humanoid, N, Qi, WF)
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        context.pkStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi)
            if config.pkCandy == false or not (context.PK and context.PK.goal) then
                return false
            end
            if context.BB and context.BB.lethal then
                return false
            end
            if runtimeState.reflex then
                return false
            end
            local vector2 = context.PK.goal(vector)
            if not vector2 then
                return false
            end
            if context.PK.fanWindow and context.PK.fanWindow() and Qi and Qi.root then
                if
                    not context.pkCandyFanOk(
                        vector,
                        vector2,
                        context.pkFanCentre(Qi),
                        context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16,
                        context.PK.myCandy
                    )
                then
                    return false
                end
            end
            local Oi, dash = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
            local Di, Pi, _i =
                sqrt(Oi * Oi + dash * dash),
                context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16,
                context.PK.myCandy
            if _i and Di > 2 then
                _i.onSince = nil
            end
            if Di <= (config.pkCandyOn or 1) then
                if _i then
                    _i.onSince = _i.onSince or WF
                    if
                        WF - _i.onSince > (config.pkCandyGiveUp or 2)
                        and WF > (_i.landAt or 0) + (config.pkCandyGiveUp or 2)
                    then
                        _i.skip = true
                        return false
                    end
                end
                g(y, N, vector2, Pi, 0.3)
                contextSetState("Pumpkin King: on the green candy - waiting for the pickup")
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                p(y, N, Qi, WF)
                return true
            end
            local li, ci, ui, hi, mi =
                math.min(Di, config.pkCandyStep or 14), Oi / Di, dash / Di, { 0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75 }
            Oi = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(hi) do
                index = math.rad(entry)
                dash, _i = math.cos(index), math.sin(index)
                local qi, Vi, Ei =
                    ci * dash - ui * _i,
                    ci * _i + ui * dash,
                    entry == 0 and li or math.min(li, config.pkCandyDetour or 8)
                index = Vector3.new(vector.X + qi * Ei, vector.Y, vector.Z + Vi * Ei)
                if
                    (entry == 0 or not context.PK.inside or context.PK.inside(index, 0))
                    and uF(vector, index, Pi)
                    and not (context.PK.redOnPath and context.PK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, index.X, index.Z))
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, index, Pi))
                then
                    mi, Oi = index, entry
                    break
                end
            end
            hi = not mi
            if
                hi
                and not (context.PK.fanWindow and context.PK.fanWindow())
                and context.PK.dashOk
                and context.PK.dashOk(vector, vector2, Pi, os.clock())
            then
                li, dash =
                    context.PK, {
                        q = vector2,
                        p = context.PK.myCandy,
                    }
                dash.untilAt, li.dash = os.clock() + Di / math.max(Pi, 8) + (config.pkDashSlack or 0.6), dash
                g(y, N, vector2, Pi, 0.3)
                contextSetState(("CANDY DASH: in and out for a green, %.0f studs"):format(Di))
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                return true
            end
            if hi then
                g(y, N, vector, Pi, 1)
                contextSetState(
                    ("Pumpkin King: green candy %.0f studs - waiting for the way to clear"):format(Di)
                )

            return true

        context.pkHealStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi)
            if config.pkHealer == false or not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent()) then
                return false
            end
            if context.BB and (context.BB.lethal or context.BB.goal ~= nil) then
                return false
            end
            if runtimeState.reflex then
                return false
            end
            if context.PK and context.PK.fanWindow and context.PK.fanWindow() then
                return false
            end
            if config.pkHealWalk ~= true then
                return false
            end
            local Li, Oi, Si =
                ipairs, {
                    localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                    localPlayer.Character,
                }, false
            for key, entry in Li(Oi) do
                if entry then
                    for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Chain Heal" then
                            Si = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                if Si then
                    break
                end
            end
            if not Si then
                return false
            end
            local Si, Di, Pi, _i, position = 0, 0, 0
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if entry2 ~= localPlayer then
                    index2 = entry2.Character
                    Oi, Li =
                        index2 and (index2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                        index2 and (index2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    if Oi and Li and Oi.Health > 0 and Oi.MaxHealth > 0 then
                        local ci = Oi.Health / Oi.MaxHealth
                        Si += Li.Position.X
                        Di += Li.Position.Z
                        Pi += 1
                        if ci < (config.pkHealBelow or 0.95) and (not _i or ci < _i) then
                            _i, position = ci, Li.Position
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not position then
                return false
            end
            local Li, Si, Di = config.pkHealNear or 12, position.X - vector.X, position.Z - vector.Z
            Oi = sqrt(Si * Si + Di * Di)
            if Oi <= Li then
                return false
            end
            local Pi, ci =
                context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(WF) or config.tweenWalk or 16,
                math.min(Oi - Li * 0.5, config.pkCandyStep or 14)
            if ci < 1 then
                return false
            end
            Li = Vector3.new(vector.X + Si / Oi * ci, vector.Y, vector.Z + Di / Oi * ci)
            if
                not uF(vector, Li, Pi)
                or context.BB
                    and context.BB.pathBlocked
                    and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Li, Pi)
            then
                return false
            end
            if context.PK and context.PK.redOnPath and context.PK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, Li.X, Li.Z) then
                return false
            end
            g(y, N, Li, Pi, 1)
            contextSetState(
                ("Pumpkin King: healer - to %s, %.0f studs"):format(
                    position and ("a teammate on %d%%"):format(math.floor(_i * 100)) or "the team",
                    Oi
                )
            )
            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
            p(y, N, Qi, WF)
            return true
        end
        local function y(N, zF, vector, Qi, Li, Oi, Si, Di, Pi)
            local _i, li = Oi.X - vector.X, Oi.Z - vector.Z
            local ci, ui =
                sqrt(_i * _i + li * li), context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(Qi) or config.tweenWalk or 16
            if ci <= (config.pkMarkerSlack or 2.5) then
                g(N, zF, vector, ui, 1)
                contextSetState(Si)
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                p(N, zF, Li, Qi)
                return true
            end
            local Si, hi, mi, Ri =
                math.min(ci, config.pkCandyStep or 14), _i / ci, li / ci, { 0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75 }
            for index, entry in ipairs(Ri) do
                _i = math.rad(entry)
                index, li = math.cos(_i), math.sin(_i)
                local Ri, Vi, Ei =
                    hi * index - mi * li,
                    hi * li + mi * index,
                    entry == 0 and Si or math.min(Si, config.pkCandyDetour or 8)
                Oi = Vector3.new(vector.X + Ri * Ei, vector.Y, vector.Z + Vi * Ei)
                if
                    uF(vector, Oi, ui)
                    and not (context.PK and context.PK.redOnPath and context.PK.redOnPath(
                        vector.X,
                        vector.Z,
                        Oi.X,
                        Oi.Z
                    ))
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Oi, ui))
                then
                    g(N, zF, Oi, ui, 0.3)
                    contextSetState(("%s, %.0f studs"):format(Di, ci))
                    combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                    p(N, zF, Li, Qi)
                    return true
                end
            end
            Si = math.min(ci, config.pkCandyDetour or 8)
            Oi = Vector3.new(vector.X + hi * Si, vector.Y, vector.Z + mi * Si)
            mi, _i = context.pkPushCost(vector, Oi, ui, Pi)
            if mi and (Pi or context.pkPushOk(N, mi, _i)) then
                g(N, zF, Oi, ui, 0.3)
                contextSetState(("%s, %.0f studs - pushing through"):format(Di, ci))
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                p(N, zF, Li, Qi)
                return true
            end
            g(N, zF, vector, ui, 1)
            contextSetState(("%s, %.0f studs - waiting for the way to clear"):format(Di, ci))
            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
            p(N, zF, Li, Qi)
            return true
        end
        context.pkPreStep = function(N, zF, vector, Qi)
            if
                config.pkPreWalk == false
                or config.pkMarkerMode == false
                or not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent())
                or not context.pkSpreadStep
            then
                return false
            end
            if context.runComplete and context.runComplete() then
                return false
            end
            local dungeonProgress = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
            local Oi = dungeonProgress and tostring(dungeonProgress.Value) or ""
            if Oi ~= "" and Oi ~= "playersNotReady" and Oi ~= "inProgress" then
                return false
            end
            local Si, Di, success =
                config.pkBossX or 120.9, config.pkBossZ or 1047.3, workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
            local _i = success and (success:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
            if _i then
                Oi = _i:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if Oi and Oi.MaxHealth > 0 and Oi.Health <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                success, dungeonProgress = pcall(function()
                    return (_i:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or _i.PrimaryPart).Position
                end)
                if success and dungeonProgress then
                    Si, Di = dungeonProgress.X, dungeonProgress.Z
                else
                end
            else
            end
            success = {
                isBoss = true,
                pre = true,
                root = {
                    Position = Vector3.new(Si, vector.Y, Di),
                },
            }
            if not context.pkSpreadStep(N, zF, vector, Qi, success) then
                return false
            end
            contextSetState("before the boss: " .. tostring(runtimeState.movementState))
            return true
        end
