                qi = if li > 0.001
                    then math.min(qi, (mi - position.X) / li)
                    else if li < -0.001 then math.min(qi, (hi - position.X) / li) else qi
                qi = if ci > 0.001
                    then math.min(qi, (yi - position.Z) / ci)
                    else if ci < -0.001 then math.min(qi, (Ri - position.Z) / ci) else qi
                ui = if qi < ui then math.max(qi, 4) else ui
            else
            end
            _i = Vector3.new(position.X + li * ui, vector.Y, position.Z + ci * ui)
            y, ci = _i.X - vector.X, _i.Z - vector.Z
            _i, li = sqrt(y * y + ci * ci), context.planSpeed and context.planSpeed(Qi) or config.tweenWalk or 16
            if _i <= (config.pkSpotSlack or 4) then
                g(N, zF, vector, li, 1)
                contextSetState(
                    ("Pumpkin King: on its edge spot %d of %d, %.0f from the boss"):format(
                        Pi,
                        Di,
                        a(vector, position)
                    )
                )
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                Oi(N, zF, Li, Qi)
                return true
            end
            local ui, hi, mi, Ri, yi =
                math.min(_i, config.pkCandyStep or 14), y / _i, ci / _i, { 0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 75, -75 }
            ci = 0
            for index9, entry7 in ipairs(Ri) do
                index9 = math.rad(entry7)
                local Ri, Vi = math.cos(index9), math.sin(index9)
                local y, Ei, pi =
                    hi * Ri - mi * Vi,
                    hi * Vi + mi * Ri,
                    entry7 == 0 and ui or math.min(ui, config.pkCandyDetour or 8)
                Ri = Vector3.new(vector.X + y * pi, vector.Y, vector.Z + Ei * pi)
                if
                    uF(vector, Ri, li)
                    and not (context.PK and context.PK.redOnPath and context.PK.redOnPath(
                        vector.X,
                        vector.Z,
                        Ri.X,
                        Ri.Z
                    ))
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.pathBlocked and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Ri, li))
                then
                    yi, ci = Ri, entry7
                    break
                end
            end
            if not yi then
                return false
            end
            g(N, zF, yi, li, 0.3)
            contextSetState(
                ("Pumpkin King: to its edge spot %d of %d, %.0f studs (%.0f from the boss)%s"):format(
                    Pi,
                    Di,
                    _i,
                    a(vector, position),
                    ci ~= 0 and ", round a zone " .. ci .. " deg" or ""
                )
            )
            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
            Oi(N, zF, Li, Qi)
            return true
        end
        context.bobAggroStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi, Li)
            if config.bobAggro == false then
                runtimeState.bobAggro = nil
                return false
            end
            if
                not (
                    Qi
                    and Qi.isBoss
                    and Qi.model
                    and Qi.root
                    and Qi.root.Parent
                    and context.bossProfile(Qi.model.Name).orbs
                )
            then
                runtimeState.bobAggro = nil
                return false
            end
            context.bobCycleTick(WF)
            local bobAggro = runtimeState.bobAggro
            if bobAggro and WF - (bobAggro.seenAt or bobAggro.at) > 0.3 then
                bobAggro = nil
                runtimeState.bobAggro = nil
            else
            end
            local function Si(Di)
                if bobAggro then
                    contextLogT("bobaggro", 0, "Brain", "in for an attack: " .. Di)
                    runtimeState.bobAggroOffUntil = WF + (config.bobAggroRest or 0.8)
                end
                runtimeState.bobAggro = nil
                return false
            end
            if hazardReader.orbLead then
                return (Si("called off - leading an orb"))
            end
            if Li ~= nil and not Li.soft or context.BB and (context.BB.lethal or context.BB.goal ~= nil) then
                return (Si("called off - something to dodge"))
            end
            if runtimeState.reflex then
                return (Si("called off - a reflex"))
            end
            if context.bobOrbWithin(vector, config.bobAggroOrbClear or 34, nil) then
                return (Si("called off - an orb close"))
            end
            if config.wallOrbStyle ~= false and context.BB and context.BB.onWallBeam then
                if context.BB.onWallBeam(vector.X, vector.Z, 0) then
                    return (Si("called off - a moving wall on us"))
                end
            elseif context.wallOffYellow and context.wallOffYellow(vector, WF) then
                return (Si("called off - a moving wall"))
            end
            local position, Pi = Qi.root.Position, context.bobAggroR(Qi)
            local _i, li, ci = a(vector, position), config.burstMax or 28, config.castRootTime or 0.7
            if bobAggro then
                bobAggro.seenAt = WF
                Li = context.lastDamagePress()
                if Li >= bobAggro.at then
                    bobAggro.castAt = bobAggro.castAt or Li
                    if WF - bobAggro.castAt >= ci then
                        return (Si(("done - the cast went %.0f studs from Bob"):format(_i)))
                    end
                end
                if WF - bobAggro.at > (config.bobAggroMax or 5) then
                    return (Si("called off - it took too long"))
                end
            else
                if _i <= Pi + 0.5 or WF < (runtimeState.bobAggroOffUntil or -infinity) then
                    return false
                end
                if _i - Pi > (config.bobAggroMaxIn or 60) then
                    return false
                end
                local ui = (_i - Pi) / li
                if context.castReadyIn(WF, ui) > max(config.bobAggroCdAt or 1, ui) then
                    return false
                end
            end
            local ui = bobAggro ~= nil and bobAggro.castAt ~= nil
            local function hi(mi, Ri)
                return (context.bobSpotOK(vector, WF, mi, Ri, ui))
            end
            ci, Li = nil
            if bobAggro and _i <= Pi + 1.5 then
                if hi(vector, 0) then
                    ci, Li = vector, 0
                else
                end
            else
                local ui = math.atan2(vector.Z - position.Z, vector.X - position.X)
                for index, entry in ipairs(config.bobAggroTurns or { 0, 15, -15, 30, -30, 45, -45 }) do
                    index = ui + toRadians(entry)
                    entry = Vector3.new(position.X + cos(index) * Pi, vector.Y, position.Z + sin(index) * Pi)
                    index = a(vector, entry)
                    if index <= (config.bobAggroMaxIn or 60) and hi(entry, index / li) then
                        ci, Li = entry, index / li
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not ci then
                if not bobAggro then
                    runtimeState.bobAggroOffUntil = WF + (config.bobAggroRetry or 0.3)
                end
                return (Si("called off - no safe way into his reach"))
            end
            local ui = context.castReadyIn(WF, Li)
            if not bobAggro then
                bobAggro = {
                    at = WF,
                    seenAt = WF,
                }
                runtimeState.bobAggro = bobAggro
                contextLogT(
                    "bobaggro",
                    0,
                    "Brain",
                    ("in for an attack: Bob %.0f studs off (in at %.0f), the cast ready in %.1fs - %.0f studs in"):format(
                        _i,
                        Pi,
                        ui,
                        a(vector, ci)
                    )
                )
            else
            end
            runtimeState.bobAggroAt = WF
            if Li <= 0 then
                if not bobAggro.castAt then
                    if ui > (config.bobAggroCdAt or 1) + 0.5 then
                        return (Si("called off - the cast is not about ready after all"))
                    end
                    if ui <= 0 then
                        bobAggro.readyAt = bobAggro.readyAt or WF
                        if WF - bobAggro.readyAt > (config.bobAggroHold or 1.5) then
                            return (Si("called off - in reach and ready, but no cast went"))
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not context.bobStrafeAt(y, N, vector, WF, position, Pi, hi) then
                    contextReleaseMover(y, N)
                end
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                contextSetState(
                    bobAggro.castAt
                            and ("BOB AGGRO: in his reach (%.0f studs) - the cast is out, back to the usual next"):format(
                                _i
                            )
                        or ("BOB AGGRO: in his reach (%.0f studs), moving round him - attacking (ready in %.1fs)"):format(
                            _i,
                            ui
                        )
                )
            else
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                combatBrain.goTo = ci
                combatBrain.goToAt = WF
                if not i(y, N, vector, ci, li, "BOB AGGRO") then
                    return (Si("called off - the way in is blocked"))
                end
                contextSetState(
                    ("BOB AGGRO: in for an attack - %.0f studs to his reach (%.0f out, ready in %.1fs)"):format(
                        a(vector, ci),
                        _i,
                        ui
                    )
                )
            end
            p(y, N, Qi, WF)
            return true
        end
        context.bobLeadWait = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi, Li, Oi)
            if config.bobAggro == false or config.bobLeadWait == false then
                runtimeState.bobLeadWait = nil
                return false
            end
            if
                not (
                    Li
                    and Li.orb
                    and Li.colour
                    and Qi
                    and Qi.isBoss
                    and Qi.model
                    and Qi.root
                    and Qi.root.Parent
                    and context.bossProfile(Qi.model.Name).orbs
                )
            then
                return false
            end
            context.bobCycleTick(WF)
            local bobLeadWait = runtimeState.bobLeadWait
            if bobLeadWait and bobLeadWait.orb ~= Li.orb then
                bobLeadWait = nil
                runtimeState.bobLeadWait = nil
            else
            end
            if bobLeadWait and bobLeadWait.over then
                return false
            end
            local function Di(Pi)
                if bobLeadWait then
                    bobLeadWait.over = true
                    contextLogT(
                        "bobaggro",
                        0,
                        "Brain",
                        ("waiting in reach for the %s orb: %s"):format(tostring(Li.colour), Pi)
                    )
                end
                return false
            end
            local orb = Li.orb
            if not orb.Parent then
                return (Di("the orb is gone"))
            end
            local position, li = Qi.root.Position, context.bobAggroR(Qi)
            local ci = a(vector, position)
            if not bobLeadWait and ci > li + (config.bobLeadWaitFrom or 12) then
                return false
            end
            if Oi and Oi < (config.bobLeadWaitFuse or 6) then
                return (Di("the fuse is short"))
            end
            if context.BB and context.BB.lethal then
                return (Di("something to dodge"))
            end
            local position2 = orb.Position
            if context.bobOrbWithin(vector, config.bobLeadOtherOrb or 30, orb) then
                return (Di("another orb close"))
            end
            Oi = context.bobCrystal and context.bobCrystal(Li.colour)
            if not Oi then
                return false
            end
            local hi, mi = config.burstMax or 28, config.orbSpeed or 17
            local Ri = config.bobLeadLeaveGap or 26
            local yi, qi = config.castRootTime or 0.7, false
            if bobLeadWait then
                bobLeadWait.seenAt = WF
                local Vi = context.lastDamagePress()
                if Vi >= bobLeadWait.at then
                    bobLeadWait.castAt = bobLeadWait.castAt or Vi
                    if WF - bobLeadWait.castAt >= yi then
                        return (Di("done - the cast went, on to the crystal"))
                    end
                    qi = true
                else
                end
                if WF - bobLeadWait.at > (config.bobLeadWaitMax or 6) then
                    return (Di("it took too long"))
                end
            else
            end
            local Vi, Ei = math.atan2(Oi.Z - position.Z, Oi.X - position.X), {}
            if ci <= li + 1.5 then
                Oi = math.atan2(vector.Z - position.Z, vector.X - position.X)
                if
                    math.abs((Oi - Vi + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793)
                    <= toRadians(config.bobLeadWaitLine or 35)
                then
                    Ei[#Ei + 1] = vector
                end
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(config.bobLeadWaitTurns or { 0, 15, -15, 30, -30 }) do
                index = Vi + toRadians(entry)
                Ei[#Ei + 1] = Vector3.new(position.X + cos(index) * li, vector.Y, position.Z + sin(index) * li)
            end
            local pi, vector2, Ui = infinity
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(Ei) do
                Oi = a(vector, entry2)
                index2 = Oi > 1.5 and Oi / hi or 0
                if Oi < pi and Oi <= (config.bobLeadWaitMaxIn or 30) then
                    Vi = qi and index2 or max(index2, context.castReadyIn(WF, index2))
                    local Ei = (qi and max(bobLeadWait.castAt + yi - WF, index2) or Vi + yi)
                        + (config.bobRootPad or 0.2)
                    if
                        sqrt((position2.X - entry2.X) ^ 2 + (position2.Z - entry2.Z) ^ 2)
                                - mi * Ei
                            >= Ri
                        and Vi <= (config.bobLeadWaitCd or 4)
                        and context.bobSpotOK(vector, WF, entry2, index2, qi)
                    then
                        pi, vector2, Ui = Oi, entry2, index2
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not vector2 then
                return (Di("the orb would be on us before the cast is done"))
            end
            if not bobLeadWait then
                bobLeadWait = {
                    orb = orb,
                    at = WF,
                    seenAt = WF,
                }
                runtimeState.bobLeadWait = bobLeadWait
                contextLogT(
                    "bobaggro",
                    0,
                    "Brain",
                    ("waiting in reach for the %s orb: it is %.0f off, the cast ready in %.1fs"):format(
                        tostring(Li.colour),
                        Li.orbD or 0,
                        context.castReadyIn(WF, Ui)
                    )
                )
            else
            end
            runtimeState.bobAggroAt = WF
            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
            if Ui > 0 then
                if not i(y, N, vector, vector2, hi, "BOB AGGRO") then
                    return (Di("the way in is blocked"))
                end
            elseif
                not context.bobStrafeAt(y, N, vector, WF, position, li, function(vector3, Si)
                    return sqrt((position2.X - vector3.X) ^ 2 + (position2.Z - vector3.Z) ^ 2)
                                - mi * (Si + yi)
                            >= Ri
                        and context.bobSpotOK(vector, WF, vector3, Si, qi)
                end)
            then
                contextReleaseMover(y, N)
            end
            contextSetState(
                ("lead %s orb %.0f: waiting in Bob's reach for it (%.0f from him, %s), then to the crystal%s"):format(
                    tostring(Li.colour),
                    Li.orbD or 0,
                    ci,
                    qi and "the cast is out" or ("ready in %.1fs"):format(context.castReadyIn(WF, 0)),
                    Li.fuseLeft and (" [fuse %.0fs]"):format(math.max(Li.fuseLeft, 0)) or ""
                )
            )
            p(y, N, Qi, WF)
            return true
        end
        context.bobApproachSpeed = function(y, N, bobAggroAt)
            if config.bobAggro == false or config.bobFastApproach == false then
                return nil
            end
            if not (y and y.isBoss and y.model and context.bossProfile(y.model.Name).orbs) then
                return nil
            end
            local WF = config.burstMax or 28
            if
                N - context.bobAggroR(y) > (config.bobAggroMaxIn or 60)
                or bobAggroAt < (runtimeState.bobAggroOffUntil or -infinity)
            then
                return nil
            end
            local Qi = max(N - context.bobHitEdge(y), 0) / WF
            y = context.castReadyIn(bobAggroAt, Qi)
            if y > Qi + (config.bobAggroCdAt or 1) then
                return nil
            end
            N = max(Qi, y)
            if
                context.bobRootOK
                and not context.bobRootOK(
                    bobAggroAt + N,
                    bobAggroAt + N + (config.castRootTime or 0.7) + (config.bobRootPad or 0.2)
                )
            then
                return nil
            end
            runtimeState.bobAggroAt = bobAggroAt
            return WF
        end
        context.bobAggroHomeTick = function(position, N, zF)
            runtimeState.bobAggroHome = nil

            if

            context.bobCycleTick(N)

            position = zF.root.Position

            }

        context.bobBuffNow = function(y)
            if config.bobAggro == false or config.bobBuffTiming == false then
                return true
            end
            local N, character = combatBrain.target, localPlayer.Character
            y = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            if not (N and N.isBoss and N.root and N.root.Parent and y) then
                return true

            local WF, Qi =
                max(a(y.Position, N.root.Position) - context.bobHitEdge(N), 0) / (config.burstMax or 28), 0
            if config.bobBuffEarly ~= false and WF >= (config.bobBuffEarlyFrom or 6.5) then
                return true

            if context.attackReady then
                N, character = context.attackReady()
                Qi = if not N then character or 0 else Qi
            else
            end
            return max(WF, Qi) <= (config.bobBuffWindow or 4) - (config.bobBuffSpare or 1.2)
        end
        context.bobReachLean = function(y, N, target)
            if config.bobEscapeLean == false or not context.bobPullTo(target) then
                return nil
            end
            target = combatBrain.target
            if not (target and target.isBoss and target.root and target.root.Parent) then

            y = sqrt(Qi * Qi + Li * Li)

        end

        context.odinRoomRouteStep = function(y, N, vector, WF, Qi, Li)
            if config.odinRoomRoute ~= true or not (Qi and not Qi.isBoss) then
                return false
            end
            if vector.Y < 5 or vector.Y > 45 then
                return false
            end
            if not (context.WALLS and context.WALLS.inNorthernLands and context.WALLS.inNorthernLands()) then
                hazardReader.odinRoute = nil
                return false
            end
            local Oi, Si, Di, Pi, _i, li = 787.1327, 36.0341, 0.95008, -0.31199, 0.31199, 0.95008
            local best, ui = vector.X - Oi, vector.Z - Si
            local hi, mi, odinRoute = best * Di + ui * Pi, best * _i + ui * li, hazardReader.odinRoute
            if
                hi < -168
                and hi > -215
                and abs(mi) < 40
                and (not odinRoute or odinRoute.done or odinRoute.i > 1)
            then
                odinRoute = {
                    side = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1,
                    i = 1,
                    armAt = WF,
                }
                hazardReader.odinRoute = odinRoute
                contextLogT(
                    "odinroute",
                    0,
                    "Brain",
                    ("room before Odin: the way round the mobs on the %s side"):format(
                        odinRoute.side < 0 and "top" or "bottom"
                    )
                )
            else
            end
            if not odinRoute or odinRoute.done then
                return false
            end
            if hi > 30 or hi < -215 or abs(mi) > 160 then
                odinRoute.done = true
                return false
            end
            if config.meleeEscape ~= false then
                ui = (config.meleeEscapeAt or 36) ^ 2
                for index, enemy in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies) do
                    if
                        enemy.melee
                        and not enemy.isBoss
                        and enemy.root
                        and enemy.root.Parent
                        and enemy.humanoid
                        and enemy.humanoid.Health > 0
                    then
                        best, mi = enemy.root.Position.X - vector.X, enemy.root.Position.Z - vector.Z
                        if best * best + mi * mi < ui then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            hi, ui, mi, best = config.odinRoutePoints
                or {
                    { -160, 0 },
                    { -130, 61 },
                    { -25, 61 },
                    { 8, 5 },
                }
            while true do
                local yi, qi = odinRoute.i, #hi
                if not (yi <= qi) then
                    break
                end
                yi = hi[odinRoute.i]
                local qi, Vi = yi[1], yi[2] * odinRoute.side
                ui, mi = Oi + qi * Di + Vi * _i, Si + qi * Pi + Vi * li
                best = sqrt((ui - vector.X) ^ 2 + (mi - vector.Z) ^ 2)
                if
                    best > (config.odinRouteArrive or 6)
                    and not (odinRoute.bestAt and WF - odinRoute.bestAt > (config.odinRouteStall or 4))
                then
                    break
                end
                if best > (config.odinRouteArrive or 6) then
                    contextLogT(
                        "odinroute",
                        0,
                        "Brain",
                        ("room before Odin: point %d of %d skipped - no progress for %.0fs"):format(
                            odinRoute.i,
                            #hi,
                            config.odinRouteStall or 4
                        )
                    )
                end
                odinRoute.i = odinRoute.i + 1
                odinRoute.best = nil
                odinRoute.bestAt = nil
            end
            if odinRoute.i > #hi then
                odinRoute.done = true
                contextLogT(
                    "odinroute",
                    0,
                    "Brain",
                    "room before Odin: round the mobs - the brain has it from here"
                )
                return false
            end
            if not odinRoute.best or best < odinRoute.best - 1.5 then
                odinRoute.best = best
                odinRoute.bestAt = WF
            end
            if contextEngageReady(vector, Qi, Li) then
                p(y, N, Qi, WF)
            end
            qF(
                y,
                N,
                Vector3.new(ui, vector.Y, mi),
                e(),
                ("ROOM BEFORE ODIN: the way round the mobs on the %s side, point %d of %d, %.0f to go"):format(
                    odinRoute.side < 0 and "top" or "bottom",
                    odinRoute.i,
                    #hi,
                    best
                ),
                Qi.model
            )
            return true
        end
        context.danceAnimId = function(y)
            if type(y) == "number" then
                return y
            end
            local N = tonumber(string.match(tostring(y), "^catalog:(%d+)$"))
            if not N then
                return tonumber(y) or 10370351535
            end
            runtimeState.danceIds = runtimeState.danceIds or {}
            if runtimeState.danceIds[N] ~= nil then
                return runtimeState.danceIds[N] or 10370351535
            end
            local y
            local function zF()
                local iterateArray, Qi, Li = ipairs, game, tostring(N)
                local Oi = vmHelpers[127](Qi:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. Li))
                for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(Oi)) do
                    key = entry:IsA("Animation") and entry or entry:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
                    if key then
                        y = tonumber(string.match(tostring(key.AnimationId), "(%d+)"))
                    end
                    Li = y
                    if Li then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(zF)
            runtimeState.danceIds[N] = y or false
            zF = not y and context.logT
            if zF then
                context.logT(
                    "dance",
                    60,
                    "Alt Farm",
                    "the emote " .. tostring(N) .. " would not load - dancing the Cartwheel instead"
                )
            end
            zF = y or 10370351535
            return zF
        end
        context.leechDance = function(d, y, N)
            local players = game:GetService("Players")
            runtimeState.dances = runtimeState.dances or {}
            local function WF(Qi)
                if Qi.dummy then
                    pcall(function()
                        Qi.dummy:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                for entry in pairs(Qi.hidden or {}) do
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end)
                end
            end

                        10370351535,
                        6862001787,

                        126451695836952,
                        122723420065601,
                        "catalog:79123882308666",
                    },

                y = (y * 31 + string.byte(game.JobId, index)) % 1000003

        context.beamExit = function(d, vector)
            if config.beamExit == false then
                runtimeState.beamExit = nil
                return nil
            end
            local N = context.DG and context.DG.boxes
            if not N then
                return nil
            end
            local zF, WF, Qi = config.beamExitNeed or 10, config.beamExitIn or 8, {}
            for index = 1, #N, 1 do
                local Oi = N[index]
                index = Oi.name
                if
                    (index == "firstbosspassivebeam" or index == "beam next")
                    and Oi.cx
                    and Oi.ax
                    and Oi.ha
                    and Oi.hb
                    and not Oi.moving
                    and (Oi.untilAt or 0) > d
                    and (Oi.from or d) < d + (config.beamExitLook or 1)
                then
                    Qi[#Qi + 1] = Oi
                end
            end
            local function Li(zone, Si, Di)
                local Pi, _i = Si - zone.cx, Di - zone.cz
                if zone.ha <= zone.hb then
                    return Pi * zone.ax + _i * zone.az, Pi * zone.bx + _i * zone.bz, zone.ax, zone.az, zone.hb
                end
                return Pi * zone.bx + _i * zone.bz, Pi * zone.ax + _i * zone.az, zone.bx, zone.bz, zone.ha
            end
            N = runtimeState.beamExit
            if N then
                if
                    d > N.untilAt
                    or not N.box
                    or (N.box.untilAt or 0) < d
                    or math.abs((Li(N.box, vector.X, vector.Z))) >= zF - 1
                then
                    runtimeState.beamExit = nil
                    N = nil
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if
                N
                and config.beamExitWayCheck ~= false
                and context.BB
                and context.BB.wayClear
                and not context.BB.wayClear(vector, N.p, config.burstMax or 28, d)
            then
                runtimeState.beamExit = nil
                N = nil
            else
            end
            if
                N
                and N.clean
                and context.BB
                and context.BB.spikeSideAt
                and context.BB.spikeSideAt(vector, N.p, config.burstMax or 28, d)
            then
                runtimeState.beamExit = nil
                N = nil
            else
            end
            if N then
                return N.p, N
            end
            local box, Si, Di, Pi
            for index2, entry in ipairs(Qi) do
                local li, ci, ui, hi, mi = Li(entry, vector.X, vector.Z)
                if
                    math.abs(li) < WF
                    and math.abs(ci) < mi
                    and (not box or (entry.from or d) < (box.from or d))
                then
                    box, Si, Di, Pi = entry, li, ui, hi
                else
                end
            end
            if not box then
                return nil
            end
            local _i, li =
                config.burstMax or 28, hazardReader.hitDelay and hazardReader.hitDelay.firstbosspassivebeam
            local ci, ui, hi =
                box.fired and infinity
                    or box.bornAt and box.bornAt + (li and li.med or 0.916)
                    or (box.untilAt or d) - 0.45,
                Si >= 0 and 1 or -1,
                false
            for index3 = config.beamSpikeSide ~= false and context.BB and context.BB.spikeSideAt and 1 or 2, 2, 1 do
                li, N = ipairs, {
                    ui,
                    -ui,
                }
                for key, entry2 in li(N) do
                    key = entry2 * zF - Si
                    local N, zF, li, qi = vector.X + Di * key, vector.Z + Pi * key, d + math.abs(key) / _i, true
                    for index4, entry3 in ipairs(Qi) do
                        if entry3 ~= box then
                            local Qi, Pi, Vi, Vi, Vi = Li(entry3, N, zF)
                            if
                                math.abs(Qi) < WF
                                and math.abs(Pi) < Vi
                                and (entry3.from or d) <= (box.untilAt or d) + 0.4
                                and (entry3.untilAt or 0) >= li - 0.1
                            then
                                qi = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if qi and context.BB and context.BB.fitsAt then
                        local success, Qi, Qi = pcall(context.BB.fitsAt, N, zF, li)
                        qi = if (if success and Qi ~= nil and Qi >= 0 then false else qi)
                                and context.BB.pathBlocked
                                and context.BB.pathBlocked(vector, Vector3.new(N, vector.Y, zF), _i)
                            then false
                            else if success and Qi ~= nil and Qi >= 0 then false else qi
                        qi = if qi
                                and config.beamExitWayCheck ~= false
                                and context.BB.wayClear
                                and not context.BB.wayClear(vector, Vector3.new(N, vector.Y, zF), _i, d)
                            then false
                            else qi
                    else
                    end
                    if qi and index3 == 1 then
                        if li > ci - (config.beamSideSpare or 0.15) then
                            qi = false
                        else
                            if context.BB.spikeSideAt(vector, Vector3.new(N, vector.Y, zF), _i, d) then
                                qi, hi = false, if entry2 == ui then true else hi
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if qi and entry2 ~= ui and config.beamExitNoCross ~= false then
                        key = math.min(box.ha or 4, box.hb or 4) + (context.DG and context.DG.reach or 1.8)
                        qi = if math.abs(Si) >= key
                                or li
                                    > ci - (config.beamCrossSpare or 0.2) - (runtimeState.dataPingS or 0.06)
                            then false
                            else qi
                    else
                    end
                    if qi then
                        runtimeState.beamExit = {
                            p = Vector3.new(N, vector.Y, zF),
                            box = box,
                            untilAt = (box.untilAt or d + 1.5) + 0.2,
                            at = d,
                            side = entry2,
                            clean = index3 == 1 or nil,
                            away = index3 == 1 and entry2 ~= ui and hi or nil,
                        }
                        return runtimeState.beamExit.p, runtimeState.beamExit
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        context.leechFollowNL = function(d, y, N)
            if config.leechFollowNL == false then
                return false
            end
            local leechNl = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (leechNl and tostring(leechNl.Value) == "Northern Lands") then
                return false
            end
            leechNl = runtimeState.leechNL
            if not leechNl or leechNl.job ~= game.JobId then
                leechNl = {
                    job = game.JobId,
                }
                runtimeState.leechNL = leechNl
            else
            end
            if leechNl.champDown then
                return false
            end
            local WF
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    entry.isBoss
                    and entry.model
                    and entry.model.Parent
                    and lowercase(tostring(entry.model.Name)):find("champion", 1, true)
                then
                    WF = entry
                    break
                end
            end
            if WF and WF.humanoid and WF.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                leechNl.seenAt = d
            elseif leechNl.seenAt and d - leechNl.seenAt > (config.leechChampGone or 3) then
                leechNl.champDown = true
                if context.logT then
                    context.logT(
                        "leechnl",
                        30,
                        "Alt Farm",
                        "the Midgardian Champion is down - the leech waits again"
                    )
                end
                return false
            end
            local WF, Qi = {}, context.AF and context.AF.carry and context.AF.carry()
            if Qi then
                WF[lowercase(tostring(Qi.name))] = true
            end
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.AF and context.AF.load and context.AF.load().accounts or {}) do
                if entry2.enabled ~= false and entry2.role ~= "leech" then
                    WF[lowercase(tostring(entry2.name))] = true
                end
            end
            local success, Oi, leechNl2 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer, math.huge
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if entry3 ~= success and WF[lowercase(entry3.Name)] then
                    Qi = entry3.Character
                    index3, leechNl =
                        Qi and (Qi:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                        Qi and (Qi:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                    if index3 and index3.Health > 0 and leechNl then
                        local magnitude = (leechNl.Position - N.Position).Magnitude
                        if magnitude < Oi then
                            Oi, leechNl2 = magnitude, leechNl
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            Qi = N.Position
            runtimeState.runOn = nil
            runtimeState.orbitLive = nil
            runtimeState.mageExit = nil
            if
                d - (dangerGeometry.lastDecision or -math.huge)
                >= (config.dodgeInterval or 0.016666666666666666)
            then
                dangerGeometry.lastDecision = d
                leechNl, WF = pcall(contextDecide, N, y)
                if not leechNl then
                    runtimeState.lastError = "leech field: " .. tostring(WF)
                    runtimeState.lastErrorAt = d
                end
            end
            success, WF = pcall(context.BB.tick, d, Qi, N, y)
            if success and WF and WF.point then
                leechNl = e()
                if not WF.soft then
                    local Oi, primary = config.burstMax or 28, context.BB.primary
                    local Pi = primary and primary.tti or nil
                    leechNl = if Pi and Pi > 0.05
                        then if a(Qi, WF.point)
                                    / math.max(Pi - 0.1, 0.15)
                                    * (config.burstMargin or 1.15)
                                > leechNl + 0.5
                            then Oi
                            else leechNl
                        else Oi
                    leechNl = if context.BB.inside then math.max(leechNl, Oi) else leechNl
                    leechNl = if leechNl > e() + 0.5
                            and not context.buffHoldsSpeed(d)
                            and not context.unbuffedOk(d)
                        then e()
                        else leechNl
                else
                end
                runtimeState.afIdle = nil
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                pcall(context.leechDance, true, N)
                g(y, N, WF.point, leechNl, 0.8)
                contextSetState("alt farm: leeching (Northern Lands) - " .. tostring(WF.label or "dodging"))
                return true
            elseif not success then
                runtimeState.lastError = "leech dodge: " .. tostring(WF)
                runtimeState.lastErrorAt = d
            end
            if leechNl2 then
                d = leechNl2.Position
                WF = a(Qi, d)
                if WF > (config.leechFollowMax or 22) then
                    local Li, Oi, Di = config.leechFollowStay or 14, Qi.X - d.X, Qi.Z - d.Z
                    leechNl = math.max(sqrt(Oi * Oi + Di * Di), 0.001)
                    runtimeState.afIdle = nil
                    combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                    pcall(context.leechDance, true, N)
                    g(y, N, Vector3.new(d.X + Oi / leechNl * Li, Qi.Y, d.Z + Di / leechNl * Li), e(), 1)
                    contextSetState(
                        ("alt farm: leeching (Northern Lands) - following the carry into the Champion's fight (%.0f away)"):format(
                            WF
                        )
                    )
                    return true
                end
            end
            if not runtimeState.afIdle then
                runtimeState.afIdle = true
                pcall(function()
                    y:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                end)
            end
            pcall(context.leechDance, true, N)
            contextSetState(
                leechNl2 and "alt farm: leeching (Northern Lands) - by the carry, dodging"
                    or "alt farm: leeching (Northern Lands) - dodging, the carry is down"
            )
            return true
        end
        context.carryOneShotTick = function(livedAt)
            if config.carryNoDodge == false then
                return
            end
            local oneShot = runtimeState.oneShot
            if not oneShot or oneShot.job ~= game.JobId then
                oneShot = {
                    job = game.JobId,
                    seen = {},
                    kills = {},
                    maxMh = 0,
                    livedAt = -infinity,
                }
                runtimeState.oneShot = oneShot
            else
            end
            local N, zF =
                livedAt - max(runtimeState.lastQ or -infinity, runtimeState.lastE or -infinity)
                    <= (config.oneShotWindow or 1.6),
                {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                index = entry.humanoid
                if index and not entry.isBoss then
                    zF[index] = true
                    local health, maxMh, Oi = index.Health, index.MaxHealth, oneShot.seen[index]
                    if Oi and N and health < Oi.h - 0.5 and Oi.h >= maxMh * 0.98 then
                        if health <= 0 then
                            oneShot.kills[#oneShot.kills + 1] = {
                                at = livedAt,
                                mh = maxMh,
                            }
                            if maxMh > oneShot.maxMh then
                                oneShot.maxMh = maxMh
                            end
                        else
                            oneShot.livedAt = livedAt
                        end
                    end
                    if health <= 0 then
                        oneShot.seen[index] = nil
                    else
                        oneShot.seen[index] = {
                            h = health,
                            mh = maxMh,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            for key, entry2 in pairs(oneShot.seen) do
                if not zF[key] then
                    if N and entry2.h >= entry2.mh * 0.98 then
                        oneShot.kills[#oneShot.kills + 1] = {
                            at = livedAt,
                            mh = entry2.mh,
                        }
                        if entry2.mh > oneShot.maxMh then
                            oneShot.maxMh = entry2.mh
                        end
                    end
                    oneShot.seen[key] = nil
                end
            end
            while #oneShot.kills > 0 and livedAt - oneShot.kills[1].at > (config.oneShotMemory or 90) do
                table.remove(oneShot.kills, 1)
            end
        end
        context.carryOneShot = function(d, vector, N)
            if config.carryNoDodge == false or not (context.afRole and context.afRole() == "carry") then
                return false
            end
            local zF = runtimeState.oneShot
            if not zF or zF.job ~= game.JobId or #zF.kills < (config.oneShotNeed or 3) then
                return false
            end
            if d - zF.livedAt < (config.oneShotLivedFor or 30) then
                return false
            end
            if N and N.MaxHealth > 0 and N.Health / N.MaxHealth < (config.carryNoDodgeHp or 0.5) then
                return false
            end
            local WF, Qi, Li = zF.maxMh * 1.05, (config.oneShotBossR or 250) ^ 2, (config.oneShotMobR or 150) ^ 2
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                index = entry.humanoid
                if index and index.Health > 0 and entry.root and entry.root.Parent then
                    zF, d = entry.root.Position.X - vector.X, entry.root.Position.Z - vector.Z
                    N = zF * zF + d * d
                    if entry.isBoss and N < Qi then
                        return false
                    end
                    if not entry.isBoss and N < Li and index.MaxHealth > WF then
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function contextBrainTick(y)
            runtimeState.brainNow = y
            if context.syncTiming then
                context.syncTiming()
            end
            if context.loadoutTick then
                pcall(context.loadoutTick, y)
            end
            context.apply1186()
            if runtimeState.burstApplied ~= (config.burstMax or 28) and context.applyBurst then
                context.applyBurst(config.burstMax)
            end
            if not runtimeState.lcCapSet and context.LC and context.LC.CONFIG then
                runtimeState.lcCapSet = true
                context.LC.CONFIG.MaxSpeed = config.burstMax or 28
            end
            local N, humanoid, zF = context.character()
            if not humanoid or not zF or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                contextSetState("no character")
                combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                return
            end
            local WF = context.afRole and context.afRole() == "leech"
            if WF then
                local Qi, Li = context.AF and context.AF.carry and context.AF.carry(), false
                if Qi then
                    local Oi = {
                        [string.lower(tostring(Qi.name))] = true,
                    }
                    for index, entry in ipairs(context.AF.load and context.AF.load().accounts or {}) do
                        if entry.enabled ~= false and entry.role ~= "leech" then
                            Oi[string.lower(tostring(entry.name))] = true
                        end
                    end
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        if Oi[string.lower(entry2.Name)] then
                            Li = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                if Qi and not Li then
                    runtimeState.noCarrySince = runtimeState.noCarrySince or y
                    local Li = y - runtimeState.noCarrySince
                    if
                        Li > (config.leechNoCarryWait or 25)
                        and y - (runtimeState.noCarryTpAt or -math.huge) > 20
                    then
                        runtimeState.noCarryTpAt = y
                        if context.queueLog then
                            local queueLog, Si =
                                context.queueLog, {
                                    reason = "no carry in the dungeon",
                                }
                            Si.waited = math.floor(Li)
                            queueLog("leech_return", Si)
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            game:GetService("TeleportService")
                                :Teleport(77649408247578, game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)
                        end)
                    end
                    contextSetState(
                        ("alt farm: the carry is not in this dungeon - back to the lobby in %.0fs"):format(
                            math.max(0, (config.leechNoCarryWait or 25) - Li)
                        )
                    )
                    return
                else
                    runtimeState.noCarrySince = nil
                end
                if context.leechFollowNL then
                    local success, Oi = pcall(context.leechFollowNL, y, humanoid, zF)
                    if success and Oi then
                        return
                    end
                    if not success then
                        runtimeState.lastError = "leech follow: " .. tostring(Oi)
                        runtimeState.lastErrorAt = y
                    end
                end
                do
                    local position, Oi, Si = zF.Position, os.clock(), {}
                    for key, model in pairs(hazardReader.models) do
                        Qi = model.from or Oi
                        key = math.max(model.untilAt or 0, Qi + 1)
                        if Oi >= Qi - 1.5 and Oi <= key then
                            for index3, entry3 in
                                ipairs(model.hbs and #model.hbs > 0 and model.hbs or {
                                    model.hb,
                                })
                            do
                                if entry3 and entry3.Parent then
                                    Si[#Si + 1] = entry3
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local function Di(Pi, _i)
                        local li = math.huge
                        for index4, entry4 in ipairs(Si) do
                            index4 = entry4.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(Pi, entry4.Position.Y, _i))
                            local Pi = math.max(
                                math.abs(index4.X) - entry4.Size.X / 2,
                                math.abs(index4.Z) - entry4.Size.Z / 2
                            )
                            li = if Pi < li then Pi else li
                        end
                        return li
                    end
                    if #Si > 0 and Di(position.X, position.Z) < 3 then
                        local Si, Pi = math.huge
                        for index5 = 3, 20, 1.5 do
                            for index6 = 0, 15, 1 do
                                Oi = index6 / 16 * 3.141592653589793 * 2
                                local li, ci =
                                    position.X + math.cos(Oi) * index5, position.Z + math.sin(Oi) * index5
                                if Di(li, ci) >= (config.leechDodgeClear or 2.5) and index5 < Si then
                                    Si, Pi = index5, Vector3.new(li, position.Y, ci)
                                else
                                end
                            end
                            if Pi then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if Pi then
                            runtimeState.afIdle = nil
                            pcall(context.leechDance, true, zF)
                            g(
                                humanoid,
                                zF,
                                Pi,
                                context.buffHoldsSpeed(y) and (config.buffSpeed or 28) or (config.tweenWalk or 16),
                                0.8
                            )
                            contextSetState(
                                ("alt farm: leeching - stepping %d studs out of an attack"):format(
                                    math.floor(Si + 0.5)
                                )
                            )
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                do

                        local function Ui(Zi, ni, fi)
                            if arenaCentre4 and (Zi - arenaCentre4.X) ^ 2 + (ni - arenaCentre4.Z) ^ 2 >= pi then

                                return false

                                return false
                            end
                            return true

                if config.bobLineRails ~= false and context.bobLinePlan then

                                                else
                                                end
                                            else
                                            end
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                    return Ji
                                end
                                local function Ui(Ji, wi)
                                    local Yi, vi, Mi, Zi =
                                        (config.missileLaneHalf or 5)
                                            + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8)
                                            + (config.rodinHopMissilePad or 1),

                                local Ji = bF + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + 0.5

                                    if config.rodinRailOffPassed == false or abs(Yi) < 1 then
                                        return false

                                        else
                                        end
                                    end

                                    return Mi ~= nil and Zi * vi >= abs(Yi) - Ji
                                end

                                    if config.rodinRailOffPassed == false then
                                        return false

                                                and (vi == nil or TF[index4] > TF[vi])

                                        Mi = if Ji then index4 else Mi

                                            Mi

                                local function railHop(Mi)

                                        bF + (dangerGeometry.reach or 1.8) + 0.25,

                                        return false
                                    end

                                        return false
                                    end

                                local bF = runtimeState.redRail
                                if

                                    and bF.at == y

                                                    Vector3.new(
                                                        posSeen.X + oi * entry49,

                            0,
                            0,
                            0
                        if q then
                            for index194, child18 in ipairs(q:GetChildren()) do
                                if child18:IsA("Model") then
                                    WF, index194 =
                                        child18:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),
                                        child18:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or child18.PrimaryPart
                                    if WF and WF.Health > 0 and index194 then
                                        index193 = index194.Position
                                        p, j, U, w = p + index193.X, j + index193.Y, U + index193.Z, w + 1
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        if order then
                            q, index193 = nil
                            local Y = u
                            if w > 0 then
                                q, index193 = Vector3.new(p / w, posSeen.Y, U / w), j / w
                                u = index193
                            else
                                if D(barrier) then
                                    q = P(child17:FindFirstChild("endPart"), posSeen.Y)
                                    if q == nil then
                                        local success18, p = pcall(function()
                                            return child17:GetBoundingBox()
                                        end)
                                        q = if success18 and p
                                            then Vector3.new(p.Position.X, posSeen.Y, p.Position.Z)
                                            else q
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                u = index193
                            end
                            if q and (value == nil or order.Value < value) then
                                value, c = order.Value, q
                            else
                                u = Y
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    D = nil
                    if c == nil then
                        for index195, child19 in ipairs(OF:GetChildren()) do
                            if child19.Name == "bossRoom" then
                                index195, P = pcall(function()
                                    return child19:GetBoundingBox()
                                end)
                                if index195 and P then
                                    _ = Vector3.new(P.Position.X, posSeen.Y, P.Position.Z)
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        D = _
                    else
                        D = _
                    end
                    D = c or D
                    if D and a(posSeen, D) > (config.roomFlowArrive or 12) then
                        P = u and posSeen.Y - u or 0
                        if P > (config.roomFlowDrop or 45) and a(posSeen, D) > (config.roomFlowDropFar or 60) then
                            g(humanoid, zF, Vector3.new(D.X, posSeen.Y, D.Z), config.tweenEscape, 1.5)
                            contextSetState(
                                ("to room %s: dropping %.0f studs"):format(tostring(value or "boss"), P)
                            )
                            combatBrain.waypoints = nil
                            return
                        end
                        qF(
                            humanoid,
                            zF,
                            D,
                            config.preWalkSprint ~= false and config.tweenEscape or e(),
                            ("to room %s"):format(tostring(value or "boss"))
                        )
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            contextReleaseMover(humanoid, zF)
            contextSetState(
                context.runComplete() and "run complete"
                    or ("no enemy in sight%s%s"):format(
                        runtimeState.wpIdleWhy and " - " .. runtimeState.wpIdleWhy or "",
                        hazardReader.bigRoom
                                and runtimeState.resetGate
                                and runtimeState.resetGate ~= "open"
                                and runtimeState.resetGate ~= "done"
                                and runtimeState.resetGate ~= "used"
                                and " [reset: " .. runtimeState.resetGate .. "]"
                            or ""
                    )
            )
        end
        if config.attackThread ~= false then
            task.spawn(function()
                while not (runtimeState and runtimeState.destroyed) do
                    task.wait(config.attackStep or 0.05)
                    pcall(function()
                        if
                            config.attackThread == false
                            or not runtimeState.farmEnabled
                            or runtimeState.modHalt
                        then
                            runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                            return
                        end
                        local aoeScanAt, coverFull = os.clock(), localPlayer.Character
                        local humanoid, l =
                            coverFull and (coverFull:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                            coverFull and (coverFull:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        if not (humanoid and l and humanoid.Health > 0) then
                            runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                            return
                        end
                        if
                            not (
                                if context.readyDamageCasts and hazardReader.abilitySlots
                                    then (context.readyDamageCasts() or 0) >= 1
                                    else true
                            )
                        then
                            runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                            runtimeState.castAvailSince = nil
                            runtimeState.attackState = "on cooldown"
                            return
                        end
                        runtimeState.castAvailSince = runtimeState.castAvailSince or aoeScanAt
                        local position, u =
                            l.Position,
                            max(
                                context.fireReach and context.fireReach() or 0,
                                context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach() or 0,
                                config.abilityRangeKnown or 0,
                                config.castStartAt or 44
                            )
                        local h, m =
                            config.tagFirst ~= false and contextTagPending(position) > 0, combatBrain.target
                        if
                            not (
                                m
                                and not m.isBoss
                                and m.root
                                and m.root.Parent
                                and m.humanoid
                                and m.humanoid.Health > 0
                                and (m.x - position.X) ^ 2 + (m.z - position.Z) ^ 2 <= u * u
                                and not (h and contextMobTagged(m))
                            )
                        then
                            coverFull = nil
                            m = nil
                            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                                if
                                    not entry.isBoss
                                    and entry.root
                                    and entry.root.Parent
                                    and entry.humanoid
                                    and entry.humanoid.Health > 0
                                    and (not h or contextMobUntagged(entry))
                                then
                                    local q, V = entry.x - position.X, entry.z - position.Z
                                    index = q * q + V * V
                                    if index <= u * u and (coverFull == nil or index < coverFull) then
                                        coverFull, m = index, entry
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        h = config.attackOverdueOn ~= false
                            and runtimeState.castAvailSince ~= nil
                            and aoeScanAt - runtimeState.castAvailSince > (config.attackOverdue or 1)
                        if not m and h then
                            coverFull = nil
                            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                                if
                                    not entry2.isBoss
                                    and entry2.root
                                    and entry2.root.Parent
                                    and entry2.humanoid
                                    and entry2.humanoid.Health > 0
                                then
                                    local S, q = entry2.x - position.X, entry2.z - position.Z
                                    index2 = S * S + q * q
                                    if index2 <= u * u and (coverFull == nil or index2 < coverFull) then
                                        coverFull, m = index2, entry2
                                    else
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                        if not m then
                            runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                            runtimeState.attackState = "ready, nothing in reach"
                            return
                        end
                        if aoeScanAt - (runtimeState.aoeScanAt or 0) >= (config.aoeScanEvery or 0.1) then
                            runtimeState.aoeScanAt = aoeScanAt
                            local coverFace, R, groupPlan = VF(position, config.drawAoeScan == true, h)
                            coverFull = (groupPlan or 0) > 0 and (R or 0) >= groupPlan
                            runtimeState.coverFace = coverFace
                            runtimeState.coverFull = coverFull
                            groupPlan = runtimeState.groupPlan
                            runtimeState.coverEnough = not (
                                    config.firstCastWholeStrict ~= false
                                    and groupPlan ~= nil
                                    and groupPlan.first == true
                                    and runtimeState.groupPlanAt ~= nil
                                    and aoeScanAt - runtimeState.groupPlanAt < 1
                                ) and (R or 0) >= (config.fireEnough or 3)
                            runtimeState.coverN = R or 0
                        end
                        runtimeState.attackState = ("%d in the disc%s"):format(
                            runtimeState.coverN or 0,
                            h and ", overdue" or ""
                        )
                        if
                            config.fireOnFullCover ~= false
                            and (runtimeState.coverFull or runtimeState.coverEnough)
                            and runtimeState.coverFace
                        then
                            if UF(humanoid, l, m, aoeScanAt, runtimeState.coverFace, h) then
                                runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                                runtimeState.coverFull = false
                                runtimeState.coverEnough = false
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        runtimeState.castReadyAt = runtimeState.castReadyAt or aoeScanAt
                        u = config.attackDeadline or 0.5
                        if config.castingPriority == "Fast Clear" then
                            u = math.min(u, config.fastClearMaxCastWait or 0.28)
                            -- A very small grace period is worthwhile only for an extra predicted hit.
                            local future = runtimeState.groupPlan
                            if future and future.tReady <= 0.16
                                and (future.n or 0) > (runtimeState.coverN or 0)
                                and (future.hereN or 0) >= (runtimeState.coverN or 0) then
                                u = min(config.fastClearMaxCastWait or 0.28,
                                    u + (config.fastClearExtraHitGrace or 0.1))
                            end
                        end
                        if config.firstHitWhole ~= false then
                            coverFull = runtimeState.groupPlan
                            u = if coverFull
                                    and coverFull.first
                                    and (coverFull.n or 0) > (coverFull.hereN or 0)
                                    and runtimeState.groupPlanAt
                                    and aoeScanAt - runtimeState.groupPlanAt < 0.5
                                then max(u, config.firstHitWindow or 3.5)
                                else u
                        else
                        end
                        if config.castingPriority == "Fast Clear" then
                            u = math.min(u, config.fastClearMaxCastWait or 0.28)
                        end
                        runtimeState.attackState = ("%d in the disc, firing in %.1fs%s"):format(
                            runtimeState.coverN or 0,
                            math.max(u - (aoeScanAt - runtimeState.castReadyAt), 0),
                            runtimeState.skillGate and " (" .. tostring(runtimeState.skillGate) .. ")" or ""
                        )
                        if aoeScanAt - runtimeState.castReadyAt <= u then
                            return
                        end
                        if UF(humanoid, l, m, aoeScanAt, nil, h) then
                            runtimeState.castReadyAt = nil
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
        context.MV, context.BR, context.brainTick, context.standoffFor, context.releaseMover, context.restoreWalkSpeed =
            movement, combatBrain, contextBrainTick, contextStandoffFor, contextReleaseMover, function(d)
                if d then
                    C(d, false)
                end
            end
    end

                "Yokai Transformation|a|e|22|d",
