        local function nameKey(u)
            local h = string.lower(tostring(u or ""))
            h = string.gsub(h, "[^a-z0-9]", "")
            return (string.gsub(h, "armour", "armor"))
        end
        inventoryAutomation.nameKey = nameKey
        inventoryAutomation.items = {}
        inventoryAutomation.dungeons = dungeons
        for index = 1, #l, 1 do
            local name, m, R, y, q = string.match(l[index], "^(.-)|(%a)|(%a)|(%d+)|(%a*)$")
            if name then
                index = #inventoryAutomation.items + 1
                inventoryAutomation.items[index] = {
                    name = name,
                    key = nameKey(name),
                    kind = D[m] or "weapon",
                    tier = P[R] or "",
                    dung = dungeons[tonumber(y)] or "",
                    sub = _[q] or "",
                }
            end
        end
        local cfg = {
            common = "sellCommon",
            uncommon = "sellUncommon",
            rare = "sellRare",
            epic = "sellEpic",
            legendary = "sellLegendary",
            ultimate = "sellUltimate",
        }
        inventoryAutomation.TIER_CFG = cfg
        local order = { "common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic", "legendary", "ultimate" }
        inventoryAutomation.TIER_ORDER = order
        local long, _ =
            {
                common = "Common",
                uncommon = "Uncommon",
                rare = "Rare",
                epic = "Epic",
                legendary = "Legendary",
                ultimate = "Ultimate",
            }, {
                common = "Com",
                uncommon = "Unc",
                rare = "Rare",
                epic = "Epic",
                legendary = "Leg",
                ultimate = "Ult",
            }
        inventoryAutomation.TIER_LONG = long
        local function l(u)
            if u == true then
                return true
            end
            if type(u) == "table" then
                for index2, entry in ipairs(order) do
                    if u[entry] == true then
                        return u
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        inventoryAutomation.keptRule = function(u)
            local sellKeep = config.sellKeep
            if type(sellKeep) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            return l(sellKeep[nameKey(u)])
        end
        inventoryAutomation.isKept = function(u, h)
            local m = inventoryAutomation.keptRule(u)
            if m == nil then
                return false
            end
            if m == true or h == nil then
                return true
            end
            return m[string.lower(tostring(h))] == true
        end
        inventoryAutomation.setKept = function(u, h)
            if type(config.sellKeep) ~= "table" then
                config.sellKeep = {}
            end
            local m = nameKey(u)
            if type(h) ~= "table" then
                config.sellKeep[m] = h and true or nil
                return
            end
            local c, u = {}, 0
            for index2, entry in ipairs(order) do
                if h[entry] == true then
                    u += 1
                    c[entry] = true
                else
                end
            end
            if u == #order then
                config.sellKeep[m] = true
            elseif u > 0 then
                config.sellKeep[m] = c
            else
                config.sellKeep[m] = nil
            end
        end
        inventoryAutomation.ruleText = function(c, u)
            if type(c) ~= "table" then
                return ""
            end
            local h = {}
            for index2, entry in ipairs(order) do
                if c[entry] == true then
                    h[#h + 1] = (u and _ or long)[entry]
                end
            end
            return table.concat(h, ", ")
        end
        inventoryAutomation.keptCount = function()
            local D = 0
            if type(config.sellKeep) == "table" then
                for key, entry in pairs(config.sellKeep) do
                    D = if l(entry) ~= nil then D + 1 else D
                end
            else
            end
            return D
        end
        inventoryAutomation.worn = nil
        inventoryAutomation.wornKey = function(D)
            local uniqueItemId = D.UniqueItemID
            if type(uniqueItemId) == "string" and uniqueItemId ~= "" and uniqueItemId ~= "none" then
                return "uid:" .. uniqueItemId
            end
            return "name:" .. string.lower(tostring(D.name))
        end
        inventoryAutomation.wornFile = function()
            local localPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            return "HarvardLabs/data/worn_"
                .. string.lower(localPlayer and localPlayer.Name or "unknown")
                .. ".json"
        end
        inventoryAutomation.wornLoad = function()
            if inventoryAutomation.worn then
                return inventoryAutomation.worn
            end
            inventoryAutomation.worn = {}
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile(inventoryAutomation.wornFile()) then
                    local D = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(inventoryAutomation.wornFile()))
                    if type(D) == "table" then
                        for key, entry in pairs(D) do
                            if type(key) == "string" and tonumber(entry) then
                                inventoryAutomation.worn[key] = tonumber(entry)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return inventoryAutomation.worn
        end
        inventoryAutomation.noteWorn = function(D)
            if type(D) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            local P = inventoryAutomation.wornLoad()
            local timestamp, l = os.time(), false
            for key, entry in pairs(D.abilities or {}) do
                if
                    type(entry) == "table"
                    and type(entry.equipped) == "table"
                    and type(entry.name) == "string"
                then
                    key = false
                    for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry.equipped) do
                        key = if entry2 == true then true else key
                    end
                    local h = inventoryAutomation.wornKey(entry)
                    if key and (P[h] == nil or timestamp - P[h] > 600) then
                        P[h] = timestamp
                        l = true
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if l then
                D = 2 * (tonumber(config.sellWornHours) or 24) * 3600
                for key3, entry3 in pairs(P) do
                    if timestamp - entry3 > D then
                        P[key3] = nil
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    writefile(inventoryAutomation.wornFile(), game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(P))
                end)
            end
        end
        inventoryAutomation.wasWorn = function(D)
            local P = inventoryAutomation.wornLoad()[inventoryAutomation.wornKey(D)]
            return P ~= nil and os.time() - P <= (tonumber(config.sellWornHours) or 24) * 3600
        end
        -- A spell is physically unequipped only if its slot flags are known and all false.
        -- Duplicate cleanup can ignore the 24-hour history, but never equipped/unknown slots.
        inventoryAutomation.spellSlotsFree = function(D)
            if type(D) ~= "table" or type(D.equipped) ~= "table" then
                return false
            end
            for _, equipped in pairs(D.equipped) do
                if type(equipped) ~= "boolean" or equipped then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Legendary spells never participate in duplicate cleanup: they are neither counted
        -- as additional copies nor selected as the keeper for a non-Legendary copy.
        inventoryAutomation.isLegendarySpell = function(item)
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return false end
            local rarity = string.lower(tostring(item.rarity or ""))
            rarity = rarity:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            return rarity == "legendary"
        end
        inventoryAutomation.abilityFree = function(D)
            return type(D) == "table"
                and type(D.name) == "string"
                and tonumber(D.levelReq) ~= nil
                and inventoryAutomation.spellSlotsFree(D)
                and not inventoryAutomation.wasWorn(D)
        end
        inventoryAutomation.shouldSell = function(item)
            if type(item) ~= "table" then return false, "Incomplete item data" end
            local level = tonumber(item.levelReq)
            if not level or level ~= level or level < 0 or level == math.huge then
                return false, "Missing or invalid item level"
            end
            local rarity = cfg[string.lower(tostring(item.rarity or ""))]
            if not rarity or config[rarity] ~= true then return false, "Rarity is not selected for sale" end
            if inventoryAutomation.isKept(item.name, item.rarity) then return false, "Protected item rule" end
            local cutoff = tonumber(config.sellKeepLevel) or 0
            if cutoff > 0 and level >= cutoff then return false, "At or above keep-level cutoff" end
            return true
        end
        local S = {
            {
                inv = "weapons",
                out = "weapon",
                pre = 8,
            },
            {
                inv = "helmets",
                out = "helmet",
                pre = 8,
            },
            {
                inv = "chests",
                out = "chest",
                pre = 7,
            },
            {
                inv = "abilities",
                out = "ability",
                pre = 9,
            },
        }
        -- One decision path for preview, planning and last-moment sale checks.
        inventoryAutomation.evaluate = function(bag)
            local result = { rows = {}, sell = 0, keep = 0, gold = 0, unknownPrices = 0 }
            if type(bag) ~= "table" then result.error = "Inventory unavailable" return result end
            local ok, keepers = pcall(function()
                assert(context.BG and context.BG.keepers, "Gear protection is not ready")
                local protected = context.BG.keepers(bag)
                assert(type(protected) == "table", "Gear protection returned invalid data")
                inventoryAutomation.noteWorn(bag)
                return protected
            end)
            if not ok then result.error = "Gear/spell protection could not be checked; selling is blocked" end
            -- Determine a single keeper for each spell name, BEFORE applying sell rules.
            -- Prefer protected/equipped/best-gear/recently-worn and higher-rarity copies.
            -- A stable tie-break prevents repeatedly changing the selected keeper.
            local spellGroups = {}
            if config.sellDuplicateSpells == true and type(bag.abilities) == "table" then
                local rarityWeight = {common=1, uncommon=2, rare=3, epic=4, legendary=5, ultimate=6}
                for key, data in pairs(bag.abilities) do
                    if type(data) == "table" and type(data.name) == "string" and data.name ~= ""
                        and not inventoryAutomation.isLegendarySpell(data) then
                        local normalized = nameKey(data.name)
                        if normalized ~= "" then
                            local group = spellGroups[normalized]
                            if not group then
                                group = {count=0, keeperKey=nil, best=-math.huge}
                                spellGroups[normalized] = group
                            end
                            group.count += 1
                            local level = tonumber(data.levelReq) or 0
                            if level ~= level or level == math.huge or level == -math.huge then level = 0 end
                            local score = (rarityWeight[string.lower(tostring(data.rarity or ""))] or 0) * 100000
                                + math.clamp(level, 0, 10000)
                            if inventoryAutomation.wasWorn(data) then score += 10000000 end
                            if type(data.equipped) == "table" then
                                for _, slotValue in pairs(data.equipped) do
                                    if slotValue == true then score += 100000000 break end
                                end
                            end
                            if keepers and keepers["abilities:" .. tostring(key)] then score += 1000000000 end
                            if inventoryAutomation.isKept(data.name, data.rarity) then score += 10000000000 end
                            if score > group.best or (score == group.best and tostring(key) < tostring(group.keeperKey)) then
                                group.best, group.keeperKey = score, tostring(key)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, category in ipairs(S) do
                local bucket = bag[category.inv]
                if type(bucket) ~= "table" then
                    result.error = "Inventory is incomplete; selling is blocked"
                else
                    for key, item in pairs(bucket) do
                        local data = type(item) == "table" and item or {}
                        local row = {
                            inv = category.inv, cat = category.inv, out = category.out,
                            key = key, id = tonumber(tostring(key):match("(%d+)$")),
                            name = tostring(data.name or "Unknown item"), rarity = tostring(data.rarity or "Unknown"),
                            req = tonumber(data.levelReq), price = tonumber(data.sellPrice), uid = data.UniqueItemID,
                            imageId = type(data.imageId) == "string" and data.imageId
                                or type(data.imageId) == "number" and "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(data.imageId) or "",
                        }
                        local reason, duplicateSpell = nil, false
                        if type(item) ~= "table" or type(data.name) ~= "string" or data.name == "" then
                            reason = "Incomplete item data"
                        elseif not row.req or row.req ~= row.req or row.req < 0 or row.req == math.huge then
                            reason = "Missing or invalid item level"
                        elseif not row.id or row.id < 0 or row.id % 1 ~= 0
                            or type(row.uid) ~= "string" or row.uid == "" or row.uid == "none" then
                            reason = "Item identity cannot be verified"
                        elseif category.out == "ability" and config.sellDuplicateSpells == true then
                            -- With duplicate cleanup enabled, a lone spell is NEVER sold by normal rarity rules.
                            -- Legendary spells do not count toward the group and cannot be sold here.
                            local group = spellGroups[nameKey(data.name)]
                            if inventoryAutomation.isLegendarySpell(data) then
                                reason = "Legendary spell excluded from duplicate cleanup"
                            elseif not inventoryAutomation.spellSlotsFree(data) then
                                reason = "Equipped or unknown spell slots"
                            elseif inventoryAutomation.isKept(data.name, data.rarity) then
                                reason = "Protected item rule"
                            elseif ok and keepers[category.inv .. ":" .. tostring(key)] then
                                reason = "Reserved by Gear & Spells"
                            elseif not group or group.count < 2 or group.keeperKey == tostring(key) then
                                reason = "Keep one copy of this spell"
                            else
                                -- Extra copies can be sold regardless of ordinary rarity and level rules.
                                -- The currently equipped, reserved, or explicitly protected copies remain safe.
                                duplicateSpell = true
                            end
                        elseif category.out == "ability" and not inventoryAutomation.abilityFree(data) then
                            reason = "Equipped, recently worn, or unknown spell slots"
                        elseif category.out ~= "ability" and data.equipped ~= false then
                            reason = "Equipped or unknown equipment status"
                        elseif inventoryAutomation.isKept(data.name, data.rarity) then
                            reason = "Protected item rule"
                        elseif ok and keepers[category.inv .. ":" .. tostring(key)] then
                            reason = "Reserved by Gear & Spells"
                        else
                            local allowed, why = inventoryAutomation.shouldSell(data)
                            if not allowed then reason = why end
                        end
                        row.sell = reason == nil and result.error == nil
                        row.duplicateSpell = duplicateSpell and row.sell
                        row.reason = reason or result.error or (duplicateSpell and "Extra spell copy" or "Matches rarity and level rules")
                        result.rows[#result.rows + 1] = row
                    end
                end
            end
            local seenIdentity = {}
            for _, row in ipairs(result.rows) do
                if type(row.uid) == "string" and row.uid ~= "" then
                    if seenIdentity[row.uid] then
                        row.sell, row.reason = false, "Duplicate item identity"
                        seenIdentity[row.uid].sell, seenIdentity[row.uid].reason = false, "Duplicate item identity"
                    else
                        seenIdentity[row.uid] = row
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(result.rows, function(a, b)
                if a.name ~= b.name then return a.name < b.name end
                return a.inv .. tostring(a.key) < b.inv .. tostring(b.key)
            end)
            for _, row in ipairs(result.rows) do
                if result.error then row.sell, row.reason = false, result.error end
                if row.sell then
                    result.sell += 1
                    if row.price and row.price >= 0 and row.price < math.huge then
                        result.gold += row.price
                    else result.unknownPrices += 1 end
                else result.keep += 1 end
            end
            return result
        end
        inventoryAutomation.plan = function(bag, dungeon, duplicatesOnly)
            local evaluation = inventoryAutomation.evaluate(bag)
            local payload, identities, items = { weapon = {}, helmet = {}, chest = {}, ability = {} }, {}, {}
            for _, row in ipairs(evaluation.rows) do
                if row.sell and (not duplicatesOnly or row.duplicateSpell) then
                    table.insert(payload[row.out], dungeon and row.id or tostring(row.id) .. ":" .. row.uid)
                    identities[row.uid] = true
                    items[#items + 1] = row
                end
            end
            return payload, #items, identities, items, evaluation.error
        end
        inventoryAutomation.planList = function(bag)
            local _, _, _, rows = inventoryAutomation.plan(bag)
            return rows
        end

        inventoryAutomation.logSale = function(S)
            local localPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            S.t, S.time, S.job, S.place = os.time(), os.date("%m/%d %I:%M:%S %p"), game.JobId, game.PlaceId
            local P, _ =
                game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(S) .. "\10",
                "HarvardLabs/logs/sales_"
                    .. string.lower(localPlayer and localPlayer.Name or "unknown")
                    .. ".jsonl"
            if appendfile and isfile and isfile(_) then
                appendfile(_, P)
            else
                writefile(_, P)
            end
        end
        local function S()
            local remotes = L:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            if not remotes then
                return nil, nil
            end
            return remotes:FindFirstChild("sellItemEvent"), remotes:FindFirstChild("reloadInvy")
        end
        inventoryAutomation.inLobby = function()
            return game.PlaceId == 77649408247578
        end
        inventoryAutomation.cancelSale = function()
            inventoryAutomation.cancelSerial = (inventoryAutomation.cancelSerial or 0) + 1
            if inventoryAutomation.busy then inventoryAutomation.note = "Cancellation requested; waiting for the current request" end
        end
        inventoryAutomation.readInventory = function()
            local _, remote = S()
            if not remote then return nil, "Inventory remote is missing" end
            local ok, bag = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer() end)
            if not ok or type(bag) ~= "table" then return nil, "Inventory could not be read" end
            return bag
        end
        inventoryAutomation.sellNow = function(manual, duplicatesOnly)
            if duplicatesOnly and config.sellDuplicateSpells ~= true then
                inventoryAutomation.note = "Enable Sell duplicate spells first"
                return 0, false
            end
            local serial = inventoryAutomation.cancelSerial or 0
            local function cancelled()
                return serial ~= (inventoryAutomation.cancelSerial or 0)
                    or (manual ~= true and config.autoSell ~= true)
                    or context.RT and (context.RT.destroyed or context.RT.modHalt)
                    or context.isEvent and context.isEvent()
            end
            if cancelled() then inventoryAutomation.note = "Sale stopped" return 0, false end
            local readyAt = os.clock()
            while not (context.BG and context.BG.keepers) and os.clock() - readyAt < 20 do
                if cancelled() then inventoryAutomation.note = "Sale cancelled" return 0, false end
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
            local prepared = pcall(function()
                assert(context.BG and context.BG.keepers, "Gear protection is not ready")
                if context.BG.beforeSale then context.BG.beforeSale() end
                assert(not context.BG.busy, "Gear changes are still running")
            end)
            if not prepared then inventoryAutomation.note = "Gear protection unavailable; no sale" return 0, false end
            local remote = S()
            if not remote then inventoryAutomation.note = "Sell remote is missing" return 0, false end
            local bag, err = inventoryAutomation.readInventory()
            if cancelled() then inventoryAutomation.note = "Sale cancelled" return 0, false end
            if not bag then inventoryAutomation.note = err return 0, false end
            local _, count, _, candidates, problem = inventoryAutomation.plan(bag, not inventoryAutomation.inLobby(), duplicatesOnly)
            if problem then inventoryAutomation.note = problem return 0, false end
            if count == 0 then inventoryAutomation.note = "Nothing matches the rules" return 0, true end
            local sent, skipped, stopReason = {}, 0, nil
            inventoryAutomation.at = os.clock()
            pcall(inventoryAutomation.logSale, { phase = "selling", asked = count, items = candidates })
            for index, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                if cancelled() then stopReason = "Cancelled" break end
                -- Refresh identity, equipment and all protection rules before every request.
                local fresh, readError = inventoryAutomation.readInventory()
                if cancelled() then stopReason = "Cancelled" break end
                if not fresh then stopReason = readError break end
                if context.BG.busy then stopReason = "Gear changes are in progress" break end
                local evaluation = inventoryAutomation.evaluate(fresh)
                if evaluation.error then stopReason = evaluation.error break end
                local eligible
                for _, row in ipairs(evaluation.rows) do
                    if row.uid == candidate.uid and row.inv == candidate.inv then eligible = row break end
                end
                if eligible and eligible.sell and (not duplicatesOnly or eligible.duplicateSpell) then
                    if cancelled() then stopReason = "Cancelled" break end
                    local payload = { weapon = {}, helmet = {}, chest = {}, ability = {} }
                    payload[eligible.out][1] = inventoryAutomation.inLobby()
                        and tostring(eligible.id) .. ":" .. eligible.uid or eligible.id
                    local ok = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(payload) end)
                    if not ok then stopReason = "Sale request failed" break end
                    sent[#sent + 1] = eligible
                else skipped += 1 end
                inventoryAutomation.note = ("Checked %d/%d; requested %d; skipped %d"):format(index, count, #sent, skipped)
                local delay = math.clamp(tonumber(config.sellDelay) or 1, 0.25, 10)
                local untilAt = os.clock() + delay
                repeat
                    if cancelled() then break end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                until os.clock() >= untilAt
            end
            if cancelled() then stopReason = "Cancelled" end
            if #sent > 0 then task.wait(math.clamp(tonumber(config.sellCheckAfter) or 2, 0.1, 10)) end
            local final = inventoryAutomation.readInventory()
            local gone, remaining, verified = 0, {}, type(final) == "table"
            if verified then
                for _, category in ipairs({ "weapons", "helmets", "chests", "abilities" }) do
                    if type(final[category]) ~= "table" then verified = false break end
                    for _, item in pairs(final[category]) do
                        if type(item) ~= "table" or type(item.UniqueItemID) ~= "string" then
                            verified = false
                        else remaining[item.UniqueItemID] = true end
                    end
                end
            end
            if verified then
                for _, item in ipairs(sent) do if not remaining[item.uid] then gone += 1 end end
                inventoryAutomation.lastSold = gone
                inventoryAutomation.totalSold += gone
            end
            inventoryAutomation.note = (stopReason and stopReason .. ". " or "")
                .. (verified and ("Confirmed gone: %d/%d requested; skipped %d"):format(gone, #sent, skipped)
                    or ("Requested %d; result unverified; skipped %d"):format(#sent, skipped))
            pcall(inventoryAutomation.logSale, {
                phase = "finished", asked = count, requested = #sent, gone = verified and gone or nil,
                verified = verified, skipped = skipped, stopped = stopReason,
            })
            if context.log then context.log("AutoSell", inventoryAutomation.note) end
            return gone, stopReason == nil and verified and gone == #sent
        end

        local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local function S()
            local localPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            return "HarvardLabs/data/sellgames_" .. (localPlayer and localPlayer.Name or "unknown") .. ".json"
        end
        local D
        local function P()
            local _ = D
            if _ then
                local l = D
                return l
            end
            D = {
                games = 0,
                job = "",
            }
            pcall(function()
                local l = isfile and isfile(S())
                if l then
                    local l = httpService:JSONDecode(readfile(S()))
                    local c = type(l) == "table"
                    if c then
                        local c, u, games, job = D, D, tonumber(l.games) or 0, tostring(l.job or "")
                        c.games = games
                        u.job = job
                    end
                end
            end)
            _ = D
            return _
        end
        local function D()
            pcall(function()
                writefile(S(), httpService:JSONEncode(P()))
            end)
        end
        inventoryAutomation.games = function()
            return P().games
        end
        inventoryAutomation.sellAfter = function()
            return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(config.sellAfterGames) or 10), 1, 50)
        end
        inventoryAutomation.sellDue = function()
            return config.autoSell == true and P().games >= inventoryAutomation.sellAfter()
        end
        inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob = nil
        inventoryAutomation.busy = false
        inventoryAutomation.holdStart = function()
            if
                config.autoSell ~= true
                or not inventoryAutomation.inLobby()
                or context.RT and context.RT.modHalt
            then
                return false
            end
            if not (inventoryAutomation.busy or inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob ~= game.JobId) then
                return false
            end
            if inventoryAutomation.holdJob ~= game.JobId then
                inventoryAutomation.holdJob, inventoryAutomation.holdSince = game.JobId, os.clock()
            end
            if os.clock() - inventoryAutomation.holdSince > (tonumber(config.sellHoldMax) or 45) then
                inventoryAutomation.note = "the sale took too long - the run starts anyway"
                return false
            end
            return true
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local L
            while not (context.RT and context.RT.destroyed) do
                task.wait(1)
                pcall(function()
                    local S = inventoryAutomation.inLobby()
                    if S then
                        if inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob == game.JobId then
                            return
                        end
                        if config.autoSell ~= true then
                            inventoryAutomation.note = "off"
                            inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob = game.JobId
                            return
                        end
                        if context.RT and context.RT.modHalt then
                            inventoryAutomation.note = "held by mod detection"
                            return
                        end
                        L = L or os.clock()
                        local success = os.clock() - L
                        if success < (tonumber(config.sellLobbySettle) or 2) then
                            return
                        end
                        local localPlayer, l = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer, os.clock() - L
                        if l < (tonumber(config.sellLobbyMin) or 10) then
                            return
                        end
                        l = localPlayer and (localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"))
                        success = l and (l:FindFirstChild("Level"))
                        l = not (success and (tonumber(success.Value) or 0) > 1)
                        if l then
                            success = os.clock() - L
                            if success < (tonumber(config.sellLoadWait) or 30) then
                                return
                            end
                            inventoryAutomation.note =
                                "this lobby never showed the account's level - no sale here"
                            inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob = game.JobId
                            return
                        end
                        if inventoryAutomation.busy then
                            return
                        end
                        inventoryAutomation.busy = true
                        success, localPlayer, l = pcall(inventoryAutomation.sellNow)
                        inventoryAutomation.busy = false
                        inventoryAutomation.lobbyJob = game.JobId
                        if success and l then
                            P().games = 0
                            D()
                        end
                    else
                        L = nil
                        if context.isEvent and context.isEvent() then
                            if config.autoSell == true then
                                inventoryAutomation.note =
                                    "not in an event run - its bag is the event's class kits"
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        local dungeonName, dungeonStarted =
                            workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName"), workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonStarted")
                        if
                            dungeonName
                            and tostring(dungeonName.Value) ~= ""
                            and dungeonStarted
                            and dungeonStarted.Value == true
                            and P().job ~= game.JobId
                        then
                            P().job = game.JobId
                            P().games = P().games + 1
                            D()
                            if config.autoSell == true then
                                inventoryAutomation.note = ("%d of %d games played"):format(
                                    P().games,
                                    inventoryAutomation.sellAfter()
                                )
                            end
                        end
                        if
                            config.autoSell == true
                            and dungeonName
                            and tostring(dungeonName.Value) ~= ""
                            and dungeonStarted
                            and dungeonStarted.Value == true
                            and P().games >= inventoryAutomation.sellAfter()
                            and inventoryAutomation.soldJob ~= game.JobId
                            and not inventoryAutomation.busy
                            and not (context.RT and context.RT.modHalt)
                        then
                            inventoryAutomation.soldJob = game.JobId
                            inventoryAutomation.busy = true
                            local success2, Q, Q = pcall(inventoryAutomation.sellNow)
                            inventoryAutomation.busy = false
                            if success2 and Q then
                                P().games = 0
                                D()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    components.partyQueue = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local contextWorkspace = context.Workspace
        local replicatedStorage = context.ReplicatedStorage
        local localPlayer = context.LocalPlayer
        local contextLog = context.log
        local lB = {
            place = nil,
            placeAt = -math.huge,
            lastAttempt = -math.huge,
            lastStartPress = -math.huge,
            attempts = 0,
            busy = false,
            status = "off",
        }
        local function c()
            if lB.pm == nil then
                local success, h = pcall(function()
                    return require(replicatedStorage.Utility.PlaceManager)
                end)
                lB.pm = success and h or false
            end
            return lB.pm or nil
        end
        local function u()
            local h = c()
            if h and h.GetPlaceName then
                local success, R = pcall(h.GetPlaceName)
                if success and type(R) == "string" and R ~= "" then
                    return R
                end
            end
            h = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            return h and h.Value ~= "" and "Level" or contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") and "Lobby" or "?"
        end
        local function h(status)
            if lB.status ~= status then
                lB.status = status
                if context.refreshQueuePanel then
                    context.refreshQueuePanel()
                end
            end
        end
        local function m(R)
            local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            return remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild(R))
        end
        local function D(R, y)
            local q = (y or contextWorkspace):FindFirstChild(R)
            return q and q:IsA("ValueBase") and q or nil
        end
        local function R()
            local dungeon = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
            local q = dungeon and (dungeon:FindFirstChild("bossRoom"))
            return q and (D("dungeonFinished", q))
        end
        local function y()
            if config.replayOnBossKilled == false then
                return false
            end
            local q = D("dungeonProgress")
            return q ~= nil and tostring(q.Value) == "bossKilled"
        end
        local function contextQueueNow(reason)
            if context.AF and context.AF.soloQueueBlocked and context.AF.soloQueueBlocked() then
                h("queued by your party")
                return false
            end
            if context.queueLog then
                context.queueLog("queue", {
                    reason = reason,
                    map = config.autoQueueMap,
                    diff = config.autoQueueDifficulty,
                })
            end
            if lB.busy then
                return false
            end
            lB.busy, lB.lastAttempt, lB.attempts = true, os.clock(), lB.attempts + 1
            task.spawn(function()
                local success, p = pcall(function()
                    local j, U = m("createLobby"), m("startDungeon")
                    if not j or not U then
                        error("the lobby remotes are not present")
                    end
                    local J = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                    local w = J and J:FindFirstChild("queueGui") and J.queueGui:FindFirstChild("lobbyInfo")
                    if w and w.Visible then
                        h("party open; starting")
                        U:FireServer()
                        return
                    end
                    h(
                        ("creating %s, %s"):format(
                            tostring(config.autoQueueMap),
                            tostring(config.autoQueueDifficulty)
                        )
                    )
                    if
                        config.autoQueueMap == "Northern Lands"
                        and config.autoQueueDifficulty ~= "Insane"
                        and config.autoQueueDifficulty ~= "Nightmare"
                    then
                        config.autoQueueDifficulty = "Nightmare"
                        h("error: Northern Lands only runs on Insane or Nightmare - set to Nightmare")
                        contextLog(
                            "Queue",
                            "Northern Lands only runs on Insane or Nightmare; difficulty set to Nightmare"
                        )
                    end
                    J = j:InvokeServer(
                        config.autoQueueMap,
                        config.autoQueueDifficulty,
                        tonumber(config.autoQueueMinLevel) or 0,
                        config.autoQueueHardcore == true,
                        true,
                        false
                    )
                    if J ~= true then
                        h("declined by the game")
                        contextLog("Queue", "declined: " .. tostring(J))
                        if context.notify then
                            context.notify("warning", "Queue declined", "The game said no: " .. tostring(J))
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    task.wait(config.autoQueueStartDelay)
                    h("starting")
                    U:FireServer()
                    contextLog(
                        "Queue",
                        ("queued %s on %s (%s)"):format(
                            tostring(config.autoQueueMap),
                            tostring(config.autoQueueDifficulty),
                            tostring(reason or "auto")
                        )
                    )
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            "party",
                            "Queued",
                            ("%s, %s."):format(
                                tostring(config.autoQueueMap),
                                tostring(config.autoQueueDifficulty)
                            )
                        )
                    end
                end)
                if not success then
                    h("failed; will retry")
                    contextLog("Queue", "queueing threw: " .. tostring(p))
                end
                lB.busy = false
            end)
            return true
        end
        local function contextQueueLog(E, p)
            pcall(function()
                local j = {
                    k = E,
                    who = localPlayer.Name,
                    wall = os.time(),
                    job = string.sub(game.JobId, 1, 8),
                }
                for key, entry in pairs(p or {}) do
                    j[key] = type(entry) == "table" and entry or tostring(entry)
                end
                local E = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(j)
                if runtimeState.bugLog then
                    pcall(runtimeState.bugLog, "queue.jsonl", E)
                end
                if config.devLogs == true then
                    appendfile("HarvardLabs/logs/queue.jsonl", E .. "\10")
                end
            end)
        end
        context.queueLog = contextQueueLog
        local function contextReplayNow()
            -- Last-chance guard: completion has priority even if a caller
            -- bypasses contextLobbyTick or the target changes at the last moment.
            if context.LEG and context.LEG.ShouldReturnToLobby then
                local name = D("dungeonName")
                local ok, leave, nextMap = pcall(context.LEG.ShouldReturnToLobby,
                    name and name.Value or nil)
                if ok and leave then
                    h(nextMap and ("Legendary goals met - returning to lobby for " .. nextMap)
                        or "Legendary goals met - returning to lobby")
                    return false
                end
            end
            local p = m("replayDungeon")
            if not p then
                lB.replayFired, lB.replayAt = true, os.clock()
                h("replay: the game's replayDungeon remote is missing")
                contextLog("Queue", "replay not sent: remotes.replayDungeon is missing")
                return false
            end
            local j, U = {}, { "dungeonName", "dungeonProgress", "dungeonStarted", "hardcore" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(U) do
                index = D(entry)
                if index then
                    j[entry] = index.Value
                end
            end
            if j.hardcore ~= nil then
                j.isHardcore = j.hardcore
            end
            local dungeon, iterateArray = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon"), ipairs
            U = {
                dungeon,
                dungeon and (dungeon:FindFirstChild("bossRoom")),
            }
            for key, entry2 in iterateArray(U) do
                for index2, child in ipairs(entry2:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                        j[child.Name] = child.Value
                    end
                end
            end
            if not j.dungeonName then
                lB.replayFired, lB.replayAt = true, os.clock()
                h("replay: no dungeon name to send")
                contextLog("Queue", "replay not sent: workspace.dungeonName is missing")
                return false
            end
            lB.replayFired, lB.replayAt = true, os.clock()
            do
                local plan
                U = context.AF and context.AF.role and context.AF.role()
                if U then
                    pcall(function()
                        plan = context.AF.plan()
                    end)
                end
                contextQueueLog("replay", {
                    dungeon = j.dungeonName,
                    progress = j.dungeonProgress,
                    plan = plan,
                    owner = true,
                })
            end
            p:FireServer(j)
            h("replay sent")
            contextLog("Queue", ("replay sent for %s"):format(tostring(j.dungeonName)))
            if context.notify then
                context.notify("run", "Replaying", tostring(j.dungeonName) .. " again, same party.")
            end
            return true
        end
        lB.ownerCache = lB.ownerCache or {
            at = -math.huge,
        }
        local function V()
            local ownerCache = lB.ownerCache
            local j = os.clock() - ownerCache.at >= (config.ownerCacheFor or 1) and not ownerCache.busy
            if j then
                ownerCache.busy = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local j = c()
                    local U, J, w
                    if j then
                        local Y = type(j.GetPublishedOwnerId) == "function"
                        if Y then
                            pcall(function()
                                U = j.GetPublishedOwnerId()
                            end)
                        end
                        Y = type(j.GetDungeonOwnerId) == "function"
                        if Y then
                            pcall(function()
                                J = j.GetDungeonOwnerId()
                            end)
                        end
                        if type(j.IsDungeonOwner) == "function" then
                            local success, v = pcall(j.IsDungeonOwner, localPlayer)
                            w = if success and type(v) == "boolean" then v else w
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    ownerCache.pub, ownerCache.dun, ownerCache.isOwn, ownerCache.has =
                        tonumber(U), tonumber(J), w, j ~= nil and type(j.IsDungeonOwner) == "function"
                    ownerCache.at = os.clock()
                    ownerCache.busy = false
                end)
            end
            return ownerCache.pub, ownerCache.dun, ownerCache.isOwn, ownerCache.has
        end
        local function contextIsRunOwner()
            local j, success, J, w = V()
            if j then
                return j == localPlayer.UserId
            end
            if w and J ~= nil then
                if success == nil then
                    return true
                end
                return J
            end
            local j = c()
            success, w = pcall(function()
                return j.GetPlaceTeleportData()
            end)
            return not success or type(w) ~= "table" or w.ownerId == nil or w.ownerId == localPlayer.UserId
        end
        local function contextRunOwnerId()
            local j, U = V()
            return j or U
        end
        context.partyNotHere = function()
            if lB.tdJob ~= game.JobId then
                lB.tdJob = game.JobId
                lB.tdIds = {}
                pcall(function()
                    local V = game:GetService("TeleportService"):GetLocalPlayerTeleportData()
                    if type(V) == "table" and type(V.playerIds) == "table" then
                        for key, playerId in pairs(V.playerIds) do
                            key = tonumber(playerId)
                            if key then
                                lB.tdIds[#lB.tdIds + 1] = key
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local V, players = {}, game:GetService("Players")
            for index, entry in ipairs(lB.tdIds) do
                if entry ~= localPlayer.UserId and not players:GetPlayerByUserId(entry) then
                    V[#V + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return V
        end
        local function contextLobbyTick(j)
            if not lB.place or lB.place == "?" or j - lB.placeAt > 5 then
                lB.place = u()
                lB.placeAt = j
            end
            if context.AF then
                pcall(context.AF.tickAlways, j)
            end
            if context.loadoutTick then
                pcall(context.loadoutTick, j)
            end
            local u = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            local farmEnabled = lB.place == "Level"
                or lB.place == "100+"
                or lB.place ~= "Lobby" and u ~= nil and u:IsA("StringValue") and u.Value ~= ""
            if
                config.autoFarmByPlace
                and lB.place ~= lB.farmAppliedFor
                and (farmEnabled or lB.place == "Lobby")
            then
                lB.farmAppliedFor = lB.place
                if runtimeState.farmEnabled ~= farmEnabled then
                    runtimeState.farmEnabled = farmEnabled
                    if context.setLoopButtonState then
                        pcall(context.setLoopButtonState)
                    end
                    if context.notify then
                        context.notify(
                            farmEnabled and "run" or "info",
                            farmEnabled and "Autofarm on" or "Autofarm off",
                            farmEnabled and "In a dungeon - farming."
                                or "In the lobby - it switches back on in the next dungeon."
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            if lB.place == "Lobby" and context.MD and context.MD.lobbyHold then
                local J, w = context.MD.lobbyHold()
                if J then
                    lB.arrivedAt = nil
                    if context.AF and context.AF.restartWait then
                        context.AF.restartWait()
                    end
                    h(w)
                    return
                end
            end
            u = false
            do
                local J
                pcall(function()
                    J = context.AF and context.AF.role and context.AF.role()
                end)
                u = if J ~= nil
                    then context.AF.isHost() == true or context.AF.ownRun ~= nil and context.AF.ownRun() == true
                    else u
            end
            if farmEnabled and u and not (context.MD and context.MD.halted) then
                lB.levelArrivedAt = lB.levelArrivedAt or j
                local J, w = D("dungeonStarted"), context.RT and context.RT.preWalk
                local Y, v, M, Z =
                    w ~= nil and (w.done == true or j - (w.at or 0) > 1.5),
                    j - lB.levelArrivedAt >= (config.autoStartWalkMax or 90),
                    config.startCountdown or 5,
                    context.RT and context.RT.preWalk
                local n, f =
                    config.startTimed ~= false and Z ~= nil and Z.pointsDone == true and j - (Z.at or 0) < 1.5,
                    true
                if config.startTimed ~= false then
                    f = if (context.nextCastIn and context.nextCastIn() or 0) > M then false else f
                    if context.buffState then
                        local r, o, o = context.buffState(j)
                        f = if r == "gap" and (o or 0) > M then false else f
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                lB.startWhy = v and "backstop"
                    or (n and "timed" or (Y and "walk done" or "walking"))
                        .. (f and "" or ", abilities not ready by the countdown")
                Z = context.partyNotHere and context.partyNotHere() or {}
                w = #Z > 0 and j - lB.levelArrivedAt < (config.startPartyWaitMax or 45)
                if w then
                    lB.startWhy = ("waiting for %d of the party to load in"):format(#Z)
                end
                lB.startMissing = #Z
                if
                    J
                    and not J.Value
                    and not w
                    and (v or (Y or n) and f)
                    and j - lB.levelArrivedAt >= config.autoStartDelay
                    and j - lB.lastStartPress >= 10
                then
                    lB.lastStartPress = j
                    Z = m("changeStartValue")
                    if Z then
                        pcall(Z.FireServer, Z)
                        contextLog("Queue", "START pressed (" .. tostring(lB.startWhy) .. ")")
                        if context.notify then
                            context.notify(
                                "run",
                                "Starting the run",
                                (lB.startMissing or 0) == 0 and "Everyone is in."
                                    or ("%d of the party never loaded in - starting without them."):format(
                                        lB.startMissing
                                    )
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if farmEnabled then
                u = D("bonusBossVotingActive")
                if u and u.Value then
                    lB.bonusVoteSeenAt = lB.bonusVoteSeenAt or j
                    if not lB.bonusVoted and j - lB.bonusVoteSeenAt >= config.bonusVoteDelay then
                        lB.bonusVoted = true
                        lB.bonusVoteAt = j
                        local J = m("bonusBossPlayerVote")
                        local w = config.bonusBoss and "yes" or "no"
                        if J then
                            task.spawn(function()
                                pcall(J.InvokeServer, J, w)
                            end)
                            contextLog("Queue", "bonus boss vote: " .. w)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    lB.bonusVoteSeenAt = nil
                    lB.bonusVoted = false
                end
            end
            u = context.AF and context.AF.role() or nil
            if lB.place == "Lobby" and u and j - (lB.playPressAt or -math.huge) > 3 then
                local _ = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local J, w = _ and (_:FindFirstChild("introGui"))
                if J and J.Enabled ~= false then
                    _ = J:FindFirstChild("title")
                    local J = _ and (_:FindFirstChild("Frame"))
                    w = J and (J:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextButton"))
                else
                end
                if w and w.Visible and w.AbsoluteSize.X > 1 then
                    lB.playPressAt = j
                    pcall(function()
                        if getconnections then
                            local _ = { "MouseButton1Click", "Activated", "MouseButton1Down" }
                            for index, entry in ipairs(_) do
                                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(getconnections(w[entry])) do
                                    entry2:Fire()
                                end
                            end
                        elseif firesignal then
                            firesignal(w.MouseButton1Click)
                        end
                    end)
                    h("title screen: pressing Play")
                    return
                end
            end
            local _ = lB.place == "Lobby"
            if _ then
                if context.RD then
                    context.RD.resetUsed, context.RD.catchUpUsed = nil, nil
                end
                lB.arrivedAt = lB.arrivedAt or j
                lB.replayFired = false
                lB.finishedSeenAt = nil
                lB.runOverAt = nil
                lB.legInventoryAt = nil
                lB.legLobbyTryAt = nil
                lB.rodinPhase = false
                lB.rodinSeenAt = nil
                lB.rodinFinishedAt = nil
                lB.rodinWasAlive = nil
                if u then
                    pcall(context.AF.lobbyTick, j)
                    return
                end
                h("not in a running party - runs start from a party (Parties & Runs)")
            elseif farmEnabled then
                lB.arrivedAt = nil
                lB.sawLevel = true
                if context.MD and context.MD.halted then
                    return
                end
                local _ = R()
                if config.bonusBoss and context.bonusBossRun and context.bonusBossRun() then
                    local U = D("bonusBossStatus")
                    local J, w = if U then tostring(U.Value or "") else "", D("bonusBossVotingActive")
                    local Y, v = w ~= nil and w.Value == true, context.rodinAlive ~= nil and context.rodinAlive()
                    if v then
                        lB.rodinWasAlive = true
                    end
                    w, U =
                        J == "success" or lB.rodinWasAlive == true and not v and J ~= "active",
                        lB.bonusVoted == true and j - (lB.bonusVoteAt or 0) < (config.rodinAfterVote or 150)
                    local M = (Y or v or J ~= "" or U) and not w
                    if w and lB.rodinPhase then
                        lB.rodinPhase = false
                        lB.rodinSeenAt = nil
                    end
                    if J:lower():find("fail", 1, true) then
                        lB.rodinPhase = false
                        lB.rodinSeenAt = nil
                        lB.replayFired = false
                        lB.finishedSeenAt = nil
                        h("dungeon failed - waiting for the game to send us back to town")
                        return
                    end
                    Y = _ and _.Value or y()
                    if not Y then
                        lB.rodinFinishedAt = nil
                    end
                    if Y then
                        lB.rodinFinishedAt = lB.rodinFinishedAt or j
                    end
                    if M then
                        lB.rodinPhase = true
                        lB.rodinSeenAt = j
                    end
                    if lB.rodinPhase and not M and j - (lB.rodinSeenAt or 0) > (config.rodinSettle or 45) then
                        lB.rodinPhase = false
                    end
                    M = Y and not lB.rodinPhase and j - (lB.rodinFinishedAt or j) < (config.rodinVoteWait or 8)
                    if lB.rodinPhase or M then
                        lB.replayFired = false
                        lB.finishedSeenAt = nil
                        if v then
                            h("fighting the bonus boss")
                        elseif lB.rodinPhase then
                            h("staying for the bonus boss" .. (J ~= "" and " - " .. J or ""))
                        else
                            h(
                                ("run finished; holding the replay %.0fs for the bonus boss vote"):format(
                                    (config.rodinVoteWait or 8) - (j - (lB.rodinFinishedAt or j))
                                )
                            )
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
                if not (_ and _.Value or y()) then
                    lB.replayFired = false
                    lB.finishedSeenAt = nil
                    lB.runOverAt = nil
                    h("in a run")
                    return
                end
                lB.runOverAt = lB.runOverAt or j
                -- Legendary progression takes precedence over *all* party replay
                -- decisions. Allow the reward event a short interval to arrive,
                -- then read the authoritative inventory (also covers T3 armor).
                -- Keep the ordinary replay countdown running during that interval.
                if context.LEG and context.LEG.state and context.LEG.state.on then
                    lB.finishedSeenAt = lB.finishedSeenAt or j
                    local elapsed = j - lB.runOverAt
                    if elapsed < 2.5 then
                        h("Legendary farm: checking the completed run's rewards")
                        return
                    end
                    if j - (lB.legInventoryAt or -math.huge) >= 3 then
                        lB.legInventoryAt = j
                        pcall(context.LEG.refreshInventory, true)
                    end
                    local currentName = D("dungeonName")
                    local ok, leave, nextMap = pcall(context.LEG.ShouldReturnToLobby,
                        currentName and currentName.Value or nil)
                    if ok and leave then
                        -- The replay remote cannot change dungeon; returning to
                        -- lobby is mandatory before the party can queue nextMap.
                        lB.replayFired = false
                        lB.afMoveOn = nextMap and (nextMap .. " Nightmare") or "farm complete"
                        lB.legLobbyTryAt = lB.legLobbyTryAt or -math.huge
                        if j - lB.legLobbyTryAt >= 6 then
                            lB.legLobbyTryAt = j
                            if context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                                pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
                            else
                                local ret = m("ReturnToLobbyEvent")
                                if ret then pcall(ret.FireServer, ret) end
                            end
                        end
                        h(nextMap and ("Goals met - returning to lobby for " .. nextMap)
                            or "All goals met - returning to lobby")
                        return
                    end
                    -- Reward replication can lag behind the victory flag. Give the
                    -- inventory a second read before allowing the same map to replay.
                    if elapsed < 7 then
                        h("Legendary farm: waiting for reward inventory before replay")
                        return
                    end
                end
                if context.MD and context.MD.pendingDrop then
                    h("run over - resting after a big drop, to the lobby")
                    return
                end
                if context.MD and context.MD.pendingBreak then
                    h("run over - taking a break, to the lobby")
                    return
                end
                _ = u ~= nil and context.AF.isHost() and context.AF.load().replay ~= false
                if _ and context.AF.others then
                    local U = {}
                    for index3, entry3 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        U[string.lower(entry3.Name)] = true
                    end
                    for index4, entry4 in ipairs(context.AF.others()) do
                        index4 = context.AF.presence and context.AF.presence(entry4.name, 86400)
                        local Y = index4 and tonumber(index4.resting)
                        if
                            (
                                Y and Y > os.time()
                                or index4
                                    and index4.dropPending
                                    and os.time() - (tonumber(index4.at) or 0) <= 60
                            )
                            and (config.afRestHoldsParty == true or U[string.lower(entry4.name)])
                        then
                            _ = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                _ = if _ and context.AF.pendingNewSave and context.AF.pendingNewSave() then false else _
                if _ and context.AF.others then
                    local U = {}
                    for index5, entry5 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                        U[string.lower(entry5.Name)] = true
                    end
                    for index6, entry6 in ipairs(context.AF.others()) do
                        if not U[string.lower(entry6.name)] then
                            index6 = context.AF.presence
                                and context.AF.presence(entry6.name, config.afOnlineAge or 60)
                            local U = index6 and tonumber(index6.resting)
                            if
                                index6
                                and not (index6 and tonumber(index6.stuck) and os.time() - tonumber(index6.stuck) <= (config.afStuckFresh or 120))
                                and not (U and U > os.time())
                            then
                                _ = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                lB.afMoveOn = nil
                if _ then
                    local success, J, w = pcall(context.AF.plan)
                    local Y = D("dungeonName")
                    local v = context.WH and context.WH.liveDungeon and context.WH.liveDungeon()
                        or Y and tostring(Y.Value)
                        or ""
                    if success and J and v ~= "" and J ~= v then
                        lB.afMoveOn = ("%s %s"):format(tostring(J), tostring(w))
                        _ = false
                    else
                    end
                    Y = _ and success and w and context.WH and context.WH.liveDifficulty
                    if Y then
                        local Y = context.WH.liveDifficulty()
                        Y = Y and Y:gsub(" %(Hardcore%)", "") or nil
                        success = not Y or Y == ""
                        if success then
                            pcall(function()
                                local U = game:GetService("HttpService")
                                    :JSONDecode(readfile(context.AF.partyFile("af_party")))
                                local M = U and U.map == v
                                if M then
                                    Y = U.diff
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        local U = Y and Y ~= "" and string.lower(Y) ~= string.lower(tostring(w))
                        if U then
                            lB.afMoveOn = ("%s %s"):format(tostring(J), tostring(w))
                            _ = false
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                local U = false
                if u ~= nil and context.AF.isHost() then
                    local J = contextRunOwnerId()
                    if J ~= nil and J ~= localPlayer.UserId then
                        _, U = false, true
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
                lB.sellTrip = nil
                if u ~= nil and not _ then
                    local J, w = context.AF.carry(), false
                    if J then
                        for index7, entry7 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                            if string.lower(entry7.Name) == string.lower(J.name) then
                                w = true
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    J = context.AF.isHost()
                    local Y = u == "carry" and J and config.afCarryLeave ~= false
                    if u == "party" or Y or U or lB.sellTrip or not J and not w then
                        if J or not w then
                            lB.ptLeaveSince = lB.ptLeaveSince or j
                            local w = J
                                    and (Y and not U and not lB.sellTrip and (config.afCarryLeaveAfter or 40) or 15)
                                or 25
                            if
                                j - lB.ptLeaveSince >= w
                                and j - (lB.ptLeaveAt or -math.huge) > 15
                                and context.MD
                                and context.MD.goLobby
                            then
                                lB.ptLeaveAt = j
                                pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
                            end
                            h(
                                (
                                    lB.sellTrip and "run over - back to the lobby to sell in %.0fs"
                                    or lB.afMoveOn and "run over - the party moves on to " .. lB.afMoveOn .. ": back to the lobby in %.0fs"
                                    or "party: run over - back to the lobby to regroup in %.0fs"
                                ):format(math.max(0, w - (j - lB.ptLeaveSince)))
                            )
                        else
                            lB.ptLeaveSince = nil
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not _ then
                    if u == nil and context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                        lB.noPartyLeaveSince = lB.noPartyLeaveSince or j
                        local U = (config.noPartyLeaveAfter or 25) - (j - lB.noPartyLeaveSince)
                        if U <= 0 and j - (lB.noPartyLeaveAt or -math.huge) > 15 then
                            lB.noPartyLeaveAt = j
                            pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
                        end
                        h(("run over - not in a party, back to the lobby in %.0fs"):format(math.max(0, U)))
                    end
                    return
                end
                if context.WH and context.WH.pendingUntil and os.clock() < context.WH.pendingUntil then
                    h(
                        ("run finished; replay waits for the win post (%.0fs max)"):format(
                            context.WH.pendingUntil - os.clock()
                        )
                    )
                    return
                end
                if lB.replayFired and j - (lB.replayAt or 0) < (config.autoQueueReplayRetry or 12) then
                    return
                end
                lB.finishedSeenAt = lB.finishedSeenAt or j
                if not contextIsRunOwner() then
                    h("run finished; the party owner sends the replay")
                    return
                end
                _ = config.autoQueueReplayDelay
                local U = (if u ~= nil then math.max(_, config.afReplaySettle or 5) else _)
                    - (j - lB.finishedSeenAt)
                if U > 0 then
                    h(("run finished; replay in %.0fs"):format(U))
                else
                    contextReplayNow()
                end
            else
                h("off")
            end
        end

        context.replayNow = contextReplayNow

        local partyQueue = {
            file = "HarvardLabs/data/altfarm.json",

        local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local players2 = game:GetService("Players")
        local function q(E)
            return string.lower(tostring(E or ""))
        end
        partyQueue.defaults = function()
            return {
                on = false,
                accounts = {},
                map = config.autoQueueMap or "Desert Temple",

        end
        partyQueue.LEVELS = {
