        partyQueue.EXTRA_DIFFS = {}
        partyQueue.allowedDiffs = function(E)
            E = tostring(E or "")
            local p = context.EVENT_DIFF and context.EVENT_DIFF[E]
            if p then
                return {
                    [p] = true,
                }
            end
            p = partyQueue.LEVELS[E]
            if p and next(p) then
                local j = {}
                for entry in pairs(p) do
                    j[entry] = true
                end
                return j
            end
            return partyQueue.EXTRA_DIFFS[E]
                or {
                    Insane = true,
                    Nightmare = true,
                }
        end
        partyQueue.validDiff = function(E, p)
            local j = partyQueue.allowedDiffs(E)
            if p and j[p] then
                return p
            end
            local E, U = context.QUEUE_DIFFICULTIES or { "Easy", "Medium", "Hard", "Insane", "Nightmare" }, 1
            for index, entry in ipairs(E) do
                U = if entry == p then index else U
            end
            for index2 = U, #E, 1 do
                if j[E[index2]] then
                    return E[index2]
                end
            end
            for index3 = #E, 1, -1 do
                if j[E[index3]] then
                    return E[index3]
                end
            end
            return p
        end
        partyQueue.refreshLevels = function()
            if partyQueue.levelsLive then
                return
            end
            local E = m("getDungeonStats")
            if not E then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.levelsLive = true
            task.spawn(function()
                for level in pairs(partyQueue.LEVELS) do
                    local success, U = pcall(E.InvokeServer, E, level)
                    if success and type(U) == "table" then
                        local E, j = {}, { "Easy", "Medium", "Hard", "Insane", "Nightmare" }
                        for index, entry in ipairs(j) do
                            if type(U[entry]) == "table" and tonumber(U[entry].levelReq) then
                                E[entry] = tonumber(U[entry].levelReq)
                            end
                        end
                        if next(E) then
                            partyQueue.LEVELS[level] = E
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
            end)
        end
        partyQueue.bestFor = function(E, p, j)
            local U, J, w, Y = partyQueue.LEVELS[p or ""], partyQueue.LEVELS[j or ""], math.huge, -math.huge
            if U then
                w = 0
                for key, entry in pairs(U) do
                    w = math.max(w, entry)
                end
            else
            end
            if J then
                Y = math.huge
                for key2, entry2 in pairs(J) do
                    Y = math.min(Y, entry2)
                end
            else
            end
            Y = if Y > w then -math.huge else Y
            local p, U, v = -1
            for key3, level in pairs(partyQueue.LEVELS) do
                for key4, entry3 in pairs(level) do
                    if entry3 <= E and entry3 <= w and entry3 >= Y and entry3 > p then
                        p, U, v = entry3, key3, key4
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            if not U and J and Y > -math.huge then
                for key5, entry4 in pairs(J) do
                    if U == nil or entry4 < p then
                        U, p, v = j, entry4, key5
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            return U, v, p
        end
        local function E(p, j)
            p = p or partyQueue.load()
            local U
            local J, w, Y = false, false
            local v = false
            for index, account in ipairs(p.accounts) do
                if account.enabled ~= false then
                    index = players2:FindFirstChild(account.name)
                    if not index then
                        for index2, entry in ipairs(players2:GetPlayers()) do
                            if q(entry.Name) == q(account.name) then
                                index = entry
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    local n = index and (index:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"))
                    local f = n and (n:FindFirstChild("Level"))
                    local r, o = f and tonumber(f.Value) or nil, partyQueue.presence(account.name, 86400)
                    f = o and tonumber(o.level) or nil
                    r = if f and (not r or f > r) then f else r
                    if r and r > 0 then
                        U = math.min(U or math.huge, r)
                    else
                        J = true
                    end
                    n = index ~= nil
                    if not n then
                        o = partyQueue.presence(account.name, tonumber(config.afPlanAge) or 180)
                        f = o
                            and tonumber(o.stuck)
                            and os.time() - tonumber(o.stuck) <= (config.afStuckFresh or 120)
                        n = o ~= nil
                            and not f
                            and not (partyQueue.restingNow and partyQueue.restingNow(account.name))
                    else
                    end
                    if n then
                        w = true
                        if r and r > 0 then
                            Y = math.min(Y or math.huge, r)
                        else
                            v = true
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if not w then
                Y, v = U, J
            else
            end
            if p.auto ~= false then
                if Y and not v then
                    local U, J, w = partyQueue.bestFor(Y, p.hardest, p.start)
                    if U then
                        if not j then
                            partyQueue.lastPlan = {
                                U,
                                J,
                                w,
                                Y,
                                (partyQueue.carry(p) or {}).name,
                            }
                        end
                        return U, J, w, Y
                    end
                end
                if
                    partyQueue.lastPlan
                    and not j
                    and partyQueue.lastPlan[5] == (partyQueue.carry(p) or {}).name
                then
                    return partyQueue.lastPlan[1],
                        partyQueue.lastPlan[2],
                        partyQueue.lastPlan[3],
                        partyQueue.lastPlan[4]
                end
                if Y then
                    local U, J, w = partyQueue.bestFor(Y, p.hardest, p.start)
                    if U then
                        return U, J, w, Y
                    end
                end
                return "Desert Temple", "Easy", 1, Y
            end
            j = partyQueue.LEVELS[p.map or ""]
            if context.EVENT_DIFF and context.EVENT_DIFF[p.map or ""] then
                return p.map, context.EVENT_DIFF[p.map], 0, Y
            end
            local U = partyQueue.validDiff(p.map, p.difficulty)
            return p.map, U, j and j[U] or 0, Y
        end
        partyQueue.plan = function()
            local now, planCache = os.clock(), partyQueue.planCache
            if planCache and now - planCache.at < 1 and planCache.raw == partyQueue.raw then
                return planCache.m, planCache.d, planCache.r, planCache.lo
            end
            local j, U, J, w = E()
            partyQueue.planCache = {
                at = now,
                raw = partyQueue.raw,
                m = j,
                d = U,
                r = J,
                lo = w,
            }
            return j, U, J, w
        end
        partyQueue.planFor = function(p)
            if p == nil or p == partyQueue.load() then
                return partyQueue.plan()
            end
            return E(p, true)
        end

        end
        partyQueue.soloQueueBlocked = function()

        context.queuePick = function()

                E = partyQueue.role()

                    return p, j, false

            return config.autoQueueMap, config.autoQueueDifficulty, config.autoQueueHardcore == true
        end
        local function E(p, j)
            local U = q(j)
            for index, account in ipairs(p.accounts) do
                if type(account) == "table" and q(account.name) == U then
                    return account
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        partyQueue.migrate = function(p)
            if p.v == 2 then
                return false
            end
            local j
            for index, account in ipairs(p.accounts) do
                if type(account) == "table" then
                    if account.role == "carry" then
                        j = if not j and account.enabled ~= false then account else j
                        account.role = "fight"
                    else
                        if account.role ~= "leech" and account.role ~= "fight" and account.role ~= "leader" then
                            account.role = "leech"
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            local success, J = pcall(function()
                local w = vmHelpers[127](readfile("HarvardLabs/data/party.json"))
                return httpService:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(w))
            end)
            if success and type(J) == "table" and type(J.members) == "table" then
                for index2, member in ipairs(J.members) do
                    if type(member) == "table" and member.name and not E(p, member.name) then
                        p.accounts[#p.accounts + 1] = {
                            name = tostring(member.name),
                            role = "fight",
                            enabled = member.enabled ~= false,
                        }
                    end
                end
                j = if not j and tostring(J.leader or "") ~= "" then E(p, J.leader) else j
                if J.on == true then
                    p.on = true
                end
            else
            end
            if not j then
                for index3, account2 in ipairs(p.accounts) do
                    if type(account2) == "table" and account2.role == "fight" and account2.enabled ~= false then
                        j = account2
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if j then
                j.role = "leader"
            end
            p.v = 2
            return true
        end
        partyQueue.partyOf = function(d, E)
            local p, parties = q(d), (E or partyQueue.doc or {}).parties
            for index, entry in ipairs(type(parties) == "table" and parties or {}) do
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(entry.accounts or {}) do
                    if type(entry2) == "table" and q(entry2.name) == p then
                        return entry, index
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function d()
            local success, p = pcall(function()
                return httpService:GenerateGUID(false)

            return success and type(p) == "string" and p
                or "p" .. tostring(os.time()) .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
        end
        local function E()
            local p = partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc)
            if p then
                return p
            end
            partyQueue.outside = partyQueue.outside or partyQueue.defaults()
            return partyQueue.outside
        end
        partyQueue.loadReal = function(p)
            local cfgAt, U = os.clock(), not p
            if U and partyQueue.cfg and cfgAt - partyQueue.cfgAt < 1.5 then
                return partyQueue.cfg
            end
            if U and not partyQueue.cfg and partyQueue.noList and cfgAt - partyQueue.cfgAt < 1.5 then
                return partyQueue.noList
            end
            partyQueue.cfgAt = cfgAt
            local J, raw = pcall(readfile, partyQueue.file)
            cfgAt = J and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= ""
            if cfgAt then
                U = raw ~= partyQueue.raw or not partyQueue.doc
                if U then
                    local success, doc = pcall(function()
                        local raw2 = raw
                        return httpService:JSONDecode(raw2)
                    end)
                    J = success and type(doc) == "table"
                    if J then
                        success = false
                        if type(doc.parties) ~= "table" then
                            doc = {
                                v = 2,
                                parties = {
                                    doc,
                                },
                            }
                            success = true
                        else
                        end
                        for index = #doc.parties, 1, -1 do
                            p = doc.parties[index]
                            if type(p) ~= "table" then
                                table.remove(doc.parties, index)
                                success = true
                            else
                                for key, entry in pairs((partyQueue.defaults())) do
                                    if p[key] == nil then
                                        p[key] = entry
                                    end
                                end
                                if type(p.accounts) ~= "table" then
                                    p.accounts = {}
                                end
                                success = if partyQueue.migrate(p) then true else success
                                if type(p.id) ~= "string" or p.id == "" then
                                    p.id = d()
                                    success = true
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if doc.v ~= 2 then
                            doc.v = 2
                            success = true
                        else
                        end
                        if success then
                            pcall(function()
                                local p = httpService:JSONEncode(doc)
                                writefile(partyQueue.file, p)
                                raw = p
                            end)
                        end
                        partyQueue.doc = doc
                        partyQueue.raw = raw
                    else
                    end
                end
            end
            if partyQueue.doc then
                partyQueue.cfg = E()
                return partyQueue.cfg
            end
            J = partyQueue.defaults()
            if partyQueue.migrate(J) and #J.accounts > 0 then
                J.id = d()
                partyQueue.doc = {
                    v = 2,
                    parties = {
                        J,
                    },
                }
                pcall(function()
                    local raw2 = httpService:JSONEncode(partyQueue.doc)
                    writefile(partyQueue.file, raw2)
                    partyQueue.raw = raw2
                end)
                partyQueue.cfg = J
                return J
            end
            partyQueue.noList = J
            return J
        end
        partyQueue.save = function()
            local p = partyQueue.loadReal()
            if not partyQueue.doc then
                if type(p.id) ~= "string" then
                    p.id = d()
                end
                partyQueue.doc = {
                    v = 2,
                    parties = {
                        p,
                    },
                }
            end
            local success, raw = pcall(function()
                local doc = partyQueue.doc
                return httpService:JSONEncode(doc)
            end)
            if success then
                pcall(writefile, partyQueue.file, raw)
                partyQueue.raw = raw
            end
            partyQueue.cfg = E()
            partyQueue.cfgAt = os.clock()
        end

        partyQueue.editParty = function(parties)
            partyQueue.loadReal(parties)
            if not partyQueue.doc then
                partyQueue.doc = {
                    v = 2,
                    parties = {},
                }
            end
            parties = partyQueue.doc.parties
            if #parties == 0 then
                local p = partyQueue.defaults()
                p.v, p.id = 2, d()
                parties[1] = p
            end
            local editIdx
            if partyQueue.editId then
                for index, partie in ipairs(parties) do
                    if partie.id == partyQueue.editId then
                        editIdx = index
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not editIdx then
                local j, j = partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc)
                editIdx = j or 1
            else
            end
            partyQueue.editIdx, partyQueue.editId = editIdx, parties[editIdx].id
            return parties[editIdx], editIdx
        end

        partyQueue.soloParty = function(E)
            partyQueue.loadReal(true)

                partyQueue.doc = {

            local p, j = partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc)
            if p then

            p, j = partyQueue.doc.parties
            for index, entry in ipairs(p) do
                if type(entry.accounts) ~= "table" or #entry.accounts == 0 then
                    j = entry

            if not j then
                j = partyQueue.defaults()
                j.v, j.id = 2, d()
                p[#p + 1] = j
            else
            end
            j.accounts = {
                {
                    name = localPlayer.Name,
                    role = "leader",
                    enabled = true,
                },
            }
            j.on = false
            if type(E) == "table" then
                for key, entry2 in pairs(E) do

                end
            end
            partyQueue.editId = j.id
            partyQueue.save()
            return j
        end

            for index, account in ipairs((d or partyQueue.load()).accounts) do
                if
                    account ~= E
                    and account.enabled ~= false
                    and (account.role == "leader" or account.role == "fight" or account.role == "carry")
                    and not partyQueue.restingNow(account.name)
                then
                    return account
                end
            end
            return E
        end

        partyQueue.presence = function(d, E)
            local p, now = q(d), os.clock()
            d = partyQueue.presCache[p]
            if not d or now - d.at >= 1 then
                local U
                local success, w = pcall(readfile, "HarvardLabs/data/af_" .. p .. ".json")
                if success and type(w) == "string" then
                    local success2, Y = pcall(function()
                        return httpService:JSONDecode(w)
                    end)
                    U = if success2 and type(Y) == "table" then Y else U
                else
                end
                d = {
                    at = now,
                    t = if U == nil and d and d.t then d.t else U,
                }
                partyQueue.presCache[p] = d
            else
            end
            p = d.t
            if p and os.time() - (tonumber(p.at) or 0) <= (E or 20) then
                return p
            end
            return nil
        end

        partyQueue.requestRejoin = function(host, j, rejoinAt)
            if partyQueue.load().rejoin == false then
                return false
            end
            if
                (partyQueue.lastRunJob == nil or j.job ~= partyQueue.lastRunJob)
                and not (context.MD and context.MD.restRejoinOk and context.MD.restRejoinOk())
            then
                return false
            end
            if j.over == true then
                return false
            end
            if not tonumber(j.at) or os.time() - tonumber(j.at) > 20 then
                return false
            end
            if partyQueue.rejoinJob ~= j.job then
                partyQueue.rejoinJob = j.job
                partyQueue.rejoinTries = 0
                partyQueue.rejoinSaid = nil
            end
            if rejoinAt - (partyQueue.rejoinAt or -math.huge) < (config.afRejoinEvery or 20) then
                p(
                    ("%s is in a run - asked to join it (%s)"):format(
                        host,
                        tostring(partyQueue.rejoinSaid or "sending")
                    )
                )
                return true
            end
            if (partyQueue.rejoinTries or 0) >= (config.afRejoinMax or 8) then
                p(
                    ("%s is in a run - asked %d times, waiting for it to come back"):format(
                        host,
                        partyQueue.rejoinTries
                    )
                )
                return true
            end
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
            local w = remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("sendJoinRequest"))
            if not (w and (w:IsA("RemoteFunction"))) then
                return false
            end
            partyQueue.rejoinAt, partyQueue.rejoinTries = rejoinAt, (partyQueue.rejoinTries or 0) + 1
            local try = partyQueue.rejoinTries
            local J = type(j.name) == "string" and j.name ~= "" and j.name or host
            task.spawn(function()
                local success, Y, v, M = pcall(w.InvokeServer, w, J, false)
                if success and Y and M == true then
                    success, Y, v = pcall(w.InvokeServer, w, J, true)
                else
                end
                partyQueue.rejoinSaid = success and (Y and "request sent" or tostring(v or "refused"))
                    or "request failed"
                if context.queueLog then
                    context.queueLog("rejoin_request", {
                        host = host,
                        ok = tostring(success),
                        sent = tostring(Y),
                        msg = tostring(v),
                        force = tostring(M),
                        try = try,
                    })
                end
            end)
            p(("%s is in a run - asking to join it (try %d)"):format(host, try))
            return true
        end
        partyQueue.mates = function()

        partyQueue.rejoinHostTick = function(h)
            if h - (partyQueue.rjHostAt or -math.huge) < 1 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.rjHostAt = h
            if partyQueue.load().rejoin == false then
                return
            end
            if not partyQueue.isHost() then
                local j = partyQueue.carry()
                if not j or d(j.name) then
                    return
                end
            end
            local j = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (j and tostring(j.Value) ~= "") then
                return
            end
            j = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
            if not j then
                return
            end
            if not partyQueue.rjConn then
                local showJoinRequest, respondJoinRequest =
                    j:FindFirstChild("showJoinRequest"), j:FindFirstChild("respondJoinRequest")
                if not (showJoinRequest and respondJoinRequest) then
                    return
                end
                partyQueue.rjIds = partyQueue.rjIds or {}
                partyQueue.rjConn = showJoinRequest.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(U, w, Y, v)
                    if runtimeState.destroyed or Y == "close" or U == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    Y = false
                    for index, entry in ipairs(partyQueue.mates()) do
                        index = q(entry.name)
                        if q(w) == index then
                            Y = true
                            break
                        end
                        if partyQueue.rjIds[index] == nil then
                            local success, f = pcall(function()
                                local name = entry.name
                                return players2:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(name)
                            end)
                            partyQueue.rjIds[index] = success and f or false
                        end
                        if partyQueue.rjIds[index] and tostring(partyQueue.rjIds[index]) == tostring(U) then
                            Y = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    Y = if Y and partyQueue.runFighters and partyQueue.runFighters() == 0 then false else Y
                    Y = if Y and context.runFailed and context.runFailed() then false else Y
                    if not Y then
                        if context.queueLog then
                            context.queueLog("rejoin_unanswered", {
                                id = tostring(U),
                                name = tostring(w),
                                level = tostring(v),
                            })
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(respondJoinRequest.FireServer, respondJoinRequest, U, true)
                    task.delay(0.3, function()
                        pcall(function()
                            local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                            local M = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("joinRequestConfirm_" .. tostring(U))
                            if M then
                                M:Destroy()
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    if context.queueLog then
                        context.queueLog("rejoin_answer", {
                            id = tostring(U),
                            name = tostring(w),
                            level = tostring(v),
                            accepted = tostring(Y),
                        })
                    end
                end)
            end
            if context.runComplete and context.runComplete() then
                partyQueue.lateJoinWanted = nil
                return
            end
            local U = {}
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(players2:GetPlayers()) do
                U[q(entry2.Name)] = true
            end
            local missing
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(partyQueue.mates()) do
                if not U[q(entry3.name)] and not partyQueue.restingNow(entry3.name) then
                    missing = entry3.name
                    break
                end
            end
            if not missing then
                partyQueue.rjMissingSince = nil
                partyQueue.lateJoinWanted = nil
                return
            end
            if partyQueue.rjMissingJob ~= game.JobId then
                partyQueue.rjMissingJob = game.JobId
                partyQueue.rjMissingSince = h
            end
            partyQueue.rjMissingSince = partyQueue.rjMissingSince or h
            if h - partyQueue.rjMissingSince < (config.afRejoinOpenAfter or 15) then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.lateJoinWanted = game.JobId
            local w, joinRequests =
                localPlayer:FindFirstChild("lateJoin"), localPlayer:FindFirstChild("joinRequests")
            w = if not (w and w:IsA("StringValue")) then nil else w
            if w then
                if
                    w.Value == "on"
                    and not (joinRequests and joinRequests:IsA("StringValue") and joinRequests.Value ~= "anyone")
                then
                    partyQueue.ljOpen = game.JobId
                    if partyQueue.ljTryJob == game.JobId then
                        partyQueue.ljTries = 0
                    end
                    return
                end
                U = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("dataLoaded")
                if U and U:IsA("BoolValue") and U.Value ~= true then
                    return
                end
                if partyQueue.ljTryJob ~= game.JobId then
                    partyQueue.ljTryJob = game.JobId
                    partyQueue.ljTries = 0
                    partyQueue.ljTryAt = nil
                end
                if
                    partyQueue.ljTries >= (config.ljTriesMax or 10)
                    or h - (partyQueue.ljTryAt or -math.huge) < (config.ljRetry or 3)
                then
                    return
                end
                partyQueue.ljTryAt, partyQueue.ljTries = h, partyQueue.ljTries + 1
            elseif partyQueue.ljOpen == game.JobId then
                return
            end
            h = partyQueue.rjOpenedJob ~= game.JobId
            partyQueue.rjOpenedJob, partyQueue.ljOpen = game.JobId, game.JobId
            local hostSetLateJoin, hostSetJoinRequestMode =
                j:FindFirstChild("hostSetLateJoin"), j:FindFirstChild("hostSetJoinRequestMode")
            if hostSetLateJoin and not (w and w.Value == "on") then
                pcall(hostSetLateJoin.FireServer, hostSetLateJoin, "on")
            end
            if
                hostSetJoinRequestMode
                and not (joinRequests and joinRequests:IsA("StringValue") and joinRequests.Value == "anyone")
            then
                pcall(hostSetJoinRequestMode.FireServer, hostSetJoinRequestMode, "anyone")
            end
            if h then
                if context.queueLog then
                    context.queueLog("rejoin_open", {
                        missing = missing,
                    })
                end
                if context.log then
                    context.log(
                        "AltFarm",
                        ("%s is not in the run - late join on, its request will be accepted"):format(missing)
                    )
                end
            end
        end
        partyQueue.giveHostBack = function(hostBackAt)
            if hostBackAt - (partyQueue.hostBackAt or -math.huge) < (config.hostBackEvery or 5) then
                return
            end
            if partyQueue.load().on ~= true or partyQueue.isHost() then
                return
            end
            local j = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (j and tostring(j.Value) ~= "") then
                return
            end
            j = partyQueue.carry()
            local U = j and d(j.name)
            if not U then
                return
            end
            if (context.runOwnerId and context.runOwnerId()) ~= localPlayer.UserId then
                return
            end
            j = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("remotes")
            local J = j and (j:FindFirstChild("hostTransfer"))
            if not J then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.hostBackAt = hostBackAt
            pcall(J.FireServer, J, U)
            if context.queueLog then
                context.queueLog("host_back", {
                    to = U.Name,
                })
            end
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    ("%s, the party's leader, is back in the run - handing the host back"):format(U.Name)
                )
            end
        end
        partyQueue.runFighters = function()
            local h, j = partyQueue.load(), 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(players2:GetPlayers()) do
                index = partyQueue.entry(entry.Name, h)
                j = if index
                        and index.enabled ~= false
                        and index.role ~= "leech"
                        and entry:GetAttribute("LateJoiner") ~= true
                    then j + 1
                    else j
            end
            return j
        end
        partyQueue.deadRunTick = function(h)
            if h - (partyQueue.deadCheckAt or -math.huge) < 1 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.deadCheckAt = h
            local j = partyQueue.load()
            if j.on ~= true or not partyQueue.entry(localPlayer.Name, j) then
                partyQueue.deadSince = nil
                return
            end
            local U, J =
                contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName"), contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonStarted")
            if
                not (U and tostring(U.Value) ~= "" and J and J.Value == true)
                or context.runComplete and context.runComplete()
            then
                partyQueue.deadSince = nil
                return
            end
            J = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(players2:GetPlayers()) do
                index = partyQueue.entry(entry.Name, j)
                J = if index
                        and index.enabled ~= false
                        and index.role ~= "leech"
                        and entry:GetAttribute("LateJoiner") ~= true
                    then J + 1
                    else J
            end
            if J > 0 then
                partyQueue.deadSince = nil
                return
            end
            partyQueue.deadSince = partyQueue.deadSince or h
            U = (config.deadRunAfter or 20) - (h - partyQueue.deadSince)
            if U > 0 then
                p(
                    ("nobody here can clear this run (late joiners are spectators) - to the lobby in %.0fs"):format(
                        U
                    )
                )
                return
            end
            if h - (partyQueue.deadLeftAt or -math.huge) < 15 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.deadLeftAt = h
            if context.queueLog then
                U, J = context.queueLog, {}
                J.waited = math.floor(h - partyQueue.deadSince)
                U("dead_run", J)
            end
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    "nobody in this run can clear it - back to the lobby to make the party again"
                )
            end
            if context.notify then
                context.notify(
                    "warning",
                    "Back to the lobby",
                    "Nobody left in this run can clear it - making the party again."
                )
            end
            if context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(77649408247578, localPlayer)
                end)
            end
        end
        context.runFailed = function()
            local u = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            local h = u and (u:FindFirstChild("failedGui"))
            if h and (not h:IsA("ScreenGui") or h.Enabled) then
                u = h:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                if u == nil or not u:IsA("GuiObject") or u.Visible then
                    return true
                end
            end
            u = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("bonusBossStatus")
            return u ~= nil and string.lower(tostring(u.Value)):find("fail", 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        partyQueue.failedTick = function(u)
            if u - (partyQueue.failCheckAt or -math.huge) < 1 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.failCheckAt = u
            if
                not (contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName") and context.runFailed and context.runFailed())
            then
                partyQueue.failedSince = nil
                return
            end
            partyQueue.failedSince = partyQueue.failedSince or u
            local S = (config.failedStuckAfter or 150) - (u - partyQueue.failedSince)
            if S > 0 then
                p(
                    ("dungeon failed - waiting for the game's teleport to town (lobby by ourselves in %.0fs)"):format(
                        S
                    )
                )
                return
            end
            if u - (partyQueue.failedLeftAt or -math.huge) < 15 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.failedLeftAt = u
            if context.queueLog then
                local queueLog, h = context.queueLog, {}
                h.waited = math.floor(u - partyQueue.failedSince)
                queueLog("failed_stuck", h)
            end
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    "the run failed and the game did not send us to town - back to the lobby to make the party again"
                )
            end
            if context.notify then
                context.notify("error", "Run failed", "Back to the lobby to make the party again.")
            end
            if context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(77649408247578, localPlayer)
                end)
            end
        end
        partyQueue.LEAVING_TITLE = "Leaving the dungeon"
        partyQueue.LEAVING_BODY = "Back to the lobby with the whole party."
        partyQueue.leaveGo = function(S, u)
            local leaving = partyQueue.leaving
            if leaving and S - leaving.at < 12 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.leaving = {
                at = S,
                tries = (leaving and leaving.tries or 0) + 1,
            }
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    ("%s - back to the lobby now (try %d)"):format(u, partyQueue.leaving.tries)
                )
            end
            if context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(77649408247578, localPlayer)
                end)
            end
        end
        partyQueue.cardLeaving = function(S)
            if not S or S.gone then
                return false
            end
            pcall(S.set, partyQueue.LEAVING_TITLE, partyQueue.LEAVING_BODY)
            pcall(function()
                S.busy = true
                S.button.Text = "Leaving..."
            end)
            return true
        end
        partyQueue.leaveNowAll = function(S)
            pcall(function()
                partyQueue.loadReal(true)
                local u = partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc)
                if u then
                    u.leaveNow = {
                        job = game.JobId,
                        at = os.time(),
                    }
                    partyQueue.save()
                end
            end)
            partyQueue.cardLeaving(S)
            partyQueue.leaveGo(os.clock(), "Leave now (Run this party is off)")
        end
        partyQueue.offNoticeTick = function(offCheckAt, u)
            if offCheckAt - (partyQueue.offCheckAt or -math.huge) < 1 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.offCheckAt = offCheckAt
            if not (lB.place == "Level" or lB.place == "100+") then
                if partyQueue.offCard then
                    pcall(partyQueue.offCard.close)
                    partyQueue.offCard = nil
                end
                return
            end
            local h = u or partyQueue.load()
            u = partyQueue.entry(localPlayer.Name, h)
            if not u then
                return
            end
            local leaveNow = h.leaveNow
            if
                type(leaveNow) == "table"
                and leaveNow.job == game.JobId
                and tonumber(leaveNow.at)
                and math.abs(os.time() - tonumber(leaveNow.at)) <= 90
            then
                if
                    not partyQueue.leaving
                    and not partyQueue.cardLeaving(partyQueue.offCard)
                    and context.notify
                then
                    context.notify(
                        "party",
                        partyQueue.LEAVING_TITLE,
                        "Leave now was pressed - back to the lobby with the whole party."
                    )
                end
                partyQueue.leaveGo(offCheckAt, "Leave now was pressed")
                return
            end
            if h.on == true then
                if u.enabled ~= false then
                    partyQueue.partyRunJob = game.JobId
                end
                partyQueue.offShown = nil
                if partyQueue.offCard then
                    pcall(partyQueue.offCard.close)
                    partyQueue.offCard = nil
                end
                return
            end
            if partyQueue.partyRunJob ~= game.JobId or partyQueue.offShown == game.JobId then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.offShown = game.JobId
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    "Run this party was switched off during this run - to the lobby after it (Leave now on the card: at once)"
                )
            end
            if context.notifyCard then
                partyQueue.offCard = context.notifyCard(
                    "party",
                    "Going to lobby after this dungeon",
                    "Run this party was switched off. Leave now takes the whole party out.",
                    nil,
                    {
                        sticky = true,
                        button = {
                            text = "Leave now",
                            onClick = function(S)
                                partyQueue.leaveNowAll(S)
                            end,
                        },
                    }
                )
            end
        end
        partyQueue.stuckTick = function(S)
            if not partyQueue.tpFailConn then
                partyQueue.tpFailConn = true
                pcall(function()
                    partyQueue.tpFailConn = game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed
                        :Connect(function(u, h)
                            if u == localPlayer and h == Enum.TeleportResult.IsTeleporting then
                                partyQueue.tpBusyLast = os.time()
                                partyQueue.tpBusyFirst = partyQueue.tpBusyFirst or os.time()
                            end
                        end)
                end)
            end
            local u = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("teleporting")
            if u and u:IsA("BoolValue") and u.Value == true then
                partyQueue.tpFlagSince = partyQueue.tpFlagSince or S
            else
                partyQueue.tpFlagSince = nil
            end
            if partyQueue.tpBusyLast and os.time() - partyQueue.tpBusyLast > 120 then
                partyQueue.tpBusyFirst = nil
                partyQueue.tpBusyLast = nil
            end
            u = tonumber(config.afStuckTpAfter) or 60
            if
                partyQueue.tpFlagSince ~= nil and S - partyQueue.tpFlagSince >= u
                or partyQueue.tpBusyLast ~= nil
                    and os.time() - partyQueue.tpBusyLast <= 30
                    and os.time() - (partyQueue.tpBusyFirst or os.time()) >= u
            then
                if not partyQueue.stuckAt then
                    if context.log then
                        context.log(
                            "AltFarm",
                            "stuck in a teleport that never finished - the party goes on without this account; its Roblox needs a restart"
                        )
                    end
                    if context.notify then
                        pcall(
                            context.notify,
                            "warning",
                            "Stuck in a teleport",
                            "The game never finished moving this account. Its party goes on without it - restart this Roblox to bring it back."
                        )
                    end
                end
                partyQueue.stuckAt = os.time()
            elseif partyQueue.stuckAt and os.time() - partyQueue.stuckAt > 30 then
                partyQueue.stuckAt = nil
            end
        end
        partyQueue.tickAlways = function(presAt)
            if partyQueue.rejoinHostTick then
                pcall(partyQueue.rejoinHostTick, presAt)
            end
            if partyQueue.deadRunTick then
                pcall(partyQueue.deadRunTick, presAt)
            end
            if partyQueue.failedTick then
                pcall(partyQueue.failedTick, presAt)
            end
            if partyQueue.offNoticeTick then
                pcall(partyQueue.offNoticeTick, presAt)
            end
            if partyQueue.stuckTick then
                pcall(partyQueue.stuckTick, presAt)
            end
            if partyQueue.giveHostBack then
                pcall(partyQueue.giveHostBack, presAt)
            end
            local u = partyQueue.role()
            if u ~= partyQueue.fpsRole then
                partyQueue.fpsRole = u
                if context.applyFps then
                    pcall(context.applyFps)
                end
                if context.applyRender then
                    pcall(context.applyRender)
                end
            end
            u = partyQueue.load().leechDraw == true
            if u ~= partyQueue.drawWas then
                partyQueue.drawWas = u
                if context.applyRender then
                    pcall(context.applyRender)
                end
            end
            if presAt - (partyQueue.presAt or -math.huge) < 3 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.presAt = presAt
            presAt = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            u = presAt and (presAt:FindFirstChild("Level"))
            local h = u and tonumber(u.Value) or 0
            if
                (partyQueue.mySlot == nil or os.clock() - (partyQueue.slotAskedAt or 0) > 60)
                and not partyQueue.slotAsk
            then
                partyQueue.slotAsk = true
                partyQueue.slotAskedAt = os.clock()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local u = partyQueue.slotInfo()
                    if u and tonumber(u.selectedSlot) then
                        partyQueue.mySlot = tonumber(u.selectedSlot)
                    end
                    partyQueue.slotAsk = false
                end)
            end
            presAt = partyQueue.presence(localPlayer.Name, 600)
            if
                presAt
                and tonumber(presAt.level)
                and tonumber(presAt.level) > h
                and (presAt.slot == nil or partyQueue.mySlot == nil or tonumber(presAt.slot) == partyQueue.mySlot)
            then
                h = tonumber(presAt.level)
            else
            end
            if lB.place == "Level" or lB.place == "100+" then
                partyQueue.lastRunJob = game.JobId
            end
            local over
            pcall(function()
                local j = (lB.place == "Level" or lB.place == "100+")
                    and (lB.runOverAt ~= nil or context.runFailed ~= nil and context.runFailed() == true)
                if j then
                    over = true
                end
            end)
            presAt = h > 0 or lB.place == "Lobby"
            if presAt then
                local xpBoost = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("xpBoost")
                pcall(function()
                    writefile(
                        "HarvardLabs/data/af_" .. q(localPlayer.Name) .. ".json",
                        httpService:JSONEncode({
                            name = localPlayer.Name,
                            level = h > 0 and h or nil,
                            place = lB.place or "?",
                            job = game.JobId,
                            at = os.time(),
                            slot = partyQueue.mySlot,
                            xpBoost = xpBoost and tonumber(xpBoost.Value) or nil,
                            noFreeSlot = partyQueue.noFreeSlot
                                or partyQueue.newSaveGaveUp
                                or partyQueue.noFreeSlotSeen
                                or nil,
                            owner = partyQueue.ownRun and partyQueue.ownRun() or nil,
                            lastRun = partyQueue.lastRunJob,
                            over = over,
                            hop = partyQueue.hopJob,
                            loading = lB.place == "Lobby" and h <= 0 or nil,
                            stuck = partyQueue.stuckAt
                                    and os.time() - partyQueue.stuckAt <= 60
                                    and partyQueue.stuckAt
                                or nil,
                            setup = runtimeState.configAsk == true or nil,
                            resting = context.MD and context.MD.restingUntil and context.MD.restingUntil() or nil,
                            restBreak = context.MD and context.MD.breakAt and context.MD.breakAt() or nil,
                            dropPending = context.MD
                                    and (context.MD.pendingDrop ~= nil or context.MD.pendingBreak ~= nil)
                                or nil,
                        })
                    )
                end)
            end
        end
        partyQueue.leaderRejoinTick = function(S)
            if partyQueue.load().rejoin == false then
                return false
            end
            partyQueue.lrArrive = partyQueue.lrArrive or S
            if
                S - partyQueue.lrArrive < (config.afLeaderRejoinAfter or 20)
                or S - (partyQueue.lastStart or -math.huge) < 60
            then
                return false
            end
            local u, h = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(partyQueue.others()) do
                index = partyQueue.presence(entry.name, 20)
                if
                    index
                    and (index.place == "Level" or index.place == "100+")
                    and type(index.job) == "string"
                    and index.job ~= ""
                    and index.job ~= game.JobId
                    and index.over ~= true
                then
                    u[index.job] = u[index.job] or {}
                    table.insert(u[index.job], {
                        name = entry.name,
                        p = index,
                    })
                    h = if index.owner == true
                        then {
                            name = entry.name,
                            p = index,
                        }
                        else h
                else
                end
            end
            local j
            if not h then
                local U
                for key, entry2 in pairs(u) do
                    U = if not U or #entry2 > #U then entry2 else U
                end
                if not U then
                    return false
                end
                j = U[(partyQueue.rejoinJob == U[1].p.job and (partyQueue.rejoinTries or 0) or 0) % #U + 1]
            else
                j = h
            end
            if partyQueue.rejoinJob == j.p.job and (partyQueue.rejoinTries or 0) >= (config.afRejoinMax or 8) then
                return false
            end
            if partyQueue.lrSaid ~= j.p.job then
                partyQueue.lrSaid = j.p.job
                if context.log then
                    context.log(
                        "AltFarm",
                        ("the party is in a run without this account - asking %s to let it back in"):format(
                            j.name
                        )
                    )
                end
            end
            return partyQueue.requestRejoin(j.name, j.p, S) == true
        end
        partyQueue.restartWait = function()
            partyQueue.startClockJob = nil
            partyQueue.hereSince = nil
            partyQueue.lobbySince = nil
        end
        partyQueue.carryTick = function(S)
            local hunt = context.LEG
            if hunt and hunt.state.on and (not hunt.invLoaded or not hunt.target) then
                p("waiting for the legendary hunt to select a dungeon")
                return
            end
            local u = partyQueue.load()
            if partyQueue.allAtNewSave() then
                partyQueue.newSaveWaitSince = partyQueue.newSaveWaitSince or S
                if S - partyQueue.newSaveWaitSince < 120 then
                    p("the leechers are starting their new saves - holding the party")
                    partyQueue.restartWait()
                    return
                end
            else
                partyQueue.newSaveWaitSince = nil
            end
            if partyQueue.leaderRejoinTick and partyQueue.leaderRejoinTick(S) then
                return
            end
            local h, j = {}, {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(partyQueue.others()) do
                index = partyQueue.presence(entry.name, 86400)
                local w = index and tonumber(index.resting)
                if w and w > os.time() then
                    j[#j + 1] = entry.name
                else
                    h[#h + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            if config.afRestHoldsParty == true then
                local U, J = {}, 0
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(partyQueue.others()) do
                    index2 = partyQueue.presence(entry2.name, 86400)
                    local v = index2 and tonumber(index2.resting)
                    if v and v > os.time() then
                        U[#U + 1] = entry2.name
                        J = math.max(J, v - os.time())
                    else
                        if index2 and index2.dropPending and os.time() - (tonumber(index2.at) or 0) <= 60 then
                            U[#U + 1] = entry2.name
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #U > 0 then
                    p(
                        ("holding the party - %s resting after a big drop%s"):format(
                            table.concat(U, ", "),
                            J > 0 and (" (%dm %02ds left)"):format(math.floor(J / 60), math.floor(J % 60)) or ""
                        )
                    )
                    partyQueue.restartWait()
                    return
                end
            end
            local U, J, w, Y, v = {}, {}, {}, {}
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(h) do
                local n, f = d(entry3.name), partyQueue.presence(entry3.name)
                index3 = n and (n:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"))
                local r = index3 and (index3:FindFirstChild("Level"))
                index3 = r and tonumber(r.Value) or f and tonumber(f.level) or nil
                v = if index3 then math.min(v or math.huge, index3) else v
                index3 = f and tonumber(f.stuck) and os.time() - tonumber(f.stuck) <= (config.afStuckFresh or 120)
                if f and not index3 and partyQueue.stuckMates then
                    partyQueue.stuckMates[q(entry3.name)] = nil
                end
                if index3 then
                    w[#w + 1] = entry3.name .. " (stuck in a teleport - restart its Roblox)"
                    partyQueue.stuckMates = partyQueue.stuckMates or {}
                    partyQueue.stuckMates[q(entry3.name)] = os.time()
                elseif n then
                    U[#U + 1] = n
                    Y[q(entry3.name)] = true
                elseif
                    partyQueue.presence(entry3.name, config.afOnlineAge or 60)
                    or partyQueue.onItsWay(entry3.name)
                then
                    J[#J + 1] = entry3.name
                    Y[q(entry3.name)] = true
                else
                    w[#w + 1] = entry3.name
                end
            end
            local M = #w > 0 and (" - not waiting for %s (not running)"):format(table.concat(w, ", ")) or ""
            M = if #j > 0 then M .. (" - %s resting after a big drop"):format(table.concat(j, ", ")) else M
            local Z =
                math.min(math.max(tonumber(u.waitMax) or 120, 15), tonumber(config.afStartWaitCap) or math.huge)
            if partyQueue.startClockJob ~= game.JobId then
                partyQueue.startClockJob = game.JobId
                partyQueue.startClock = S
            end
            local function n(f)
                local r = {}
                for index4, entry4 in ipairs(f) do
                    index4 = partyQueue.presence(entry4, config.afOnlineAge or 60)
                    if index4 and index4.setup then
                        r[#r + 1] = entry4 .. " (setting up a new account)"
                    end
                end
                return r
            end
            local f, r = math.max(tonumber(config.afSetupWaitMax) or 600, Z), V(localPlayer.Name)
            u = not r
            if u then
                partyQueue.lobbySince = nil
                if
                    partyQueue.lastStart > (partyQueue.startClock or math.huge)
                    and S - partyQueue.lastStart > 15
                then
                    partyQueue.startClock = S
                    partyQueue.hereSince = nil
                end
                partyQueue.hereSince = partyQueue.hereSince or S
                if #J > 0 and S - partyQueue.hereSince < Z and S - (partyQueue.startClock or S) < Z then
                    p(
                        ("waiting for %s to reach this server (%.0fs)%s"):format(
                            table.concat(J, ", "),
                            Z - (S - partyQueue.hereSince),
                            M
                        )
                    )
                    return
                end
                local o = #J > 0 and n(J) or {}
                if #o > 0 and S - (partyQueue.startClock or S) < f then
                    p(
                        ("waiting for %s (%.0fs)%s"):format(
                            table.concat(o, ", "),
                            f - (S - (partyQueue.startClock or S)),
                            M
                        )
                    )
                    return
                end
                if S - partyQueue.lastCreate < 12 then
                    return
                end
                o = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
                local A = o and (o:FindFirstChild("Level"))
                o = not (A ~= nil and (tonumber(A.Value) or 0) > 0)
                if o and S - (partyQueue.hereSince or S) < 20 then
                    p("waiting for this account's data to load")
                    return
                end
                if
                    o
                    and not localPlayer.Character
                    and S - (partyQueue.hereSince or S) > (config.afUnloadedHop or 45)
                    and S - (partyQueue.unloadedHopAt or -math.huge) > 60
                then
                    partyQueue.unloadedHopAt = S
                    p("this account never loaded into the lobby - moving to a fresh lobby server")
                    if context.queueLog then
                        local queueLog, k =
                            context.queueLog, {
                                reason = "never loaded",
                            }
                        k.waited = math.floor(S - (partyQueue.hereSince or S))
                        queueLog("lobby_hop", k)
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(77649408247578, localPlayer)
                    end)
                    return
                end
                partyQueue.lastCreate = S
                local A = m("createLobby")
                if not A then
                    p("the game's createLobby remote is missing")
                    return
                end
                local map, diff, a, e = partyQueue.plan()
                local req = math.max(0, math.floor(math.min(a or 0, v or a or 0)))
                p(
                    ("creating a private %s (%s) party, level %d+%s"):format(
                        tostring(map),
                        tostring(diff),
                        req,
                        e and (" - best for level %d"):format(e) or ""
                    )
                )
                local hardcore = false
                pcall(function()
                    hardcore = partyQueue.load().hardcore == true
                end)
                o = context.queueLog
                if o then
                    context.queueLog("create", {
                        map = map,
                        diff = diff,
                        req = req,
                        lo = e,
                        hardcore = hardcore,
                    })
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local o, a, e =
                        writefile, partyQueue.partyFile("af_party"), {
                            map = map,
                            diff = diff,
                        }
                    e.at = os.time()
                    o(a, httpService:JSONEncode(e))
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local success, res = pcall(A.InvokeServer, A, map, diff, req, hardcore, true, false)
                    if context.queueLog then
                        context.queueLog("create_result", {
                            ok = success,
                            res = res,
                        })
                    end
                    if not success or res ~= true then
                        p("the game declined the party: " .. tostring(res))
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            if hunt and hunt.state.on then
                local desired = partyQueue.plan()
                local current = r:FindFirstChild("mapName")
                if not current or tostring(current.Value) ~= tostring(desired) then
                    p("replacing the old lobby with " .. tostring(desired))
                    if S - (partyQueue.wrongMapAt or -math.huge) >= 5 then
                        partyQueue.wrongMapAt = S
                        local remove = m("removeLobby")
                        if remove then pcall(remove.FireServer, remove) end
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
            partyQueue.hereSince = nil
            partyQueue.lobbySince = partyQueue.lobbySince or S
            u = r:FindFirstChild("mapName")
            J = u and (u:FindFirstChild("private"))
            for index5, entry5 in ipairs(U) do
                if
                    J
                    and not J:FindFirstChild(entry5.Name)
                    and S - (partyQueue.lastWhite[entry5.Name] or -math.huge) > 4
                then
                    partyQueue.lastWhite[entry5.Name] = S
                    u = m("addPlayerToWhitelist")
                    if u then
                        pcall(u.FireServer, u, entry5.Name)
                    end
                end
            end
            U = E(r)
            for key, entry6 in pairs(U) do
                if
                    key ~= q(localPlayer.Name)
                    and not partyQueue.entry(entry6)
                    and S - (partyQueue.lastKick[entry6] or -math.huge) > 4
                then
                    partyQueue.lastKick[entry6] = S
                    J = m("kickPlayer")
                    if J then
                        pcall(J.FireServer, J, entry6)
                    end
                end
            end
            u = {}
            for index6, entry7 in ipairs(h) do
                if
                    not (
                        partyQueue.stuckMates
                        and partyQueue.stuckMates[q(entry7.name)]
                        and os.time() - partyQueue.stuckMates[q(entry7.name)]
                            <= (config.afStuckFresh or 120)
                    )
                    and not U[q(entry7.name)]
                    and (Y[q(entry7.name)] or partyQueue.presence(entry7.name, config.afOnlineAge or 60))
                then
                    u[#u + 1] = entry7.name
                end
            end
            h = S - partyQueue.lobbySince
            if #u > 0 and h < Z and (S - (partyQueue.startClock or S) < Z or h < 15) then
                p(("party open - waiting for %s (%.0fs)%s"):format(table.concat(u, ", "), Z - h, M))
                return
            end
            Y = #u > 0 and n(u) or {}
            if #Y > 0 and S - (partyQueue.startClock or S) < f then
                p(
                    ("party open - waiting for %s (%.0fs)%s"):format(
                        table.concat(Y, ", "),
                        f - (S - (partyQueue.startClock or S)),
                        M
                    )
                )
                return
            end
            if context.AS and context.AS.holdStart and context.AS.holdStart() then
                p("selling in the lobby before the run starts")
                return
            end
            if S - partyQueue.lastStart < 10 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.lastStart = S
            n = m("startDungeon")
            if context.queueLog then
                U = r:FindFirstChild("mapName")
                context.queueLog("start", {
                    lobbyMap = U and U.Value,
                    missing = #u,
                })
            end
            if n then
                pcall(n.FireServer, n)
            end
            p(#u == 0 and "everyone is in - starting" or ("starting without %s"):format(table.concat(u, ", ")))
            if
                (#u > 0 or #w > 0 or #j > 0)
                and partyQueue.saidWithout ~= partyQueue.lobbySince
                and context.log
            then
                partyQueue.saidWithout = partyQueue.lobbySince
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    ("starting after %.0fs%s%s"):format(
                        S - (partyQueue.startClock or S),
                        #u > 0 and " without " .. table.concat(u, ", ") or "",
                        M
                    )
                )
            end
        end
        partyQueue.leechTick = function(S)
            if partyQueue.stuckAt then
                p("stuck in a teleport that never finished - restart this Roblox (the party goes on without it)")
                return
            end
            local u = partyQueue.carry()
            if not u then
                p("no leader - press a crown in Parties & Runs")
                return
            end
            local h = d(u.name)
            if not h then
                local d = partyQueue.presence(u.name)
                if not d then
                    p(("waiting for %s to come online"):format(u.name))
                    return
                end
                if d.place ~= "Lobby" then
                    if
                        (d.place == "Level" or d.place == "100+")
                        and partyQueue.requestRejoin
                        and partyQueue.requestRejoin(u.name, d, S)
                    then
                        return
                    end
                    p(("%s is in a run - waiting for it to come back"):format(u.name))
                    return
                end
                if d.job and d.job ~= "" and d.job ~= game.JobId and S - partyQueue.lastHop > 25 then
                    partyQueue.lastHop = S
                    partyQueue.hopJob = d.job
                    p(("moving to %s's lobby server"):format(u.name))
                    pcall(function()
                        game:GetService("TeleportService")
                            :TeleportToPlaceInstance(77649408247578, d.job, localPlayer)
                    end)
                end
                return
            end
            local d = V(h.Name)
            if not d then
                p(("with %s - waiting for its party"):format(u.name))
                return
            end
            if E(d)[q(localPlayer.Name)] then
                p(("in %s's party - waiting for the start"):format(u.name))
                return
            end
            local mapName = d:FindFirstChild("mapName")
            local E, j =
                mapName and (mapName:FindFirstChild("minLevelReq")), localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            d = j and (j:FindFirstChild("Level"))
            j = d and tonumber(d.Value) or 0
            if E and tonumber(E.Value) and j < tonumber(E.Value) then
                p(("the party needs level %d, this account is %d"):format(tonumber(E.Value), j))
                return
            end
            E = mapName and (mapName:FindFirstChild("private"))
            if E and E.Value == true and not E:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) then
                p("waiting for the carry to whitelist this account")
                return
            end
            if S - partyQueue.lastJoin < 5 then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.lastJoin = S
            p(("joining %s's party"):format(u.name))
            local d = m("joinDungeon")
            if d then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(d.InvokeServer, d, h.Name)
                end)
            end
        end
        partyQueue.slotInfo = function()
            local d = m("getCharacterSlots")
            if not d then
                return nil
            end
            local success, u = pcall(d.InvokeServer, d)
            if success and type(u) == "table" then
                return u
            end
            return nil
        end
        partyQueue.newSaveAt = function()
            local d = partyQueue.load()
            if d.newSave ~= true then
                return nil
            end
            return tonumber(d.newSaveLevel) or 100
        end
        partyQueue.pendingNewSave = function()
            local d = partyQueue.newSaveAt()
            if not d then
                return false
            end
            for index, account in ipairs(partyQueue.load().accounts) do
                if account.enabled ~= false and account.role == "leech" then
                    index = partyQueue.presence(account.name, 120)
                    if
                        index
                        and tonumber(index.level)
                        and tonumber(index.level) >= d
                        and index.noFreeSlot ~= true
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        partyQueue.allAtNewSave = partyQueue.pendingNewSave
        partyQueue.newSaveTick = function(newSaveTryAt)
            local S = partyQueue.newSaveAt()
            if partyQueue.role() ~= "leech" or not S or partyQueue.noFreeSlot or partyQueue.newSaveGaveUp then
                return false
            end
            local u = 0
            pcall(function()
                u = tonumber(localPlayer.leaderstats.Level.Value) or 0
            end)
            local h = u < S
            if h then
                return false
            end
            if newSaveTryAt - (partyQueue.newSaveTryAt or -math.huge) < 30 then
                p("starting a new save...")
                return true
            end
            partyQueue.newSaveTries = (partyQueue.newSaveTries or 0) + 1
            if partyQueue.newSaveTries > (tonumber(config.afNewSaveTries) or 4) then
                partyQueue.newSaveGaveUp = true
                p("new save: the switch did not go through - staying on this save for now")
                if context.log then
                    context.log(
                        "AltFarm",
                        "new save: the slot switch did not go through after 4 tries - staying on this save for now"
                    )
                end
                return false
            end
            partyQueue.newSaveTryAt = newSaveTryAt
            h = partyQueue.slotInfo()
            if not h then
                p("new save: could not read the character slots")
                return true
            end
            local from = tonumber(h.selectedSlot)
            local V
            newSaveTryAt = tonumber(h.maxSlots) or 5
            for index = 1, newSaveTryAt, 1 do
                S = h.slots and (h.slots[index] or h.slots[tostring(index)])
                if S and S.unlocked == true and S.created ~= true then
                    V = index
                    break
                end
            end
            if not V then
                partyQueue.noFreeSlot = true
                p("new save: no free unlocked slot left - staying on this one")
                return false
            end
            partyQueue.noFreeSlotSeen = nil
            local fromLevel = 0
            pcall(function()
                fromLevel = tonumber(localPlayer.leaderstats.Level.Value) or 0
            end)
            p(
                ("new save: switching from save %s (Lv %d) to a fresh one in slot %d"):format(
                    tostring(from),
                    fromLevel,
                    V
                )
            )
            local S = m("selectCharacterSlot")
            if not S then
                return true
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local success, E = pcall(S.InvokeServer, S, V)
                local S = success and E
                if S then
                    task.wait(3)
                    success = m("characterSwapClosed")
                    if success then
                        pcall(success.FireServer, success)
                    end
                    partyQueue.mySlot = V
                    pcall(function()
                        writefile(
                            "HarvardLabs/data/af_" .. q(localPlayer.Name) .. ".json",
                            httpService:JSONEncode({
                                name = localPlayer.Name,
                                level = 1,
                                place = lB.place or "?",
                                job = game.JobId,
                                at = os.time(),
                                slot = V,
                            })
                        )
                    end)
                    local S = context.queueLog
                    if S then
                        context.queueLog("new_save", {
                            from = from,
                            to = V,
                            fromLevel = fromLevel,
                        })
                    end
                    S = context.WH and context.WH.newSave
                    if S then
                        pcall(context.WH.newSave, localPlayer.Name, fromLevel, from, V)
                    end
                else
                    p("new save: the game declined the slot switch (" .. tostring(E) .. ")")
                end
            end)
            return true
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(10 + math.random() * 5)
            for index = 1, 60, 1 do
                if not runtimeState.configAsk then
                    break
                end
                task.wait(5)
            end
            if runtimeState.destroyed or config.autoQueue ~= true then
                return
            end
            for index2 = 1, 3, 1 do
                partyQueue.loadReal(true)
                if partyQueue.doc and partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc) then
                    break
                end
                pcall(partyQueue.soloParty, {
                    auto = false,
                    map = config.autoQueueMap or "Desert Temple",
                    difficulty = config.autoQueueDifficulty or "Nightmare",
                    replay = config.autoQueueReplay ~= false,
                })
                task.wait(2 + math.random() * 3)
            end
            partyQueue.loadReal(true)
