            if partyQueue.doc and partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, partyQueue.doc) then
                config.autoQueue = false
                if context.saveConfig then
                    pcall(context.saveConfig)
                end
                if context.log then
                    context.log(
                        "Party",
                        "runs only start from a party now - this account has a party of its own (see Parties & Runs)"
                    )
                end
                if context.refreshQueueMode then
                    pcall(context.refreshQueueMode)
                end
            end
        end)
        partyQueue.lobbyTick = function(d)
            local L = partyQueue.role()
            if not L then
                return
            end
            partyQueue.refreshLevels()
            if L == "leech" and partyQueue.newSaveTick(d) then
                return
            end
            pcall(partyQueue.noteStandIn)
            if partyQueue.isHost() then
                partyQueue.carryTick(d)
            else
                partyQueue.leechTick(d)
            end
        end
        partyQueue.noteStandIn = function()
            local standInFor = partyQueue.load()
            local L, O, S = partyQueue.crowned(standInFor), partyQueue.carry(standInFor), q(localPlayer.Name)
            standInFor = L and O and q(O.name) == S and q(L.name) ~= S and L.name or nil
            if standInFor == partyQueue.standInFor then
                return
            end
            if standInFor then
                if context.log then
                    context.log(
                        "AltFarm",
                        ("%s is resting after a big drop - this account hosts the party until it is back"):format(
                            standInFor
                        )
                    )
                end
                if context.notify then
                    context.notify(
                        "party",
                        "Hosting the party",
                        ("%s is resting after a big drop - this account hosts until it is back."):format(
                            standInFor
                        ),
                        8
                    )
                end
            elseif partyQueue.standInFor and context.log then
                context.log(
                    "AltFarm",
                    ("%s's rest is over - it hosts the party again"):format(partyQueue.standInFor)
                )
            end
            partyQueue.standInFor = standInFor
        end
        context.runComplete = function()
            if context.rodinAlive ~= nil and context.rodinAlive() then
                return false
            end
            local d, L = R(), D("bonusBossVotingActive")
            return d ~= nil and d.Value == true or L ~= nil and L.Value == true or (y())
        end
        context.QUEUE_MAPS = {
            "Desert Temple",
            "Winter Outpost",
            "Pirate Island",
            "King's Castle",
            "The Underworld",
            "Samurai Palace",
            "The Canals",
            "Steampunk Sewers",
            "Ghastly Harbor",
            "Orbital Outpost",
            "Volcanic Chambers",
            "Enchanted Forest",
            "Aquatic Temple",
            "Northern Lands",
            "Pumpkin King",
        }
        context.EVENT_DIFF = {
            ["Pumpkin King"] = "Nightmare",
        }
        context.isEvent = function()
            local dungeonName = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            return dungeonName ~= nil and context.EVENT_DIFF[tostring(dungeonName.Value)] ~= nil
        end
        context.QUEUE_DIFFICULTIES = { "Easy", "Medium", "Hard", "Insane", "Nightmare" }
    end

    components.raidAutomation = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local teleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
        local localPlayer, rAID =
            context.LocalPlayer, {
                Version = "1.1.1",
                Status = "Off",
                Alive = true,
                builtIn = true,
            }
        context.RAID = rAID
        local defaults, cfg =
            {
                enabled = false,
                firstLevel = 130,
                lastLevel = 140,
                fixedTier = 0,
                maxTier = 30,
                advance = true,
                resumeOrbital = true,
                finishDelay = 8,
            }, {}
        for key, default in pairs(defaults) do
            cfg[key] = default
        end
        rAID.cfg = cfg
        rAID.DEFAULTS = defaults
        local state = {
            party = {},
            records = {},
            keys = {},
            keysKnown = false,
            keysAt = -math.huge,
            actions = {},
            busy = {},
            lowest = nil,
            complete = false,
            participant = false,
            host = false,
            rosterKey = "",
            route = "waiting",
            desired = nil,
            owned = false,
            failures = 0,
            cooldownUntil = 0,
            finishedAt = nil,
            nextEligible = false,
            actual = {
                accounts = {},
            },
        }
        rAID.state = state
        local policy = {
            route = function(y, q, V, E)
                if not q or not y then
                    return "waiting"
                end
                if y >= V and y < E then
                    return "raid"
                end
                return "dungeon"
            end,
            commonTier = function(y, q, V, E)
                local p
                for index = 1, V, 1 do
                    if E == 0 or E == index then
                        local V = #y > 0
                        for index2, entry in ipairs(y) do
                            index2 = q[string.lower(entry.name)]
                            if not index2 or not index2.keys or index2.keys[tostring(index)] ~= true then
                                V = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        p = if V then index else p
                    else
                    end
                end
                return p
            end,
            canAdvance = function(y, q, V, E, p)
                if #y == 0 or E >= p then
                    return false
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(y) do
                    index = q[string.lower(entry.name)]
                    if not index or index.job ~= V or index.tier ~= E or index.nextEligible ~= true then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                return true
            end,
        }
        rAID.Policy = policy
        local function y(q)
            return string.lower(tostring(q or ""))
        end
        local function q()
            return os.clock()
        end
        local function V(E)
            if not readfile then
                return nil
            end
            local success, j = pcall(function()
                local U = vmHelpers[127](readfile(E))
                return httpService:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(U))
            end)
            return success and type(j) == "table" and j or nil
        end
        local function d(E, p)
            if not writefile then
                return false
            end
            return (pcall(function()
                writefile(E, httpService:JSONEncode(p))
            end))
        end
        local function P()
            cfg.enabled = cfg.enabled == true
            cfg.firstLevel = math.max(130, math.floor(tonumber(cfg.firstLevel) or 130))
            cfg.lastLevel = math.max(cfg.firstLevel + 1, math.floor(tonumber(cfg.lastLevel) or 140))
            cfg.maxTier = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.maxTier) or 30), 1, 30)
            cfg.fixedTier = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.fixedTier) or 0), 0, cfg.maxTier)
            cfg.finishDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.finishDelay) or 8, 5, 60)
        end
        local E = false
        local function p()
            local j = E
            if j then
                return
            end
            j = V("HarvardLabs/data/bossraid_extension.json")
            if j then
                for default2 in pairs(defaults) do
                    if j[default2] ~= nil then
                        cfg[default2] = j[default2]
                    end
                end
            end
            P()
        end
        rAID.save = function()
            P()
            d("HarvardLabs/data/bossraid_extension.json", cfg)
        end
        rAID.saveSoon = function()
            P()
            local P = E
            if P then
                return
            end
            E = true
            task.delay(0.5, function()
                E = false
                rAID.save()
            end)
        end
        local function P(status)
            rAID.Status = status
            if state.owned and context.AF then
                context.AF.status = "boss raids: " .. status
                if context.LB then
                    context.LB.status = "boss raids: " .. status
                end
            end
        end
        local function u(E)
            local remotes = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            return remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild(E))
        end
        local function D(E, j, U)
            if state.busy[E] or q() - (state.actions[E] or -math.huge) < j then
                return false
            end
            state.actions[E], state.busy[E] = q(), true
            task.spawn(function()
                local success, J = pcall(U)
                state.busy[E] = nil
                if not success and rAID.Alive then
                    P(E .. ": " .. tostring(J):sub(1, 180))
                end
            end)
            return true
        end
        local function E(j, U)
            local J = j and (j:FindFirstChild(U))
            return J and J:IsA("ValueBase") and J.Value or nil
        end
        local function j(U)
            for index, entry in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                if y(entry.Name) == y(U) then
                    return entry
                end
            end
        end
        local function U(J)
            return tonumber(E(J and (J:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")), "Level"))
        end
        local J = {
            Steampunk = true,
            Steampunk2 = true,
            ["Realm Of The Gods"] = true,
            ["Realm Of The Gods2"] = true,
            ["Mystical Garden"] = true,
            MysticalGarden = true,
            ["Mystical Garden2"] = true,
        }
        local function isRaid()
            return J[tostring(E(workspace, "dungeonName") or "")] == true
        end
        rAID.isRaid = isRaid
        local function J()
            local Y = context.LB and context.LB.pm
            if Y and type(Y.GetPlaceName) == "function" then
                local success, M = pcall(Y.GetPlaceName)
                if success and M == "Lobby" then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return game.PlaceId == 77649408247578
        end
        local function Y()
            if tostring(E(workspace, "dungeonProgress")) == "bossKilled" then
                return true
            end
            local dungeon = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
            return E(dungeon, "dungeonFinished") == true
                or E(dungeon and dungeon:FindFirstChild("bossRoom"), "dungeonFinished") == true
        end
        local function v(M)
            return "HarvardLabs/data/" .. "bossraid_presence_" .. y(M):gsub("[^%w_]", "") .. ".json"
        end
        local function M(Z, n)
            local f = Z and os.time() - (tonumber(Z.at) or 0)
            return f and f >= -5 and f <= n
        end
        rAID.absent = function(Z)
            if j(Z) then
                return false
            end
            local partyQueue = context.AF
            if not (partyQueue and partyQueue.presence) then
                return false
            end
            local f = partyQueue.presence(Z, 86400)
            if f and tonumber(f.resting) and tonumber(f.resting) > os.time() then
                return true
            end
            if f and tonumber(f.stuck) and os.time() - tonumber(f.stuck) <= (config.afStuckFresh or 120) then
                return true
            end
            if partyQueue.presence(Z, config.afOnlineAge or 60) then
                return false
            end
            return not (partyQueue.onItsWay and partyQueue.onItsWay(Z))
        end
        rAID.waitedOut = function(Z)
            local n = q()
            if not state.rosterWaitSince or n - (state.rosterWaitLast or -math.huge) > 10 then
                state.rosterWaitSince = n
            end
            state.rosterWaitLast = n
            local f = math.max(tonumber(state.actual and state.actual.waitMax) or 120, 30)
            if n - state.rosterWaitSince < f then
                return false
            end
            state.rosterWaitSince, state.cooldownUntil = nil, os.time() + 300
            P(("Waited %ds for %s - ordinary dungeons for 5 minutes"):format(math.floor(f), tostring(Z)))
            if context.log then
                context.log(
                    "Boss raids",
                    ("waited %ds for %s - ordinary dungeons for 5 minutes"):format(math.floor(f), tostring(Z))
                )
            end
            return true
        end
        local function Z()
            local partyQueue = context.AF
            local actual = partyQueue.loadReal and partyQueue.loadReal() or partyQueue.load()
            state.party = {}
            state.records = {}
            state.lowest = nil
            state.participant = false
            state.host = false
            state.complete = true
            state.leader = nil
            state.actual = actual
            local r = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(actual.accounts or {}) do
                if entry.enabled ~= false and type(entry.name) == "string" and entry.name ~= "" then
                    index = y(entry.name) == y(localPlayer.Name)
                    if index or not rAID.absent(entry.name) then
                        state.party[#state.party + 1] = entry
                    end
                    r[#r + 1] = y(entry.name) .. ":" .. tostring(entry.role)
                    if index then
                        state.participant = true
                        state.myRole = entry.role
                    end
                end
            end
            local o = partyQueue.carry and partyQueue.carry(actual) or nil
            state.leader = o and o.name or nil
            table.sort(r)
            state.rosterKey = table.concat(r, "|")
            state.host = state.leader ~= nil and y(state.leader) == y(localPlayer.Name)
            state.participant = state.participant and actual.on == true and state.leader ~= nil
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(state.party) do
                o, actual = j(entry2.name), V(v(entry2.name))
                if M(actual, 30) and actual.roster == state.rosterKey then
                    state.records[y(entry2.name)] = actual
                else
                    actual = nil
                end
                r = U(o) or actual and tonumber(actual.level)
                if not r and partyQueue and partyQueue.presence then
                    index2 = partyQueue.presence(entry2.name, 86400)
                    r = index2 and tonumber(index2.level) or nil
                else
                end
                if not r or r < 1 then
                    state.complete = false
                else
                    state.lowest = math.min(state.lowest or math.huge, r)
                end
            end
            if #state.party == 0 then
                state.complete = false
            end
            state.route = policy.route(state.lowest, state.complete, cfg.firstLevel, cfg.lastLevel)
        end
        local function n()
            if not state.participant then
                return
            end
            local f = {
                at = os.time(),
                name = localPlayer.Name,
                level = U(localPlayer),
                job = game.JobId,
                place = J() and "Lobby" or "Run",
                roster = state.rosterKey,
                tier = tonumber(E(workspace, "tier")) or 0,
                keys = state.keysKnown and state.keys or nil,
                ready = E(localPlayer, "ready") == true,
                nextEligible = state.nextEligible == true,
            }
            state.records[y(localPlayer.Name)] = f
            d(v(localPlayer.Name), f)
        end
        local function U()
            if not state.leader then
                return "HarvardLabs/data/bossraid_plan.json"
            end
            return "HarvardLabs/data/" .. "bossraid_plan_" .. y(state.leader):gsub("[^%w_]", "") .. ".json"
        end
        local function v(f)
            return M(f, 30) and f.roster == state.rosterKey and y(f.leader) == y(state.leader)
        end
        local function M()
            local plan = V(U())
            if not state.host then
                state.plan = v(plan) and plan or nil
                return
            end
            if v(plan) then
                state.cooldownUntil = math.max(state.cooldownUntil, tonumber(plan.cooldownUntil) or 0)
            end
            plan = {
                at = os.time(),
                leader = localPlayer.Name,
                roster = state.rosterKey,
                job = game.JobId,
                place = J() and "Lobby" or "Run",
                lowest = state.lowest,
                mode = state.route,
                cooldownUntil = state.cooldownUntil,
            }
            if state.route == "raid" then
                local v = true
                for index, entry in ipairs(state.party) do
                    index = state.records[y(entry.name)]
                    v = if not index or type(index.keys) ~= "table" then false else v
                end
                if state.cooldownUntil > os.time() then
                    plan.mode = "fallback"
                    plan.reason = "Raid retry cooldown; ordinary dungeons"
                elseif not v then
                    plan.mode = "waiting"
                    plan.reason = "Waiting for every account's raid key data"
                else
                    plan.tier = policy.commonTier(state.party, state.records, cfg.maxTier, cfg.fixedTier)
                    if not plan.tier then
                        plan.mode = "fallback"
                        plan.reason = "No shared unlocked tier; ordinary dungeons"
                    end
                end
            end
            state.plan = plan
            d(U(), plan)
        end
        local function wantsControl()
            if not state.participant then
                return false
            end
            if isRaid() then
                return cfg.enabled or state.managedRaid == true
            end
            if not cfg.enabled then
                return false
            end
            local plan = state.plan
            if plan and (plan.mode == "fallback" or plan.mode == "dungeon") then
                return false
            end
            if J() then
                return state.route == "raid" or state.route == "waiting"
            end
            return Y() and state.route == "raid" and (not plan or plan.mode ~= "fallback")
        end
        rAID.wantsControl = wantsControl
        local function U(v)
            D("return to lobby", 25, function()
                if not rAID.Alive then
                    return
                end
                local f = u("ReturnToLobbyEvent")
                if not f then
                    error("ReturnToLobbyEvent is unavailable")
                end
                P(v)
                f:FireServer()
            end)
        end
        local function v(f)
            local bossLobbies = workspace:FindFirstChild("bossLobbies")
            if not bossLobbies then
                return nil
            end
            for index, child in ipairs(bossLobbies:GetChildren()) do
                if y(child.Name) == y(f) then
                    return child
                end
            end
        end
        local function f(r, o)
            if not r then
                return false
            end
            for index, child in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
                if y(child.Name) == y(o) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function r(o)
            local A = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(state.party) do
                if not f(o, entry.name) then
                    A[#A + 1] = entry.name
                end
            end
            return #A == 0, table.concat(A, ", ")
        end
        local function o()
            state.finishedAt = nil
            state.nextEligible = false
            state.replaySentAt = nil
            local plan = state.plan
            if not plan or plan.mode == "waiting" then
                P(plan and plan.reason or "Waiting for leader's raid plan")
                return
            end
            if plan.mode ~= "raid" then
                return
            end
            if not state.host then
                if not j(state.leader) then
                    if plan.place == "Lobby" and plan.job and plan.job ~= game.JobId then
                        D("follow leader", 30, function()
                            if rAID.Alive then
                                P("Following leader to the lobby")
                                teleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(77649408247578, plan.job, localPlayer)
                            end
                        end)
                    else
                        P("Waiting for leader to return to the lobby")
                    end
                    return
                end
                local _ = v(state.leader)
                if not _ then
                    P("Waiting for leader's boss raid lobby")
                    return
                end
                if f(_:FindFirstChild("players"), localPlayer.Name) then
                    P("Joined Tier " .. tostring(E(_, "tier")) .. "; waiting for party")
                    return
                end
                if
                    E(_, "private") == true
                    and not f(_:FindFirstChild("whitelist"), localPlayer.Name)
                    and not f(_:FindFirstChild("private"), localPlayer.Name)
                then
                    P("Waiting for raid whitelist")
                    return
                end
                D("join raid", 5, function()
                    local j = u("playerJoinBossLobby")
                    if j and rAID.Alive then
                        local k = j:InvokeServer(_)
                        if rAID.Alive then
                            P(k == true and "Joined boss raid party" or "Raid join declined; waiting to retry")
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            local _, j = r(players)
            if not _ then
                if not rAID.waitedOut(j) then
                    P("Waiting for accounts: " .. j)
                end
                return
            end
            local k = v(localPlayer.Name)
            if not k then
                D("create raid", 15, function()
                    local v = u("createBossLobby")
                    if not v then
                        error("createBossLobby is unavailable")
                    end
                    if not rAID.Alive then
                        return
                    end
                    P("Creating private Tier " .. tostring(plan.tier) .. " raid")
                    local success, a = pcall(v.InvokeServer, v, plan.tier, true, 0)
                    if not rAID.Alive then
                        return
                    end
                    if not success or a ~= true then
                        state.failures = state.failures + 1
                        P("Raid creation declined (" .. state.failures .. "/3)")
                        if state.failures >= 3 then
                            state.cooldownUntil = os.time() + 300
                            state.failures = 0
                        end
                    else
                        state.failures = 0
                    end
                end)
                return
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(state.party) do
                if
                    y(entry.name) ~= y(localPlayer.Name)
                    and not f(k:FindFirstChild("whitelist"), entry.name)
                    and not f(k:FindFirstChild("private"), entry.name)
                then
                    D("whitelist " .. entry.name, 5, function()
                        local y = u("addPlayerToBossWhitelist")
                        if y and rAID.Alive then
                            y:FireServer(entry.name)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            j, _ = r(k:FindFirstChild("players"))
            if not j then
                if not rAID.waitedOut(_) then
                    P("Raid party waiting for: " .. _)
                end
                return
            end
            state.rosterWaitSince = nil
            D("start raid", 20, function()
                local _ = u("startBossRaid")
                if not _ then
                    error("startBossRaid is unavailable")
                end
                if rAID.Alive then
                    _:FireServer()
                    P("Tier " .. tostring(E(k, "tier")) .. " start requested; waiting for teleport")
                end
            end)
        end
        local function _()
            local y, j = {}, { "dungeonName", "dungeonProgress", "dungeonStarted", "hardcore", "tier" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(j) do
                y[entry] = E(workspace, entry)
            end
            y.isHardcore = y.hardcore
            j = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
            if j then
                local iterateArray, f =
                    ipairs, {
                        j,
                        j:FindFirstChild("bossRoom"),
                    }
                for key2, entry2 in iterateArray(f) do
                    for index2, child in ipairs(entry2:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                            y[child.Name] = child.Value
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return y
        end
        local function y()
            local j = isRaid()
            if j then
                state.managedRaid = true
            end
            if not cfg.enabled then
                P("Paused; no raid actions will be sent")
                return
            end
            if
                j
                and tostring(E(workspace, "dungeonProgress")) == "playersNotReady"
                and E(localPlayer, "ready") ~= true
            then
                D("ready", 3, function()
                    local l = u("readyUp")
                    if l and rAID.Alive then
                        P("Readying for the boss raid")
                        l:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not Y() then
                state.finishedAt = nil
                state.nextEligible = false
                state.replaySentAt = nil
                if j then
                    P("Tier " .. tostring(E(workspace, "tier")) .. " raid in progress")
                end
                return
            end
            state.finishedAt = state.finishedAt or q()
            if q() - state.finishedAt < cfg.finishDelay then
                P("Run finished; waiting for rewards")
                return
            end
            if
                context.WH
                and tonumber(context.WH.pendingUntil)
                and q() < context.WH.pendingUntil
                and q() - state.finishedAt < 35
            then
                P("Waiting for the run report")
                return
            end
            if not j then
                if state.plan and state.plan.mode == "raid" then
                    U("Run complete; returning for boss raids")
                else
                    P("Run complete; waiting for raid plan")
                end
                return
            end
            if state.route == "dungeon" or state.plan and state.plan.mode == "dungeon" then
                U("Raid level range completed; returning to ordinary dungeons")
                return
            end
            if state.actual.replay == false then
                P("Raid finished; party replay is off")
                return
            end
            if state.replaySentAt then
                if q() - state.replaySentAt > 60 then
                    U("Replay did not restart; regrouping in the lobby")
                end
                return
            end
            if cfg.advance and cfg.fixedTier == 0 then
                D("check next tier", 8, function()
                    local l = u("checkNextTierKey")
                    if l and rAID.Alive then
                        local j = l:InvokeServer()
                        if rAID.Alive then
                            state.nextEligible = type(j) == "table" and j.eligible == true
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            if not state.host then
                P("Raid complete; waiting for leader's replay")
                return
            end
            local l, j = r(players)
            if not l then
                U("Regrouping with missing accounts: " .. j)
                return
            end
            if q() - state.finishedAt < cfg.finishDelay + 5 then
                P("Checking the party's next-tier eligibility")
                return
            end
            local S = tonumber(E(workspace, "tier")) or 0
            local l = cfg.advance
                and cfg.fixedTier == 0
                and policy.canAdvance(state.party, state.records, game.JobId, S, cfg.maxTier)
            D("replay raid", 60, function()
                local R = u("replayDungeon")
                if not R or not rAID.Alive then
                    return
                end
                local E = _()
                if not E.dungeonName then
                    error("Missing raid replay data")
                end
                if l then
                    E.advanceTier = true
                end
                state.replaySentAt = q()
                P(l and "Advancing to Tier " .. S + 1 or "Replaying Tier " .. S)
                R:FireServer(E)
            end)
        end
        local contextLobbyTick = context.lobbyTick
        context.lobbyTick = function(placeAt, ...)
            if rAID.Alive and wantsControl() then
                state.owned = true
                if context.AF and context.AF.restartWait then
                    context.AF.restartWait()
                end
                if context.AF and context.AF.tickAlways then
                    pcall(context.AF.tickAlways, placeAt)
                end
                if context.LB then
                    context.LB.place = J() and "Lobby" or "Level"
                    context.LB.placeAt = placeAt
                end
                if config.autoFarmByPlace and context.LB and context.LB.farmAppliedFor ~= context.LB.place then
                    context.LB.farmAppliedFor = context.LB.place
                    runtimeState.farmEnabled = not J()
                    if context.setLoopButtonState then
                        pcall(context.setLoopButtonState)
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            state.owned = false
            return contextLobbyTick(placeAt, ...)
        end
        local contextAfRole = context.afRole
        context.afRole = function(...)
            local S = contextAfRole(...)
            if rAID.Alive and cfg.enabled and state.participant and isRaid() and S == "carry" then
                return nil
            end
            return S
        end
        local plan2 = context.AF.plan
        context.AF.plan = function(...)
            local S, _, l, R = plan2(...)
            local L = context.AF.loadReal and context.AF.loadReal() or context.AF.load()
            local E = L.hardest or L.cap
            if
                rAID.Alive
                and cfg.enabled
                and cfg.resumeOrbital
                and L.auto ~= false
                and E == "Steampunk Sewers"
                and state.complete
                and state.lowest
                and state.lowest >= cfg.lastLevel
                and state.lowest >= 140
            then
                local E, j, U = context.AF.bestFor(state.lowest, "Orbital Outpost", L.start)
                if E then
                    return E, j, U, state.lowest
                end
            end
            return S, _, l, R
        end
        local function L()
            local S = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
            local _ = rawget(S, "HLBossRaids")
            if _ ~= nil and _ ~= rAID then
                if type(_) == "table" and _.builtIn == true then
                    _.Alive = false
                else
                    if type(_) == "table" and type(_.Destroy) == "function" then
                        pcall(_.Destroy)
                    end
                    if V("HarvardLabs/data/bossraid_extension.json") == nil then
                        cfg.enabled = true
                        rAID.save()
                    end
                    context.log(
                        "Boss raids",
                        "the separate boss raids script was switched off - they are built in now (Party > Boss raids)"
                    )
                end
            end
            S.HLBossRaids = rAID
        end
        rAID.Destroy = function() end
        rAID.Inspect = function()
            local settings = {}
            for key2, entry in pairs(cfg) do
                settings[key2] = entry
            end
            return {
                version = rAID.Version,
                status = rAID.Status,
                attached = true,
                queueOwned = state.owned,
                route = state.route,
                partyLowest = state.lowest,
                partyComplete = state.complete,
                leader = state.leader,
                host = state.host,
                plan = state.plan,
                settings = settings,
                raid = isRaid(),
                keysKnown = state.keysKnown,
            }
        end
        rAID.tickOnce = function()
            Z()
            if state.participant then
                if cfg.enabled and (state.route == "raid" or isRaid()) and q() - state.keysAt >= 30 then
                    D("read raid keys", 30, function()
                        local keys = u("reloadInvy")
                        if not keys then
                            return
                        end
                        local D = keys:InvokeServer()
                        if not rAID.Alive or type(D) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end
                        keys = {}
                        for key2, entry in pairs(D.keys or {}) do
                            if entry == true then
                                keys[tostring(key2)] = true
                            end
                        end
                        state.keys, state.keysKnown, state.keysAt = keys, true, q()
                    end)
                end
                if q() - (state.lastPublish or -math.huge) >= 2 then
                    state.lastPublish = q()
                    n()
                end
                if q() - (state.lastPlan or -math.huge) >= 2 then
                    state.lastPlan = q()
                    M()
                end
                state.owned = wantsControl()
                if state.owned then
                    if J() then
                        local d, S = false
                        if context.MD and context.MD.lobbyHold then
                            d, S = context.MD.lobbyHold()
                        else
                        end
                        if d then
                            P(S or "mod detection cooldown")
                        else
                            o()
                        end
                    else
                        y()
                    end
                elseif not cfg.enabled then
                    P("Off")
                elseif state.plan and state.plan.mode == "fallback" then
                    P(state.plan.reason)
                elseif state.route == "raid" then
                    P("Finishing the current dungeon before switching to raids")
                else
                    P("Ordinary dungeons | boss raids at " .. cfg.firstLevel .. "-" .. cfg.lastLevel - 1)
                end
            else
                state.owned = false
                P("Turn on party mode and crown a leader in Parties & Runs")
            end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local d = { "HarvardLabs", "HarvardLabs/data" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(d) do
                if makefolder then
                    pcall(makefolder, entry)
                end
            end
            p()
            pcall(L)
            task.wait()
            local d = -math.huge
            local Q = q()
            local S = q()
            while rAID.Alive and not runtimeState.destroyed do
                local O, D, _ =
                    cfg.enabled or state.managedRaid == true and isRaid(), pcall(function()
                        local l = q() - Q >= (q() - S < 120 and 2 or 15)
                        if l then
                            Q = q()
                            L()
                        end
                        l = q() - d >= 2
                        if l then
                            d = q()
                            p()
                        end
                        if cfg.enabled or state.managedRaid and isRaid() then
                            rAID.tickOnce()
                        else
                            state.owned = false
                            state.participant = false
                            P("Off")
                        end
                        if rAID.onRefresh then
                            pcall(rAID.onRefresh)
                        end
                    end)
                if not D then
                    P("error: " .. tostring(_):sub(1, 180))
                end
                task.wait(O and 0.5 or 2)
            end
            rAID.Alive = false
        end)
    end

    components.uiLibrary = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local runtimeState, config, localPlayer, userInputService =
            context.RT, context.CFG, context.LocalPlayer, context.UserInputService
        local runService = context.RunService
        local theme, fontFamilies =
            {
                TextPrimary = Color3.fromRGB(238, 246, 255),
                TextSub = Color3.fromRGB(150, 178, 212),
                TextMuted = Color3.fromRGB(110, 135, 170),
                TextOnAccent = Color3.fromRGB(10, 20, 35),
                StatusBad = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 140),
                StatusGood = Color3.fromRGB(135, 200, 255),
                SurfaceHeader = Color3.fromRGB(14, 22, 36),
                SurfaceElement = Color3.fromRGB(26, 40, 64),
                SurfaceHover = Color3.fromRGB(40, 62, 96),
                SurfaceField = Color3.fromRGB(22, 34, 54),
                SurfaceSection = Color3.fromRGB(20, 31, 50),
                SurfaceWell = Color3.fromRGB(12, 19, 31),
                SurfaceChip = Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 26),
                Hairline = Color3.fromRGB(52, 78, 115),
                BodyTop = Color3.fromRGB(24, 38, 60),
                BodyMid = Color3.fromRGB(16, 26, 42),
                BodyBot = Color3.fromRGB(10, 17, 28),
                BodyTopA = 0.05,
                BodyMidA = 0.13,
                BodyBotA = 0.42,
                SweepSpeed = 0.06,
                AccentA = Color3.fromRGB(95, 155, 230),
                AccentMid = Color3.fromRGB(135, 200, 255),
                AccentB = Color3.fromRGB(110, 185, 255),
                AccentDark = Color3.fromRGB(40, 70, 110),
                RadiusSm = 3,
                RadiusMd = 4,
                RadiusLg = 5,
                GapSm = 6,
                GapMd = 8,
                GapLg = 12,
                GapXl = 14,
                RowH = 34,
                HeaderH = 40,
            }, {
                sans = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Code).Family,
                mono = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.Code).Family,
            }
        -- Every player-facing status goes through this display-only translator.
        -- Keep the original values for route decisions, replay handling and diagnostics.
        local function formatStatus(raw, mode)
            local value = tostring(raw or ""):gsub("[%c]", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
                :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            local lower = value:lower()
            mode = mode or "queue"
            local function has(fragment)
                return lower:find(fragment, 1, true) ~= nil
            end
            local function starts(fragment)
                return lower:sub(1, #fragment) == fragment
            end
            local function done(output)
                output = tostring(output):gsub("[%c]", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
                    :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                local cutoff = utf8.offset(output, 96)
                if cutoff then
                    output = output:sub(1, cutoff - 1):gsub("%s+%S*$", "") .. "..."
                end
                return output
            end
            local function distance()
                local d = lower:match("([%d%.]+)%s+studs%s+to go")
                    or lower:match("([%d%.]+)%s+studs%s+away")
                    or lower:match("([%d%.]+)%s+studs%s+off")
                    or lower:match("([%d%.]+)%s+studs")
                    or lower:match("([%d%.]+)%s+to go")
                if d then
                    return " · " .. d .. " studs"
                end
                return ""
            end
            local function seconds()
                local t = lower:match("in%s+([%d%.]+)s")
                    or lower:match("([%d%.]+)s%s+left")
                    or lower:match("pulse%s+~?([%d%.]+)s")
                    or lower:match("%(([0-9%.]+)s%)")
                return t and (" · %ss"):format(t) or ""
            end
            local function action()
                if has("can't get") or has("no clear way") or has("no way")
                    or has("waiting") or has("holding") or has("standing still")
                    or has("staying") or has("settling") then
                    return "holding for a safe opening"
                elseif has("cast is out") or has(" - casting") or has("attacking") then
                    return "attacking"
                elseif has("back out") or has("retreat") or has("straight out") then
                    return "retreating to safety"
                elseif has("dodg") or has("flee") or has("escape") or has("out of")
                    or has("off the") or has("off it") then
                    return "dodging to safety"
                elseif has("round") or has("orbit") or has("circl") then
                    return "circling to a safe position"
                elseif has("to the") or has("toward") or has("moving") or has("closing")
                    or has("stepping") or has("sprinting") or has("straight over")
                    or has("hopping") or has("through") then
                    return "moving to a safe position"
                end
                return "positioning safely"
            end
            local missing = value == "" or value == "--" or value == "-" or lower == "nil"
            if missing then
                return mode == "attack" and "Scanning for enemies" or "Waiting for activity"
            end

            if mode == "queue" and starts("alt farm: ") then
                return done("Party — " .. formatStatus(value:sub(11), "party"))
            elseif mode == "queue" and starts("boss raids: ") then
                return done("Raids — " .. formatStatus(value:sub(13), "raid"))
            end

            if mode == "attack" then
                if lower == "on cooldown" then return "Abilities recharging" end
                if lower == "ready, nothing in reach" then return "Abilities ready — searching for targets" end
                local count, remaining = lower:match("^(%d+) in the disc, firing in ([%d%.]+)s")
                if count and remaining then
                    return done(("Aiming at %s enem%s — casting in %ss"):format(
                        count, count == "1" and "y" or "ies", remaining
                    ))
                end
                count = lower:match("^(%d+) in the disc")
                if count then
                    if count == "0" then return "Adjusting aim — no targets covered" end
                    return done(("Attack lined up — %s enem%s covered"):format(
                        count, count == "1" and "y" or "ies"
                    ))
                end
                if has("buff") then return "Waiting for ability buff" end
                if has("cooldown") or has("ready in") then return "Waiting for abilities" end
                return "Preparing next attack"
            end

            if mode == "queue" then
                local fixed = {
                    ["off"] = "Auto-queue disabled",
                    ["idle"] = "Ready — awaiting next run",
                    ["starting"] = "Starting dungeon",
                    ["running"] = "Dungeon in progress",
                    ["in a run"] = "Dungeon in progress",
                    ["queued by your party"] = "Waiting for party leader to queue",
                    ["party open; starting"] = "Party ready — starting dungeon",
                    ["declined by the game"] = "Queue declined — check party settings",
                    ["failed; will retry"] = "Queue failed — retrying automatically",
                    ["replay sent"] = "Replay requested — loading next run",
                    ["title screen: pressing play"] = "Entering dungeon",
                    ["fighting the bonus boss"] = "Bonus boss fight in progress",
                }
                if fixed[lower] then return fixed[lower] end
                if starts("creating ") then
                    return done("Creating dungeon lobby — " .. value:sub(10))
                elseif starts("not in a running party") then
                    return "No active party — create or join a party"
                elseif starts("staying for the bonus boss") then
                    return "Bonus boss active — delaying replay"
                elseif starts("run finished; holding the replay") then
                    return done("Run complete — awaiting bonus boss vote" .. seconds())
                elseif starts("run finished") or starts("run complete") then
                    return "Run complete — preparing next run"
                elseif starts("run over - resting") then
                    return "Run complete — resting after valuable loot"
                elseif starts("run over - taking a break") then
                    return "Run complete — scheduled break starting"
                elseif starts("dungeon failed") then
                    return "Dungeon failed — waiting to return to lobby"
                elseif starts("replay: ") then
                    if has("missing") then return "Replay unavailable — dungeon connection missing" end
                    return "Replay unavailable — dungeon details missing"
                elseif starts("error:") then
                    if has("northern lands") then
                        return "Difficulty adjusted — Northern Lands requires Insane or Nightmare"
                    end
                    return "Queue error — check dungeon settings"
                end
                return done("Queue — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper):gsub("; ", " — "))
            end

            if mode == "party" then
                if lower == "off" then return "Party automation disabled" end
                if starts("nobody here can clear") then
                    return done("No active fighters — returning to lobby" .. seconds())
                elseif starts("dungeon failed") then
                    return done("Run failed — returning to lobby" .. seconds())
                elseif starts("the leechers are starting") then
                    return "Waiting for alt accounts to create new saves"
                elseif starts("holding the party - ") then
                    return done("Party paused — teammates resting after rare drops")
                elseif starts("waiting for this account's data") then
                    return "Loading player data before joining party"
                elseif starts("this account never loaded") then
                    return "Lobby loading stalled — switching servers"
                elseif starts("the game's createlobby remote is missing") then
                    return "Cannot create party — game lobby service unavailable"
                elseif starts("creating a private ") then
                    local map, difficulty = value:match("[Cc]reating a private (.-) %((.-)%) party")
                    return done(map and ("Creating private party — " .. map .. " (" .. difficulty .. ")")
                        or "Creating private dungeon party")
                elseif starts("the game declined the party") then
                    return "Party creation declined — retrying"
                elseif starts("party open - waiting") then
                    local names = value:match("[Ww]aiting for (.-) %(")
                    return done("Party open — waiting for " .. (names or "teammates") .. seconds())
                elseif starts("selling in the lobby") then
                    return "Selling inventory before starting the run"
                elseif starts("everyone is in - starting") then
                    return "All party members ready — starting dungeon"
                elseif starts("starting without ") then
                    return done("Starting dungeon — missing " .. value:sub(18))
                elseif starts("stuck in a teleport") then
                    return "Teleport stalled — restart Roblox to rejoin party"
                elseif starts("no leader") then
                    return "No party leader — select a leader in Parties & Runs"
                elseif starts("the party needs level") then
                    local need, got = lower:match("level%s+(%d+), this account is%s+(%d+)")
                    return need and ("Level requirement not met — need " .. need .. ", current " .. got)
                        or "Level requirement not met"
                elseif starts("waiting for the carry to whitelist") then
                    return "Waiting for party invitation approval"
                elseif starts("the leechers") then
                    return "Coordinating party accounts"
                elseif starts("new save: ") then
                    if has("switching") then return "Creating a fresh character save" end
                    if has("no free") then return "New save unavailable — no unlocked slot free" end
                    if has("declined") then return "Save switch declined — keeping current save" end
                    if has("would not") or has("could not") then return "Could not open character slots" end
                    return "Save switch unsuccessful — keeping current save"
                elseif starts("starting a new save") then
                    return "Preparing a new character save"
                end
                local person = value:match("^(.-) is in a run")
                if person then
                    if has("asking") or has("asked") then
                        return done("Requesting to join " .. person .. "'s run")
                    end
                    return done("Waiting for " .. person .. "'s dungeon to finish")
                end
                person = value:match("^[Ww]aiting for (.-) %(")
                if person then return done("Waiting for " .. person .. seconds()) end
                person = value:match("^[Ww]aiting for (.-) to reach this server")
                if person then return done("Waiting for " .. person .. " to join" .. seconds()) end
                person = value:match("^[Ww]aiting for (.-) to come online")
                if person then return done("Waiting for " .. person .. " to come online") end
                person = value:match("^[Mm]oving to (.-)'s lobby server")
                if person then return done("Joining " .. person .. "'s lobby server") end
                person = value:match("^[Ww]ith (.-) %- waiting for its party")
                if person then return done("Waiting in " .. person .. "'s lobby") end
                person = value:match("^[Ii]n (.-)'s party %- waiting for the start")
                if person then return done("In " .. person .. "'s party — awaiting start") end
                person = value:match("^[Jj]oining (.-)'s party")
                if person then return done("Joining " .. person .. "'s party") end
                return done("Party — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end

            if mode == "raid" then
                if lower == "off" then return "Boss raids disabled" end
                if starts("error:") then return "Raid error — check connection or party settings" end
                if starts("waited ") then return "Raid party timed out — switching to dungeons temporarily" end
                if starts("waiting for leader's raid plan") then return "Waiting for raid plan from party leader" end
                if starts("following leader to the lobby") then return "Following raid leader to lobby" end
                if starts("waiting for leader to return") then return "Waiting for raid leader to return" end
                if starts("waiting for leader's boss raid") then return "Waiting for raid party to open" end
                if starts("joined tier ") then return done("Joined " .. value:gsub("^[Jj]oined ", "") .. "") end
                if starts("waiting for raid whitelist") then return "Waiting for raid invitation approval" end
                if starts("joined boss raid party") then return "Joined raid party — waiting to start" end
                if starts("raid join declined") then return "Raid join declined — retrying" end
                if starts("waiting for accounts: ") then return done("Waiting for raid teammates — " .. value:sub(23)) end
                if starts("creating private tier ") then return done("Creating raid lobby — " .. value:sub(18)) end
                if starts("raid creation declined") then return "Raid lobby creation declined — retrying" end
                if starts("raid party waiting for: ") then return done("Raid party waiting — " .. value:sub(25)) end
                if starts("tier ") and has("start requested") then
                    return done("Starting raid — Tier " .. (value:match("%d+") or "?"))
                end
                if starts("paused") then return "Raids paused — no actions being sent" end
                if starts("readying") then return "Preparing boss raid" end
                if starts("tier ") and has("raid in progress") then
                    return done("Boss raid in progress — Tier " .. (value:match("%d+") or "?"))
                end
                if starts("run finished; waiting for rewards") then return "Raid complete — collecting rewards" end
                if starts("waiting for the run report") then return "Waiting for raid results" end
                if starts("run complete; waiting for raid plan") then return "Raid complete — planning next raid" end
                if starts("raid finished; party replay is off") then return "Raid complete — replay disabled" end
                if starts("raid complete; waiting for leader's replay") then return "Raid complete — waiting for leader to replay" end
                if starts("checking the party's next-tier") then return "Checking party eligibility for next tier" end
                if starts("advancing to tier") then return done("Advancing to raid Tier " .. (value:match("%d+") or "?")) end
                if starts("replaying tier") then return done("Replaying raid Tier " .. (value:match("%d+") or "?")) end
                if starts("waiting") then return done("Raids — " .. value) end
                return done("Raids — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end

            if mode == "inventory" then
                if lower == "off" then return "Auto-sell disabled" end
                if has("held by mod") then return "Auto-sell paused — player safety check" end
                if has("menu is still loading") then return "Waiting for inventory to load" end
                if has("sell remotes are missing") then return "Auto-sell unavailable — sell service missing" end
                if has("inventory would not open") or has("bag would not open") then
                    return "Unable to open inventory — will retry"
                end
                if has("nothing matched") then return "Inventory checked — nothing to sell" end
                if starts("selling ") then return done("Selling items — " .. value:sub(9)) end
                if starts("sold ") then return done("Auto-sell complete — " .. value) end
                if has("sale took too long") then return "Auto-sell timed out — dungeon continuing" end
                if has("game sold nothing") then return "Auto-sell completed — no items sold" end
                if has("sell remote refused") then return "Sell request declined — will retry" end
                if has("not in an event run") then return "Auto-sell unavailable outside event run" end
                return done("Auto-sell — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end

            if mode == "candy" then
                if lower == "off" or lower == "off." then return "Candy collection disabled" end
                if has("mod detection") then return "Candy collection paused — safety check" end
                if has("character") then return "Candy collection — waiting for character" end
                if has("roof") then return "Candy skipped — unreachable on roof" end
                if has("ghosts to throw") then return "Watching for candy drops" end
                if has("going for a candy") then return done("Collecting nearby candy" .. distance()) end
                if starts("error:") then return "Candy collection error — retrying" end
                return done(value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end

            if mode == "movement" then
                if lower == "starting" then return "Starting navigation" end
                if lower == "stunned" then return "Stunned — waiting to recover" end
                if lower == "no character" then return "Respawning — waiting for character" end
                if lower == "strafe" then return "Strafing to maintain safe distance" end
                if lower == "back off" or lower == "back off via spot" then
                    return "Retreating to a safer attack position"
                end
                if lower == "run complete" then return "Dungeon complete — awaiting next run" end
                if starts("room cleared") then return "Room cleared — resetting for next section" end
                if starts("no enemy in sight") then return "No enemies detected — checking next objective" end
                if starts("trapped with no way out") then return "Navigation blocked — resetting to recover" end
                if starts("respawn:") then return "Respawning — stabilizing movement" end
                if starts("respawn rush") or starts("odin respawn") then
                    return done("Rejoining combat after respawn" .. distance() .. seconds())
                end
                if starts("alt farm: leeching") then
                    if has("carry is down") then return "Alt account — dodging until carry returns" end
                    if has("carry") and has("following") then return "Alt account — following the carry" end
                    if has("dodge") or has("attack") then return "Alt account — dodging incoming attacks" end
                    if has("waiting at spawn") then return "Alt account — waiting safely at spawn" end
                    return "Alt account — positioning with party"
                elseif starts("alt farm: ") then
                    return done("Alt account — " .. action() .. distance() .. seconds())
                end
                if starts("before the boss: ") then
                    return "Approaching boss arena — moving safely"
                end
                if starts("to room ") then return done("Entering next room" .. distance()) end
                if starts("to home base") then return done("Returning to attack position" .. distance()) end
                if starts("to the firing distance") then return done("Approaching attack range" .. distance()) end
                if starts("idle:") then
                    if has("beam") then return done("Moving away from incoming beam" .. seconds()) end
                    if has("waypoint") then return done("Following next waypoint" .. distance()) end
                    if has("ring") then return done("Maintaining safe boss distance" .. distance()) end
                    return done("Repositioning between attacks" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("first cast:") or starts("opener:") then
                    local covered, total = lower:match("(%d+)%s+of%s+(%d+)%s+in the disc")
                    if covered then return done("Opening attack — lining up " .. covered .. "/" .. total .. " enemies" .. distance()) end
                    if has("waiting") then return done("Opening attack — waiting for readiness" .. seconds()) end
                    return "Opening attack — positioning for group coverage"
                end
                if starts("group:") or starts("gathering") or starts("gather point") then
                    local covered, total = lower:match("(%d+)%s+of%s+(%d+)%s+in the disc")
                    if covered then return done("Grouping enemies — " .. covered .. "/" .. total .. " covered" .. seconds()) end
                    local covered2 = lower:match("group:%s+(%d+)%s+in the disc")
                    if covered2 then return done("Aiming at group — " .. covered2 .. " enemies covered" .. seconds()) end
                    if has("casting") then return "Attacking clustered enemies" end
                    return done("Gathering enemies for maximum coverage" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("sweep:") then
                    if has("still to tag") then
                        local n = lower:match("sweep:%s+(%d+)")
                        return done("Targeting unhit enemies — " .. (n or "more") .. " remaining")
                    end
                    return "Sweeping attack across enemy group"
                end
                if starts("cast:") or starts("holding fire:") then
                    if has("cannot be hurt") then return "Waiting for boss vulnerability window" end
                    if has("turning") then return "Aligning attack toward boss" end
                    if has("holding") then return "Holding attack angle for better accuracy" end
                    return "Preparing next attack"
                end
                if starts("mages:") or starts("mage strafe:") then
                    return done("Repositioning around ranged enemies" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("1-186 carry:") then return "Circling enemies to support the party" end
                if starts("move on:") or starts("run on:") then
                    return done("Advancing to next enemy group" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("melee break:") or starts("melee escape") then
                    return done("Evading nearby melee enemies" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("finish rush:") or starts("orb gap attack:") then
                    if has("casting") then return "Finishing boss — casting abilities" end
                    return done("Finishing boss — moving into attack range" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("boss:") or starts("into the arena:") then
                    return done("Maintaining safe boss distance" .. distance())
                end
                if starts("lead ") and has(" orb") then
                    local colour = lower:match("^lead%s+(%a+)%s+orb") or ""
                    local name = colour ~= "" and (colour:sub(1, 1):upper() .. colour:sub(2) .. " orb") or "Orb"
                    if has("crystal") then
                        return done(name .. " — guiding toward crystal" .. distance())
                    end
                    return done(name .. " — " .. action() .. distance())
                end
                if starts("rodin") then
                    local label = "Rodin"
                    if starts("rodin spiral") then label = "Rodin spiral"
                    elseif starts("rodin sweep") then label = "Rodin shockwave"
                    elseif starts("rodin missiles") then label = "Rodin missiles"
                    elseif starts("rodin split") then label = "Rodin arena split"
                    elseif starts("rodin red orb") then label = "Rodin red orb"
                    elseif starts("rodin blue orb") then label = "Rodin blue orb"
                    elseif starts("rodin good orb") then label = "Rodin green orb"
                    elseif starts("rodin zone") then label = "Rodin safe zone"
                    elseif starts("rodin flame") then label = "Rodin flames"
                    elseif starts("rodin fan") then label = "Rodin fan attack"
                    elseif starts("rodin home base") then label = "Rodin home position"
                    elseif starts("rodin opening") or starts("rodin camp") then label = "Rodin arena setup"
                    elseif starts("rodin aggro") then label = "Rodin attack range"
                    end
                    return done(label .. " — " .. action() .. distance() .. seconds())
                end
                if starts("odin") then return done("Odin — " .. action() .. distance() .. seconds()) end
                if starts("bob aggro") then return done("Bob — " .. action() .. distance() .. seconds()) end
                if starts("pumpkin king:") then
                    if has("healer") then return done("Pumpkin King — supporting team" .. distance()) end
                    if has("green candy") then return done("Pumpkin King — collecting green candy" .. distance()) end
                    if has("marker") then return done("Pumpkin King — moving to arena marker" .. distance()) end
                    return done("Pumpkin King — " .. action() .. distance())
                end
                if starts("sea king:") then return done("Sea King — navigating shockwave rings" .. distance()) end
                if starts("candy") then
                    return done("Collecting green candy — " .. action() .. distance())
                end
                local threats = {
                    {"safe spot:", "Safe zone"}, {"grid:", "Grid beams"},
                    {"pylon shot:", "Pylon projectiles"}, {"orb:", "Orb projectile"},
                    {"orb bubble:", "Orb projectile"}, {"orb sidestep:", "Orb projectile"},
                    {"orb flee", "Orb projectile"}, {"beam exit:", "Laser beam"},
                    {"line out:", "Line attack"}, {"fan out:", "Fan attack"},
                    {"fan:", "Fan attack"}, {"fan hold", "Fan attack"},
                    {"slam tell:", "Boss slam"}, {"slam run", "Boss slam"},
                    {"seeking step", "Tracking spike"}, {"spike exit:", "Ice spikes"},
                    {"spike stand", "Ice spikes"}, {"lethal out:", "Lethal attack"},
                    {"poison out:", "Poison hazard"}, {"no-go:", "Restricted area"},
                    {"middle keep-out:", "Boss arena center"}, {"boss 1 tour:", "Boss waypoint"},
                }
                for _, rule in ipairs(threats) do
                    if starts(rule[1]) then
                        return done(rule[2] .. " — " .. action() .. distance() .. seconds())
                    end
                end
                if starts("route:") or has("waypoint") or has("planning the route") then
                    return done("Navigating dungeon route" .. distance())
                end
                if has("wall") or has("blocked") or has("pathfinder") then
                    return done("Navigating around obstacles" .. distance())
                end
                if has("beam") or has("laser") or has("slam") or has("spike")
                    or has("hazard") or has("missile") or has("orb") or has("poison")
                    or has("dodge") or has("danger") or has("attack across") then
                    return done("Avoiding incoming attacks — " .. action() .. distance())
                end
                if has("enemy") or has("mob") or has("group") then
                    return done("Engaging enemy group" .. distance())
                end
                if has("cast") or has("firing") then return "Positioning for attack" end
                if has("wait") or has("hold") then return "Holding position — awaiting safe opening" end
                if has("flee") or has("escape") then return "Evading danger" end
                if has("travel") or has("approach") or has("goal") or has("move") then
                    return done("Moving toward next objective" .. distance())
                end
                return done("Navigating dungeon — " .. action() .. distance())
            end

            if mode == "error" then
                if has("config load failed") then return "Settings could not load — using defaults" end
                if has("no character") or has("humanoid") then return "Character unavailable — recovering" end
                if has("teleport") then return "Teleport failed — retry required" end
                if has("http") or has("webhook") then return "Network request failed — check settings" end
                if has("queue") then return "Party queue error — check settings" end
                if has("attempt to index") or has("nil value") then
                    return "Script error — check diagnostics for details"
                end
                return "Operation interrupted — check diagnostics"
            end
            if mode == "map" then
                if has("waiting for interface") then return "Map — loading interface" end
                if has("ready") then return "Map — ready to open" end
                if has("stopped") then return "Map — closed" end
                if starts("classic /") then return done("Map — viewing " .. value:sub(11)) end
                return done("Map — " .. value)
            end
            if mode == "break" then
                if starts("off") or has("disabled") then return "Scheduled breaks disabled" end
                if has("rest") or has("break") then return done("Party rest — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper)) end
                if has("farm") then return done("Farming session — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper)) end
                return done("Session — " .. value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end
            if mode == "stats" then
                if lower == "idle" then return "Waiting for data" end
                if lower == "stopped" or lower == "off" then return "Telemetry disabled" end
                return done(value:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            end
            if lower == "off" then return "Disabled" end
            return done(value:gsub("^%l", string.upper):gsub("; ", " — "))
        end
        context.formatStatus = formatStatus
        local P = {
            [Enum.FontWeight.Regular] = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            [Enum.FontWeight.Medium] = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            [Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold] = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            [Enum.FontWeight.Bold] = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        }
        local function setFont(l, c, u)
            if not pcall(function()
                l.FontFace = Font.new(fontFamilies[c], u)
            end) then
                l.Font = P[u] or Enum.Font.Gotham
            end
        end
        local D = {
            windowTitle = {
                family = "sans",
                weight = Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,
                size = 15,
                color = "TextPrimary",
            },
            windowChip = {

        local function accentGradient(parent, q)

                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, theme.AccentA),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.53, theme.AccentMid),

            gradient.Rotation = q or 0

            return gradient
