        local function section(parent, Z, n, I)
            local section2 = Instance.new("Frame")
            section2.Name = "Section"
            section2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            section2.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            section2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
            section2.LayoutOrder = n or 1
            section2.Parent = parent
            vlist(section2, theme.GapSm)
            local head, textControl = row(section2, Z, 1, nil, 24)
            head.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SurfaceSection
            setFont(textControl, "sans", Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)
            local i, b = hoverable(head, true), chevron(head)
            local content = Instance.new("Frame")
            content.Name = "Content"
            content.BackgroundColor3 = theme.SurfaceWell
            content.BorderSizePixel = 0
            content.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
            content.Visible = false
            content.LayoutOrder = 2
            content.Parent = section2
            corner(content, theme.RadiusMd)
            local G = vlist(content, theme.GapSm)
            pad(content, 6, 6, 6, 6)
            local visible = false
            local function setOpen(T, W)
                T = T and true or false
                local K = T ~= visible
                visible = T
                b.setOpen(visible)
                textControl.TextColor3 = visible and theme.AccentMid or theme.TextPrimary
                local C = K
                    and not W
                    and context.Shell
                    and context.Shell.slideTo
                    and context.Shell.isShown
                    and context.Shell.isShown()
                    and section2:IsDescendantOf(game)
                if C then
                    context.Shell.slideTo(content, G, 12, visible)
                else
                    content.Visible = visible
                end
            end
            setOpen(false, true)
            i.onClick(function()
                setOpen(not visible)
            end)
            tip(head, I)
            if I and I ~= "" then
                n = label(content, I, "captionSub", -1000)
                n.Name = "Description"
                n.TextSize = 11
                n.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                n.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                n.TextWrapped = true
                n.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                pad(n, 2, 4, 2, 4)
            end
            context.sectionReg = context.sectionReg or {}
            context.sectionReg[section2] = {
                head = head,
                content = content,
                setOpen = setOpen,
                isOpen = function()
                    local visible2 = visible
                    return visible2
                end,
            }
            Z = {
                holder = section2,
                content = content,
                setOpen = function(M, n)
                    if not M then
                        setOpen(false, n)
                    end
                end,
                isOpen = function()
                    local visible2 = visible
                    return visible2
                end,
            }
            return Z
        end
        context.UIKit = {
            Theme = theme,
            setFont = setFont,
            corner = corner,
            stroke = stroke,
            pad = pad,
            vlist = vlist,
            hlist = hlist,
            label = label,
            caption = function(Q, S, P)
                local _ = label(Q, S, "captionSub", P)
                _.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
                _.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                _.TextWrapped = true
                _.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
                return _
            end,
            flexFill = flexFill,
            accentGradient = accentGradient,
            accentSweep = accentSweep,
            stopSweeps = stopSweeps,
            bodyGradient = bodyGradient,
            shadow = shadow,
            ensureTip = ensureTip,
            tip = tip,
            hideTip = hideTip,
            chevron = chevron,
            row = row,
            hoverable = hoverable,
            icon = icon,
            toggle = toggle,
            slider = slider,
            dropdown = dropdown,
            textInput = textInput,
            rangeSlider = rangeSlider,
            listInput = listInput,
            colorRow = colorRow,
            colorWheel = colorWheel,
            button = button2,
            buttonRow = buttonRow,
            window = window,
            section = section,
            makeDraggable = makeDraggable,
        }
    end

    components.drawing = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local config = context.CFG
        local dangerGeometry = context.DG
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local contextHazards = context.hazards
        local contextVisualRoot = context.visualRoot
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local _ = {
            parts = {},
            freeHazards = {},
            candidates = {},
            nodes = {},
            spots = {},
            scan = {},
            ring = {},
            groups = {},
            tags = {},
            wallTags = {},
            lastDraw = -math.huge,
            lastSweep = -math.huge,
            list = {},
        }
        local function l()
            if _.folder and _.folder.Parent then
                return _.folder
            end
            _.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            _.folder.Name = "Hazards"
            _.folder.Parent = contextVisualRoot()
            return _.folder
        end
        local function c(parent, name, transparency)
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Name = name
            part.Anchored = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.CanQuery = false
            part.CanTouch = false
            part.CastShadow = false
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            part.Transparency = transparency
            part.Parent = parent
            return part
        end
        local function u(h, lineThickness, color3)
            local y = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            y.Name = "edge"
            y.LineThickness = lineThickness
            y.SurfaceTransparency = 1
            y.Color3 = color3
            y.Adornee = h
            y.Parent = h
            return y
        end
        local function h(m, R, color, vector, V, E, p, transparency, U, J, w)
            U = math.clamp(U or math.floor(V * 1.65), 16, config.devRingSegments or 48)
            local limit = m == _.groups and (config.devMaxGroupParts or 120)
                or (config.devMaxRingParts or 350)
            if R >= limit then return R end
            local Y = 6.283185307179586 / U
            local v, M = 2 * V * math.sin(Y / 2), math.max((p or 0.5) * (config.markerScale or 1), 0.2)
            for index = 0, U - 1, 1 do
                p = index * Y + Y / 2
                if R >= limit then
                    break
                end
                if not (J and math.cos(p) * J + math.sin(p) * w < 0) then
                    local U, J = vector.X + math.cos(p) * V, vector.Z + math.sin(p) * V
                    R += 1
                    index = m[R]
                    if not index or not index.Parent then
                        index = c(l(), "ring", transparency)
                        index.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
                        m[R] = index
                    else
                    end
                    index.Size = Vector3.new(M, M, v)
                    index.Color = color
                    index.Transparency = transparency
                    index.CFrame =
                        CFrame.new(Vector3.new(U, E, J), Vector3.new(U - math.sin(p), E, J + math.cos(p)))
                else
                end
            end
            return R
        end
        local function m(R, y, color, vector, E, p, j, transparency, J, w)
            local Y = (E + p) * 0.5
            local v = math.clamp(math.floor(Y * 0.8), 12, config.devBandSegments or 40)
            local M = 6.283185307179586 / v
            local Z, n = 2 * E * math.sin(M / 2) * 1.03, math.max(E - p, 0.5)
            for index = 0, v - 1, 1 do
                if y >= (config.devMaxRingParts or 350) then
                    break
                end
                E = index * M + M / 2
                if not (J and math.cos(E) * J + math.sin(E) * w < 0) then
                    p, index = vector.X + math.cos(E) * Y, vector.Z + math.sin(E) * Y
                    y += 1
                    local V = R[y]
                    if not V or not V.Parent then
                        V = c(l(), "ring", transparency)
                        V.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
                        R[y] = V
                    else
                    end
                    V.Size = Vector3.new(n, 0.4, Z)
                    V.Color = color
                    V.Transparency = transparency
                    V.CFrame =
                        CFrame.new(Vector3.new(p, j, index), Vector3.new(p - math.sin(E), j, index + math.cos(E)))
                else
                end
            end
            return y
        end
        local function R(y, q, color, E, p, transparency)
            local cap = y == _.nodes and (config.devMaxNodeParts or 100)
                or y == _.spots and (config.devMaxSpotParts or 80)
                or y == _.scan and (config.devMaxScanParts or 75)
                or nil
            if cap and q > cap then
                return
            end
            local U = y[q]
            if not U or not U.Parent then
                U = c(l(), "node", transparency)
                U.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                y[q] = U
            else
            end
            E = math.max(E * (config.markerScale or 1), 0.55)
            U.Size, U.Color, U.Transparency, U.CFrame = Vector3.new(E, E, E), color, transparency, CFrame.new(p)
        end
        local function y(q, V)
            -- Keep geometry to reuse on the next draw instead of destroying/recreating it.
            local pooled = q == _.ring or q == _.groups or q == _.nodes
                or q == _.spots or q == _.scan
            for index = #q, V + 1, -1 do
                local part = q[index]
                if pooled and part and part.Parent then
                    if part.Transparency ~= 1 then
                        part.Transparency = 1
                    end
                else
                    if part then part:Destroy() end
                    q[index] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function q(parent, textColor3)
            local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            tag.Name, tag.Size, tag.AlwaysOnTop, tag.MaxDistance, tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace =
                "tag", UDim2.fromOffset(240, 22), true, 250, Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
            tag.LightInfluence = 0
            local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            text.Name, text.Size, text.BackgroundTransparency, text.TextColor3, text.TextStrokeTransparency, text.TextScaled, text.Font =
                "text", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, textColor3, 0.2, true, Enum.Font.GothamBold
            text.Parent = tag
            tag.Parent = parent
            return tag
        end
        local function V()
            local spare = table.remove(_.freeHazards)
            if spare and spare.Parent then
                spare.Transparency = config.hazardTransparency
                if spare:FindFirstChild("edge") then spare.edge.Visible = true end
                if spare:FindFirstChild("tag") then spare.tag.Enabled = config.labelHazards end
                return spare
            end
            local part = c(l(), "box", config.hazardTransparency)
            u(part, 0.035, config.colorFloor)
            q(part, Color3.fromRGB(246, 224, 171))
            return part
        end
        local function releaseHazard(entry)
            local part = _.parts[entry]
            if not part then return end
            _.parts[entry] = nil
            if not part.Parent then return end
            part.Transparency = 1
            if part:FindFirstChild("edge") then part.edge.Visible = false end
            if part:FindFirstChild("tag") then part.tag.Enabled = false end
            local sweep = part:FindFirstChild("sweep")
            if sweep then sweep:Destroy() end
            local sight = part:FindFirstChild("sight")
            if sight then sight:Destroy() end
            if #_.freeHazards < (config.drawMaxBoxes or 70) then
                _.freeHazards[#_.freeHazards + 1] = part
            else
                part:Destroy()
            end
        end
        local function E(p, j)
            local U = p:FindFirstChild("sight")
            if not j then
                if U then
                    U:Destroy()
                end
                return nil
            end
            if not U then
                U = c(p, "sight", 1)
                u(U, 0.03, Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245))
            else
            end
            return U
        end
        local function u()
            if _.orbFolder and _.orbFolder.Parent then
                return _.orbFolder
            end
            _.orbFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            _.orbFolder.Name = "GroupOrbs"
            _.orbFolder.Parent = contextVisualRoot()
            return _.orbFolder
        end
        local function p()
            if _.aoeFolder and _.aoeFolder.Parent then
                return _.aoeFolder
            end
            _.aoeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            _.aoeFolder.Name = "AoEMarker"
            _.aoeFolder.Parent = contextVisualRoot()
            return _.aoeFolder
        end
        local function j()
            local U = hazardReader.aoeShape
            if not (U and U.aoeX) and type(config.aoeKnown) == "table" and hazardReader.abilitySlots then
                for key, abilitySlot in pairs(hazardReader.abilitySlots) do
                    key = abilitySlot.name and config.aoeKnown[string.lower(tostring(abilitySlot.name))] or nil
                    if key then
                        U = {
                            aoeX = key.x,
                            aoeZ = key.z,
                            aoeRound = key.round,
                            measured = true,
                        }
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            local J, w = runtimeState.groupPlan, game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            local aoeMarker, v, M, Z =
                w and (w:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
                context.aoeLanding and select(1, context.aoeLanding()) or nil
            w = context.BR and context.BR.aim or nil
            if w and aoeMarker then
                local n, f = w.X - aoeMarker.Position.X, w.Z - aoeMarker.Position.Z
                local r = math.sqrt(n * n + f * f)
                if r > 0.5 then
                    M, Z = n / r, f / r
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not M and J then
                if J.hfx then
                    M, Z = J.hfx, J.hfz
                else
                    if J.a then
                        M, Z = (math.cos(J.a)), math.sin(J.a)
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            if not M and aoeMarker then
                w = aoeMarker.CFrame.LookVector
                J = math.sqrt(w.X * w.X + w.Z * w.Z)
                if J > 0.01 then
                    M, Z = w.X / J, w.Z / J
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if config.aoeMarker == false or not (U and aoeMarker and v and M) then
                if _.aoeMark then
                    _.aoeMark:Destroy()
                    _.aoeMark = nil
                end
                return
            end
            J = aoeMarker.Position
            w, aoeMarker = Vector3.new(J.X + M * v, J.Y - 2.4, J.Z + Z * v), _.aoeMark
            if not (aoeMarker and aoeMarker.Parent) then
                aoeMarker = Instance.new("Part")
                aoeMarker.Name = "aoeMarker"
                aoeMarker.Anchored = true
                aoeMarker.CanCollide = false
                aoeMarker.CanQuery = false
                aoeMarker.CanTouch = false
                aoeMarker.CastShadow = false
                aoeMarker.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                aoeMarker.Transparency = 0.72
                aoeMarker.Color = config.colorAbility or Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
                aoeMarker.Parent = p()
                _.aoeMark = aoeMarker
            else
            end
            if U.aoeRound then
                aoeMarker.Shape, aoeMarker.Size = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.4, U.aoeX, U.aoeX)
                aoeMarker.CFrame = CFrame.new(w) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
            else
                aoeMarker.Shape, aoeMarker.Size = Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(U.aoeX, 0.4, U.aoeZ)
                aoeMarker.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(w, w + Vector3.new(M, 0, Z))
            end
        end
        local function U()
            local aoeScan = _.aoeScan or {}
            _.aoeScan = aoeScan
            local aoeScan2 = hazardReader.aoeScan
            if config.drawAoeScan ~= true or not aoeScan2 or os.clock() - (aoeScan2.at or 0) > 1 then
                for index = 1, #aoeScan do
                    local part = aoeScan[index]
                    if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
                end
                return
            end
            local Y, v, M =
                math.max(math.floor((config.aoeScanDrawStep or 15) / math.max(config.aimStepDeg or 5, 1)), 1),
                config.aoeScanLift or 2.4,
                0
            for index2 = 1, #aoeScan2.list, 1 do
                M = if aoeScan2.list[index2].n > M then aoeScan2.list[index2].n else M
            end
            local Z = 0
            local function n()
                Z += 1
                local aoeScan3 = aoeScan[Z]
                local r = not (aoeScan3 and aoeScan3.Parent)
                if r then
                    aoeScan3 = Instance.new("Part")
                    aoeScan3.Name = "aoeScan"
                    aoeScan3.Anchored = true
                    aoeScan3.CanCollide = false
                    aoeScan3.CanQuery = false
                    aoeScan3.CanTouch = false
                    aoeScan3.CastShadow = false
                    aoeScan3.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    aoeScan3.Parent = p()
                    aoeScan[Z] = aoeScan3
                else
                end
                return aoeScan3
            end
            local p = aoeScan2.rx ~= nil and aoeScan2.rz ~= nil and config.aoeScanTrueShape ~= false
            for index3 = 1, #aoeScan2.list, 1 do
                local r = aoeScan2.list[index3]
                if (index3 - 1) % Y == 0 or index3 == aoeScan2.best then
                    local Y, o = index3 == aoeScan2.best, M > 0 and r.n / M or 0
                    local color, f =
                        Y and Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(
                            60 + math.floor(o * 60),
                            90 + math.floor(o * 165),
                            140 + math.floor(o * 40)
                        ),
                        (aoeScan2.y or 0) - v + (Y and 0.6 or 0)
                    if p and r.fx then
                        local p, A = r.fx, r.fz
                        local k, x, a, e, transparency, iterateArray =
                            -A,
                            aoeScan2.rz * 0.5,
                            aoeScan2.rx * 0.5,
                            Y and 0.7 or 0.3,
                            Y and 0.2 or 0.88 - o * 0.45,
                            ipairs
                        local F = {
                            {
                                r.x + p * x,
                                r.z + A * x,
                                k,
                                p,
                                aoeScan2.rx,
                            },
                            {
                                r.x - p * x,
                                r.z - A * x,
                                k,
                                p,
                                aoeScan2.rx,
                            },
                            {
                                r.x + k * a,
                                r.z + p * a,
                                p,
                                A,
                                aoeScan2.rz,
                            },
                            {
                                r.x - k * a,
                                r.z - p * a,
                                p,
                                A,
                                aoeScan2.rz,
                            },
                        }
                        for key, entry in iterateArray(F) do
                            x = n()
                            x.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
                            x.Size = Vector3.new(e, 0.2, entry[5] + e)
                            x.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                                Vector3.new(entry[1], f, entry[2]),
                                Vector3.new(entry[1] + entry[3], f, entry[2] + entry[4])
                            )
                            x.Color = color
                            x.Transparency = transparency
                        end
                    else
                        local p = n()
                        p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                        p.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, aoeScan2.lr * 2, aoeScan2.lr * 2)
                        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.x, f, r.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
                        p.Transparency = Y and 0.55 or 0.97 - o * 0.12
                        p.Color = color
                    end
                end
            end
            for index4 = #aoeScan, Z + 1, -1 do
                local part = aoeScan[index4]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        local function p()
            local orbs = _.orbs or {}
            _.orbs = orbs
            if
                config.groupOrbs == false
                or not hazardReader.mobGroups
                    and not hazardReader.firstCastMobs
                    and not hazardReader.castPending
            then
                if next(orbs) ~= nil then
                    for key, orb in pairs(orbs) do
                        orb:Destroy()
                        orbs[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            local w, Y, v = config.groupOrbSize or 1.7, config.groupOrbHeight or 5.5, {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(hazardReader.enemies or {}) do
                if
                    not entry.isBoss
                    and entry.root
                    and entry.root.Parent
                    and (entry.humanoid == nil or entry.humanoid.Health > 0)
                then
                    local n, groupOrb =
                        hazardReader.groupOf and entry.model and hazardReader.groupOf[entry.model] or nil,
                        hazardReader.firstCastMobs
                    index = config.tagMark ~= false
                        and entry.model ~= nil
                        and (
                            context.mobTagged ~= nil and context.mobTagged(entry)
                            or groupOrb ~= nil and groupOrb[entry.model] == true
                        )
                    n = if n and (n.n or 0) < 2 then nil else n
                    if n or index then
                        groupOrb = orbs[entry.model]
                        if not (groupOrb and groupOrb.Parent) then
                            groupOrb = Instance.new("Part")
                            groupOrb.Name = "groupOrb"
                            groupOrb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                            groupOrb.Anchored = true
                            groupOrb.CanCollide = false
                            groupOrb.CanQuery = false
                            groupOrb.CanTouch = false
                            groupOrb.CastShadow = false
                            groupOrb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            groupOrb.Parent = u()
                            orbs[entry.model] = groupOrb
                        else
                        end
                        groupOrb.Size = index and Vector3.new(w * 1.4, w * 1.4, w * 1.4) or Vector3.new(w, w, w)
                        groupOrb.Transparency = (index or n) and 0 or 1
                        groupOrb.Color = index and (config.colorTagged or Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 110))
                            or n and n.colour
                            or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        groupOrb.CFrame = CFrame.new(entry.root.Position + Vector3.new(0, Y, 0))
                        if config.groupNumbers ~= false then
                            local num = groupOrb:FindFirstChild("num")
                            if not num then
                                num = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                                num.Name = "num"
                                num.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26)
                                num.AlwaysOnTop = true
                                num.MaxDistance = 300
                                num.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
                                num.LightInfluence = 0
                                local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                                label.Name = "t"
                                label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                                label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
                                label.TextScaled = true
                                label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                                label.Parent = num
                                num.Parent = groupOrb
                            else
                            end
                            local textControl = num:FindFirstChild("t")
                            if textControl then
                                local u, text = index and "TAG"
                                if u then
                                    text = u
                                else
                                    local toString, f = tostring, n and (n.num or n.id)
                                    text = toString(f or "?")
                                end
                                textControl.Text = text
                                textControl.TextColor3 = index and Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 140)
                                    or n and n.colour
                                    or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            end
                        end
                        v[entry.model] = true
                    end
                end
            end
            for key2, orb2 in pairs(orbs) do
                if not v[key2] then
                    orb2:Destroy()
                    orbs[key2] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function u()
            if _.mlFolder and _.mlFolder.Parent then
                return _.mlFolder
            end
            _.mlFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            _.mlFolder.Name = "MissileLines"
            _.mlFolder.Parent = contextVisualRoot()
            return _.mlFolder
        end
        local function contextDrawMissileLines()
            local mLines = _.mLines or {}
            _.mLines = mLines
            local missileLines, v = hazardReader.missileLines, 0
            if
                config.visuals ~= false
                and config.drawMissileLines ~= false
                and missileLines
                and missileLines.lines
                and os.clock() - (missileLines.at or 0) < (config.missileLineStale or 3)
            then
                local M, arenaCentre, color, f =
                    config.missileLaneLen or 600,
                    hazardReader.arenaCentre,
                    config.colorMissileLine or Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90),
                    (missileLines.y or 0) - 2.3
                for index, line in ipairs(missileLines.lines) do
                    local A, k =
                        missileLines.bx + missileLines.nx * line, missileLines.bz + missileLines.nz * line
                    if arenaCentre then
                        index = (arenaCentre.X - A) * missileLines.ax + (arenaCentre.Z - k) * missileLines.az
                        A, k = A + missileLines.ax * index, k + missileLines.az * index
                    else
                    end
                    v += 1
                    index = mLines[v]
                    if not (index and index.Parent) then
                        index = Instance.new("Part")
                        index.Name = "missileLine"
                        index.Anchored = true
                        index.CanCollide = false
                        index.CanQuery = false
                        index.CanTouch = false
                        index.CastShadow = false
                        index.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        index.Parent = u()
                        mLines[v] = index
                    else
                    end
                    local Z = missileLines.pick ~= nil and math.abs(line - missileLines.pick) < 0.01
                    local new, x = Vector3.new, Z and (config.missileLineWidthPick or 0.7)
                    index.Size = new(x or (config.missileLineWidth or 0.4), 0.2, M)
                    index.Color, index.Transparency = color, Z and 0 or 0.3
                    index.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                        Vector3.new(A, f, k),
                        Vector3.new(A + missileLines.ax, f, k + missileLines.az)
                    )
                end
            else
            end
            for index2 = #mLines, v + 1, -1 do
                local part = mLines[index2]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        context.drawMissileLines = contextDrawMissileLines
        local function w()
            local bLines = _.bLines or {}
            _.bLines = bLines
            local v = 0
            if
                config.visuals ~= false
                and config.drawBlueRails ~= false
                and context.PB
                and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
                and context.OD
                and context.OD.blueArcs
            then
                local M, M, M = context.character()
                local Z = M and M.Position.Y - 2.3 or nil
                local n, blueRail, r =
                    Z and context.OD.blueArcs(os.clock()) or {},
                    config.colorBlueRail or Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 255),
                    config.blueRailSegments or 12
                for index, entry in ipairs(n) do
                    M = math.atan2(entry.sz, entry.sx)
                    for index2 = 0, r - 1, 1 do
                        local k, blueRail2 =
                            M - 1.5707963267948966 + 3.141592653589793 * index2 / r,
                            M - 1.5707963267948966 + 3.141592653589793 * (index2 + 1) / r
                        local M, a, e, N =
                            entry.cx + math.cos(k) * entry.r,
                            entry.cz + math.sin(k) * entry.r,
                            entry.cx + math.cos(blueRail2) * entry.r,
                            entry.cz + math.sin(blueRail2) * entry.r
                        index2 = math.sqrt((e - M) ^ 2 + (N - a) ^ 2)
                        if index2 > 0.05 then
                            v += 1
                            blueRail2 = bLines[v]
                            if not (blueRail2 and blueRail2.Parent) then
                                blueRail2 = Instance.new("Part")
                                blueRail2.Name = "blueRail"
                                blueRail2.Anchored = true
                                blueRail2.CanCollide = false
                                blueRail2.CanQuery = false
                                blueRail2.CanTouch = false
                                blueRail2.CastShadow = false
                                blueRail2.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                                blueRail2.Parent = u()
                                bLines[v] = blueRail2
                            else
                            end
                            k, index = (M + e) * 0.5, (a + N) * 0.5
                            blueRail2.Size = Vector3.new(
                                (context.OD.railHalfW and context.OD.railHalfW() or 0.2) * 2,
                                0.2,
                                index2 + 0.1
                            )
                            blueRail2.Color = blueRail
                            blueRail2.Transparency = 0.2
                            blueRail2.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(k, Z, index), Vector3.new(e, Z, N))
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
                r = context.OD.cross
                if Z and r and os.clock() - (r.at or 0) < 0.5 then
                    v += 1
                    blueRail = bLines[v]
                    if not (blueRail and blueRail.Parent) then
                        blueRail = Instance.new("Part")
                        blueRail.Name = "blueRail"
                        blueRail.Anchored = true
                        blueRail.CanCollide = false
                        blueRail.CanQuery = false
                        blueRail.CanTouch = false
                        blueRail.CastShadow = false
                        blueRail.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        blueRail.Parent = u()
                        bLines[v] = blueRail
                    else
                    end
                    blueRail.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 3, 3)
                    blueRail.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 230)
                    blueRail.Transparency = 0
                    blueRail.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.x, Z, r.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
                else
                end
            else
            end
            for index3 = #bLines, v + 1, -1 do
                local part = bLines[index3]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        local function Y()
            local bobRailParts = _.bobRailParts or {}
            _.bobRailParts = bobRailParts
            local M, bobLines = 0, hazardReader.bobLines
            if
                config.visuals ~= false
                and config.drawMissileLines ~= false
                and bobLines
                and bobLines.lines
                and os.clock() - (bobLines.at or 0) < 0.5
            then
                local n, n, bobRail = context.character()
                local f = bobRail and bobRail.Position.Y - 2.3 or nil
                if f then
                    local r, color =
                        math.min(bobLines.halfL * 2, config.bobRailDrawLen or 160),
                        config.colorMissileLine or Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 90)
                    for index, line in ipairs(bobLines.lines) do
                        M += 1
                        bobRail = bobRailParts[M]
                        if not (bobRail and bobRail.Parent) then
                            bobRail = Instance.new("Part")
                            bobRail.Name = "bobRail"
                            bobRail.Anchored = true
                            bobRail.CanCollide = false
                            bobRail.CanQuery = false
                            bobRail.CanTouch = false
                            bobRail.CastShadow = false
                            bobRail.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            bobRail.Parent = u()
                            bobRailParts[M] = bobRail
                        else
                        end
                        local k, x, a =
                            bobLines.pick ~= nil and math.abs(line - bobLines.pick) < 0.01,
                            bobLines.bx + bobLines.nx * line + bobLines.ax * bobLines.alongMid,
                            bobLines.bz + bobLines.nz * line + bobLines.az * bobLines.alongMid
                        bobRail.Size = Vector3.new(k and 0.7 or 0.4, 0.2, r)
                        bobRail.Color, bobRail.Transparency = color, k and 0 or 0.3
                        bobRail.CFrame =
                            CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(x, f, a), Vector3.new(x + bobLines.ax, f, a + bobLines.az))
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            for index2 = #bobRailParts, M + 1, -1 do
                local part = bobRailParts[index2]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        local function v()
            local fanParts = _.fanParts or {}
            _.fanParts = fanParts
            local Z = 0
            local n = config.visuals ~= false
                and config.drawFanBeam ~= false
                and context.PB
                and context.PB.boss == "Odin"
                and context.OD
                and context.OD.fanRedNow
            if n then
                local n, n, now = context.character()
                local f = now and now.Position.Y - 2.3 or nil
                now = os.clock()
                local function r(o, A, k, x, a, e, color, transparency)
                    Z += 1
                    local fanBeam = fanParts[Z]
                    local C = not (fanBeam and fanBeam.Parent)
                    if C then
                        fanBeam = Instance.new("Part")
                        fanBeam.Name = "fanBeam"
                        fanBeam.Anchored = true
                        fanBeam.CanCollide = false
                        fanBeam.CanQuery = false
                        fanBeam.CanTouch = false
                        fanBeam.CastShadow = false
                        fanBeam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        fanBeam.Parent = u()
                        fanParts[Z] = fanBeam
                    else
                    end
                    fanBeam.Size = Vector3.new(a, 0.2, e)
                    fanBeam.Color = color
                    fanBeam.Transparency = transparency
                    fanBeam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(o, f, A), Vector3.new(o + k, f, A + x))
                end
                if f then
                    local f = hazardReader.arenaCentre
                    local o = config.odinRuneStand ~= false
                            and f
                            and context.OD.runeR
                            and context.OD.runeR()
                        or nil
                    if o and config.drawRuneRing ~= false then
                        local A = config.runeRingSegments or 32
                        for index = 0, A - 1, 1 do
                            local x, a = 6.283185307179586 * index / A, 6.283185307179586 * (index + 1) / A
                            local A, k, e, N =
                                f.X + math.cos(x) * o,
                                f.Z + math.sin(x) * o,
                                f.X + math.cos(a) * o,
                                f.Z + math.sin(a) * o
                            x = math.sqrt((e - A) ^ 2 + (N - k) ^ 2)
                            if x > 0.05 then
                                r(
                                    (A + e) * 0.5,
                                    (k + N) * 0.5,
                                    e - A,
                                    N - k,
                                    0.3,
                                    x + 0.1,
                                    config.colorRuneRing or Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 90),
                                    0.35
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    f = context.OD.fanRedNow(now)
                    if f then
                        r(
                            f.x,
                            f.z,
                            f.ax,
                            f.az,
                            f.halfW * 2,
                            f.halfL * 2,
                            config.colorFanRed or Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 45),
                            0.4
                        )
                    end
                    f = context.OD.fanGreenNow(now)
                    if f then
                        r(
                            f.x,
                            f.z,
                            f.ax,
                            f.az,
                            f.halfW * 2,
                            f.halfL * 2,
                            config.colorFanGreen or Color3.fromRGB(60, 235, 95),
                            0.4
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            for index2 = #fanParts, Z + 1, -1 do
                local part = fanParts[index2]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        local function M()
            local orbParts = _.orbParts or {}
            _.orbParts = orbParts
            local n = 0
            local f = runtimeState.orbitLive
            local P = config.visuals ~= false
                and config.drawOrbit ~= false
                and f
                and f.x
                and f.z
                and f.R
                and os.clock() - (f.at or 0) < 0.5
            if P then
                local r, r, r = context.character()
                local o = r and r.Position.Y - 2.3 or nil
                if o then
                    local function A()
                        n += 1
                        local orbitRing = orbParts[n]
                        local x = not (orbitRing and orbitRing.Parent)
                        if x then
                            orbitRing = Instance.new("Part")
                            orbitRing.Name = "orbitRing"
                            orbitRing.Anchored = true
                            orbitRing.CanCollide = false
                            orbitRing.CanQuery = false
                            orbitRing.CanTouch = false
                            orbitRing.CastShadow = false
                            orbitRing.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            orbitRing.Parent = u()
                            orbParts[n] = orbitRing
                        else
                        end
                        return orbitRing
                    end
                    local function u(k, x, a, color, N, transparency, F)
                        if not (k and x and a and a > 0.5) then
                            return
                        end
                        for index = 0, F - 1, 1 do
                            local g, i = 6.283185307179586 * index / F, 6.283185307179586 * (index + 1) / F
                            local F, C, b, B, G =
                                k + math.cos(g) * a,
                                x + math.sin(g) * a,
                                k + math.cos(i) * a,
                                x + math.sin(i) * a,
                                A()
                            G.Size = Vector3.new(N, 0.2, math.sqrt((b - F) ^ 2 + (B - C) ^ 2) + 0.05)
                            G.Color = color
                            G.Transparency = transparency
                            G.CFrame =
                                CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new((F + b) * 0.5, o, (C + B) * 0.5), Vector3.new(b, o, B))
                        end
                    end
                    local color2, x =
                        f.mode == "gather" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(185, 105, 255),
                        f.Reff or f.R
                    u(f.x, f.z, x, color2, 0.42, 0.26, config.orbitRingSegments or 24)
                    if f.Reff and f.Reff < f.R - 0.5 then
                        u(f.x, f.z, f.R, color2, 0.24, 0.76, config.orbitRingSegments or 24)
                    end
                    u(f.x, f.z, f.sr, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.25, 0.5, 24)
                    u(f.ax, f.az, f.ar, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60), 0.3, 0.25, 24)
                    r = A()
                    r.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 0.6)
                    r.Color = color2
                    r.Transparency = 0.1
                    r.CFrame = CFrame.new(f.x, o + 2, f.z)
                end
            end
            for index2 = #orbParts, n + 1, -1 do
                local part = orbParts[index2]
                if part and part.Parent then part.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end
        context.DEV_VIS_KEYS = {
            "visuals",
            "showHitboxes",
            "labelHazards",
            "labelUnknown",
            "drawAbility",
            "drawAoe",
            "drawAoeScan",
            "drawBubble",
            "drawGroups",
            "drawHazards",
            "drawLeads",
            "drawNoGo",
            "drawPath",
            "drawScan",
            "drawSpots",
            "drawTarget",
            "drawWaypoints",
            "drawMissileLines",
            "drawBlueRails",
            "drawBlueBeams",
            "drawProjected",
            "drawLanding",
            "groupOrbs",
            "groupNumbers",
            "aoeMarker",
            "ghostDraw",
            "drawFanBeam",
            "drawOrbit",
        }
        context.DEV_VIS_FILE = "HarvardLabs/data/devvis.json"
        local function P()
            if context.devPrefs then
                return context.devPrefs
            end
            local contextDevPrefs = {}
            pcall(function()
                local Z = isfile and isfile(context.DEV_VIS_FILE)
                if Z then
                    local Z = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(context.DEV_VIS_FILE))
                    local n = type(Z) == "table"
                    if n then
                        contextDevPrefs = Z
                    end
                end
            end)
            context.devPrefs = contextDevPrefs
            return contextDevPrefs
        end
        local u = P()._on
        context.devVisOn = (if u == nil then context.DEV else u) == true
        if not context.devVisOn then
            context.NOVIS = true
        end
        context.devVisApply = function(u)
            if not context.devVisOn then
                return
            end
            context.NOVIS = false
            context.devSaved = context.devSaved or {}
            for index, key in ipairs(context.DEV_VIS_KEYS) do
                if u or context.devSaved[key] == nil then
                    context.devSaved[key] = {
                        v = config[key],
                    }
                end
                config[key] = true
            end
        end
        context.devVisSet = function(u, Z)
            config[u] = Z == true
            if u == "visuals" and Z ~= true and context.clearDrawing then
                pcall(context.clearDrawing)
            end
        end
        context.devVis = function(u)
            context.devVisOn = u ~= false
            if context.devVisOn then
                context.devVisApply(false)
            else
                for key, entry in pairs(context.devSaved or {}) do
                    config[key] = entry.v
                end
                context.devSaved = nil
                context.NOVIS = true
                if context.clearDrawing then
                    pcall(context.clearDrawing)
                end
            end
            local u = P()
            u._on = context.devVisOn
            pcall(function()
                if context.ensureFolders then
                    context.ensureFolders()
                end
                writefile(context.DEV_VIS_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(u))
            end)
            return context.devVisOn
        end
        if context.devVisOn then
            pcall(context.devVisApply, true)
        end
        local function contextDrawTick(u)
            if u - _.lastDraw < (config.devVisualInterval or 0.09) then
                return
            end
            _.lastDraw = u
            if context.NOVIS or config.visuals == false then
                if _.folder or _.mlFolder or _.orbFolder or _.aoeFolder then
                    context.clearDrawing()
                end
                return
            end
            if u - (_.lastDecorDraw or -math.huge) >= (config.devDecorInterval or 0.19) then
                _.lastDecorDraw = u
                pcall(p)
                pcall(j)
                pcall(U)
                pcall(contextDrawMissileLines)
                pcall(w)
                pcall(v)
                pcall(Y)
                pcall(M)
            end
            if u - _.lastSweep > 8 then
                _.lastSweep = u
                for index, child in ipairs(contextVisualRoot():GetChildren()) do
                    if
                        child.Name ~= "Hazards"
                        and child.Name ~= "streamer"
                        and child.Name ~= "GroupOrbs"
                        and child.Name ~= "AoEMarker"
                        and child.Name ~= "MissileLines"
                    then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                if _.folder and _.folder.Parent then
                    local D = {}
                    for key, part in pairs(_.parts) do
                        D[part] = true
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(_.freeHazards) do
                        D[part] = true
                    end
                    -- All pooled decorator meshes live in Hazards as well: never sweep them
                    -- as "orphans" or they will blink out every few seconds.
                    for _, bucket in ipairs({_.nodes, _.spots, _.scan, _.ring, _.groups, _.tags, _.wallTags}) do
                        for _, part in pairs(bucket) do
                            if part then D[part] = true end
                        end
                    end
                    if _.target then D[_.target] = true end
                    if _.aoe then D[_.aoe] = true end
                    local orphans = _.orphans or {}
                    for index2, child2 in ipairs(_.folder:GetChildren()) do
                        if not D[child2] then
                            orphans[#orphans + 1] = child2
                        end
                    end
                    _.orphans = orphans
                    _.orphanPeak = #orphans
                end
            end
            if _.orphans and #_.orphans > 0 then
                for index3 = 1, config.drawSweepPerTick or 12, 1 do
                    index3 = table.remove(_.orphans)
                    if not index3 then
                        break
                    end
                    if index3.Parent then
                        index3:Destroy()
                    end
                end
            end
            local D, D, success = context.character()
            local vector, j, U = success and success.Position, _.seenHazards or {}, 0
            table.clear(j)
            _.seenHazards = j
            if config.drawHazards then
                success = contextHazards(u, _.list)
                local candidates = _.candidates
                table.clear(candidates)
                local maxBoxes = config.drawMaxBoxes or 70
                for _, hazard in ipairs(success or {}) do
                    local hx = hazard.moving and hazard.ox or hazard.cx
                    local hz = hazard.moving and hazard.oz or hazard.cz
                    if hazard.untilAt and u <= hazard.untilAt + 0.05
                        and not hazard.noDraw
                        and (not hazard.noGo or config.drawNoGo ~= false)
                        and (not vector or hazard.drawAlways
                            or (hx and hz and (hx - vector.X)^2 + (hz - vector.Z)^2 < 16900))
                    then
                        candidates[#candidates + 1] = hazard
                    end
                end
                if vector and config.drawNearestFirst ~= false and #candidates > maxBoxes then
                    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
                        local ax, az = a.moving and a.ox or a.cx or 0, a.moving and a.oz or a.cz or 0
                        local bx, bz = b.moving and b.ox or b.cx or 0, b.moving and b.oz or b.cz or 0
                        return (ax - vector.X)^2 + (az - vector.Z)^2
                            < (bx - vector.X)^2 + (bz - vector.Z)^2
                    end)
                end
                for index4, entry in ipairs(candidates) do
                    if U >= maxBoxes then break end
                    repeat
                        local S, Y = entry.moving and entry.ox or entry.cx, entry.moving and entry.oz or entry.cz
                        if
                            U < (config.drawMaxBoxes or 110)
                            and u <= (entry.untilAt or -math.huge) + 0.05
                            and (
                                not vector
                                or entry.drawAlways
                                or (S - vector.X) ^ 2 + (Y - vector.Z) ^ 2 < 16900
                            )
                        then
                            U += 1
                            index4 = _.parts[entry]
                            if not index4 or not index4.Parent then
                                index4 = V()
                                _.parts[entry] = index4
                            else
                            end
                            j[entry] = true
                            if entry.noGo and config.drawNoGo == false or entry.noDraw then
                                local S = _.parts[entry]
                                if S then
                                    S:Destroy()
                                    _.parts[entry] = nil
                                end
                                break
                            end
                            if
                                config.drawLeads == false
                                and string.lower(tostring(entry.name or "")):find("ahead", 1, true)
                            then
                                local S = _.parts[entry]
                                if S then
                                    S:Destroy()
                                    _.parts[entry] = nil
                                end
                                break
                            end
                            local S = entry.warn
                            S = if S == nil then not entry.moving and u < entry.from else S
                            local drawPlain = entry.drawPlain
                            if drawPlain == nil then
                                local Y = string.lower(tostring(entry.name or ""))
                                drawPlain = (
                                    Y:find("crisscross", 1, true)
                                    or Y:find("bigspike", 1, true)
                                    or Y:find("seeking", 1, true)
                                    or Y:find("thirdboss", 1, true) and Y:find("orb", 1, true)
                                )
                                        and true
                                    or false
                                entry.drawPlain = drawPlain
                            else
                            end
                            local Y, v = E(index4, S and not drawPlain), index4:FindFirstChild("sweep")
                            if drawPlain then
                                local sweep = index4:FindFirstChild("sweep")
                                if sweep then
                                    sweep:Destroy()
                                    v = nil
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                            local S = (
                                entry.slim and math.min(dangerGeometry.reach, entry.slim)
                                or dangerGeometry.reach
                            )
                                + (entry.slim and config.slimShoulder or config.dodgeShoulder)
                            if entry.moving then
                                local E = entry.offset + entry.speed * math.max(u - entry.pathStart, 0)
                                local M, Z, n =
                                    entry.ox + entry.dx * E,
                                    entry.oz + entry.dz * E,
                                    entry.ground and vector and vector.Y - 2.4 or entry.oy - entry.halfH + 0.6
                                index4.Shape, index4.Size =
                                    Enum.PartType.Block,
                                    Vector3.new(
                                        (entry.halfW - (entry.pad or 0)) * 2,
                                        1,
                                        (entry.halfL - (entry.pad or 0)) * 2
                                    )
                                index4.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                                    Vector3.new(M, n, Z),
                                    Vector3.new(M + entry.dx, n, Z + entry.dz)
                                )
                                if Y then
                                    Y.Shape, Y.Size =
                                        index4.Shape,
                                        Vector3.new(index4.Size.X + S * 2, index4.Size.Y, index4.Size.Z + S * 2)
                                end
                                if entry.r then
                                    index4.Shape, index4.Size =
                                        Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
                                        Vector3.new(
                                            1,
                                            (entry.r - (entry.pad or 0)) * 2,
                                            (entry.r - (entry.pad or 0)) * 2
                                        )
                                    index4.CFrame = CFrame.new(M, n, Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
                                    if Y then
                                        Y.Shape, Y.Size =
                                            index4.Shape,
                                            Vector3.new(1, index4.Size.Y + S * 2, index4.Size.Z + S * 2)
                                    end
                                end
                                if entry.kind == "part" or drawPlain or config.drawLeads == false then
                                    if v then
                                        v:Destroy()
                                    end
                                else
                                    v = v or (c(index4, "sweep", 0.88))
                                    E = math.min(
                                        math.max(entry.untilAt - u, 0),
                                        entry.horizon or config.laneHorizon
                                    )
                                    local V = math.max(math.min(entry.speed * E, 260), 1)
                                    local E = Vector3.new(
                                        M + entry.dx * (entry.halfL + V * 0.5),
                                        n,
                                        Z + entry.dz * (entry.halfL + V * 0.5)
                                    )
                                    v.Size, v.Color = Vector3.new(entry.halfW * 2, 0.4, V), config.colorSoon
                                    v.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(E, E + Vector3.new(entry.dx, 0, entry.dz))
                                end
                            else
                                local V, E = 0, 0
                                if entry.kind == "model" and context.BB and context.BB.velocityOf then
                                    V, E = context.BB.velocityOf(entry, u)
                                else
                                end
                                local M = math.sqrt(V * V + E * E)
                                if M > 2 and entry.cx and config.drawLeads ~= false then
                                    v = v or (c(index4, "sweep", 0.88))
                                    local Z, n, f, r =
                                        V / M,
                                        E / M,
                                        math.max(math.min(M * (config.bubbleTrajLead or 1.2), 260), 1),
                                        entry.r or math.min(entry.ha or 3, entry.hb or 3)
                                    local V, E =
                                        entry.r or math.max(
                                            math.abs(Z * (entry.ax or 0) + n * (entry.az or 0))
                                                    * (entry.ha or 0)
                                                + math.abs(Z * (entry.bx or 0) + n * (entry.bz or 0))
                                                    * (entry.hb or 0),
                                            1
                                        ),
                                        vector and vector.Y - 2.4 or entry.cy - (entry.hy or 1) + 0.6
                                    local M =
                                        Vector3.new(entry.cx + Z * (V + f * 0.5), E, entry.cz + n * (V + f * 0.5))
                                    v.Size, v.Color = Vector3.new(r * 2, 0.4, f), config.colorSoon
                                    v.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(M, M + Vector3.new(Z, 0, n))
                                elseif v then
                                    v:Destroy()
                                end
                                if entry.cyl then
                                    index4.Shape, index4.Size, index4.CFrame =
                                        Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
                                        Vector3.new(math.min(entry.size.X, 1.5), entry.size.Y, entry.size.Z),
                                        entry.cframe
                                    if Y then
                                        Y.Shape, Y.Size =
                                            index4.Shape,
                                            Vector3.new(
                                                index4.Size.X,
                                                index4.Size.Y + S * 2,
                                                index4.Size.Z + S * 2
                                            )
                                    end
                                elseif entry.round then
                                    index4.Shape, index4.Size, index4.CFrame =
                                        Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
                                        Vector3.new(0.6, entry.size.X, entry.size.X),
                                        CFrame.new(entry.cframe.Position) * CFrame.Angles(
                                            0,
                                            0,
                                            1.5707963267948966
                                        )
                                    if Y then
                                        Y.Shape, Y.Size =
                                            index4.Shape,
                                            Vector3.new(
                                                index4.Size.X,
                                                index4.Size.Y + S * 2,
                                                index4.Size.Z + S * 2
                                            )
                                    end
                                else
                                    index4.Shape, index4.Size, index4.CFrame =
                                        Enum.PartType.Block,
                                        Vector3.new(entry.size.X, math.min(entry.size.Y, 1.5), entry.size.Z),
                                        entry.cframe - Vector3.new(0, entry.size.Y * 0.5 - 0.8, 0)
                                    if Y then
                                        Y.Shape, Y.Size =
                                            index4.Shape,
                                            Vector3.new(
                                                index4.Size.X + S * 2,
                                                index4.Size.Y,
                                                index4.Size.Z + S * 2
                                            )
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if Y then
                                Y.CFrame = index4.CFrame
                            end
                            Y = string.lower(tostring(entry.name or ""))
                            S = entry.attack
                                    and not (Y:find("secondboss", 1, true) and Y:find("orb", 1, true))
                                    and context.attackColourNow()
                                or entry.drawColour
                                or (
                                    u >= entry.from and config.colorLive
                                    or (
                                        entry.from - u <= config.dodgeLead and config.colorSoon
                                        or config.colorFloor
                                    )
                                )
                            if index4.Color ~= S then
                                index4.Color, index4.edge.Color3 = S, S
                            end
                            index4.Transparency = entry.weight and 0.85 or config.hazardTransparency
                            S = index4.tag
                            S.Enabled = config.labelHazards
                            if S.Enabled then
                                local text, name = S.text, entry.name
                                local S, J =
                                    name or "?",
                                    u > entry.untilAt and "done"
                                        or (u >= entry.from and "live" or ("in %.1fs"):format(entry.from - u))
                                text.Text = ("%s  %s"):format(S, J)
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    until true
                end
            end
            for key2, part2 in pairs(_.parts) do
                if not j[key2] then
                    releaseHazard(key2)
                end
            end
            local S = 0
            local combatBrain = context.BR
            success, U = pcall(function()
                local E = config.drawPath and combatBrain.waypoints
                if E then
                    local iterateArray, waypoints = ipairs, combatBrain.waypoints
                    for key3, waypoint in iterateArray(waypoints) do
                        local J = key3 == combatBrain.index
                        S += 1
                        R(
                            _.nodes,
                            S,
                            J and Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 112) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 117, 53),
                            J and 2.2 or 1.1,
                            waypoint + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
                            J and 0.1 or 0.4
                        )
                    end
                end
                E = context.PB
                    and context.PB.boss
                    and tostring(context.PB.boss):lower():find("champion", 1, true) ~= nil
                E = config.drawWaypoints ~= false and config.champWaypoints and E
                if E then
                    local iterateArray2, champWaypoints = ipairs, config.champWaypoints
                    for key4, champWaypoint in iterateArray2(champWaypoints) do
                        for index5 = 0, 3, 1 do
                            S += 1
                            R(
                                _.nodes,
                                S,
                                Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90),
                                2,
                                Vector3.new(champWaypoint[1], champWaypoint[2] + index5 * 3, champWaypoint[3]),
                                0.25
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
                E = config.drawWaypoints ~= false
                    and context.waypointSets
                    and (
                        game:GetService("Workspace"):FindFirstChild("dungeon")
                        or game:GetService("Workspace"):FindFirstChild("Dungeon")
                    )

                    local V, J = context.waypointSets(), context.RT

                        J and J.preWalk and J.preWalk.active and J.preWalkPoint or nil, ipairs, V or {}
                    for key5, entry2 in iterateArray3(v) do
                        J = type(entry2) == "table"
                        if J then
                            V = entry2.group
                            key5 = type(V) == "table" and V[1] and V[3]
                            if key5 then
                                S += 1
                                R(
                                    _.nodes,
                                    S,
                                    Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0),
                                    3,
                                    Vector3.new(V[1], (V[2] or 0) + 3, V[3]),
                                    0.2
                                )
                            end
                            local iterateArray4, J = ipairs, entry2.points or {}
                            for key6, entry3 in iterateArray4(J) do
                                key6 = type(entry3) == "table" and entry3[1] and entry3[3]
                                if key6 then
                                    local Y = vector2 ~= nil
                                        and (vector2.X - entry3[1]) ^ 2 + (vector2.Z - entry3[3]) ^ 2 < 1
                                    local w = Y and 3 or 0
                                    for index6 = 0, w, 1 do
                                        S += 1
                                        R(
                                            _.nodes,
                                            S,
                                            Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
                                            Y and 2.2 or 2,
                                            Vector3.new(entry3[1], (entry3[2] or 0) + 1.2 + index6 * 3, entry3[3]),
                                            Y and 0.1 or 0.3
                                        )
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            iterateArray4, J =
                                ipairs, {
                                    {
                                        entry2.home,
                                        Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60),
                                    },
                                    {
                                        entry2.strike,
                                        Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 220),
                                    },
                                }
                            for key7, entry4 in iterateArray4(J) do
                                local V, J = entry4[1], entry4[2]
                                key7 = type(V) == "table" and V[1] and V[3]
                                if key7 then
                                    S += 1
                                    R(_.nodes, S, J, 2.5, Vector3.new(V[1], (V[2] or 0) + 1.2, V[3]), 0.2)
                                    entry4 = V[4] and V[5] and V[4] * V[4] + V[5] * V[5] > 0.01
                                    if entry4 then
                                        S += 1
                                        R(
                                            _.nodes,
                                            S,
                                            J,
                                            1.4,
                                            Vector3.new(V[1] + V[4] * 6, (V[2] or 0) + 1.2, V[3] + V[5] * 6),
                                            0.35
                                        )
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                y(_.nodes, S)
                S = 0
                E = config.drawSpots and dangerGeometry.origin
                if E then
                    local origin, dodgeMoveAt, iterateArray5, cands =
                        dangerGeometry.origin, config.dodgeMoveAt, ipairs, dangerGeometry.cands
                    for key8, cand in iterateArray5(cands) do
                        S += 1
                        local w, Y
                        if cand.blocked then
                            w, Y = (Color3.fromRGB(120, 122, 132)), 0.55
                        else
                            if cand.danger >= 0.999 or cand.endDanger >= 0.999 then
                                w, Y = config.colorLive, 0.2
                            else
                                if cand.padded then
                                    w, Y = (Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)), 0.2
                                else
                                    if cand.danger >= dodgeMoveAt or cand.endDanger >= dodgeMoveAt then
                                        w, Y = config.colorSoon, 0.2
                                    else
                                        if cand.safe then
                                            w, Y = config.colorFloor, 0.2
                                        else
                                            w, Y = config.colorFloor, 0.35
                                        end
                                    end

                            end

                        R(
                            _.spots,
                            S,
                            w,
                            1.2,
                            cand.valid and Vector3.new(cand.x, cand.y + 0.6, cand.z)
                                or Vector3.new(origin.X + cand.ox, origin.Y - 2.4, origin.Z + cand.oz),

                end
                y(_.spots, S)
                S = 0
                E = config.drawScan and context.BB and context.BB.scanNodes and vector
                if E then

                    for index7 = 1, E, 1 do
                        local w = context.BB.scanNodes[index7]
                        if w then

                            index7 = w.v == 0 and config.colorFloor
                                or w.v == 1 and config.colorSoon
                                or w.v == 2 and config.colorLive
                                or w.v == 4 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
                                or Color3.fromRGB(120, 122, 132)

                    E = context.BB.goal
                    local J = E and E.p
                    if J then
                        S += 1
                        R(_.scan, S, Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255), 2.4, Vector3.new(E.p.X, V + 0.6, E.p.Z), 0.1)

                end
                y(_.scan, S)

            if not success then
                context.RT.lastError, context.RT.lastErrorAt = "draw routing: " .. tostring(U), os.clock()
