            j = config.drawSpots
            if j then
                u, U = ipairs, dangerGeometry.cands
                for key9, entry5 in u(U) do
                    key9 = entry5.blocked and entry5.blocker and entry5.blocker.Parent and S < 8
                    if key9 then
                        S += 1
                        success = _.wallTags[S]
                        local R = not success or not success.Parent
                        if R then
                            success = q(l(), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
                            _.wallTags[S] = success
                        else
                        end
                        success.Adornee, success.Enabled, success.text.Text =
                            entry5.blocker, true, "wall: " .. entry5.blocker.Name
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            y(_.wallTags, S)
            S = 0
            j = config.labelUnknown and vector
            if j then
                u, success = ipairs, hazardReader.spawns
                for key10, entry6 in u(success) do
                    key10 = entry6.inst
                    entry6 = key10:IsA("BasePart") and key10
                        or (key10.PrimaryPart or key10:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
                    U = entry6 and entry6.Parent and (entry6.Position - vector).Magnitude < 80
                    if U then
                        S += 1
                        local E = _.tags[S]
                        local J = not E or not E.Parent
                        if J then
                            E = q(l(), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210))
                            _.tags[S] = E
                        else
                        end
                        E.Adornee = entry6
                        E.Enabled = true
                        J = ""
                        if key10:IsA("Model") then
                            local q = {}
                            for index8, child3 in ipairs(key10:GetChildren()) do
                                if child3:IsA("BasePart") and #q < 3 then
                                    q[#q + 1] = child3.Name
                                end

                        end
                        E.text.Text = ("? %s (%s)%s"):format(key10.Name, key10.ClassName, J)
                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            y(_.tags, S)
            S = 0
            success, U = context.BR.aim, config.drawAbility and vector
            if U then
                j = context.abilityReach and context.abilityReach()

                        hazardReader.abilityRange

                    if index9 then
                        local R, V, E =
                            q.ox + q.dx * q.speed * u,
                            q.oz + q.dz * q.speed * u,
                            q.r or math.max(q.ha or 3, q.hb or 3)
                        S = h(
                            _.ring,
                            S,
                            Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120),
                            Vector3.new(R, vector.Y, V),

                            0.45,
                            0.35

                    else
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            u = config.drawLanding ~= false
                and vector
                and context.aoeLanding
                and not (context.aoeShapeNow ~= nil and select(3, context.aoeShapeNow()) ~= nil)
            if u then
                U, j = context.aoeLanding()
                local R = context.character and select(3, context.character()) or nil
                local q = U and j and R
                if q then
                    local q = R.CFrame.LookVector
                    local R, V, E =
                        Vector3.new(q.X, 0, q.Z),
                        context.BR
                                and (context.BR.aim or context.BR.target and context.BR.target.root and context.BR.target.root.Parent and context.BR.target.root.Position)
                            or nil
                    if V then
                        local J, w = V.X - vector.X, V.Z - vector.Z
                        q = math.sqrt(J * J + w * w)
                        if q > 1 and q <= U + (config.faceWithin or 25) + 40 then
                            R, E =
                                Vector3.new(J / q, 0, w / q),
                                if context.RT and context.RT.aoeMode == "target" then math.min(U, q) else U
                        else
                            E = U
                        end
                    else
                        E = U
                    end
                    q = R.Magnitude > 0.01
                    if q then
                        R = R.Unit
                        V = Vector3.new(vector.X + R.X * E, vector.Y, vector.Z + R.Z * E)
                        S = h(_.ring, S, Color3.fromRGB(255, 211, 105), V, j, vector.Y - 2.3, 0.36, 0.48)
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
            j = config.drawHazards and hazardReader.zones
            if j then
                U, u = ipairs, hazardReader.zones
                for key11, entry7 in U(u) do
                    key11 = entry7.ring and entry7.r and entry7.cx and (entry7.untilAt or 0) > os.clock()
                    if key11 then
                        local R, V = Vector3.new(entry7.cx, 0, entry7.cz), config.ringDrawFill ~= false
                        if V then
                            local V = (entry7.cy or vector and vector.Y - 2.4 or 0) + (config.ringDrawLift or 4)

                                entry7.sz

                if m and not m.isBoss then
                    for index10, mobGroup in ipairs(hazardReader.mobGroups) do
                        u = math.sqrt((m.x - mobGroup.x) ^ 2 + (m.z - mobGroup.z) ^ 2)
                        if u < j then
                            j, R, q = u, mobGroup.x, mobGroup.z
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
                local iterateArray6, E = ipairs, hazardReader.mobGroups
                for key12, entry8 in iterateArray6(E) do
                    m = entry8.n >= 2
                    if m then
                        key12 = entry8.r + 8
                        S = h(
                            _.groups,
                            S,
                            Color3.fromRGB(195, 157, 70),
                            Vector3.new(entry8.x, 0, entry8.z),
                            key12,
                            (entry8.y or 0) - 2.4,
                            0.55,
                            0.3
                        )
                    else
                    end
                end
                if R then
                    E = config.groupZoneRadius or 70
                    S = h(
                        _.groups,
                        S,
                        Color3.fromRGB(235, 185, 78),
                        Vector3.new(R, 0, q),
                        E,
                        (vector and vector.Y or 0) - 2.4,
                        0.6,
                        0.25
                    )
                else
                end
            else
            end
            y(_.groups, S)
            u = hazardReader.aoeShape
            if config.drawAoe and vector and success and u then
                if not _.aoe or not _.aoe.Parent then
                    _.aoe = c(l(), "aoe", 0.7)
                    _.aoe.Color = config.colorAbility
                end
                U, j =
                    Vector3.new(success.X - vector.X, 0, success.Z - vector.Z),
                    Vector3.new(success.X, success.Y - 2.4, success.Z)
                if u.aoeRound then
                    _.aoe.Shape, _.aoe.Size = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.4, u.aoeX, u.aoeX)
                    _.aoe.CFrame = CFrame.new(j) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
                else
                    _.aoe.Shape, _.aoe.Size = Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(u.aoeX, 0.4, u.aoeZ)
                    _.aoe.CFrame = U.Magnitude > 0.5 and CFrame.lookAt(j, j + U.Unit) or CFrame.new(j)
                end
            elseif _.aoe then
                _.aoe:Destroy()
                _.aoe = nil
            end
            if config.drawTarget and dangerGeometry.target then
                local targetPoint = CFrame.new(dangerGeometry.target + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0))
                if not _.target or not _.target.Parent then
                    _.target = c(l(), "target", 0.2)
                    _.target.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    _.target.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 209, 106)
                    _.target.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
                    _.target.CFrame = targetPoint
                elseif (_.target.Position - targetPoint.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
                    _.target.CFrame = targetPoint
                else
                    _.target.CFrame = _.target.CFrame:Lerp(targetPoint, config.devTargetSmoothing or 0.55)
                end
            elseif _.target then
                _.target:Destroy()
                _.target = nil
            end
        end
        local function contextClearDrawing()
            if _.folder then
                _.folder:Destroy()
            end
            _.folder = nil
            _.target = nil
            _.aoe = nil
            if _.mlFolder then
                pcall(function()
                    _.mlFolder:Destroy()
                end)
                _.mlFolder = nil
            end
            for _, folderKey in ipairs({"orbFolder", "aoeFolder"}) do
                if _[folderKey] then
                    _[folderKey]:Destroy()
                    _[folderKey] = nil
                end
            end
            _.aoeMark = nil
            for _, key in ipairs({"mLines", "bLines", "bobRailParts", "orbParts", "orbs", "fanParts", "aoeScan",
                "parts", "freeHazards", "candidates", "seenHazards", "nodes", "spots",
                "scan", "ring", "groups", "tags", "wallTags", "orphans"}) do
                if type(_[key]) == "table" then
                    table.clear(_[key])
                end
            end
        end
        context.drawTick = contextDrawTick
        context.clearDrawing = contextClearDrawing
    end

        walls.mapWalls = function()
            local dungeonName = parent:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            if not (dungeonName and dungeonName:IsA("StringValue") and parent:FindFirstChild("dungeon")) then
                return nil
            end
            return u[dungeonName.Value], dungeonName.Value
        end
        walls.inWallsMap = function()
            return walls.mapWalls() ~= nil
        end
        local function u(h)
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            collectionService:AddTag(part, _)
            part.Name = name
            part.Anchored = true
            part.CanCollide = true
            part.CastShadow = false
            part.Material, part.Color = Enum.Material.ForceField, arenaColor()
            part.Size = Vector3.new(h[13], h[14], h[15])
            part.CFrame = CFrame.new(h[1], h[2], h[3], h[4], h[5], h[6], h[7], h[8], h[9], h[10], h[11], h[12])
            part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            part.Transparency = 0
            part.Parent = parent
            walls.parts[#walls.parts + 1] = part
            walls.built = walls.built + 1
            return part
        end

            dropMarker.CanTouch = false

            dropMarker.CFrame =

            walls.dropMarker = dropMarker
            return dropMarker
        end
        local function R(y)
            if not y then
                return 0
            end
            local q = 0
            local V = not pcall(function()
                local iterateArray, p = ipairs, vmHelpers[127](y:GetDescendants())
                for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(p)) do
                    key = entry:IsA("Humanoid")
                    if key then
                        local parent2 = entry.Parent
                        local E = parent2
                            and parent2 ~= y
                            and not (context.isOurs and context.isOurs(parent2))
                            and parent2 ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
                        if E then
                            local success = pcall(function()
                                parent2.Parent = parent
                            end)
                            if success then
                                q += 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if V then
                return q
            end
            return q
        end

        walls.buildLogos = function()
            -- In-place reloads adopt the walls, including untracked logos from older builds.
            -- Replace only our own logo parts so the current palette and animation own them.
            if walls.logoAnimConn then walls.logoAnimConn:Disconnect() end
            walls.logoAnimConn = nil
            local logoNames = {
                ObliterateProductionsLogo = true, ObliterateProductionsLogo2 = true,
                ObliterateProductionsLogoO = true, ObliterateProductionsLogoO2 = true,
            }
            for _, part in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and logoNames[part.Name] then part:Destroy() end
            end
            walls.logoParts, walls.logoGroups = {}, {}
            if config.wallLogo ~= false then
                walls.logoParts = walls.logoParts or {}
                walls.logoGroups = {}
                -- Both legacy wall marks were hard-coded H-shaped 3D voxel meshes.
                -- Rebuild the footprint of each mesh as a true extruded letter O.
                -- Using the old anchor/orientation keeps the two logos in-place.
                local function makeLetterO(source, worldName, tileSize, depth)
                    if type(source) ~= "table" or #source == 0 then
                        return
                    end
                    local first = source[1]
                    local basis = CFrame.new(
                        first[1], first[2], first[3],
                        0.260535, 0, -0.965464,
                        0, 1, 0,
                        0.965464, 0, 0.260535
                    )
                    local xMin, xMax = math.huge, -math.huge
                    local yMin, yMax = math.huge, -math.huge
                    for _, entry in ipairs(source) do
                        local lp = basis:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]))
                        xMin, xMax = math.min(xMin, lp.X), math.max(xMax, lp.X)
                        yMin, yMax = math.min(yMin, lp.Y), math.max(yMax, lp.Y)
                    end
                    local group = {}
                    local columns, rows = 16, 32
                    local stepX, stepY = (xMax - xMin) / (columns - 1), (yMax - yMin) / (rows - 1)
                    for row = 1, rows do
                        for column = 1, columns do
                            local nx = (column - (columns + 1) / 2) / (columns / 2)
                            local ny = (row - (rows + 1) / 2) / (rows / 2)
                            local outside = nx * nx + ny * ny
                            local inside = (nx / 0.56) ^ 2 + (ny / 0.71) ^ 2
                            if outside <= 0.99 and inside >= 1 then
                                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                                part.Name = worldName
                                part.Anchored = true
                                part.CanCollide = false
                                part.CanTouch = false
                                part.CanQuery = false
                                part.CastShadow = false
                                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                                part.Color = Color3.fromHex("87C8FF")
                                part.Size = Vector3.new(math.min(stepX * 0.98, tileSize), math.min(stepY * 0.98, tileSize), depth)
                                part.CFrame = basis * CFrame.new(xMin + (column - 1) * stepX, yMin + (row - 1) * stepY, 0)
                                part.Parent = parent
                                walls.logoParts[#walls.logoParts + 1] = part
                                group[#group + 1] = part
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    walls.logoGroups[#walls.logoGroups + 1] = group
                end
                makeLetterO(y, "ObliterateProductionsLogoO", 1.625, 3.249998)
                makeLetterO(q, "ObliterateProductionsLogoO2", 1.3125, 2.625)
            end
            local y = config.logoAnim ~= false and walls.logoParts and #walls.logoParts > 0
            if y then
                local y = {}
                for index3, entry3 in
                    ipairs(walls.logoGroups or {
                        walls.logoParts,
                    })
                do
                    if #entry3 > 0 then
                        local rightVector, p, j, U, J =
                            entry3[1].CFrame.RightVector, math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge
                        J = -math.huge
                        for index4, entry4 in ipairs(entry3) do
                            index4 = entry4.Position.X * rightVector.X + entry4.Position.Z * rightVector.Z
                            p, j, U, J =
                                if index4 < p then index4 else p,
                                if index4 > j then index4 else j,
                                if entry4.Position.Y < U then entry4.Position.Y else U,
                                if entry4.Position.Y > J then entry4.Position.Y else J
                        end
                        local w, Y, v = math.max(j - p, 1), math.max(J - U, 1), {}
                        for index5, entry5 in ipairs(entry3) do
                            v[index5] = (
                                (entry5.Position.X * rightVector.X + entry5.Position.Z * rightVector.Z - p)
                                    / w
                                + (J - entry5.Position.Y) / Y
                            ) * 0.5
                        end
                        y[#y + 1] = {
                            parts = entry3,
                            us = v,
                        }
                    end
                end
                -- Migrate the old red/gold defaults, including values in saved configs.
                local darkHex = tostring(config.logoDark or "142D4A"):upper():gsub("#", "")
                local brightHex = tostring(config.logoRed or "87C8FF"):upper():gsub("#", "")
                if darkHex == "6E0000" or darkHex == "10100A" then darkHex = "142D4A" end
                if brightHex == "D50000" or brightHex == "E6BE56" or brightHex == "C9993E" then
                    brightHex = "87C8FF"
                end
                config.logoDark, config.logoRed = darkHex, brightHex
                local color = Color3.fromHex(darkHex)
                local color2, p = Color3.fromHex(brightHex), 0
                if walls.logoAnimConn then
                    pcall(function()
                        walls.logoAnimConn:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
                walls.logoAnimConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not walls.on then
                        return
                    end
                    local now = os.clock()
                    local U = now - p
                    if U < (config.logoAnimStep or 0.05) then
                        return
                    end
                    p = now
                    U = now * (config.logoAnimSpeed or 0.35)
                    for index6, entry6 in ipairs(y) do
                        for index7, part in ipairs(entry6.parts) do
                            if part.Parent then
                                index6 = (entry6.us[index7] * (config.logoAnimWidth or 1.4) - U) % 1
                                part.Color = color:Lerp(color2, 1 - math.abs(index6 * 2 - 1))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                walls.conns[#walls.conns + 1] = walls.logoAnimConn
            end
        end
        walls.inNorthernLands = function()
            local dungeonName = parent:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
            return dungeonName ~= nil
                and dungeonName:IsA("StringValue")
                and dungeonName.Value == "Northern Lands"
                and parent:FindFirstChild("dungeon") ~= nil
        end
        walls.build = function()
            if walls.on then
                return walls.built
            end
            local dropMarker, q = walls.mapWalls()
            if not dropMarker then
                context.log(
                    "Walls",
                    "not in Northern Lands: nothing rebuilt (the toggle stays on for the next run)"
                )
                return 0
            end
            local E = q == "Northern Lands"
            walls.on = true
            walls.built = 0
            walls.purged = 0
            walls.v2 = true
            walls.template = false
            do
                pcall(function()
                    parent.Terrain:Clear()
                end)
                local map = parent:FindFirstChild("Map")
                if map then
                    for index, descendant in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d[descendant.Name] then
                            pcall(function()
                                descendant.Parent = parent
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    local j = R(map)
                    if j > 0 then
                        context.log(
                            "Walls",
                            ("lifted %d living model(s) out of Map before taking it down"):format(j)
                        )
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        map:Destroy()
                    end)
                    walls.purged = walls.purged + 1
                    _G.DungeonAutofarmMapDown = game.JobId
                end
            end
            for index2, entry in ipairs(dropMarker) do
                u(entry)
            end
            if E then
                dropMarker = parent:FindFirstChild(h[1])
                if dropMarker and (dropMarker:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    dropMarker.Color = arenaColor()
                    dropMarker.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    walls.dropMarker = dropMarker
                else
                    m()
                end
            end
            if E and config.noLogos ~= true then
                walls.buildLogos()
            end
            if walls.v2 and E then
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(V) do
                    index3 = Instance.new("Part")
                    collectionService:AddTag(index3, _)
                    index3.Name = entry2[1]
                    index3.Anchored = true
                    index3.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    index3.CanCollide = false
                    index3.Transparency = 0
                    index3.Size, index3.Orientation, index3.Position =
                        Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(0, 45, 0), Vector3.new(entry2[2], entry2[3], entry2[4])
                    index3.Parent = parent
                    walls.parts[#walls.parts + 1] = index3
                end
            end
            if config.wallClearView then
                walls.fog = {
                    lighting.FogEnd,
                    lighting.FogStart,
                    lighting.Brightness,
                }
                pcall(function()
                    lighting.FogEnd = 100000
                    lighting.FogStart = 100000
                end)
            end
            if walls.v2 then
                walls.conns[#walls.conns + 1] = parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(y)
                    if not walls.on or y.Name ~= "Map" then
                        return
                    end
                    task.delay(1.5, function()
                        if not walls.on or not y.Parent then
                            return
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            for index4, descendant2 in ipairs(y:GetDescendants()) do
                                if d[descendant2.Name] then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        descendant2.Parent = parent
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                        local E = R(y)
                        if E > 0 then
                            context.log("Walls", ("lifted %d living model(s) out of the streamed Map"):format(E))
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            y:Destroy()
                        end)
                        walls.purged = walls.purged + 1
                        context.log("Walls", "the Map folder streamed back in: taken down again")
                    end)
                end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                local terrain = parent.Terrain
                terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
                terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
            end)
            do
                local now = os.clock()
                walls.conns[#walls.conns + 1] = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not walls.on then
                        return
                    end
                    local now2 = os.clock()
                    local p = now2 - now
                    if p < (config.terrainSweep or 2) then
                        return
                    end
                    now = now2
                    pcall(function()
                        parent.Terrain:Clear()
                    end)
                end)
            end
            context.RT.navHoldUntil = nil
            context.RD.navHoldUntil = os.clock() + (config.navHold or 2.5)
            context.log("Walls", ("%s: built %d walls, purged %d"):format(tostring(q), walls.built, walls.purged))
            return walls.built
        end
        walls.stop = function()
            walls.on = false
            for index, conn in ipairs(walls.conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            walls.conns = {}
            for index2, part in ipairs(walls.parts) do
                pcall(function()
                    part:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            walls.parts = {}
            if walls.dropMarker then
                pcall(function()
                    walls.dropMarker:Destroy()
                end)
                walls.dropMarker = nil
            end
            for index3, entry in ipairs(walls.logoParts or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    entry:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            walls.logoParts = {}
            walls.logoGroups = nil
            if walls.fog then
                pcall(function()
                    lighting.FogEnd, lighting.FogStart, lighting.Brightness =
                        walls.fog[1], walls.fog[2], walls.fog[3]
                end)
                walls.fog = nil
            end
            context.log("Walls", "removed - rejoin to get the real map back")
        end
        walls.set = function(S)
            if S then
                walls.build()
            else
                walls.stop()
            end
        end
        walls.detach = function()
            for index, conn in ipairs(walls.conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            walls.conns = {}
            if walls.logoAnimConn then
                pcall(function()
                    walls.logoAnimConn:Disconnect()
                end)
                walls.logoAnimConn = nil
            end
            walls.on = false
        end
        walls.adopt = function()
            if walls.on then
                return true
            end
            local dropMarker = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(V) do
                dropMarker[entry[1]] = true
            end
            local parts = {}
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(collectionService:GetTagged(_)) do
                if
                    entry2:IsA("BasePart")
                    and entry2.Parent == parent
                    and (entry2.Name == name or dropMarker[entry2.Name])
                then
                    parts[#parts + 1] = entry2
                end
            end
            if #parts == 0 then
                return false
            end
            local D, _ = walls.mapWalls()
            if not D then
                dropMarker = parent:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                if
                    dropMarker
                    and dropMarker:IsA("StringValue")
                    and dropMarker.Value ~= ""
                    and dropMarker.Value ~= "Northern Lands"
                then
                    return false
                end
                D = l
            else
            end
            walls.template = false
            walls.on, walls.v2, walls.parts, walls.built = true, true, parts, #parts
            if config.noLogos ~= true and config.wallLogo ~= false then
                walls.buildLogos()
            end
            dropMarker = {}
            for index3, part in ipairs(parts) do
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                if part.Name == name then
                    part.Color = arenaColor()
                    part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    dropMarker[#dropMarker + 1] = part.Position
                end
            end
            local P = 0
            for index4, entry3 in ipairs(type(D) == "table" and D or {}) do
                index4 = false
                for index5 = 1, #dropMarker, 1 do
                    local vector = dropMarker[index5]
                    if
                        math.abs(vector.X - entry3[1]) < 0.05
                        and math.abs(vector.Y - entry3[2]) < 0.05
                        and math.abs(vector.Z - entry3[3]) < 0.05
                    then
                        index4 = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not index4 then
                    u(entry3)
                    P += 1
                else
                end
            end
            if _ ~= "Aquatic Temple" then
                dropMarker = parent:FindFirstChild(h[1])
                if dropMarker and (dropMarker:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    dropMarker.Color = arenaColor()
                    dropMarker.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                    walls.dropMarker = dropMarker
                else
                    m()
                    P += 1
                end
            else
            end
            if P > 0 then
                context.log("Walls", ("built %d part(s) missing from the walls already standing"):format(P))
            end
            walls.conns[#walls.conns + 1] = parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(S)
                if not walls.on or S.Name ~= "Map" then
                    return
                end
                task.delay(1.5, function()
                    if not walls.on or not S.Parent then
                        return
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        for index6, descendant in ipairs(S:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d[descendant.Name] then
                                pcall(function()
                                    descendant.Parent = parent
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    R(S)
                    pcall(function()
                        S:Destroy()
                    end)
                    walls.purged = walls.purged + 1
                end)
            end)
            _ = not walls.template
            if _ then
                local now = os.clock()
                walls.conns[#walls.conns + 1] = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                    if not walls.on then
                        return
                    end
                    local now2 = os.clock()
                    local D = now2 - now
                    if D < (config.terrainSweep or 2) then
                        return
                    end
                    now = now2
                    pcall(function()
                        parent.Terrain:Clear()
                    end)
                end)
            end
            context.log("Walls", ("adopted %d walls already standing (in-place reload)"):format(#parts))
            return true
        end
        walls.removeLogos = function()
            if walls.logoAnimConn then
                pcall(function()
                    walls.logoAnimConn:Disconnect()
                end)
                walls.logoAnimConn = nil
            end
            for index, entry in ipairs(walls.logoParts or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    entry:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            walls.logoParts = {}
            walls.logoGroups = nil
            context.log("Walls", "logos removed")
        end
    end

    -- All-Time analytics: independent, versioned, per-account persistent lifetime history.
    -- Unlike DQSession_*, these counters are never expired by session gaps.
    components.allTimeAnalytics = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local player = context.LocalPlayer
        local runtime = context.RT
        local http = context.HttpService or game:GetService("HttpService")
        local path = "ObliterateProductions_AllTime_" .. tostring(player.UserId) .. ".json"
        local canSave = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function"
        local started = os.time()
        local function blank()
            return {
                version = 1, firstRecorded = started, lastRecorded = started,
                launches = 0, trackedSeconds = 0, farmSeconds = 0,
                runsStarted = 0, runsWon = 0, runsLost = 0, totalRunSeconds = 0,
                winningRunSeconds = 0, fastestWin = 0, longestRun = 0,
                currentStreak = 0, bestStreak = 0, mobs = 0, bosses = 0,
                deaths = 0, keyQ = 0, keyE = 0, damageTaken = 0,
                maxHit = 0, healthHealed = 0, distanceStuds = 0,
                drops = 0, rarity = {}, dungeon = {},
                goldGained = 0, gemsGained = 0, bestGoldRun = 0,
                rodinAttempts = 0, rodinWins = 0, rodinLosses = 0,
                rodinSeconds = 0, rodinBest = 0, rodinDeaths = 0, rodinDrops = 0,
                lastRun = nil,
            }
        end
        local data = blank()
        if canSave then
            pcall(function()
                if type(isfile) ~= "function" or isfile(path) then
                    local loaded = http:JSONDecode(readfile(path))
                    if type(loaded) == "table" and tonumber(loaded.version) == 1 then
                        for key, value in pairs(data) do
                            if type(value) == "number" and type(loaded[key]) == "number" then
                                data[key] = math.max(0, loaded[key])
                            elseif type(value) == "table" and type(loaded[key]) == "table" then
                                data[key] = loaded[key]
                            elseif key == "lastRun" and type(loaded[key]) == "table" then
                                data[key] = loaded[key]
                            end
                        end
                        if type(loaded.lastRun) == "table" then data.lastRun = loaded.lastRun end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        data.launches += 1
        local dirty = true
        local lastSave = 0
        local api
        local observedLootUids = {} -- deduplicate the regular-run / bonus-boss inventory snapshots
        local function save(force)
            if not canSave then return false end
            if not force and (not dirty or os.clock() - lastSave < 5) then return true end
            data.lastRecorded = os.time()
            local ok = pcall(function()
                writefile(path, http:JSONEncode(data))
            end)
            if ok then dirty = false lastSave = os.clock() end
            if api then api.persistent = ok end
            return ok
        end
        local function mark()
            dirty = true
        end
        local function positive(n)
            return math.max(0, tonumber(n) or 0)
        end
        local function runBucket(run)
            local key = tostring(run.dungeon or "Unknown") .. "  /  " .. tostring(run.difficulty or "Unknown")
            local b = data.dungeon[key]
            if type(b) ~= "table" then
                b = { started = 0, wins = 0, losses = 0, secs = 0,
                    best = 0, mobs = 0, bosses = 0, deaths = 0, drops = 0, last = 0 }
                data.dungeon[key] = b
            end
            return b
        end
        api = { data = data, file = path, persistent = canSave, save = save }
        context.ALLTIME = api
        function api.onStart(run)
            if not run or run._allTimeStarted then return end
            run._allTimeStarted = true
            data.runsStarted += 1
            local b = runBucket(run)
            b.started = positive(b.started) + 1
            mark()
            save()
        end
        function api.onKill(isBoss)
            local key = isBoss and "bosses" or "mobs"
            data[key] += 1
            local active = context.WH and context.WH.run
            if active then
                local b = runBucket(active)
                b[key] = positive(b[key]) + 1
            end
            mark()
        end
        function api.onDeath()
            data.deaths += 1
            local active = context.WH and context.WH.run
            if active then
                local b = runBucket(active)
                b.deaths = positive(b.deaths) + 1
            end
            mark()
            save()
        end
        function api.onRodinStart(rodin)
            if rodin and not rodin._allTimeStarted then
                rodin._allTimeStarted = true
                data.rodinAttempts += 1
                mark()
            end
        end
        function api.onRodinFinish(rodin, won, seconds)
            if rodin and rodin._allTimeFinished then return end
            if rodin then rodin._allTimeFinished = true end
            if won then data.rodinWins += 1 else data.rodinLosses += 1 end
            seconds = positive(seconds)
            data.rodinSeconds += seconds
            if won and (data.rodinBest == 0 or seconds < data.rodinBest) then
                data.rodinBest = seconds
            end
            mark()
            save(true)
        end
        function api.onRodinDeath()
            data.rodinDeaths += 1
            mark()
        end
        function api.onRodinLoot(items)
            if type(items) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                if type(item) == "table" then
                    data.rodinDrops += 1
                    local uid = item.uid or item.id or item.uniqueId
                    local already = uid and observedLootUids[tostring(uid)]
                    if uid then observedLootUids[tostring(uid)] = true end
                    if not already then
                        data.drops += 1
                        local rarity = tostring(item.rarity or "unknown"):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                        data.rarity[rarity] = positive(data.rarity[rarity]) + 1
                    end
                    mark()
                end
            end
            save()
        end
        function api.onCast(slot)
            if slot == "q" then data.keyQ += 1
            elseif slot == "e" then data.keyE += 1
            else return end
            mark()
        end
        local function currency(name)
            local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            local v = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name)
            return v and positive(v.Value) or nil
        end
        function api.onFinish(run, won, seconds)
            if not run or run._allTimeFinished then return end
            run._allTimeFinished = true
            if not run._allTimeStarted then api.onStart(run) end
            local b = runBucket(run)
            seconds = positive(seconds)
            data.totalRunSeconds += seconds
            data.longestRun = math.max(data.longestRun, seconds)
            b.secs = positive(b.secs) + seconds
            b.last = os.time()
            if won then
                data.runsWon += 1
                data.winningRunSeconds += seconds
                if data.fastestWin == 0 or seconds < data.fastestWin then data.fastestWin = seconds end
                if positive(b.best) == 0 or seconds < b.best then b.best = seconds end
                data.currentStreak += 1
                data.bestStreak = math.max(data.bestStreak, data.currentStreak)
                b.wins = positive(b.wins) + 1
            else
                data.runsLost += 1
                data.currentStreak = 0
                b.losses = positive(b.losses) + 1
            end
            local gold = currency("Gold")
            local gems = currency("Gems")
            local goldDelta = gold and gold - (tonumber(run.gold) or gold) or 0
            local gemsDelta = gems and gems - (tonumber(run.gems) or gems) or 0
            goldDelta, gemsDelta = math.max(0, goldDelta), math.max(0, gemsDelta)
            data.goldGained += goldDelta
            data.gemsGained += gemsDelta
            run._allTimeGoldAdded, run._allTimeGemsAdded = goldDelta, gemsDelta
            data.bestGoldRun = math.max(data.bestGoldRun, goldDelta)
            data.lastRun = { dungeon = tostring(run.dungeon or "Unknown"),
                difficulty = tostring(run.difficulty or "Unknown"),
                won = won == true, seconds = seconds, at = os.time(),
                deaths = positive(run.deaths), gold = goldDelta, gems = gemsDelta }
            mark()
            save(true)
        end
        function api.onLoot(run, items)
            if not run or type(items) ~= "table" then return end
            -- Rewards may arrive after the run completes; update the net snapshot once visible.
            local goldNow, gemsNow = currency("Gold"), currency("Gems")
            local goldNet = goldNow and math.max(0, goldNow - (tonumber(run.gold) or goldNow)) or 0
            local gemsNet = gemsNow and math.max(0, gemsNow - (tonumber(run.gems) or gemsNow)) or 0
            if goldNet > (run._allTimeGoldAdded or 0) then
                data.goldGained += goldNet - (run._allTimeGoldAdded or 0)
                run._allTimeGoldAdded = goldNet
                data.bestGoldRun = math.max(data.bestGoldRun, goldNet)
                if data.lastRun and data.lastRun.at and os.time()-data.lastRun.at < 90 then
                    data.lastRun.gold = goldNet
                end
                mark()
            end
            if gemsNet > (run._allTimeGemsAdded or 0) then
                data.gemsGained += gemsNet - (run._allTimeGemsAdded or 0)
                run._allTimeGemsAdded = gemsNet
                if data.lastRun and data.lastRun.at and os.time()-data.lastRun.at < 90 then
                    data.lastRun.gems = gemsNet
                end
                mark()
            end
            run._allTimeLootSeen = run._allTimeLootSeen or {}
            local b = runBucket(run)
            for index, item in ipairs(items) do
                if type(item) == "table" then
                    local uid = tostring(item.uid or item.id or item.uniqueId or "row_" .. tostring(index))
                    if not run._allTimeLootSeen[uid] then
                        run._allTimeLootSeen[uid] = true
                        local globalKey = item.uid or item.id or item.uniqueId
                        local already = globalKey and observedLootUids[tostring(globalKey)]
                        if globalKey then observedLootUids[tostring(globalKey)] = true end
                        if not already then
                            data.drops += 1
                            b.drops = positive(b.drops) + 1
                            local rarity = tostring(item.rarity or "Unknown"):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                            if rarity == "" then rarity = "unknown" end
                            data.rarity[rarity] = positive(data.rarity[rarity]) + 1
                            mark()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            save()
        end
        function api.reset()
            data = blank()
            data.launches = 1
            api.data = data
            dirty = true
            return save(true)
        end
        local previousRoot
        local lastPosition
        local lastHealth
        local healthConnection
        local function bindCharacter(char)
            if healthConnection then healthConnection:Disconnect() healthConnection = nil end
            lastHealth = nil
            lastPosition = nil
            previousRoot = nil
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not hum or runtime.destroyed then return end
            lastHealth = hum.Health
            healthConnection = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
                if lastHealth ~= nil then
                    if h < lastHealth then
                        local delta = lastHealth - h
                        data.damageTaken += delta
                        data.maxHit = math.max(data.maxHit, delta)
                        mark()
                    elseif h > lastHealth then
                        data.healthHealed += h - lastHealth
                        mark()
                    end
                end
                lastHealth = h
            end)
        end
        local characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
        task.spawn(function()
            bindCharacter(player.Character)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            local lastTick = os.clock()
            while not runtime.destroyed do
                task.wait(1)
                local now = os.clock()
                local delta = math.clamp(now - lastTick, 0, 3)
                lastTick = now
                data.trackedSeconds += delta
                if runtime.farmEnabled then data.farmSeconds += delta end
                local char = player.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root and root == previousRoot and lastPosition then
                    local moved = (root.Position - lastPosition).Magnitude
                    if moved < 65 * delta then data.distanceStuds += moved end
                end
                previousRoot = root
                lastPosition = root and root.Position or nil
                dirty = true
                if now - lastSave >= 20 then save(true) end
            end
            if healthConnection then healthConnection:Disconnect() end
            characterConnection:Disconnect()
            save(true)
        end)
        save(true)
    end

    components.statisticsWebhooks = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local S = context.HttpService or game:GetService("HttpService")
        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local P = context.ReplicatedStorage or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local webhooks = {
            wins = 0,
            losses = 0,
            run = nil,
            mobKills = 0,
            bossKills = 0,
            sessionStart = os.time(),
        }
        local l = "DQSession_" .. tostring(players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer.UserId or 0) .. ".json"
        local function c()
            pcall(function()
                if not writefile then
                    return
                end
                if webhooks.sessStart then
                    pcall(webhooks.sessStart, true)
                end
                writefile(
                    l,
                    S:JSONEncode({
                        wins = webhooks.wins,
                        losses = webhooks.losses,
                        mobKills = webhooks.mobKills,
                        bossKills = webhooks.bossKills,
                        at = os.time(),
                        start = webhooks.sessionStart,
                    })
                )
            end)
        end
        (function()
            local u, h = pcall(function()
                if not (isfile and readfile and isfile(l)) then
                    return nil
                end
                local m = vmHelpers[127](readfile(l))
                return S:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(m))
            end)
            if not (u and type(h) == "table") then
                return
            end
            u = tonumber(config.whSessionGap) or 21600
            if type(h.at) == "number" and os.time() - h.at > u then
                return
            end
            u = tonumber(h.start) or tonumber(h.at)
            if u and u <= os.time() then
                webhooks.sessionStart = u
            end
            local wins, losses, mobKills =
                tonumber(h.wins), tonumber(h.losses), tonumber(config.whSessionMax) or 5000
            if
                wins == nil
                or losses == nil
                or wins ~= math.floor(wins)
                or losses ~= math.floor(losses)
                or wins < 0
                or losses < 0
                or wins > mobKills
                or losses > mobKills
            then
                return
            end
            webhooks.wins = wins
            webhooks.losses = losses
            mobKills, u = tonumber(h.mobKills), tonumber(h.bossKills)
            if
                mobKills
                and u
                and mobKills >= 0
                and u >= 0
                and mobKills == math.floor(mobKills)
                and u == math.floor(u)
            then
                webhooks.mobKills = mobKills
                webhooks.bossKills = u
            end
        end)()
        context.WH = webhooks
        local l, u = "HarvardLabs/data/session_all.json", "HarvardLabs/data/sessionruns"
        local function h()
            return type(readfile) == "function"
                and type(writefile) == "function"
                and type(listfiles) == "function"
        end
        webhooks.sessStart = function(m)
            if not h() then
                return webhooks.sessionStart
            end
            local start = os.time()
            local y
            pcall(function()
                y = S:JSONDecode(readfile(l))
            end)
            local q = type(y) ~= "table"
                or not tonumber(y.start)
                or start - (tonumber(y.at) or 0) > (tonumber(config.whSessionGap) or 21600)
            if q then
                y = {
                    start = start,
                    at = start,
                }
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(writefile, l, S:JSONEncode(y))
                pcall(function()
                    local q = tostring(start) .. "_"
                    for index, entry in ipairs(listfiles(u)) do
                        if (tostring(entry):match("([^/\\]+)$") or ""):sub(1, #q) ~= q then
                            pcall(delfile, entry)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                local q = m and start - (tonumber(y.at) or 0) >= 30
                if q then
                    y.at = start
                    pcall(writefile, l, S:JSONEncode(y))
                end
            end
            webhooks.sessionStart = math.floor(tonumber(y.start) or start)
            return webhooks.sessionStart
        end
        webhooks.sessCount = function()
            if not h() then
                return webhooks.wins, webhooks.losses
            end
            local l, m = tostring(webhooks.sessStart(false)) .. "_", {}
            pcall(function()
                for index, entry in ipairs(listfiles(u)) do
                    index = tostring(entry):match("([^/\\]+)$") or ""
                    if index:sub(1, #l) == l then
                        local y, q = index:sub(#l + 1):match("^(.+)%.([wl])$")
                        if y then
                            if q == "w" then
                                m[y] = "w"
                            elseif not m[y] then
                                m[y] = "l"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local wins, losses = 0, 0
            for key, entry2 in pairs(m) do
                if entry2 == "w" then
                    wins = wins + 1
                else
                    losses = losses + 1
                end
            end
            webhooks.wins = wins
            webhooks.losses = losses
            return wins, losses
        end
        webhooks.sessMark = function(l)
            local success = false
            if h() then
                local h = webhooks.sessStart(true)
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                pcall(function()
                    if isfolder and makefolder and not isfolder(u) then
                        makefolder(u)
                    end
                end)
                local R = tostring(game.JobId or ""):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
                R = if R == "" then "solo" .. tostring(os.time()) else R
                success = pcall(writefile, ("%s/%d_%s.%s"):format(u, h, R, l and "w" or "l"), "1")
            else
            end
            if not success then
                if l then
                    webhooks.wins = webhooks.wins + 1
                else
                    webhooks.losses = webhooks.losses + 1
                end
                return
            end
            webhooks.sessCount()
        end
        pcall(webhooks.sessStart, true)
        pcall(webhooks.sessCount)
        task.spawn(function()
            while not (runtimeState and runtimeState.destroyed) do
                task.wait(300)
                pcall(webhooks.sessStart, true)
            end
        end)
        context.noteBossDeath = function(l)
            if l then
                webhooks.rodinDeathAt = os.clock()
            else
                webhooks.bossDeathAt = os.clock()
            end
        end
        webhooks.endAt = function(l, u)
            local now = os.clock()
            if l and u and l >= u and l <= now and now - l <= (tonumber(config.whEndWithin) or 30) then
                return l
            end
            return now
        end
        context.runStopAt = function(l)
            local u = webhooks.run
            if u and u.endedAt and u.at and l and math.abs(u.at - l) < 30 then
                return u.endedAt
            end
            local h = false
            pcall(function()
                local m = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
                local R = m and tostring(m.Value) == "bossKilled"
                if R then
                    h = true
                end
                m = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
                R = m and (m:FindFirstChild("bossRoom"))
                m = R and (R:FindFirstChild("dungeonFinished"))
                R = m and m.Value == true
                if R then
                    h = true
                end
            end)
            u = not h
            if u then
                return nil
            end
            return webhooks.endAt(webhooks.bossDeathAt, l)
        end
        webhooks.runSecs = function(l)
            if not l then
                return 0
            end
            local u = l.endedAt or os.clock()
            if config.whTimeAsHud == false then
                return math.floor(u - (l.at or u) + 0.5)
            end
            local h = l.hudAt or l.at or u
            return math.max(math.floor(u - h - (config.startCountdown or 5)), 0)
        end
        context.noteKillAll = function(l)
            if context.ALLTIME then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onKill, l == true) end
            if context.ST and context.ST.noteKill then
                pcall(context.ST.noteKill, l)
            end
            if l then
                webhooks.bossKills = (webhooks.bossKills or 0) + 1
            else
                webhooks.mobKills = (webhooks.mobKills or 0) + 1
            end
            if not webhooks.killSavePending then
                webhooks.killSavePending = true
                task.delay(2, function()
                    webhooks.killSavePending = false
                    pcall(c)
                end)
            end
        end
        local function l(url, body, contentType, method)
            local m = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or request
            if not m then
                return false, "this executor has no HTTP request function"
            end
            local success, y = pcall(m, {
                Url = url,
                Method = method or "POST",
                Headers = {
                    ["Content-Type"] = contentType or "application/json",
                },
                Body = body,
            })
            if not success then
                return false, tostring(y)
            end
            success = y.StatusCode or y.status_code or 0
            if success == 429 then
                body, m = pcall(function()
                    local u = y.Body or "{}"
                    return S:JSONDecode(u)
                end)
                return false,
                    "rate limited",
                    if body and type(m) == "table" and tonumber(m.retry_after) then tonumber(m.retry_after) else 1
            end
            if success < 200 or success >= 300 then
                return false, ("HTTP %d"):format(success)
            end
            return true, y
        end
        local function name()
            local h = tostring(config.webhookUser or "")
            if h:match("^%s*$") or h:lower() == "harvard labs" then
                return "obliterate productions"
            end
            return h
        end
