        -- Icy dispatch cards. Tracking stays in the event hooks; every send uses this renderer.
        local OBL_ICE, OBL_LOSS, OBL_RARE, OBL_WARN = 8898815, 16747660, 7262950, 16763502
        local OBL = { version = "ice-dispatch-v3", filename = "obliterate_ice.png" }
        OBL.brand64 = [==[]==]
        OBL.templates = {
            test = { "Webhook connected", "Connection check passed. Your next run will report here.", "CONNECTION / READY", 36 },
            start = { "Run started", "The party is moving in. Tracking this run from the first pull to extraction.", "MISSION / ACTIVE", 36 },
            win = { "Victory", "Dungeon secured. Here is what made it back.", "RESULT / VICTORY", 32 },
            loss = { "Defeat", "This attempt ended before extraction. The session stays on record.", "RESULT / DEFEAT", 31 },
            rodinWin = { "Rodin defeated", "Bonus encounter cleared. Additional rewards are listed below.", "BONUS / CLEARED", 36 },
            rodinLoss = { "Rodin attempt ended", "The bonus encounter ended without a clear. Main-run tracking continues.", "BONUS / FAILED", 31 },
            late = { "Additional drops", "A delayed delivery arrived after the run report. These are the extra drops.", "LOOT / LATE ARRIVAL", 36 },
            security = { "Queue paused", "An account outside the allowlist was detected. Review the watch details before resuming.", "WATCH / ATTENTION", 33 },
            dropRest = { "Waiting after a valuable drop", "A valuable reward triggered the configured waiting period.", "QUEUE / HOLDING", 35 },
            rest = { "Taking a break", "The party is taking its scheduled break. The return window is recorded below.", "PARTY / ON BREAK", 36 },
            save = { "New save started", "A new save has started. Progress tracking will follow the next climb.", "PROGRESS / RESET", 36 },
            notice = { "Farm update", "A new event was recorded by the farm.", "SYSTEM / UPDATE", 36 },
        }
        function OBL.clean(value)
            return tostring(value or ""):gsub("\27%[[%d;]*m", ""):gsub("`", ""):gsub("%*", ""):gsub("__", ""):gsub("\r", "")
        end
        function OBL.len(value) return utf8.len(value) or #value end
        function OBL.clip(value, limit)
            value = tostring(value or "")
            if limit <= 0 then return "" end
            local count = utf8.len(value)
            if count and count <= limit then return value end
            if not count then
                -- Some legacy loot builders use byte truncation. Repair incomplete UTF-8 tails.
                local _, bad = utf8.len(value)
                value = value:sub(1, (bad or 1) - 1)
                if OBL.len(value) <= limit then return value end
            end
            local cut = utf8.offset(value, math.max(1, limit - 2))
            return value:sub(1, (cut or #value + 1) - 1) .. "..."
        end
        function OBL.code(language, value, limit)
            return "```" .. language .. "\n" .. OBL.clip(OBL.clean(value), (limit or 900) - #language - 8) .. "\n```"
        end
        function OBL.event(embed)
            if embed.oblEvent and OBL.templates[embed.oblEvent] then return embed.oblEvent end
            local title = OBL.clean(embed.title):lower()
            local body = OBL.clean(embed.description):lower()
            if title == "test" or title:find("signal online", 1, true) then return "test" end
            if title:find("run started", 1, true) then return "start" end
            if title:find("late drops", 1, true) then return "late" end
            if body:find("rodin failed", 1, true) or title:find("rodin failed", 1, true) then return "rodinLoss" end
            if body:find("rodin cleared", 1, true) or title:find("rodin cleared", 1, true) then return "rodinWin" end
            if title:find("new save", 1, true) then return "save" end
            if title:find("waiting after a good drop", 1, true) then return "dropRest" end
            if title:find("detected", 1, true) then return "security" end
            if title:find("break", 1, true) then return "rest" end
            if title:find("defeat", 1, true) or title:find("failed", 1, true) or body:find("defeat", 1, true) then return "loss" end
            if title:find("victory", 1, true) or title:find("completed", 1, true) or body:find("victory", 1, true) then return "win" end
            return "notice"
        end
        OBL.fieldNames = {
            ["Best drop"] = "Best drop", ["Earned"] = "Earned this run",
            ["Session"] = "Session", ["Bag"] = "Inventory",
            ["Haul value"] = "Loot value", ["Session playtime"] = "Session playtime",
            ["Candy"] = "Event rewards", ["Candy, every account"] = "Party event rewards",
        }
        function OBL.render(payload)
            payload.username = name()
            payload.avatar_url = nil -- use the webhook's configured icy avatar
            local who = players.LocalPlayer
            local private = config.whHideName == true or (config.streamer == true and config.streamerName ~= false)
            local footer = "obliterate productions" .. (who and not private and " / " .. who.Name or "")
            local remaining, banner = 5500, false
            local embeds = {}
            for _, embed in ipairs(type(payload.embeds) == "table" and payload.embeds or {}) do
                if #embeds >= 10 or remaining < 650 then break end
                local event = OBL.event(embed)
                local style = OBL.templates[event]
                local oldTitle, oldDescription = OBL.clean(embed.title), OBL.clean(embed.description)
                local resume = oldDescription:match("(<t:%d+:[tTdDfFR]>)")
                if resume then oldDescription = oldDescription:gsub("<t:%d+:[tTdDfFR]>", "") end
                local contextText = embed.oblContext or oldTitle:gsub("^[Vv]ictory%s*", ""):gsub("^[Dd]efeat%s*", ""):gsub("^[Ll]ate drops%s*", "")
                embed.title = style[1]
                if event == "win" or event == "loss" then
                    embed.title = (oldDescription:match("%d+ account") and "Party " or "") .. embed.title
                end
                local oldColor = embed.color
                embed.color = (event == "loss" or event == "rodinLoss") and OBL_LOSS
                    or event == "security" and OBL_WARN
                    or event == "dropRest" and OBL_RARE or OBL_ICE
                if config.whAccent ~= false and embed.color == OBL_ICE and event ~= "test" then
                    if embed.oblRare or oldColor == 16750848 or oldColor == 16726843 then embed.color = OBL_RARE end
                end
                local lines, inventory, loot = {}, {}, {}
                local rarityColors = { common = 37, uncommon = 32, rare = 34, epic = 35, legendary = 33, ultimate = 31 }
                local rarityAccents = { common = 8898815, uncommon = 2278750, rare = 3899638, epic = 11032054, legendary = 16750848, ultimate = 16726843 }
                local function ink(value, color)
                    return "\27[" .. tostring(color) .. "m" .. value .. "\27[0m"
                end
                local statColors = { Dungeon = 36, Run = 34, Earned = 33, Session = 32, Bag = 36, Max = 36, Roll = 35, Reports = 36 }
                local function row(label, value, color)
                    local shade = color or statColors[label] or 37
                    value = OBL.clean(value):gsub("\n", " · ")
                    if value == "" then return end
                    local text, first = label .. ": " .. value, true
                    -- Bound visible line width before adding invisible ANSI color sequences.
                    while OBL.len(text) > 58 do
                        local offset = utf8.offset(text, 59) or #text + 1
                        local head = text:sub(1, offset - 1)
                        local cut = head:match("^.*()%s")
                        if not cut or cut < 20 then cut = offset end
                        local part = text:sub(1, cut - 1)
                        lines[#lines + 1] = ink(part, shade)
                        text = "  " .. text:sub(cut):gsub("^%s+", "")
                        first = false
                    end
                    if first and not color then
                        lines[#lines + 1] = ink(label .. ":", 36) .. " " .. ink(value, shade)
                    else lines[#lines + 1] = ink(text, shade) end
                end
                if event == "test" then
                    row("Status", "Connected and ready", 32)
                    row("Reports", "Run stats · drops · artwork")
                    banner = true
                    embed.image = { url = "attachment://" .. OBL.filename }
                    embed.thumbnail = nil
                else
                    contextText = OBL.clean(contextText):gsub("^[%s%p]+", ""):gsub("^·%s*", "")
                    if contextText ~= "" and contextText ~= oldDescription then row("Dungeon", OBL.clip(contextText, 200)) end
                    if oldDescription ~= "" and event ~= "start" then
                        local summary = oldDescription
                        if event == "win" or event == "loss" then
                            summary = summary:gsub("no deaths", "0 deaths"):gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("%s*·%s*", " · ")
                        end
                        row((event == "win" or event == "loss") and "Run" or "Status", OBL.clip(summary, 900))
                    elseif event == "start" and contextText == "" then row("Dungeon", oldDescription) end
                    if event == "save" then row("Save", oldTitle) end
                    if config.whImages == false then embed.image, embed.thumbnail = nil, nil end
                end
                local best
                for _, field in ipairs(embed.fields or {}) do
                    local label, raw = OBL.clean(field.name), OBL.clean(field.value)
                    local flat = raw:gsub("\n", " · ")
                    if label == "Best drop" then best = raw
                    elseif label == "Bag" then inventory[#inventory + 1] = "Bag " .. flat
                    elseif label == "Haul value" then inventory[#inventory + 1] = "Loot " .. flat
                    elseif label == "Session" then
                        flat = flat:gsub("(%d+) won%s+(%d+) lost", "%1W / %2L"):gsub(" win rate", " wins")
                        row("Session", flat)
                    elseif label == "Earned" then row("Earned", raw)
                    elseif label:lower():find("loot", 1, true) or label:lower():find("drop", 1, true) then
                        if config.whItems ~= false then
                            for line in raw:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
                                local rarity, drops = line:match("^(%a+)%s%s+(.+)$")
                                loot[#loot + 1] = {label = rarity or "Loot", value = drops or line, color = rarityColors[(rarity or ""):lower()]}
                            end
                        end
                    else row(OBL.fieldNames[label] or label, raw) end
                end
                if #inventory > 0 then row("Bag", table.concat(inventory, " · "):gsub("^Bag%s+", "")) end
                if best then
                    local first, rest = best:match("^([^\n]+)\n?(.*)$")
                    local rarity = (rest or ""):match("^(%a+)")
                    local key = (rarity or ""):lower()
                    row("Best", (first or best) .. (rarityColors[key] and (" (" .. rarity .. ")") or ""), rarityColors[key])
                    if rarityColors[key] then rest = rest:sub(#rarity + 1):gsub("^[%s·]+", "") end
                    if rest and rest ~= "" then
                        local roll = rest:match("Godpot%s+([%d%.]+%%)")
                        rest = rest:gsub("Godpot%s+[%d%.]+%%", ""):gsub(" at max", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                        if rest ~= "" then row("Max", rest) end
                        if roll then row("Roll", roll) end
                    end
                    if config.whAccent ~= false and rarityAccents[key] and event ~= "loss" and event ~= "rodinLoss" and event ~= "security" then
                        embed.color = rarityAccents[key]
                    end
                end
                for _, item in ipairs(loot) do row(item.label, item.value, item.color) end
                if #lines == 0 then row("Status", style[3]) end
                local overhead = OBL.len(embed.title) + OBL.len(footer) + 24
                local budget = math.min(3500, remaining - overhead - 100)
                local selected, used = {}, 12
                for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
                    if used + OBL.len(line) + 1 > budget - 25 then
                        selected[#selected + 1] = ink("... more items omitted", 30)
                        break
                    end
                    selected[#selected + 1] = line
                    used += OBL.len(line) + 1
                end
                local panel = "```ansi\n" .. table.concat(selected, "\n") .. "\n```"
                embed.description = panel .. (resume and ("\n**Resume** " .. resume) or "")
                embed.author = { name = "obliterate productions" }
                embed.footer = { text = footer }
                embed.fields = nil
                remaining -= overhead + OBL.len(embed.description)
                embed.oblColor, embed.oblRare, embed.oblEvent, embed.oblContext = nil, nil, nil, nil
                embeds[#embeds + 1] = embed
            end
            payload.embeds = embeds
            -- Preserve intentional drop pings; suppress role/everyone and incidental mentions.
            local ids, seen = {}, {}
            for id in tostring(payload.content or ""):gmatch("<@!?(%d+)>") do
                if not seen[id] and #ids < 100 then ids[#ids + 1] = id; seen[id] = true end
            end
            payload.allowed_mentions = { parse = {}, users = ids }
            payload.attachments = banner and { { id = 0, filename = OBL.filename, description = "Icy-blue obliterate O emblem" } } or nil
            return banner
        end
        function OBL.endpoint(url)
            local host = url:match("^https://([^/]+)/")
            if host ~= "discord.com" and host ~= "discordapp.com" and host ~= "canary.discord.com" and host ~= "ptb.discord.com" then return nil end
            return url:match("^(https://[^/]+/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+)")
                or url:match("^(https://[^/]+/api/v%d+/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+)")
        end
        function OBL.avatar(force)
            if config.webhook == false then return false, "webhook disabled" end
            local endpoint = OBL.endpoint(tostring(config.webhookUrl or ""))
            if not endpoint then return false, "not a Discord webhook URL" end
            local id = endpoint:match("/webhooks/(%d+)/")
            local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
            env.__ObliterateIcyProfiles = env.__ObliterateIcyProfiles or {}
            local profiles = env.__ObliterateIcyProfiles
            local state = profiles[id]
            local file = "HarvardLabs/data/ice_profile_" .. id .. ".json"
            if not state and not force then
                pcall(function() state = S:JSONDecode(readfile(file)) end)
                if type(state) ~= "table" then state = nil end
            end
            if state and state.version == OBL.version and not force then
                profiles[id] = state; OBL.avatarUrl = state.url; return true
            end
            if state and state.busy then return false, "avatar update pending" end
            if state and state.retryAt and state.retryAt > os.clock() and not force then return false, "avatar retry scheduled" end
            profiles[id] = { busy = true }
            local json = S:JSONEncode({ avatar = "data:image/png;base64," .. OBL.brand64 })
            for attempt = 1, 3 do
                local ok, response, retry = l(endpoint, json, "application/json", "PATCH")
                if ok then
                    local result
                    pcall(function() result = S:JSONDecode(response.Body or response.body or "{}") end)
                    local url = type(result) == "table" and result.avatar and ("https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/" .. id .. "/" .. result.avatar .. ".png") or nil
                    state = { version = OBL.version, url = url }
                    profiles[id] = state; OBL.avatarUrl = url
                    pcall(writefile, file, S:JSONEncode(state))
                    return true
                end
                if attempt < 3 then task.wait(retry or attempt) end
            end
            profiles[id] = { retryAt = os.clock() + 300 }
            return false, "Discord did not accept the avatar update"
        end
        function OBL.bytes()
            if OBL.binary then return OBL.binary end
            local alphabet, values, decoded = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", {}, {}
            for i = 1, #alphabet do values[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
            for i = 1, #OBL.brand64, 4 do
                local a, b, c, d = OBL.brand64:byte(i, i + 3)
                local n = values[a] * 262144 + values[b] * 4096 + (values[c] or 0) * 64 + (values[d] or 0)
                decoded[#decoded + 1] = c == 61 and string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
                    or d == 61 and string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256)
                    or string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256)
            end
            OBL.binary = table.concat(decoded)
            return OBL.binary
        end
        function OBL.multipart(json)
            local boundary = "----ObliterateIce" .. S:GenerateGUID(false):gsub("%-", "")
            local body = table.concat({
                "--", boundary, '\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="payload_json"\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n', json,
                "\r\n--", boundary, '\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="files[0]"; filename="', OBL.filename, '"\r\nContent-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n',
                OBL.bytes(), "\r\n--", boundary, "--\r\n",
            })
            return body, "multipart/form-data; boundary=" .. boundary
        end
        local function post(payload)
            local handle = { over = false, sent = false }
            local url = tostring(config.webhookUrl or "")
            if config.webhook == false or url == "" then handle.over = true; return handle end
            local ok, banner = pcall(OBL.render, payload)
            if not ok then
                handle.over = true
                if context.log then context.log("Webhook", "could not format the dispatch card") end
                return handle
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                -- Updating the webhook's default avatar needs no extra chat message or hosted image.
                OBL.avatar(false)
                if OBL.avatarUrl then payload.avatar_url = OBL.avatarUrl end
                local ok, body = pcall(S.JSONEncode, S, payload)
                if not ok then handle.over = true; return end
                local contentType = "application/json"
                if banner then body, contentType = OBL.multipart(body) end
                for attempt = 1, 3 do
                    local sent, err, retry = l(url, body, contentType)
                    if sent then handle.sent = true; break end
                    if attempt < 3 then task.wait(retry or attempt)
                    elseif context.log then context.log("Webhook", "dispatch failed after three attempts") end
                end
                handle.over = true
            end)
            return handle
        end

        local function v(M)
            local Z = string.lower(tostring(M or ""))
            Z = string.gsub(Z, "[^a-z0-9]", "")
            return (string.gsub(Z, "armour", "armor"))
        end
        local assetArtwork = {}
        local function M(Z, imageId)
            if config.whImages == false then return nil end
            local n = w[v(Z)]
            if n then
                return n:match("^https://") and n or "https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dungeonquestroblox/images/" .. n
            end
            local raw = tostring(imageId or "")
            local id = raw:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or raw:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or raw:match("^(%d+)$")
            if not id then return nil end
            if assetArtwork[id] then return assetArtwork[id] end
            local ok, url = pcall(function()
                local data = S:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet("https://thumbnails.roblox.com/v1/assets?assetIds=" .. id .. "&size=420x420&format=Png&isCircular=false"))
                local result = data.data and data.data[1]
                if result and result.state == "Completed" and type(result.imageUrl) == "string" and result.imageUrl:match("^https://") then
                    return result.imageUrl
                end
            end)
            if ok and url then assetArtwork[id] = url; return url end
            return nil
        end
        local function w(Z)
            if config.whImages == false then
                return nil
            end
            local n = Y[v(Z)]
            if not n then
                return nil
            end
            return n:match("^https://") and n or "https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/dungeonquestroblox/images/" .. n
        end
        webhooks.itemArtwork = M
        webhooks.dungeonArtwork = w
        local function Y(v)
            local Z, n, f = -1, -1
            for index, entry in ipairs(v or {}) do
                if
                    config.whBestSpells == true
                    or entry.cat ~= "abilities"
                    or (E[entry.rarity] or 0) >= (E[config.whBestSpellMin or "legendary"] or 5)
                then
                    local v, o = E[entry.rarity] or 0, tonumber(entry.sell) or 0
                    if v > Z or v == Z and o > n then
                        Z, n, f = v, o, entry
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return f
        end
        local v = {
            common = 9741752,
            uncommon = 2278750,
            rare = 3899638,
            epic = 11032054,
            legendary = 16750848,
            ultimate = 16726843,
        }
        local function Z(n, f)
            if not n then
                return color2
            end
            if config.whAccent ~= false and f and (E[f.rarity] or 0) >= (E.rare or 3) then
                return v[f.rarity] or y
            end
            return y
        end
        local function v(n, f)
            if not f then
                return
            end
            local url = M(f.name, f.imageId)
            if not url then
                return
            end
            if (E[f.rarity] or 0) >= (E.legendary or 5) then
                n.image = {
                    url = url,
                }
            else
                n.thumbnail = {
                    url = url,
                }
            end
        end
        local function M()
            return config.streamer == true and config.streamerName ~= false
        end
        local function n()
            return config.whHideName == true or M()
        end
        local function f(r, o)
            if n() or r.hidden then
                return ("Account %d"):format(o or 0)
            end
            return tostring(r.display or r.who)
        end
        local function r()
            local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
            return {
                name = localPlayer
                        and not n()
                        and ("%s (@%s)"):format(localPlayer.DisplayName, localPlayer.Name)
                    or "obliterate productions",
            }
        end
        local function o()
            local success, k = pcall(function()
                return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(os.time()):ToIsoDate()
            end)
            return success and k or nil
        end
        webhooks.runStats = function()
            if game.PlaceId == 77649408247578 then
                return nil
            end
            local success, k = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("TeleportService"):GetLocalPlayerTeleportData()
            end)
            return success and type(k) == "table" and type(k.dungeonStats) == "table" and k.dungeonStats or nil
        end
        webhooks.liveDungeon = function()
            for index, child in ipairs(game:GetService("Workspace"):GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "dungeonName" and child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value ~= "" then
                    return child.Value
                end
            end
            local A = config.tdDifficulty ~= false and webhooks.runStats() or nil
            if A and type(A.dungeonName) == "string" and A.dungeonName ~= "" then
                return A.dungeonName
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function liveDifficulty()
            local success, x = pcall(function()
                local a = P:FindFirstChild("aGame")
                local e = a and (a:FindFirstChild("mapName"))
                if not e then
                    return nil
                end
                a = e:FindFirstChild("difficulty")
                local N = a and tostring(a.Value) or ""
                if N == "" then
                    return nil
                end
                a = e:FindFirstChild("hardcore")
                if a and a.Value == true then
                    return N .. " (Hardcore)"
                end
                return N
            end)
            if success and x and x ~= "" then
                return x
            end
            if config.tdDifficulty ~= false then
                x, success = webhooks.runStats(), webhooks.liveDungeon()
                if
                    x
                    and type(x.difficulty) == "string"
                    and x.difficulty ~= ""
                    and success
                    and tostring(x.dungeonName) == success
                then
                    return x.difficulty .. ((x.isHardcore == true or x.hardcore == true) and " (Hardcore)" or "")
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        webhooks.liveDifficulty = liveDifficulty
        local function k(x)
            x = math.max(math.floor(x + 0.5), 0)
            local a, e, N = math.floor(x / 3600), math.floor(x / 60) % 60, x % 60
            if a > 0 then
                return ("%d:%02d:%02d"):format(a, e, N)
            end
            return ("%d:%02d"):format(e, N)
        end
        context.upgradeKey = function(name2, a, e, N, I)
            e, N, I = tonumber(e) or 0, tonumber(N) or 0, tonumber(I) or 0
            local F = string.lower(tostring(name2 or ""))
            if F:find("guardian", 1, true) and I > 0 then
                return "hp"
            end
            if F:find("mage", 1, true) and N > 0 then
                return "spell"
            end
            if F:find("warrior", 1, true) and e > 0 then
                return "phys"
            end
            if a ~= "pet" and context.GP and context.GP.primaryKey then
                local success, C = pcall(context.GP.primaryKey, {
                    name = name2,
                    physicalDamage = e > 0 and e or nil,
                    spellPower = N > 0 and N or nil,
                    health = I > 0 and I or nil,
                }, a)
                if success and C then
                    return C == "health" and "hp" or C == "spellPower" and "spell" or "phys"
                end
            end
            if e > 0 or N > 0 then
                return e >= N and "phys" or "spell"
            end
            return I > 0 and "hp" or nil
        end
        context.upgradeStatAfter = function(x, a)
            x, a = tonumber(x) or 0, math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(a) or 0))
            if context.GP and context.GP.maxPotential then
                local success, N = pcall(context.GP.maxPotential, x, a)
                if success and tonumber(N) then
                    return tonumber(N)
                end
            end
            return x + a * (config.upgradeStatStep or 10)
        end
        local x = {
            weapons = "weapon",
            helmets = "helmet",
            chests = "armor",
            pets = "pet",
        }
        local function contextItemFinalStats(e)
            if type(e) ~= "table" or e.upMax == nil then
                return nil
            end
            local N, I =
                {
                    phys = tonumber(e.phys) or 0,
                    spell = tonumber(e.spell) or 0,
                    hp = tonumber(e.hp) or 0,
                }, math.max(0, (tonumber(e.upMax) or 0) - (tonumber(e.cur) or 0))
            local F = context.upgradeKey(e.name, x[tostring(e.cat or "")], N.phys, N.spell, N.hp)
            if F and I > 0 then
                N[F] = context.upgradeStatAfter(N[F], I)
            end
            return N
        end
        context.itemFinalStats = contextItemFinalStats
        local x
        local e = {
            weapons = "weapon",
            helmets = "helmet",
            chests = "chest",
        }
        context.itemGodpot = function(N)
            local gearProfiles = context.GP
            if not (gearProfiles and gearProfiles.compute) or type(N) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            local F = e[tostring(N.cat or "")]
            if not F then
                return nil
            end
            local e, success, g = tonumber(N.phys) or 0, tonumber(N.spell) or 0, tonumber(N.hp) or 0
            local i = {
                name = N.name,
                rarity = N.rarity,
                physicalDamage = e > 0 and e or nil,
                spellPower = success > 0 and success or nil,
                health = g > 0 and g or nil,
                currentUpgrade = tonumber(N.cur) or 0,
                maxUpgrades = tonumber(N.upMax) or 0,
            }
            success, e = pcall(gearProfiles.compute, i, F)
            if success and type(e) == "number" then
                return e
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function e(N)
            local I = contextItemFinalStats(N)
            if not I or I.phys + I.spell + I.hp <= 0 then
                return ""
            end
            local a = {}
            if I.phys > 0 then
                a[#a + 1] = ("Phys `%s`"):format(x(I.phys))
            end
            if I.spell > 0 then
                a[#a + 1] = ("Spell `%s`"):format(x(I.spell))
            end
            if I.hp > 0 then
                a[#a + 1] = ("HP `%s`"):format(x(I.hp))
            end
            I = "\10" .. table.concat(a, "  ") .. " at max"
            if config.whGodpot ~= false then
                a = context.itemGodpot(N)
                I = if a then I .. ("  Godpot `%.1f%%`"):format(a) else I
            else
            end
            return I
        end
        local function contextSig3(N)
            local I = math.abs(N)
            if I >= 100 then
                return ("%.0f"):format(N)
            end
            if I >= 10 then
                return ("%.1f"):format(N)
            end
            return ("%.2f"):format(N)
        end
        context.sig3 = contextSig3
        x = function(N)
            N = tonumber(N) or 0
            local I = math.abs(N)
            if I >= 999500000000 then
                return contextSig3(N / 1000000000000) .. "t"
            end
            if I >= 999500000 then
                return contextSig3(N / 1000000000) .. "b"
            end
            if I >= 999500 then
                return contextSig3(N / 1000000) .. "m"
            end
            if I >= 999.5 then
                return contextSig3(N / 1000) .. "k"
            end
            return tostring(math.floor(N + 0.5))
        end
        local function a(N)
            N = tonumber(N) or 0
            if N >= 0 then
                return "+" .. x(N)
            end
            return "-" .. x(-N)
        end
        local function N(I)
            local F = players.LocalPlayer
            local C = F and (F:FindFirstChild("leaderstats"))
            F = C and (C:FindFirstChild(I))
            if F then
                return tonumber(F.Value)
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function I(F)
            local C = string.lower(tostring(F.rarity or ""))
            if E[C] then
                return C
            end
            C = string.lower(tostring(F.name or ""))
            for index, entry in ipairs(p) do
                if entry ~= "unknown" and string.find(C, entry, 1, true) then
                    return entry
                end
            end
            return "unknown"
        end
        local F, C, g = false, 0
        local function i()
            local b = g
            if b then
                local B = g
                return B
            end
            g = tonumber(config.whBagCap) or 0
            b = g <= 0
            if b then
                pcall(function()
                    local B = P:FindFirstChild("modules")
                    local G = B and (B:FindFirstChild("inventoryHelperFunctions"))
                    B = G and require(G)
                    G = type(B) == "table" and tonumber(B.MAX_INVENTORY_ITEMS)
                    if G then
                        g = tonumber(B.MAX_INVENTORY_ITEMS)
                    end
                end)
            end
            b = g <= 0
            if b then
                g = 300
            end
            b = g
            return b
        end
        local function g()
            local remotes = P:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            if remotes then
                return remotes:FindFirstChild("reloadInvy")
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function P()
            local b = g()
            if not b then
                return nil
            end
            local success, B = pcall(function()
                return b:InvokeServer()
            end)
            if not success or type(B) ~= "table" then
                return nil
            end
            local g, b = {}, 0
            for key, entry in pairs(B) do
                if type(entry) == "table" then
                    for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry) do
                        if type(entry2) == "table" and type(entry2.name) == "string" and entry2.name ~= "" then
                            b += 1
                            g[type(entry2.UniqueItemID) == "string" and entry2.UniqueItemID or tostring(key) .. "/" .. tostring(
                                key2
                            )] =
                                {
                                    name = entry2.name,
                                    imageId = entry2.imageId,
                                    rarity = I(entry2),
                                    cat = tostring(key),
                                    sell = tonumber(entry2.sellPrice) or 0,
                                    level = tonumber(entry2.levelReq) or 0,
                                    phys = tonumber(entry2.physicalPower or entry2.physicalDamage) or 0,
                                    spell = tonumber(entry2.spellPower) or 0,
                                    hp = tonumber(entry2.health) or 0,
                                    upMax = tonumber(entry2.maxUpgrades) or 0,
                                    cur = tonumber(entry2.currentUpgrade) or 0,
                                }
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            return g, b
        end
        local function I(g)
            local b = F and os.clock() - C < 15
            if b then
                return nil
            end
            b = nil
            b, F = os.clock(), true
            C = b
            local C, B
            local G = false
            task.spawn(function()
                C, B = P()
                F, G = false, true
            end)
            b = os.clock()
            while true do
                local P = not G and os.clock() - b < (g or 12)
                if not P then
                    break
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
            b, g = C, B
            return b, g
        end
        local function P(F, C)
            local g = {}
            if not (F and C) then
                return g
            end
            for key, entry in pairs(C) do
                if not F[key] then
                    entry.uid = key
                    g[#g + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return g
        end
        local function F(C, g)
            if #C == 0 then
                if (g or 0) > 0 then
                    return ("%d reward%s, but the inventory would not open - no names this run"):format(
                        g,
                        g == 1 and "" or "s"
                    )
                end
                return "nothing"
            end
            g = {}
            for index, entry in ipairs(C) do
                index = E[entry.rarity] and entry.rarity or "unknown"
                if not g[index] then
                    g[index] = {}
                end
                local G = g[index]
                G[#G + 1] = entry
            end
            C = {}
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(p) do
                index2 = g[entry2]
                if index2 then
                    table.sort(index2, function(p, g)
                        return p.name < g.name
                    end)
                    local p, g = {}, {}
                    for index3, entry3 in ipairs(index2) do
                        index3 = U[entry3.cat]
                        local b = index3 and ("%s *(%s)*"):format(entry3.name, index3) or entry3.name
                        if g[b] then
                            g[b] = g[b] + 1
                        else
                            g[b] = 1
                            p[#p + 1] = b
                        end
                    end
                    for index4, entry4 in ipairs(p) do
                        if g[entry4] > 1 then
                            p[index4] = entry4 .. " x" .. g[entry4]
                        end
                    end
                    C[#C + 1] = ("%s **%s** - %s"):format(
                        V[entry2] or V.unknown,
                        j[entry2] or entry2,
                        table.concat(p, ", ")
                    )
                end
            end
            local p, g = "", 0
            for index5, entry5 in ipairs(C) do
                if #p + #entry5 + 1 > 950 then
                    g = #C - index5 + 1
                    break
                end
                p = p == "" and entry5 or p .. "\10" .. entry5
            end
            return if g > 0 then p .. ("\10...and %d more line%s"):format(g, g == 1 and "" or "s") else p
        end
        local function p(C)
            local g = 0
            for index, entry in ipairs(C) do
                g += entry.sell or 0
            end
            return g
        end
        local function val3(g)
            if (E[g.rarity] or 0) < 4 then
                return false
            end
            local b = string.lower(tostring(g.name or ""))
            return string.find(b, "valhalla mage", 1, true) ~= nil
                or string.find(b, "valhalla warrior", 1, true) ~= nil
        end

                    g[#g + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            return g
        end
        local function g(b)
            local B, G, z =
                J[tostring(config.whPingMin or "off")] or 99, webhooks.pingIds(), config.whPingValT3 ~= false
            if B > 6 and not z or #G == 0 then
                return nil

                if (E[entry.rarity] or 0) >= B or z and val3(entry) then
                    index = {}
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(G) do
                        index[index2] = "<@" .. entry2 .. ">"
                    end
                    return table.concat(index, " ")
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        -- obliterate productions run summary: title "Victory / Defeat - dungeon", one line of run facts,
        -- a small grid (best drop, earned, session, bag) and the loot grouped by rarity.
        local OBL_RANK = { ultimate = 6, legendary = 5, epic = 4, rare = 3, uncommon = 2, common = 1 }
        local function oblRarityName(r)
            r = tostring(r or "unknown")
            return (j and j[r]) or (r:sub(1, 1):upper() .. r:sub(2))
        end
        local function oblLoot(items, cards)
            if #items == 0 then
                if (cards or 0) > 0 then
                    return ("%d reward%s - the inventory didn't open, so no names"):format(cards, cards == 1 and "" or "s")
                end
                return "nothing new"
            end
            local byRarity = {}
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                local r = OBL_RANK[item.rarity] and item.rarity or "unknown"
                byRarity[r] = byRarity[r] or {}
                local names = byRarity[r]
                local key = tostring(item.name)
                names[key] = (names[key] or 0) + 1
            end
            local lines = {}
            for _, r in ipairs({ "ultimate", "legendary", "epic", "rare", "uncommon", "common", "unknown" }) do
                local names = byRarity[r]
                if names then
                    local list = {}
                    for itemName, count in pairs(names) do
                        list[#list + 1] = count > 1 and (itemName .. " x" .. count) or itemName
                    end
                    table.sort(list)
                    local line = ("**%s**  %s"):format(oblRarityName(r), table.concat(list, ", "))
                    if #line > 300 then line = line:sub(1, 297) .. "..." end
                    lines[#lines + 1] = line
                end
            end
            local text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            if #text > 1000 then text = text:sub(1, 997) .. "..." end
            return text
        end
        local function R(run, won, items)
            local facts, fields = {}, {}
            local function field(fieldName, value, inline)
                if value == nil or value == "" then return end
                fields[#fields + 1] = { name = fieldName, value = tostring(value), inline = inline ~= false }
            end
            if config.whDungeon ~= false and run.difficulty and run.difficulty ~= "" then facts[#facts + 1] = run.difficulty end
            if config.whTime ~= false then facts[#facts + 1] = k(webhooks.runSecs(run)) end
            if config.whDeaths ~= false then
                facts[#facts + 1] = run.deaths == 0 and "no deaths" or ("%d death%s"):format(run.deaths, run.deaths == 1 and "" or "s")
            end
            local level = N("Level")
            if level and config.whLevel ~= false then facts[#facts + 1] = "Lv " .. tostring(level) end
            local best = Y(items)
            if config.whBest ~= false and best then
                field("Best drop", ("%s\n%s"):format(tostring(best.name), oblRarityName(best.rarity)) .. e(best))
            end
            if config.whGold ~= false then
                local gold, gems = N("Gold"), N("Gems")
                if gold or gems then
                    field("Earned", ("%s gold\n%s gems"):format(a((gold or run.gold) - run.gold), a((gems or run.gems) - run.gems)))
                end
            end
            if config.whWins ~= false then
                local total = webhooks.wins + webhooks.losses
                local session = ("%d won  %d lost"):format(webhooks.wins, webhooks.losses)
                if config.whRatio ~= false and total > 0 then
                    session = session .. ("\n%d%% win rate"):format(math.floor(webhooks.wins / total * 100 + 0.5))
                end
                field("Session", session)
            end
            if config.whInv ~= false and run.invTotal then field("Bag", ("%d / %d"):format(run.invTotal, i())) end
            if config.whWorth ~= false and #items > 0 then field("Haul value", x(p(items)) .. " gold") end
            local candy = E()
            if run.event and run.candy and candy then
                field("Candy", ("%s this run\n%s banked"):format(a(candy - run.candy), x(candy)))
            end
            if config.whItems ~= false then field(("Loot  (%d)"):format(#items), oblLoot(items, run.cards), false) end
            local rare = config.whAccent ~= false and best and (OBL_RANK[best.rarity] or 0) >= 5
            local payload = {
                embeds = { {
                    title = ("%s  \u{00B7}  %s"):format(won and "Victory" or "Defeat", config.whDungeon ~= false and tostring(run.dungeon or "Dungeon") or "Dungeon"),
                    description = table.concat(facts, "  \u{00B7}  "),
                    color = not won and OBL_LOSS or (rare and OBL_RARE or OBL_ICE),
                    oblColor = true,
                    oblRare = best and (OBL_RANK[best.rarity] or 0) >= 5,
                    fields = fields,
                    timestamp = o(),
                } },
            }
            v(payload.embeds[1], best)
            local ping = g(items)
            if ping then payload.content = ping end
            post(payload)
        end
        local function J(run, items)
            local best = Y(items)
            local fields = {}
            if config.whBest ~= false and best then
                fields[#fields + 1] = { name = "Best drop", value = ("%s\n%s"):format(tostring(best.name), oblRarityName(best.rarity)) .. e(best), inline = true }
            end
            if config.whItems ~= false then
                fields[#fields + 1] = { name = ("Loot  (%d)"):format(#items), value = oblLoot(items, 0), inline = false }
            end
            local payload = {
                embeds = { {
                    title = "Late drops  \u{00B7}  " .. (config.whDungeon ~= false and tostring(run.dungeon or "Dungeon") or "Dungeon"),
                    description = "Handed over after the run closed.",
                    color = config.whAccent ~= false and best and (OBL_RANK[best.rarity] or 0) >= 5 and OBL_RARE or OBL_ICE,
                    oblColor = true,
                    oblRare = best and (OBL_RANK[best.rarity] or 0) >= 5,
                    fields = fields,
                    timestamp = o(),
                } },
            }
            v(payload.embeds[1], best)
            local ping = g(items)
            if ping then payload.content = ping end
            post(payload)
        end
        local function C()
            return config.whMerge ~= false
                and type(writefile) == "function"
                and type(readfile) == "function"
                and type(listfiles) == "function"
                and type(delfile) == "function"
                and type(isfile) == "function"
        end
        webhooks.copyId = webhooks.copyId or S:GenerateGUID(false)
        webhooks.claimRun = function(b, B, G)
            if not C() then
                return true
            end
            local z = (tostring(B or "") .. tostring(G or "")):gsub("[^%w]", "")
            if z == "" then
                return true
            end
            local G = ("HarvardLabs/data/postmark_%s_%s.json"):format(tostring(b), string.sub(z, 1, 48))
            local function b()
                local success, s = pcall(function()
                    local T = vmHelpers[127](readfile(G))
                    return S:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(T))
                end)
                return success and type(s) == "table" and s or nil
            end
            B = b()
            if B and os.time() - (tonumber(B.at) or 0) < 7200 and (B.by ~= webhooks.copyId or B.sent) then
                return false
            end
            pcall(
                writefile,
                G,
                S:JSONEncode({
                    at = os.time(),
                    by = webhooks.copyId,
                })
            )
            task.wait(0.3)
            B = b()
            if B and B.by ~= webhooks.copyId then
                return false
            end
            pcall(
                writefile,
                G,
                S:JSONEncode({
                    at = os.time(),
                    by = webhooks.copyId,
                    sent = true,
                })
            )
            if os.clock() - (webhooks.markPruneAt or -math.huge) > 600 then
                webhooks.markPruneAt = os.clock()
                pcall(function()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(listfiles("HarvardLabs/data")) do
                        local G = tostring(entry)
                        if G:find("postmark_", 1, true) then
                            entry, index = pcall(function()
                                local z = vmHelpers[127](readfile(G))
                                return S:JSONDecode(vmHelpers:jB(z))
                            end)
                            if
                                not entry
                                or type(index) ~= "table"
                                or os.time() - (tonumber(index.at) or 0) > 7200
                            then
                                pcall(delfile, G)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return true
        end
        local function b(B, G, z)
            local s, T, W, K = {}, {}, 0, false
            for index = 1, #z, 1 do
                local H = z[index].d.event and tonumber(z[index].d.candy)
                if H then
                    W, K = W + H, true
                else
                end
            end
            for index2 = 1, #z, 1 do
                local H = z[index2].d
                local X = type(H.items) == "table" and H.items or {}
                for index3 = 1, #X, 1 do
                    s[#s + 1] = X[index3]
                end
                local dF, QF, LF = #T + 1, {}, f(H, index2)
                QF.name = ("%s  -  %d drop%s"):format(LF, #X, #X == 1 and "" or "s")
                QF.value = F(X, tonumber(H.cards) or 0)
                QF.inline = false
                T[dF] = QF
                if #X == 0 and tonumber(H.bag) and tonumber(H.bag) >= i() then
                    T[#T].value = ("nothing - bag full (%d/%d), drops are lost"):format(tonumber(H.bag), i())
                end
                if H.event and tonumber(H.candy) and #X == 0 then
                    local X, dF, LF, OF = #T, {}, f(H, index2), vmHelpers[127](a(tonumber(H.candy)))
                    dF.name = ("%s  -  %s candy"):format(LF, vmHelpers:jB(OF))
                    QF = vmHelpers[127](x(tonumber(H.candyTotal) or 0))
                    dF.value = ("%s banked"):format(vmHelpers:jB(QF))
                    dF.inline = true
                    T[X] = dF
                end
            end
            local content, fields = Y(s), {}
            if config.whBest ~= false and content then
                local X, dF =
                    #fields + 1, {
                        name = "Best drop",
                        inline = true,
                    }
                dF.value, fields[X] =
                    ("%s **%s**\10%s%s%s"):format(
                        V[content.rarity] or V.unknown,
                        tostring(content.name),
                        j[content.rarity] or "Unsorted",
                        U[content.cat] and " " .. U[content.cat] or "",
                        e(content)
                    ),
                    dF
            end
            if config.whWorth ~= false and #s > 0 then
                local X, dF = #fields + 1, {
                    name = "Haul value",
                }
                dF.value, dF.inline, fields[X] = "`" .. x(p(s)) .. "` gold", true, dF
            end
            for index4 = 1, #T, 1 do
                fields[#fields + 1] = T[index4]
            end
            if K then
                fields[#fields + 1] = {
                    name = "Candy, every account",
                    value = a(W),
                    inline = false,
                }
            end
            if config.whWins ~= false then
                local X, value =
                    (webhooks.wins or 0) + (webhooks.losses or 0),
                    ("%d W / %d L"):format(webhooks.wins or 0, webhooks.losses or 0)
                value = if config.whRatio ~= false and X > 0
                    then value .. ("   %d%%"):format(math.floor((webhooks.wins or 0) / X * 100 + 0.5))
                    else value
                fields[#fields + 1] = {
                    name = "Session",
                    value = value,
                    inline = true,
                }
            end
            T = B.dungeon
            local X = {
                title = if config.whDungeon ~= false
                        and B.difficulty
                        and B.difficulty ~= ""
                    then ("%s   %s"):format(B.dungeon, B.difficulty)
                    else T,
                description = ("**%s**%s   `%d account%s`   %s"):format(
                    G and "VICTORY" or "DEFEAT",
                    config.whTime ~= false and "   `" .. k(webhooks.runSecs(B)) .. "`" or "",
                    #z,
                    #z == 1 and "" or "s",
                    K and ("`%s candy in all`"):format(a(W)) or ("`%d drop%s`"):format(#s, #s == 1 and "" or "s")
                ),
                color = Z(G, content),
                fields = fields,
                footer = {
                    text = text,
                },
                timestamp = o(),
            }
            v(X, content)
            fields, content =
                {
                    username = name(),
                    embeds = {
                        X,
                    },
                }, g(s)
            if content then
                fields.content = content
            end
            post(fields)
        end
        local function B(G, won, success)
            if not C() then
                return false
            end
            local T = players.LocalPlayer
            local who = T and T.Name or nil
            if not who then
                return false
            end
            local items = {}
            for index = 1, #success, 1 do
                local H = success[index]
                items[index] = {
                    name = H.name,
                    imageId = H.imageId,
                    rarity = H.rarity,
                    cat = H.cat,
                    sell = H.sell,
                    level = H.level,
                    phys = H.phys,
                    spell = H.spell,
                    hp = H.hp,
                    upMax = H.upMax,
                    cur = H.cur,
                }
            end
            local t = {
                who = who,
                display = ("%s (@%s)"):format(T.DisplayName, who),
                hidden = n() or nil,
                won = won,
                job = game.JobId,
                dungeon = G.dungeon,
                difficulty = G.difficulty,
                cards = G.cards,
                at = os.time(),
                items = items,
                secs = webhooks.runSecs(G),
                deaths = G.deaths or 0,
                bag = G.invTotal,
                event = G.event,
                candy = G.candy and E() and E() - G.candy or nil,
                candyTotal = E(),
            }
            success, items = pcall(function()
                return S:JSONEncode(t)
            end)
            if not success then
                return false
            end
            success = "HarvardLabs/data/haul_" .. who .. ".json"
            if not pcall(writefile, success, items) then
                return false
            end
            local E, t = {
                [who] = true,
            }, 1
            for index2, entry in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                if entry ~= T then
                    items = context.AF and context.AF.presence and context.AF.presence(entry.Name, 60)
                    if items and items.job == game.JobId and not E[entry.Name] then
                        E[entry.Name] = true
                        t += 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if t < 2 then
                return false
            end
            items = who
            for entry2 in pairs(E) do
                items = if entry2 < items then entry2 else items
            end
            webhooks.pendingUntil = nil
            local t = tonumber(config.whMergeStale) or 240
            local function H()
                local X, dF = {}
                local QF, path, OF = {}, pcall(listfiles, "HarvardLabs/data")
                if not path or type(OF) ~= "table" then
                    return X, dF, QF
                end
                for index3 = 1, #OF, 1 do
                    path = tostring(OF[index3])
                    if path:find("haul_", 1, true) and path:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                        local success2, DF = pcall(readfile, path)
                        index3 = nil
                        if success2 then
                            local success3, PF = pcall(function()
                                return S:JSONDecode(DF)
                            end)
                            index3 = if success3
                                    and type(PF) == "table"
                                    and type(PF.who) == "string"
                                then PF
                                else index3
                        else
                        end
                        if index3 and index3.job and index3.job ~= game.JobId then
                        else
                            if index3 and os.time() - (tonumber(index3.at) or 0) <= t then
                                X[#X + 1] = {
                                    path = path,
                                    d = index3,
                                }
                                QF[index3.who] = true
                                dF = if dF == nil or index3.who < dF then index3.who else dF
                            else
                                if index3 then
                                    pcall(delfile, path)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return X, dF, QF
            end
            local function t(X)
                table.sort(X, function(dF, QF)
                    return dF.d.who < QF.d.who
                end)
                if webhooks.claimRun("party", game.JobId, G.dungeon) then
                    pcall(b, G, won, X)
                end
                for index3 = 1, #X, 1 do
                    pcall(delfile, X[index3].path)
                end
            end
            T = tonumber(config.whMergeMax) or 30
            if items ~= who then
                task.wait(T + (tonumber(config.whMergeGrace) or 8))
                local success4, z = pcall(isfile, success)
                if success4 and not z then
                    return true
                end
                z, success4 = H()
                if #z < 2 then
                    pcall(delfile, success)
                    return false
                end
                if success4 ~= who then
                    return true
                end
                t(z)
                return true
            end
            who, items = os.clock(), {}
            while true do
                task.wait(0.5)
                local success5, z = pcall(isfile, success)
                if success5 and not z then
                    return true
                end
                local G, X, X = H()
                z = true
                for entry3 in pairs(E) do
                    if not X[entry3] then
                        z = false
                        break
                    end
                end
                if z or os.clock() - who >= T then
                    items = G
                    break
                end
                items = G
            end
            if #items < 2 then
                pcall(delfile, success)
                return false
            end
            t(items)
            return true
        end
        local function E(G)
            local z, s, T, W, K, t, H, X = {}, {}, 0, 0, 0, 0
            for index = 1, #G, 1 do
                local QF = G[index].d
                local LF = type(QF.items) == "table" and QF.items or {}
                for index2 = 1, #LF, 1 do
                    z[#z + 1] = LF[index2]
                end
                local OF, SF, DF, PF = tonumber(QF.level), #s + 1, {}, f(QF, index)
                DF.name = ("%s%s  -  %d drop%s"):format(
                    PF,
                    OF and (("  -  Lv %d"):format(OF)) or "",
                    #LF,
                    #LF == 1 and "" or "s"
                )
                DF.value = F(LF, tonumber(QF.cards) or 0)
                DF.inline = false
                s[SF] = DF
                if #LF == 0 and tonumber(QF.bag) and tonumber(QF.bag) >= i() then
                    s[#s].value = ("nothing - bag full (%d/%d), drops are lost"):format(tonumber(QF.bag), i())
                end
                T += tonumber(QF.deaths) or 0
                W = math.max(W, tonumber(QF.clears) or 0)
                K += tonumber(QF.gold) or 0
                t += tonumber(QF.gems) or 0
                index, SF = tonumber(QF.fight), tonumber(QF.run)
                H = if index and (H == nil or index > H) then index else H
                PF = SF and (X == nil or SF > X)
                X = if PF then SF else X
            end
            local f, F = Y(z), {}
            if H then
                F[#F + 1] = ("`fight %s`"):format(k(H))
            end
            if config.whDeaths ~= false then
                F[#F + 1] = T <= 0 and "`no deaths`" or ("`%d death%s`"):format(T, T == 1 and "" or "s")
            end
            if X then
                F[#F + 1] = ("`run %s`"):format(k(X))
            end
            F[#F + 1] = ("`%d account%s`"):format(#G, #G == 1 and "" or "s")
            F[#F + 1] = ("`%d drop%s`"):format(#z, #z == 1 and "" or "s")
            local fields = {}
            if config.whBest ~= false and f then
                local i, T =
                    #fields + 1, {
                        name = "Best drop",
                        inline = true,
                    }
                T.value, fields[i] =
                    ("%s **%s**\10%s%s%s"):format(
                        V[f.rarity] or V.unknown,
                        tostring(f.name),
                        j[f.rarity] or "Unsorted",
                        U[f.cat] and " " .. U[f.cat] or "",
                        e(f)
                    ),
                    T
            end
            if config.whWorth ~= false and #z > 0 then
                local V, j = #fields + 1, {
                    name = "Haul value",
                }
                j.value, j.inline, fields[V] = "`" .. x(p(z)) .. "` gold", true, j
            end
            if config.whGold ~= false and (K ~= 0 or t ~= 0) then
                local V, p = #fields + 1, {
                    name = "Earned",
                }
                p.value, p.inline, fields[V] = ("%s gold\10%s gems"):format(a(K), a(t)), true, p
            end
            for index3 = 1, #s, 1 do
                fields[#fields + 1] = s[index3]
            end
            local V, content = #fields + 1, {
                name = "Session",
            }
            content.value, content.inline, fields[V] =
                ("%d Rodin clear%s"):format(W, W == 1 and "" or "s"), true, content
            content = G[1].d
            V = {
                title = if content.dungeon
                    then ("%s   %s   %s"):format(
                        "Odin Reincarnation",
                        tostring(content.dungeon),
                        tostring(content.difficulty or "")
                    )
                    else "Odin Reincarnation",
                description = "**RODIN CLEARED**" .. (#F > 0 and "   " .. table.concat(F, "   ") or ""),
                color = f and Z(true, f) or y,
                fields = fields,
                footer = {
                    text = text,
                },
                timestamp = o(),
            }
            v(V, f)
            F, content =
                {
                    username = name(),
                    embeds = {
                        V,
                    },
                }, g(z)
            if content then
                F.content = content
            end
            post(F)
        end
        webhooks.rodinMerge = function(V)
            if not C() then
                return false
            end
            local p = players.LocalPlayer
            local who = p and p.Name or nil
            if not who then
                return false
            end
            V.who = who
            V.display = ("%s (@%s)"):format(p.DisplayName, who)
            V.hidden = n() or nil
            V.at = os.time()
            V.job = game.JobId
            local success, path = pcall(function()
                return S:JSONEncode(V)
            end)
            if not success then
                return false
            end
            p = "HarvardLabs/data/rodin_" .. who .. ".json"
            if not pcall(writefile, p, path) then
                return false
            end
            task.wait(tonumber(config.whRodinMergeWait) or 4)
            success, path = pcall(isfile, p)
            if success and not path then
                return true
            end
            path, success = pcall(listfiles, "HarvardLabs/data")
            if not path or type(success) ~= "table" then
                pcall(delfile, p)
                return false
            end
            local V, v, Z = {}, tonumber(config.whMergeStale) or 240
            for index = 1, #success, 1 do
                path = tostring(success[index])
                if path:find("rodin_", 1, true) and path:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                    local success2, f = pcall(readfile, path)
                    index = nil
                    if success2 then
                        local success3, x = pcall(function()
                            return S:JSONDecode(f)
                        end)
                        index = if success3 and type(x) == "table" and type(x.who) == "string" then x else index
                    else
                    end
                    if index and index.job and index.job ~= game.JobId then
                    else
                        if index and os.time() - (tonumber(index.at) or 0) <= v then
                            V[#V + 1] = {
                                path = path,
                                d = index,
                            }
                            Z = if Z == nil or index.who < Z then index.who else Z
                        else
                            if index then
                                pcall(delfile, path)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if #V < 2 then
                pcall(delfile, p)
                return false
            end
            if Z ~= who then
                task.wait(tonumber(config.whMergeGrace) or 4)
                path, v = pcall(isfile, p)
                if not path or not v then
                    return true
                end
                pcall(delfile, p)
                return false
            end
            table.sort(V, function(p, j)
                return p.d.who < j.d.who
            end)
            for index2 = 1, #V, 1 do
                pcall(delfile, V[index2].path)
            end
            pcall(E, V)
            return true
        end
        webhooks.rodinRecover = function()
            if not C() or config.whRodin == false then
                return
            end
            local V = players.LocalPlayer
            local p = V and V.Name or nil
            if not p then
                return
            end
            V = "HarvardLabs/data/rodin_" .. p .. ".json"
            local success, success2 = pcall(isfile, V)
            if not (success and success2) then
                return
            end
            local function Y()
                local v, Z, n = {}
                local path, x = pcall(listfiles, "HarvardLabs/data")
                if not path or type(x) ~= "table" then
                    return v, Z, n
                end
                local a, e =
                    (tonumber(config.whRodinMergeWait) or 4) + (tonumber(config.whMergeGrace) or 4) + 3,
                    tonumber(config.whRodinRecoverMax) or 3600
                for index = 1, #x, 1 do
                    path = tostring(x[index])
                    if path:find("rodin_", 1, true) and path:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                        local success3, g = pcall(readfile, path)
                        index = nil
                        if success3 then
                            local success4, G = pcall(function()
                                return S:JSONDecode(g)
                            end)
                            index = if success4
                                    and type(G) == "table"
                                    and type(G.who) == "string"
                                then G
                                else index
                        else
                        end
                        success3 = index and os.time() - (tonumber(index.at) or 0) or nil
                        if not index or (success3 or math.huge) > e then
                            pcall(delfile, path)
                        else
                            if success3 >= a then
                                v[#v + 1] = {
                                    path = path,
                                    d = index,
                                }
                                Z, n =
                                    if Z == nil or index.who < Z then index.who else Z,
                                    if index.who == p then index else n
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return v, Z, n
            end
            local v, Z, n = Y()
            if not n or #v == 0 then

        local function flush1186(path)
            if not C() then
                return
            end
            task.wait(path or 0)
            path = players.LocalPlayer
            local h, m, y = path and path.Name or "?", pcall(listfiles, "HarvardLabs/data")
            if not m or type(y) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            m = {}
            for index = 1, #y, 1 do
                path = tostring(y[index])
                if path:find("lvl_", 1, true) and path:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                    local success, E = pcall(readfile, path)
                    local success2, j = false
                    if success then
                        success2, j = pcall(function()
                            return S:JSONDecode(E)
                        end)
                    else
                    end
                    if
                        success2
                        and type(j) == "table"
                        and type(j.who) == "string"
                        and os.time() - (tonumber(j.at) or 0)
                            <= (tonumber(config.wh1186Stale) or 900)
                    then
                        m[#m + 1] = {
                            path = path,
                            d = j,
                        }
                    else
                        pcall(delfile, path)
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(m, function(q, E)
                return (tonumber(q.d.at) or 0) < (tonumber(E.d.at) or 0)
            end)
            y, path = {}
            for index2, entry in ipairs(m) do
                index2 = tonumber(entry.d.at) or 0
                if
                    not path
                    or path.dungeon ~= tostring(entry.d.dungeon)
                    or path.job ~= tostring(entry.d.job)
                    or index2 - path.at0 > 30
                then
                    path = {
                        dungeon = tostring(entry.d.dungeon),
                        job = tostring(entry.d.job),
                        at0 = index2,
                        recs = {},
                    }
                    y[#y + 1] = path
                else
                end
                table.insert(path.recs, entry)
            end
            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(y) do
                y[index3] = entry2.recs
            end
            for key, entry3 in pairs(y) do
                table.sort(entry3, function(m, y)
                    return m.d.who < y.d.who
                end)
                if entry3[1].d.who == h then
                    if webhooks.claimRun("x186", entry3[1].d.job, entry3[1].d.dungeon) then
                        d(entry3)
                    else
                        context.log(
                            "Webhook",
                            ("1-186: %d record(s) of a run that was already posted - not posted again"):format(
                                #entry3
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    for index4 = 1, #entry3, 1 do
                        pcall(delfile, entry3[index4].path)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        webhooks.flush1186 = flush1186
        local function finish1186(h, m)
            local y = players.LocalPlayer
            local who, level, frac, j, cap = y and y.Name or "?", V()
            local V = {
                who = who,
                display = ("%s (@%s)"):format(y and y.DisplayName or who, who),
                level = level,
                frac = frac,
                p = j,
                cap = cap,
            }
            y, j =
                tostring,
                context.afRole and context.afRole() == "leech" and "alt" or context.afRole and context.afRole()
            V.role = y(j or config.role1186 or "carry")
            V.at = os.time()
            V.won = m and true or false
            V.job = game.JobId
            V.dungeon = h.dungeon
            V.difficulty = h.difficulty
            V.deaths = h.deaths or 0
            V.secs = webhooks.runSecs(h)
            if not C() then
                d({
                    {
                        d = V,
                    },
                })
                return
            end
            level, y = pcall(function()
                return S:JSONEncode(V)
            end)
            if not level or not pcall(writefile, "HarvardLabs/data/lvl_" .. who .. ".json", y) then
                d({
                    {
                        d = V,
                    },
                })
                return
            end
            flush1186(tonumber(config.wh1186Wait) or 1.5)
        end
        webhooks.finish1186 = finish1186
        local function flushHauls()
            if not C() then
                return
            end
            local h, m, y =
                players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer.Name or "?", pcall(listfiles, "HarvardLabs/data")
            if not m or type(y) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            m = {}
            for index = 1, #y, 1 do
                local path = tostring(y[index])
                if path:find("haul_", 1, true) and path:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                    local success, p = pcall(readfile, path)
                    local success2, U = false
                    if success then
                        success2, U = pcall(function()
                            return S:JSONDecode(p)
                        end)
                    else
                    end
                    if
                        success2
                        and type(U) == "table"
                        and type(U.who) == "string"
                        and os.time() - (tonumber(U.at) or 0)
                            <= (tonumber(config.whFlushStale) or 1800)
                    then
                        index = tostring(U.dungeon) .. "|" .. tostring(U.job)
                        m[index] = m[index] or {}
                        table.insert(m[index], {
                            path = path,
                            d = U,
                        })
                    elseif success2 and type(U) == "table" then
                        pcall(delfile, path)
                    end
                end
            end
            for key, entry in pairs(m) do
                table.sort(entry, function(m, E)
                    return m.d.who < E.d.who
                end)
                if entry[1].d.who == h then
                    y, key = entry[1].d, os.clock()
                    local h = {
