                        dungeon = y.dungeon,
                        difficulty = y.difficulty,
                        at = key - (tonumber(y.secs) or 0),
                        endedAt = key,
                        deaths = tonumber(y.deaths) or 0,
                        cards = tonumber(y.cards) or 0,
                        items = {},
                    }
                    if webhooks.claimRun("party", y.job, y.dungeon) then
                        if #entry >= 2 then
                            pcall(b, h, y.won ~= false, entry)
                        else
                            pcall(R, h, y.won ~= false, type(y.items) == "table" and y.items or {})
                        end
                    end
                    for index2 = 1, #entry, 1 do
                        pcall(delfile, entry[index2].path)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        webhooks.flushHauls = flushHauls
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(tonumber(config.whFlushWait) or 8)
            if not (context.is1186 and context.is1186()) then
                pcall(flushHauls)
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            if context.is1186 and context.is1186() then
                pcall(flush1186, tonumber(config.wh1186LoadWait) or 6)
            end
        end)
        webhooks.finish = function(d)
            local run = webhooks.run
            webhooks.run = nil
            if run and context.ALLTIME then
                pcall(context.ALLTIME.onFinish, run, d == true, webhooks.runSecs(run))
            end
            if not run then
                webhooks.pendingUntil = nil
                return
            end
            if context.is1186 and context.is1186() then
                webhooks.sessMark(d)
                c()
                task.spawn(finish1186, run, d)
                return
            end
            webhooks.sessMark(d)
            c()
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(tonumber(config.whGatherFor) or 3)
                local c, invTotal = I(12)
                local invTotal2 = P(run.base, c)
                if context.ALLTIME then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onLoot, run, invTotal2) end
                if invTotal then
                    run.invTotal = invTotal
                end
                if not B(run, d, invTotal2) then
                    if webhooks.claimRun("party", game.JobId, run.dungeon) then
                        R(run, d, invTotal2)
                    end
                    task.wait(1)
                    pcall(
                        delfile,
                        "HarvardLabs/data/haul_"
                            .. tostring(players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer.Name or "?")
                            .. ".json"
                    )
                end
                task.wait(1)
                webhooks.pendingUntil = nil
                if context.ST and context.ST.reportRun then
                    pcall(context.ST.reportRun, run, d, invTotal2)
                end
                if config.whLate == false or not c then
                    return
                end
                task.wait(tonumber(config.whLateAfter) or 30)
                invTotal, invTotal2 = I(12)
                if not invTotal then
                    return
                end
                if invTotal2 then
                    run.invTotal = invTotal2
                end
                invTotal2 = P(c, invTotal)
                if context.ALLTIME then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onLoot, run, invTotal2) end
                if #invTotal2 > 0 then
                    J(run, invTotal2)
                end
            end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local d, health = false
            local l, c, u, jobId, m, R = false, false, 0
            local y = 0
            local function q()
                local V = u > 0 and os.clock() - u > (tonumber(config.whVerdictAfter) or 20)
                return V
            end
            local function V()
                if not q() then
                    return false
                end
                local E = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
                local p = E and (E:FindFirstChild("bossRoom"))
                E = p and (p:FindFirstChild("dungeonFinished"))
                if E and E.Value == true then
                    return true
                end
                p = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
                if p and tostring(p.Value) == "bossKilled" then
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            local function E()
                local dungeonProgress = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
                local j = dungeonProgress and tostring(dungeonProgress.Value) or ""
                return j == "noLivesLeft" or j == "outOfTime"
            end
            local function p()
                if not q() then
                    return false
                end
                local q = players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local j = q and (q:FindFirstChild("timeLeftGui"))
                q = j and (j:FindFirstChild("Frame"))
                j = q and (q:FindFirstChild("time"))
                if j and j:IsA("TextLabel") and (j.Text == "00:00" or j.Text == "0:00") then
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end
            while not (runtimeState and runtimeState.destroyed) do
                task.wait(0.5)
                local success = pcall(function()
                    local dungeonName = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
                    local U, J =
                        workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonStarted"),
                        dungeonName ~= nil and tostring(dungeonName.Value) ~= ""
                    local w, Y = U ~= nil and U.Value == true, not J
                    if Y then
                        l, c = false, false
                    end
                    U, Y =
                        context.runComplete ~= nil and context.runComplete() == true,
                        workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
                    U = if Y and tostring(Y.Value) == "bossKilled" then true else U
                    local v, M = J and w and not d and not U
                    if v then
                        U = jobId
                        M = U ~= game.JobId
                    else
                        M = v
                    end
                    v = M and (not c and not l or l and not V())
                    if v then
                        M = nil
                        M, d = os.clock(), true
                        u, l = M, false
                        local u = liveDifficulty()
                        Y = not u
                        if Y then
                            pcall(function()
                                local Z = S:JSONDecode(
                                    readfile(
                                        context.AF
                                                and context.AF.partyFile
                                                and context.AF.partyFile("af_party")
                                            or "HarvardLabs/data/af_party.json"
                                    )
                                )
                                local S = Z
                                    and Z.map == tostring(dungeonName.Value)
                                    and os.time() - (tonumber(Z.at) or 0) < 3600
                                if S then
                                    u = Z.diff
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        U = not u and context.queuePick
                        if U then
                            local S
                            S, u = context.queuePick()
                        else
                        end
                        webhooks.start(
                            tostring(dungeonName.Value),
                            u or tostring(config.autoQueueDifficulty or "?")
                        )
                    else
                        local S = d
                        if S then
                            local S = context.runComplete ~= nil and context.runComplete() == true or V()
                            if S then
                                local jobId2
                                jobId2, d, l = game.JobId, false, true
                                jobId = jobId2
                                if webhooks.run and not webhooks.run.endedAt then
                                    webhooks.run.endedAt = webhooks.endAt(webhooks.bossDeathAt, webhooks.run.at)
                                end
                                if not (context.is1186 and context.is1186()) and config.webhook ~= false then
                                    webhooks.pendingUntil = os.clock() + (config.whReplayHold or 25)
                                end
                                task.spawn(function()
                                    local waitTask, u =
                                        task.wait,
                                        context.is1186 and context.is1186() and 0 or (config.whLootWait or 3)
                                    waitTask(u)
                                    webhooks.finish(true)
                                end)
                            else
                                local S = p() or not J or not w or E()
                                if S then
                                    d, l = false, true
                                    local S = p() or E() or context.runFailed and context.runFailed()
                                    if S then
                                        jobId = game.JobId
                                    end
                                    if webhooks.run and not webhooks.run.endedAt then
                                        webhooks.run.endedAt = os.clock()
                                    end
                                    webhooks.finish(false)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    c = w
                    v = workspace:FindFirstChild("bonusBossStatus")
                    M = v and tostring(v.Value or "") or ""
                    J = M ~= m
                    if J then
                        U = M == "active"
                        if U then
                            w, Y, v = os.clock(), webhooks.run
                            v, R = Y and webhooks.run.deaths or 0, w
                            y = v
                            pcall(webhooks.rodinBegin)
                        end
                        local Q = M == "success" and m == "active"
                        if Q then
                            pcall(webhooks.rodinClear, R, y)
                        end
                        Q = M:lower():find("fail", 1, true) and m == "active"
                        if Q then
                            pcall(webhooks.rodinFail, R, y)
                        end
                        m = M
                    end
                    U = players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer.Character
                    M, Y = U and (U:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), webhooks.rodin ~= nil and m == "active"
                    J = (d or Y) and M
                    if J then
                        w = health ~= nil
                            and M.Health <= 0
                            and health > 0
                            and not (
                                runtimeState.selfResetAt ~= nil
                                and os.clock() - runtimeState.selfResetAt
                                    < (config.whResetGrace or 5)
                            )
                        if w then
                            if Y then
                                webhooks.rodin.deaths = webhooks.rodin.deaths + 1
                                if context.ALLTIME then pcall(context.ALLTIME.onRodinDeath) end
                            else
                                v = d
                                if v then
                                    webhooks.death()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        health = M.Health
                    end
                end)
                if not success then
                    task.wait(2)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- obliterate productions: Legendary farm. Runs DQR's legacy dungeons on Nightmare and hunts
    -- each one's Warrior and Mage legendary (optionally T3 armor / ultimates). It only chooses the
    -- dungeon: context.AF.plan() is wrapped so harvard's party queue creates, starts, replays and
    -- moves on (afMoveOn when the plan no longer matches the live dungeon) exactly as usual.
    components.legendaryFarm = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
        local LOBBY_PLACE = 77649408247578
        local FILE = "obliterate_legfarm.json"
        local DIFFICULTY = "Nightmare"

        local DUNGEONS = {
            { name = "Desert Temple", level = 27, warrior = { "Desert Fury" }, mage = { "Desert Fury" } },
            { name = "Winter Outpost", level = 55, warrior = { "Crystalized Greatsword" }, mage = { "Crystalized Greatsword" } },
            { name = "Pirate Island", level = 65, warrior = { "Soulstealer Greatsword" }, mage = { "Staff of the Gods" } },
            { name = "King's Castle", level = 75, warrior = { "Beastmaster War Scythe" }, mage = { "Beastmaster Spell Scythe" } },
            { name = "The Underworld", level = 85, warrior = { "Dual Phoenix Daggers" }, mage = { "Phoenix Greatstaff" } },
            { name = "Samurai Palace", level = 95, warrior = { "Sakura Katana" }, mage = { "Sakura Greatstaff" } },
            { name = "The Canals", level = 105, warrior = { "Overlord's Rageblade" }, mage = { "Overlord's Manablade" } },
            { name = "Ghastly Harbor", level = 115, warrior = { "Kraken Slayer" }, mage = { "Sea Serpent's Wings" } },
            { name = "Steampunk Sewers", level = 125, warrior = { "Inventor's Greatsword" }, mage = { "Inventor's Spellblade" } },
            { name = "Orbital Outpost", level = 145, warrior = { "Galactic Dual Blades" }, mage = { "Galactic Pike" } },
            { name = "Volcanic Chambers", level = 155, warrior = { "Lava King's Warscythe" }, mage = { "Lava King's Spell Daggers" } },
            { name = "Aquatic Temple", level = 165, warrior = { "Sea King's Trident" }, mage = { "Sea King's Greatstaff" } },
            { name = "Enchanted Forest", level = 175, warrior = { "Eldenbark Greatsword" }, mage = { "Eldenbark Greatstaff" },
                ultimate = { warrior = { "Eden's Vengeance" }, mage = { "Eden's Reaper" } } },
            { name = "Northern Lands", level = 185, warrior = { "Mjolnir" }, mage = { "Gungnir" },
                ultimate = { warrior = { "Hofund" }, mage = { "Laevateinn", "Laevattein" } } },
        }
        local ARMOR = {
            ["Desert Temple"] = { label = "Red Knight / Templar / Guardian", perClass = { warrior = "redknight", mage = "templar", guardian = "guardian" } },
            ["Winter Outpost"] = { label = "Ice King's", family = "icekings" },
            ["Pirate Island"] = { label = "Godly", family = "godly" },
            ["King's Castle"] = { label = "Titan-forged", family = "titanforged" },
            ["The Underworld"] = { label = "Glorious", family = "glorious" },
            ["Samurai Palace"] = { label = "Ancestral", family = "ancestral" },
            ["The Canals"] = { label = "Overlord's", family = "overlords" },
            ["Ghastly Harbor"] = { label = "Mythical", family = "mythical" },
            ["Steampunk Sewers"] = { label = "War-forged", family = "warforged" },
            ["Orbital Outpost"] = { label = "Alien", family = "alien" },
            ["Volcanic Chambers"] = { label = "Lava King's", family = "lavakings" },
            ["Aquatic Temple"] = { label = "Triton", family = "triton" },
            ["Enchanted Forest"] = { label = "Eldenbark", family = "eldenbark" },
            ["Northern Lands"] = { label = "Valhalla", family = "valhalla" },
        }
        local RARITY_RANK = { common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, epic = 4, legendary = 5, ultimate = 6 }
        local ARMOR_RARITY_NAMES = { "Grey (Common)", "Green (Uncommon)", "Blue (Rare)", "Purple (Epic)" }
        local ARMOR_RARITY = { ["Grey (Common)"] = "common", ["Green (Uncommon)"] = "uncommon", ["Blue (Rare)"] = "rare", ["Purple (Epic)"] = "epic" }
        local HUNTS = { ["Warrior + Mage"] = { "warrior", "mage" }, ["Warrior only"] = { "warrior" }, ["Mage only"] = { "mage" } }
        local GOALS = { "Legendaries", "T3 armor", "Legendaries + T3 armor" }
        local BY_NAME = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(DUNGEONS) do BY_NAME[d.name] = d end

        local function norm(s) return (string.lower(tostring(s or "")):gsub("[^%w]", "")) end
        local function lower(s) return string.lower(tostring(s or "")) end
        local function remote(name)
            local r = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("remotes")
            return r and r:FindFirstChild(name)
        end
        local function wsValue(name)
            local v = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
            return v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and v.Value or nil
        end
        local function armorMatch(a, class, n)
            if a.perClass then
                local prefix = a.perClass[class]
                if not prefix or n:sub(1, #prefix) ~= prefix then return false end
                return class ~= "guardian" or n == "guardianarmor" or n == "guardianhelmet"
            end
            return n:sub(1, #a.family) == a.family and n:find(class, 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        local function isT3Family(n)
            for _, a in pairs(ARMOR) do
                for _, class in ipairs({ "warrior", "mage", "guardian" }) do
                    if armorMatch(a, class, n) then return true end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local leg = { status = "Off", owned = {}, invAt = -math.huge, alive = true, conns = {} }
        leg.DUNGEONS = DUNGEONS
        context.LEG = leg

        ------------------------------------------------------------ state
        local function load()
            local state = { on = false, hunt = "Warrior + Mage", ultimates = false, autoSell = true, goal = "Legendaries",
                guardian = false, armorRarity = "Purple (Epic)" }
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile(FILE) then
                    local data = httpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
                    if type(data) == "table" then
                        state.on = data.on == true
                        if HUNTS[data.hunt] then state.hunt = data.hunt end
                        state.ultimates = data.ultimates == true
                        state.autoSell = data.autoSell ~= false
                        if table.find(GOALS, data.goal) then state.goal = data.goal end
                        state.guardian = data.guardian == true
                        if ARMOR_RARITY[data.armorRarity] then state.armorRarity = data.armorRarity end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return state
        end
        leg.state = load()
        function leg.save()
            pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(FILE, httpService:JSONEncode(leg.state)) end end)
        end
        local function set(key, value)
            leg.state[key] = value
            leg.invAt = -math.huge
            leg.save()
        end
        function leg.ensureQueue()
            local af = context.AF
            if not af then return false, "Party queue unavailable" end
            af.loadReal(true)
            local party = af.partyOf(localPlayer.Name, af.doc)
            if not party then
                local reason
                party, reason = af.soloParty({ on = true, replay = true })
                if not party then return false, reason or "Could not create party" end
            end
            local changed = party.on ~= true
            party.on = true
            for _, account in ipairs(party.accounts or {}) do
                if string.lower(account.name or "") == string.lower(localPlayer.Name) and account.enabled == false then
                    account.enabled, changed = true, true
                end
            end
            if changed then af.save() end
            return true
        end
        function leg.SetEnabled(on)
            set("on", on == true)
            leg.queueReady = false
            leg.status = on and "Starting" or "Off"
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------ inventory
        local function armorRank() return RARITY_RANK[ARMOR_RARITY[leg.state.armorRarity] or "epic"] end
        local SELL_CATS = {
            { inv = "weapons", out = "weapon" }, { inv = "helmets", out = "helmet" },
            { inv = "chests", out = "chest" }, { inv = "abilities", out = "ability" },
        }
        local KNOWN_FILE = "obliterate_autosell_known.json"
        local KEEP_RARITY = { legendary = true, ultimate = true }
        local function loadKnown()
            if leg.known then return leg.known end
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile(KNOWN_FILE) then
                    local data = httpService:JSONDecode(readfile(KNOWN_FILE))
                    if type(data) == "table" and type(data.uids) == "table" then leg.known = data.uids end
                end
            end)
            return leg.known
        end
        local function saveKnown()
            pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(KNOWN_FILE, httpService:JSONEncode({ uids = leg.known })) end end)
        end
        local function isEquipped(item)
            if item.equipped == true then return true end
            if type(item.equipped) == "table" then
                for _, v in pairs(item.equipped) do if v == true then return true end end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function huntNames()
            local names = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(DUNGEONS) do
                for _, class in ipairs({ "warrior", "mage" }) do
                    for _, n in ipairs(d[class]) do names[lower(n)] = true end
                    if d.ultimate then for _, n in ipairs(d.ultimate[class] or {}) do names[lower(n)] = true end end
                end
            end
            return names
        end
        local function rows(bag, hunt)
            local out = {}
            for _, cat in ipairs(SELL_CATS) do
                for key, item in pairs(type(bag[cat.inv]) == "table" and bag[cat.inv] or {}) do
                    if type(item) == "table" and type(item.UniqueItemID) == "string" and item.UniqueItemID ~= "" then
                        local id = tonumber(tostring(key):match("(%d+)$"))
                        local rarity = lower(item.rarity)
                        out[#out + 1] = {
                            cat = cat.inv, out = cat.out, id = id, uid = item.UniqueItemID, name = tostring(item.name), rarity = rarity,
                            keep = KEEP_RARITY[rarity] or isEquipped(item) or hunt[lower(item.name)] or id == nil
                                or ((cat.inv == "helmets" or cat.inv == "chests") and (RARITY_RANK[rarity] or 0) >= armorRank() and isT3Family(norm(item.name))),
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        local function inLobby() return game.PlaceId == LOBBY_PLACE end
        local function autoSell(bag)
            local known = loadKnown()
            local hunt = huntNames()
            local list = rows(bag, hunt)
            if not known then
                known = {}
                for _, r in ipairs(list) do known[r.uid] = true end
                leg.known = known
                saveKnown()
                leg.sellNote = ("Auto-sell armed (%d existing items protected)"):format(#list)
                return
            end
            local candidates = {}
            for _, r in ipairs(list) do
                if not known[r.uid] then
                    if r.keep then known[r.uid] = true else candidates[#candidates + 1] = r end
                end
            end
            if #candidates == 0 then return saveKnown() end
            local sell, inv = remote("sellItemEvent"), remote("reloadInvy")
            if not (sell and inv) then
                leg.sellNote = "Sell remote missing"
                return
            end
            local sold, requested = 0, {}
            for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
                local ok, fresh = pcall(inv.InvokeServer, inv)
                if not (ok and type(fresh) == "table") then break end
                local match
                for _, r in ipairs(rows(fresh, hunt)) do
                    if r.uid == c.uid and r.cat == c.cat then match = r break end
                end
                if match and not match.keep then
                    local payload = { weapon = {}, helmet = {}, chest = {}, ability = {} }
                    payload[match.out][1] = inLobby() and (tostring(match.id) .. ":" .. match.uid) or match.id
                    if pcall(sell.FireServer, sell, payload) then requested[#requested + 1] = match end
                else
                    known[c.uid] = true
                end
                task.wait(0.6)
            end
            task.wait(1.5)
            local ok, final = pcall(inv.InvokeServer, inv)
            if ok and type(final) == "table" then
                local still = {}
                for _, r in ipairs(rows(final, hunt)) do still[r.uid] = true end
                for _, r in ipairs(requested) do
                    if not still[r.uid] then sold += 1 end
                    known[r.uid] = true
                end
            end
            leg.soldTotal = (leg.soldTotal or 0) + sold
            leg.sellNote = ("Sold %d of %d drops - %d this session"):format(sold, #requested, leg.soldTotal)
            saveKnown()
        end
        function leg.refreshInventory(force)
            if not force and os.clock() - leg.invAt < 30 then return end
            leg.invAt = os.clock()
            local inv = remote("reloadInvy")
            if not inv then return end
            local ok, bag = pcall(inv.InvokeServer, inv)
            if not (ok and type(bag) == "table") then return end
            local armor = {}
            for cat, slot in pairs({ helmets = "helmet", chests = "chest" }) do
                for _, item in pairs(type(bag[cat]) == "table" and bag[cat] or {}) do
                    if type(item) == "table" and item.name then
                        armor[#armor + 1] = { n = norm(item.name), slot = slot, rank = RARITY_RANK[lower(item.rarity)] or 0 }
                    end
                end
            end
            leg.armor = armor
            local owned = {}
            for _, list in pairs(bag) do
                if type(list) == "table" then
                    for _, item in pairs(list) do
                        if type(item) == "table" and item.name then owned[lower(item.name)] = true end
                    end
                end
            end
            for k in pairs(leg.dropped or {}) do owned[k] = true end
            leg.owned = owned
            leg.invLoaded = true
            if leg.state.on and leg.state.autoSell and not leg.selling then
                leg.selling = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local okSell, err = pcall(autoSell, bag)
                    if not okSell then leg.sellNote = "Auto-sell error: " .. tostring(err) end
                    leg.selling = false
                end)
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------ targets
        local function ownsAny(names)
            for _, n in ipairs(names) do if leg.owned[lower(n)] then return true end end
            return false
        end
        local function ownsT3(a, class, slot)
            for _, piece in ipairs(leg.armor or {}) do
                if piece.slot == slot and piece.rank >= armorRank() and armorMatch(a, class, piece.n) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        function leg.Needs(d)
            local goal = leg.state.goal or "Legendaries"
            local need, seen = {}, {}
            local function add(n) if not seen[n] then seen[n] = true need[#need + 1] = n end end
            if goal ~= "T3 armor" then
                for _, class in ipairs(HUNTS[leg.state.hunt] or HUNTS["Warrior + Mage"]) do
                    if not ownsAny(d[class]) then for _, n in ipairs(d[class]) do add(n) end end
                    local ult = leg.state.ultimates and d.ultimate and d.ultimate[class]
                    if ult and not ownsAny(ult) then add(ult[1]) end
                end
            end
            local a = ARMOR[d.name]
            if goal ~= "Legendaries" and a then
                local classes = table.clone(HUNTS[leg.state.hunt] or HUNTS["Warrior + Mage"])
                if leg.state.guardian then classes[#classes + 1] = "guardian" end
                for _, class in ipairs(classes) do
                    for _, slot in ipairs({ "helmet", "chest" }) do
                        if not ownsT3(a, class, slot) then
                            local fam = a.perClass and ({ warrior = "Red Knight", mage = "Templar", guardian = "Guardian" })[class] or a.label
                            add(("%s %s %s"):format(fam, class, slot))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return need
        end
        local function level()
            local ls = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            local lv = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Level")
            return lv and tonumber(lv.Value) or 0
        end
        function leg.Target()
            for _, d in ipairs(DUNGEONS) do
                if level() >= d.level and #leg.Needs(d) > 0 then return d end
            end
            return nil
        end
        function leg.Progress()
            local done, total = 0, 0
            for _, d in ipairs(DUNGEONS) do
                if level() >= d.level then
                    total += 1
                    if #leg.Needs(d) == 0 then done += 1 end
                end
            end
            return done, total
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------ harvard queue hook
        -- Never select a dungeon from the stale background-loop target: loot can arrive
        -- during the replay countdown, before the once-per-second planner runs.
        -- A completed run must go to the lobby to pick the next dungeon; the
        -- normal replayDungeon remote can ONLY replay the current dungeon.
        function leg.ShouldReturnToLobby(dungeonName)
            if not leg.alive or not leg.state.on or not leg.invLoaded or inLobby() then
                return false
            end
            local here = BY_NAME[tostring(dungeonName or wsValue("dungeonName") or "")]
            if not here or #leg.Needs(here) ~= 0 then return false end
            local nextDungeon = leg.Target()
            leg.target = nextDungeon
            leg.transitionFrom = here.name
            leg.transitionTo = nextDungeon and nextDungeon.name or nil
            return true, leg.transitionTo
        end
        if context.AF and context.AF.plan then
            local basePlan = context.AF.plan
            context.AF.plan = function(...)
                local map, diff, req, lo = basePlan(...)
                local t = leg.state.on and leg.invLoaded and leg.Target()
                if t then
                    leg.target = t
                    return t.name, DIFFICULTY, t.level, lo
                end
                return map, diff, req, lo
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------ drops
        local loot = remote("cloneRewardGui")
        if loot and loot:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            leg.conns[#leg.conns + 1] = loot.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
                if not leg.state.on or type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.items) ~= "table" then return end
                task.delay(4, function() if leg.alive then pcall(leg.refreshInventory, true) end end)
                local got = {}
                for _, item in pairs(payload.items) do
                    if type(item) == "table" then
                        local name = item.itemName
                        if name == nil then pcall(function() name = item.template.Name end) end
                        local rarity = lower(item.rarity)
                        if name and (rarity == "legendary" or rarity == "ultimate") then
                            leg.dropped = leg.dropped or {}
                            leg.dropped[lower(name)] = true
                            leg.owned[lower(name)] = true
                            got[#got + 1] = tostring(name)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #got > 0 then
                    -- The game's reward event is authoritative for this run. Update
                    -- progression immediately, without waiting for the polling loop
                    -- or a delayed inventory reload to run.
                    leg.target = leg.Target()
                    leg.lastLegendaryLootAt = os.clock()
                    leg.status = "Dropped: " .. table.concat(got, ", ")
                    if context.notify then pcall(context.notify, "drop", "Legendary farm", table.concat(got, ", ")) end
                end
            end)
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------ loop
        task.spawn(function()
            while leg.alive do
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    if not leg.state.on then
                        -- Still read the inventory (no selling) so the menu can show progress.
                        leg.status, leg.target = "Off", nil
                        leg.refreshInventory(false)
                        return
                    end
                    leg.refreshInventory(false)
                    if not leg.invLoaded then
                        leg.status = "Reading inventory..."
                        return
                    end
                    leg.target = leg.Target()
                    local map = tostring(wsValue("dungeonName") or "")
                    if not leg.target then
                        -- Keep the progression controller active until the player
                        -- has actually returned to the lobby; otherwise the normal
                        -- replay controller takes over and restarts the final dungeon.
                        if inLobby() then
                            leg.status = "All legendary-farm goals completed"
                            set("on", false)
                        else
                            leg.status = "All goals completed - returning to lobby after this run"
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if not leg.queueReady then
                        local ready, reason = leg.ensureQueue()
                        if not ready then
                            leg.status = "Waiting for party: " .. tostring(reason)
                            return
                        end
                        leg.queueReady = true
                    end
                    local here = BY_NAME[map]
                    if inLobby() or map == "" then
                        leg.status = ("Next: %s (Nightmare) for %s"):format(leg.target.name, table.concat(leg.Needs(leg.target), " / "))
                    elseif here and #leg.Needs(here) > 0 then
                        leg.status = ("Hunting %s in %s"):format(table.concat(leg.Needs(here), " / "), map)
                    elseif here then
                        leg.status = ("Done with %s - moving on to %s after this run"):format(map, leg.target.name)
                    else
                        leg.status = ("Farming %s (not on the list) - next: %s"):format(map, leg.target.name)
                    end
                end)
                if not ok then leg.status = "Error: " .. tostring(err) end
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end)

        ------------------------------------------------------------ page (our UI)
        context.buildLegendaryPage = function(body)
            local uiKit = context.UIKit
            local function opts(list)
                local out = {}
                for _, v in ipairs(list) do out[#out + 1] = { value = v, label = v } end
                return out
            end
            local widgets = {}
            local function keep(w) widgets[#widgets + 1] = w return w end
            local main = uiKit.section(body, "Legendary farm", 1,
                "Runs the legacy dungeons on Nightmare until each one's legendary drops, then moves on to the next. It picks the dungeon; your party queues, starts and replays it.")
            local reg = context.sectionReg and context.sectionReg[main.holder]
            if reg then pcall(reg.setOpen, true, true) end
            local c = main.content
            keep(uiKit.toggle(c, "Legendary farm", function() return leg.state.on end, function(v) leg.SetEnabled(v) end, 1,
                "On: the party's dungeon is chosen for you - the first eligible dungeon whose legendary you don't own yet. Makes a party of just you if you aren't in one."))
            keep(uiKit.dropdown(c, "Goal", opts(GOALS), function() return leg.state.goal end, function(v) set("goal", v) end, 2,
                "Legendaries, best (T3) armor sets, or both."))
            keep(uiKit.dropdown(c, "Armor rarity", opts(ARMOR_RARITY_NAMES), function() return leg.state.armorRarity end, function(v) set("armorRarity", v) end, 3,
                "The lowest rarity of T3 armor that counts as done."))
            keep(uiKit.toggle(c, "Include Guardian armor", function() return leg.state.guardian end, function(v) set("guardian", v == true) end, 4,
                "Also collect each dungeon's Guardian armor set."))
            keep(uiKit.dropdown(c, "Hunt", opts({ "Warrior + Mage", "Warrior only", "Mage only" }), function() return leg.state.hunt end, function(v) set("hunt", v) end, 5,
                "Which class's legendaries to hunt."))
            keep(uiKit.toggle(c, "Also hunt ultimates", function() return leg.state.ultimates end, function(v) set("ultimates", v == true) end, 6,
                "Enchanted Forest and Northern Lands also wait for their ultimate (Eden's Vengeance / Reaper, Hofund / Laevateinn). Ultimates are far rarer."))
            keep(uiKit.toggle(c, "Auto-sell non-legendary drops", function() return leg.state.autoSell end, function(v) set("autoSell", v == true) end, 7,
                "Sells new drops that aren't legendary, ultimate, equipped, hunted or wanted T3 armor. Items you owned before turning it on are never sold."))
            local status = uiKit.caption(c, "", 8)
            local sellNote = uiKit.caption(c, "", 9)
            uiKit.button(c, "Re-check inventory", "accent", function()
                leg.invAt = -math.huge
                task.spawn(leg.refreshInventory, true)
            end, 10, "Read the inventory again now instead of waiting up to 30 seconds.")

            local list = uiKit.section(body, "Dungeons", 2, "Every legacy dungeon, its level and what's still missing.")
            local listReg = context.sectionReg and context.sectionReg[list.holder]
            if listReg then pcall(listReg.setOpen, true, true) end
            local rowsText = uiKit.caption(list.content, "", 1)

            task.spawn(function()
                while leg.alive and body.Parent do
                    for _, w in ipairs(widgets) do pcall(w.render) end
                    local done, total = leg.Progress()
                    local text = ("%s\nProgress: %d / %d dungeons done"):format(leg.status, done, total)
                    if status.Text ~= text then status.Text = text end
                    local note = leg.sellNote or ""
                    if sellNote.Text ~= note then sellNote.Text = note end
                    local lines, lv = {}, level()
                    for _, d in ipairs(DUNGEONS) do
                        local need = leg.invLoaded and leg.Needs(d) or {}
                        local mark = lv < d.level and ("locked (level %d)"):format(d.level)
                            or (not leg.invLoaded and "...")
                            or (#need == 0 and "done")
                            or ("missing: " .. table.concat(need, ", "))
                        lines[#lines + 1] = ("%s%s - %s"):format(leg.target == d and "> " or "  ", d.name, mark)
                    end
                    local all = table.concat(lines, "\n")
                    if rowsText.Text ~= all then rowsText.Text = all end
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)
        end

        context.legendaryDestroy = function()
            leg.alive = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(leg.conns) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
        end
    end

    -- obliterate UI: the menu from obliterate_nav_v2.lua (frosted glass, tab strip, two columns of
    -- groupboxes, animated icons) is the only interface. Harvard's window is gone; its settings
    -- code runs against bare holders and the curated controls are drawn here.
    -- Local winter lighting and pooled geometric snowfall; no physics or hitbox interaction.
    components.abilityColorizer = function(context)
        local config, runtime = context.CFG, context.RT
        local players, runService = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService")
        local player, world = players.LocalPlayer, game:GetService("Workspace")
        local fx = { tracked = {}, pending = {}, claims = {}, connections = {}, enabled = false, time = 0, accumulator = 0, activeCount = 0 }
        context.ABILITY_COLORS = fx
        fx.presets = { Ice = "87C8FF", White = "FFFFFF", Red = "FF4545", Orange = "FF963F", Gold = "FFD45C", Lime = "BCFF45",
            Green = "45FF88", Cyan = "45FFFF", Blue = "457DFF", Purple = "AD65FF", Pink = "FF69C8" }
        local ownerKeys = { owner = true, ownerid = true, owneruserid = true, ownername = true, player = true, playerid = true,
            playername = true, userid = true, caster = true, casterid = true, castername = true, creator = true, sourceplayer = true }
        local effectFolders = { abilities = true, playereffects = true, playerabilities = true, effects = true, projectiles = true, vfx = true }
        local rigNames = { HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
            LeftHand = true, RightHand = true, LeftFoot = true, RightFoot = true, LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true,
            RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, RightUpperLeg = true,
            RightLowerLeg = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true }
        local function normalize(text) return tostring(text or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "") end
        function fx.matchSpell(name)
            name = normalize(name)
            for spell in pairs(fx.spells or {}) do if #spell >= 5 and name:find(spell, 1, true) then return spell end end
            return nil
        end
        function fx.parseHex(value)
            local hex = tostring(value or ""):gsub("#", ""):gsub("%s", ""):upper()
            if #hex == 3 and hex:match("^%x+$") then hex = hex:gsub("(.)", "%1%1") end
            if #hex ~= 6 or not hex:match("^%x+$") then return nil end
            return hex
        end
        config.abilityColorHex = fx.parseHex(config.abilityColorHex) or "87C8FF"
        config.abilityColorMode = config.abilityColorMode == "Rainbow" and "Rainbow" or "Custom color"
        config.abilityRainbowSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(config.abilityRainbowSpeed) or 0.15, 0.05, 1)
        config.abilityColorPreset = config.abilityColorPreset or "Ice"
        function fx.color()
            if config.abilityColorMode == "Rainbow" then return Color3.fromHSV((fx.time * config.abilityRainbowSpeed) % 1, 0.9, 1) end
            return Color3.fromHex(config.abilityColorHex)
        end
        local function propertyTypes(object)
            if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") then return { Color = "sequence" } end
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then return { Color = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("Light") or object:IsA("Smoke") then return { Color = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("Fire") then return { Color = "color", SecondaryColor = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("Sparkles") then return { SparkleColor = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("Highlight") then return { FillColor = "color", OutlineColor = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then return { Color3 = "color" } end
            if object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then return { VertexColor = "vector" } end
            return nil
        end
        local function ownerValue(value)
            if typeof(value) == "Instance" then
                if value == player or value == player.Character then return true end
                if value:IsA("Player") or value:IsA("Model") then return false end
                return nil
            end
            if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" then
                if value == "" or value == 0 then return nil end
                return tostring(value) == player.Name or tonumber(value) == player.UserId
            end
            return nil
        end
        function fx.ownership(object)
            local character = player.Character
            local cursor, root, inEffects, characterChild = object, object, false, nil
            local owner, excluded = nil, false
            for _ = 1, 16 do
                if not cursor or cursor == world then break end
                local lower = cursor.Name:lower()
                if lower == "enemies" or lower == "enemypool" or lower == "vfxpool" or lower == "sfxpool" or lower == "templates"
                    or lower == "dungeonautofarmvisuals" or lower == "obliteratewintersnow" then excluded = true end
                if cursor:IsA("Camera") then excluded = true end
                local other = cursor:IsA("Model") and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cursor)
                if other and other ~= player then return false end
                if cursor == character then
                    if excluded then return false end
                    local geometry = object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("SpecialMesh") or object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture")
                    if not geometry then return true end
                    if object:IsA("BasePart") and rigNames[object.Name] then return false end
                    if characterChild and fx.matchSpell(characterChild.Name) then return true end
                    -- Recolor spell geometry, while leaving body parts and equipped armor intact.
                    if characterChild and characterChild:IsA("Tool") and characterChild:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot") then return true end
                    if characterChild and not characterChild:IsA("Accessory") and not characterChild:IsA("BasePart") and not characterChild:IsA("Tool") then return true end
                    return owner == true
                end
                if cursor.Parent == character then characterChild = cursor end
                if effectFolders[normalize(cursor.Name)] or fx.matchSpell(cursor.Name) then inEffects = true end
                for key, value in pairs(cursor:GetAttributes()) do
                    if ownerKeys[normalize(key)] then
                        local result = ownerValue(value)
                        if result == false then return false elseif result == true then owner = true end
                    end
                end
                for _, child in ipairs(cursor:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("ValueBase") and ownerKeys[normalize(child.Name)] then
                        local result = ownerValue(child.Value)
                        if result == false then return false elseif result == true then owner = true end
                    end
                end
                if cursor.Name == player.Name or cursor.Name == tostring(player.UserId) then owner = true end
                root = cursor
                cursor = cursor.Parent
            end
            if excluded then return false end
            if owner ~= nil then return owner end
            -- Some versions omit owner tags. Match an equipped spell spawned beside a confirmed local cast.
            if inEffects then
                local spells = fx.spells or {}
                local effectRoot = object
                while effectRoot.Parent and effectRoot.Parent ~= world and not effectFolders[normalize(effectRoot.Parent.Name)] do effectRoot = effectRoot.Parent end
                local claim = fx.claims[effectRoot]
                if claim and claim.parent == effectRoot.Parent then return true end
                -- The highest ancestor can be the effects folder; inspect names below it as well.
                local node, matched = object, nil
                while node and node ~= world do
                    matched = fx.matchSpell(node.Name)
                    if matched then break end
                    node = node.Parent
                end
                local info = matched and fx.spellInfo and fx.spellInfo[matched]
                local slot = info and info.slot
                if info and info.tool and info.tool.Parent then
                    local cd, length = info.tool:FindFirstChild("cooldown"), info.tool:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
                    local remaining, total = cd and tonumber(cd.Value), length and tonumber(length.Value)
                    if remaining and total and remaining > 0 then info.castAt = os.clock() - math.max(0, total - remaining) end
                end
                local at = math.max(info and info.castAt or -math.huge,
                    slot and fx.lastInputs and fx.lastInputs[slot] or -math.huge,
                    slot == "q" and runtime.lastQ or slot == "e" and runtime.lastE or -math.huge,
                    slot and runtime.lastBuff and runtime.lastBuff[slot] or -math.huge)
                local isBuff = info and info.buff or matched and (matched:find("innerfocus", 1, true) or matched:find("innerrage", 1, true))
                if matched and os.clock() - at >= 0 and os.clock() - at < (isBuff and 7 or 2) then
                    local part = object:IsA("BasePart") and object or object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    local localRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local reach = isBuff and 10 or 120
                    if part and localRoot and (part.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude <= reach then
                        if isBuff then
                            local localDistance = (part.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude
                            for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                                local otherRoot = otherPlayer ~= player and otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if otherRoot and (part.Position - otherRoot.Position).Magnitude + 0.5 < localDistance then return false end
                            end
                        end
                        local claim = { parent = effectRoot.Parent }
                        claim.connection = effectRoot.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                            if parent ~= claim.parent then
                                fx.claims[effectRoot] = nil
                                claim.connection:Disconnect()
                            end
                        end)
                        fx.claims[effectRoot] = claim
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        function fx.refreshSpells()
            fx.spells, fx.spellInfo = {}, {}
            for _, container in pairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
                if container then for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local slot = tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot")
                    if slot then
                        local cooldown, length = tool:FindFirstChild("cooldown"), tool:FindFirstChild("cooldownLength")
                        local remaining, total = cooldown and tonumber(cooldown.Value), length and tonumber(length.Value)
                        local name = normalize(tool.Name)
                        local info = { slot = tostring(slot.Value):lower(), tool = tool,
                            buff = name:find("innerfocus", 1, true) ~= nil or name:find("innerrage", 1, true) ~= nil,
                            castAt = remaining and total and remaining > 0 and os.clock() - math.max(0, total - remaining) or -math.huge }
                        fx.spells[name], fx.spellInfo[name] = true, info
                        -- Enhanced buffs reuse the base spell's effect/particle-holder names.
                        local base = name:gsub("^enhanced", "")
                        fx.spells[base], fx.spellInfo[base] = true, info
                        if name == "enhancedinnerfocus" or name == "enhancedinnerrage" then
                            for _, alias in ipairs({ "enhancedauraring", "groundaura" }) do fx.spells[alias], fx.spellInfo[alias] = true, info end
                        end
                    end
                end end
            end
        end
        function fx.restore(object, entry)
            for _, connection in ipairs(entry.connections or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
            for key, value in pairs(entry.original) do pcall(function() object[key] = value end) end
            fx.tracked[object] = nil
        end
        function fx.paint(object, entry, color, sequence)
            if entry.writing then return end
            entry.writing = true
            for key, kind in pairs(entry.types) do
                local value = kind == "sequence" and sequence or kind == "vector" and Vector3.new(color.R, color.G, color.B) or color
                pcall(function() if object[key] ~= value then object[key] = value end end)
            end
            entry.writing = false
        end
        function fx.consider(object)
            if not fx.enabled or not object.Parent then return end
            local types = propertyTypes(object)
            if not types or not fx.ownership(object) then return end
            if not fx.tracked[object] then
                local original = {}
                for key in pairs(types) do local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[key] end); if ok then original[key] = value end end
                local entry = { original = original, types = types, connections = {} }
                fx.tracked[object] = entry
                for key in pairs(types) do
                    entry.connections[#entry.connections + 1] = object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(key):Connect(function()
                        if fx.enabled and not entry.writing and object.Parent and fx.ownership(object) then
                            local color = fx.color()
                            fx.paint(object, entry, color, config.abilityColorMode == "Rainbow" and fx.currentSequence or ColorSequence.new(color))
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            fx.pending[object] = nil
            local color = fx.color()
            fx.paint(object, fx.tracked[object], color, ColorSequence.new(color))
        end
        function fx.enqueue(object)
            if not propertyTypes(object) then return end
            local cursor = object
            while cursor and cursor ~= world do
                local name = cursor.Name:lower()
                if cursor:IsA("Camera") or name == "vfxpool" or name == "enemypool" or name == "sfxpool"
                    or name == "templates" or name == "enemies" or name == "dungeonautofarmvisuals" then return end
                cursor = cursor.Parent
            end
            fx.pending[object] = { expires = os.clock() + 1.5, nextAt = 0 }
        end
        function fx.scan()
            fx.refreshSpells()
            if player.Character then for _, object in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do fx.enqueue(object) end end
            for _, folder in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
                if effectFolders[normalize(folder.Name)] or folder.Name == player.Name or fx.matchSpell(folder.Name) or fx.ownership(folder) then
                    fx.enqueue(folder)
                    for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do fx.enqueue(object) end
                end
            end
        end
        function fx.step(dt)
            if runtime.destroyed then fx.disable(); return end
            fx.time += dt
            fx.accumulator += dt
            if fx.accumulator < 0.05 then return end
            fx.accumulator = 0
            fx.maintenance = (fx.maintenance or 0) + 0.05
            if fx.maintenance >= 1 then fx.maintenance = 0; fx.scan() end
            local now, processed = os.clock(), 0
            for object, pending in pairs(fx.pending) do
                if not object.Parent or now > pending.expires then fx.pending[object] = nil
                elseif processed < 100 and now >= pending.nextAt then
                    pending.nextAt = now + 0.15
                    fx.consider(object); processed += 1
                end
            end
            local color, count = fx.color(), 0
            local sequence = ColorSequence.new(color)
            if config.abilityColorMode == "Rainbow" then
                local points = {}
                for i = 0, 5 do points[#points + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 5, Color3.fromHSV((fx.time * config.abilityRainbowSpeed + i / 20) % 1, 0.9, 1)) end
                sequence = ColorSequence.new(points)
            end
            fx.currentSequence = sequence
            for object, entry in pairs(fx.tracked) do
                if not object.Parent then fx.restore(object, entry)
                elseif not fx.ownership(object) then fx.restore(object, entry)
                else fx.paint(object, entry, color, sequence); count += 1 end
            end
            fx.activeCount = count
        end
        function fx.disable()
            fx.enabled = false
            for _, connection in ipairs(fx.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
            table.clear(fx.connections)
            for root, claim in pairs(fx.claims) do claim.connection:Disconnect(); fx.claims[root] = nil end
            for object, entry in pairs(fx.tracked) do fx.restore(object, entry) end
            table.clear(fx.pending)
            fx.activeCount = 0
        end
        function fx.enable()
            if fx.enabled then return end
            fx.enabled, fx.time = true, 0
            fx.scan()
            fx.connections[#fx.connections + 1] = world.DescendantAdded:Connect(fx.enqueue)
            fx.connections[#fx.connections + 1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(function() if fx.enabled then fx.scan() end end) end)
            fx.connections[#fx.connections + 1] = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                if not processed and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                    fx.lastInputs = fx.lastInputs or {}
                    fx.lastInputs[input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q and "q" or "e"] = os.clock()
                end
            end)
            fx.connections[#fx.connections + 1] = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(fx.step)
            fx.step(0.05)
        end
        function fx.set(on)
            config.abilityColorEnabled = on == true
            if config.abilityColorEnabled then fx.enable() else fx.disable() end
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        function fx.setMode(mode)
            config.abilityColorMode = mode == "Rainbow" and "Rainbow" or "Custom color"
            fx.error = nil
            if fx.enabled then fx.step(0.05) end
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        function fx.setHex(value)
            local hex = fx.parseHex(value)
            if not hex then fx.error = "Use a hex color such as #87C8FF."; return false end
            config.abilityColorHex, config.abilityColorPreset = hex, "Custom"
            config.abilityColorMode = "Custom color"
            fx.error = nil
            if fx.enabled then fx.step(0.05) end
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
            return true
        end
        function fx.setRGB(channel, value)
            local color = Color3.fromHex(config.abilityColorHex)
            local rgb = { R = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), G = math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), B = math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5) }
            rgb[channel] = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0), 0, 255)
            fx.setHex(("%02X%02X%02X"):format(rgb.R, rgb.G, rgb.B))
        end
        function fx.setPreset(preset)
            if not fx.presets[preset] then return end
            fx.setHex(fx.presets[preset]); config.abilityColorPreset = preset; pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        function fx.setSpeed(speed)
            config.abilityRainbowSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(speed) or 0.15, 0.05, 1)
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        fx.destroy = fx.disable
        if config.abilityColorEnabled then fx.enable() end
    end

    components.winterVisuals = function(context)
        local config, runtime = context.CFG, context.RT
        local lighting, world = game:GetService("Lighting"), game:GetService("Workspace")
        local runService, players = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("Players")
        local winter = { enabled = false, flakes = {}, parts = {}, frames = {}, effects = {}, accumulator = 0, clock = 0 }
        context.WINTER = winter
        local random = Random.new()
        if config.winterRTX == nil then config.winterRTX = false end
        if config.winterSnow == nil then config.winterSnow = true end
        config.winterSnowAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(config.winterSnowAmount) or 280), 60, 500)
        local preset = {
            Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(174, 199, 225), OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(205, 223, 244),
            Brightness = 2.2, ClockTime = 13.7, ExposureCompensation = 0.12,
            ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(15, 25, 40), ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.7, EnvironmentSpecularScale = 1,
            GlobalShadows = true, ShadowSoftness = 0.35,
            FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(217, 234, 250), FogStart = 180, FogEnd = 700,
        }
        local atmospherePreset = {
            Density = 0.22, Offset = 0.1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(219, 237, 255),
            Decay = Color3.fromRGB(146, 182, 219), Glare = 0.1, Haze = 0.7,
        }
        local function readProperties(object, properties)
            local values = {}
            for key in pairs(properties) do
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[key] end)
                if ok then values[key] = value end
            end
            return values
        end
        local function writeProperties(object, properties)
            for key, value in pairs(properties) do pcall(function() object[key] = value end) end
        end
        local function effect(class, name, properties)
            local object = Instance.new(class)
            object.Name = name
            writeProperties(object, properties)
            object.Parent = lighting
            winter.effects[#winter.effects + 1] = object
            return object
        end
        function winter.clearSnow()
            if winter.snowFolder then winter.snowFolder:Destroy() end
            winter.snowFolder = nil
            table.clear(winter.flakes); table.clear(winter.parts); table.clear(winter.frames)
        end
        function winter.center()
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            local player = players.LocalPlayer
            local character = player and player.Character
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local position = root and root.Position or camera and camera.Focus.Position or Vector3.zero
            local top = math.max(position.Y + 38, camera and camera.CFrame.Position.Y + 7 or position.Y + 38)
            return position, math.clamp(top - position.Y + 5, 43, 180)
        end
        function winter.resetFlake(flake, center, height, scatter)
            flake.x, flake.z = center.X + random:NextNumber(-58, 58), center.Z + random:NextNumber(-58, 58)
            flake.y = center.Y - 5 + (scatter and random:NextNumber(0, height) or height)
        end
        function winter.resizeSnow()
            if not winter.enabled or config.winterSnow == false then winter.clearSnow(); return end
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then return end
            if not winter.snowFolder or not winter.snowFolder.Parent then
                winter.clearSnow()
                winter.snowFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
                winter.snowFolder.Name = "ObliterateWinterSnow"
                winter.snowFolder.Parent = camera
            elseif winter.snowFolder.Parent ~= camera then winter.snowFolder.Parent = camera end
            local target = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(config.winterSnowAmount) or 280), 60, 500)
            local center, height = winter.center()
            while #winter.parts > target do
                winter.parts[#winter.parts]:Destroy()
                table.remove(winter.parts); table.remove(winter.flakes); table.remove(winter.frames)
            end
            while #winter.parts < target do
                local size = random:NextNumber(0.13, 0.29)
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name, part.Shape = "Snowflake3D", Enum.PartType.Ball
                part.Size = Vector3.new(size, size * random:NextNumber(0.65, 1), size)
                part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
                part.CastShadow, part.Material = false, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(237, 247, 255)
                part.Transparency = random:NextNumber(0.05, 0.3)
                local flake = { speed = random:NextNumber(3.5, 7), phase = random:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2), sway = random:NextNumber(0.3, 1.1) }
                winter.resetFlake(flake, center, height, true)
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(flake.x, flake.y, flake.z)
                part.Parent = winter.snowFolder
                winter.parts[#winter.parts + 1] = part
                winter.flakes[#winter.flakes + 1] = flake
                winter.frames[#winter.frames + 1] = part.CFrame
            end
        end
        function winter.applyLighting()
            writeProperties(lighting, preset)
            if winter.atmosphere and winter.atmosphere.Parent then writeProperties(winter.atmosphere, atmospherePreset) end
        end
        function winter.disable()
            winter.enabled = false
            if winter.connection then winter.connection:Disconnect(); winter.connection = nil end
            winter.clearSnow()
            for _, object in ipairs(winter.effects) do object:Destroy() end
            table.clear(winter.effects)
            if winter.atmosphere then
                if winter.ownAtmosphere then winter.atmosphere:Destroy()
                elseif winter.atmosphere.Parent and winter.atmosphereBefore then writeProperties(winter.atmosphere, winter.atmosphereBefore) end
            end
            winter.atmosphere, winter.atmosphereBefore, winter.ownAtmosphere = nil, nil, nil
            if winter.before then writeProperties(lighting, winter.before); winter.before = nil end
        end
        function winter.step(dt)
            if runtime.destroyed then winter.disable(); return end
            if config.winterSnow ~= false then
                if not world.CurrentCamera then winter.clearSnow(); return end
                if not winter.snowFolder or not winter.snowFolder.Parent or winter.snowFolder.Parent ~= world.CurrentCamera then winter.resizeSnow() end
            end
            winter.accumulator += dt
            if winter.accumulator < 1 / 30 then return end
            local delta = math.min(winter.accumulator, 0.15)
            winter.accumulator = 0
            winter.clock += delta
            winter.maintenance = (winter.maintenance or 0) + delta
            if winter.maintenance >= 1 then
                winter.maintenance = 0
                winter.applyLighting()
                winter.resizeSnow()
            end
            if #winter.parts == 0 then return end
            local center, height = winter.center()
            for index, flake in ipairs(winter.flakes) do
                flake.y -= flake.speed * delta
                flake.x += (0.65 + math.sin(winter.clock * 0.6 + flake.phase) * flake.sway) * delta
                flake.z += math.cos(winter.clock * 0.4 + flake.phase) * flake.sway * delta
                if flake.y < center.Y - 5 or math.abs(flake.x - center.X) > 64 or math.abs(flake.z - center.Z) > 64
                    or flake.y > center.Y + height + 10 then
                    winter.resetFlake(flake, center, height, math.abs(flake.x - center.X) > 90 or math.abs(flake.z - center.Z) > 90)
                end
                winter.frames[index] = CFrame.new(flake.x, flake.y, flake.z)
            end
            world:BulkMoveTo(winter.parts, winter.frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
        end
        function winter.enable()
            if winter.enabled then return end
            winter.before = readProperties(lighting, preset)
            -- Modern Roblox exposes Realistic lighting; some clients restrict changing renderer properties.
            winter.realistic = pcall(function()
                winter.before.LightingStyle = lighting.LightingStyle
                lighting.LightingStyle = Enum.LightingStyle.Realistic
            end)
            pcall(function()
                winter.before.PrioritizeLightingQuality = lighting.PrioritizeLightingQuality
                lighting.PrioritizeLightingQuality = true
            end)
            winter.atmosphere = lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if winter.atmosphere then winter.atmosphereBefore = readProperties(winter.atmosphere, atmospherePreset)
            else
                winter.atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
                winter.atmosphere.Name, winter.atmosphere.Parent = "ObliterateWinterAtmosphere", lighting
                winter.ownAtmosphere = true
            end
            effect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "ObliterateWinterGrade", { Brightness = 0.025, Contrast = 0.08, Saturation = -0.06, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 247, 255) })
            effect("BloomEffect", "ObliterateWinterBloom", { Intensity = 0.12, Size = 22, Threshold = 1.4 })
            effect("SunRaysEffect", "ObliterateWinterSun", { Intensity = 0.055, Spread = 0.65 })
            winter.enabled, winter.accumulator, winter.clock, winter.maintenance = true, 0, 0, 0
            winter.applyLighting()
            winter.resizeSnow()
            winter.connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(winter.step)
        end
        function winter.set(on)
            config.winterRTX = on == true
            if config.winterRTX then winter.enable() else winter.disable() end
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        function winter.setSnow(on)
            config.winterSnow = on == true
            winter.resizeSnow()
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        function winter.setAmount(amount)
            config.winterSnowAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 280), 60, 500)
            winter.resizeSnow()
            pcall(context.saveConfig)
        end
        winter.destroy = winter.disable
        if config.winterRTX then winter.enable() end
    end

    components.obliterateUI = function(context)
        local Icons = (function()
-- Animated icons ported from lucide-animated (MIT, (c) 2024-2026 pqoqubbw, github.com/pqoqubbw/icons).
-- Each animated SVG element was rasterised to its own white PNG layer, centred on its Motion
-- transform origin, so an ImageLabel rotating/scaling about its centre matches the web pivot.
-- The Motion variants are replayed here: springs integrate the same stiffness/damping/mass,
-- keyframes use the same values/times/durations with Motion's easeInOut curve.
-- generated by render.js from lucide-animated (MIT, (c) pqoqubbw) - do not edit by hand
local ICON_PNG = {
    settings_gear = "",
    play_tri = "",
    handfist_fist = "",
    compass_ring = "",
    compass_needle = "",
    eye_lid = "",
    eye_pupil = "",
    sparkles_star = "",
    sparkles_starfill = "",
    sparkles_twinkle = "",
    chevron_v = "",
    refresh_arrows = "",
    rotate_arrow = "",
    users_front = "",
    users_back = "",
}

local Icons = { active = {} }

---------------------------------------------------------------- image files
local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64MAP = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64MAP[B64:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
local function b64decode(s)
    local out, n, bits, nb = table.create(#s * 3 // 4), 0, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local v = B64MAP[s:byte(i)]
        if v then
            bits = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bits, 6), v)
            nb += 6
            if nb >= 8 then
                nb -= 8
                n += 1
                out[n] = string.char(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(bits, nb), 255))
                bits = bit32.band(bits, bit32.lshift(1, nb) - 1)
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local assetCache = {}
local FOLDER = "obliterate_icons"
local function asset(key)
    if assetCache[key] ~= nil then return assetCache[key] or nil end
    local id = false
    pcall(function()
        local get = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if not (get and writefile and ICON_PNG[key]) then return end
        if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder(FOLDER) then makefolder(FOLDER) end
        local path = FOLDER .. "/" .. key .. ".png"
        writefile(path, b64decode(ICON_PNG[key]))
        id = get(path)
    end)
    assetCache[key] = id
    return id or nil
end
function Icons.available()
    return asset("chevron_v") ~= nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- motion
-- Motion's "easeInOut" is cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1).
local function bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    return function(t)
        if t <= 0 then return 0 elseif t >= 1 then return 1 end
        local u = t
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            local cx = 3 * x1 * u * (1 - u) ^ 2 + 3 * x2 * u ^ 2 * (1 - u) + u ^ 3 - t
            local d = 3 * x1 * (1 - u) ^ 2 + 6 * (x2 - x1) * u * (1 - u) + 3 * (1 - x2) * u ^ 2
            if math.abs(d) < 1e-6 then break end
            u = math.clamp(u - cx / d, 0, 1)
        end
        return 3 * y1 * u * (1 - u) ^ 2 + 3 * y2 * u ^ 2 * (1 - u) + u ^ 3
    end
end
local EASE_IN_OUT = bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1)
-- Calm return-to-rest spring used when a variant goes back to "normal" without its own transition.
local REST = { k = 170, c = 26, m = 1 }

local Icon = {}
Icon.__index = Icon

local DEFS -- defined below

function Icons.new(kind, parent, size, color)
    local def = DEFS[kind]
    if not def then return nil end
    if def.images and not Icons.available() then return nil end
    local s = size / 24
    local root = Instance.new("Frame")
    root.Name = "Icon_" .. kind
    root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    root.Parent = parent
    local self = setmetatable({ kind = kind, def = def, root = root, s = s, layers = {}, color = color, t = 0 }, Icon)
    for _, L in ipairs(def.layers) do
        local layer = { def = L, p = { x = 0, y = 0, rot = 0, scale = 1, sx = 1, sy = 1, alpha = L.alpha or 1, x1 = L.x1, x2 = L.x2 }, drivers = {} }
        if L.line then
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.BackgroundColor3 = color
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            c.Parent = f
            f.Parent = root
            layer.inst = f
        else
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            img.Image = asset(kind .. "_" .. L.name) or ""
            img.ImageColor3 = color
            img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            img.Parent = root
            layer.inst = img
        end
        self.layers[L.name] = layer
        self.layers[#self.layers + 1] = layer
    end
    self:_apply()
    Icons.active[self] = true
    return self
end
