-- Drivers -----------------------------------------------------------
function Icon:spring(layer, prop, target, k, c, m, delay)
    local L = self.layers[layer]
    local d = L.drivers[prop]
    L.drivers[prop] = { kind = "spring", target = target, k = k, c = c, m = m or 1, v = d and d.v or 0, wait = delay or 0 }
    self.awake = true
end
function Icon:keys(layer, prop, values, times, duration, delay, ease)
    local L = self.layers[layer]
    if not times then
        times = {}
        for i = 1, #values do times[i] = (i - 1) / (#values - 1) end
    end
    L.drivers[prop] = { kind = "keys", values = values, times = times, duration = duration, t = 0, wait = delay or 0, ease = ease or EASE_IN_OUT }
    self.awake = true
end
function Icon:tween(layer, prop, to, duration, delay)
    local L = self.layers[layer]
    self:keys(layer, prop, { L.p[prop], to }, { 0, 1 }, duration, delay)
end

function Icon:play()
    self.playing = true
    self.def.enter(self)
    self.awake = true
end
function Icon:stop()
    self.playing = false
    if self.def.leave then self.def.leave(self) end
    -- Anything without an explicit "normal" transition eases home on the calm rest spring.
    for _, L in ipairs(self.layers) do
        for prop, d in pairs(L.drivers) do
            if d.kind == "keys" then
                local rest = L.def.rest and L.def.rest[prop]
                if rest == nil then rest = (prop == "scale" or prop == "sx" or prop == "sy") and 1 or (prop == "alpha" and (L.def.alpha or 1)) or 0 end
                L.drivers[prop] = { kind = "spring", target = rest, k = REST.k, c = REST.c, m = REST.m, v = 0, wait = 0 }
            end
        end
    end
    self.awake = true
end
function Icon:setColor(color, half)
    self.color = color
    for _, L in ipairs(self.layers) do
        L.targetColor = color
    end
    self.colorHalf = half or 0.11
    self.awake = true
end

function Icon:_step(dt)
    local busy = false
    for _, L in ipairs(self.layers) do
        for prop, d in pairs(L.drivers) do
            if d.wait > 0 then
                d.wait -= dt
                busy = true
            elseif d.kind == "spring" then
                -- Semi-implicit Euler on m*x'' = -k(x - target) - c*x', sub-stepped for stability.
                local x, v, steps = L.p[prop], d.v, math.max(1, math.ceil(dt / (1 / 240)))
                local h = dt / steps
                for _ = 1, steps do
                    local a = (-d.k * (x - d.target) - d.c * v) / d.m
                    v += a * h
                    x += v * h
                end
                d.v = v
                if math.abs(x - d.target) < 1e-3 and math.abs(v) < 1e-2 then
                    x = d.target
                    L.drivers[prop] = nil
                else
                    busy = true
                end
                L.p[prop] = x
            else
                d.t += dt
                local u = math.clamp(d.t / d.duration, 0, 1)
                local vals, times = d.values, d.times
                local i = 1
                while i < #times - 1 and u > times[i + 1] do i += 1 end
                local span = times[i + 1] - times[i]
                local f = span > 0 and math.clamp((u - times[i]) / span, 0, 1) or 1
                L.p[prop] = vals[i] + (vals[i + 1] - vals[i]) * d.ease(f)
                if u >= 1 then
                    L.p[prop] = vals[#vals]
                    L.drivers[prop] = nil
                else
                    busy = true
                end
            end
        end
        if L.targetColor then
            local cur = L.curColor or self.color
            local k = 1 - 2 ^ (-dt / (self.colorHalf or 0.11))
            local nxt = cur:Lerp(L.targetColor, k)
            if math.abs(nxt.R - L.targetColor.R) + math.abs(nxt.G - L.targetColor.G) + math.abs(nxt.B - L.targetColor.B) < 2e-3 then
                nxt = L.targetColor
                L.targetColor = nil
            else
                busy = true
            end
            L.curColor = nxt
            if L.inst:IsA("ImageLabel") then L.inst.ImageColor3 = nxt else L.inst.BackgroundColor3 = nxt end
        end
    end
    self:_apply()
    self.awake = busy
end

function Icon:_apply()
    local s = self.s
    for _, L in ipairs(self.layers) do
        local p, d = L.p, L.def
        if d.line then
            -- Axis-aligned stroke between (x1, y) and (x2, y) or a vertical tick; stroke width 2 units.
            local w = 2 * s
            if d.vertical then
                L.inst.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x1 * s, (d.y1 + d.y2) / 2 * s)
                L.inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, (math.abs(d.y2 - d.y1) + 2) * s)
            else
                L.inst.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((p.x1 + p.x2) / 2 * s, d.y * s)
                L.inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((math.abs(p.x2 - p.x1) + 2) * s, w)
            end
            L.inst.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - p.alpha
        else
            L.inst.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((d.cx + p.x) * s, (d.cy + p.y) * s)
            L.inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24 * s * p.scale * p.sx, 24 * s * p.scale * p.sy)
            L.inst.Rotation = p.rot
            L.inst.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(p.alpha, 0, 1)
        end
    end
end

function Icon:destroy()
    Icons.active[self] = nil
    self.root:Destroy()
end

function Icons.step(dt)
    for icon in pairs(Icons.active) do
        if not icon.root.Parent then
            Icons.active[icon] = nil
        elseif icon.awake then
            icon:_step(dt)
        end
    end
end

        local UI = (function()
-- Calm frosted-glass menu. Layout follows the classic tall dark menus (title, tab strip,
-- two columns of titled groupboxes), restyled in a cozy light-blue glass palette.
-- Blur: the world behind each panel is frosted with a Glass part held a hair in front of
-- the camera plus a DepthOfField effect (the acrylic technique), resized to the panel rect.
-- Motion: one half-life animator, k = 1 - 2^(-dt / halfLife): frame-rate independent,
-- never overshoots, so everything eases in calmly.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local function lower(s) return string.lower(tostring(s or "")) end

local T = {
    Glass = Color3.fromRGB(16, 26, 42), GlassT = 0.22,
    Section = Color3.fromRGB(26, 40, 64), SectionT = 0.42,
    Field = Color3.fromRGB(34, 52, 82), FieldT = 0.30,
    Outline = Color3.fromRGB(125, 175, 240), OutlineT = 0.70, OutlineHoverT = 0.25,
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(135, 200, 255),
    AccentSoft = Color3.fromRGB(95, 155, 230),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(238, 246, 255),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(150, 178, 212),
    Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13,
}
local ACCENTS = {
    ["Ice"] = Color3.fromRGB(135, 200, 255),
    ["Sky"] = Color3.fromRGB(110, 185, 255),
    ["Powder"] = Color3.fromRGB(165, 205, 245),
    ["Lagoon"] = Color3.fromRGB(110, 210, 230),
}
local SLOW, CALM, QUICK = 0.16, 0.11, 0.06 -- half-lives (s)
local TAB_GAP = 3

---------------------------------------------------------------- animator
-- UDim2 offsets are stored as integers, so lerping a UDim2 directly rounds every step and
-- freezes the last half-pixel short. UDim2 state is kept as four floats and rounded only on write.
local Anim = { items = {} }
local function pack(v)
    if typeof(v) == "UDim2" then return { v.X.Scale, v.X.Offset, v.Y.Scale, v.Y.Offset } end
    return v
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
    if type(a) == "table" then
        return { a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * k, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k, a[4] + (b[4] - a[4]) * k }
    end
    if typeof(a) == "number" then return a + (b - a) * k end
    return a:Lerp(b, k)
end
local function close(a, b)
    if type(a) == "table" then
        return math.abs(a[1] - b[1]) + math.abs(a[3] - b[3]) < 1e-4 and math.abs(a[2] - b[2]) + math.abs(a[4] - b[4]) < 0.25
    end
    local t = typeof(a)
    if t == "number" then return math.abs(a - b) < 1e-3 end
    if t == "Color3" then return math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 2e-3 end
    return a == b
end
local function unpackValue(v)
    if type(v) == "table" then return UDim2.new(v[1], math.floor(v[2] + 0.5), v[3], math.floor(v[4] + 0.5)) end
    return v
end
function Anim.to(inst, prop, target, half)
    local byInst = Anim.items[inst]
    if not byInst then
        byInst = {}
        Anim.items[inst] = byInst
    end
    local item = byInst[prop]
    if item then
        item.target, item.half = pack(target), half or CALM
    else
        byInst[prop] = { value = pack(inst[prop]), target = pack(target), half = half or CALM }
    end
end
function Anim.set(inst, prop, value)
    local byInst = Anim.items[inst]
    if byInst then byInst[prop] = nil end
    inst[prop] = value
end
function Anim.step(dt)
    for inst, props in pairs(Anim.items) do
        if not inst.Parent then
            Anim.items[inst] = nil
        else
            for prop, item in pairs(props) do
                local k = 1 - 2 ^ (-dt / item.half)
                local v = lerp(item.value, item.target, k)
                if close(v, item.target) then
                    v = item.target
                    props[prop] = nil
                end
                item.value = v
                if not pcall(function() inst[prop] = unpackValue(v) end) then props[prop] = nil end
            end
            if next(props) == nil then Anim.items[inst] = nil end
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
local function new(class, props, children)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do inst[k] = v end
    for _, c in ipairs(children or {}) do c.Parent = inst end
    return inst
end
local function corner(r) return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 3) }) end
local function outline(transparency)
    return new("UIStroke", { Color = T.Outline, Transparency = transparency or T.OutlineT, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
end
local function label(props)
    local l = new("TextLabel", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.85,
        TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 10, 20), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
    })
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
    return l
end
local function accentLine(parent, props)
    -- Soft accent line that fades out toward the right.
    local f = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Parent = parent })
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do f[k] = v end
    new("UIGradient", {
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
        Parent = f,
    })
    return f
end
local function guiParent()
    local ok, hui = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
    if ok and hui then return hui end
    local ok2, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if ok2 and core then
        local probe = Instance.new("Folder")
        if pcall(function() probe.Parent = core end) then
            probe:Destroy()
            return core
        end
    end
    return Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- frosted blur
local Frost = {}
Frost.__index = Frost
local DOF_NAME = "ObliterateUIFrost"
local function ensureDof()
    local dof = Lighting:FindFirstChild(DOF_NAME)
    if not dof then
        dof = new("DepthOfFieldEffect", { Name = DOF_NAME, FarIntensity = 0, FocusDistance = 0.05, InFocusRadius = 0.1, NearIntensity = 1, Parent = Lighting })
    end
    return dof
end
function Frost.new(frame)
    ensureDof()
    local part = new("Part", {
        Name = "ObliterateFrost", Material = Enum.Material.Glass, Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 205, 255),
        Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0), Anchored = true, CanCollide = false,
        CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Locked = true,
    })
    local mesh = new("SpecialMesh", { MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick, Offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1e-6), Parent = part })
    part.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return setmetatable({ frame = frame, part = part, mesh = mesh, on = true }, Frost)
end
function Frost:update()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local f = self.frame
    if not (cam and f.Parent) then return end
    if self.part.Parent ~= cam then self.part.Parent = cam end
    local visible = self.on and not self.disabled and f.Visible
    self.part.Transparency = visible and 0.98 or 1
    if not visible then return end
    local p, s = f.AbsolutePosition, f.AbsoluteSize
    local inset = 2 -- keep the frost inside the rounded corners
    local function world(x, y)
        -- AbsolutePosition is measured below the topbar inset; ScreenPointToRay adds it back.
        local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(x, y)
        return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 0.001
    end
    local tl = world(p.X + inset, p.Y + inset)
    local tr = world(p.X + s.X - inset, p.Y + inset)
    local br = world(p.X + s.X - inset, p.Y + s.Y - inset)
    local cf = cam.CFrame
    self.part.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((tl + br) / 2, cf.XVector, cf.YVector, cf.ZVector)
    self.mesh.Scale = Vector3.new((tr - tl).Magnitude, (br - tr).Magnitude, 0)
end
function Frost:destroy()
    self.part:Destroy()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- library
local UI = {}
UI.__index = UI
UI.Anim = Anim

function UI.new(nav)
    local self = setmetatable({
        nav = nav, accentUsers = {}, tabs = {}, conns = {}, frosts = {}, visible = true,
        toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, live = {},
    }, UI)
    local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "ObliterateNavV2UI", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 50,
    })
    pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end end)
    gui.Parent = guiParent()
    self.gui = gui
    self:_buildWatermark()
    self:_buildWindow()
    self:_buildTooltip()
    self.bound = {}
    self:_loadSettings()
    self:_buildContent()
    self:_applyPrefs()
    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        dt = math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.1)
        Anim.step(dt)
        Icons.step(dt)
        for _, fr in ipairs(self.frosts) do fr:update() end
        self:_tipStep()
        local ok, err = pcall(self._tick, self, dt)
        if not ok and not self.tickWarned then
            self.tickWarned = true
            warn("[obliterate ui] live update error: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if input.KeyCode == self.toggleKey and not processed then self:SetVisible(not self.visible) end
    end)
    -- Calm entrance.
    self.window.GroupTransparency = 1
    self.window.Position = self.windowHome + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14)
    self:SetVisible(true)
    return self
end

function UI:_accent(inst, prop)
    self.accentUsers[#self.accentUsers + 1] = { inst, prop }
    inst[prop] = T.Accent
end

function UI:SetAccent(color)
    T.Accent = color
    for _, pair in ipairs(self.accentUsers) do
        if pair[1].Parent then Anim.to(pair[1], pair[2], color, SLOW) end
    end
    for _, refresh in ipairs(self.accentRefresh or {}) do refresh() end
    if self.current and self.current.icon then self.current.icon:setColor(color, SLOW) end
    if self.titleIcon then self.titleIcon:setColor(color, SLOW) end
end

function UI:_frost(frame)
    local ok, fr = pcall(Frost.new, frame)
    if ok then self.frosts[#self.frosts + 1] = fr end
    return ok and fr or nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- tooltip
-- One shared tooltip: appears after a short calm hover delay, follows the cursor and stays
-- on screen. Hovering a different control just swaps the text.
local TIP_DELAY, TIP_WIDTH = 0.35, 250

function UI:_buildTooltip()
    local tip = new("CanvasGroup", {
        Name = "Tooltip", BackgroundColor3 = T.Glass, BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TIP_WIDTH, 30), GroupTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 50, Parent = self.gui,
    }, { corner(4), outline(0.45) })
    self:_accent(accentLine(tip), "BackgroundColor3")
    local l = label({
        TextWrapped = true, TextColor3 = T.Text, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 6),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -10), TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 51, Parent = tip,
    })
    self.tip, self.tipLabel = tip, l
end

function UI:_tip(target, text)
    if not text or not target then return end
    target.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        self.tipFor, self.tipText, self.tipSince = target, text, os.clock()
    end)
    target.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if self.tipFor == target then self.tipFor = nil end
    end)
end

function UI:_tipStep()
    local tip = self.tip
    if not tip then return end
    local want = self.tipFor ~= nil and self.visible and self.tipFor.Parent ~= nil and os.clock() - self.tipSince >= TIP_DELAY
    if want then
        if self.tipLabel.Text ~= self.tipText then
            self.tipLabel.Text = self.tipText
            local h = TextService:GetTextSize(self.tipText, T.TextSize, T.Font, Vector2.new(TIP_WIDTH - 18, 1000)).Y
            tip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TIP_WIDTH, h + 14)
        end
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local x = math.min(m.X + 16, vp.X - tip.AbsoluteSize.X - 8)
        local y = math.min(m.Y + 18, vp.Y - tip.AbsoluteSize.Y - 8)
        tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        tip.Visible = true
        Anim.to(tip, "GroupTransparency", 0, CALM)
    elseif tip.Visible then
        Anim.to(tip, "GroupTransparency", 1, QUICK)
        if tip.GroupTransparency > 0.98 then tip.Visible = false end
    end
end

        Name = "Watermark", BackgroundColor3 = T.Glass, BackgroundTransparency = T.GlassT, BorderSizePixel = 0,

    self.watermark, self.watermarkLabel, self.fps = frame, l, 60
    self.watermarkFrost = self:_frost(frame)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- window
function UI:_buildWindow()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local w, h = self.winW or 540, 620
    local vh = cam and cam.ViewportSize.Y or 900
    local start = UDim2.fromOffset(70, math.max(56, math.floor(vh * 0.5 - h * 0.5)))
    local win = new("CanvasGroup", {
        Name = "Window", BackgroundColor3 = T.Glass, BackgroundTransparency = T.GlassT, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = start, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), Parent = self.gui,
    }, { corner(5), outline() })
    self:_accent(accentLine(win), "BackgroundColor3")
    local titleIcon = Icons.new("sparkles", win, 16, T.Accent)
    if titleIcon then titleIcon.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 7) end
    self.titleIcon = titleIcon
    local tx = titleIcon and 32 or 12
    label({ Text = "obliterate productions", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -tx - 12, 0, 18), Parent = win })
    label({ Text = "dungeon farm", TextColor3 = T.TextDim, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx + 166, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -tx - 178, 0, 18), Parent = win })
    self.keyHint = label({ Text = "[RIGHTSHIFT]", TextColor3 = T.TextDim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18), Parent = win })
    local tabBar = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24), Parent = win },
        { new("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, TAB_GAP), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })
    self.tabBarWidth = w - 20
    local body = new("Frame", {
        BackgroundColor3 = T.Section, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 58), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -68), Parent = win,
    }, { corner(4), outline() })
    self.window, self.windowHome, self.tabBar, self.body = win, start, tabBar, body
    self.windowFrost = self:_frost(win)

    -- Drag on the title strip; the window glides to the pointer with a short half-life.
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    local grab = new("TextButton", { Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = win })
    if titleIcon then
        grab.MouseEnter:Connect(function() titleIcon:play() end)
        grab.MouseLeave:Connect(function() titleIcon:stop() end)
    end
    grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, self.windowHome
        end
    end)
    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            self.windowHome = UDim2.fromOffset(startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            Anim.to(win, "Position", self.windowHome, QUICK)
        end
    end)
    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
    end)
end

function UI:SetVisible(on)
    self.visible = on
    local w = self.window
    if self.windowFrost then self.windowFrost.on = on end
    if on then
        w.Visible = true
        if self.titleIcon then
            -- A single sparkle as the menu settles in, then back to rest.
            self.titleIcon:play()
            task.delay(2.2, function() if self.titleIcon then self.titleIcon:stop() end end)
        end
        Anim.to(w, "GroupTransparency", 0, SLOW)
        Anim.to(w, "Position", self.windowHome, SLOW)
    else
        Anim.to(w, "GroupTransparency", 1, CALM)
        Anim.to(w, "Position", self.windowHome + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14), CALM)
        task.delay(0.8, function() if not self.visible and w.Parent then w.Visible = false end end)
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- tabs / groupboxes
local TAB_ICONS = { Farm = "play", Party = "users", Combat = "handfist", Movement = "compass", Visuals = "eye", Settings = "settings", Advanced = "sliders" }
-- Tab sizing: icon 14 + 6 gap + text, 7px pad each side; leftover bar width is shared evenly
-- so the row always fills the window exactly instead of running off the edge.
local TAB_ICON, TAB_ICON_GAP, TAB_PAD = 14, 5, 7

function UI:_layoutTabs()
    local avail = self.tabBarWidth or 520
    -- Side padding shrinks (7 -> 2) when many tabs share the bar, so the row never overflows.
    local content = 0
    for _, t in ipairs(self.tabs) do content += t.textW + (t.icon and (TAB_ICON + TAB_ICON_GAP) or 0) end
    local gaps = TAB_GAP * math.max(#self.tabs - 1, 0)
    local pad = math.clamp(math.floor((avail - gaps - content) / math.max(#self.tabs * 2, 1)), 2, TAB_PAD)
    local natural, total = {}, 0
    for i, t in ipairs(self.tabs) do
        natural[i] = t.textW + pad * 2 + (t.icon and (TAB_ICON + TAB_ICON_GAP) or 0)
        total += natural[i]
    end
    total += TAB_GAP * math.max(#self.tabs - 1, 0)
    local extra = math.max(0, avail - total) / math.max(#self.tabs, 1)
    local used = 0
    for i, t in ipairs(self.tabs) do
        -- Last tab absorbs rounding so the row ends exactly at the bar edge.
        local w = i == #self.tabs and math.max(natural[i], avail - used) or math.floor(natural[i] + extra)
        used += w + TAB_GAP
        t.button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 24)
        local content = t.textW + (t.icon and (TAB_ICON + TAB_ICON_GAP) or 0)
        local left = math.floor((w - content) / 2)
        if t.icon then t.icon.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, 5) end
        t.text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left + (t.icon and (TAB_ICON + TAB_ICON_GAP) or 0), 0)
        t.text.Size = UDim2.new(0, t.textW + 2, 1, 0)
    end
end

function UI:Tab(name)
    local icon_kind = TAB_ICONS[name]
    local textW = TextService:GetTextSize(name, T.TextSize, T.Font, Vector2.new(1000, 24)).X
    local width = textW + 26 + (icon_kind and 18 or 0)
    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
        BackgroundColor3 = T.Section, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 24), LayoutOrder = #self.tabs + 1, Parent = self.tabBar,
    }, { corner(3), outline() })
    local text = label({ Text = name, TextColor3 = T.TextDim, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(icon_kind and 31 or 13, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -13, 1, 0), Parent = btn })
    local icon = icon_kind and Icons.new(icon_kind, btn, 14, T.TextDim)
    if icon then icon.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 5) end
    local top = accentLine(btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    self:_accent(top, "BackgroundColor3")
    local page = new("ScrollingFrame", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollBarThickness = 2, ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.Outline, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5,
        Visible = false, Parent = self.body,
    }, { new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10) }) })
    local cols = {}
    for i = 1, 2 do
        -- Inside a padded ScrollingFrame, scaled Size and scaled Position resolve against different
        -- widths, so columns use fixed offsets: page 520 - 2x10 padding = 500 = 245 + 10 gutter + 245.
        cols[i] = new("Frame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(i == 2 and ((self.colW or 245) + 10) or 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.colW or 245, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = page,
        }, { new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 10), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })
    end
    local tab = { name = name, button = btn, text = text, icon = icon, textW = textW, top = top, page = page, cols = cols, order = 0 }
    self.tabs[#self.tabs + 1] = tab
    self:_layoutTabs()
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() self:Select(tab) end)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if icon then icon:play() end
        if self.current ~= tab then
            Anim.to(text, "TextColor3", T.Text, CALM)
            if icon then icon:setColor(T.Text) end
        end
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if icon then icon:stop() end
        if self.current ~= tab then
            Anim.to(text, "TextColor3", T.TextDim, CALM)
            if icon then icon:setColor(T.TextDim) end
        end
    end)
    if #self.tabs == 1 then self:Select(tab) end
    function tab.Groupbox(_, title, side) return self:_groupbox(tab, title, side) end
    return tab
end

function UI:Select(tab)
    if self.current == tab then return end
    local prev = self.current
    self.current = tab
    for _, t in ipairs(self.tabs) do
        local on = t == tab
        Anim.to(t.text, "TextColor3", on and T.Text or T.TextDim, CALM)
        if t.icon then t.icon:setColor(on and T.Accent or T.TextDim, SLOW) end
        Anim.to(t.button, "BackgroundTransparency", on and 0.35 or 0.85, CALM)
        Anim.to(t.top, "BackgroundTransparency", on and 0 or 1, SLOW)
    end
    if prev then prev.page.Visible = false end
    tab.page.Visible = true
    tab.page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8)
    Anim.to(tab.page, "Position", UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), SLOW)
end

function UI:_groupbox(tab, title, side)
    tab.order += 1
    local ui = self
    local col = tab.cols[side == "right" and 2 or 1]
    local box = new("Frame", {
        BackgroundColor3 = T.Section, BackgroundTransparency = T.SectionT, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = tab.order,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = col,
    }, { corner(4), outline() })
    self:_accent(accentLine(box), "BackgroundColor3")
    local content = new("Frame", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = box,
    }, {
        new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9) }),
    })
    label({ Text = title, TextColor3 = T.Accent, LayoutOrder = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Parent = content })
    local gb, n = {}, 0
    local function order() n += 1 return n end
    local function field(parent, props)
        local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = parent }, { corner(3) })
        for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do f[k] = v end
        local s = outline()
        s.Parent = f
        return f, s
    end
    local function hover(target, s)
        target.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineHoverT, CALM) end)
        target.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineT, CALM) end)
    end

    gb.content = content
    gb.nextOrder = order

    function gb:Input(placeholder, buttonText, onSubmit)
        local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local box, s = field(row, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 1, 0) })
        local tb = new("TextBox", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
            PlaceholderText = placeholder, PlaceholderColor3 = T.TextDim, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0), Parent = box,
        })
        tb.Focused:Connect(function() Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineHoverT, CALM) end)
        tb.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineT, CALM)
            if enter and tb.Text ~= "" then task.spawn(onSubmit, tb.Text) tb.Text = "" end
        end)
        local b = new("TextButton", {
            Text = buttonText, AutoButtonColor = false, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
            BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 68, 1, 0), Parent = row,
        }, { corner(3) })
        local bs = outline()
        bs.Parent = b
        hover(b, bs)
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if tb.Text ~= "" then task.spawn(onSubmit, tb.Text) tb.Text = "" end
        end)
        return tb
    end

    function gb:Label(str, dim)
        local l = label({ Text = str, TextColor3 = dim and T.TextDim or T.Text, LayoutOrder = order(), TextWrapped = true, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = content })
        return function(s) if l.Text ~= s then l.Text = s end end
    end

    function gb:Divider(str)
        local row = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local w = TextService:GetTextSize(str, T.TextSize, T.Font, Vector2.new(1000, 14)).X + 12
        for _, sideX in ipairs({ 0, 1 }) do
            new("Frame", {
                BackgroundColor3 = T.Outline, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(sideX, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(sideX, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -w / 2, 0, 1), Parent = row,
            })
        end
        label({ Text = str, TextColor3 = T.TextDim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Parent = row })
    end

    function gb:Toggle(str, default, callback, helpText)
        local state = default == true
        local row = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local boxF, s = field(row, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12) })
        local fill = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 1, Parent = boxF }, { corner(2) })
        ui:_accent(fill, "BackgroundColor3")
        local l = label({ Text = str, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0), TextColor3 = state and T.Text or T.TextDim, Parent = row })
        local function render()
            Anim.to(fill, "BackgroundTransparency", state and 0 or 1, CALM)
            Anim.to(l, "TextColor3", state and T.Text or T.TextDim, CALM)
        end
        hover(row, s)
        row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state = not state
            render()
            if callback then task.spawn(callback, state) end
        end)
        ui:_tip(row, helpText)
        return function(v) if v ~= state then state = v render() end end
    end

    function gb:Slider(str, min, max, default, decimals, callback, suffix, helpText)
        local value = math.clamp(default, min, max)
        local fmt = "%." .. (decimals or 0) .. "f"
        local wrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local l = label({ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Parent = wrap })
        local bar = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 17), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10), Parent = wrap })
        local track, s = field(bar, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
        local fill = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale((value - min) / (max - min), 1), Parent = track }, {
            corner(3),
            new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)), Rotation = 90 }),
        })
        ui:_accent(fill, "BackgroundColor3")
        local function render(instant)
            l.Text = ("%s: %s%s"):format(str, fmt:format(value), suffix or "")
            local target = UDim2.fromScale((value - min) / (max - min), 1)
            if instant then Anim.set(fill, "Size", target) else Anim.to(fill, "Size", target, QUICK) end
        end
        render(true)
        local dragging = false
        local function set(x)
            local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
            local step = 10 ^ -(decimals or 0)
            local v = math.floor((min + (max - min) * a) / step + 0.5) * step
            if v ~= value then
                value = v
                render()
                if callback then task.spawn(callback, value) end
            end
        end
        bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                set(input.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        hover(bar, s)
        ui.conns[#ui.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then set(input.Position.X) end
        end)
        ui.conns[#ui.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
        end)
        ui:_tip(wrap, helpText)
        return function(v) value = math.clamp(v, min, max) render() end
    end

    function gb:Button(str, callback, iconKind)
        local b = new("TextButton", {
            Text = str, AutoButtonColor = false, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
            BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content,
        }, { corner(3) })
        local s = outline()
        s.Parent = b
        hover(b, s)
        local icon = iconKind and Icons.new(iconKind, b, 14, T.TextDim)
        if icon then
            icon.root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            icon.root.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0)
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() icon:play() icon:setColor(T.Accent) end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() icon:stop() icon:setColor(T.TextDim) end)
        end
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            -- Calm press: a soft accent wash that slowly drains away.
            b.BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
            Anim.to(b, "BackgroundColor3", T.Field, SLOW * 2)
            Anim.to(b, "BackgroundTransparency", T.FieldT, SLOW * 2)
            if callback then task.spawn(callback) end
        end)
    end

    function gb:Dropdown(str, options, default, callback, helpText)
        local value = default or options[1]
        local open = false
        label({ Text = str, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local head = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local hf, hs = field(head, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
        local cur = label({ Text = value, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0), Parent = hf })
        local chev = Icons.new("chevron", hf, 14, T.TextDim)
        local plus = { }
        if chev then
            chev.root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
            chev.root.Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0.5, 0)
        else
            plus = label({ Text = "+", TextColor3 = T.TextDim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0), Parent = hf })
        end
        local function turn(isOpen)
            if chev then
                chev:spring("v", "rot", isOpen and 180 or 0, 170, 22, 1)
                chev:setColor(isOpen and T.Accent or T.TextDim)
            end
        end
        head.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if chev and not open then chev:play() end end)
        local list = new("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = order(), Visible = false, Parent = content,
        }, { corner(3), outline(), new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }) })
        local items = {}
        local function closeList()
            open = false
            plus.Text = "+"
            turn(false)
            Anim.to(list, "Size", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), CALM)
            task.delay(0.6, function() if not open then list.Visible = false end end)
        end
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local it = new("TextButton", {
                Text = "  " .. opt, AutoButtonColor = false, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = opt == value and T.Accent or T.Text,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = i, Parent = list,
            })
            items[opt] = it
            it.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if opt ~= value then Anim.to(it, "TextColor3", T.TextDim, CALM) end end)
            it.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if opt ~= value then Anim.to(it, "TextColor3", T.Text, CALM) end end)
            it.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                value = opt
                cur.Text = opt
                for o, b in pairs(items) do Anim.to(b, "TextColor3", o == value and T.Accent or T.Text, CALM) end
                closeList()
                if callback then task.spawn(callback, opt) end
            end)
        end
        ui.accentRefresh = ui.accentRefresh or {}
        table.insert(ui.accentRefresh, function()
            local it = items[value]
            if it then Anim.to(it, "TextColor3", T.Accent, SLOW) end
        end)
        hover(head, hs)
        head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if open then return closeList() end
            open = true
            plus.Text = "-"
            turn(true)
            list.Visible = true
            Anim.to(list, "Size", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, #options * 20), CALM)
        end)
        ui:_tip(head, helpText)
        return function(v)
            if not items[v] or v == value then return end
            value = v
            cur.Text = v
            for o, b in pairs(items) do Anim.to(b, "TextColor3", o == value and T.Accent or T.Text, CALM) end
        end
    end

    function gb:Progress(str)
        local wrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = order(), Parent = content })
        local l = label({ Text = str, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Parent = wrap })
        local track = field(wrap, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 17), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10) })
        local fill = new("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), Parent = track }, {
            corner(3),
            new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255)), Rotation = 90 }),
        })
        ui:_accent(fill, "BackgroundColor3")
        return function(frac, text)
            Anim.to(fill, "Size", UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(frac, 0, 1), 1), SLOW)
            local t = str .. (text and ("  -  " .. text) or "")
            if l.Text ~= t then l.Text = t end
        end
    end

    return gb
end

        { title = "Discord", side = "left", items = {
            { "Webhook", "Send to Discord" }, { "Webhook", "Webhook URL" }, { "Webhook", "Ping on" },
            { "Webhook", "Drop artwork" }, { "Webhook", "Send a test message" },
        } },
    } },
    { tab = "Settings", native = "settings", groups = {
        { title = "Game", side = "right", items = {
            { "Visuals", "Notifications" }, { "Visuals", "Show the minimap" }, { "Visuals", "Streamer mode" },
            { "Visuals", "Cap FPS" },
        } },
