            { "ModDetect", "Enabled" }, { "ModDetect", "Take breaks" },
        } },
    } },
}
TAB_ICONS.Legendary = "sparkles"
TAB_ICONS.Selling = "refresh"
TAB_ICONS.Webhook = "rotate"

local function decimalsFor(step, oneDecimal)
    if type(step) == "number" and step > 0 then
        local d = math.ceil(-math.log10(step) - 1e-9)
        if d <= 0 then return 0 end -- never -0: "%.-0f" is not a valid format
        return math.min(d, 3)
    end
    return oneDecimal and 1 or 0
end

-- Children added to a groupbox by one widget call (our widgets don't return their frames).
local function capture(gb, fn)
    local before = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(gb.content:GetChildren()) do before[c] = true end
    local result = fn()
    local frames = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(gb.content:GetChildren()) do
        if not before[c] and c:IsA("GuiObject") then frames[#frames + 1] = c end
    end
    return result, frames
end

-- Two-way text field in our style (label above, glass field below).
local function textField(ui, gb, labelText, get, set, placeholder, tip)
    local wrap = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), LayoutOrder = gb.nextOrder(), Parent = gb.content })
    label({ Text = labelText, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Parent = wrap })
    local box = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), Parent = wrap }, { corner(3) })
    local s = outline()
    s.Parent = box
    local tb = new("TextBox", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
        PlaceholderText = placeholder or "", PlaceholderColor3 = T.TextDim, Text = tostring(get() or ""), ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0), Parent = box,
    })
    tb.Focused:Connect(function() Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineHoverT, CALM) end)
    tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        Anim.to(s, "Transparency", T.OutlineT, CALM)
        pcall(set, tb.Text)
    end)
    ui:_tip(wrap, tip)
    return wrap, function(v)
        if not tb:IsFocused() then
            v = tostring(v or "")
            if tb.Text ~= v then tb.Text = v end
        end
    end
end

function UI.newMirror(context, mirror)
    local self = setmetatable({
        context = context, mirror = mirror, accentUsers = {}, tabs = {}, conns = {}, frosts = {}, visible = false,
        live = {}, entries = {}, boxes = {},
    }, UI)
    local old = guiParent():FindFirstChild("ObliterateUI")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "ObliterateUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 120,
    })
    pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(gui) end end)
    gui.Parent = guiParent()
    self.gui = gui
    self:_loadPrefs()
    self:_buildWatermark()
    self:_buildWindow()
    self:_buildTooltip()
    self.keyHint.Text = "[" .. tostring(context.CFG.menuKey or "RightShift"):upper() .. "]"

    for _, spec in ipairs(LAYOUT) do
        local tab = self:Tab(spec.tab)
        if spec.native == "legendary" then
            local ok, err = pcall(self._buildLegendary, self, tab)
            if not ok then warn("[obliterate ui] legendary tab: " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
        if spec.native == "settings" then self:_buildSettingsLeft(tab) end
        for _, g in ipairs(spec.groups or {}) do
            local gb = self:_groupbox(tab, g.title, g.side)
            local box = { gb = gb, entries = {}, alwaysShown = g.live }
            self.boxes[#self.boxes + 1] = box
            if g.live then
                self.live.state = gb:Label("Starting", false)
                self.live.place = gb:Label("", true)
            end
            for _, e in ipairs(g.items) do
                local entry = { page = e[1], label = e[2], find = e.find, gb = gb, box = box }
                box.entries[#box.entries + 1] = entry
                self.entries[#self.entries + 1] = entry
            end
        end
    end
    self:_applyPrefs()
    self:_sync()
    self:_buildNotices()
    local runtime = context.RT
    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if processed or (runtime and (runtime.menuKeyCapture or runtime.mapKeyCapture)) then return end
        if input.KeyCode.Name == tostring(context.CFG.menuKey or "RightShift") then self:SetVisible(not self.visible) end
    end)
    if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        local touch = new("TextButton", {
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = T.Glass, BackgroundTransparency = T.GlassT,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.35, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), Parent = gui,
        }, { corner(5), outline() })
        local icon = Icons.new("sparkles", touch, 22, T.Accent)
        if icon then
            icon.root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            icon.root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        end
        touch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() self:SetVisible(not self.visible) end)
    end

    self.conns[#self.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        dt = math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.1)
        Anim.step(dt)
        Icons.step(dt)
        for _, fr in ipairs(self.frosts) do fr:update() end
        self:_tipStep()
        local ok, err = pcall(self._tickMirror, self, dt)
        if not ok and not self.tickWarned then
            self.tickWarned = true
            warn("[obliterate ui] live update error: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    self.window.Visible = false
    self.window.GroupTransparency = 1
    return self
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- prefs
function UI:_loadPrefs()
    self.prefs = {}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(PREFS_FILE) then
            local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(PREFS_FILE))
            if type(data) == "table" then self.prefs = data end
        end
    end)
end

function UI:_savePrefs()
    pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(PREFS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(self.prefs)) end end)
end

function UI:_applyPrefs()
    local p = self.prefs
    if p.accent and ACCENTS[p.accent] then self:SetAccent(ACCENTS[p.accent]) end
    if p.watermark == false then
        self.watermark.GroupTransparency = 1
        if self.watermarkFrost then self.watermarkFrost.on = false end
    end
    if p.blur == false then for _, fr in ipairs(self.frosts) do fr.disabled = true end end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- harvard lookups
local function pageOf(holder)
    local a = holder
    while a and a ~= game do
        if a.Parent and a.Parent.Name == "Pages" then return a.Name end
        a = a.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function itemText(item)
    if item.kind == "label" or item.kind == "button" then return item.holder.Text end
    return item.label
end

-- Newest live harvard control on `page` whose label matches.
function UI:_findItem(entry)
    local items = self.mirror.items
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do
        local item = items[i]
        if item.holder and item.holder.Parent and pageOf(item.holder) then
            local text = tostring(itemText(item) or "")
            local hit
            if entry.find then hit = text:find(entry.label, 1, true) ~= nil else hit = text == entry.label end
            if hit and pageOf(item.holder) == entry.page then return item end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Is a harvard control shown inside its page? A section's collapsed Content frame doesn't count.
function UI:_harvardVisible(holder)
    local a = holder
    while a and a ~= game do
        if a.Parent and a.Parent.Name == "Pages" then return true end
        if a:IsA("GuiObject") and not a.Visible then
            if not (a.Name == "Content" and self.mirror.sections[a.Parent]) then return false end
        end
        a = a.Parent
    end
    return false
end

-- Our widget for an entry; it calls through entry.item so a rebuilt harvard row rebinds cleanly.
function UI:_buildEntry(entry, item)
    local gb, ui = entry.gb, self
    local function get(...) return entry.item.get(...) end
    local function set(...) return entry.item.set(...) end
    local frames
    if item.kind == "toggle" then
        entry.setter, frames = capture(gb, function()
            return gb:Toggle(item.label, get() == true, function(v) pcall(set, v) end, item.tip)
        end)
    elseif item.kind == "slider" then
        local dec = decimalsFor(item.step, item.oneDecimal)
        entry.setter, frames = capture(gb, function()
            return gb:Slider(item.label, item.min, item.max, tonumber(get()) or item.min, dec,
                function(v) pcall(set, v) end, "", item.tip or item.sub)
        end)
    elseif item.kind == "range" then
        local fromSet, toSet, fb
        fromSet, frames = capture(gb, function()
            local a = get()
            return gb:Slider(item.label .. " (from)", item.min, item.max, tonumber(a) or item.min, 0, function(v)
                local _, b = get()
                pcall(set, math.min(v, tonumber(b) or v), math.max(v, tonumber(b) or v))
            end, item.suffix or "", item.tip)
        end)
        toSet, fb = capture(gb, function()
            local _, b = get()
            return gb:Slider(item.label .. " (to)", item.min, item.max, tonumber(b) or item.max, 0, function(v)
                local a = get()
                pcall(set, math.min(v, tonumber(a) or v), math.max(v, tonumber(a) or v))
            end, item.suffix or "", item.tip)
        end)
        for _, f in ipairs(fb) do frames[#frames + 1] = f end
        entry.setter = function()
            local a, b = get()
            fromSet(tonumber(a) or item.min)
            toSet(tonumber(b) or item.max)
        end
        entry.noValue = true
    elseif item.kind == "dropdown" then
        local opts = type(item.options) == "function" and item.options() or item.options or {}
        local labels, byValue, byLabel = {}, {}, {}
        for _, o in ipairs(opts) do
            local value = type(o) == "table" and o.value or o
            local text = tostring(type(o) == "table" and (o.label or o.value) or o)
            labels[#labels + 1] = text
            byValue[tostring(value)] = text
            byLabel[text] = value
        end
        if #labels == 0 then return false end
        local setter
        setter, frames = capture(gb, function()
            return gb:Dropdown(item.label, labels, byValue[tostring(get())] or labels[1],
                function(text) pcall(set, byLabel[text]) end, item.tip)
        end)
        entry.setter = function(v) setter(byValue[tostring(v)]) end
        entry.listFrame = frames[3]
    elseif item.kind == "text" then
        local frame
        frame, entry.setter = textField(ui, gb, item.label, get, function(v) pcall(set, v) end, item.placeholder, item.tip)
        frames = { frame }
    elseif item.kind == "button" then
        local _, fr = capture(gb, function()
            return gb:Button(item.holder.Text ~= "" and item.holder.Text or item.label, function() pcall(entry.item.click) end)
        end)
        frames = fr
        if fr[1] then ui:_tip(fr[1], item.tip) end
        entry.setter = function()
            local t = entry.item.holder.Text
            if fr[1] and t ~= "" and fr[1].Text ~= t then fr[1].Text = t end
        end
        entry.noValue = true
    elseif item.kind == "label" then
        entry.setter, frames = capture(gb, function() return gb:Label(item.holder.Text, true) end)
        entry.noValue = true
    else
        return false
    end
    entry.frames = frames or {}
    return true
end

function UI:_sync()
    for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
        local item = entry.item
        if not (item and item.holder and item.holder.Parent and pageOf(item.holder)) then
            item = self:_findItem(entry)
            if item and entry.frames and entry.kind ~= item.kind then
                for _, f in ipairs(entry.frames) do f:Destroy() end
                entry.frames = nil
            end
            entry.item = item
            if item and not entry.frames then
                entry.kind = item.kind
                local ok, built = pcall(self._buildEntry, self, entry, item)
                if not (ok and built) then entry.frames = {} end
            end
        end
        local shown = entry.item ~= nil and self:_harvardVisible(entry.item.holder)
        if shown and entry.kind == "label" and entry.item.holder.Text == "" then shown = false end
        for _, f in ipairs(entry.frames or {}) do
            if f.Visible ~= shown and not (shown and f == entry.listFrame) then f.Visible = shown end
        end
        entry.shown = shown
        if shown and entry.setter then
            if entry.kind == "label" then
                pcall(entry.setter, entry.item.holder.Text)
            elseif entry.noValue then
                pcall(entry.setter)
            else
                local ok, v = pcall(entry.item.get)
                if ok then pcall(entry.setter, v) end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, box in ipairs(self.boxes) do
        local any = box.alwaysShown or false
        for _, e in ipairs(box.entries) do if e.shown then any = true break end end
        local frame = box.gb.content.Parent
        if frame.Visible ~= any then frame.Visible = any end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- legendary (native, our module)
function UI:_buildLegendary(tab)
    local leg = self.context.LEG
    if not leg then return end
    local main = tab:Groupbox("Legendary farm", "left")
    self.legOn = main:Toggle("Hunt legendaries", leg.state.on, function(on) leg.SetEnabled(on) end,
        "Picks your party's dungeon: the first one whose legendary you don't own yet, on Nightmare. Moves on once it drops.")
    self.legHunt = main:Dropdown("Hunt", { "Warrior + Mage", "Warrior only", "Mage only" }, leg.state.hunt, function(v)
        leg.state.hunt = v
        leg.save()
    end, "Which class's legendaries to collect.")
    self.legGoal = main:Dropdown("Goal", { "Legendaries", "T3 armor", "Legendaries + T3 armor" }, leg.state.goal, function(v)
        leg.state.goal = v
        leg.save()
    end, "Legendaries, the best (T3) armor set of each dungeon, or both.")
    local armorFrames, guardianFrames
    self.legRarity, armorFrames = capture(main, function()
        return main:Dropdown("Armor rarity", { "Grey (Common)", "Green (Uncommon)", "Blue (Rare)", "Purple (Epic)" },
            leg.state.armorRarity, function(v) leg.state.armorRarity = v leg.save() end, "Lowest armor rarity that counts as done.")
    end)
    self.legGuardian, guardianFrames = capture(main, function()
        return main:Toggle("Include Guardian armor", leg.state.guardian, function(on) leg.state.guardian = on leg.save() end)
    end)
    self.legArmorList = armorFrames[3]
    self.legArmorFrames = { armorFrames[1], armorFrames[2] }
    for _, f in ipairs(guardianFrames) do self.legArmorFrames[#self.legArmorFrames + 1] = f end
    self.legUlt = main:Toggle("Also hunt ultimates", leg.state.ultimates, function(on) leg.state.ultimates = on leg.save() end,
        "Enchanted Forest and Northern Lands also wait for their (much rarer) ultimate.")
    self.legSell = main:Toggle("Auto-sell other drops", leg.state.autoSell, function(on) leg.state.autoSell = on leg.save() end,
        "Sells new drops that aren't legendary, ultimate, equipped or wanted armor. Items you already owned are never sold.")

    local now = tab:Groupbox("Progress", "right")
    self.legProgress = now:Progress("Dungeons done")
    self.legNext = now:Label("Next: -")
    self.legStatus = now:Label("", true)
    now:Button("Re-check inventory", function()
        leg.invAt = -math.huge
        task.spawn(leg.refreshInventory, true)
    end, "refresh")
    local missing = tab:Groupbox("Missing items", "right")
    self.legMissingSummary = missing:Label("Reading inventory...")
    missing:Label("Scroll down for the complete list.", true)
    self.legList = missing:Label("", true)
end

function UI:_tickLegendary()
    local leg = self.context.LEG
    if not (leg and self.legOn) then return end
    local s = leg.state
    self.legOn(s.on)
    self.legHunt(s.hunt)
    self.legGoal(s.goal)
    self.legRarity(s.armorRarity)
    self.legGuardian(s.guardian)
    self.legUlt(s.ultimates)
    self.legSell(s.autoSell)
    local armor = s.goal ~= "Legendaries"
    for _, f in ipairs(self.legArmorFrames) do if f and f.Visible ~= armor then f.Visible = armor end end
    if not armor and self.legArmorList then self.legArmorList.Visible = false end
    self.legStatus(s.on and leg.status or "Off - turn on to start hunting")
    if not leg.invLoaded then
        self.legProgress(0, "reading inventory")
        self.legNext("Next: -")
        self.legMissingSummary("Reading inventory...")
        self.legList("")
        return
    end
    local done, total = leg.Progress()
    self.legProgress(total > 0 and done / total or 0, ("%d / %d"):format(done, total))
    -- Every missing item for the selected goal, grouped by dungeon; the page scrolls to fit.
    local sections, missingCount = {}, 0
    for _, d in ipairs(leg.DUNGEONS or {}) do
        local need = leg.Needs(d)
        if #need > 0 then
            local lines = { d.name }
            for _, item in ipairs(need) do lines[#lines + 1] = "  - " .. item end
            sections[#sections + 1] = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            missingCount += #need
        end
    end
    local t = leg.Target()
    self.legNext(t and ("Next: %s"):format(t.name) or missingCount > 0 and "Next: unlock the remaining dungeons" or "Next: nothing left!")
    self.legMissingSummary(("%d item%s across %d dungeon%s"):format(missingCount, missingCount == 1 and "" or "s", #sections, #sections == 1 and "" or "s"))
    self.legList(#sections > 0 and table.concat(sections, "\n\n") or "You have everything for this goal.")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- settings (left column, ours)
function UI:_buildSettingsLeft(tab)
    local context, config, ui = self.context, self.context.CFG, self
    local menu = tab:Groupbox("Menu", "left")
    local keyNames = { "RightShift", "RightControl", "LeftAlt", "Insert", "Home", "End", "Delete", "F1", "F4" }
    menu:Dropdown("Open / close key", keyNames, config.menuKey or "RightShift", function(name)
        config.menuKey = name
        pcall(context.saveConfig)
        ui.keyHint.Text = "[" .. name:upper() .. "]"
    end, "The key that shows and hides this menu.")
    menu:Dropdown("Accent colour", { "Ice", "Sky", "Powder", "Lagoon" }, self.prefs.accent or "Ice", function(name)
        ui.prefs.accent = name
        ui:SetAccent(ACCENTS[name])
        ui:_savePrefs()
    end)
    menu:Toggle("Info bar", self.prefs.watermark ~= false, function(on)
        ui.prefs.watermark = on
        Anim.to(ui.watermark, "GroupTransparency", on and 0 or 1, CALM)
        if ui.watermarkFrost then ui.watermarkFrost.on = on end
        ui:_savePrefs()
    end)
    menu:Toggle("Blur behind menu", self.prefs.blur ~= false, function(on)
        ui.prefs.blur = on
        for _, fr in ipairs(ui.frosts) do fr.disabled = not on end
        ui:_savePrefs()
    end)
    local colors = tab:Groupbox("Ability colors", "right")
    self.abilityOn = colors:Toggle("Ability colorizer", config.abilityColorEnabled == true, function(on)
        if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.set(on) end
    end, "Color your spell parts, particles, beams and trails on this client.")
    self.abilityMode = colors:Dropdown("Color mode", { "Custom color", "Rainbow" }, config.abilityColorMode or "Custom color", function(mode)
        if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.setMode(mode) end
    end)
    self.abilityPreset = colors:Dropdown("Color preset", { "Custom", "Ice", "White", "Red", "Orange", "Gold", "Lime", "Green", "Cyan", "Blue", "Purple", "Pink" }, config.abilityColorPreset or "Ice", function(preset)
        if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.setPreset(preset) end
    end)
    local _, hexSetter = textField(ui, colors, "Hex color", function() return "#" .. (config.abilityColorHex or "87C8FF") end,
        function(hex) if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.setHex(hex) end end, "#87C8FF", "Enter any hex color. Three-digit colors also work.")
    self.abilityHex = hexSetter
    self.abilityRGB = {}
    for _, channel in ipairs({ "R", "G", "B" }) do
        self.abilityRGB[channel] = colors:Slider(({ R = "Red", G = "Green", B = "Blue" })[channel], 0, 255,
            math.floor(Color3.fromHex(config.abilityColorHex or "87C8FF")[channel] * 255 + 0.5), 0, function(value)
                if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.setRGB(channel, value) end
            end)
    end
    self.abilitySpeed = colors:Slider("Rainbow speed", 0.05, 1, config.abilityRainbowSpeed or 0.15, 2, function(speed)
        if context.ABILITY_COLORS then context.ABILITY_COLORS.setSpeed(speed) end
    end, " cycles/s")
    self.abilitySwatch = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(config.abilityColorHex or "87C8FF"),
        BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12), LayoutOrder = colors.nextOrder(), Parent = colors.content }, { corner(3), outline() })
    self.abilityStatus = colors:Label("", true)
    local winter = tab:Groupbox("Winter RTX", "left")
    self.winterOn = winter:Toggle("Winter RTX lighting", config.winterRTX == true, function(on)
        if context.WINTER then context.WINTER.set(on) end
    end, "Crisp winter daylight, icy atmosphere, soft glow and realistic lighting where supported.")
    self.winterSnow = winter:Toggle("3D snowfall", config.winterSnow ~= false, function(on)
        if context.WINTER then context.WINTER.setSnow(on) end
    end, "Falling three-dimensional snow pieces around you while Winter RTX is enabled.")
    self.winterAmount = winter:Slider("Snow amount", 60, 500, config.winterSnowAmount or 280, 0, function(amount)
        if context.WINTER then context.WINTER.setAmount(amount) end
    end, "", "More flakes make a denser snowfall.")
    local misc = tab:Groupbox("Script", "left")
    misc:Button("Show example notifications", function()
        for i, e in ipairs({ { "run", "Run started", "Northern Lands, Nightmare." }, { "success", "Run won", "4:12." },
            { "drop", "Legendary drop", "Mjolnir" } }) do
            task.delay((i - 1) * 0.6, function() ui:Notify(e[1], e[2], e[3]) end)
        end
    end, "sparkles")
    misc:Button("Unload script", function()
        if context.destructScript then context.destructScript() end
    end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- notifications (our style)
-- Same contract harvard's party code expects from a card: close(), set(title, body), .button.
function UI:_buildNotices()
    self.noticeHolder = new("Frame", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, -14),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 420), Parent = self.gui,
    }, { new("UIListLayout", {
        VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
        Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    }) })
    self.noticeSeen = {}
end

function UI:Notify(kind, title, body, duration, opts)
    if self.context.CFG.notifications == false or not self.noticeHolder then return nil end
    opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {}
    title, body = tostring(title or ""), tostring(body or "")
    local key = title .. "|" .. body
    if not opts.sticky and self.noticeSeen[key] and os.clock() - self.noticeSeen[key] < 4 then return nil end
    self.noticeSeen[key] = os.clock()
    self.noticeN = (self.noticeN or 0) + 1
    local card = new("CanvasGroup", {
        BackgroundColor3 = T.Glass, BackgroundTransparency = T.GlassT, BorderSizePixel = 0, GroupTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = self.noticeN, Parent = self.noticeHolder,
    }, { corner(4), outline() })
    self:_accent(accentLine(card), "BackgroundColor3")
    local inner = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = card }, {
        new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }),
    })
    local t = label({ Text = title, TextColor3 = T.Accent, LayoutOrder = 1, TextWrapped = true, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = inner })
    local b = label({ Text = body, TextColor3 = T.TextDim, LayoutOrder = 2, TextWrapped = true, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = body ~= "", Parent = inner })
    local h = { gone = false }
    function h.set(a, c)
        t.Text = tostring(a or "")
        b.Text = tostring(c or "")
        b.Visible = b.Text ~= ""
    end
    function h.close()
        if h.gone then return end
        h.gone = true
        Anim.to(card, "GroupTransparency", 1, CALM)
        task.delay(0.6, function() card:Destroy() end)
    end
    if type(opts.button) == "table" then
        local btn = new("TextButton", {
            Text = tostring(opts.button.text or "OK"), AutoButtonColor = false, Font = T.Font, TextSize = T.TextSize, TextColor3 = T.Text,
            BackgroundColor3 = T.Field, BackgroundTransparency = T.FieldT, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), LayoutOrder = 3, Parent = inner,
        }, { corner(3) })
        outline().Parent = btn
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if opts.button.onClick then pcall(opts.button.onClick, h) end
        end)
        h.button = btn
    end
    Anim.to(card, "GroupTransparency", 0, CALM)
    if not opts.sticky then task.delay(tonumber(duration) or 5, h.close) end
    local cards = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(self.noticeHolder:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("CanvasGroup") then cards[#cards + 1] = c end end
    if #cards > 5 then cards[1]:Destroy() end
    return h
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- live tick
function UI:_tickMirror(dt)
    self.fps = (self.fps or 60) + ((1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3)) - (self.fps or 60)) * (1 - 2 ^ (-dt / 0.5))
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (self.lastLive or 0) < 0.3 then return end
    self.lastLive = now
    local ping = "?"
    pcall(function()
        ping = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() + 0.5) .. "ms"
    end)
    self.watermarkLabel.Text = ("obliterate productions  |  %d fps  |  %s  |  %s"):format(math.floor(self.fps + 0.5), ping, os.date("%H:%M:%S"))
    Anim.to(self.watermark, "Size", UDim2.fromOffset(self.watermarkLabel.TextBounds.X + 20, 24), CALM)
    if not self.visible and now - (self.lastHiddenSync or 0) < 2 then return end
    self.lastHiddenSync = now
    local rt = self.context.RT
    local ability = self.context.ABILITY_COLORS
    if ability and self.abilityOn then
        local config = self.context.CFG
        self.abilityOn(config.abilityColorEnabled == true)
        self.abilityMode(config.abilityColorMode)
        self.abilityPreset(config.abilityColorPreset or "Custom")
        self.abilityHex("#" .. config.abilityColorHex)
        local color = Color3.fromHex(config.abilityColorHex)
        for channel, setter in pairs(self.abilityRGB) do setter(math.floor(color[channel] * 255 + 0.5)) end
        self.abilitySpeed(config.abilityRainbowSpeed)
        self.abilitySwatch.BackgroundColor3 = ability.color()
        self.abilityStatus(ability.error or (ability.enabled and ("%d visual effects colored"):format(ability.activeCount) or "Original ability colors"))
    end
    if self.winterOn then self.winterOn(self.context.CFG.winterRTX == true) end
    if self.winterSnow then self.winterSnow(self.context.CFG.winterSnow ~= false) end
    if self.winterAmount then self.winterAmount(self.context.CFG.winterSnowAmount or 280) end
    if self.live.state then
        self.live.state(rt and rt.farmEnabled and tostring(rt.movementState or "Farming"):sub(1, 70) or "Autofarm is off")
        local dn = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonName")
        self.live.place(dn and tostring(dn.Value) ~= "" and ("In " .. tostring(dn.Value)) or "In the lobby")
    end
    pcall(self._tickLegendary, self)
    self:_sync()
end

function UI:Destroy()
    for _, c in ipairs(self.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    self.conns = {}
    for _, fr in ipairs(self.frosts) do pcall(function() fr:destroy() end) end
    self.frosts = {}
    local dof = Lighting:FindFirstChild(DOF_NAME)
    if dof then dof:Destroy() end
    if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return UI

        end)()

        local mirror = { items = {}, sections = {} }
        context.oblMirror = mirror
        local kit = context.UIKit
        local function add(item)
            mirror.items[#mirror.items + 1] = item
            return item
        end
        local noop = function() end
        -- Harvard's settings code still runs (its logic lives there) but its widgets are now bare,
        -- never-rendered frames carrying only the label and getter/setter our menu needs.
        local function bare(parent, order, class, name)
            local f = Instance.new(class or "Frame")
            f.Name = name or "Row"
            if order then pcall(function() f.LayoutOrder = order end) end
            f.Parent = parent
            return f
        end
        local function clicker(button, cb)
            return function()
                if cb then return cb() end
                if getconnections then
                    for _, sig in ipairs({ button.MouseButton1Click, button.Activated }) do
                        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(sig)) do pcall(function() c:Fire() end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        kit.tip, kit.hideTip, kit.ensureTip, kit.accentSweep, kit.stopSweeps = noop, noop, noop, noop, noop
        kit.section = function(parent, title, order, desc)
            local holder = bare(parent, order, "Frame", "Section")
            local content = bare(holder, 2, "Frame", "Content")
            local open = false
            mirror.sections[holder] = { title = title, desc = desc }
            context.sectionReg = context.sectionReg or {}
            context.sectionReg[holder] = { head = holder, content = content, setOpen = function(v) open = v and true or false end,
                isOpen = function() return open end }
            return { holder = holder, content = content, setOpen = function(v) if not v then open = false end end,
                isOpen = function() return open end }
        end
        kit.toggle = function(parent, label, get, set, order, tip)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            add({ kind = "toggle", holder = row, label = tostring(label), get = get, set = set, tip = tip })
            return { row = row, render = noop }
        end
        kit.slider = function(parent, label, sub, min, max, oneDecimal, get, set, order, tip, step)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            add({ kind = "slider", holder = row, label = tostring(label), sub = sub, min = min, max = max,
                oneDecimal = oneDecimal, get = get, set = set, tip = tip, step = step })
            return { holder = row, render = noop }
        end
        kit.rangeSlider = function(parent, label, sub, min, max, get, set, order, tip, suffix)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            add({ kind = "range", holder = row, label = tostring(label), min = min, max = max, get = get, set = set,
                tip = tip or sub, suffix = suffix })
            return { holder = row, render = noop }
        end
        kit.dropdown = function(parent, label, options, get, set, order, tip)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            add({ kind = "dropdown", holder = row, label = tostring(label), options = options, get = get, set = set, tip = tip })
            return { holder = row, render = noop }
        end
        kit.textInput = function(parent, label, get, set, order, tip, placeholder)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            local box = bare(row, 2, "TextBox", "Input")
            add({ kind = "text", holder = row, label = tostring(label), get = get, set = set, tip = tip, placeholder = placeholder })
            return { row = row, render = noop, box = box }
        end
        kit.listInput = function(parent, label, sub, get, set, order, tip, placeholder)
            local row = bare(parent, order)
            add({ kind = "list", holder = row, label = tostring(label), sub = sub, get = get, set = set, tip = tip, placeholder = placeholder })
            return { holder = row, render = noop, toBottom = noop }
        end
        kit.button = function(parent, text, style, cb, order, tip)
            local b = bare(parent, order, "TextButton", "Button")
            b.Text = tostring(text or "")
            if cb then b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb) end
            add({ kind = "button", holder = b, label = tostring(text), click = clicker(b, cb), tip = tip })
            return b
        end
        kit.buttonRow = function(parent, order)
            local frame = bare(parent, order, "Frame", "Buttons")
            return { frame = frame, add = function(text, style, cb, tip)
                local b = bare(frame, nil, "TextButton", "Button")
                b.Text = tostring(text or "")
                if cb then b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb) end
                add({ kind = "button", holder = b, label = tostring(text), click = clicker(b, cb), tip = tip })
                return b
            end }
        end
        kit.caption = function(parent, text, order)
            local l = bare(parent, order, "TextLabel", "Caption")
            l.Text = tostring(text or "")
            add({ kind = "label", holder = l })
            return l
        end
        kit.label = function(parent, text, style, order)
            local l = bare(parent, order, "TextLabel", "Label")
            l.Text = tostring(text or "")
            add({ kind = "label", holder = l })
            return l
        end

        -- Notifications go to our cards (harvard's lived in the removed window).
        context.notify = function(...)
            local ui = context.oblUI
            if not ui then return false end
            return (pcall(ui.Notify, ui, ...))
        end
        context.notifyCard = function(...)
            local ui = context.oblUI
            if not ui then return nil end
            local ok, card = pcall(ui.Notify, ui, ...)
            return ok and card or nil
        end
        -- Only the first call (harvard's initial state) matters; afterwards our menu owns its key.
        context.oblMenu = function(shown)
            if not context.oblUI then context.oblWant = shown end
        end
        context.oblBuild = function()
            local ui = UI.newMirror(context, mirror)
            context.oblUI = ui
            if context.oblWant ~= nil then ui:SetVisible(context.oblWant) end
            local function wrapDestruct(fn)
                return function(...)
                    pcall(ui.Destroy, ui)
                    if fn then return fn(...) end
                end
            end
            context.destructScript = wrapDestruct(context.destructScript)
            _G.DungeonAutofarmDestruct = wrapDestruct(_G.DungeonAutofarmDestruct)
            -- Run notifications (harvard hooked these inside its window).
            local wh = context.WH
            local function hook(name, fn)
                if not (wh and type(wh[name]) == "function") then return end
                local original = wh[name]
                wh[name] = function(...)
                    pcall(fn, ...)
                    return original(...)
                end
            end
            local good = { legendary = true, ultimate = true, epic = true }
            hook("start", function(dungeon, diff)
                context.notify("run", "Run started", ("%s, %s."):format(tostring(dungeon or "Dungeon"), tostring(diff or "")))
            end)
            hook("finish", function(won)
                local run = wh.run
                local secs = run and run.at and wh.runSecs and wh.runSecs(run) or nil
                local t = secs and ("%d:%02d"):format(math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60) or ""
                if won == false then
                    context.notify("error", "Run lost", (t ~= "" and t .. ". " or "") .. "Back to the party.")
                else
                    context.notify("success", "Run won", (t ~= "" and t .. ". " or "") .. tostring(run and run.dungeon or ""))
                end
            end)
            hook("item", function(name, rarity)
                if rarity and good[string.lower(tostring(rarity))] then
                    context.notify("drop", tostring(rarity) .. " drop", tostring(name))
                end
            end)
            hook("rodinClear", function() context.notify("success", "Rodin cleared", "The bonus boss is down.") end)
            hook("rodinFail", function() context.notify("error", "Rodin failed", "The bonus boss got away.") end)
        end
    end

    components.interfaceMainLoop = function(context)
        local Color3 = OBL_Color3
        local uiKit = context.UIKit
        local theme = context.UIKit.Theme
        local config = context.CFG
        local runtimeState = context.RT
        local hazardReader = context.RD
        local uiSettings = context.UI
        local localPlayer = context.LocalPlayer
        local runService = context.RunService
        local userInputService = context.UserInputService
        local contextWorkspace = context.Workspace
        local contextSliderConnections = context.sliderConnections
        local contextReleaseMover = context.releaseMover
        local contextRestoreWalkSpeed = context.restoreWalkSpeed
        local contextReaderStop = context.readerStop
        local contextClearDrawing = context.clearDrawing
        pcall(function()
            local virtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
            contextSliderConnections[#contextSliderConnections + 1] = localPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
                pcall(function()
                    virtualUser:CaptureController()
                    virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
                end)
            end)
        end)
        local contextSaveConfig = context.saveConfig
        local contextLoadConfig = context.loadConfig
        local ver, U, J, w = context.SCRIPT_VERSION, {}, {}, false
        local function Y(v)
            U[#U + 1] = v
            return v
        end
        local function contextRefreshAll()
            for index, entry in ipairs(U) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and entry.render then
                    pcall(entry.render)
                end
            end
        end
        context.refreshAll = contextRefreshAll
        local function U()
            local M, M, Z = context.character()
            pcall(contextReleaseMover, M, Z)
            return M
        end
        local R = {
            saved = {},
            box = nil,
            coreChanged = {},
            lastApply = -math.huge,
            on = false,
        }
        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local starterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
        local contextVisualRoot = context.visualRoot
        local function f(r, o, A)
            if r[o] == A then
                return
            end
            local k = R.saved[r]
            if not k then
                k = {}
                R.saved[r] = k
            else
            end
            if k[o] == nil then
                k[o] = r[o]
            end
            r[o] = A
        end
        R.fakes = R.fakes or {}
        local function r(o, text)
            if not (o and (o:IsA("TextLabel"))) then
                f(o, "Visible", false)
                return
            end
            text = tostring(text or "")
            if text == "" then
                f(o, "Visible", false)
                return
            end
            f(o, "TextTransparency", 1)
            f(o, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1)
            local k = R.fakes[o]
            if not k or not k.Parent then
                k = o:Clone()
                for index, child in ipairs(k:GetChildren()) do
                    if
                        not (
                            child:IsA("UIStroke")
                            or child:IsA("UICorner")
                            or child:IsA("UIGradient")
                            or child:IsA("UITextSizeConstraint")
                            or child:IsA("UIPadding")
                        )
                    then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                k.Name = "streamerFake"
                k.TextTransparency, k.TextStrokeTransparency = 0, o.TextStrokeTransparency
                k.Visible = true
                k.ZIndex = o.ZIndex + 1
                k.Parent = o.Parent
                R.fakes[o] = k
            else
            end
            if k.Text ~= text then
                k.Text = text
            end
        end
        R.plates = R.plates or {}
        R.plateKeys = R.plateKeys
            or {
                name = true,
                title = true,
                vip = true,
                healthamount = true,
                level = true,
            }
        local function o(A)
            local k = R.plates[A]
            if not k then
                for key, plate in pairs(R.plates) do
                    if not key:IsDescendantOf(game) then
                        for index, conn in ipairs(plate.conns) do
                            pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                        end
                        R.plates[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                k = {
                    list = {},
                    dirty = true,
                    at = 0,
                    conns = {},
                }
                local function x(a)
                    if runtimeState.destroyed then
                        for index2, conn2 in ipairs(k.conns) do
                            pcall(conn2.Disconnect, conn2)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if not k.dirty and a:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        k.dirty = true
                    end
                end
                k.conns[1] = A.DescendantAdded:Connect(x)
                k.conns[2] = A.DescendantRemoving:Connect(x)
                R.plates[A] = k
            else
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            if k.dirty or now - k.at > 5 then
                k.dirty = false
                k.at = now
                local list, plateKeys = {}, R.plateKeys
                for index3, descendant in ipairs(A:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") and descendant.Name ~= "streamerFake" then
                        index3 = string.lower(descendant.Name)
                        if plateKeys[index3] then
                            list[#list + 1] = descendant
                            list[#list + 1] = index3
                        end
                    end
                end
                k.list = list
            end
            return k.list
        end
        local function A(k, x)
            if not k then
                return
            end
            local a = o(k)
            for index = 1, #a, 2 do
                local k, e = a[index], a[index + 1]
                if e == "name" then
                    if x then
                        if config.streamerName then
                            r(k, config.streamerNameText)
                        end
                    else
                        f(k, "Visible", false)
                    end
                elseif e == "title" or e == "vip" then
                    if not x or config.streamerName then
                        f(k, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
                if x and e == "healthamount" and config.streamerHealth then
                    r(k, config.streamerHealthText)
                end
                if x and e == "level" and config.streamerLevel and (config.streamerLevelText or "") ~= "" then
                    r(k, config.streamerLevelText)
                elseif e == "level" and config.streamerLevel then
                    index = k
                    for index2 = 1, 2, 1 do
                        index2 = index.Parent
                        if
                            not (
                                index2
                                and index2:IsA("GuiObject")
                                and index2.Parent
                                and index2.Parent:IsA("GuiObject")
                            )
                        then
                            break
                        end
                        index = index2
                    end
                    f(index, "Visible", false)
                end
            end
        end
        local function o(char)
            local body = R.body
            if not body or body.char ~= char then
                if body then
                    for index, conn in ipairs(body.conns) do
                        pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                    end
                end
                body = {
                    char = char,
                    dirty = true,
                    list = {},
                    conns = {},
                }
                local function a(e)
                    if runtimeState.destroyed then
                        for index2, conn2 in ipairs(body.conns) do
                            pcall(conn2.Disconnect, conn2)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if body.dirty then
                        return
                    end
                    if
                        e:IsA("BasePart")
                        or e:IsA("Decal")
                        or e:IsA("Texture")
                        or e:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                        or e:IsA("Trail")
                        or e:IsA("Beam")
                    then
                        body.dirty = true
                    end
                end
                body.conns[1] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(a)
                body.conns[2] = char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(a)
                R.body = body
            else
            end
            if body.dirty then
                body.dirty = false
                local list = {}
                for index3, descendant in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        list[#list + 1] = descendant
                        list[#list + 1] = 1
                    elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") then
                        list[#list + 1] = descendant
                        list[#list + 1] = 2
                    elseif
                        descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                        or descendant:IsA("Trail")
                        or descendant:IsA("Beam")
                    then
                        list[#list + 1] = descendant
                        list[#list + 1] = 3
                    end
                end
                body.list = list
            end
            return body.list
        end
        local function k(x)
            local rootPart, streamer = x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), o(x)
            for index = 1, #streamer, 2 do
                local x, N = streamer[index], streamer[index + 1]
                if N == 1 then
                    if x ~= rootPart then
                        f(x, "Transparency", 1)
                        f(x, "CastShadow", false)
                    end
                elseif N == 2 then
                    f(x, "Transparency", 1)
                else
                    f(x, "Enabled", false)
                end
            end
            if rootPart then
                streamer = R.box
                if not streamer or not streamer.Parent then
                    streamer = Instance.new("Part")
                    streamer.Name = "streamer"
                    streamer.Anchored = true
                    streamer.CanCollide = false
                    streamer.CanQuery = false
                    streamer.CanTouch = false
                    streamer.CastShadow = false
                    streamer.Material, streamer.Color, streamer.Size =
                        Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                        config.streamerBodyColor or Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
                        Vector3.new(2, 5, 2)
                    streamer.Parent = contextVisualRoot()
                    R.box = streamer
                else
                end
                streamer.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
                if config.streamerBodyColor and streamer.Color ~= config.streamerBodyColor then
                    streamer.Color = config.streamerBodyColor
                end
            end
        end
        local function n()
            local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if not playerGui then
                return
            end
            local x = playerGui:FindFirstChild("playerStatus")
            x = x and (x:FindFirstChild("Frame"))
            if x then
                local a, healthFrame = x:FindFirstChild("playerName"), x:FindFirstChild("healthFrame")
                if a and config.streamerName then
                    r(a, config.streamerNameText)
                end
                if healthFrame and config.streamerHealth then
                    a = healthFrame:FindFirstChild("health")
                    if (config.streamerHealthText or "") ~= "" and a then
                        r(a, config.streamerHealthText)
                    else
                        f(healthFrame, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
            end
            if x then
                if config.streamerLevel then
                    local a = x:FindFirstChild("portraitBorder")
                    local e, N =
                        a and (a:FindFirstChild("portrait")), context.customLogo and context.customLogo() or nil
                    if a then
                        if N and e then
                            f(e, "Image", N)
                            f(e, "ImageColor3", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                            f(e, "ScaleType", Enum.ScaleType.Crop)
                        else
                            f(a, "Visible", false)
                        end
                    end
                    N = x:FindFirstChild("levelBorder")
                    a = N and (N:FindFirstChild("level"))
                    if (config.streamerLevelText or "") ~= "" and a then
                        r(a, config.streamerLevelText)
                    elseif N then
                        f(N, "Visible", false)
                    end
                end
                if config.streamerWealth then
                    local moneyMain, xpFrame = x:FindFirstChild("moneyMain"), x:FindFirstChild("xpFrame")
                    local x, N, I =
                        moneyMain and (moneyMain:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")),
                        moneyMain and (moneyMain:FindFirstChild("GemsText")),
                        xpFrame and (xpFrame:FindFirstChild("xp"))
                    if moneyMain then
                        if
                            ((config.streamerGoldText or "") ~= "" or (config.streamerGemsText or "") ~= "")
                            and x
                            and N
                        then
                            r(x, config.streamerGoldText)
                            r(N, config.streamerGemsText)
                        else
                            f(moneyMain, "Visible", false)
                        end
                    end
                    if xpFrame then
                        if (config.streamerXpText or "") ~= "" and I then
                            r(I, config.streamerXpText)
                        else
                            f(xpFrame, "Visible", false)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if config.streamerName then
                local r = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Cmdr")
                local x = r and (r:FindFirstChild("Frame"))
                x = x and (x:FindFirstChild("Entry"))
                r = x and (x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel"))
                if r then
                    f(r, "Visible", false)
                end
            end
            local r, x =
                playerGui:FindFirstChild("playerStatsLeaderboard"),

        local function f(r, o)
            local success, a = pcall(starterGui.GetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, r)
            if not success then
                return
            end

                    pcall(starterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, starterGui, r, false)

        local function Z()
            for key, entry in pairs(R.saved) do
                for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry) do
                    pcall(function()
                        key[key2] = entry2
                    end)
                end
            end
            table.clear(R.saved)
            for key3, entry3 in pairs(R.fakes or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    entry3:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            R.fakes = {}
            for key4, entry4 in pairs(R.plates or {}) do
                for index, conn in ipairs(entry4.conns) do
                    pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                end
            end
            R.plates = {}
            if R.body then
                for index2, conn2 in ipairs(R.body.conns) do
                    pcall(conn2.Disconnect, conn2)
                end
                R.body = nil
            end
            if R.box then
                R.box:Destroy()
                R.box = nil
            end
            f(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
            f(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, false)
            R.on = false
        end

        local function success2()
            pcall(function()
                local k = context.readJson(n, "HarvardLabs_configs.json")
                local x = type(k) == "table" and type(k.list) == "table"
                if x then
                    f = k
                    local k = f
                    k.current = k.current or "Default"
                end
            end)
            local k = type(f.currentBy) ~= "table"
            if k then
                f.currentBy = {}
            end
            k = f.currentBy[o] == nil
            if k then
                f.currentBy[o] = f.current or "Default"
            end
            k = f
            k.current = k.currentBy[o]
            k = f.current ~= "Default"
            if k then
                local k, list, a = ipairs, f.list, false
                for key, entry in k(list) do
                    local name, current = entry.name, f.current
                    if name == current then
                        a = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                k = not a
                if k then
                    f.current = "Default"
                end
            end
        end
        local function k()
            pcall(context.ensureFolders)
            local x = type(f.currentBy) ~= "table"
            if x then
                f.currentBy = {}
            end
            f.currentBy[o] = f.current or "Default"
            local function x()
                local a = context.readJson(n, "HarvardLabs_configs.json")
                local e = type(a) == "table" and type(a.currentBy) == "table"
                if e then
                    local iteratePairs, currentBy = pairs, a.currentBy
                    for key, entry in iteratePairs(currentBy) do
                        local e = key ~= o
                        if e then
                            f.currentBy[key] = entry
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(x)
            pcall(function()
                writefile(n, context.HttpService:JSONEncode(f))
            end)
        end
        local function n(o)
            local x, a = {}, { "sellLegendary", "sellUltimate" }
            for index, entry in ipairs(a) do
                if o[entry] == true and config[entry] ~= true then
                    x[#x + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            for index2, entry2 in ipairs(context.PERSIST) do
                a, index2 = o[entry2], config[entry2]
                if typeof(index2) == "Color3" and type(a) == "string" then
                    local success, I = pcall(Color3.fromHex, a)
                    if success then
                        config[entry2] = I
                    end
                elseif a ~= nil and (typeof(a) == typeof(index2) or index2 == nil and type(a) ~= "table") then
                    config[entry2] = a
                end
            end
            for index3, entry3 in ipairs(x) do
                config[entry3] = false
            end
            if #x > 0 and context.askHeldSells then
                task.defer(context.askHeldSells, x)
            end
            if context.autoClass then
                pcall(context.autoClass, true)
            end
        end

        contextProfiles = {

                local a = f
                return a.list
            end,
            save = function(a)
                local e = o(a)

                    f.list[#f.list + 1] = e
                else

                local e = current == "Default"
                if e then
                    n(context.CFG_DEFAULTS or {})
                    f.current = "Default"
                else
                    local e = o(current)
                    if not e then
                        return
                    end
                    n(e.data or {})
                    f.current = current
                end
                k()
                contextSaveConfig()
                if context.streamerRefresh then
                    pcall(context.streamerRefresh)
                end
                if
                    context.WALLS
                    and context.WALLS.set

                then
                    pcall(context.WALLS.set, config.wallsOn == true)
                end
            end,
            rename = function(a, e)
                local N = o(a)
                if not N or o(e) then
                    return
                end
                N.name = e
                N = f.current == a
                if N then
                    f.current = e
                end
                k()
            end,
            delete = function(a)
                local e, N = o(a)
                if not e then
                    return
                end
                table.remove(f.list, N)
                e = f.current
                if e == a then
                    contextProfiles.select("Default")
                end
                k()
            end,
            autosave = function()
                local data = f.current
                if not data or data == "Default" then
                    return
                end
                local f = o(data)
                if not f then
                    return
                end
                data = context.snapshot()
                local success, e = pcall(context.HttpService.JSONEncode, context.HttpService, data)
                local success3, I = pcall(context.HttpService.JSONEncode, context.HttpService, f.data or {})
                if success and success3 and e ~= I then
                    f.data, f.savedAt = data, os.date("%m/%d/%Y : %H:%M")
                    k()
                    if context.rebuildConfigList then
                        pcall(context.rebuildConfigList)
                    end
                end
            end,
        }

        -- obliterate UI: harvard's window builder is gone. This stub gives its settings code detached

        context.buildShell = function(screenGui)
            local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
            local pagesRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
            pagesRoot.Name = "Pages"
            local root = Instance.new("Frame")
            root.Name = "Window"
            pagesRoot.Parent = root
            local k = { pages = {}, order = {}, root = root, holder = root, accentBar = root }
            local function page(name, title, desc)
                local p = k.pages[name]
                if not p then
                    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                    frame.Name = name
                    frame.Parent = pagesRoot
                    local body = Instance.new("Frame")
                    body.Name = "Body"
                    body.Parent = frame
                    p = { frame = frame, body = body, tab = { id = name, name = title or name, desc = desc or "" } }
                    k.pages[name] = p
                    k.order[#k.order + 1] = name
                end
                return { frame = p.frame, body = p.body, fit = function() end,
                    isPinned = function() return false end, setPinned = function() end }
            end
            for _, id in ipairs({ "Farm", "Legendary", "AltFarm", "ModDetect", "AutoSell", "Webhook", "Visuals" }) do
                page(id)
            end
            k.page = page
            k.tw = function(inst, dur, goal)
                local t = tweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
                t:Play()
                return t
            end
            k.twd = function(inst, dur, goal, delay, style, dir)
                local t = tweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(dur, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
                    dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, delay or 0), goal)
                t:Play()
                return t
            end
            k.pressable = function() end
            k.slideTo = function(frame, layout, pad, open, done)
                frame.Visible = open and true or false
                if done then done() end
            end
            k.sections = context.sectionReg or {}
            context.sectionReg = k.sections
            k.selectTab = function() end
            k.menuPage = function(name) return k.pages[name] and k.pages[name].frame or nil end
            k.menuButton = function() return nil end
            k.notify = function(...) return context.notify and context.notify(...) end
            k.toast = function(text) return context.notify and context.notify("info", tostring(text), "") end
            k.notifyExamples = function()
                for i, e in ipairs({ { "run", "Run started", "Northern Lands, Nightmare." }, { "success", "Run won", "4:12." },
                    { "drop", "Legendary drop", "Mjolnir" } }) do
                    task.delay((i - 1) * 0.6, function() if context.notify then context.notify(e[1], e[2], e[3]) end end)
                end
            end
            k.isShown = function() return false end
            k.setShown = function() end
            k.finish = function() end
            return k
        end

                local function T(W)
                    local K = (context.BONUS_BOSS_LC or {})[W]
                    if K == "hazard" then
                        return "DODGE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
                    end
                    if K == "colour" then
                        return "COLOR BEAM - harmless", Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)

                        return "TOUCH (green orb)", Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)
                    end
                    if K == "split" then
                        return "SPLIT - leave the lethal half", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)
                    end
                    if K == "arena" then
                        return "ARENA PART - not an attack", Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)

                    K = N[W]
                    if K == "dodge" then
                        return "DODGE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)

                        return "BLAST", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 200)

                    if W:sub(1, 9) == "bonusboss" then
                        return "NOT ON ANY LIST", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 90)
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local function W(K)
                    return K:sub(1, 9) == "bonusboss" or N[K] ~= nil
                end
                local function N(K)
                    if K:IsA("Part") and K.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
                        return "ball"
                    end
                    if K:IsA("Part") and K.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
                        return "cylX"
                    end
                    local t, H, X = K.Size.X, K.Size.Y, K.Size.Z
                    if math.abs(H - X) <= 0.02 * math.max(H, X) and t < 0.25 * H then
                        return "cylX"
                    end
                    if math.abs(t - X) <= 0.02 * math.max(t, X) and H < 0.25 * t then
                        return "cylY"
                    end
                    if math.abs(t - H) <= 0.02 * math.max(t, H) and X < 0.25 * t then
                        return "cylZ"
                    end
                    return "box"
                end
                local function K(t)
                    local H, size = t.a, t.p.Size
                    if t.flat then
                        H.Size = Vector3.new(size.X, context.CFG and context.CFG.rodinSweepDrawH or 5, size.Z)
                        local color3 = context.RD and context.RD.rodinSweep
                        local QF = color3 and color3.segs and color3.segs[t.p.Parent]
                        if QF and context.sweepPlan then
                            pcall(context.sweepPlan, os.clock())
                        end
                        color3 = t.col
                        color3 = if QF and QF.T == math.huge
                            then Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)
                            else if QF and QF.fireAt then Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 20) else color3
                        if color3 and H.Color3 ~= color3 then
                            H.Color3 = color3
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if t.kind == "ball" then
                        H.Radius = math.min(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylX" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.X, math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylY" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.Y, math.min(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5
                    elseif t.kind == "cylZ" then
                        H.Height, H.Radius = size.Z, math.min(size.X, size.Y) * 0.5
                    else
                        H.Size = size
                    end
                end
                local function t(adornee, X, dF, flat)
                    local kind, OF = flat and "box" or N(adornee)
                    if kind == "ball" then
                        OF = Instance.new("SphereHandleAdornment")
                    else
                        if kind == "box" then
                            OF = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                        else
                            OF = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
                            if kind == "cylX" then

                    OF.ZIndex = 1
                    OF.Transparency = 0.6
                    OF.Color3 = X
                    local N = {
                        a = OF,
                        p = adornee,
                        kind = kind,
                        flat = flat,
                        col = X,

                    K(N)
                    OF.Parent = hlRodinTags
                    dF[#dF + 1] = N
                end
                local function N(H)
                    local X = {}
                    if H:IsA("BasePart") then
                        X[1] = H
                        return X

                                    X[#X + 1] = descendant

                            end
                        end
                        if #X > 0 then
                            return X
                        end
                    end
                    for index3, descendant2 in ipairs(H:GetDescendants()) do

                            descendant2:IsA("BasePart")
                            and descendant2 ~= H.PrimaryPart
                            and string.lower(descendant2.Name) ~= "particles"
                        then
                            X[#X + 1] = descendant2
                        end
                    end
                    return X
                end
                local function H(adornee, text, textColor3, LF)
                    local parent2 = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    parent2.Name, parent2.AlwaysOnTop, parent2.LightInfluence, parent2.Size =
                        "HLTag", true, 0, UDim2.fromOffset(240, 40)

                end
                local function X(dF)
                    if B[dF] or not dF:IsA("BasePart") and not dF:IsA("Model") then
                        return
                    end
                    local parent2, LF = dF.Parent, {
                        draws = {},
                    }
                    if dF:IsA("BasePart") and parent2 and parent2.Name == "bonusBossColorSafeSpots" then
                        LF.bb = H(dF, "SAFE SPOT: " .. dF.Name, Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255))
                    elseif
                        dF:IsA("BasePart")
                        and parent2
                        and parent2.Name == "bonusBossMemoryModel"
                        and dF.Name ~= "PrimaryPart"
                    then
                        local OF, color, DF = string.lower(dF.Name), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), 4
                        if OF:find("hitbox", 1, true) then
                            color, DF = (Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60)), 14
                        else
                            if OF:find("good", 1, true) then
                                color, DF = (Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 120)), 9
                            else
                            end
                        end
                        LF.bb = H(dF, "split part: " .. dF.Name, color, DF)
                    else
                        local OF = string.lower(dF.Name)
                        if OF == "bonusbosscolorsafespots" or not W(OF) then
                            return
                        end
                        local SF = parent2
                        while SF and SF ~= workspace2 do
                            if W(string.lower(SF.Name)) then
                                return
                            end
                            SF = SF.Parent
                        end
                        local W, QF = T(OF)
                        if not W then
                            return
                        end
                        SF = dF:IsA("BasePart") and dF
                            or dF.PrimaryPart
                            or dF:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if not SF then
                            return
                        end
                        LF.bb = H(
                            SF,
                            dF.Name
                                .. "\10"
                                .. W
                                .. ((context.ATTACKS or {})[OF] == true and "  (on dodge list)" or ""),
                            QF
