                                t(entry, QF, LF.draws, OF == "bonusbosssweepingflames")
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    B[dF] = LF
                end
                local function N(b, T)
                    pcall(function()
                        T.bb:Destroy()
                    end)
                    for index, draw in ipairs(T.draws) do
                        pcall(function()
                            draw.a:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    B[b] = nil
                end
                local function b()
                    local T = connection
                    if T then
                        connection:Disconnect()
                        connection = nil
                    end
                    z = nil
                    for key, entry in pairs(B) do
                        N(key, entry)
                    end
                    T = hlRodinTags
                    if T then
                        pcall(function()
                            hlRodinTags:Destroy()
                        end)
                        hlRodinTags = nil
                    end
                end
                function context.rodinTags(parent2)
                    b()
                    if not parent2 then
                        return
                    end
                    parent2 = localPlayer2 and (localPlayer2:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
                    if not parent2 then
                        return
                    end
                    hlRodinTags = Instance.new("Folder")
                    hlRodinTags.Name = "HLRodinTags"
                    hlRodinTags.Parent = parent2
                    for index, descendant in ipairs(workspace2:GetDescendants()) do
                        pcall(X, descendant)
                    end
                    connection = workspace2.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(b)
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(X, b)
                        end)
                    end)
                    local b = {}
                    z = b
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while true do
                            local G = z
                            if not (G == b) then
                                break
                            end
                            G = not hlRodinTags or not hlRodinTags.Parent
                            if G then
                                local parent3 = localPlayer2 and (localPlayer2:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"))
                                if parent3 then
                                    hlRodinTags = Instance.new("Folder")
                                    hlRodinTags.Name = "HLRodinTags"
                                    hlRodinTags.Parent = parent3
                                end
                            end
                            G = {}
                            for key, entry in pairs(B) do
                                if not key:IsDescendantOf(workspace2) then
                                    N(key, entry)
                                else
                                    local B = not (entry.bb and entry.bb.Parent)
                                    for index2, draw in ipairs(entry.draws) do
                                        if not draw.a.Parent then
                                            B = true
                                        else
                                            if draw.p.Parent then
                                                pcall(K, draw)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if B then
                                        N(key, entry)
                                        G[#G + 1] = key
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            for index3, entry2 in ipairs(G) do
                                pcall(X, entry2)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.15)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                local e, N =
                    {
                        bonusbossgroundflame = true,
                        bonusbosslongline = true,
                        bonusbosssmallspiralflame = true,
                        bonusbosssweepingflames = "segments",
                        thirdbossmultirings = true,
                    }, {
                        units = {},
                        conn = nil,
                        run = nil,
                    }
                local function b(B)
                    if not N.units[B] then
                        local units, z =
                            N.units, {
                                lit = {},
                                darkSince = nil,
                            }
                        z.born, units[B] = os.clock(), z
                    end
                end
                local function B(G)
                    if not G:IsA("Model") or G.Parent ~= workspace2 then
                        return
                    end
                    local z = e[string.lower(G.Name)]
                    if not z then
                        return
                    end
                    if z == "segments" then
                        for index, child in ipairs(G:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("Model") then
                                b(child)
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        b(G)
                    end
                end
                local function e(b, G)
                    local hazardReader2 = context.RD
                    hazardReader2.janitor = hazardReader2.janitor
                        or {
                            n = 0,
                            recent = {},
                        }
                    hazardReader2.janitor.n = hazardReader2.janitor.n + 1
                    local s = ""
                    pcall(function()
                        local position = b:GetPivot().Position
                        s = ("%.0f,%.0f"):format(position.X, position.Z)
                    end)
                    local recent = hazardReader2.janitor.recent
                    recent[#recent + 1] = ("%s @%s after %.1fs (clock %.1f)"):format(b.Name, s, G, os.clock())
                    if #recent > 30 then
                        table.remove(recent, 1)
                    end
                end
                function context.rodinJanitor(b)
                    if N.conn then
                        N.conn:Disconnect()
                        N.conn = nil
                    end
                    N.run = nil
                    N.units = {}
                    if not b then
                        return
                    end
                    for index, child in ipairs(workspace2:GetChildren()) do
                        pcall(B, child)
                    end
                    N.conn = workspace2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(b)
                        task.defer(function()
                            pcall(B, b)
                        end)
                    end)
                    local run = {}
                    N.run = run
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while N.run == run do
                            local now, config2 = os.clock(), context.CFG
                            for key, unit in pairs(N.units) do
                                if key.Parent and string.lower(key.Name) == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame" then
                                    local precast = key:FindFirstChild("precast")
                                    if precast and (precast:IsA("BasePart")) then
                                        unit.base = unit.base or precast.Transparency
                                        if
                                            math.abs(precast.Transparency - unit.base) > 0.05
                                            or now - unit.born >= (config2.janSpiralLife or 0.72)
                                        then
                                            e(key, now - unit.born)
                                            pcall(function()
                                                key:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if not key.Parent then
                                    N.units[key] = nil
                                else
                                    local s = true
                                    for index2, descendant in ipairs(key:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Transparency < 0.9 then
                                            unit.lit[descendant] = true
                                            s = false
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if s and next(unit.lit) ~= nil then
                                        unit.darkSince = unit.darkSince or now
                                        local s = string.lower(key.Name) == "bonusbosssmallspiralflame"
                                                and 0
                                            or (config2.janDark or 0.1) + (config2.janGrace or 0.05)
                                        if now - unit.darkSince >= s then
                                            local parent2 = key.Parent
                                            e(key, now - unit.born)
                                            N.units[key] = nil
                                            pcall(function()
                                                key:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                            if
                                                parent2
                                                and parent2 ~= workspace2
                                                and parent2:IsA("Model")
                                                and not parent2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                                            then
                                                pcall(function()
                                                    parent2:Destroy()
                                                end)
                                            end
                                        end
                                    else
                                        unit.darkSince = nil
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            task.wait(0.03)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                task.spawn(function()
                    for index = 1, 60, 1 do
                        for index2, child in ipairs(workspace2:GetChildren()) do
                            if
                                child.Name == "dungeonName"
                                and child:IsA("StringValue")

                                end
                                pcall(context.rodinJanitor, true)
                                return
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(2)
                    end
                end)
            end

                local function B(G)
                    G = tonumber(G) or 0

                        math.abs(G), context.sig3 or function(T)
                            return ("%.2f"):format(T)
                        end
                    if z >= 999500000000 then
                        return s(G / 1000000000000) .. "t"
                    end
                    if z >= 999500000 then
                        return s(G / 1000000000) .. "b"
                    end
                    if z >= 999500 then
                        return s(G / 1000000) .. "m"
                    end
                    if z >= 999.5 then
                        return s(G / 1000) .. "k"
                    end
                    return tostring(math.floor(G + 0.5))
                end
                local function G()

                    if W == "Mage" then
                        return tonumber(s.spellPower) or 0
                    end
                    if T == "weapon" then
                        return tonumber(s.physicalDamage) or 0
                    end
                    return tonumber(s.physicalPower) or 0
                end
                local function s(T)
                    return tonumber(tostring(T):match("_(%d+)$"))
                end
                local function T()
                    if game.PlaceId == 77649408247578 then
                        return false
                    end

                local function K(t, H, X)
                    local dF, QF, LF, OF = b(), {}, 1, 1
                    for key, entry in pairs(t or {}) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and (tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0) <= dF and s(key) then
                            local main, _F = z(entry, H, X), tonumber(entry.health) or 0
                            LF, OF = math.max(LF, main), math.max(OF, _F)
                            QF[#QF + 1] = {
                                n = s(key),
                                key = key,
                                item = entry,
                                main = main,
                                hp = _F,
                            }
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    t, dF, X = nil
                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(QF) do
                        index = if config.bestGearPriority == "Balanced" and H ~= "weapon"
                            then 0.7 * entry2.main / LF + 0.3 * entry2.hp / OF
                            else entry2.main + entry2.hp * 1.0E-9
                        if entry2.item.equipped == true then
                            index, t = index + 1.0E-12, entry2
                        else
                        end
                        if not dF or index > dF then
                            dF, X = index, entry2
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    return X, t
                end
                local function z(t, H)
                    local X = t == "Mage" and "spellPower" or "physicalPower"

                        (tonumber(e(X == "spellPower" and "physicalPower" or "spellPower")) or 0) + (tonumber(
                            e("stamina")
                        ) or 0),
                        "Skill points: " .. (t == "Mage" and "spell power" or "physical power")
                    QF = if dF > 0 then QF .. (" (%d elsewhere)"):format(dF) else QF

                        QF ..= " +" .. dF

                        if t then
                            pcall(t.FireServer, t, X, dF)
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    H[#H + 1] = QF
                end
                local planSpells, t

                    local H
                    local function X(dF)
                        local QF = not H

                            H = {}

                            for key, entry in iterateArray(OF) do
                                key = entry.kind == "ability"

                                    LF[entry.key] = entry.sub

                            end
                        end

                            or string.lower(tostring(dF.name))

                        QF = OF:find("movement speed", 1, true) ~= nil
                        if LF == "damaging" then
                            if OF:find("scales with spell", 1, true) then
                                return "Mage", false, QF
                            end
                            if OF:find("scales with physical", 1, true) then
                                return "Warrior", false, QF
                            end
                        elseif LF == "boosting" then
                            if OF:find("spell damage", 1, true) then
                                return "Mage", true, QF
                            end
                            if OF:find("physical damage", 1, true) then
                                return "Warrior", true, QF
                            end
                        end
                        return nil, false, false
                    end
                    local function H(dF)
                        return dF ~= nil
                            and context.CARRY_SKILLS ~= nil
                            and context.CARRY_SKILLS[string.lower(tostring(dF))] == true
                    end
                    local dF = {
                        { "q", "e" },
                        { "q2", "e2" },
                    }
                    local function QF()
                        local LF, iterateArray, SF =
                            {}, ipairs, {
                                localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack"),

                    planSpells = function(LF, OF, SF)
                        local DF, slots, _F, lF = b(), {}, {}, {}
                        for key, entry in pairs(LF.abilities or {}) do
                            local uF = s(key)
                            if type(entry) == "table" and uF then
                                local where
                                if type(entry.equipped) == "table" then
                                    for key2, entry2 in pairs(entry.equipped) do
                                        if entry2 == true then
                                            slots[key2] = {
                                                n = uF,
                                                key = key,
                                                name = entry.name,
                                            }
                                            where = key2
                                        else
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                                if (tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0) <= DF and not H(entry.name) then
                                    local mF, buff, speed = X(entry)
                                    if mF == OF then
                                        local X, mF =
                                            {
                                                n = uF,
                                                key = key,
                                                name = entry.name,
                                                buff = buff,
                                                speed = speed,
                                                req = tonumber(entry.levelReq) or 0,
                                                price = tonumber(entry.sellPrice) or 0,
                                                where = where,
                                            }, lF[entry.name]
                                        if not mF or where and not mF.where then
                                            lF[entry.name] = X
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                        local function b(X, cF, uF, hF)
                            if X.buff ~= cF.buff then
                                return X.buff == uF
                            end
                            if X.buff and X.speed ~= cF.speed then
                                return X.speed
                            end
                            if X.req ~= cF.req then
                                return X.req > cF.req
                            end
                            local uF, mF =
                                X.where ~= nil and X.where == hF and 2 or X.where ~= nil and 1 or 0,
                                cF.where ~= nil and cF.where == hF and 2 or cF.where ~= nil and 1 or 0
                            if uF ~= mF then
                                return uF > mF
                            end
                            if X.price ~= cF.price then
                                return X.price > cF.price
                            end
                            return tostring(X.name) < tostring(cF.name)
                        end
                        SF = SF or (QF())
                        local function X(QF)
                            for index, entry4 in ipairs(QF) do
                                index = slots[entry4]
                                if not (index and SF[index.name]) then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                            return true
                        end

                                                name = index5.name,

                                                end
                                            end

                                                n = index5.n,
                                                key = index5.key,
                                                name = index5.name,
                                            }
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                                if mF(slots[entry12]) then
                                    keep[slots[entry12].key] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        for slot2 in pairs(slots) do
                            OF[slot2] = true
                        end
                        X = false
                        for index9, entry13 in ipairs(QF) do

                                            else lF

                                    if lF then
                                        SF[lF.name] = true
                                        index9[entry14] = lF

                                            end
                                        end

                    t = function(b, success, QF)
                        local LF, list = planSpells(b, success), {}

                                success = if type(entry) == "table"
                                        and type(entry.equipped) == "table"
                                        and entry.equipped[move.slot] == true
                                    then tostring(entry.name) .. "#" .. tostring(s(key))
                                    else success
                            end

                                move.slot,
                                tostring(move.name),
                                tostring(move.n),
                                success and " (took off " .. success .. ")" or ""

                            success, index2 = pcall(function()
                                return DF and DF:InvokeServer("ability", move2.n, move2.slot)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.15)
                            if success and index2 == true then
                                list = list + 1
                            else
                                b = b + 1
                            end
                        end
                        if list > 0 then
                            runtimeState.speedSetCache = nil
                        end
                        success = {}
                        for index3, entry2 in ipairs(dF) do
                            local dF, DF = LF.slots[entry2[1]], LF.slots[entry2[2]]
                            entry2, index3 = dF and dF.name or "empty", DF and DF.name or "empty"
                            if H(dF and dF.name) and H(DF and DF.name) then
                                success[#success + 1] = (
                                    entry2 == index3 and entry2 .. " x2" or entry2 .. " + " .. index3
                                ) .. " (carry kit, left alone)"
                            else
                                success[#success + 1] = entry2 .. " + " .. index3
                            end
                        end
                        QF[#QF + 1] = "Spells: "
                            .. table.concat(success, "  |  ")
                            .. (list > 0 and "  (" .. list .. " put on)" or "")
                            .. (b > 0 and "  (" .. b .. " could not be put on)" or "")
                        return list
                    end
                end
                bG.planSpells = planSpells
                local b
                bG.keepers = function(s)
                    local H, X = {}, G()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(W) do
                        index = K(s[entry.bucket], entry.type, X)
                        if index then
                            H[entry.bucket .. ":" .. tostring(index.key)] = true
                        end
                    end
                    local success, QF = pcall(planSpells, s, X)

                        end

                            QF = false
                            if type(entry3.equipped) == "table" then
                                for key2, entry4 in pairs(entry3.equipped) do
                                    QF = if entry4 == true then true else QF
                                end
                                if QF then
                                    LF += 1
                                else
                                    dF[#dF + 1] = key
                                end
                            else
                                dF[#dF + 1] = key
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(dF, function(e, s)
                        return tostring(e) < tostring(s)
                    end)
                    for index2 = 1, math.min(#dF, math.max(0, 2 - LF)), 1 do
                        H["abilities:" .. tostring(dF[index2])] = true
                    end
                    return H
                end

                    -- Native inventorySlot artwork/style inspected through Potassium MCP.
                    local function createInventoryCards(parent)
                        local function make(class, props, into)
                            local object = Instance.new(class)
                            for key, value in pairs(props) do object[key] = value end
                            object.Parent = into
                            return object
                        end
                        local host = make("Frame", {
                            Name = "InventoryPreviewCards", BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 3,
                        }, parent)
                        local grid = make("UIGridLayout", {
                            CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 146),
                            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                        }, host)
                        local colors = {
                            common = Color3.fromRGB(151,151,151), uncommon = Color3.fromRGB(88,167,71),
                            rare = Color3.fromRGB(75,77,195), epic = Color3.fromRGB(146,70,159),
                            legendary = Color3.fromRGB(244,154,9), ultimate = Color3.fromRGB(225,60,60),
                        }
                        local currentCount, previousKey = 0, nil
                        local function resize()
                            local columns = host.AbsoluteSize.X >= 620 and 2 or 1
                            local width = math.max(1, math.floor((host.AbsoluteSize.X - (columns - 1) * 10) / columns))
                            grid.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 146)
                            host.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, currentCount == 0 and 0 or math.ceil(currentCount / columns) * 156 - 10)
                        end
                        host:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize)
                        local function label(parent, text, pos, size, color, bold)
                            return make("TextLabel", {
                                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = pos, Size = size,
                                Text = text, RichText = false, TextSize = 12,
                                Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham,
                                TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235),
                                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                                TextWrapped = true,
                            }, parent)
                        end
                        return function(rows, first, last, bag)
                            -- Learn any available rarity colors directly from the game's current cards.
                            local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                            local native = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                            native = native and native:FindFirstChild("inventory")
                            local buckets = {weapon="weapons", helmet="helmets", chest="chests", ability="abilities"}
                            if native and bag then
                                for _, slot in ipairs(native:GetDescendants()) do
                                    local kind = slot:IsA("ImageLabel") and slot:FindFirstChild("itemType")
                                    local num = kind and kind:FindFirstChild("uniqueItemNum")
                                    local bucket = kind and buckets[kind.Value]
                                    local data = num and bucket and bag[bucket] and bag[bucket][kind.Value .. "_" .. num.Value]
                                    if type(data) == "table" and type(data.rarity) == "string" then
                                        colors[data.rarity:lower()] = slot.ImageColor3
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            local signatures = {}
                            for i = first, last do
                                local row = rows[i]
                                signatures[#signatures + 1] = table.concat({
                                    tostring(row.uid or row.key), row.name, row.rarity, tostring(row.req),
                                    tostring(row.imageId), tostring(row.sell), row.reason, tostring(row.price),
                                    tostring(colors[row.rarity:lower()]),
                                }, "\31")
                            end
                            local key = table.concat(signatures, "\30")

                        B.Text = s()

                        for _, item in ipairs(result.rows) do
                            if item.duplicateSpell and item.sell then duplicateCount += 1 end
                        end
                        local rows = {}
                        for _, row in ipairs(result.rows) do
                            if filter == "All" or (filter == "Sell" and row.sell) or (filter == "Keep" and not row.sell) then
                                rows[#rows + 1] = row
                            end
                        end
                        local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#rows / 10))
                        page = math.clamp(page, 1, pages)
                        summary.Text = readError and (readError .. ". Showing previous snapshot; refresh to retry.")
                            or result.error
                            or ("Sell %d (spare spells %d) | Keep %d | Estimated gold: %s%s | Snapshot: %ds ago"):format(

                        pageLabel.Text = ("%s | Page %d/%d | %d items"):format(filter, page, pages, #rows)
                    end

                        if loading or inventoryAutomation.busy then return end

                            e or 0
                        )

                        textControl11.Text = ("This account is in Party %d but switched off."):format(e or 0)

                        textControl11.Text = "This account is a leecher - it joins the party and waits at spawn."
                    elseif partyQueue.isHost() then
                        textControl11.Text = H and "This account leads and carries the leechers."
                            or "This account leads the party and fights."

                            or "This account is a carry in the leader's party."

                    textControl12.Text = "Activity: " .. context.formatStatus(partyQueue.status or "off", "party")

                    end

                W[#W + 1] = "speed buff is on, fps, ping, cooldowns, then | status | attack):"
                return table.concat(W, "\10") .. "\10"
            end
            local function W()
                local K = localPlayer.Character
                local success, H, X =
                    K and (K:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), K and (K:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), {
                        runtimeState.farmEnabled and "farm" or "OFF",
                    }
                if runtimeState.modHalt then
                    X[#X + 1] = "MODHOLD"
                end
                if H then
                    local position, linearVelocity = H.Position, H.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    X[#X + 1] = ("pos %.0f,%.0f,%.0f spd %.1f"):format(
                        position.X,
                        position.Y,
                        position.Z,
                        Vector3.new(linearVelocity.X, 0, linearVelocity.Z).Magnitude
                    )
                else
                    X[#X + 1] = "no character"
                end
                if success then
                    X[#X + 1] = ("ws %.1f hp %d/%d %s"):format(
                        success.WalkSpeed,
                        math.floor(success.Health),
                        math.floor(success.MaxHealth),
                        success:GetState().Name
                    )
                end
                if K and (K:FindFirstChild("spellBuff")) then
                    X[#X + 1] = "BUFF"
                end
                local dF = 0
                pcall(function()
                    dF = stats2.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
                end)
                X[#X + 1] = ("fps %d ping %d"):format(bug.fps or 0, math.floor(dF + 0.5))
                success, H = pcall(function()
                    return getfpscap and getfpscap()
                end)
                local p = {}
                for key, entry in pairs(runtimeState.stMax or {}) do
                    p[#p + 1] = {
                        key,
                        entry,
                    }
                end
                table.sort(p, function(dF, QF)
                    return dF[2] > QF[2]
                end)
                local dF = {}
                for index = 1, math.min(4, #p), 1 do
                    dF[#dF + 1] = ("%s %.1fms"):format(p[index][1], p[index][2] * 1000)
                end
                X[#X + 1] = ("cap %s gap %.0fms slowest: %s"):format(
                    success and tostring(H) or "?",
                    (bug.gap or 0) * 1000,
                    table.concat(dF, ", ")
                )
                bug.gap = 0
                if runtimeState.stMax then
                    table.clear(runtimeState.stMax)
                end
                dF, success, p =
                    {}, ipairs, {
                        localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                        K,
                    }
                for key2, entry2 in success(p) do
                    if entry2 then
                        for index2, child in ipairs(entry2:GetChildren()) do
                            index2, K = child:FindFirstChild("abilitySlot"), child:FindFirstChild("cooldown")
                            if child:IsA("Tool") and index2 and K then
                                dF[#dF + 1] = ("%s %.1f"):format(tostring(index2.Value), tonumber(K.Value) or 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(dF)
                if #dF > 0 then
                    X[#X + 1] = "cd " .. table.concat(dF, " ")
                end
                X[#X + 1] = "| " .. tostring(runtimeState.movementState)
                X[#X + 1] = "| " .. tostring(runtimeState.attackState)
                return table.concat(X, " ")
            end

            local function contextBugStop(p)
                if not bug.on then
                    return
                end
                local Y = os.clock() - bug.t0
                add("END", ("part %d stopped: %s - %.0fs, %d lines"):format(bug.part or 1, p, Y, bug.n + 1))
                G()
                bug.on = false
                runtimeState.bugLog = nil
                runtimeState.bugKey = nil
                for index, conn in ipairs(bug.conns) do
                    pcall(function()
                        conn:Disconnect()
                    end)
                end
                table.clear(bug.conns)
                bug.all = nil
                pcall(i)
                if p == "stopped by hand" then
                    n(nil)
                    pcall(
                        C,
                        "Bug report saved.",
                        ("%d file%s (one per server) in %s in your executor's workspace folder. Send us all of them with your report."):format(
                            bug.part or 1,
                            (bug.part or 1) == 1 and "" or "s",
                            tostring(bug.where or bug.file)
                        ),
                        14
                    )
                end
                context.log("Bug report", ("stopped (%s): %s"):format(p, tostring(bug.file)))
            end
            bug.stop = contextBugStop

            local function p(Y)
                local humanoid = Y and (Y:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10))
                if not (humanoid and bug.on) then
                    return
                end
                local walkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
                local z = humanoid.Health
                bug.conns[#bug.conns + 1] = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
                    add("SPEED", ("WalkSpeed %.1f -> %.1f"):format(walkSpeed, humanoid.WalkSpeed))
                    walkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
                end)
                bug.conns[#bug.conns + 1] = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(Y)
                    local s = z - Y
                    if s >= math.max(1, humanoid.MaxHealth) * 0.05 then
                        add(
                            "HIT",
                            ("-%d (%.0f%%) -> %d/%d"):format(
                                math.floor(s),
                                s / math.max(1, humanoid.MaxHealth) * 100,
                                math.floor(Y),
                                math.floor(humanoid.MaxHealth)
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    z = Y
                end)
                bug.conns[#bug.conns + 1] = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                    add("DIED", "while: " .. tostring(runtimeState.movementState))
                    G()
                end)
            end
            local function start2(B)
                if bug.on then
                    return
                end
                if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                    C("Can't record a bug report.", "This executor can't save files.", 8)
                    return
                end
                pcall(context.ensureFolders)
                local success, s = context.PATH and context.PATH.logs or "HarvardLabs/logs", B and v() or nil
                B = not s
                if B then
                    local t
                    pcall(function()
                        t = httpService5:GenerateGUID(false):gsub("%W", ""):sub(1, 6):lower()
                    end)
                    s = {
                        on = true,
                        session = ("bugreport_%s_%s"):format(
                            os.date("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S"),
                            t or tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
                        ),
                        part = 0,
                        since = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                    }
                else
                end
                s.part = (tonumber(s.part) or 0) + 1
                local y, t = success .. "/" .. s.session, false
                pcall(function()
                    local H = type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function"
                    if H then
                        if not isfolder(y) then
                            makefolder(y)
                        end
                        t = isfolder(y)
                    end
                end)
                bug.part, bug.since, bug.where = s.part, s.since, t and y or success
                bug.file = t
                        and ("%s/part%02d_%s_place%s.txt"):format(
                            y,
                            s.part,
                            os.date("%H-%M-%S"),
                            tostring(game.PlaceId)
                        )
                    or ("%s/%s_part%02d.txt"):format(success, s.session, s.part)
                success = nil
                success, o, k, x, a, e = -math.huge, {}, {}, 0, 0, 0
                N = success
                bug.buf = {}
                bug.all = nil
                bug.bytes = 0
                bug.n = 0
                bug.last = {}
                bug.cfg = {}
                bug.t0 = os.clock()
                success, B = pcall(T)
                B = if not success then "obliterate productions bug report\10header failed: " .. tostring(B) .. "\10" else B
                if not pcall(writefile, bug.file, B) then
                    C("Can't record a bug report.", "Could not write " .. bug.file .. ".", 8)
                    return
                end
                if not w then
                    bug.all = {
                        B,
                    }
                end
                bug.bytes = #B

                n(s)

                    )
                end
                B = bug.conns
                B[#B + 1] = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(gap)
                    bug.frames = bug.frames + 1
                    if gap > (bug.gap or 0) then
                        bug.gap = gap
                    end
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(y)
                    add("SPAWN", "new character")
                    task.spawn(p, y)
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(y)
                    pcall(b, y)
                    add("PLAYER", "joined: " .. tostring(y.Name))
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(y)
                    pcall(b, y)
                    add("PLAYER", "left: " .. tostring(y.Name))
                end)
                local y, n, o = 0, 0
                B[#B + 1] = logService.MessageOut:Connect(function(q, k)
                    local x = os.clock()
                    local a = x - y >= 1
                    if a then
                        y, n = x, 0
                    end
                    n += 1
                    x = n > 40 or q == o
                    if x then
                        return
                    end
                    o = q
                    add("CONSOLE", tostring(k and k.Name or "?"):gsub("^Message", "") .. ": " .. tostring(q))
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = guiService.ErrorMessageChanged:Connect(function(y)
                    if y and y ~= "" then
                        add("KICK", y)
                        G()
                    end
                end)
                B[#B + 1] = localPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(y, q)
                    add("TELEPORT", ("%s, place %s"):format(tostring(y and y.Name), tostring(q)))
                    if y == Enum.TeleportState.Started or y == Enum.TeleportState.RequestedFromServer then
                        contextBugStop("switched servers")
                    end
                end)
                task.spawn(p, localPlayer.Character)
                i()
                if s.part == 1 then
                    C(
                        "Now recording bug report, click to stop.",
                        ("Saving to %s in your executor's workspace folder, a new file every time you change server. It keeps recording until you press the bug again."):format(
                            bug.where
                        ),
                        10
                    )

                    C(

                        ("A new file for this server in %s. Press the bug to stop recording."):format(bug.where),
                        8
                    )

                context.log("Bug report", "recording to " .. bug.file)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local now, q, now2, p = os.clock(), -math.huge, (os.clock()), false
                    while bug.on and not runtimeState.destroyed do
                        local now3 = os.clock()
                        bug.fps = math.floor(bug.frames / math.max(now3 - now, 0.05) + 0.5)
                        bug.frames = 0
                        local success3, k = pcall(W)
                        add("TICK", success3 and k or "could not read: " .. tostring(k))
                        if now3 - q >= 2 then
                            pcall(K)
                            q = now3
                        else
                        end
                        if now3 - now2 >= 1 then
                            G()
                            now2 = now3
                        else
                        end
                        p = not p
                        rec.BackgroundTransparency = p and 0 or 0.6
                        if bug.bytes >= (w and 16 or 3) * 1024 * 1024 then
                            contextBugStop("the file reached its size limit")
                            task.defer(start2, true)
                            now = now3
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        now = now3
                    end
                end)
            end

                    if index ~= "" then

                    end

            mD.partyIds = function()
                if mD.partyAt and os.clock() - mD.partyAt < 30 then
                    return mD.party
                end
                mD.partyAt = os.clock()
                local party
                local function E()
                    local p = game:GetService("TeleportService"):GetLocalPlayerTeleportData()
                    local J = type(p) == "table" and type(p.playerIds) == "table"
                    if J then
                        party = {}
                        local J, w = pairs, p.playerIds
                        for key, entry in J(w) do
                            key = tonumber(entry)
                            if key then
                                party[key] = true
                            end
                        end
                        w = tonumber(p.ownerId)
                        if w then
                            J = party
                            J[tonumber(p.ownerId)] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(E)
                mD.party = party

            end

            mD.allowed = function(player, E)
                if player == localPlayer then
                    return true
                end
                if (E or mD.names())[mD.norm(player.Name)] == true then
                    return true
                end
                E = mD.inDungeon() and mD.partyIds() or nil
                if E and E[player.UserId] then
                    return true
                end
                mD.ours = mD.ours or {}
                local p, now = mD.norm(player.Name), os.clock()
                E = mD.ours[p]
                if not E or now - E.at > 10 then
                    E = {
                        at = now,
                        ours = context.AF
                                and context.AF.entry
                                and context.AF.entry(player.Name) ~= nil
                            or context.AF and context.AF.partyOf and context.AF.partyOf(player.Name) ~= nil
                            or context.AF and context.AF.presence and context.AF.presence(
                                player.Name,
                                config.afOnlineAge or 60
                            ) ~= nil
                            or false,
                    }
                    mD.ours[p] = E
                else
                end
                return E.ours
            end
