            local function VF()
                local EF = localPlayer.Character
                local pF = EF and (EF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                if pF then
                    zone.cx, zone.cy, zone.cz = pF.Position.X, pF.Position.Y, pF.Position.Z
                end
                if not zone.cx then
                    return false
                end
                EF, pF = view.AbsoluteSize, config.mapFollow == false
                if pF then
                    local pF, jF, UF = zone.anchor(), EF.X, EF.Y
                    local JF, wF = pF.x, pF.z
                    x, e, N, K = jF, UF, JF, wF
                else
                    local pF, jF, UF = zone.big and zone.freeAt or nil, EF.X, EF.Y
                    local JF, wF = pF and pF.x or zone.cx, pF and pF.z or zone.cz
                    x, e, N, K = jF, UF, JF, wF
                end
                EF = zone.big and (config.minimapBigRange or 160) or (config.minimapRange or 110)
                dF = math.min(x, e) * 0.5 / EF * (zone.big and zone.zoomB or zone.zoomS)
                EF = dF
                return EF > 0
            end
            local function EF(pF, jF, UF, JF)
                local transform, size, vF = pF.CFrame, pF.Size, pF:IsA("Part")
                local MF = vF and pF.Shape or nil
                local ZF = MF == Enum.PartType.Ball
                if ZF then
                    SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(size.X * 0.5 * dF, 2), jF, UF, JF)
                    return
                end
                local rightVector, upVector, lookVector, oF =
                    transform.RightVector, transform.UpVector, transform.LookVector, MF == Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                if oF then
                    ZF = math.abs(rightVector.Y) > 0.7
                    if ZF then
                        SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5 * dF, 2), jF, UF, JF)
                    else
                        DF(
                            transform.X,
                            transform.Z,
                            size.X * 0.5,
                            math.min(size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5,
                            math.atan2(rightVector.Z, rightVector.X),
                            jF,
                            UF,
                            JF
                        )
                    end
                    return
                end
                oF, MF, ZF = math.abs(rightVector.Y), math.abs(upVector.Y), math.abs(lookVector.Y)
                local rF, AF, kF
                if MF >= oF and MF >= ZF then
                    rF, AF, kF = rightVector, size.X * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                else
                    if oF >= ZF then
                        rF, AF, kF = upVector, size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                    else
                        rF, AF, kF = rightVector, size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5
                    end
                end
                MF = (not vF or pF:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil)
                    and AF > 1
                    and kF > 1
                    and math.abs(AF - kF) <= math.max(AF, kF) * 0.1
                if MF then
                    SF(transform.X, transform.Z, math.max(AF, kF) * dF, jF, UF, JF)
                    return
                end
                DF(transform.X, transform.Z, AF, kF, math.atan2(rF.Z, rF.X), jF, UF, JF)
            end
            local function pF(jF, UF, JF, wF, YF, color, transparency, zIndex)
                local nF, fF = QF(jF, UF)
                jF = OF(nF, fF, JF * dF)
                if not jF then
                    return
                end
                jF, UF = math.max((JF - wF) * dF, 1), n("arc")
                UF.Position, UF.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nF, fF), UDim2.fromOffset(jF * 2, jF * 2)
                UF.ZIndex = zIndex
                zIndex = k[UF]
                zIndex.Color, zIndex.Thickness = color, math.max(wF * dF, 1)
                zIndex.Transparency = transparency
                L[UF].Rotation = math.deg(YF)
            end

            zone.draw = function()
                if not VF() then
                    o()
                    return
                end
                local v, k = zone.use3D(), context.DG
                local a, jF, UF = k and k.now or os.clock(), context.WALLS and context.WALLS.parts, zone.cy or 0
                if jF and not v then
                    for index = 1, math.min(#jF, 400), 1 do

                                math.abs(transform.UpVector.Y) > 0.7
                                and transform.Y + index > UF - 1

                UF, jF = hazardReader.rodinRig, not v

                    SF(UF.X, UF.Z, (config.rodinSweepArenaR or 100) * dF, color2, 0.3, 2, 2)
                end
                UF = jF and config.mapCrystals ~= false
                if UF then
                    JF = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("secondBossCrystals")
                    if JF then
                        local iterateArray, YF = ipairs, vmHelpers[127](JF:GetChildren())
                        for key, entry in iterateArray(vmHelpers:jB(YF)) do
                            key = string.lower(entry.Name)
                            local wF = key == "red" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
                                or key == "green" and Color3.fromRGB(60, 255, 60)
                                or key == "yellow" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 40)
                                or nil
                            key = wF and (entry:IsA("BasePart"))
                            if key then
                                local YF = math.max(entry.Size.X * 0.5 * dF, 6)
                                SF(entry.Position.X, entry.Position.Z, YF, wF, 0.15, 6)
                                SF(entry.Position.X, entry.Position.Z, YF + 3, wF, 0.2, 6, 2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                UF = jF and config.mapOrbLinks ~= false and hazardReader.orbScan
                if UF then
                    local function wF(YF, vF, MF, ZF, nF, fF, rF)
                        local oF, AF = MF - YF, ZF - vF
                        local kF = math.sqrt(oF * oF + AF * AF)
                        if kF < 1 then
                            return
                        end
                        DF(
                            (YF + MF) * 0.5,
                            (vF + ZF) * 0.5,
                            kF * 0.5,
                            fF * 0.5 / math.max(dF, 0.01),
                            math.atan2(AF, oF),
                            nF,
                            rF,
                            4
                        )
                    end
                    JF = localPlayer.Character
                    local YF, vF, MF =
                        JF and (JF:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")),
                        context.otherRoots and context.otherRoots() or {},
                        {}
                    for index2, entry2 in ipairs(hazardReader.orbScan) do
                        index2 = entry2.part
                        local fF = index2 and hazardReader.parts[index2]
                        if index2 and index2.Parent and fF and not MF[index2] then

            local L, v, M, n =
                {
                    on = false,
                    orig = {},
                    conns = {},

                }, {
                    dungeon = true,
                    Map = true,
                    map = true,

            local function o(k, a, QF)
                local OF = L.orig[k]
                if not OF then
                    OF = {}
                    L.orig[k] = OF
                else
                end
                if OF[a] == nil then
                    local success, DF = pcall(function()
                        return k[a]
                    end)
                    if not success or DF == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    OF[a] = DF
                end
                pcall(function()
                    k[a] = QF
                end)
            end
            local function k(a)
                if a:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if a.Transparency >= 0.98 then
                        return
                    end
                    o(
                        a,
                        "Color",
                        typeof(config.map3DGrey) == "Color3" and config.map3DGrey or Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 122)
                    )
                    o(a, "Material", Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
                    if a:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        o(a, "TextureID", "")
                    end
                    if a:IsA("UnionOperation") then
                        o(a, "UsePartColor", true)
                    end
                elseif a:IsA("Decal") or a:IsA("Texture") then
                    o(a, "Transparency", 1)
                elseif a:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    o(a, "TextureId", "")
                elseif a:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    o(a, "Parent", nil)
                end
            end
            local function a(QF)
                local OF = (QF:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
                while OF do
                    if OF:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        return true
                    end
                    OF = (OF:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
                end
                return false
            end
            local function QF(OF, SF)
                for index, child in ipairs(OF:GetChildren()) do
                    if not (child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
                        SF[#SF + 1] = child
                        QF(child, SF)
                    end
                end
            end
            L.set = function(OF)
                if OF == L.on then
                    return
                end
                L.on = OF
                L.gen = L.gen + 1
                for index, conn in ipairs(L.conns) do
                    pcall(conn.Disconnect, conn)
                end
                L.conns = {}
                if OF then
                    local gen, SF = L.gen, {}
                    for index2, child in ipairs(contextWorkspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if v[child.Name] then
                            QF(child, SF)

                        or Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 122)
                    local terrain = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                    if terrain then
                        L.tcol = {}
                        for index3, entry in ipairs(n) do
                            pcall(function()
                                local n = Enum.Material[entry]
                                L.tcol[entry] = terrain:GetMaterialColor(n)
                                terrain:SetMaterialColor(n, QF)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    for index4, child2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Lighting"):GetChildren()) do
                        if child2:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                            o(child2, "Density", config.map3DHaze or 0.12)
                        elseif child2:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") or child2:IsA("BlurEffect") then
                            o(child2, "Enabled", false)
                        end
                    end
                    task.spawn(function()
                        for index5 = 1, #SF, 1 do
                            if L.gen ~= gen then
                                return
                            end
                            pcall(k, SF[index5])
                            if index5 % 400 == 0 then
                                task.wait()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    for index6, child3 in ipairs(contextWorkspace:GetChildren()) do
                        if v[child3.Name] then
                            L.conns[#L.conns + 1] = child3.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
                                task.defer(function()
                                    if L.on and L.gen == gen and v.Parent and not a(v) then
                                        pcall(k, v)
                                    end
                                end)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    L.conns[#L.conns + 1] = contextWorkspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
                        if M[v.Name] then
                            task.defer(function()
                                if L.on and L.gen == gen and v:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    pcall(k, v)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    for key, entry2 in pairs(L.orig) do
                        for key2, entry3 in pairs(entry2) do
                            pcall(function()
                                key[key2] = entry3
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    L.orig = {}
                    local terrain2 = contextWorkspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                    if terrain2 and L.tcol then
                        for key3, entry4 in pairs(L.tcol) do
                            pcall(function()
                                terrain2:SetMaterialColor(Enum.Material[key3], entry4)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    L.tcol = nil
                end
            end
            local see, setMetatable5, weakKeys6 = {}, setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",
            }
            see.a = setMetatable5({}, weakKeys6)
            see.t = 0
            see.hit = nil
            see.ray = nil
            see.geo = function(M)
                if M:IsA("Terrain") or not (M.Anchored and M.CanCollide and M.Transparency < 0.95) then
                    return false
                end
                local n = M
                while n and n ~= contextWorkspace do
                    M = string.lower(n.Name)
                    if
                        M:find("hitbox", 1, true)
                        or M:find("precast", 1, true)
                        or M:find("telegraph", 1, true)
                        or M:find("warning", 1, true)
                        or M:find("safespot", 1, true)
                        or M:find("safezone", 1, true)
                        or M == "abilities"
                        or M == "enemyprojectiles"
                        or M == "projectiles"
                        or M == "vfxpool"
                        or M == "enemypool"
                        or M == "sfxpool"
                        or M == "enemies"
                        or M == "enemyfolder"
                    then
                        return false
                    end
                    if n:IsA("Model") and n:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        return false
                    end
                    n = n.Parent
                end
                return true
            end
            see.clear = function()
                for entry in pairs(see.a) do
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end)
                    see.a[entry] = nil
                end
                see.hit = nil
            end
            see.step = function(M, n, o)
                see.t = see.t + M
                if see.t >= 0.05 or not see.hit then
                    see.t = 0
                    local hit2 = {}
                    see.ray = see.ray or RaycastParams.new()
                    see.ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    see.ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
                    local position, QF, OF = n.CFrame.Position, {}, { 2, 0, -1.5 }
                    for index, entry in ipairs(OF) do
                        QF[#QF + 1] = (o + Vector3.new(0, entry, 0) - position).Unit
                    end
                    local SF, DF =
                        view.AbsolutePosition + game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset(), view.AbsoluteSize
                    for index2 = 0, 7, 1 do
                        for index3 = 0, 4, 1 do
                            QF[#QF + 1] = n:ViewportPointToRay(
                                SF.X + DF.X * (index2 + 0.5) / 8,
                                SF.Y + DF.Y * (index3 + 0.5) / 5
                            ).Direction.Unit
                        end
                    end
                    SF = (o - position).Magnitude + 3
                    for index4, entry2 in ipairs(QF) do
                        OF, index4 = position, SF
                        for index5 = 1, 5, 1 do
                            DF = contextWorkspace:Raycast(OF, entry2 * index4, see.ray)
                            if not DF then
                                break
                            end
                            index5 = DF.Instance
                            if index5:IsA("Terrain") then
                                break
                            end
                            if see.geo(index5) then
                                if
                                    DF.Normal.Y > 0.7
                                    and (DF.Position.Y < o.Y + 4 or math.min(index5.Size.X, index5.Size.Z) < 10)
                                then
                                    break
                                end
                                hit2[index5] = true
                            end
                            index4 -= (DF.Position - OF).Magnitude + 0.05
                            if index4 <= 0 then
                                break
                            end
                            OF = DF.Position + entry2 * 0.05
                        end
                    end
                    for index6, entry3 in ipairs(contextWorkspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, 1)) do
                        if see.geo(entry3) then
                            hit2[entry3] = true
                        end
                    end
                    see.hit = hit2
                end
                for entry4 in pairs(see.hit) do
                    if not see.a[entry4] then
                        see.a[entry4] = 0
                    end
                end
                n = math.min(1, M * 8)
                for key, entry5 in pairs(see.a) do
                    o = see.hit[key] and (config.map3DSeeAlpha or 0.72) or 0
                    entry5 += (o - entry5) * n
                    if o == 0 and entry5 < 0.02 then
                        see.a[key] = nil
                        pcall(function()
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                        end)
                    else
                        see.a[key] = entry5
                        pcall(function()
                            key.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry5
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            zone.see = see
            local M = {
                on = false,
                fov = 70,
            }
            local function n(o)
                if not M.on then
                    return
                end
                local camera = contextWorkspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera or not VF() then
                    return
                end
                local viewportSize, QF = camera.ViewportSize, config.map3DFov or 50
                local OF, camCur = viewportSize.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(QF) * 0.5), config.map3DMaxH or 1200
                local DF, _F = OF / dF * math.clamp(tonumber(config.map3DZoom) or 1, 0.2, 6)
                if DF > camCur then
                    DF, _F =
                        camCur, math.min(math.deg(2 * math.atan(math.tan(math.rad(QF) * 0.5) * DF / camCur)), 110)
                else
                    _F = QF
                end
                QF, OF = zone.camShot(os.clock())
                camCur = zone.camCur
                if not camCur then
                    camCur = {
                        p = QF,
                        y = OF,
                        d = DF,
                        f = _F,
                    }
                    zone.camCur = camCur
                else
                end
                local cF = 1 - math.exp(-(tonumber(o) or 0.016) * 5)
                camCur.p = camCur.p + (QF - camCur.p) * cF
                camCur.y = (camCur.y + ((OF - camCur.y + 180) % 360 - 180) * cF) % 360
                camCur.d = camCur.d + (DF - camCur.d) * math.min(1, cF * 2)
                camCur.f = camCur.f + (_F - camCur.f) * math.min(1, cF * 2)
                cF, QF =
                    view.AbsolutePosition + game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset(),
                    camCur.d * math.tan(math.rad(camCur.f) * 0.5) / math.max(viewportSize.Y * 0.5, 1)
                local DF, _F, uF, mF =
                    (cF.X + x * 0.5 - viewportSize.X * 0.5) * QF,
                    (cF.Y + e * 0.5 - viewportSize.Y * 0.5) * QF,
                    math.rad(camCur.y),
                    N
                OF, QF = mF - math.cos(uF) * DF - math.sin(uF) * _F, K
                local RF, yF =
                    QF + math.sin(uF) * DF - math.cos(uF) * _F, (zone.cy or 0) - (config.map3DGroundDrop or 3)
                if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                end
                if math.abs(camera.FieldOfView - camCur.f) > 0.01 then
                    camera.FieldOfView = camCur.f
                end
                QF, mF = Vector3.new(OF, yF, RF), camCur.p >= 89.4
                if mF then
                    camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                        QF + Vector3.new(0, camCur.d, 0),
                        QF,
                        Vector3.new(-math.sin(uF), 0, -math.cos(uF))
                    )
                else
                    RF, DF = math.rad(math.clamp(camCur.p, 5, 89.4)), Vector3.new(N, zone.cy or yF, K)
                    local transform, OF, _F, mF =
                        CFrame.lookAt(
                            DF
                                + Vector3.new(
                                        math.sin(uF) * math.cos(RF),
                                        math.sin(RF),
                                        math.cos(uF) * math.cos(RF)
                                    )
                                    * camCur.d,
                            DF
                        ),
                        camCur.d / (viewportSize.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(camCur.f) * 0.5)),
                        cF.X + x * 0.5 - viewportSize.X * 0.5,
                        cF.Y + e * 0.5 - viewportSize.Y * 0.5
                    camera.CFrame = transform - transform.RightVector * (_F * OF) + transform.UpVector * (mF * OF)
                end
                cF = config.map3DSeeThrough ~= false
                if cF then
                    pcall(see.step, tonumber(o) or 0.016, camera, Vector3.new(N, zone.cy or yF, K))
                elseif next(see.a) then
                    see.clear()
                end
            end
            zone.sync3D = function()
                local cam3On = zone.use3D()

                    UDim2.fromOffset(0, x), UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(k, 0), absoluteSize.Y)
                C[4].Position, C[4].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(M, x), UDim2.new(1, -M, 0, absoluteSize.Y)
            end

            local evstart = {
