                readyAt = -math.huge,
                tries = 0,
            }
            context.EVSTART = evstart
            local replicatedStorage2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            game:GetService("Players")
            evstart.choice = function()
                local u = config.pkEventClass or "Mage"
                if evstart.healerOff or evstart.tries >= 2 and evstart.picked == "Healer" then
                    evstart.healerOff = true
                    return u
                end
                local y = {}
                pcall(function()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(context.AF.load().accounts or {}) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.enabled ~= false then
                            y[#y + 1] = tostring(entry.name)
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if
                    #y >= (tonumber(config.pkHealerMin) or 2)
                    and string.lower(y[#y]) == string.lower(localPlayer.Name)
                then
                    return "Healer"
                end
                return u
            end
            local function u()
                local iterateArray, q =
                    ipairs, {
                        localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                        localPlayer.Character,
                    }
                for key, entry in iterateArray(q) do
                    if entry then
                        for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            evstart.tick = function()
                local remotes = replicatedStorage2:FindFirstChild("remotes")
                if not remotes then
                    return
                end
                local dungeonProgress, q, V =
                    contextWorkspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress"),
                    context.isEvent and context.isEvent(),
                    os.clock()
                if evstart.job ~= game.JobId then
                    evstart.job, evstart.arrived, evstart.picked, evstart.done, evstart.tries, evstart.pickAt, evstart.readyAt =
                        game.JobId, V, nil, false, 0, -math.huge, -math.huge
                    evstart.healerOff = nil
                    evstart.firstPickAt = nil
                    evstart.sugarAt = nil
                    evstart.sugarTries = 0
                end
                if not q then
                    return
                end
                local h = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                local E = h and (h:FindFirstChild("selectClassGui"))
                h = remotes:FindFirstChild("equipSet")
                if (q or E) and not evstart.done then
                    if evstart.picked and u() then
                        evstart.done = true
                        if context.log then
                            context.log("Event", "Quick Gear Select: " .. tostring(evstart.picked))
                        end
                    elseif
                        evstart.picked
                        and evstart.firstPickAt
                        and V - evstart.firstPickAt > (tonumber(config.pkPickMaxWait) or 10)
                    then
                        evstart.done = true
                        if context.log then
                            context.log(
                                "Event",
                                "Quick Gear Select: "
                                    .. tostring(evstart.picked)
                                    .. " - no spells came, readying anyway"
                            )
                        end
                    elseif E and h then
                        if V - evstart.pickAt < 3 then
                            return
                        end
                        if evstart.picked then
                            evstart.tries = evstart.tries + 1
                        end
                        evstart.firstPickAt = evstart.firstPickAt or V
                        evstart.picked = evstart.choice()
                        evstart.pickAt = V
                        pcall(h.FireServer, h, evstart.picked)
                        pcall(function()
                            E.Enabled = false
                        end)
                        return
                    else
                        return
                    end
                end
                if q and evstart.done and config.pkSugarstorm ~= false and evstart.picked ~= "Healer" then
                    local u, E, pkSugar, J =
                        ipairs, {
                            localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),
                            localPlayer.Character,
                        }, false, false
                    for key, entry in u(E) do
                        if entry then
                            for index, child in ipairs(entry:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                                    if child.Name == "Sugarstorm" then
                                        pkSugar = true
                                    else
                                        J = if child.Name == "Witches Brew" then true else J
                                    end
                                else
                                end
                            end
                        else
                        end
                    end
                    runtimeState.pkSugar = pkSugar
                    if pkSugar then
                        evstart.sugarTries = 0
                    elseif J and V - (evstart.sugarAt or -math.huge) > 2.5 and (evstart.sugarTries or 0) < 4 then
                        u = localPlayer.Character
                        h = u and (u:FindFirstChild("busyCasting"))
                        if not (h and h.Value == true) then
                            evstart.sugarAt, evstart.sugarTries = V, (evstart.sugarTries or 0) + 1
                            runtimeState.swapHoldUntil = os.clock() + 0.8
                            pcall(function()
                                local virtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                                local keyCode, p = Enum.KeyCode, game
                                virtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode.F, false, p)
                                task.delay(0.05, function()
                                    pcall(
                                        virtualInputManager.SendKeyEvent,
                                        virtualInputManager,
                                        false,
                                        Enum.KeyCode.F,
                                        false,
                                        game
                                    )
                                end)
                            end)
                            if context.log then
                                context.log(
                                    "Event",
                                    "Sugarstorm: set swap (F), try " .. tostring(evstart.sugarTries)
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    runtimeState.pkSugar = false
                end
                if not (dungeonProgress and dungeonProgress.Value == "playersNotReady") then
                    return
                end
                h, q = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("ready"), remotes:FindFirstChild("readyUp")
                if not (h and h.Value == false and q) then
                    return
                end
                if V - evstart.pickAt < 1.5 then
                    return
                end
                if
                    #(context.partyNotHere and context.partyNotHere() or {}) > 0
                    and V - (evstart.arrived or V) < (tonumber(config.startPartyWaitMax) or 45)
                then
                    return
                end
                if V - evstart.readyAt < 3 then
                    return
                end
                evstart.readyAt = V
                pcall(q.FireServer, q)
                if context.log then
                    context.log("Event", "ready")
                end
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                while not runtimeState.destroyed do
                    pcall(evstart.tick)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end
        do
            local pK = {
                hooked = false,
                candy = {},
                snap = {},
                on = {},
                err = nil,
            }
            context.PK = pK
            pK.MODELS = {
                passivecircle = true,
                staffslamline = true,
                staffbeamstrail = true,
                breathbeam = true,
                pumpkinshockwave = true,
                rainpumpkin = true,
                headexplosion = true,
                thrownpumpkinhead = true,
                snapvines = true,
                thornwall = true,
                branchhub = true,
                treebranch = true,
                candy = true,
                vinepoison = true,
            }
            local replicatedStorage3 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local players3, h =
                game:GetService("Players"), {
                    "PassiveCircle",
                    "LineStrike",
                    "Trail",
                    "JackOLanternBreath",
                    "HeadThrow",
                    "PumpkinRain",
                    "ThornVines",
                    "Snapvines",
                    "SnapvineStrike",
                    "CandyScatter",
                    "CandyTaken",
                    "ArenaShrink",
                }
            local function y()
                return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            end
            local function q(V)
                return os.clock() + ((tonumber(V) or 0) - y())
            end
            local function V(vector, vector2)
                local J, w = vector.X - vector2.X, vector.Z - vector2.Z
                return math.sqrt(J * J + w * w)
            end
            local function E(p)
                local J = replicatedStorage3:FindFirstChild("enemyAssets")
                J = J and (J:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                return J and (J:FindFirstChild(p))
            end
            local function O()
                return tonumber(config.pkPad) or 2.5
            end
            local function p(J, cframe, size, v, untilAt, Z, ring)
                if not context.addZone then
                    return nil
                end
                local o = {
                    name = "pk " .. J,
                    kind = "zone",
                    bubbleKeep = true,
                    exact = true,
                    weight = 1,
                    madeAt = os.clock(),
                    hardPending = true,
                    cframe = cframe,
                    size = size,
                    round = v or nil,
                    ring = ring,
                    from = Z or os.clock(),
                    untilAt = untilAt,
                }
                pcall(context.addZone, o)
                return o
            end
            local function J(w, Y, v, M, Z, n)
                local o = v + O()
                return p(w, CFrame.new(Y), Vector3.new(o * 2, 14, o * 2), true, M, Z, n)
            end
            local function w(Y, v, M, Z, untilAt, o)
                if not context.addZone then
                    return
                end
                local k, x = M + O(), {
                    { 1, 0 },
                    { -1, 0 },
                }
                for index, entry in ipairs(x) do
                    pcall(context.addZone, {
                        name = "pk " .. Y,
                        kind = "zone",
                        bubbleKeep = true,
                        exact = true,
                        weight = 1,
                        madeAt = os.clock(),
                        hardPending = true,
                        cframe = CFrame.new(v),
                        size = Vector3.new(k * 2, 14, k * 2),
                        round = true,
                        ring = math.max(Z - O(), 0.5),
                        sx = entry[1],
                        sz = entry[2],
                        from = o or os.clock(),
                        untilAt = untilAt,
                    })
                end
            end
            local function Y(v, M, Z, n, o, k, x)
                local a = Vector3.new(Z.X, 0, Z.Z)
                if a.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                    return nil
                end
                a = a.Unit
                Z = M + a * (n / 2)
                return p(v, CFrame.lookAt(Z, Z + a), Vector3.new(o + O() * 2, 14, n + O()), false, k, x)
            end
            local v = pK.on
            pK.lanes = {}
            local function M(Z, vector, o, k, hitAt, untilAt)
                if typeof(Z) ~= "Vector3" then
                    return
                end
                local e = Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z)
                if e.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                    return
                end
                e = e.Unit
                table.insert(pK.lanes, {
                    o = Z,
                    ux = e.X,
                    uz = e.Z,
                    len = tonumber(o) or 60,
                    half = tonumber(k) or 3.5,
                    hitAt = hitAt,
                    untilAt = untilAt,
                })
                while #pK.lanes > 64 do
                    table.remove(pK.lanes, 1)
                end
            end
            pK.laneOut = function(vector, n)
                if config.pkLaneOut == false then
                    return nil
                end
                local o, k = tonumber(config.pkLaneMargin) or 3, {}
                for index, lane in ipairs(pK.lanes) do
                    if n < lane.untilAt then
                        k[#k + 1] = lane
                    end
                end
                if #k == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                local function x(a, e, N, I)
                    local F, C = a - N.o.X, e - N.o.Z
                    e = F * N.ux + C * N.uz
                    if e < -1 or e > N.len + 1 then
                        return false
                    end
                    return math.abs(-F * N.uz + C * N.ux) < N.half + I
                end
                n = nil
                for index2, entry in ipairs(k) do
                    n = if x(vector.X, vector.Z, entry, o) and (not n or entry.hitAt < n.hitAt) then entry else n
                end
                if not n then
                    return nil
                end
                local a, e = vector.X - n.o.X, vector.Z - n.o.Z
                local N, I, F, C, g, i, b =
                    -a * n.uz + e * n.ux, -n.uz, n.ux, n.half + o + 0.5, { 1, -1 }, math.huge
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(g) do
                    a = entry2 * C - N
                    e, entry2 = Vector3.new(vector.X + I * a, vector.Y, vector.Z + F * a), math.abs(a)
                    for index4, entry3 in ipairs(k) do
                        entry2 = if entry3 ~= n and x(e.X, e.Z, entry3, o * 0.5) then entry2 + 50 else entry2
                    end
                    entry2 = if pK.inside and not pK.inside(e, 0) then entry2 + 100 else entry2
                    entry2 = if pK.redOnPath and pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, e.X, e.Z)
                        then entry2 + 200
                        else entry2
                    entry2 = if pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(e.X, e.Z, 1.5) then entry2 + 150 else entry2
                    if entry2 < i then
                        i, b = entry2, e
                    else
                    end
                end
                return b
            end
            pK.circles = {}
            v.PassiveCircle = function(Z)
                local n = E("PassiveCircle")
                local o = n and n:GetAttribute("Radius") or 12.5
                n = J("circle", Z.point, o, q(Z.hitTime) + 0.3)
                if n then
                    n.weight = context.pkNoHits and context.pkNoHits() and 1
                        or (tonumber(config.pkCircleWeight) or 0.35)
                end
                if typeof(Z.point) == "Vector3" then
                    table.insert(pK.circles, {
                        p = Z.point,
                        r = tonumber(o) or 12.5,
                        hitAt = q(Z.hitTime),
                    })
                    while #pK.circles > 40 do
                        table.remove(pK.circles, 1)
                    end
                end
            end
            pK.dashOk = function(vector, n, o, k)
                if config.pkCandyDash == false then
                    return false
                end
                local x, a = n.X - vector.X, n.Z - vector.Z
                n = math.sqrt(x * x + a * a)
                local e = math.max(n - (config.pkDashReach or 2.5), 0)
                if e < 0.5 then
                    return true
                end
                local N, I, F = x / n, a / n, math.max(o or 16, 8)
                if pK.redOnPath and pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, vector.X + N * e, vector.Z + I * e) then
                    return false
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.lanes or {}) do
                    if k < entry.untilAt then
                        for index2 = 0, e, 2 do
                            n, index = vector.X + N * index2, vector.Z + I * index2
                            x, index2 = n - entry.o.X, index - entry.o.Z
                            a = x * entry.ux + index2 * entry.uz
                            if
                                a >= -1
                                and a <= entry.len + 1
                                and math.abs(-x * entry.uz + index2 * entry.ux) < entry.half + 3
                            then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index3, entry2 in ipairs(pK.lethal or {}) do
                    if k < entry2.landAt + 0.1 then
                        for index4 = 0, e, 2 do
                            o, x = vector.X + N * index4, vector.Z + I * index4
                            if (o - entry2.p.X) ^ 2 + (x - entry2.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry2.r + O()) ^ 2 then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for index5 = 0, e, 2 do
                    if pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(vector.X + N * index5, vector.Z + I * index5, 1.5) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                n = config.pkDashBody or 1.5
                for index6, circle in ipairs(pK.circles) do
                    if k < circle.hitAt + 0.1 then
                        index6, a, x = circle.r + n, vector.X - circle.p.X, vector.Z - circle.p.Z
                        o = a * N + x * I
                        local Z = o * o - (a * a + x * x - index6 * index6)
                        if Z > 0 then
                            local n = -o - math.sqrt(Z)
                            if -o + math.sqrt(Z) > 0 and n < e then
                                if
                                    k + (e + (e - math.max(n, 0))) / F
                                    > circle.hitAt - (config.pkDashMargin or 0.25)
                                then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            v.LineStrike = function(Z)
                pK.firstFan = true
                local n = os.clock()
                if not pK.lineAt or n - pK.lineAt > 5 then
                    pK.fanAt = n
                end
                pK.lineAt = n
                if typeof(Z.origin) == "Vector3" then
                    pK.fanO = Z.origin
                end
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z.dirs or {}) do
                    index, n = ipairs, {
                        entry,
                        -entry,
                    }
                    for key, entry2 in index(n) do
                        Y(
                            "line",
                            Z.origin,
                            entry2,
                            Z.radius,
                            Z.width + 2 * (config.pkFanExtra or 0),
                            q(Z.hitTime) + (config.pkFanAfter or 0.15)
                        )
                        M(
                            Z.origin,
                            entry2,
                            Z.radius,
                            (tonumber(Z.width) or 7) / 2,
                            q(Z.hitTime),
                            q(Z.hitTime) + (config.pkFanAfter or 0.15)
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            v.Trail = function(Z)
                pK.softUntil = math.max(pK.softUntil or 0, q(Z.hitTime) + 0.5)
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z.segments or {}) do
                    local o, k = entry[1], tonumber(entry[2]) or 0
                    if typeof(o) == "CFrame" then
                        p("trail", o, Vector3.new(Z.width + O() * 2, 14, k + O()), false, q(Z.hitTime) + 0.35)
                    end
                end
            end
            v.JackOLanternBreath = function(Z)
                local n = Vector3.new(math.cos(Z.aim), 0, math.sin(Z.aim))
                Y("breath", Z.origin + n * 3, n, math.max(Z.length - 3, 1) + O(), Z.width, q(Z.fireEnd) + 0.3)
                M(Z.origin, n, Z.length, (tonumber(Z.width) or 20) / 2, q(Z.shootStart), q(Z.fireEnd) + 0.2)
            end
            pK.lethal = {}
            v.HeadThrow = function(Y)
                J("head", Y.impact, tonumber(Y.radius) or 30, q(Y.impactTime) + 0.3)
                if typeof(Y.impact) == "Vector3" then
                    table.insert(pK.lethal, {
                        p = Y.impact,
                        r = tonumber(Y.radius) or 30,
                        landAt = q(Y.impactTime),
                        name = "head throw",
                    })
                    while #pK.lethal > 16 do
                        table.remove(pK.lethal, 1)
                    end
                end
            end
            v.PumpkinRain = function(Y)
                pK.softUntil = math.max(
                    pK.softUntil or 0,
                    q((Y.landTime or 0) + 3 * (Y.ringInterval or 0) + (Y.ringDelay or 0)) + 0.5
                )
                local M, Z = {}, E("PumpkinShockwave")
                for index, entry in ipairs(Z and Z:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    index = entry:GetAttribute("Radius")
                    if index and (entry:IsA("BasePart")) then
                        local k, x = #M + 1, {
                            inner = index,
                        }
                        x.outer, M[k] = math.max(entry.Size.Y, entry.Size.Z) / 2, x
                    end
                end
                table.sort(M, function(n, o)
                    return n.inner < o.inner
                end)
                M = if #M == 0
                    then {
                        {
                            inner = 0,
                            outer = 11.75,
                        },
                        {
                            inner = 26,
                            outer = 29.5,
                        },
                        {
                            inner = 44,
                            outer = 47.5,
                        },
                    }
                    else M
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(Y.impacts or {}) do
                    for index3, entry3 in ipairs(M) do
                        index2 = q((Y.landTime or 0) + (index3 - 1) * (Y.ringInterval or 0) + (Y.ringDelay or 0))
                        Z = index3 == 1 and os.clock() or index2 - (config.pkRingLead or 0.9)
                        if index3 == 1 then
                            J("ring" .. index3, entry2, entry3.outer, index2 + 0.3, Z)
                        else
                            w("ring" .. index3, entry2, entry3.outer, entry3.inner, index2 + 0.3, Z)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            v.ThornVines = function(w)
                pK.thorn = {
                    centre = w.centre,
                    angles = w.angles or {},
                    speed = tonumber(w.speed) or 0,
                    spinStart = w.spinStart,
                    spinEnd = w.spinEnd,
                    growStart = w.growStart,
                }
            end
            pK.roots = {}
            v.Snapvines = function(w)
                pK.snap[w.id] = tonumber(w.precastRadius) or 8
                local untilAt = tonumber(w.expire) and q(w.expire) or os.clock() + 15
                for key, entry in pairs(w.vines or {}) do
                    if type(entry) == "table" and typeof(entry.base) == "Vector3" then
                        key = tonumber(config.pkVineRootR) or 6
                        J("vine root", entry.base, key, untilAt)
                        table.insert(pK.roots, {
                            p = entry.base,
                            r = key,
                            untilAt = untilAt,
                        })
                        while #pK.roots > 8 do
                            table.remove(pK.roots, 1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            pK.nearRoot = function(w, Y, M)
                local now = os.clock()
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.roots or {}) do
                    if
                        now < entry.untilAt
                        and (w - entry.p.X) ^ 2 + (Y - entry.p.Z) ^ 2 < (entry.r + (M or 0)) ^ 2
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            v.SnapvineStrike = function(w)
                J("vine", w.target, pK.snap[w.id] or 8, q(w.landed) + 0.3)
                if typeof(w.target) == "Vector3" then
                    table.insert(pK.lethal, {
                        p = w.target,
                        r = pK.snap[w.id] or 12,
                        landAt = q(w.landed),
                        name = "grab circle",
                    })
                    while #pK.lethal > 16 do
                        table.remove(pK.lethal, 1)
                    end
                end
            end
            pK.lethalOut = function(vector, Y, M)
                if config.pkLethalOut == false then
                    return nil
                end
                local Z, n = {}
                for index, entry in ipairs(pK.lethal) do
                    if M < entry.landAt + 0.1 then
                        Z[#Z + 1] = entry
                        n = if not n and V(vector, entry.p) < entry.r + O() then entry else n
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not n then
                    return nil
                end
                M = n.r + O() + (config.pkLethalOutMargin or 2)
                if
                    Y ~= nil
                    and typeof(Y.point) == "Vector3"
                    and not (Y.label and tostring(Y.label):find("last resort", 1, true))
                    and not (context.BB and context.BB.pickedSafe == false)
                    and V(Y.point, n.p) >= M
                then
                    return nil
                end
                Y = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local o = Y and (Y:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                Y = o and (o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or o.PrimaryPart)
                local vector2, x, a = Y and Y.Position, vector.X - n.p.X, vector.Z - n.p.Z
                local e, N, I = x * x + a * a - M * M, math.huge
                for index2 = 0, 15, 1 do
                    o = index2 * 3.141592653589793 / 8
                    index2, Y = math.cos(o), math.sin(o)
                    local C = index2 * x + Y * a
                    local g = C * C - e
                    if g >= 0 then
                        local e = -C + math.sqrt(g)
                        local vector3 = Vector3.new(vector.X + index2 * e, vector.Y, vector.Z + Y * e)
                        local g = (not pK.inside or pK.inside(vector3, 0))
                            and not pK.redOnPath(vector.X, vector.Z, vector3.X, vector3.Z)
                        for index3, entry2 in ipairs(Z) do
                            g = if g and entry2 ~= n and V(vector3, entry2.p) < entry2.r + O() then false else g
                        end
                        if g and pK.nearRoot and pK.nearRoot(vector3.X, vector3.Z, 1.5) then
                        else
                            if g then
                                local O
                                if vector2 then
                                    local Z, g = vector2.X - vector.X, vector2.Z - vector.Z
                                    local i = math.clamp(Z * index2 + g * Y, 0, e)
                                    Z, g = vector.X + index2 * i - vector2.X, vector.Z + Y * i - vector2.Z
                                    O = if (config.pkBossKeep or 0) > 0
                                            and math.sqrt(Z * Z + g * g) < config.pkBossKeep
                                        then e + 25
                                        else e
                                else
                                    O = e
                                end
                                if O < N then
                                    N, I = O, vector3
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                if not I then
                    o = math.sqrt(x * x + a * a)
                    if o < 0.5 then
                        x, a, o = 1, 0, 1
                    else
                    end
                    I = Vector3.new(n.p.X + x / o * M, vector.Y, n.p.Z + a / o * M)
                else
                end
                return I, n.name
            end
            v.CandyScatter = function(O)
                pK.throwAt = os.clock()
                local w = {
                    landAt = q(O.landTime),
                    endAt = q(O.endTime),
                    pieces = {},
                }
                for index, entry in ipairs(O.candies or {}) do
                    local M = {
                        point = entry.point,
                        good = entry.good == true,
                    }
                    if not M.good then
                        M.zone =
                            J("red candy", entry.point, tonumber(config.pkRedR) or 6, w.endAt + 0.5, os.clock())
                    end
                    w.pieces[index] = M
                end
                pK.candy[O.id] = w
            end
            v.CandyTaken = function(O)
                local q = pK.candy[O.id]
                local J = q and q.pieces[O.index]
                if J then
                    J.taken = true
                    if J.zone then
                        J.zone.untilAt = os.clock()
                    end
                end
            end
            v.ArenaShrink = function(O)
                pK.shrink = {
                    start = O.start,
                    moveTime = tonumber(O.moveTime) or 1,
                    holdTime = tonumber(O.holdTime) or 0,
                    inset = tonumber(O.inset) or 0,
                }
            end
            pK.nextFan = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                if pK.throwAt and now - pK.throwAt < 8 and not (pK.fanAt and pK.fanAt > pK.throwAt) then
                    return pK.throwAt + (config.pkFanAfterThrow or 4.5)
                end
                if pK.fanAt then
                    return pK.fanAt + (config.pkFanLoop or 45.1)
                end
                if pK.startAt then
                    return pK.startAt + (config.pkFirstFan or 11.9)
                end
                return nil
            end
            pK.fanWindow = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                if pK.fanAt and now - pK.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2) then
                    return true
                end
                local q = pK.nextFan()
                if not q then
                    return false
                end
                return now >= q - (config.pkFanLead or 3.5) and now <= q + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
            end
            pK.openingHold = function()
                if config.pkOpeningHold == false or pK.firstFan then
                    return false
                end
                local O = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local q = O and (O:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                O = q and (q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                if not O or O.MaxHealth <= 0 then
                    return false
                end
                return O.Health >= O.MaxHealth - 1
            end
            pK.redTouch = function(O, q, J, w)
                local now, M, Z, n = os.clock(), tonumber(config.pkRedTouch) or 6, J - O, w - q
                J = Z * Z + n * n
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if not piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                w, index = piece.point.X - O, piece.point.Z - q
                                key = J > 1.0E-6 and math.clamp((w * Z + index * n) / J, 0, 1) or 0
                                local O, q = w - Z * key, index - n * key
                                if key > 0.02 and O * O + q * q < M * M then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            pK.redOnPath = function(O, q, J, w)
                local now, M, Z, n = os.clock(), tonumber(config.pkRedClear) or 6, J - O, w - q
                w = Z * Z + n * n
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if not piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                key, index = piece.point.X - O, piece.point.Z - q
                                J = w > 1.0E-6 and math.clamp((key * Z + index * n) / w, 0, 1) or 0
                                local O, q = key - Z * J, index - n * J
                                if O * O + q * q < M * M then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            pK.greenLive = function()
                local now = os.clock()
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if now < entry.endAt then
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if piece.good and not piece.taken then
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local function O(pos)
                local J = {}
                pcall(function()
                    for index, entry in ipairs(context.AF.load().accounts or {}) do
                        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.enabled ~= false then
                            J[string.lower(tostring(entry.name))] = true
                        end
                    end
                end)
                J[string.lower(localPlayer.Name)] = true
                local w = {}
                for index2, entry2 in ipairs(players3:GetPlayers()) do
                    if J[string.lower(entry2.Name)] then
                        index2 = entry2.Character
                        local humanoid, Z =
                            index2 and (index2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")),
                            index2 and (index2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                        if entry2 == localPlayer then
                            w[#w + 1] = {
                                name = entry2.Name,
                                pos = pos,
                                me = true,
                            }
                        elseif humanoid and Z and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                            w[#w + 1] = {
                                name = entry2.Name,
                                pos = Z.Position,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(w, function(q, J)
                    return q.name < J.name
                end)
                return w
            end
            pK.goal = function(myCandy)
                local J, w = os.clock(), {}
                for key, entry in pairs(pK.candy) do
                    if J > entry.endAt + 1 then
                        pK.candy[key] = nil
                    else
                        for index, piece in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                            if
                                piece.good
                                and not piece.taken
                                and not piece.skip
                                and J < entry.endAt - 0.2
                                and math.abs(myCandy.Y - 3 - piece.point.Y) <= (config.pkCandyDy or 6)
                                and (
                                    config.pkCandyThorns ~= false
                                        and not (context.pkNoHits and context.pkNoHits())
                                        and pK.inArena(piece.point, 0.5)
                                    or pK.inside(piece.point, 1)
                                )
                            then
                                piece.landAt = entry.landAt
                                local n, aim = tonumber(config.pkRedClear) or 6, piece.point
                                for index2, piece2 in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                                    if not piece2.good and not piece2.taken then
                                        index, index2 =
                                            piece.point.X - piece2.point.X, piece.point.Z - piece2.point.Z
                                        local x = math.sqrt(index * index + index2 * index2)
                                        if x < n + 3.5 and x > 0.3 then
                                            local a = math.min(2.5, n + 3.5 - x)
                                            aim = Vector3.new(
                                                piece.point.X + index / x * a,
                                                piece.point.Y,
                                                piece.point.Z + index2 / x * a
                                            )
                                        else
                                        end
                                    else
                                    end
                                end
                                local Y = true
                                for index3, piece3 in ipairs(entry.pieces) do
                                    if not piece3.good and not piece3.taken and V(aim, piece3.point) < n then
                                        Y = false
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                piece.aim = aim
                                if Y then
                                    w[#w + 1] = {
                                        p = piece,
                                        endAt = entry.endAt,
                                    }
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #w == 0 then
                    pK.myCandy = nil
                    return nil
                end
                local Y, M, Z, n, o =
                    O(myCandy),
                    tonumber(config.pkCandySpeed) or 16,
                    pK.fanO or Vector3.new(config.pkFanX or 104, 0, config.pkFanZ or 1042)
                if pK.fanAt and J - pK.fanAt < (config.pkFanTail or 3.2) then
                    n, o = J - 1, pK.fanAt + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
                else
                    if pK.nextFan then
                        myCandy = pK.nextFan()
                        if myCandy and myCandy > J - 1 then
                            n, o = myCandy + (config.pkFanHitAfter or 0.93), myCandy + (config.pkFanTail or 3.2)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                local O, k, x = {}, {}, {}
                for index4, entry2 in ipairs(Y) do
                    O[index4], k[index4] = J, entry2.pos
                end
                J = {}
                for index5 = 1, #w, 1 do
                    J[index5] = true
                end
                myCandy = nil
                for index6 = 1, #w, 1 do
                    local e, N, I
                    for index7, entry3 in ipairs(Y) do
                        for index8, entry4 in ipairs(w) do
                            if J[index8] then
                                index6 = V(k[index7], entry4.p.aim or entry4.p.point)
                                index6 = if entry3.me
                                        and not x[index7]
                                        and pK.myCandy == entry4.p
                                    then math.max(index6 - (config.pkCandyStick or 4), 0)
                                    else index6
                                local C = O[index7] + index6 / M
                                if
                                    o
                                    and (config.pkCandyFanRule == true or context.pkNoHits and context.pkNoHits())
                                then
                                    local a = V(entry4.p.aim or entry4.p.point, Z)
                                    C = if a < (config.pkFanCandyFar or 30)
                                            and C > n - math.max(0, (config.pkFanSafeR or 40) - a) / M - (config.pkFanSpare or 0.6)
                                            and C < o
                                        then o + ((config.pkFanSafeR or 40) + 5 - a) / M
                                        else C
                                else
                                end
                                if
                                    C < entry4.endAt - 0.2
                                    and (
                                        not e
                                        or C < e - 1.0E-6
                                        or math.abs(C - e) <= 1.0E-6
                                            and (index7 < N or index7 == N and index8 < I)
                                    )
                                then
                                    e, N, I = C, index7, index8
                                else
                                end
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not N then
                        break
                    end
                    J[I] = false
                    O[N], k[N] = e + (config.pkCandyPickT or 0.3), w[I].p.aim or w[I].p.point
                    if not x[N] then
                        x[N] = w[I].p
                        myCandy = if Y[N].me then w[I].p else myCandy
                    else
                    end
                end
                pK.myCandy = myCandy
                return myCandy and (myCandy.aim or myCandy.point) or nil
            end
            local O
            local function q()
                local V = O
                if V then
                    local J = O
                    return J
                end
                V = E("Thornwall")
                local J, w, iterateArray, M, Z =
                    V and tonumber(V:GetAttribute("HalfX")) or 62.42,
                    V and tonumber(V:GetAttribute("HalfZ")) or 41.43,
                    ipairs,
                    {
                        V and (V:FindFirstChild("Vines")),
                        V and (V:FindFirstChild("Thorns")),
                    },
                    0
                for key, entry in iterateArray(M) do
                    for index, entry2 in ipairs(entry and entry:GetChildren() or {}) do
                        V, key =
                            ipairs, {
                                entry2:GetAttribute("A"),
                                entry2:GetAttribute("B"),
                            }
                        for key2, entry3 in V(key) do
                            if typeof(entry3) == "Vector3" then
                                key2 = math.min(J - math.abs(entry3.X), w - math.abs(entry3.Z))
                                    + (tonumber(entry2:GetAttribute("Radius")) or 0.5)
                                Z = if key2 > Z then key2 else Z
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                O = math.clamp(Z, 2, 20)
                w = O
                return w
            end
            local function O()
                local shrink = pK.shrink
                if not shrink then
                    return 0
                end
                local J = y() - (tonumber(shrink.start) or 0)
                if J <= 0 then
                    return 0
                end
                local w, Y =
                    math.clamp(J / shrink.moveTime, 0, 1),
                    math.clamp((J - shrink.moveTime - shrink.holdTime) / shrink.moveTime, 0, 1)
                return shrink.inset * (w * w * (3 - w * 2) - Y * Y * (3 - Y * 2))
            end
            pK.arena = function()
                local bossBarriers = workspace:FindFirstChild("BossBarriers")
                local J, w, Y, M =
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierWest")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierEast")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierNorth")),
                    bossBarriers and (bossBarriers:FindFirstChild("BarrierSouth"))
                if not (J and w and Y and M) then
                    return nil
                end
                local V, Z, n, o =
                    J.Position.X + J.Size.X / 2,
                    w.Position.X - w.Size.X / 2,
                    Y.Position.Z + Y.Size.Z / 2,
                    M.Position.Z - M.Size.Z / 2
                if V > Z then
                    V, Z = Z, V
                else
                end
                if n > o then
                    n, o = o, n
                else
                end
                return {
                    x0 = V,
                    x1 = Z,
                    z0 = n,
                    z1 = o,
                }
            end
            pK.borderDepth = function()
                local V = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local J = V and (V:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                V = J and (J:GetAttribute("BorderSlamTime"))
                if not V or y() < V then
                    return 0
                end
                V = tonumber(config.pkBorderPad) or 6
                V = if pK.greenLive and pK.greenLive()
                    then math.min(V, tonumber(config.pkBorderPadCandy) or 4)
                    else V
                local shrink, w = pK.shrink, O()
                w = if shrink
                    then if y() - (tonumber(shrink.start) or 0)
                            <= (tonumber(shrink.moveTime) or 2.5)
                                + (tonumber(shrink.holdTime) or 8)
                        then math.max(w, tonumber(shrink.inset) or 0)
                        else w
                    else w
                return q() + w + V
            end
            pK.thornDepth = function()
                local V = workspace:FindFirstChild("enemies")
                local J = V and (V:FindFirstChild("Pumpkin King"))
                V = J and (J:GetAttribute("BorderSlamTime"))
                if not V or y() < V then
                    return 0
                end
                return q() + O()
            end
            pK.clamp = function(vector, q)
                local V = pK.arena()
                if not V then
                    return vector
                end
                local J = (q or 0) + pK.borderDepth()
                if V.x1 - V.x0 <= J * 2 or V.z1 - V.z0 <= J * 2 then
                    return vector
                end
                return Vector3.new(
                    math.clamp(vector.X, V.x0 + J, V.x1 - J),
                    vector.Y,
                    math.clamp(vector.Z, V.z0 + J, V.z1 - J)
                )
            end
            success2, band2 = setmetatable, {
                __mode = "k",
            }
            pK.maxHp = success2({}, band2)
            pK.attackersOut = function()
                local O, R, q = false, 0, 0
                for index, entry in ipairs(players3:GetPlayers()) do
                    index = entry.Character
                    local w = index and (index:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
                    index = w ~= nil and w.Health > 0
                    if index and w.MaxHealth > 500 then
                        pK.maxHp[entry] = w.MaxHealth
                    end
                    w = pK.maxHp[entry]
                    if w then
                        if w >= (tonumber(config.pkHealerHp) or 4000) then
                            O = if index then true else O
                        else
                            R += 1
                            local lives = entry:FindFirstChild("lives")
                            q = if not index
                                    and lives
                                    and tonumber(lives.Value)
                                    and lives.Value <= 0
                                then q + 1
                                else q
                        end
                    else
                    end
                end
                return R > 0 and q == R and O, R
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                while not runtimeState.destroyed do
                    task.wait(1)
                    pcall(function()
                        if config.pkRestartNoDps == false or not (context.isEvent and context.isEvent()) then
                            pK.outSince = nil
                            return
                        end
                        local dungeonProgress = workspace:FindFirstChild("dungeonProgress")
                        if
                            not (dungeonProgress and dungeonProgress.Value == "inProgress")
                            or pK.restartJob == game.JobId
                        then
                            pK.outSince = nil
                            return
                        end
                        local O, R = pK.attackersOut()
                        if not O then
                            pK.outSince = nil
                            return
                        end
                        pK.outSince = pK.outSince or os.clock()
                        if os.clock() - pK.outSince < (tonumber(config.pkRestartWait) or 2) then
                            return
                        end
                        pK.restartJob = game.JobId
                        if context.log then
                            context.log(
                                "Event",
                                ("all %d attackers are out of lives - the healer cannot finish the boss: restarting the run"):format(
                                    R
                                )
                            )
                        end
                        if context.notify then
                            context.notify(
                                "warning",
                                "Restarting the run",
                                ("All %d attackers are out - the healer cannot finish the boss. Back to the lobby to start again."):format(
                                    R
                                ),
                                8
                            )
                        end
                        local localPlayer2 = players3.LocalPlayer
                        pcall(function()
                            local partyQueue = context.AF
                            partyQueue.loadReal(true)
                            local R = partyQueue.partyOf(localPlayer2.Name, partyQueue.doc)
                            if R then
                                R.leaveNow = {
                                    job = game.JobId,
                                    at = os.time(),
                                }
                                partyQueue.save()
                            end
                        end)
                        if context.AF and context.AF.leaveGo then
                            context.AF.leaveGo(os.clock(), "every attacker is out of lives - restarting the run")
                        elseif context.MD and context.MD.goLobby then
                            pcall(context.MD.goLobby)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()

                    pcall(function()

            pK.inArena = function(vector, u)
                local R = pK.arena()
                if not R then
                    return true
                end
                u = u or 0
                return vector.X > R.x0 + u and vector.X < R.x1 - u and vector.Z > R.z0 + u and vector.Z < R.z1 - u
            end
            pK.inside = function(vector, u)
                local vector2 = pK.clamp(vector, u)
                return math.abs(vector2.X - vector.X) < 0.01 and math.abs(vector2.Z - vector.Z) < 0.01
            end
            pK.border = function(O)
                local u = pK.arena()
                if not u then
                    return
                end
                local R, q, V, J, w = u.x0, u.x1, u.z0, u.z1, pK.borderDepth()
                if w <= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local u, Y, M, Z, n, o =
                    os.clock() + 0.6, (R + q) / 2, (V + J) / 2, q - R, J - V, tonumber(config.pkBorderOut) or 40
                p("border", CFrame.new(R + (w - o) / 2, O, M), Vector3.new(w + o, 14, n + o * 2), false, u)
                p("border", CFrame.new(q - (w - o) / 2, O, M), Vector3.new(w + o, 14, n + o * 2), false, u)
                p("border", CFrame.new(Y, O, V + (w - o) / 2), Vector3.new(Z + o * 2, 14, w + o), false, u)
                p("border", CFrame.new(Y, O, J - (w - o) / 2), Vector3.new(Z + o * 2, 14, w + o), false, u)
            end
            local O
            local function u()
                local R = O
                if R then
                    local q = O
                    return q
                end
                R = E("TreeBranch")
                local q = R and (R:FindFirstChild("Branch"))
                O = if R
                        and R.PrimaryPart
                        and q
                    then math.abs(R.PrimaryPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(q.CFrame).Position.Z) + q.Size.Z / 2
                    else 57.5
                R = O
                return R
            end
            pK.thornJump = function(O, R)
                local thorn = pK.thorn
                if not thorn then
                    return
                end
                local V = y()
                if V > (thorn.spinEnd or 0) + 0.5 then
                    pK.thorn = nil
                    return
                end
                if V < (thorn.growStart or 0) + 0.45 then
                    return
                end
                local y, E = R.X - thorn.centre.X, R.Z - thorn.centre.Z
                R = math.sqrt(y * y + E * E)
                if R > u() + 3 or R < 2 then
                    return
                end
                local u, J = math.atan2(E, y), tonumber(config.pkThornLead) or 0.18
                local function y(E)
                    return math.clamp(
                        E - (thorn.spinStart or 0),
                        0,
                        (thorn.spinEnd or 0) - (thorn.spinStart or 0)
                    ) * thorn.speed
                end
                local E, w, Y = y(V), y(V + J), math.atan2(2.5, math.max(R, 1))
                for index, angle in ipairs(thorn.angles) do
                    J, index = angle + E, angle + w
                    if index < J then
                        J, index = index, J
                    else
                    end
                    y = u
                    while y < J - Y - 3.141592653589793 do
                        y += 6.283185307179586
                    end
                    while y > J - Y + 3.141592653589793 do
                        y -= 6.283185307179586
                    end
                    if y >= J - Y and y <= index + Y then
                        if O.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                            O.Jump = true
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            pK.hook = function()
                if pK.hooked then
                    return true
                end
                local O

                        key = type(entry) == "function"
                            and islclosure(entry)
                            and tostring(debug.info(entry, "s")):find("EnemyClientEffects", 1, true)

                            local iteratePairs, y = pairs, vmHelpers[127](debug.getupvalues(entry))

                                key2 = type(entry2) == "table"

                                            and type(entry3) == "table"
                                            and type(rawget(entry3, "CandyScatter")) == "function"
                                        if q then
                                            O = entry3
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                entry2 = O
                                if entry2 then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        entry = O
                        if entry then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(u)
                u = not O
                if u then
                    return false
                end
                u = rawget(O, "__hlOrig")
                local R = type(u) ~= "table"
                if R then
                    u = {}
                    rawset(O, "__hlOrig", u)
                else
                end
                for index, entry4 in ipairs(h) do
                    local h = u[entry4] or rawget(O, entry4)
                    R = type(h) == "function"
                    if R then
                        u[entry4] = h
                        index = O
                        rawset(index, entry4, function(O, u, R)
                            local y = v[entry4]
                            if y and type(R) == "table" and not runtimeState.destroyed then

                    "onBlueBeam",
                    "orbCrossIn",
                    "orbArrive",
                    "redRoute",
                    "pathBlocked",
                }
                for index29, entry32 in ipairs(success2) do
                    d(context.BB, entry32, "BB." .. entry32)
                end
            end
            bugButton = { "spiralList", "spiralArms", "spiralWalkBad", "spiralRedOn", "groupPlan" }
            for index30, entry33 in ipairs(bugButton) do
                d(context, entry33, entry33)
            end
        end
        runtimeState.mainConnection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if runtimeState.destroyed then
                return
            end
            if runtimeState.modHalt then
                return
            end
            local d = os.clock()
            local perf, cur = runtimeState.perf
            if perf then
                local wasRodin = hazardReader.rodinRig ~= nil and hazardReader.rodinRig.Parent ~= nil
                if perf.wasRodin and not wasRodin and not context.NOVIS then
                    pcall(function()
                        local P, u =
                            (context.PATH and context.PATH.logs or "HarvardLabs/logs") .. "/perf_rodin.jsonl",
                            game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
                                ver = ver,
                                at = os.time(),
                                set = perf.sets.rodin,
                            })
                        if appendfile and isfile and isfile(P) then
                            appendfile(P, u .. "\10")
                        elseif writefile then
                            writefile(P, u .. "\10")
                        end
                    end)
                    perf.sets.rodin = perf.newSet()
                end
                perf.wasRodin = wasRodin
                cur = wasRodin and perf.sets.rodin or perf.sets.other
                perf.cur = cur
                if d - (perf.pingAt or 0) > 1 then
                    perf.pingAt = d
                    local max, ping = (runtimeState.pingS or 0) * 1000, cur.ping
                    ping.n, ping.sum = ping.n + 1, ping.sum + max
                    if max > ping.max then
                        ping.max = max
                    end
                    if max > 150 then
                        ping.over150 = ping.over150 + 1
                    end
                    if max > 300 then
                        ping.over300 = ping.over300 + 1
                    end
                end
                if not context.NOVIS and d - (perf.savedAt or 0) > 10 then
                    perf.savedAt = d
                    pcall(function()
                        if writefile then
                            writefile(
                                (context.PATH and context.PATH.logs or "HarvardLabs/logs") .. "/perf.json",
                                game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
                                    ver = ver,
                                    secs = d - perf.since,
                                    sets = perf.sets,
                                })
                            )
                        end
                    end)
                end
                wasRodin = cur.frames
                local P = d - (wasRodin.last or d)
                wasRodin.last, wasRodin.n = d, wasRodin.n + 1
                if P > wasRodin.maxGap then
                    wasRodin.maxGap = P
                end
                if P > 0.05 then
                    wasRodin.gap50 = wasRodin.gap50 + 1
                end
                if P > 0.1 then
                    wasRodin.gap100 = wasRodin.gap100 + 1
                    if P > 0.25 then
                        wasRodin.gap250 = wasRodin.gap250 + 1
                    end
                    local spikes = wasRodin.spikes
                    local h, m =
                        #spikes + 1, {
                            at = d - perf.since,
                            gap = P,
                            work = wasRodin.lastWork or 0,
                        }
                    m.state, spikes[h] = tostring(runtimeState.movementState or ""):sub(1, 70), m
                    if #spikes > 40 then
                        table.remove(spikes, 1)
                    end
                end
            else
            end
            local mainLoop = config.tickHz or 0
            if mainLoop > 0 then
                if runtimeState.lastTickAt and d - runtimeState.lastTickAt < 1 / mainLoop then
                    return
                end
                runtimeState.lastTickAt = d
            end
            O("reader", context.readerTick, d)
            O("lobby", context.lobbyTick, d)
            O("config", context.autosaveTick, d)
            O("range", context.judgeCasts, d)
            O("buffs", context.buffTick, d)
            O("brain", l, d)
            O("caster", context.casterTick, d)
            O("face", context.faceTick, d)
            runtimeState.econN = (runtimeState.econN or 0) + 1
            if
                not (
                    config.lowEndEconomy ~= false
                    and (runtimeState.tickMs or 0) > (config.lowEndLoad or 2)
                    and runtimeState.econN % 2 == 0
                )
            then
                O("draw", context.drawTick, d)
            end
            mainLoop = os.clock() - d
            if mainLoop > (runtimeState.stMax.mainLoop or 0) then
                runtimeState.stMax.mainLoop = mainLoop
            end
            runtimeState.tickMs = runtimeState.tickMs * 0.9 + (os.clock() - d) * 100
            if cur then
                local Q, work = os.clock() - d, cur.work
                work.n, work.sum = work.n + 1, work.sum + Q
                if Q > work.max then
                    work.max = Q
                end
                if Q > 0.008 then
                    work.over8 = work.over8 + 1
                end
                if Q > 0.016 then
                    work.over16 = work.over16 + 1
                end
                if Q > 0.033 then
                    work.over33 = work.over33 + 1
                end
                cur.frames.lastWork = Q
            end
        end)
    end

    return components
end)()

local context = {}
components.coreSettings(context)
context.loadConfig()
components.attackCatalog(context)
components.gearProfiles(context)
components.movementBoost(context)
components.hazardReader(context)
components.dangerGeometry(context)
components.odinMechanics(context)
components.bossPhases(context)
components.bubbleBoss(context)
components.movementCombat(context)
components.inventoryAutomation(context)
components.partyQueue(context)
components.raidAutomation(context)
components.uiLibrary(context)
components.drawing(context)
components.walls(context)
components.allTimeAnalytics(context)
components.statisticsWebhooks(context)
components.legendaryFarm(context)
components.winterVisuals(context)
components.abilityColorizer(context)
components.obliterateUI(context)
-- User tuning wins over automatic presets, including their saved overlay values.
for _, name in ipairs({ "applyClassProfile", "apply1186", "applyBurst" }) do
    local original = context[name]
    if original then
        context[name] = function(...)
            local result = table.pack(original(...))
            context.reapplyTuning()
            return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
        end
    end
end
context.reapplyTuning()
components.interfaceMainLoop(context)
context.applyNorthernFastClearTuning()

return context
